`internal/game/actions/doc.go`:

```go
// Package actions ports the object action-script runner
// (godot/action_runner.gd; driver C0:5359, fetch C0:536D, handler table
// C0:70AA, continuations C0:7022; docs/action-scripts.md has the
// per-opcode evidence). One StepPass is one logic pass of the engine's
// object loop (C0:51F7), objects in slot order, all rolling on the
// shared field RNG.
//
// The goldens are the engine trails exports/tests/trails/*.trail.gz,
// replayed the way main.gd's --actreplay replays them (ReplayTrail):
// every non-leader slot spawns from its first sample and must match
// each later sample; the first mismatch per slot is reported and any
// divergence fails.
//
// Frame timing of action opcodes is NOT ported: the runner models the
// logic pass, not animation frames (op 27's pose frames only as a
// counter), and opcodes no trail reaches stay unmodeled — an unmodeled
// op or continuation sets Error and halts that object (the GDScript's
// stance; a divergence, never a fallback).
//
// Dependencies are narrow interfaces defined here: FieldRNG (the field
// stream; internal/game/rng owns the implementation), the walk grid and
// class table through *mapfmt.WalkGrid plus the Classes bytes (the
// object gate C0:57FF reads Attr/Low/classes directly, not the
// flattened Walk flag), and map data through TrailMap/NPCRecord in the
// replay. The runner takes the F8 bank and FF:6500 field tables as
// bytes; nothing here reads files.
package actions

```

`internal/game/actions/party.go`:

```go
package actions

import (
	"sort"
)

// PartyInput is C0:7DA9, run each field frame after the object loop
// (C0:06AA-06B0); a step it starts moves from the next frame's loop.
// pad = $02 (the high joypad byte: 01 right, 02 left, 04 down, 08 up,
// 40 Y).
func (r *Runner) PartyInput(pad int) {
	o := r.Objects[0]
	if o.EventDriven || r.Latch != 0 { // C0:7DAC, 7DB4
		return
	}
	r.Hop = 0
	if o.T8 == 0 { // C0:7DD0
		if o.Op != 0 && !(o.Op == 0x0B && pad&0x0F != 0) {
			return
		}
	} else if o.Op != 0 && o.Op != 0x02 {
		return
	}
	o.T7 = 1                            // C0:7E0B
	if pad&0x40 != 0 && pad&0x0F != 0 { // C0:7E14: Y runs one row faster
		if (o.Spd&0x0F)+1 != o.Row {
			r.setRow(o, (o.Spd&0x0F)+1)
		}
		if o.D6&0x20 != 0 {
			r.Hop = 1
		}
	} else if (o.Spd & 0x0F) != o.Row {
		r.setRow(o, o.Spd&0x0F)
	}
	if o.D7&0x90 == 0x10 && o.Row != 0 { // C0:7E7A: slow ground
		r.setRow(o, o.Row-1)
	}
	if o.D6&0x10 != 0 { // C0:7E95
		r.Hop = 2
		r.setRow(o, 1)
	}
	r.d8e7 = pad | 0x10
	r.d8e8 = 0
	r.partyDispatch(o, pad)
}

// partyDispatch is C0:8052: right, left, down, up in that order.
func (r *Runner) partyDispatch(o *Object, bits int) {
	switch {
	case bits&1 != 0:
		r.partyStep(o, 3)
	case bits&2 != 0:
		r.partyStep(o, 2)
	case bits&4 != 0:
		r.partyStep(o, 1)
	case bits&8 != 0:
		r.partyStep(o, 0)
	}
}

// partyStep is C0:8090/8129/81CB/8252: the walk direction (hop, stairs
// from $D9D8, then the map slope) and the facing passed to 62C3.
func (r *Runner) partyStep(o *Object, d int) {
	mdir := d
	face := d
	stairBit := [4]int{0x40, 0x20, 0x10, 0x08}[d]
	slopeBit := 0x40
	if d >= 2 {
		slopeBit = 0x20
	}
	hi := false
	if r.Hop != 0 {
		mdir = r.Hop*4 + [4]int{0x0C, 0x0D, 0x0E, 0x0F}[d]
	} else if o.D8&stairBit != 0 {
		hi = o.D8&0x80 != 0
		mdir = (o.D8 & 4) + partyDiag(d, hi)
		face = partyDiagFace(d, hi)
	} else if r.PartySlope[0] != 0 && (r.PartySlope[1]&slopeBit) != 0 {
		hi = r.PartySlope[1]&0x80 != 0
		mdir = ((r.PartySlope[1] & 1) << 2) + partyDiag(d, hi)
		face = partyDiagFace(d, hi)
	}
	o.MDir = mdir
	r.face62c3(o, face)
	r.setMotion(o)
	switch r.partyChecks(o) {
	case "gate":
		r.partySlide(o, d)
	case "block":
		r.partyBump(o)
	default:
		r.partyGo(o)
	}
}

func partyDiag(d int, hi bool) int {
	i := 0
	if hi {
		i = 1
	}
	return [4][2]int{{4, 7}, {6, 5}, {4, 5}, {6, 7}}[d][i]
}

func partyDiagFace(d int, hi bool) int {
	i := 0
	if hi {
		i = 1
	}
	return [4][2]int{{2, 3}, {3, 2}, {2, 2}, {3, 3}}[d][i]
}

// face62c3 is C0:62C3's facing part: a tile class with $D9D7 bit 5
// forces $D9D8 & 3; a changed facing on a diagonal or slope walk shows
// west or east.
func (r *Runner) face62c3(o *Object, face int) {
	if o.D7&0x20 != 0 {
		face = o.D8 & 3
	}
	if face != o.Dir {
		o.Dir = face
		if o.MDir >= 4 && o.MDir < 0x10 {
			o.Dir = ((o.MDir & 2) >> 1) | 2
		}
	}
}

// partySlide is C0:80F8 (vertical) / 821F (horizontal): one retry
// toward the slide direction the gate left in $D8E7.
func (r *Runner) partySlide(o *Object, d int) {
	if r.d8e8 != 0 {
		return
	}
	r.d8e8 = 1
	if d < 2 {
		r.d8e7 &= 3
		if r.d8e7&1 != 0 {
			r.partyStep(o, 3)
		} else if r.d8e7&2 != 0 {
			r.partyStep(o, 2)
		}
	} else {
		r.d8e7 &= 0x0C
		if r.d8e7&4 != 0 {
			r.partyStep(o, 1)
		} else if r.d8e7&8 != 0 {
			r.partyStep(o, 0)
		}
	}
}

// partyGo is C0:7F73: a passed step walks one tile (op 02), or hops
// (op 0F).
func (r *Runner) partyGo(o *Object) {
	switch o.Op {
	case 0x0F, 0x11, 0x12, 0x1D, 0x1E:
		return
	}
	if r.Hop != 0 { // C0:7F8A: hop 1 moves at row 2, hop 2 at row 1
		row := 1
		if r.Hop == 1 {
			row = 2
		}
		v := r.velocity(row, o.MDir&3)
		o.Vel = &v
		o.Pxp = 0xFF
		o.Pyp = 0xFF
		o.C4 = 0
		o.Op = 0x0F
	} else {
		o.C4 = o.C3
		o.Op = 0x02
	}
	o.T8 = 0
}

// partyBump is C0:7FFA: a step blocked by an object touches the
// objects whose $D9B2 low bits are 1 or 3 and whose shape meets the
// leader's target.
func (r *Runner) partyBump(o *Object) {
	slots := make([]int, 0, len(r.Objects))
	for slot := range r.Objects {
		slots = append(slots, slot)
	}
	sort.Ints(slots)
	for _, slot := range slots {
		if slot == 0 {
			continue
		}
		n := r.Objects[slot]
		if n.Scene || n.Stamp == nil {
			continue
		}
		f := n.GateFlags & 3
		if f == 1 || f == 3 {
			if !intIn(r.PartyBumped, slot) {
				r.PartyBumped = append(r.PartyBumped, slot)
			}
		}
	}
}

// partyChecks is C0:593E + 7731 for slot 0: "gate" (with the slide
// probes run), "block" (collision) or "".
func (r *Runner) partyChecks(o *Object) string {
	off := r.offset(o.MDir)
	tx := o.X + off.X
	ty := o.Y + off.Y
	if tx < 0 || ty < 0 {
		return "gate"
	}
	cx := tx >> 3
	cy := ty >> 3
	if !r.partyBounds(cx, cy, off) {
		return "gate"
	}
	cx %= r.Wrap.X >> 3
	cy %= r.Wrap.Y >> 3
	cls := r.classAt(cx, cy)
	flags := o.GateFlags | o.Plane
	fc := cls[0]
	if flags&0x30 == 0x10 { // C0:5A60: bit-4 rule, no slide
		if fc&0x10 != 0 {
			return "gate"
		}
	} else if fc&0xC0 == 0xC0 || flags&0xF0&fc != 0 { // C0:5A8A
		if cls[2]&0x84 == 0x04 {
			r.d8e8 = 1
		}
		if r.d8e8 == 0 && o.MDir < 4 {
			r.partyProbe(o, cx, cy, o.MDir)
		}
		return "gate"
	}
	if fc&(8>>(o.MDir&3)) != 0 { // C0:5922, no slide
		return "gate"
	}
	// C0:7731 on slot 0
	keep := cls[1]&0x80 != 0
	testPlane := 0
	if keep {
		testPlane = r.planeIndexOf(o)
	} else if cls[0]&0xC0 == 0x40 {
		testPlane = 1
	}
	r.apply(o.Stamp, r.planeIndexOf(o), false)
	st := r.shapeAt((*o.Hitbox)[o.Dir&3], tx, ty)
	if r.hits(&st, r.Planes[testPlane]) {
		r.apply(o.Stamp, r.planeIndexOf(o), true)
		return "block"
	}
	r.stampObj(o, &st, testPlane)
	if !keep {
		o.Plane = planeBits(cls[0])
	}
	r.footprint(o)
	o.D6 = cls[1]
	o.D7 = cls[2]
	o.D8 = cls[3]
	return ""
}

// partyBounds is C0:5976-5A39: bounds x0..x1, y0..y1 inclusive.
// Stepping onto x0/y0 queues that edge's word when the map has edge
// words (otherwise it is just open); stepping onto x1/y1 queues it or,
// without edge words, blocks. A queued word skips the remaining bound
// checks.
func (r *Runner) partyBounds(cx, cy int, off Vec) bool {
	x0, y0, x1, y1 := r.Bounds[0], r.Bounds[1], r.Bounds[2], r.Bounds[3]
	if cx < x0 {
		return false
	}
	if cx == x0 && off.X < 0 && r.PartyEdgesOn {
		r.PartyEdges = append(r.PartyEdges, r.PartyEdgeWords[2])
		return true
	}
	if cx > x1 {
		return false
	}
	if cx == x1 && off.X > 0 {
		if !r.PartyEdgesOn {
			return false
		}
		r.PartyEdges = append(r.PartyEdges, r.PartyEdgeWords[3])
		return true
	}
	if cy < y0 {
		return false
	}
	if cy == y0 && off.Y < 0 && r.PartyEdgesOn {
		r.PartyEdges = append(r.PartyEdges, r.PartyEdgeWords[0])
		return true
	}
	if cy > y1 {
		return false
	}
	if cy == y1 && off.Y > 0 {
		if !r.PartyEdgesOn {
			return false
		}
		r.PartyEdges = append(r.PartyEdges, r.PartyEdgeWords[1])
	}
	return true
}

// partyClassOk is C0:5AFA-5BC5: the slide probes' class rules (no
// $D8FE tests, no low buffer, no side bit).
func (r *Runner) partyClassOk(o *Object, cls [4]int) bool {
	flags := o.GateFlags | o.Plane
	fc := cls[0]
	if flags&0x30 == 0x10 {
		return fc&0x10 == 0
	}
	return fc&0xC0 != 0xC0 && flags&0xF0&fc == 0
}

// partyProbe is C0:5AAE-5AF9: probe the two tiles diagonally ahead;
// the first open one sets the slide direction (2/1 west/east for
// north-south steps, 8/4 north/south for west-east steps).
func (r *Runner) partyProbe(o *Object, cx, cy, d int) {
	w := r.Wrap.X >> 3
	h := r.Wrap.Y >> 3
	tries := [2][3]int{{-1, 0, 2}, {1, 0, 1}}
	if d >= 2 {
		tries = [2][3]int{{0, -1, 8}, {0, 1, 4}}
	}
	for _, t := range tries {
		if r.partyClassOk(o, r.classAt(posmod(cx+t[0], w), posmod(cy+t[1], h))) {
			r.d8e7 = t[2]
			return
		}
	}
}

```

`internal/game/actions/replay.go`:

```go
package actions

import (
	"fmt"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"saga3/internal/mapfmt"
)

// The replay harness: the Go port of main.gd's replay_trail
// (--actreplay). An engine trail sampled at the object-loop start
// (PASS/TR/PTY/INSTALL/ACTOR lines as written by the acttrail-style
// captures) is replayed on the runner with the map's walk grid and
// bounds; every non-leader slot spawns from its first sample and must
// match each later sample. The result reports the first mismatch per
// slot (plus the first RNG divergence) and Diverged when any slot
// mismatched or no slot matched a single pass.

// TrailMap is the replay's map side: the walk grid, gate bounds, the
// open-map flag, the NPCs indexed by entry (tag), the header's slope
// byte (-1 none) and the edge words.
type TrailMap struct {
	Grid       *mapfmt.WalkGrid
	Bounds     [4]int
	Open       bool
	NPCs       []NPCRecord
	Slope      int
	EdgeEvents [4]int
}

// Assets is the replay's read-only data: the F8 bank, the FF:6500
// field tables, the F9:A400 class table and the per-graphic hitboxes
// (graphic_hitboxes.json, indexed by graphic).
type Assets struct {
	BankF8   []byte
	Tables   []byte
	Classes  []byte
	Hitboxes [][4]Hitbox
}

// SeededRNG is FieldRNG plus the raw state access a replay needs: the
// trail's PASS lines carry the engine's ($0A, $0B) at each pass start,
// and exact comparison injects the first as the initial state.
type SeededRNG interface {
	FieldRNG
	SetState(a, b uint8)
	State() (a uint8, b uint8)
}

// TrailResult is a replay's verdict: per-slot lines and whether any
// slot diverged.
type TrailResult struct {
	Lines    []string
	Diverged bool
}

type extras struct{ spd, c4, c6, c7, c8, mdir, tag int }

type actorSpawn struct{ slot, gfx, x, y, ef3, off, shift int }

type trailData struct {
	tr          map[int]map[int]State
	ex          map[int]*extras
	passRNG     map[int][2]uint8
	passWindow  map[int]bool
	planeTr     map[int]map[int]int
	installs    map[int][][2]int
	pads        map[int]int
	partyOK     map[int]bool
	actors      map[int][]actorSpawn
	firstRNG    [2]uint8
	hasFirstRNG bool
}

// ReplayTrail replays one trail (text) on the map and data; every
// non-leader slot spawns from its first sample and must match each
// later sample. Party trails (PTY lines) run slot 0 too, from the
// recorded joypad.
func ReplayTrail(text string, tm *TrailMap, assets *Assets, rng SeededRNG) (*TrailResult, error) {
	td, err := parseTrail(text)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse trail: %w", err)
	}
	runner, err := NewRunner(assets.BankF8, assets.Tables, rng)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("new runner: %w", err)
	}
	if err := runner.SetMap(tm.Grid, assets.Classes, tm.Bounds, tm.Open); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("set map: %w", err)
	}
	rng.SetState(td.firstRNG[0], td.firstRNG[1])
	party := len(td.pads) > 0
	partySlope := [2]int{0, 0}
	if tm.Slope >= 0 {
		partySlope = [2]int{1, tm.Slope}
	}
	edgesOn := false
	for _, w := range tm.EdgeEvents {
		edgesOn = edgesOn || w != 0
	}
	var out []string
	passes := make([]int, 0, len(td.tr))
	for p := range td.tr {
		passes = append(passes, p)
	}
	sort.Ints(passes)
	dead := map[int]string{}
	matched := map[int]int{}
	rngDiverged := -1
	for _, pnum := range passes {
		next, ok := td.tr[pnum+1]
		if !ok {
			break
		}
		lead := State{}
		if l, ok := next[0]; ok {
			lead = l
		} else if l, ok := td.tr[pnum][0]; ok {
			lead = l
		}
		if !party {
			runner.LeaderPos = &Vec{lead.X, lead.Y}
			if len(td.actors) > 0 {
				if cur, ok := td.tr[pnum][0]; ok && runner.Objects[0] == nil {
					// objOp 2E copies slot 0: keep a frozen copy of the
					// sampled leader (it does not step; leader_pos drives
					// NPCs)
					runner.Spawn(0, cur)
					ef0 := td.ex[0]
					runner.SetExtras(0, ef0.spd, ef0.c4, ef0.c6, ef0.c7, ef0.c8, -1)
					hb := LeaderHitbox
					runner.Objects[0].Hitbox = &[4]Hitbox{hb, hb, hb, hb}
					runner.Objects[0].Halted = true
				}
			}
		}
		if plane, ok := td.planeTr[pnum][0]; ok {
			runner.LeaderPlane = plane
			runner.LeaderPlaneFixed = true
		}
		if party && runner.Objects[0] == nil {
			if cur, ok := td.tr[pnum][0]; ok {
				// the party leader: its own shape (0F82) and $D9B2 from the trail
				runner.Spawn(0, cur)
				e0 := td.ex[0]
				runner.SetExtras(0, e0.spd, e0.c4, e0.c6, e0.c7, e0.c8, -1)
				runner.Objects[0].MDir = e0.mdir
				lb := 0
				if plane, ok := td.planeTr[pnum][0]; ok {
					lb = plane
				}
				hb := LeaderHitbox
				runner.SetObject(0, NPCRecord{GateFlags: 0, Hitbox: [4]Hitbox{hb, hb, hb, hb}}, lb, nil)
				runner.PartySlope = partySlope
				runner.PartyEdgesOn = edgesOn
				runner.PartyEdgeWords = tm.EdgeEvents
			}
		}
		cur := td.tr[pnum]
		slots := make([]int, 0, len(cur))
		for slot := range cur {
			slots = append(slots, slot)
		}
		sort.Ints(slots)
		for _, slot := range slots {
			if slot == 0 || runner.Objects[slot] != nil {
				continue
			}
			e := td.ex[slot]
			if e == nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("pass %d slot %03X: no first sample", pnum, slot)
			}
			runner.Spawn(slot, cur[slot])
			runner.SetExtras(slot, e.spd, e.c4, e.c6, e.c7, e.c8, -1)
			runner.Objects[slot].MDir = e.mdir
			// the slot tag $D9D9 is the NPC's entry index (older trails
			// without it assume every entry spawned in order)
			if e.tag < 0 || e.tag >= len(tm.NPCs) {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("pass %d slot %03X: NPC entry %d, map has %d", pnum, slot, e.tag, len(tm.NPCs))
			}
			plane := -1
			if p, ok := td.planeTr[pnum][slot]; ok {
				plane = p
			}
			at := runner.StampTarget(slot)
			runner.SetObject(slot, tm.NPCs[e.tag], plane, &at)
			runner.Objects[slot].Tag = e.tag
		}
		runner.StepPass(td.passWindow[pnum])
		partyOK := true
		if gated, has := td.partyOK[pnum]; has {
			partyOK = gated
		}
		if _, has := td.pads[pnum]; has && runner.Objects[0] != nil && !td.passWindow[pnum] && partyOK {
			runner.PartyInput(td.pads[pnum])
		}
		if acts, has := td.actors[pnum]; has && runner.Objects[0] != nil && !party {
			// the queue runs objOp 2E at the next frame's start: the copy
			// sees the leader as pass pnum+1 samples it, with its stamp
			leadNext, ok := next[0]
			if !ok {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("pass %d: actor spawn but pass %d has no slot-000 sample", pnum, pnum+1)
			}
			runner.SetState(0, leadNext)
			if plane, ok := td.planeTr[pnum+1][0]; ok {
				runner.Objects[0].Plane = plane
			} else {
				runner.Objects[0].Plane = 0
			}
			if runner.leaderStamp != nil {
				st := *runner.leaderStamp
				runner.Objects[0].Stamp = &st
			}
			for _, act := range acts {
				if act.gfx < 0 || act.gfx >= len(assets.Hitboxes) {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("pass %d: actor graphic %d, %d hitboxes", pnum, act.gfx, len(assets.Hitboxes))
				}
				aslot, err := runner.SpawnActor(act.gfx, act.x, act.y, act.ef3, assets.Hitboxes[act.gfx])
				if err != nil {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("pass %d: spawn actor: %w", pnum, err)
				}
				if aslot != act.slot {
					out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("actor slot %03X, engine %03X", aslot, act.slot))
					return &TrailResult{Lines: out, Diverged: true}, nil
				}
				if act.off >= 0 {
					// the copied stamp parameters: slot 0's $D9CD/$D9CF as the
					// engine holds them (from its last check, not its position)
					cst := runner.Objects[aslot].Stamp
					cst.Off = act.off
					cst.Shift = act.shift
				}
			}
		}
		for _, ins := range td.installs[pnum] {
			islot := runner.FindObject(ins[0], -1)
			if islot > 0 {
				if err := runner.Install(islot, ins[1], true); err != nil {
					out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("install pass %d slot %03X id %04X: %v", pnum, islot, ins[1], err))
					return &TrailResult{Lines: out, Diverged: true}, nil
				}
			}
		}
		if rngDiverged < 0 {
			if erng, has := td.passRNG[pnum+1]; has {
				a, b := rng.State()
				if a != erng[0] || b != erng[1] {
					rngDiverged = pnum
					out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("rng diverges in pass %d: runner %02X/%d, engine %02X/%d", pnum, a, b, erng[0], erng[1]))
				}
			}
		}
		oslots := make([]int, 0, len(runner.Objects))
		for slot := range runner.Objects {
			oslots = append(oslots, slot)
		}
		sort.Ints(oslots)
		for _, slot := range oslots {
			if _, isDead := dead[slot]; isDead {
				continue
			}
			want, ok := next[slot]
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			if slot == 0 && !party {
				continue // a frozen copy of the sampled leader
			}
			got := runner.StateOf(slot)
			if got != want {
				dead[slot] = fmt.Sprintf("pass %d got %s want %s (%s)", pnum+1, got, want, runner.Error)
				runner.SetState(slot, want)
			} else {
				matched[slot]++
			}
		}
	}
	oslots := make([]int, 0, len(runner.Objects))
	for slot := range runner.Objects {
		oslots = append(oslots, slot)
	}
	sort.Ints(oslots)
	for _, slot := range oslots {
		if reason, isDead := dead[slot]; isDead {
			out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("slot %03X: %s", slot, reason))
		} else {
			out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("slot %03X: matched %d passes", slot, matched[slot]))
		}
	}
	if len(matched) == 0 {
		out = append(out, "no slot matched a single pass (empty or unparsed trail)")
	}
	return &TrailResult{Lines: out, Diverged: len(dead) > 0 || len(matched) == 0}, nil
}

// parseTrail reads the PASS/TR/PTY/INSTALL/ACTOR lines; unknown keys on
// a known line kind are ignored (the captures carry more counters than
// the replay reads).
func parseTrail(text string) (*trailData, error) {
	td := &trailData{
		tr:         map[int]map[int]State{},
		ex:         map[int]*extras{},
		passRNG:    map[int][2]uint8{},
		passWindow: map[int]bool{},
		planeTr:    map[int]map[int]int{},
		installs:   map[int][][2]int{},
		pads:       map[int]int{},
		partyOK:    map[int]bool{},
		actors:     map[int][]actorSpawn{},
	}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(text, "\n") {
		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\r")
		tok := strings.Fields(line)
		if len(tok) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		kv := map[string]string{}
		for _, f := range tok[1:] {
			e := strings.IndexByte(f, '=')
			if e < 0 {
				continue
			}
			kv[f[:e]] = f[e+1:]
		}
		switch tok[0] {
		case "PASS":
			if len(tok) < 2 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("PASS line without a pass number: %q", line)
			}
			p, err := strconv.Atoi(tok[1])
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("PASS number %q: %w", tok[1], err)
			}
			a, err := hexVal(kv["rnga"])
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("PASS %d rnga: %w", p, err)
			}
			b, err := hexVal(kv["rngb"])
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("PASS %d rngb: %w", p, err)
			}
			w76, err := hexVal(kv["w76"])
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("PASS %d w76: %w", p, err)
			}
			td.passRNG[p] = [2]uint8{uint8(a), uint8(b)}
			td.passWindow[p] = w76 != 0
			if !td.hasFirstRNG {
				td.firstRNG = td.passRNG[p]
				td.hasFirstRNG = true
			}
		case "TR":
			f, err := atoiField(kv, "f")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			slot, err := hexField(kv, "y")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			st := State{}
			for _, g := range []struct {
				key string
				dst *int
			}{
				{"scr", &st.Scr}, {"pos", &st.Pos}, {"t7", &st.T7}, {"t8", &st.T8},
				{"op", &st.Op}, {"x", &st.X}, {"yy", &st.Y}, {"dir", &st.Dir},
			} {
				v, err := hexField(kv, g.key)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("TR f=%d y=%03X %s: %w", f, slot, g.key, err)
				}
				*g.dst = v
			}
			if td.tr[f] == nil {
				td.tr[f] = map[int]State{}
			}
			td.tr[f][slot] = st
			if b2, has := kv["b2"]; has {
				v, err := hexVal(b2)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("TR f=%d y=%03X b2: %w", f, slot, err)
				}
				if td.planeTr[f] == nil {
					td.planeTr[f] = map[int]int{}
				}
				td.planeTr[f][slot] = v & 0xC0
			}
			if _, has := td.ex[slot]; !has {
				bb, err := hexField(kv, "bb")
				if err != nil {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("TR f=%d y=%03X bb: %w", f, slot, err)
				}
				c4, err := hexField(kv, "c4")
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				c6, err := hexField(kv, "c6")
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				c7, err := hexField(kv, "c7")
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				c8, err := hexField(kv, "c8")
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				ba, err := hexField(kv, "ba")
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				tag := slot/0x40 - 1
				if raw, has := kv["tag"]; has {
					tag, err = hexVal(raw)
					if err != nil {
						return nil, fmt.Errorf("TR f=%d y=%03X tag: %w", f, slot, err)
					}
				}
				td.ex[slot] = &extras{spd: bb & 0x0F, c4: c4, c6: c6, c7: c7, c8: c8, mdir: ba, tag: tag}
			}
		case "PTY":
			f, err := atoiField(kv, "f")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			j, err := hexField(kv, "j")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("PTY f=%d j: %w", f, err)
			}
			td.pads[f] = j
			if rawED, has := kv["ed"]; has {
				ed, err := hexVal(rawED)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("PTY f=%d ed: %w", f, err)
				}
				b6, err := hexField(kv, "b6")
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				eb, err := hexField(kv, "eb")
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
				// C0:7DB4-7DBC/7DBF: $D6B6 = 0, $D8ED != 0, no vehicle ($D8EB)
				td.partyOK[f] = ed != 0 && b6 == 0 && eb == 0
			}
		case "INSTALL":
			p, err := atoiField(kv, "pass")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			tag, err := hexField(kv, "tag")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("INSTALL pass=%d tag: %w", p, err)
			}
			id, err := hexField(kv, "id")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("INSTALL pass=%d id: %w", p, err)
			}
			td.installs[p] = append(td.installs[p], [2]int{tag, id})
		case "ACTOR":
			p, err := atoiField(kv, "pass")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			slot, err := hexField(kv, "slot")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("ACTOR pass=%d slot: %w", p, err)
			}
			gfx, err := hexField(kv, "gfx")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("ACTOR pass=%d gfx: %w", p, err)
			}
			x, err := atoiField(kv, "x")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("ACTOR pass=%d x: %w", p, err)
			}
			y, err := atoiField(kv, "y")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("ACTOR pass=%d y: %w", p, err)
			}
			ef3, err := hexField(kv, "ef3")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("ACTOR pass=%d ef3: %w", p, err)
			}
			off, shift := -1, -1
			if raw, has := kv["off"]; has {
				if off, err = hexVal(raw); err != nil {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("ACTOR pass=%d off: %w", p, err)
				}
			}
			if raw, has := kv["shift"]; has {
				if shift, err = hexVal(raw); err != nil {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("ACTOR pass=%d shift: %w", p, err)
				}
			}
			td.actors[p] = append(td.actors[p], actorSpawn{slot, gfx, x, y, ef3, off, shift})
		default:
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unknown trail line: %q", line)
		}
	}
	return td, nil
}

func hexVal(s string) (int, error) {
	v, err := strconv.ParseUint(s, 16, 32)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("hex %q: %w", s, err)
	}
	return int(v), nil
}

func hexField(kv map[string]string, key string) (int, error) {
	raw, has := kv[key]
	if !has {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("missing field %s", key)
	}
	return hexVal(raw)
}

func atoiField(kv map[string]string, key string) (int, error) {
	raw, has := kv[key]
	if !has {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("missing field %s", key)
	}
	v, err := strconv.Atoi(raw)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("field %s=%q: %w", key, raw, err)
	}
	return v, nil
}

```

`internal/game/actions/runner.go`:

```go
package actions

import (
	"fmt"

	"saga3/internal/mapfmt"
)

// Vec is a pixel or tile position pair (the GDScript's Vector2i).
type Vec struct{ X, Y int }

// Hitbox is one facing's collision shape (E1:0002 through the sprite
// table): an offset in px and rows of mask bytes (1 bit = 4 px).
type Hitbox struct {
	Xoff, Yoff int
	Rows       [][]byte
}

// Stamp is a shape placed on an occupancy bitmap (C0:79DC). Plane is
// set on the leader's stamp only.
type Stamp struct {
	Off, Shift int
	Rows       [][]byte
	Plane      int
}

// State is one object's sampled script state (a trail TR line): script
// base, script position, the two wait counters, the opcode, the pixel
// position and the facing.
type State struct {
	Scr, Pos, T7, T8, Op, X, Y, Dir int
}

// String formats as the TR line's fields, so a replay mismatch reads
// next to its trail line.
func (st State) String() string {
	return fmt.Sprintf("[scr=%04X pos=%04X t7=%02X t8=%02X op=%02X x=%04X y=%04X dir=%02X]",
		st.Scr, st.Pos, st.T7, st.T8, st.Op, st.X, st.Y, st.Dir)
}

// Object is one object slot's record (the GDScript's per-slot
// Dictionary). Nil pointers mark fields the record has not taken yet
// (Vel until a walk sets it, Hitbox/Stamp until SetObject).
type Object struct {
	Scr, Pos, T7, T8, Op int
	X, Y, Dir            int
	Spd, Row, C3, C4, C6 int // speed row, its steps per tile, step counter, move pattern
	C7, C8               int // the proximity range and jump target ($D9C7/$D9C8)
	SC                   int // op 1B's camera-step counter
	Running              bool
	Halted               bool
	EventDriven          bool // $D99A bit 7: installed by objOp 20, runs while a window is open
	Scene                bool // $D99A bits 3-4: a scene actor skips the walk checks
	MDir                 int  // $D9BA walk direction (0x18 = none)
	Pxp, Pyp             int  // per-axis move patterns
	GateFlags            int  // $D9B2 low bits at spawn (map.json gate_flags)
	Plane                int  // $D9B2 bits 6-7: 0x40 / 0x80, the last entered tile's class plane
	D6, D7, D8           int  // $D9D5-$D9D8: the last entered tile's class bytes
	Vel                  *Vec
	Hitbox               *[4]Hitbox
	Stamp                *Stamp
	Tag                  int // $D9D9: the map entry index (event object ids resolve through it)
	Event                int // op 41's event word ($D9D2)
	Frame                int // op 27's pose frame
	Removed              bool
	Inline               []byte // RunInline's one-instruction list
	Target               Vec    // ops 1A/30
}

// clone copies the record (the GDScript's duplicate(true)): stamps and
// the inline list are copied, the mask rows are shared (read-only).
func (o *Object) clone() *Object {
	n := *o
	if o.Vel != nil {
		v := *o.Vel
		n.Vel = &v
	}
	if o.Stamp != nil {
		s := *o.Stamp
		n.Stamp = &s
	}
	if o.Hitbox != nil {
		h := *o.Hitbox
		n.Hitbox = &h
	}
	if o.Inline != nil {
		n.Inline = append([]byte(nil), o.Inline...)
	}
	return &n
}

// FieldRNG is the field RNG stream the runner consumes (the wander
// directions and waits of the walking ops, op 1C/3E waits). D mirrors
// $0D: Roll stores the width hi-lo+1 there, ops 01/2C/3C store 4 /
// 0x10 / 4 without rolling every frame, and a later 3C wait rolls
// 0..D() as the engine reads $0D back.
type FieldRNG interface {
	Roll(lo, hi uint8) int
	SetD(d uint8)
	D() uint8
}

// Latch states: 0 = clear, LatchDispatched after a dispatch until the
// next C0:5585 clears it, else the touching object's slot >> 6.
const LatchDispatched = 0xFF

// FF:6500-69FF (data/field_tables.bin): speed rows and velocities.
const tablesBase = 0x6500

var (
	// steps per tile by speed row (FF:65CC)
	steps = [9]int{0x08, 0x08, 0x04, 0x02, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x01, 0x10}
	// per-axis move patterns ($D9C1 x, $D9C2 y) by $D9BA >> 2 (FF:65E8)
	axisPattern = [4]int{0xFFFF, 0xFFFF, 0xAAFF, 0x88FF}
	// handlers that end `JMP $536D` fetch again in the same pass
	chains = map[int]bool{0x04: true, 0x05: true, 0x08: true, 0x09: true, 0x0A: true,
		0x16: true, 0x19: true, 0x20: true, 0x21: true, 0x32: true, 0x33: true,
		0x34: true, 0x41: true}
	// ops with a fixed operand length and no other behavior (C0:5740
	// +1, 574C +2, 575D +3; op 09/34 are handled elsewhere in fetch)
	instantLength = map[int]int{0x19: 2, 0x34: 2, 0x12: 2}
	// ops whose continuation is walk
	walks = map[int]bool{0x01: true, 0x02: true, 0x13: true, 0x31: true,
		0x06: true, 0x07: true, 0x2C: true, 0x3F: true, 0x3D: true,
		0x14: true, 0x10: true, 0x1A: true, 0x30: true, 0x0C: true,
		0x0D: true, 0x0E: true, 0x3C: true, 0x17: true, 0x18: true,
		0x37: true, 0x38: true, 0x39: true}
	turn25 = [4]int{2, 3, 1, 0} // C0:6500
	spin31 = [4]int{2, 1, 3, 0} // FF:6802: op 31's turn every 4th frame (C0:6B03)
	turn24 = [4]int{3, 2, 0, 1} // C0:6504
	// C0:6896: with $D019 set, slot 0x40's 0A raises slot 0x80's fetch flag
	pairLead = 0x40
)

const speedDefault = 3 // the row objects move at before any 0A

// LeaderHitbox is the party shape the leader stamps (0F82: mask 0F at
// x-4).
var LeaderHitbox = Hitbox{Xoff: -4, Yoff: 0, Rows: [][]byte{{0x0F}}}

// NPCRecord is a map.json NPC's gate-facing parts: the spawn $D9B2
// (gate_flags) and the four facing hitboxes.
type NPCRecord struct {
	GateFlags int
	Hitbox    [4]Hitbox
}

// Runner is the frame-timed action-script interpreter over one map's
// objects. Not modeled: animation frames, opcodes no trail reaches (an
// unmodeled op sets Error and halts the object), the $D99A bit 3 skip
// and the $D991 branch of C0:5585.
type Runner struct {
	Bank     []byte // F8:0000, script pointers and script bytes
	Tables   []byte // FF:6500 field tables
	Rng      FieldRNG
	Objects  map[int]*Object
	PairLink bool // $D019
	Wrap     Vec  // map size in pixels ($D0C9/$D0CB)
	Error    string

	// The leader's pixel position when slot 0 is not a runner object.
	LeaderPos        *Vec
	LeaderPlane      int // the leader's $D9B2 plane bits (0x40 / 0x80 / 0)
	LeaderPlaneFixed bool

	// The object gate (C0:57FF) reads the map's attr grid through the
	// class table F9:A400 (C0:5BC6) and the low buffer, with per-object
	// flags (GateFlags/Plane).
	Grid    *mapfmt.WalkGrid
	Classes []byte
	Bounds  [4]int // tile x0, y0, x1, y1 (C0:4F6E)
	OpenMap bool   // Controls bit 7 ($D0DD): proximity by wrapped tiles

	// Object collision (C0:7731/7892): two occupancy bitmaps ($7F:1000
	// and $7F:1200 in the engine, the latter for plane bits 0x80), 1 bit
	// = 4 px across, one row per 8 px tile. Every non-scene object
	// stamps its hitbox at spawn and after each passed check; a check
	// erases the mover's own stamp, tests the shape at the target, and
	// restamps the old one when blocked.
	Planes   [2][]byte
	BmStride int

	leaderStamp   *Stamp
	LastBlockGate bool  // the latest "block" came from the gate, not collision
	Bumped        []int // slots whose step was blocked by the leader this pass (C0:7797)

	// The touch latch: an armed object's blocked step on the leader
	// stores its slot number ($D6B6) and facing ($D6B7) at
	// C0:77F8-780D; the touch word goes out only when slot 0 next
	// reaches C0:5585 (C0:5635, arg 0). A battle keeps the field
	// objects, so the port keeps the latch across it (UNVERIFIED: not
	// traced past the battle).
	Latch      int
	LatchDir   int
	Dispatched []int // slots C0:5635 dispatched this pass (the caller clears it)
	LeaderTile Vec   // the leader's tile at its last C0:5585 ($D6B2/$D6B4)

	Enqueued   []int // words op 09 queued, in order
	NmiFrame   int   // the NMI frame counter's low byte ($0014), one per logic pass
	QueueLen   int   // words in the event queue; the caller sets it before each pass
	Footprints []Footprint

	// The party leader (slot 0) under joypad control: partySlope is the
	// map header's $D2FA/$D2FB, PartyEdges collects the edge words a
	// step onto the bounds' edge queues (C0:5976-5A39), PartyBumped the
	// slots a blocked step touches (C0:7FFA -> AB2E).
	PartySlope     [2]int
	PartyEdges     []int
	PartyBumped    []int
	Hop            int // $D8F2
	PartyEdgeWords [4]int
	PartyEdgesOn   bool // $D0DE: the map has edge words
	d8e7, d8e8     int  // the slide direction and its one-shot flag
}

// Footprint is a passed step's mark (C0:5413-544B -> 7C75): the tile
// and facing+1.
type Footprint struct {
	X, Y, Delta int
}

// NewRunner takes the F8 bank and the FF:6500 field tables as bytes
// (exports/data/bank_f8.bin and field_tables.bin).
func NewRunner(bankF8, fieldTables []byte, rng FieldRNG) (*Runner, error) {
	if len(bankF8) != 0x10000 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("bank F8: got %d bytes, want %d (bank_f8.bin)", len(bankF8), 0x10000)
	}
	if len(fieldTables) != 0x500 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("field tables: got %d bytes, want %d (field_tables.bin, FF:6500-69FF)", len(fieldTables), 0x500)
	}
	return &Runner{Bank: bankF8, Tables: fieldTables, Rng: rng, Objects: map[int]*Object{}}, nil
}

// ScriptBase is F8:0000[(id & 0xFFF) * 2], the script pointer.
func (r *Runner) ScriptBase(id int) int {
	i := (id & 0x0FFF) * 2
	return int(r.Bank[i]) | int(r.Bank[i+1])<<8
}

// setRow is C0:6876: a speed row sets the move pattern (FF:65C3), the
// steps per tile (FF:65CC) and the row; 0A/32/33 then copy it into
// $D9BB (spd), 2B does not.
func (r *Runner) setRow(o *Object, row int) {
	o.Row = row & 0x0F
	o.C6 = int(r.Tables[0x65C3-tablesBase+o.Row])
	o.C3 = int(r.Tables[0x65CC-tablesBase+o.Row])
}

// offset is FF:6700 + dir*4: the check offset of walk direction dir
// (0x10-0x13 are op 0F's 32 px hops, 0x18 none).
func (r *Runner) offset(mdir int) Vec {
	return r.signedPair(0x6700 - tablesBase + mdir*4)
}

func (r *Runner) signedPair(i int) Vec {
	x := int(r.Tables[i]) | int(r.Tables[i+1])<<8
	y := int(r.Tables[i+2]) | int(r.Tables[i+3])<<8
	if x >= 0x8000 {
		x -= 0x10000
	}
	if y >= 0x8000 {
		y -= 0x10000
	}
	return Vec{x, y}
}

// velocity is C0:6323: the per-frame velocity of a walk, picked at its
// start from FF:65F0 + row*64 + dir*4 (signed x, y); rows past 3 read
// the data after the table, as the engine does.
func (r *Runner) velocity(row, mdir int) Vec {
	return r.signedPair(0x65F0 - tablesBase + row*64 + mdir*4)
}

// Spawn plants a sampled object state (a TR line): script base,
// position, wait counters, opcode, pixel position, facing.
func (r *Runner) Spawn(slot int, st State) {
	r.Objects[slot] = &Object{
		Scr: st.Scr, Pos: st.Pos, T7: st.T7, T8: st.T8, Op: st.Op,
		X: st.X, Y: st.Y, Dir: st.Dir,
		Spd: speedDefault, Row: speedDefault, C3: steps[speedDefault],
		C6: 0xFF, Running: true, MDir: st.Dir, Pxp: 0xFF, Pyp: 0xFF,
		Tag: -1,
	}
}

// SetMap installs the walk grid (Attr/Low from map.json), the class
// table (attr_class.bin), the gate bounds and the open-map flag
// (Controls bit 7, $D0DD: proximity by wrapped tiles).
func (r *Runner) SetMap(grid *mapfmt.WalkGrid, classes []byte, bounds [4]int, open bool) error {
	if grid == nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("set map: nil walk grid")
	}
	if len(classes) != 0x400 {
		return fmt.Errorf("class table: got %d bytes, want %d (attr_class.bin, F9:A400)", len(classes), 0x400)
	}
	r.Wrap = Vec{grid.W * 8, grid.H * 8}
	r.OpenMap = open
	r.Grid = grid
	r.Classes = classes
	r.Bounds = bounds
	r.BmStride = r.Wrap.X / 32
	for i := range r.Planes {
		r.Planes[i] = make([]byte, r.BmStride*(r.Wrap.Y/8)+2)
	}
	r.leaderStamp = nil
	return nil
}

// classAt is $D8FC-$D8FF for tile (tx, ty), already wrapped.
func (r *Runner) classAt(tx, ty int) [4]int {
	c := int(r.Grid.Attr[ty][tx]) * 4
	return [4]int{int(r.Classes[c]), int(r.Classes[c+1]), int(r.Classes[c+2]), int(r.Classes[c+3])}
}

// planeBits is C0:54B0: plane bits from a tile class (0x40 and 0x80
// swap, 0xC0 -> 0).
func planeBits(fc int) int {
	p := fc & 0xC0
	if p != 0 {
		return p ^ 0xC0
	}
	return 0
}

// SetObject is spawn C0:4C29-4CD1: the gate on the object's own tile
// sets the plane bits (plane < 0 derives them), then the hitbox is
// stamped on that plane. A replay that picks up objects mid-walk
// passes the engine's plane bits and the walk's target (at), where the
// engine's last passed check stamped.
func (r *Runner) SetObject(slot int, npc NPCRecord, plane int, at *Vec) {
	o := r.Objects[slot]
	hb := npc.Hitbox
	o.Hitbox = &hb
	o.GateFlags = npc.GateFlags
	if plane >= 0 {
		o.Plane = plane
	} else {
		cls := r.classAt(posmod(o.X, r.Wrap.X)>>3, posmod(o.Y, r.Wrap.Y)>>3)
		if cls[1]&0x80 != 0 {
			o.Plane = 0
		} else {
			o.Plane = planeBits(cls[0])
		}
	}
	p := Vec{o.X, o.Y}
	if at != nil {
		p = *at
	}
	// $D9D8 starts clear (C0:71C0 zeroes the slot); a replay picking an
	// object up mid-walk takes the class its last check entered
	if at == nil {
		o.D8 = 0
	} else {
		o.D8 = r.classAt(p.X>>3, p.Y>>3)[3]
	}
	st := r.shapeAt((*o.Hitbox)[o.Dir&3], p.X, p.Y)
	r.stampObj(o, &st, r.planeIndexOf(o))
}

// StampTarget is the tile a walking object's last check targeted: c4
// more steps along the walk's velocity (cardinal walks).
func (r *Runner) StampTarget(slot int) Vec {
	o := r.Objects[slot]
	if o.T8 != 0 || o.C4 == 0 || o.MDir >= 4 || !walks[o.Op] {
		return Vec{o.X, o.Y}
	}
	v := r.velocity(o.Row, o.MDir)
	return Vec{posmod(o.X+v.X*o.C4, r.Wrap.X), posmod(o.Y+v.Y*o.C4, r.Wrap.Y)}
}

// shapeAt is C0:79DC: bitmap byte offset and bit shift of a shape
// placed at (x, y).
func (r *Runner) shapeAt(hb Hitbox, x, y int) Stamp {
	px := posmod(x+hb.Xoff, r.Wrap.X)
	py := posmod(y+hb.Yoff, r.Wrap.Y)
	return Stamp{
		Off:   (py>>3)*r.BmStride + (px >> 5),
		Shift: (px >> 2) & 7,
		Rows:  hb.Rows,
	}
}

func (r *Runner) apply(st *Stamp, plane int, on bool) {
	bm := r.Planes[plane]
	off := st.Off
	for _, row := range st.Rows {
		i := off
		for _, b := range row {
			w := (int(b) << uint(st.Shift)) & 0xFFFF
			if i+1 < len(bm) {
				if on {
					bm[i] |= byte(w & 0xFF)
					bm[i+1] |= byte(w >> 8)
				} else {
					bm[i] &= ^byte(w & 0xFF)
					bm[i+1] &= ^byte(w >> 8)
				}
			}
			i++
		}
		off += r.BmStride
	}
	r.Planes[plane] = bm
}

func (r *Runner) hits(st *Stamp, bm []byte) bool {
	off := st.Off
	for _, row := range st.Rows {
		i := off
		for _, b := range row {
			w := (int(b) << uint(st.Shift)) & 0xFFFF
			if i+1 < len(bm) && (int(bm[i])|int(bm[i+1])<<8)&w != 0 {
				return true
			}
			i++
		}
		off += r.BmStride
	}
	return false
}

func (r *Runner) stampObj(o *Object, st *Stamp, plane int) {
	o.Stamp = st
	r.apply(st, plane, true)
}

func (r *Runner) planeIndexOf(o *Object) int {
	if o.Plane == 0x80 {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

// placeLeader restamps the sampled leader every pass: the leader's
// script 0 waits with op 00, which restamps it on its own tile
// (C0:5E36), so an object erasing a copy of its stamp (objOp 2E
// actors) does not leave it unstamped.
func (r *Runner) placeLeader() {
	if r.LeaderPos == nil || len(r.Grid.Attr) == 0 {
		return
	}
	if !r.LeaderPlaneFixed {
		cls := r.classAt(posmod(r.LeaderPos.X, r.Wrap.X)>>3, posmod(r.LeaderPos.Y, r.Wrap.Y)>>3)
		if cls[1]&0x80 == 0 {
			r.LeaderPlane = planeBits(cls[0])
		}
	}
	st := r.shapeAt(LeaderHitbox, r.LeaderPos.X, r.LeaderPos.Y)
	if r.LeaderPlane == 0x80 {
		st.Plane = 1
	} else {
		st.Plane = 0
	}
	if r.leaderStamp != nil {
		r.apply(r.leaderStamp, r.leaderStamp.Plane, false)
	}
	r.leaderStamp = &st
	r.apply(&st, st.Plane, true)
}

// FindObject is C0:E994: the slot an event's object id names, or -1.
// 0x80 is the leader (slot 0), 0xFF the event's own object
// (eventSlot), 0x81-0x8F the nth object tagged 0x80 (event actors),
// anything else the first object whose tag ($D9D9: map entry index)
// equals the id.
func (r *Runner) FindObject(id, eventSlot int) int {
	if id == 0x80 {
		return 0
	}
	if id == 0xFF {
		return eventSlot
	}
	nth := (id & 0x0F) - 1
	for slot := 0x40; slot < 0x800; slot += 0x40 {
		o, ok := r.Objects[slot]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		if id >= 0x80 && id < 0x90 && o.Tag == 0x80 {
			if nth == 0 {
				return slot
			}
			nth--
		} else if o.Tag == id {
			return slot
		}
	}
	return -1
}

// SpawnActor is objOp 2E (C0:D72D): an event actor in the first free
// slot, a copy of slot 0's whole record (stamp parameters included)
// placed at tile (tx, ty) with graphic graphic, script 0 from its
// start, op 0, pose facing 4, tag 0x80 and the tile's class; ef03 bit
// 7 sets $D9B2 bit 4.
func (r *Runner) SpawnActor(graphic, tx, ty, ef03 int, hb [4]Hitbox) (int, error) {
	slot, err := r.spawnCopy(graphic, hb)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	o := r.Objects[slot]
	o.X = tx * 8
	o.Y = ty * 8
	o.Dir = 4
	if ef03&0x80 != 0 { // C0:D7B7
		o.GateFlags |= 0x10
	}
	if len(r.Grid.Attr) != 0 {
		cls := r.classAt(posmod(o.X, r.Wrap.X)>>3, posmod(o.Y, r.Wrap.Y)>>3)
		o.D6 = cls[1]
		o.D7 = cls[2]
		o.D8 = cls[3]
	}
	return slot, nil
}

// SpawnFollower is objOp 2C (C0:D976): a party member's figure, the
// same copy of slot 0 but keeping the leader's position, facing and
// tile class (0B4B on 0250: members 1-5 into slots 11-15 at (96,464)
// facing 2).
func (r *Runner) SpawnFollower(graphic int, hb [4]Hitbox) (int, error) {
	return r.spawnCopy(graphic, hb)
}

// spawnCopy is the body objOps 2C and 2E share: the first free slot
// from slot 1 takes slot 0's record with script 0 from its start, op 0
// and tag 0x80.
func (r *Runner) spawnCopy(graphic int, hb [4]Hitbox) (int, error) {
	slot := 0x40
	for {
		o, ok := r.Objects[slot]
		if !ok || o.Removed {
			break
		}
		slot += 0x40
	}
	if slot >= 0x800 {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("objOp 2C/2E: no free object slot")
	}
	o := r.Objects[0].clone()
	o.Scr = r.ScriptBase(0)
	o.Pos = 0
	o.Op = 0
	o.Tag = 0x80
	o.EventDriven = false
	o.Halted = false
	o.Scene = false
	o.Running = true
	o.Hitbox = &hb
	if graphic >= 0xFD { // C0:7B0A: graphics FD-FF skip the sprite table
		o.GateFlags |= 0x0C
	}
	r.Objects[slot] = o
	return slot, nil
}

// Install is objOp 20 (C0:B2D4): the object runs script id from its
// start. An object between tiles is first moved on to the next tile
// (C0:B341); $D9D8 takes the tile's class (C0:B2A3); $D99A bit 7 keeps
// it running while a window is open (eventDriven). objOp 1F (C0:B1F7)
// is the same with eventDriven false: a window stops the object.
func (r *Runner) Install(slot, id int, eventDriven bool) error {
	o := r.Objects[slot]
	vel := o.Vel
	if vel == nil {
		v := r.velocity(o.Row, o.MDir)
		vel = &v
	}
	if ((o.X&7) != 0 && vel.X == 0) || ((o.Y&7) != 0 && vel.Y == 0) {
		return fmt.Errorf("install slot %03X: object between tiles across its walk (x %d y %d vel %d/%d)", slot, o.X, o.Y, vel.X, vel.Y)
	}
	for (o.X & 7) != 0 { // C0:B341 adds $D9BD until aligned
		o.X = posmod(o.X+vel.X, r.Wrap.X)
	}
	for (o.Y & 7) != 0 {
		o.Y = posmod(o.Y+vel.Y, r.Wrap.Y)
	}
	o.Scr = r.ScriptBase(id)
	o.Pos = 0
	o.T7 = 1
	o.T8 = 1
	o.Running = true
	o.Halted = false
	o.EventDriven = eventDriven
	if len(r.Grid.Attr) != 0 {
		o.D8 = r.classAt(posmod(o.X, r.Wrap.X)>>3, posmod(o.Y, r.Wrap.Y)>>3)[3]
	}
	return nil
}

// SetExtras plants the fields of an object spawned mid-walk that the
// TR sample carries beyond the state: speed row, step and pattern
// counters, proximity range/target ($D9BB low nibble, $D9C4, $D9C6,
// $D9C7, $D9C8). c3 < 0 takes the row's table value ($D9C3).
func (r *Runner) SetExtras(slot, spd, c4, c6, c7, c8, c3 int) {
	o := r.Objects[slot]
	o.Spd = spd
	o.Row = spd
	if c3 >= 0 {
		o.C3 = c3
	} else {
		o.C3 = int(r.Tables[0x65CC-tablesBase+spd])
	}
	o.Vel = nil
	o.C4 = c4
	o.C6 = c6
	o.C7 = c7
	o.C8 = c8
}

func (r *Runner) SetState(slot int, st State) {
	o := r.Objects[slot]
	o.Scr, o.Pos, o.T7, o.T8 = st.Scr, st.Pos, st.T7, st.T8
	o.Op, o.X, o.Y, o.Dir = st.Op, st.X, st.Y, st.Dir
}

func (r *Runner) StateOf(slot int) State {
	o := r.Objects[slot]
	return State{o.Scr, o.Pos, o.T7, o.T8, o.Op, o.X, o.Y, o.Dir}
}

// RunInline is C0:53CE: run one instruction from a list ($D8E9: op,
// operand) on the object at once, then halt (3B). The arrival
// sequence's leader 31 0E.
func (r *Runner) RunInline(slot, op, operand int) {
	o := r.Objects[slot]
	o.Inline = []byte{byte(op), byte(operand), 0x3B}
	o.Pos = 0
	o.Running = true
	o.Halted = false
	r.fetch(slot, o)
}

func posmod(a, m int) int {
	mo := a % m
	if mo < 0 {
		mo += m
	}
	return mo
}

func absi(a int) int {
	if a < 0 {
		return -a
	}
	return a
}

func intIn(list []int, v int) bool {
	for _, x := range list {
		if x == v {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

```

`internal/game/actions/step.go`:

```go
package actions

import (
	"fmt"
	"sort"
)

// StepPass is one logic pass of the engine's object loop (C0:51F7),
// objects in slot order. An object that reaches an unmodeled opcode
// halts where it stands and records the error (Error keeps the latest
// one); the others go on. windowOpen ($76 != 0): the object loop
// C0:5190 drives only objects an event installed a script on ($D99A
// bit 7).
func (r *Runner) StepPass(windowOpen bool) {
	r.placeLeader()
	slots := make([]int, 0, len(r.Objects))
	for slot := range r.Objects {
		slots = append(slots, slot)
	}
	sort.Ints(slots)
	for _, slot := range slots {
		o := r.Objects[slot]
		if o.Halted {
			continue
		}
		if windowOpen && slot != 0 && !o.EventDriven {
			continue // C0:51A7: the leader always runs
		}
		before := r.Error
		r.step(slot)
		if r.Error != before {
			o.Halted = true
		}
	}
	r.NmiFrame = (r.NmiFrame + 1) & 0xFFFF
}

// byteAt reads a script byte: the inline list's or F8:(scr + pos + k).
func (r *Runner) byteAt(o *Object, k int) int {
	if o.Inline != nil {
		i := o.Pos + k
		if i > len(o.Inline)-1 {
			i = len(o.Inline) - 1
		}
		return int(o.Inline[i])
	}
	return int(r.Bank[(o.Scr+o.Pos+k)&0xFFFF])
}

func (r *Runner) step(slot int) {
	o := r.Objects[slot]
	if o.T8 != 0 {
		r.fetch(slot, o)
		return
	}
	switch {
	case o.Op == 0x00 || o.Op == 0x0B || o.Op == 0x03 || o.Op == 0x3E:
		o.T7--
		if o.T7 == 0 {
			if slot == 0 {
				r.leader5585(o) // C0:68AF, 68C4, 6D34
			}
			o.T8 = 1
		}
		// C0:68A6 (00) checks the proximity range (C0:5C91) every pass,
		// C0:68BB (0B, 3E) when the count's low nibble is 0; 03
		// (C0:6D2B) never (0103: a monster jumped out of its 00 wait)
		if o.Op == 0x00 || (o.Op != 0x03 && o.T7&0x0F == 0) {
			if r.inProximity(o) {
				r.proximityJump(o)
			}
		}
	case o.Op == 0x35:
		r.walk35(slot, o)
	case o.Op == 0x0F: // C0:6C6D: move every frame along the arc FF:6780; a hop is 16 frames
		o.X = posmod(o.X+o.Vel.X, r.Wrap.X)
		o.Y = posmod(o.Y+o.Vel.Y, r.Wrap.Y)
		ai := 0x6780 - tablesBase + o.C4*2
		arc := int(r.Tables[ai]) | int(r.Tables[ai+1])<<8
		if arc >= 0x8000 {
			arc -= 0x10000
		}
		o.Y = posmod(o.Y-arc, r.Wrap.Y)
		o.C4++
		if o.C4 != 16 {
			return
		}
		o.C4 = 0
		if slot == 0 {
			r.leader5585(o) // C0:6C9E
		}
		o.T7--
		if o.T7 == 0 {
			o.T8 = 1
			return
		}
		switch r.checks(slot, o) {
		case "prox":
			r.proximityJump(o)
		case "block":
			o.T8 = 1
		}
	case o.Op == 0x27: // C0:6F5D: every 8th pass the next pose frame; done after frame 4
		o.T7--
		if o.T7 == 0 {
			o.T7 = 8
			o.Frame++
			if o.Frame >= 5 {
				o.T8 = 1
			}
		}
	case o.Op == 0x2B: // C0:7001: 02's walk, then each new tile at speed row + 2
		r.walk(slot, o)
		if o.C3 == o.C4 && o.T8 == 0 {
			r.setRow(o, o.Spd+2)
		}
	case o.Op == 0x1C: // C0:6FB5: count down; at the end of a pose cycle re-roll
		if o.T7 >= 0x0E {
			o.T7--
			return
		}
		if 6-(o.T7>>1) == 6 {
			o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 4)
			o.T7 = r.Rng.Roll(0, 0x32) // C0:6FD9 loads 0x14 but stores $0C = 0 (STZ)
		}
		o.T7--
	case o.Op == 0x2D: // C0:691A: done when that object runs op 06, or op 07 on this object's frame
		target := (o.T7 + 1) << 6
		if to, ok := r.Objects[target]; ok {
			if to.Op == 0x06 || (to.Op == 0x07 && r.NmiFrame&0x1F == slot>>6) {
				o.T8 = 1
			}
		}
	case walks[o.Op]:
		if o.Op == 0x31 && r.NmiFrame&3 == 0 { // C0:6B03
			o.Dir = spin31[o.Dir&3]
		}
		r.walk(slot, o)
	case o.Op == 0x1B:
		o.SC--
		if o.SC == 0 {
			o.T7--
			if o.T7 == 0 {
				o.T8 = 1
				if r.PairLink {
					r.fetch(slot, o) // C0:696C
				}
				return
			}
			o.SC = o.C3
		}
	default:
		r.Error = fmt.Sprintf("slot %X: continuation of op %02X not modeled", slot, o.Op)
	}
}

// fetch is C0:536D: run instructions until the op ends the frame. Ops
// in chains fetch again in the same pass; FF restarts and keeps
// fetching.
func (r *Runner) fetch(slot int, o *Object) {
	for guard := 0; guard < 64; guard++ {
		b := r.byteAt(o, 0)
		a1 := r.byteAt(o, 1)
		a2 := r.byteAt(o, 2)
		o.Op = b
		switch b {
		case 0xFF:
			if slot == 0 { // C0:5395: object 0 reloads script 0 and leaves event mode
				o.Scr = r.ScriptBase(0)
				o.Running = false
				o.EventDriven = false // C0:53B0: $D99A &= 7F
			}
			o.Pos = 0
			continue
		case 0x16: // C0:6350: switch script, then fetch on
			o.Scr = r.ScriptBase(a1 | a2<<8)
			o.Pos = 0
		case 0x08: // C0:679E: back jump, absolute
			o.Pos = a1
		case 0x00, 0x0B: // C0:5E36: wait a1 frames, restamped on the own tile
			o.T7 = a1
			o.T8 = 0
			o.Pos += 2
			r.restampHere(o)
		case 0x03: // C0:647F: hold, facing = nn>>6
			o.T7 = a1 & 0x3F
			o.Dir = a1 >> 6
			o.T8 = 0
			o.Pos += 2
		case 0x02: // C0:60D8: walk nn&63 tiles toward nn>>6
			o.Dir = a1 >> 6
			o.T7 = a1 & 0x3F
			o.Pos += 2
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x13, 0x31: // C0:6291 (31 also turns while it walks)
			o.T7 = a1
			o.Dir &= 3
			o.Pos += 2
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x01: // C0:5E6B: wander
			o.T7 = a1
			if o.Dir < 4 {
				if r.Rng.Roll(0, 4) == 1 {
					o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
				} else if o.Dir >= 5 {
					o.Dir -= 5
				}
			} else {
				o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
			}
			o.Pos += 2
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x04: // C0:65B7: proximity range
			o.C7 = a1
			o.Pos += 2
		case 0x05: // C0:65C0: proximity jump target
			o.C8 = a1
			o.Pos += 2
		case 0x06, 0x07: // C0:6666/6672: walk toward (away from) the leader
			o.T7 = a1
			xor := 0
			if b == 0x07 {
				xor = 1
			}
			o.Dir = r.toward(o) ^ xor
			o.Pos += 2
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x32: // C0:67FD: speed row +1 below row 4 (C0:6876)
			if o.Spd+1 < 4 {
				o.Spd++
				r.setRow(o, o.Spd)
			}
			o.Pos++
		case 0x33: // C0:6821: speed row -1
			if o.Spd >= 1 {
				o.Spd--
				r.setRow(o, o.Spd)
			}
			o.Pos++
		case 0x1F: // C0:66D8: scene actor ($D99A |= 0x18), stamp erased; ends the frame
			o.Scene = true
			o.D8 = 0
			r.eraseStamp(o)
			o.T8 = 1
			o.Pos++
		case 0x2C: // C0:5E65: wander with a 1-in-17 turn (first roll 0..16)
			o.T7 = a1
			if o.Dir < 4 {
				if r.Rng.Roll(0, 16) == 1 {
					o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
				} else if o.Dir >= 5 {
					o.Dir -= 5
				}
			} else {
				o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
			}
			o.Pos += 2
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x1A: // C0:662A: walk to tile (a1, a2)
			o.Target = Vec{a1 * 8, a2 * 8}
			o.T7 = 0xFF
			o.Pos += 3
			td := r.towardPoint(o)
			if td < 0 {
				return // already there: $D9B8 stays set (C0:5DDA)
			}
			o.Dir = td
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x30: // C0:65C9: a scene actor walks to the leader's tile, then leaves
			o.Scene = true
			o.D7 &= 0xC0
			o.D8 = 0
			r.eraseStamp(o)
			lead := r.leader()
			o.Target = Vec{(lead.X >> 3) * 8, (lead.Y >> 3) * 8}
			o.T7 = 0xFF
			o.Pos++
			td := r.towardPoint(o)
			if td < 0 { // already there: C0:6619 frees the slot
				o.Running = false
				o.Halted = true
				o.Removed = true
				return
			}
			o.Dir = td
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x22: // C0:6534: face the leader, end the frame
			o.Dir = r.face(o, r.leader())
			o.Pos++
		case 0x23: // C0:6545: face tile (a1, a2), end the frame
			o.Dir = r.face(o, Vec{a1 * 8, a2 * 8})
			o.Pos += 3
		case 0x17, 0x18: // C0:5ECA/5E9E: walk along y (17) or x (18) toward the leader
			o.T7 = a1
			o.Dir = r.axisToward(o, b == 0x18)
			o.Pos += 2
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x0C, 0x0D, 0x0E: // C0:61F8/620D/6222: diagonal (|4) and slope (|8, |12) walks
			o.T7 = a1 & 0x3F
			o.Dir = (a1 >> 6) | map[int]int{0x0C: 4, 0x0D: 8, 0x0E: 12}[b]
			o.Pos += 2
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x37, 0x38, 0x39: // C0:6237/6255/6273: diagonal/slope walks that keep the facing
			o.T7 = a1 & 0x3F
			o.MDir = (a1 >> 6) | map[int]int{0x37: 4, 0x38: 8, 0x39: 12}[b]
			o.Pos += 2
			keep := r.stairDir(o, o.Dir) // C0:624F: 577E on the facing
			if keep != o.Dir {           // C0:62D5
				o.Dir = keep
				if o.MDir >= 4 && o.MDir < 0x10 {
					o.Dir = ((o.MDir & 2) >> 1) | 2
				}
			}
			r.setMotion(o)
			r.walkFromHere(slot, o)
		case 0x3C: // C0:5E6B start (as 01); a blocked start turns and retries (C0:616F)
			o.T7 = a1
			if o.Dir < 4 {
				if r.Rng.Roll(0, 4) == 1 {
					o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
				} else if o.Dir >= 5 {
					o.Dir -= 5
				}
			} else {
				o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
			}
			o.Pos += 2
			for turn := 0; turn < 4; turn++ { // C0:6168: only a gate block turns and retries
				r.startWalk(slot, o)
				if o.T8 == 0 || !r.LastBlockGate {
					break
				}
				o.Dir = (o.Dir + 1) & 3
			}
		case 0x14, 0x10: // C0:62A2: walk nn&63 tiles toward nn>>6 keeping the facing
			o.T7 = a1 & 0x3F
			o.MDir = a1 >> 6
			o.Dir &= 3
			o.Pos += 2
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x3F, 0x3D: // C0:60D8, same as 02
			o.Dir = a1 >> 6
			o.T7 = a1 & 0x3F
			o.Pos += 2
			r.startWalk(slot, o)
		case 0x35: // C0:6186: walk a1&3F tiles toward a1>>6 (stairs apply); a block retries the op
			o.T7 = a1 & 0x3F
			o.Pos += 2
			o.MDir = r.stairDir(o, a1>>6)
			if o.MDir >= 4 {
				if (o.MDir & 3) < 2 {
					o.Dir = 2
				} else {
					o.Dir = 3
				}
			} else {
				o.Dir = o.MDir
			}
			r.setMotion(o)
			o.T8 = 0
			switch r.checks(slot, o) {
			case "prox":
				r.proximityJump(o)
			case "block":
				o.Pos -= 2
				o.T8 = 1
			default:
				o.C4 = o.C3
			}
		case 0x0F: // C0:5F04: hop a1&3F times 32 px toward a1>>6
			o.T7 = a1 & 0x3F
			o.Pos += 2
			o.Dir = a1 >> 6
			o.MDir = o.Dir + 0x10
			o.Pxp = 0xFF
			o.Pyp = 0xFF
			v := r.velocity(2, o.Dir) // C0:5F3F: row 2 whatever the speed
			o.Vel = &v
			o.C4 = 0
			o.T8 = 0
			switch r.checks(slot, o) {
			case "prox":
				r.proximityJump(o)
			case "block":
				o.T8 = 1
			}
		case 0x24, 0x25: // C0:64A8/64D4: turn by C0:6504 / C0:6500; ends the frame
			f := o.Dir
			if o.Dir >= 5 {
				f = o.Dir - 5
			}
			if b == 0x24 {
				o.Dir = turn24[f&3]
			} else {
				o.Dir = turn25[f&3]
			}
			o.Pos++
		case 0x2A, 0x29: // C0:66CB/670C: no longer a scene actor, restamped; ends the frame
			o.Scene = false
			o.Pos++
			r.restampHere(o)
			o.T8 = 1
		case 0x28: // C0:6728: scene actor (bits 3-5), stamp erased; ends the frame
			o.Scene = true
			o.D8 = 0
			r.eraseStamp(o)
			o.T8 = 1
			o.Pos++
		case 0x1C: // C0:6390: idle; pose 0, facing 0, t7 = roll(20..50)
			o.Dir = 0
			o.T7 = r.Rng.Roll(0x14, 0x32)
			o.T8 = 0
			o.Pos++
		case 0x2D: // C0:5E36: wait on object a1+1 (C0:691A), restamped first
			o.T7 = a1
			o.Pos += 2
			r.restampHere(o)
			o.T8 = 0
		case 0x27: // C0:63E7: pose: frame 0 in facing group (facing & 3) + 5, 8 passes a frame
			o.Pos++
			o.Frame = 0
			o.Dir = (o.Dir & 3) + 5
			o.T7 = 8
			o.T8 = 0
		case 0x2B: // C0:63B4: 7 tiles along the facing, pose facing+5 (C0:60FE)
			f := o.Dir
			if o.Dir >= 5 {
				f = o.Dir - 5
			}
			f &= 3
			o.Pos++
			o.MDir = f
			o.Dir = f + 5
			o.T7 = 7
			r.setMotion(o)
			r.walkFromHere(slot, o)
		case 0x41: // C0:678F: the object's event word ($D9D2)
			o.Event = a1 | a2<<8
			o.Pos += 3
		case 0x3B: // C0:6843: RTS without advancing: the object halts here
			return
		case 0x20: // C0:6742: toggle $D8D8 (the leader's check switch)
			o.Pos++
		case 0x3E: // C0:5E48: wait 5..60 frames, rolled, restamped on the own tile
			o.T7 = r.Rng.Roll(5, 0x3C)
			o.T8 = 0
			o.Pos++
			r.restampHere(o)
		case 0x0A: // C0:685C: speed row; C0:6876 reloads the move pattern
			o.Spd = a1 & 0x0F
			r.setRow(o, o.Spd)
			o.Pos += 2
			if r.PairLink && slot == pairLead {
				if o80, ok := r.Objects[0x80]; ok {
					o80.T8 = 1
				}
			}
		case 0x1B: // C0:5E1F: camera steps
			o.T7 = a1 & 0x3F
			o.T8 = 0
			o.SC = o.C3
			o.Pos += 2
		case 0x15: // C0:6377: pose frame a1, facing 4
			o.Dir = 4
			o.Pos += 2
		case 0x21: // C0:675F: place at tile (a1, a2), instant
			o.X = a1 * 8
			o.Y = a2 * 8
			o.Pos += 3
		case 0x09: // C0:67AE: a call word waits for an empty queue ($D6BD = FF)
			// (battle words 18/19 also wait on the leader: not modeled)
			if a1 < 0x0C && r.QueueLen > 0 {
				o.T8 = 1
				return
			}
			r.Enqueued = append(r.Enqueued, a1<<8|a2)
			r.QueueLen++
			o.Pos += 3
		default:
			l, ok := instantLength[b]
			if !ok {
				r.Error = fmt.Sprintf("slot %X: op %02X not modeled", slot, b)
				return
			}
			o.Pos += l
		}
		if !chains[b] {
			return
		}
	}
	r.Error = fmt.Sprintf("slot %X: fetch did not settle", slot)
}
```

`internal/game/actions/trail_test.go`:

```go
package actions

import (
	"compress/gzip"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strconv"

	"saga3/internal/game/rng"

// The goldens are the committed engine trails exports/tests/trails/
// (tools/emulator/acttrail.lua captures). Read in place: they are
// engine-neutral data and the migration keeps them where they are.

const trailsDir = "../../../exports/tests/trails"
const dataDir = "../../../exports/data"

// trailRNG adapts the rng package's Field stream to the runner's
// FieldRNG and the replay's SeededRNG.
type trailRNG struct{ f *rng.Field }

func newTrailRNG() *trailRNG { return &trailRNG{f: rng.NewField()} }

func (w *trailRNG) Roll(lo, hi uint8) int { return w.f.Roll(lo, hi) }
func (w *trailRNG) SetD(d uint8)          { w.f.D = d }
func (w *trailRNG) D() uint8              { return w.f.D }
func (w *trailRNG) SetState(a, b uint8)   { w.f.A, w.f.B = a, b }
func (w *trailRNG) State() (uint8, uint8) { return w.f.A, w.f.B }

var loadAssets = sync.OnceValues(func() (*Assets, error) {
	read := func(name string) ([]byte, error) {
		return os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dataDir, name))
	}
	bank, err := read("bank_f8.bin")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	tables, err := read("field_tables.bin")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	classes, err := read("attr_class.bin")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	rawHbs, err := read("graphic_hitboxes.json")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var flat [][]Hitbox
	if err := json.Unmarshal(rawHbs, &flat); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("graphic_hitboxes.json: %w", err)
	}
	hbs := make([][4]Hitbox, len(flat))
	for gfx, hb := range flat {
		if len(hb) != 4 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("graphic_hitboxes.json[%d]: got %d facings, want 4", gfx, len(hb))
		}
		hbs[gfx] = [4]Hitbox(hb)
	}
	return &Assets{BankF8: bank, Tables: tables, Classes: classes, Hitboxes: hbs}, nil
})

func loadTrail(t *testing.T, name string) string {
	t.Helper()
	f, err := os.Open(filepath.Join(trailsDir, name+".trail.gz"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("open trail: %v", err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	gz, err := gzip.NewReader(f)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("gzip trail %s: %v", name, err)
	}
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(gz)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read trail %s: %v", name, err)
	}
	return string(raw)
}

func loadTrailMap(t *testing.T, id string) *TrailMap {
	t.Helper()
	raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dataDir, "maps", id, "map.json"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read map %s: %v", id, err)
	}
	var m struct {
		Width      int      `json:"width"`
		Height     int      `json:"height"`
		Open       bool     `json:"open"`
		Slope      *int     `json:"slope"`
		Bounds     []int    `json:"bounds"`
		Walkable   [][]byte `json:"walkable"`
		Attr       [][]byte `json:"attr"`
		Low        [][]byte `json:"low"`
		EdgeEvents []int    `json:"edge_events"`
		NPCs       []struct {
			GateFlags int      `json:"gate_flags"`
			Hitbox    []Hitbox `json:"hitbox"`
		} `json:"npcs"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(raw, &m); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse map %s: %v", id, err)
	}
	if len(m.Bounds) != 4 {
		t.Fatalf("map %s: got %d bounds, want 4", id, len(m.Bounds))
	}
	if len(m.Attr) != m.Height || len(m.Low) != m.Height || len(m.Walkable) != m.Height {
		t.Fatalf("map %s: grid rows do not match height %d (attr %d low %d walk %d)",
			id, m.Height, len(m.Attr), len(m.Low), len(m.Walkable))
	}
	tm := &TrailMap{
		Grid: &mapfmt.WalkGrid{
			W: m.Width, H: m.Height,
			Walk: boolGrid(m.Walkable), Attr: m.Attr, Low: m.Low,
		},
		Bounds: [4]int(m.Bounds),
		Open:   m.Open,
		Slope:  -1,
	}
	if m.Slope != nil {
		tm.Slope = *m.Slope
	}
	if len(m.EdgeEvents) == 4 {
		tm.EdgeEvents = [4]int(m.EdgeEvents)
	} else if len(m.EdgeEvents) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("map %s: got %d edge words, want 4 or none", id, len(m.EdgeEvents))
	}
	for i, npc := range m.NPCs {
		if len(npc.Hitbox) != 4 {
			t.Fatalf("map %s npc %d: got %d hitbox facings, want 4", id, i, len(npc.Hitbox))
		}
		tm.NPCs = append(tm.NPCs, NPCRecord{GateFlags: npc.GateFlags, Hitbox: [4]Hitbox(npc.Hitbox)})
	}
	return tm
}

// boolGrid converts map.json's 0/1 walkable grid to the WalkGrid's
// booleans.
func boolGrid(raw [][]byte) [][]bool {
	out := make([][]bool, len(raw))
	for y, row := range raw {
		out[y] = make([]bool, len(row))
		for x, v := range row {
			out[y][x] = v != 0
		}
	}
	return out
}

func listTrails(t *testing.T) []string {
	t.Helper()
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(trailsDir)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("list trails: %v", err)
	}
	var names []string
	for _, e := range entries {
		name := e.Name()
		if strings.HasSuffix(name, ".trail.gz") {
			names = append(names, strings.TrimSuffix(name, ".trail.gz"))
		}
	}
	slices.Sort(names)
	if len(names) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("no trails in %s", trailsDir)
	}
	return names
}

// TestEngineTrails replays every committed engine trail: each
// non-leader slot spawns from its first sample and must match every
// later sample (the --actreplay contract). The trails pin the wander
// rolls on the field RNG, the object gate with plane bits, both
// collision planes, waits, stair diagonals, the window freeze,
// objOp 20 installs, objOp 2E actors and the party's joypad walk.
func TestEngineTrails(t *testing.T) {
	assets, err := loadAssets()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load data: %v", err)
	}
	for _, name := range listTrails(t) {
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			text := loadTrail(t, name)
			tm := loadTrailMap(t, name[:4])
			res, err := ReplayTrail(text, tm, assets, newTrailRNG())
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("replay trail %s: %v", name, err)
			}
			if res.Diverged {
				t.Fatalf("trail %s diverged:\n%s", name, strings.Join(res.Lines, "\n"))
			}
			t.Logf("trail %s: %d slots matched\n%s", name, len(res.Lines), strings.Join(res.Lines, "\n"))
		})
	}
}

// TestReplayDetectsCorruption proves the harness can fail: corrupting
// one later sample of slot 040 in 0131 (a wait counter plus one) must
// report that slot's divergence, not a green replay.
func TestReplayDetectsCorruption(t *testing.T) {
	assets, err := loadAssets()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load data: %v", err)
	}
	text := corruptSample(t, loadTrail(t, "0131"), 2, "040")
	tm := loadTrailMap(t, "0131")
	res, err := ReplayTrail(text, tm, assets, newTrailRNG())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("replay corrupted trail: %v", err)
	}
	if !res.Diverged {
		t.Fatalf("corrupted sample was not detected:\n%s", strings.Join(res.Lines, "\n"))
	}
	if !slices.ContainsFunc(res.Lines, func(l string) bool {
		return strings.HasPrefix(l, "slot 040: pass 2 ")
	}) {
		t.Fatalf("divergence line for slot 040 at pass 2 missing:\n%s", strings.Join(res.Lines, "\n"))
	}
}

// corruptSample rewrites slotToken's t7 sample on trail pass (a wait
// counter plus one, same hex width).
func corruptSample(t *testing.T, text string, pass int, slotToken string) string {
	t.Helper()
	want := fmt.Sprintf("TR f=%d y=%s ", pass, slotToken)
	lines := strings.Split(text, "\n")
	for i, line := range lines {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(line, want) {
			continue
		}
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		for j, f := range fields {
			if !strings.HasPrefix(f, "t7=") {
				continue
			}
			v, err := strconv.ParseUint(f[3:], 16, 32)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatalf("parse %q: %v", f, err)
			}
			fields[j] = fmt.Sprintf("t7=%02X", (v+1)&0xFF)
			lines[i] = strings.Join(fields, " ")
			return strings.Join(lines, "\n")
		}
		t.Fatalf("TR line %q has no t7", line)
	}
	t.Fatalf("no TR line %q in the trail", want)
	return ""
}

// unitRunner builds a runner over a synthetic 8x8 open map with the
// real FF:6500 field tables: the script sits at F8:0100 behind a script
// 0 pointer, attr/low grids and the F9:A400 class table come from the
// caller.
func unitRunner(t *testing.T, script []byte, attr, low [][]byte, classes []byte) *Runner {
	t.Helper()
	assets, err := loadAssets()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load data: %v", err)
	}
	bank := make([]byte, 0x10000)
	bank[0], bank[1] = 0x00, 0x01
	copy(bank[0x100:], script)
	r, err := NewRunner(bank, assets.Tables, newTrailRNG())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("new runner: %v", err)
	}
	walk := make([][]bool, 8)
	for y := range walk {
		walk[y] = make([]bool, 8)
		for x := range walk[y] {
			walk[y][x] = true
		}
	}
	grid := &mapfmt.WalkGrid{W: 8, H: 8, Walk: walk, Attr: attr, Low: low}
	if err := r.SetMap(grid, classes, [4]int{0, 0, 7, 7}, false); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("set map: %v", err)
	}
	return r
}

func grid8() (attr, low [][]byte) {
	attr = make([][]byte, 8)
	low = make([][]byte, 8)
	for i := range attr {
		attr[i] = make([]byte, 8)
		low[i] = make([]byte, 8)
	}
	return attr, low
}

func leaderBoxes() [4]Hitbox {
	return [4]Hitbox{LeaderHitbox, LeaderHitbox, LeaderHitbox, LeaderHitbox}
}

// TestWindowOpenRunsOnlyEventDriven pins C0:51A7's bit-7 exemption: with
// a window open the loop keeps running the objects an event installed a
// script on and freezes the rest. No golden covers the exemption (0039's
// window passes hold no installed object), so the freeze side is
// trail-pinned and this pins the run side.
func TestWindowOpenRunsOnlyEventDriven(t *testing.T) {
	script := []byte{0x02, 0x03, 0x3B} // walk 3 tiles north, halt
	attr, low := grid8()
	r := unitRunner(t, script, attr, low, make([]byte, 0x400))
	r.Spawn(0x40, State{Scr: r.ScriptBase(0), Pos: 0, T8: 1, X: 16, Y: 16, Dir: 0})
	r.Spawn(0x80, State{Scr: r.ScriptBase(0), Pos: 0, T8: 1, X: 40, Y: 16, Dir: 0})
	for _, slot := range []int{0x40, 0x80} {
		r.SetObject(slot, NPCRecord{Hitbox: leaderBoxes()}, -1, nil)
	}
	if err := r.Install(0x80, 0, true); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("install slot 080: %v", err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ { // window closed: both walk
		r.StepPass(false)
	}
	y40, y80 := r.StateOf(0x40).Y, r.StateOf(0x80).Y
	if y40 == 16 || y80 == 16 {
		t.Fatalf("window closed: walkers did not start (slot 040 y %d, slot 080 y %d)", y40, y80)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ { // window open: only the installed one walks
		r.StepPass(true)
	}
	if got := r.StateOf(0x40); got.Y != y40 {
		t.Fatalf("window open: plain object walked (y %d -> %d)", y40, got.Y)
	}
	if got := r.StateOf(0x80); got.Y >= y80 {
		t.Fatalf("window open: installed object froze (y %d -> %d)", y80, got.Y)
	}
}

// TestClosedProximityBoxEdge pins the leader-side edge of the closed-map
// proximity box (C0:5C91): the leader's own pixel is counted, so at
// rng+1 px past the object the leader is still inside and one px
// further out is not. No trail puts the leader on that pixel.
func TestClosedProximityBoxEdge(t *testing.T) {
	script := []byte{0x00, 0x20, 0x3B} // wait 32 frames
	for _, lx := range []int{22, 23, 30} {
		attr, low := grid8()
		r := unitRunner(t, script, attr, low, make([]byte, 0x400))
		r.Spawn(0x40, State{Scr: r.ScriptBase(0), Pos: 0, T8: 1, X: 40, Y: 32, Dir: 0})
		r.SetObject(0x40, NPCRecord{Hitbox: leaderBoxes()}, -1, nil)
		r.SetExtras(0x40, 3, 0, 0, 2, 0x40, -1)
		r.LeaderPos = &Vec{lx, 32}
		r.StepPass(false) // fetch arms the wait
		r.StepPass(false) // op 00 checks proximity every frame
		got := r.StateOf(0x40)
		jumped := got.Pos == 0x40 && got.T8 == 1
		if jumped != (lx >= 23) {
			t.Fatalf("leader at x %d: proximity jump fired = %v, want %v (pos %02X t8 %d)", lx, jumped, lx >= 23, got.Pos, got.T8)
		}
	}
}

// TestWaitProximityOnLowNibble pins C0:68BB: ops 0B/3E check proximity
// only when the wait counter's low nibble is 0, so a leader walking
// into range mid-wait jumps at the next low-nibble frame, not at once
// (op 00 checks every frame, op 03 never). The trails' 0B waiters never
// have the leader enter their range.
func TestWaitProximityOnLowNibble(t *testing.T) {
	script := []byte{0x0B, 0x2A, 0x3B} // wait 42 frames
	attr, low := grid8()
	r := unitRunner(t, script, attr, low, make([]byte, 0x400))
	r.Spawn(0x40, State{Scr: r.ScriptBase(0), Pos: 0, T8: 1, X: 40, Y: 32, Dir: 0})
	r.SetObject(0x40, NPCRecord{Hitbox: leaderBoxes()}, -1, nil)
	r.SetExtras(0x40, 3, 0, 0, 2, 0x40, -1)
	r.LeaderPos = &Vec{60, 32} // outside the box
	r.StepPass(false)          // fetch arms the wait
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {   // t7 41, 40: nibbles 9, 8
		r.StepPass(false)
	}
	if got := r.StateOf(0x40); got.Pos != 0x02 {
		t.Fatalf("left the wait while the leader was outside (pos %02X t7 %d)", got.Pos, got.T7)
	}
	r.LeaderPos = &Vec{40, 32} // the leader walks into the box mid-wait
	for i := 0; i < 7; i++ {   // t7 39..33: no low nibble is 0
		r.StepPass(false)
	}
	if got := r.StateOf(0x40); got.Pos != 0x02 {
		t.Fatalf("jumped off the low-nibble frame (pos %02X t7 %d)", got.Pos, got.T7)
	}
	r.StepPass(false) // t7 32: the first low-nibble-0 frame
	if got := r.StateOf(0x40); got.Pos != 0x40 || got.T8 != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("no jump on the low-nibble frame (pos %02X t8 %d t7 %d)", got.Pos, got.T8, got.T7)
	}
}

// TestGateBlocksOnEnteredSideBit pins C0:5922: the gate blocks a walk
// through the side bit of the direction entered (8>>dir); the other
// sides' bits on the same class do not block. The trail maps' classes
// never carry a lone side bit, so no golden exercises the rule.
func TestGateBlocksOnEnteredSideBit(t *testing.T) {
	for _, fc := range []byte{0x08, 0x04} {
		attr, low := grid8()
		attr[1][2] = 1 // the tile north of the start
		classes := make([]byte, 0x400)
		classes[4] = fc                    // tile (2,1)'s class byte 0
		script := []byte{0x02, 0x01, 0x3B} // walk 1 tile north
		r := unitRunner(t, script, attr, low, classes)
		r.Spawn(0x40, State{Scr: r.ScriptBase(0), Pos: 0, T8: 1, X: 16, Y: 16, Dir: 0})
		r.SetObject(0x40, NPCRecord{Hitbox: leaderBoxes()}, -1, nil)
		for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
			r.StepPass(false)
		}
		got := r.StateOf(0x40)
		if fc == 0x08 && (got.Y != 16 || got.T8 != 1) {
			t.Fatalf("north-side bit 8 did not block the north walk (state %s)", got)
		}
		if fc == 0x04 && (got.Y != 8 || got.T8 != 1) {
			t.Fatalf("east-side bit 4 blocked a north walk (state %s)", got)
		}
	}
}

// TestFootprintRecordsTileAndFacingPlusOne pins C0:5413 -> 7C75: a
// passed step records the tile just left with facing+1 when the
// entered tile's class byte 3 has bit 1, and sets the low buffer's
// repeat bit; a class without bit 1 records nothing. The replay never
// reads Runner.Footprints, so no golden pins any of this.
func TestFootprintRecordsTileAndFacingPlusOne(t *testing.T) {
	attr, low := grid8()
	attr[2][2], attr[2][3], attr[2][4] = 1, 2, 3
	classes := make([]byte, 0x400)
	classes[4+3] = 0x02 // tile (2,2): class byte 3 bit 1 = footprint
	classes[8+3] = 0x02 // tile (3,2): footprint
	// tile (4,2) (attr 3) has class zeros: no footprint
	script := []byte{0x02, 0xC4, 0x3B} // walk 4 tiles east
	r := unitRunner(t, script, attr, low, classes)
	r.Spawn(0x40, State{Scr: r.ScriptBase(0), Pos: 0, T8: 1, X: 16, Y: 16, Dir: 3})
	r.SetObject(0x40, NPCRecord{Hitbox: leaderBoxes()}, -1, nil)
	for i := 0; i < 24; i++ {
		r.StepPass(false)
	}
	want := []Footprint{{X: 3, Y: 2, Delta: 4}}
	if !slices.Equal(r.Footprints, want) {
		t.Fatalf("footprints %v, want %v", r.Footprints, want)
	}
	if low[2][2] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("start tile recorded before any tile was entered (low %02X)", low[2][2])
	}
	if low[2][3]&2 == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("repeat bit not set on tile (3,2) (low %02X)", low[2][3])
	}
	if low[2][4]&2 != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("non-footprint tile (4,2) recorded (low %02X)", low[2][4])
	}
}
```
