`internal/game/actions/walk.go`:

```go
package actions

// Walk continuations (C0:6B2B for 02/13, C0:6975 for 01, C0:6DB3 for
// 06/07): rotate the move pattern, move on a 1 bit, count steps; a
// finished tile decrements $D9B7 (0 ends the walk), re-rolls the
// wander/chase direction, then runs the checks.
func (r *Runner) walk(slot int, o *Object) {
	// 3C (C0:6A02) waiting at a blocked tile ($D9C4 = 0) re-runs the
	// tile-end logic each frame without moving or counting the tile.
	// 01/2C/3C store $0D (4 / 0x10 / 4) every frame before the pattern
	// test (C0:6975, 696F, 6A07); a later 3C wait roll reads what the
	// last object left there, rolled or not
	switch o.Op {
	case 0x01:
		r.Rng.SetD(4)
	case 0x2C:
		r.Rng.SetD(0x10)
	case 0x3C:
		if o.C4 != 0 {
			r.Rng.SetD(4)
		}
	}
	if !(o.Op == 0x3C && o.C4 == 0) {
		if !r.advance(o) {
			return
		}
		if slot == 0 {
			r.leader5585(o) // the tile end: C0:6B42, 6990, 6DCA, 6A22
		}
		o.T7--
		if o.T7 == 0 {
			o.T8 = 1
			return
		}
	}
	retry := false
	waiting := o.Op == 0x3C && o.C4 == 0
	switch o.Op {
	case 0x01, 0x3C:
		// C0:69A3 / 6A35; 3C's wait path rolls 0..$0D as left
		limit := byte(4)
		if waiting {
			limit = r.Rng.D()
		}
		if r.Rng.Roll(0, limit) == 1 {
			o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
			o.MDir = o.Dir
			r.setMotion(o) // C0:62C3
		}
	case 0x2C:
		if r.Rng.Roll(0, 16) == 1 { // C0:696F: $0D = 0x10, then 6975's roll
			o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
			o.MDir = o.Dir
			r.setMotion(o) // C0:62C3
		}
	case 0x17, 0x18: // C0:6BBE: roll 0..3, a 1 re-aims along the axis; 01's checks follow
		if r.Rng.Roll(0, 3) == 1 {
			o.Dir = r.axisToward(o, o.Op == 0x18)
			o.MDir = o.Dir
			r.setMotion(o) // C0:62C3
		}
	case 0x1A, 0x30: // C0:6D6D: re-aim at the target every tile
		td := r.towardPoint(o)
		if td < 0 {
			o.T8 = 1
			if o.Op == 0x30 { // C0:6D99: the object leaves (its slot is free)
				o.Running = false
				o.Halted = true
				o.Removed = true
			}
			return
		}
		o.Dir = td
		o.MDir = td
		r.setMotion(o) // C0:62C3
		retry = true
	case 0x06, 0x07:
		if r.Rng.Roll(0, 3) == 1 { // C0:6DE5
			xor := 0
			if o.Op == 0x07 {
				xor = 1
			}
			o.Dir = r.toward(o) ^ xor
			o.MDir = o.Dir
			r.setMotion(o) // C0:62C3
			retry = true
		}
	}
	if o.Scene {
		o.C4 = o.C3
		return
	}
	res := r.checks(slot, o)
	if res == "block" && retry { // C0:6E30: one random retry after a re-aim
		o.Dir = r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
		o.MDir = o.Dir
		r.setMotion(o) // C0:62C3
		res = r.checks(slot, o)
	}
	switch res {
	case "prox":
		r.proximityJump(o)
	case "block":
		if o.Op == 0x3C {
			o.C4 = 0 // C0:6A86: wait at the tile, retry next frame
		} else {
			o.T8 = 1
		}
	default:
		// C0:6B2B -> C0:5585 at the tile end: a non-leader object's row
		// returns to its base row (C0:6876) before the step count
		// reloads, so op 2B's raise holds one tile at a time (0267
		// capture: rows 0 -> 2, every tile 8 passes). $D99A bit 3 (skip)
		// and the $D9C5 = $D9C6 copy are not modelled.
		if slot != 0 && o.Spd&0x0F != o.Row {
			r.setRow(o, o.Spd&0x0F)
		}
		o.C4 = o.C3
	}
}

// advance is one frame of movement: rotate the move pattern, and on a
// 1 bit move each axis by its own pattern (C0:7132) and count a step.
// True when the step count reaches 0 (the tile is done).
func (r *Runner) advance(o *Object) bool {
	bit := o.C6 & 1
	o.C6 >>= 1
	if bit == 0 {
		return false
	}
	o.C6 |= 0x80
	if o.Vel == nil { // objects picked up mid-walk by a replay
		v := r.velocity(o.Row, o.MDir)
		o.Vel = &v
	}
	xb := o.Pxp & 1
	o.Pxp = (o.Pxp >> 1) | rotBit(xb)
	if xb != 0 {
		o.X = posmod(o.X+o.Vel.X, r.Wrap.X)
	}
	yb := o.Pyp & 1
	o.Pyp = (o.Pyp >> 1) | rotBit(yb)
	if yb != 0 {
		o.Y = posmod(o.Y+o.Vel.Y, r.Wrap.Y)
	}
	o.C4--
	return o.C4 == 0
}

func rotBit(b int) int {
	if b != 0 {
		return 0x80
	}
	return 0
}

// walk35 is 35 (C0:6A8C): walk on; a blocked tile end leaves $D9C4 = 0
// and the object retries the checks every frame (t7 is taken and given
// back).
func (r *Runner) walk35(slot int, o *Object) {
	if o.C4 == 0 {
		o.T7--
	} else {
		if !r.advance(o) {
			return
		}
		if slot == 0 {
			r.leader5585(o) // C0:6AA8
		}
		o.T7--
		if o.T7 == 0 {
			o.T8 = 1
			return
		}
	}
	switch r.checks(slot, o) {
	case "prox":
		r.proximityJump(o)
	case "block":
		o.T7++
	default:
		o.C4 = o.C3
	}
}

// leader5585 is C0:5585 on slot 0 (the leader's wait end or tile end):
// a new tile with low-buffer bit 3 (an event rect, C0:55E8-5609) leaves
// the latch for a later call; otherwise C0:5635 dispatches it. The
// $D991 branch (C0:5621) and the $D99A bit 3 skip are not modeled.
func (r *Runner) leader5585(o *Object) {
	t := Vec{posmod(o.X, r.Wrap.X) >> 3, posmod(o.Y, r.Wrap.Y) >> 3}
	if t != r.LeaderTile {
		r.LeaderTile = t
		if len(r.Grid.Low) != 0 && r.Grid.Low[t.Y][t.X]&8 != 0 {
			return
		}
	}
	if r.Latch == 0 {
		return
	}
	if r.Latch == LatchDispatched {
		r.Latch = 0
		return
	}
	y := r.Latch << 6
	if oo, ok := r.Objects[y]; ok {
		oo.Dir = r.LatchDir // C0:5651
		r.Dispatched = append(r.Dispatched, y)
	}
	r.Latch = LatchDispatched
}

// leader is the leader's pixel position: the sampled one when set,
// else slot 0's.
func (r *Runner) leader() Vec {
	if r.LeaderPos != nil {
		return *r.LeaderPos
	}
	if l, ok := r.Objects[0]; ok {
		return Vec{l.X, l.Y}
	}
	return Vec{}
}

// toward is C0:5D1F: direction toward the leader.
func (r *Runner) toward(o *Object) int {
	l := r.leader()
	if o.X == l.X && o.Y == l.Y {
		return r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
	}
	roll := r.Rng.Roll(0, 16)
	if roll == 8 {
		return r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
	}
	if roll < 8 {
		if o.Y == l.Y {
			return r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
		}
		if o.Y > l.Y {
			return 0
		}
		return 1
	}
	if o.X == l.X {
		return r.Rng.Roll(0, 3)
	}
	if o.X > l.X {
		return 2
	}
	return 3
}

// axisToward is C0:5ED0/5EA4: toward the leader along one axis; level
// rolls the pair.
func (r *Runner) axisToward(o *Object, horizontal bool) int {
	l := r.leader()
	if horizontal {
		if o.X == l.X {
			return r.Rng.Roll(2, 3)
		}
		if o.X < l.X {
			return 3
		}
		return 2
	}
	if o.Y == l.Y {
		return r.Rng.Roll(0, 1)
	}
	if o.Y < l.Y {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

// face is C0:6561: the facing toward p: the longer axis wins, y on a
// tie.
func (r *Runner) face(o *Object, p Vec) int {
	dx := o.X - p.X
	dy := o.Y - p.Y
	if absi(dy) < absi(dx) {
		if dx >= 0 {
			return 2
		}
		return 3
	}
	if dy >= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return 1
}

// towardPoint is C0:5DC8: direction toward o.Target, x axis first; -1
// once there.
func (r *Runner) towardPoint(o *Object) int {
	t := o.Target
	if o.X == t.X {
		if o.Y == t.Y {
			return -1
		}
		if o.Y > t.Y {
			return 0
		}
		return 1
	}
	if o.X > t.X {
		return 2
	}
	return 3
}

func (r *Runner) proximityJump(o *Object) {
	o.Pos = o.C8
	o.C7 = 0
	o.T8 = 1
}

// inProximity is C0:5C91: the leader inside the box of (c7 & 7F) tiles
// around the object (c7 bit 7: outside it) takes the proximity jump.
func (r *Runner) inProximity(o *Object) bool {
	if o.C7 == 0 {
		return false
	}
	l := r.leader()
	var inside bool
	if r.OpenMap {
		// C0:5BFD: per axis the tile distance, strictly below the range;
		// x wraps past half the map ($D0C4 tiles). y never wraps: C0:5C51
		// compares 16-bit against $D0C3, which reads height | width << 8
		rt := o.C7 & 0x7F
		inside = openDist(l.X-o.X, r.Wrap.X>>3) < rt && (absi(l.Y-o.Y)>>3) < rt
	} else {
		rng := (o.C7 & 0x7F) * 8
		inside = o.X+rng >= l.X && l.X+1+rng >= o.X && o.Y+rng >= l.Y && l.Y+1+rng >= o.Y
	}
	return inside != (o.C7&0x80 != 0)
}

// openDist is C0:5C02-5C42: |d| in tiles; at or past half the map
// (|d| / 4 >= tiles) the way round instead.
func openDist(d, tiles int) int {
	a := absi(d) >> 2
	if a < tiles {
		return a >> 1
	}
	return tiles - (a >> 1)
}

// checks is C0:5C91 / C0:57FF / C0:7731 for the tile ahead: "prox",
// "block" or "".
func (r *Runner) checks(slot int, o *Object) string {
	if r.inProximity(o) {
		return "prox"
	}
	off := r.offset(o.MDir)
	tx := o.X + off.X
	ty := o.Y + off.Y
	cls := r.gateClass(o, tx, ty)
	r.LastBlockGate = cls == nil
	if r.LastBlockGate {
		return "block"
	}
	// C0:7892: the target's class picks the plane unless $D8FD bit 7
	// keeps the object's own
	keep := cls[1]&0x80 != 0
	testPlane := 0
	if keep {
		testPlane = r.planeIndexOf(o)
	} else if cls[0]&0xC0 == 0x40 {
		testPlane = 1
	}
	r.apply(o.Stamp, r.planeIndexOf(o), false) // C0:7956
	st := r.shapeAt((*o.Hitbox)[o.Dir&3], tx, ty)
	if r.hits(&st, r.Planes[testPlane]) {
		r.apply(o.Stamp, r.planeIndexOf(o), true) // C0:7797 restamps the old spot
		// C0:77A4: a block on the leader's stamp, on a shared plane, is a bump
		ls := r.leaderStamp
		lplane := -1
		if ls != nil {
			lplane = ls.Plane
		}
		if slot != 0 && r.LeaderPos == nil { // the leader is slot 0
			if o0, ok := r.Objects[0]; ok && o0.Stamp != nil {
				ls = o0.Stamp
				lplane = r.planeIndexOf(o0)
			}
		}
		if ls != nil && lplane == testPlane {
			lone := make([]byte, len(r.Planes[0]))
			saved := r.Planes[0]
			r.Planes[0] = lone
			r.apply(ls, 0, true)
			onLeader := r.hits(&st, r.Planes[0])
			r.Planes[0] = saved
			if onLeader && !intIn(r.Bumped, slot) {
				r.Bumped = append(r.Bumped, slot)
				if o.GateFlags&3 == 1 && r.Latch == 0 { // C0:77EF-780D
					r.LatchDir = o.Dir
					r.Latch = slot >> 6
				}
			}
		}
		return "block"
	}
	r.stampObj(o, &st, testPlane)
	if !keep {
		o.Plane = planeBits(cls[0]) // C0:54A8
	}
	r.footprint(o)
	o.D6 = cls[1] // C0:5485: $D9D5-$D9D8 = the entered tile's $D8FC-$D8FF
	o.D7 = cls[2]
	o.D8 = cls[3]
	return ""
}

// gateClass is C0:57FF: the class row of the target pixel (tx, ty), or
// nil when the gate blocks. The $D0DD (open map) and $D991 branches are
// not modeled.
func (r *Runner) gateClass(o *Object, tx, ty int) *[4]int {
	if tx < 0 || ty < 0 { // C0:5835: the tile word's high byte reads 1F
		return nil
	}
	cx := tx >> 3
	cy := ty >> 3
	if cx < r.Bounds[0] || cx >= r.Bounds[2] || cy < r.Bounds[1] || cy >= r.Bounds[3] {
		return nil
	}
	cx %= r.Wrap.X >> 3
	cy %= r.Wrap.Y >> 3
	cls := r.classAt(cx, cy)
	fc := cls[0]
	fe := cls[2]
	if fe&0x88 == 0x08 || (fe&0x80 == 0 && fe&0x02 != 0) { // C0:5881
		return nil
	}
	if r.Grid.Low[cy][cx]&0x08 != 0 { // C0:58CC
		return nil
	}
	flags := o.GateFlags | o.Plane
	if flags&0x30 == 0x10 { // C0:58F7
		if fc&0x10 != 0 {
			return nil
		}
	} else if fc&0xC0 == 0xC0 || flags&0xF0&fc != 0 { // C0:5906-591C
		return nil
	}
	if fc&(8>>(o.MDir&3)) != 0 { // C0:5922: the entered side
		return nil
	}
	return &cls
}

// setMotion is C0:62F8-632E (every 62C3 call): the axis patterns and
// the velocity follow $D9BA and the current row.
func (r *Runner) setMotion(o *Object) {
	pat := axisPattern[(o.MDir>>2)&3] // C0:630C
	o.Pxp = pat & 0xFF
	o.Pyp = pat >> 8
	v := r.velocity(o.Row, o.MDir)
	o.Vel = &v
}

// startWalk is C0:60E8: start a walk; non-scene objects check the
// first tile (C0:614A-6157) and a blocked start ends the walk at once.
func (r *Runner) startWalk(slot int, o *Object) {
	if o.Op != 0x14 && o.Op != 0x10 {
		o.MDir = o.Dir // C0:60E8 stores the walk direction in $D9BA
	}
	o.MDir = r.stairDir(o, o.MDir)
	if o.MDir >= 4 { // C0:60EE: diagonal and slope walks face west or east
		if (o.MDir & 3) < 2 {
			o.Dir = 2
		} else {
			o.Dir = 3
		}
	}
	r.setMotion(o)
	r.walkFromHere(slot, o)
}

// walkFromHere is C0:6101-6157: the first tile's checks of a walk set
// up by the caller.
func (r *Runner) walkFromHere(slot int, o *Object) {
	o.T8 = 0
	o.C4 = o.C3 // C0:6135: only the step count reloads; the move pattern keeps its phase
	if o.Scene {
		return
	}
	switch r.checks(slot, o) {
	case "prox":
		r.proximityJump(o)
	case "block":
		o.T8 = 1
	}
}

// stairDir is C0:577E: on a stair tile (the class byte 3 of the tile
// last entered, $D9D8, has the bit 0x80 >> (d+1)) a cardinal walk
// becomes one diagonal tile; $D9B2 bit 4 objects ignore stairs.
func (r *Runner) stairDir(o *Object, d int) int {
	if (o.GateFlags|o.Plane)&0x10 != 0 || d >= 4 {
		return d
	}
	if o.D8&(0x80>>(d+1)) == 0 {
		return d
	}
	o.T7 = 1
	if o.D8&0x80 != 0 {
		if (d+1)&3 < 2 {
			return 7
		}
		return 5
	}
	if d&1 != 0 {
		return 6
	}
	return 4
}

// restampHere is C0:66F2: $D9BA = 0x18 (no offset), then the gate and
// C0:7731 on the object's own tile, results unused: the stamp moves to
// the plane the tile's class picks unless that spot is taken. Objects
// spawned without SetObject have no collision model.
func (r *Runner) restampHere(o *Object) {
	o.MDir = 0x18
	if o.Stamp == nil {
		return
	}
	cls := r.classAt(posmod(o.X, r.Wrap.X)>>3, posmod(o.Y, r.Wrap.Y)>>3)
	testPlane := 0
	if cls[1]&0x80 != 0 {
		testPlane = r.planeIndexOf(o)
	} else if cls[0]&0xC0 == 0x40 {
		testPlane = 1
	}
	r.apply(o.Stamp, r.planeIndexOf(o), false)
	st := r.shapeAt((*o.Hitbox)[o.Dir&3], o.X, o.Y)
	if r.hits(&st, r.Planes[testPlane]) {
		r.apply(o.Stamp, r.planeIndexOf(o), true)
	} else {
		r.stampObj(o, &st, testPlane)
	}
}

// eraseStamp is C0:6703: erase the object's stamp (C0:7956). The saved
// shape stays, so a later erase clears those bits again, as the
// engine's does.
func (r *Runner) eraseStamp(o *Object) {
	if o.Stamp != nil {
		r.apply(o.Stamp, r.planeIndexOf(o), false)
	}
}

// footprint is C0:5413-544B -> 7C75: a passed step leaves a footprint
// on the tile the object stands on when that tile's class ($D9D7/$D9D8,
// still the old tile's) has byte 3 bit 1 and not byte 2 bit 5, unless
// $D9B2 bits 4-5 are 0x10: the first time (low-buffer bit 1, set here)
// the footprint layer's word gains facing+1.
func (r *Runner) footprint(o *Object) {
	if o.D7&0x20 != 0 || o.D8&0x02 == 0 || (o.GateFlags|o.Plane)&0x30 == 0x10 {
		return
	}
	if len(r.Grid.Low) == 0 {
		return
	}
	tx := posmod(o.X, r.Wrap.X) >> 3
	ty := posmod(o.Y, r.Wrap.Y) >> 3
	b := r.Grid.Low[ty][tx]
	if b&3 != 3 {
		if b&2 != 0 {
			return
		}
		r.Grid.Low[ty][tx] = b | 2
	}
	r.Footprints = append(r.Footprints, Footprint{X: tx, Y: ty, Delta: (o.Dir & 3) + 1})
}

```

`internal/game/battle/attack.go`:

```go
package battle

// The attack/judgment resolution paths (docs/battle-formulas.md §4
// defense chain + §15 families + §6 statuses + §4.6 spark), port of
// battle.gd's resolve half.

import ib "saga3/internal/battle"

// AttackResult is one attack through the §4 chain.
type AttackResult struct {
	Dmg     int
	Landed  int
	E0      int
	Events  []string
	Missed  bool
	Blocked bool
}

// resolveAttackChain runs one attack through the §4 chain: shield block
// (C2:89EC, once per attack), then per-hit counter/parry (C2:86C6) and
// hit rolls (C2:8AF6 family rolls, $0379 rand 1..100 <= rate; type 0x11
// self-buffs have no roll path and always land), then one family D with
// the full 回数 and one envelope against the target's attribute defense
// $E0 (C2:B3ED/99D5). computeD is the family's D factory; it receives
// (hits, e0) - the family's 攻−防÷2 term reads the same $e0.
func (e *Engine) resolveAttackChain(attacker, target *Combatant, techRes TechRow, techEn EnemyTechRow,
	enemy bool, hits, weight, lv int, computeD func(hits, e0 int) int) AttackResult {
	var res AttackResult
	attrs := techEn.Attributes
	name := techEn.Name
	if !enemy {
		attrs = techRes.Attributes
		name = techRes.Name
	}
	e0 := AttributeDefense(attrs, target.AttrDef)
	res.E0 = e0
	// shield block
	if shield := e.EquippedShield(target); shield != nil {
		if ShieldBlockLanded(shield.Evade, e.Roll100(), target.Defending) {
			res.Blocked = true
			res.Events = append(res.Events, target.Name+" は "+shield.Name+" で防いだ")
			return res
		}
	}
	// per-hit rolls
	counter := e.CounterTechFor(target)
	landed := 0
	if !enemy && techRes.Type == 0x11 {
		landed = hits
	} else {
		techType, baseHit := techEn.TechType, techEn.Hit
		if !enemy {
			techType, baseHit = techRes.Type, techRes.Hit
		}
		rate := HitRateEngine(techType, baseHit, lv, attacker.STR, e.CombatSpeed(attacker),
			weight, EvadeSum(e.CombatSpeed(target), 0))
		for i := 0; i < hits; i++ {
			if counter != nil && CounterLanded(counter.Hit, e.Roll100(), false, target.Defending) {
				res.Events = append(res.Events, target.Name+" は "+counter.Name+" で受け流した")
				continue
			}
			if HitLanded(rate, e.Roll100()) {
				landed++
			}
		}
	}
	res.Landed = landed
	if landed == 0 {
		res.Missed = true
		res.Events = append(res.Events, attacker.Name+" の "+name+" は "+target.Name+" にかわされた")
		return res
	}
	if e0 >= 0x80 {
		res.Events = append(res.Events, target.Name+" は "+name+" を受けつけない")
		return res
	}
	d := computeD(hits, e0)
	res.Dmg = EnvelopeE0(d, e0, target.VIT, target.Defending)
	return res
}

// CounterTechFor is the defender's counter tech (§4.2): only a
// カウンター技 (settings bit 0x02) placed in the assigned-tech slots
// (battle record +0x47..+0x4E, FE:E0CA) counters. The opening party's
// slots are all empty, so パリイ known but unassigned never rolls. The
// port has no assignment screen yet, so "assigned" starts empty.
func (e *Engine) CounterTechFor(target *Combatant) *TechRow {
	for _, tid := range target.AssignedTechs {
		if rec, ok := e.D.Techniques[tid]; ok && rec.Settings&0x02 != 0 {
			return &rec
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// EquippedShield is the defender's shield row, or nil. Enemies carry no
// shield data (their armor is joined into the record at build time).
func (e *Engine) EquippedShield(c *Combatant) *ItemRow {
	for _, sid := range c.Equipment {
		if sid == "" {
			continue
		}
		if it, ok := e.D.Items[sid]; ok && it.Kind == "shield" {
			return &it
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// ResolveAllyAction is one ally action against the chosen living enemy:
// WP/JP is paid, then the §4 defense chain, then the tech record's 基/成
// with the equipped weapon's 攻 and the actor's class level through the
// §15 family, and the envelope with the target's $E0. bokuno battles
// resolve per action - there is no linkage/chain system to defer into.
func (e *Engine) ResolveAllyAction(allyIdx int, techID string, targetIdx int) {
	a := e.Allies[allyIdx]
	if rec, ok := e.D.Techniques[techID]; ok && rec.Cost > 0 {
		if rec.JPCost {
			a.JP = maxInt(a.JP-rec.Cost, 0)
		} else {
			a.WP = maxInt(a.WP-rec.Cost, 0)
		}
	}
	tech := e.D.Techniques[techID]
	target := e.Enemies[targetIdx]
	// C2:A70F: the spark walk runs before the executor, for a tech with
	// 閃き派生有効 (+6 bit 0x80) against an enemy; a spark runs the new tech
	if tech.Special&0x80 != 0 {
		if sparked := e.TrySpark(a, techID, tech.Class, target); sparked != "" {
			techID = sparked
			tech = e.D.Techniques[techID]
		}
	}
	res := e.ResolveAllyAttack(a, tech, target)
	for _, ev := range res.Events {
		e.log(ev)
	}
	target.HP = maxInt(target.HP-res.Dmg, 0)
	if res.Missed || res.Blocked {
		e.log(a.Name + "：" + e.SpecLabel(techID) + " → " + target.Name + " 命中せず")
	} else {
		e.log(a.Name + "：" + e.SpecLabel(techID) + " → " + target.Name + " " + itoa(res.Dmg) + " 傷害（殘 " + itoa(target.HP) + "）")
	}
	if target.HP == 0 {
		target.Alive = false
		e.log(target.Name + " を倒した！")
		e.ApplyAddedEffects(&tech, target)
		return
	}
	e.ApplyAddedEffects(&tech, target)
}

// ResolveAllyItem is one ally item use (docs/battle-formulas.md §16): the
// item action is tech 08「術」(type 4); its executor C2:700E applies the
// 道具 record's 回復力 (= byte +1 x 4, items.json recover_power) and the
// +2 cure bits (bit 0x01 毒 is the decoded one). Attack items carry
// 回復力 = 0 and +2 = 0, so the engine no-ops them. No WP/JP cost. The
// equipped item is NOT consumed (§16: the engine never reads the bag in
// battle and the 腕4 slot survives a use), so the command stays available
// next turn.
func (e *Engine) ResolveAllyItem(allyIdx int, itemID string, targetIdx int) {
	a := e.Allies[allyIdx]
	item := e.D.Items[itemID]
	target := e.Allies[targetIdx]
	if item.RecoverPower > 0 {
		healed := minInt(item.RecoverPower, maxInt(target.MaxHP-target.HP, 0))
		target.HP += healed
		e.log(a.Name + "：" + item.Name + " → " + target.Name + " " + itoa(healed) + " 回復（殘 " + itoa(target.HP) + "/" + itoa(target.MaxHP) + "）")
	} else {
		e.log(a.Name + "：" + item.Name + " → " + target.Name + " 何も起きなかった（戦闘では効果なし）")
	}
	if item.CuresStatus&0x01 != 0 && target.Poison {
		target.Poison = false
		e.log(target.Name + " の毒が治った")
	}
	for _, bit := range []int{0x02, 0x04, 0x08, 0x10, 0x20} {
		if item.CuresStatus&bit != 0 {
			e.Say(item.Name + " の status cure bit " + hexByte(bit) + " は未実装")
		}
	}
}

// ResolveAllyAttack is the ally-side D factory + chain entry (also used
// by confusion attacks). The 乱 term is the §2.1 roll; the e0 argument
// feeds the family's 攻−防÷2 term (the engine family reads $e0, C2:8F22).
func (e *Engine) ResolveAllyAttack(a *Combatant, tech TechRow, target *Combatant) AttackResult {
	techType := tech.Type
	hits := maxInt(tech.Hits, 1)
	classCode := tech.Class
	classLabel := weaponClassNames[classCode]
	if classLabel == "" {
		classLabel = "剣"
	}
	classLv := e.ClassLevel(a, classCode)
	power := tech.Power
	growth := tech.Growth
	weight := 0
	if wid := e.WeaponItemID(a); wid != "" {
		weight = e.D.Items[wid].Weight
	}
	c, _ := ib.C(classLabel, classLv)
	atk := a.WeaponAtk
	computeD := func(h, e0 int) int {
		rand := RandBonus(e.R, classLv)
		switch techType {
		case 0x00, 0x01, 0x02:
			return FamilyWeaponD(power, h, growth, a.STR, atk, e0, c, classLv, rand)
		case 0x03:
			eff := effSpeed(a.AGI, 0, 0)
			return FamilyMartialD(power, h, growth, a.STR, eff, c, classLv, rand)
		default:
			e.Say(tech.Name + "：技タイプ " + hexByte(techType) + " は §2.1 フォールバック")
			base := power * 4 * h
			d, _ := ib.WeaponD(base, a.STR, atk, e0, growth, classLv, classLabel, rand)
			return d
		}
	}
	return e.resolveAttackChain(a, target, tech, EnemyTechRow{}, false, hits, weight, classLv, computeD)
}

// WeaponItemID is the equipped weapon's item id ("" = bare-handed): the
// weight source for the §4.1 hit-rate term.
func (e *Engine) WeaponItemID(a *Combatant) string {
	for _, slot := range a.Equipment {
		if slot == "" {
			continue
		}
		if it, ok := e.D.Items[slot]; ok && it.Kind == "weapon" {
			return slot
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// PlainTechFor is the actor's plain-attack tech record: the engine's
// normal attack for the equipped weapon's class, 素手 (00) bare-handed.
func (e *Engine) PlainTechFor(a *Combatant) string {
	if a.WeaponClass < 0 {
		return "00"
	}
	if t, ok := normalAttackTech[a.WeaponClass]; ok {
		return t
	}
	return "01"
}

// BattleItemFor is the ally's equipped 道具 record (engine 腕4, the fourth
// 腕 slot). Empty slot or a missing catalog row = no item command.
func (e *Engine) BattleItemFor(a *Combatant) *ItemRow {
	if len(a.Equipment) <= 3 || a.Equipment[3] == "" {
		return nil
	}
	if row, ok := e.D.Items[a.Equipment[3]]; ok && row.Kind == "consumable" {
		return &row
	}
	return nil
}

// ClassLevel is the actor's level in a class (clamped 0..50).
func (e *Engine) ClassLevel(a *Combatant, classCode int) int {
	idx, ok := classWLevel[classCode]
	if !ok {
		idx = 0
	}
	if idx >= len(a.WLevels) {
		return 0
	}
	return clampIndex(a.WLevels[idx], 0, 50)
}

// ResolveConfusion: a confused combatant swings at a random living
// combatant on either side (through the same §4 defense chain as a normal
// attack).
func (e *Engine) ResolveConfusion(idx int) {
	c := e.actorAt(idx)
	type pickT struct {
		idx int
		c   *Combatant
	}
	var pool []pickT
	for j := 0; j < e.combatantCount(); j++ {
		o := e.actorAt(j)
		if j != idx && o.Alive {
			pool = append(pool, pickT{j, o})
		}
	}
	if len(pool) == 0 {
		return
	}
	target := pool[e.R.Roll(0, uint8(len(pool)-1))].c
	e.log(c.Name + " は混乱している")
	var res AttackResult
	if c.IsAlly {
		plain := e.D.Techniques[e.PlainTechFor(c)]
		res = e.ResolveAllyAttack(c, plain, target)
	} else {
		move := e.EnemyMoveOf(c)
		res = e.ResolveEnemyAttack(c, target, move)
	}
	for _, ev := range res.Events {
		e.log(ev)
	}
	target.HP = maxInt(target.HP-res.Dmg, 0)
	e.log(c.Name + " → " + target.Name + " " + itoa(res.Dmg) + " 傷害（殘 " + itoa(target.HP) + "）")
	if target.HP == 0 {
		target.Alive = false
		e.log(target.Name + " は倒れた")
	}
}

// EnemyRoundTurn runs one enemy action in the round loop.
func (e *Engine) EnemyRoundTurn(idx int) {
	en := e.actorAt(idx)
	e.EnemyRoundTurnDict(en, en.Decision)
}

// EnemyRoundTurnDict resolves the decision the round start picked. A
// fallen single target falls to the first living ally (the engine's
// re-target at action time is not decoded); targets the executor has no
// path for (self, the enemy side, everyone, counter stance) log the move
// only.
func (e *Engine) EnemyRoundTurnDict(en *Combatant, d Decision) {
	if d.Empty() {
		return
	}
	switch d.Kind {
	case TAlly:
		t := e.Allies[d.Index]
		if !t.Alive {
			t = e.FirstLiving(e.Allies)
		}
		e.EnemyAttack(en, t)
	case TAllAllies:
		for _, t := range e.Allies {
			if t.Alive {
				e.EnemyAttack(en, t)
			}
		}
	case TNone:
	default:
		e.log(en.Name + " の " + e.EnemyTechName(d.Tech))
	}
}

// EnemyTechName resolves an enemy tech label.
func (e *Engine) EnemyTechName(id string) string {
	if n, ok := e.D.EnemyTechNames[id]; ok {
		return n
	}
	return "技" + id
}

// EnemyMove carries the pattern row's weapon fields for one enemy action.
type EnemyMove struct {
	Name         string
	WeaponAtk    int
	WeaponWeight int
}

// EnemyMoveOf is the move the round-start decision picked (C2:5AE6:
// pattern 1 or 2 by the C2:59FF roll, slot by the unlocked range); it
// also sets EnemyLastMoveID for the 敵技性能 lookup.
func (e *Engine) EnemyMoveOf(en *Combatant) EnemyMove {
	d := en.Decision
	pat := en.Patterns[d.WeaponPattern]
	e.EnemyLastMoveID = d.Tech
	weight := 0
	if it, ok := e.D.Items[hexByte(pat.Weapon)]; ok && it.Kind == "weapon" {
		weight = it.Weight
	}
	return EnemyMove{Name: e.EnemyTechName(d.Tech), WeaponAtk: pat.WeaponAtk, WeaponWeight: weight}
}

// EnemyFamilyD is the damage D for an enemy attacker through the §15
// families, computed the engine way: one D with the full 回数 (C2:6EEE
// loop), the family's 攻−防÷2 term reading the target's $e0. Dispatch by
// the tech record's 技タイプ byte (docs/battle-formulas.md §15):
// 0x00-0x02 weapon swings -> C2:8F22; 0x03 martial/素手 -> C2:9007;
// 0x06 earthquake -> C2:91C3; 0x11 self-buff -> NO damage (executor
// 7531). Unknown types log loudly and deal 0.
func (e *Engine) EnemyFamilyD(en *Combatant, tech EnemyTechRow, move EnemyMove, hits, e0 int) int {
	techType := tech.TechType
	power := tech.Power
	growth := tech.Growth
	techLv := en.TechLV
	classCode := tech.Class
	classLabel := enemyClassNames[classCode]
	if classLabel == "" {
		classLabel = "剣"
	}
	c, _ := ib.C(classLabel, techLv)
	atk := move.WeaponAtk
	switch techType {
	case 0x00, 0x01, 0x02:
		return FamilyWeaponD(power, hits, growth, en.STR, atk, e0, c, techLv, RandBonus(e.R, techLv))
	case 0x03:
		eff := effSpeed(en.AGI, 0, 0)
		return FamilyMartialD(power, hits, growth, en.STR, eff, c, techLv, RandBonus(e.R, techLv))
	case 0x06:
		return FamilyQuakeD(power, en.STR, atk, move.WeaponWeight&7, c, growth, RandBonus(e.R, techLv))
	case 0x11:
		return 0 // self-buff family: the executor applies a stat-up, no damage
	default:
		e.Say(move.Name + " は未実装の技タイプ " + hexByte(techType) + "（ダメージ 0）")
		return 0
	}
}

// ResolveEnemyAttack is the enemy-side chain entry (docs §4): hit rolls
// per 回数, one family D, one envelope against the target's $e0.
func (e *Engine) ResolveEnemyAttack(en *Combatant, target *Combatant, move EnemyMove) AttackResult {
	tech := e.D.EnemyTechs[e.EnemyLastMoveID]
	hits := maxInt(tech.Hits, 1)
	weight := move.WeaponWeight
	techLv := en.TechLV
	computeD := func(h, e0 int) int {
		return e.EnemyFamilyD(en, tech, move, h, e0)
	}
	return e.resolveAttackChain(en, target, TechRow{}, tech, true, hits, weight, techLv, computeD)
}

// EnemyAttack is one enemy action against a living ally: the move pick,
// the defender's counter spark before the shield and hit rolls (C2:A96F;
// a success voids this hit), the §4 chain, then the tech's added-effect
// statuses against the ally (§6.2).
func (e *Engine) EnemyAttack(en *Combatant, target *Combatant) {
	if target == nil || !target.Alive {
		return
	}
	move := e.EnemyMoveOf(en)
	tech := e.D.EnemyTechs[e.EnemyLastMoveID]
	// C2:A96F: the defender's counter spark runs before the shield and
	// hit rolls; a success voids this hit
	if e.CounterSpark(en, target, &tech) {
		return
	}
	res := e.ResolveEnemyAttack(en, target, move)
	for _, ev := range res.Events {
		e.log(ev)
	}
	total := res.Dmg
	target.HP = maxInt(target.HP-total, 0)
	guard := ""
	if target.Defending {
		guard = "（守）"
	}
	if res.Missed || res.Blocked {
		e.log(en.Name + " の " + move.Name + " → " + target.Name + " 命中せず")
	} else {
		e.log(en.Name + " の " + move.Name + " → " + target.Name + " " + itoa(total) + " 傷害" + guard + "（殘 " + itoa(target.HP) + "）")
	}
	if target.HP == 0 {
		target.Alive = false
		e.log(target.Name + " は倒れた")
		return
	}
	if res.Landed > 0 {
		e.ApplyAddedEffectsEnemy(&tech, target)
	}
}

// SpecLabel is the ally tech's display name ("攻撃" for unknown ids).
func (e *Engine) SpecLabel(techID string) string {
	if t, ok := e.D.Techniques[techID]; ok {
		return t.Name
	}
	return "攻撃"
}

func effSpeed(base, armorBonus, armorWeight int) int {
	return base + armorBonus - armorWeight/2
}

func sleepDecay(status, targetVit int) int {
	return status/4*3 - minInt(targetVit, 99)
}
```

`internal/game/battle/compose.go`:

```go
package battle

// Encounter composition (C2:13EA), port of main.gd's _compose_encounter
// block; ground truth docs/field-monsters.md "Encounter composition" and
// docs/formation-f.md (the F branch, decoded + live-verified 2026-11-23).

// EncounterByte classifies a field event id: NPC event ids 0x18xx/0x19xx
// are the battle encounters (the touch dispatcher C0:AB2E byteswaps the
// id word; ops 18/19 are the battle dispatch), and the id's low byte is
// the engine's $1306 -> $141B encounter byte (low nibble race, high
// nibble companion pattern / F = multi-leader). The 0x2xxx ids are NOT
// encounters: byteswapped they land on queue words whose low byte >= 0x20
// and the queue processor (5A:E654) skips them — traced live
// (tools/emulator enc_dispatch.lua run /tmp/encdisp/run1: NPC 0x1862 ->
// word 0x6218 dispatched; a 0x2000 bump enqueued 0x0020 and dispatched
// nothing). Returns -1 for a non-encounter id.
func EncounterByte(ev string) int {
	if len(ev) != 4 {
		return -1
	}
	hi := hexPair(ev[0], ev[1])
	if hi != 0x18 && hi != 0x19 {
		return -1
	}
	return hexPair(ev[2], ev[3])
}

func hexPair(a, b byte) int {
	const digits = "0123456789ABCDEFabcdef"
	hi := -1
	lo := -1
	for i, d := range digits {
		if rune(a) == d {
			hi = i % 16
		}
		if rune(b) == d {
			lo = i % 16
		}
	}
	if hi < 0 || lo < 0 {
		return -1
	}
	return hi<<4 | lo
}

// LevelTerm is S_C2_15E6 (level = $F533[race], add = $F319 party count)
// and S_C2_16F1 (level = $F532 global, add = 4): (level*7)>>3 + two
// roll(1, level>>3) + add - roll(1, 8), floored at 0.
func LevelTerm(r RNG, level, add int) int {
	v := (level*7)>>3 + r.Roll(1, uint8(level>>3)) + r.Roll(1, uint8(level>>3)) + add
	return maxInt(0, v-r.Roll(1, 8))
}

// PartyTerm is S_C2_16B0: ($1308 & 0xF0) + $F319 - roll(1, 8), floored
// at 0. base = the map's $D2FE (encounter_party_base).
func PartyTerm(r RNG, base, partyCount int) int {
	return maxInt(0, (base&0xF0)+partyCount-r.Roll(1, 8))
}

// EncounterLevel is FE:D097: $56 = min(255, max(level term, party term)).
func EncounterLevel(r RNG, term, base, partyCount int) int {
	return minInt(255, maxInt(term, PartyTerm(r, base, partyCount)))
}

// EncounterBudget is FE:D0AF ($57, add 0) / FE:D0D9 ($58, add = the
// companion bonus FE:317A): max(0, global-excess>>4 + (level & 0x0F)>>1 +
// add - count).
func EncounterBudget(level, globalLevel, count, add int) int {
	excess := 0
	if globalLevel > level {
		excess = (globalLevel - level) >> 4
	}
	return maxInt(0, excess+((level&0x0F)>>1)+add-count)
}

// fits is FE:D107: the enemy's grid extents against the hensei row.
func fits(d *Data, id int, h *HenseiRow) bool {
	row := d.EnemyByID[id]
	if row == nil {
		panic("battle: compose enemy missing from enemies.json: " + itoa(id))
	}
	return row.FitWidth <= h.WidthMax && row.FitHeight <= h.HeightMax
}

// kindOK is FE:D139: at most three distinct enemy kinds ($16D2 list).
func kindOK(kinds []int, id int) ([]int, bool) {
	for _, k := range kinds {
		if k == id {
			return kinds, true
		}
	}
	if len(kinds) < 3 {
		return append(kinds, id), true
	}
	return kinds, false
}

// ComposeConfig carries the composition's world inputs.
type ComposeConfig struct {
	Base        int     // the map's $D2FE
	PartyCount  int     // $F319
	GlobalLevel int     // $F532
	RaceLevels  [16]int // $F533
}

// ComposeEncounter is C2:13EA: the enemy ids of one field encounter,
// leader first. enc = the encounter byte ($141B): low nibble race, high
// nibble companion pattern / F = multi-leader. Fixed formations reuse it:
// levelByte = the record's $141C (nonzero: the level term starts from
// $F532 ± (byte & 7F), bit 7 subtracting, clamped 0..FF, C2:15E6, in
// place of $F533[race]); fixedLeader/fixedHensei >= 0 pass the type-03
// record's leader and hensei (C2:15A0 still rolls the level).
func ComposeEncounter(r RNG, d *Data, ef *EnemyFormations, cfg *ComposeConfig,
	enc int, levelByte int, fixedLeader, fixedHensei int) []int {
	race := enc & 0x0F
	pattern := enc >> 4
	n := cfg.PartyCount
	g := cfg.GlobalLevel
	raceLevel := cfg.RaceLevels[race]
	if levelByte != 0 {
		delta := levelByte & 0x7F
		if levelByte&0x80 != 0 {
			raceLevel = g - delta
		} else {
			raceLevel = g + delta
		}
		if raceLevel < 0 {
			raceLevel = 0
		} else if raceLevel > 0xFF {
			raceLevel = 0xFF
		}
	}
	// C2:1411: the leader from band $56>>4, the hensei's max count.
	level := EncounterLevel(r, LevelTerm(r, raceLevel, n), cfg.Base, n)
	pair := ef.Appearance[race][level>>4]
	leader := pair.Leader
	if fixedLeader >= 0 {
		leader = fixedLeader
	}
	henseiIdx := pair.Hensei
	if fixedHensei >= 0 {
		henseiIdx = fixedHensei
	}
	hensei := &ef.Hensei[henseiIdx]
	maxCount := hensei.Count
	ids := []int{leader}
	kinds := []int{leader}
	if len(ids) == maxCount {
		return ids
	}
	if pattern == 0xF {
		// C2:1461: each remaining slot re-rolls the level and may add a
		// leader of the new band (fit and kind checked); 5 draws per slot
		// (the level term's 4 + the roll(1, 15) gate).
		for range maxCount - len(ids) {
			level = EncounterLevel(r, LevelTerm(r, raceLevel, n), cfg.Base, n)
			if EncounterBudget(level, g, len(ids), 0) < r.Roll(1, 15) {
				continue
			}
			id := ef.Appearance[race][level>>4].Leader
			var ok bool
			kinds, ok = kindOK(kinds, id)
			if fits(d, id, hensei) && ok {
				ids = append(ids, id)
			}
		}
		return ids
	}
	// C2:14D0: copies of the leader, budget $57 per remaining slot.
	for range maxCount - len(ids) {
		if EncounterBudget(level, g, len(ids), 0) >= r.Roll(1, 15) {
			ids = append(ids, leader)
		}
	}
	if len(ids) == maxCount {
		return ids
	}
	// C2:150C: companions from pattern `pattern`, budget $58 set once.
	budget := EncounterBudget(level, g, len(ids), ef.CompanionBonus)
	comps := ef.Companions[pattern]
	for range maxCount - len(ids) {
		if budget < r.Roll(1, 15) {
			continue
		}
		added := false
		for attempt := 0; attempt < 3 && !added; attempt++ {
			clevel := EncounterLevel(r, LevelTerm(r, g, 4), cfg.Base, n)
			for _, e := range comps {
				if e[0] <= clevel {
					id := e[1]
					var ok bool
					kinds, ok = kindOK(kinds, id)
					if fits(d, id, hensei) && ok {
						ids = append(ids, id)
						added = true
					}
					break
				}
			}
		}
		if !added || budget == 0 {
			return ids
		}
		budget--
	}
	return ids
}
```

`internal/game/battle/compose_test.go`:

```go
package battle

import (
	"testing"

	"saga3/internal/game/rng"
)

// fixtures_test.go holds the shared helpers (readRngTable, fixedAt,
// newEngineAt, assertEq).

// The encounter composition pins (C2:13EA + the F variant). Sources:
// main.gd's --selftest block ("encounters ok" / "composition ok" /
// "fixed compositions" / "F composition ok", read 2026-11-23), whose
// expected values come from the live engine traces (tools/emulator
// enc_dispatch.lua /tmp/encdisp/run1, encounter_comp.lua
// /tmp/encounter/run1, formationf.lua battles 138/139) and from the
// decode simulation of docs/formation-f.md run over battle_rng.bin.
// The seed-0x21 composition walks are regression pins of the battle
// generator from clock 0x21, not engine evidence (same stance as
// main.gd's).

// newBattleRNG builds the traced generator over exports/data/battle_rng.bin
// (Trace non-nil from the start: every roll logs its bounds and index,
// like the GDScript's brng.trace = []).
func newBattleRNG(t *testing.T, clock int) *rng.Battle {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := rng.NewBattle(readRngTable(t))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("rng table: %v", err)
	}
	b.SeedFromClock(clock)
	b.Trace = []rng.TraceEntry{}
	return b
}

func composeAt(t *testing.T, clock int, party []int, enc int, base int,
	levelByte int, fixedLeader, fixedHensei int) ([]int, int) {
	t.Helper()
	r := newBattleRNG(t, clock)
	return composeSeq(t, r, party, enc, base, levelByte, fixedLeader, fixedHensei)
}

// composeSeq runs one composition on an existing generator (the walks
// that repeat at one seed share the generator's advancing index, exactly
// like main.gd's selftest).
func composeSeq(t *testing.T, r *rng.Battle, party []int, enc int, base int,
	levelByte int, fixedLeader, fixedHensei int) ([]int, int) {
	t.Helper()
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	cfg := &ComposeConfig{Base: base, PartyCount: len(party),
		GlobalLevel: 0, RaceLevels: [16]int{}}
	ids := ComposeEncounter(r, d, &d.EnemyFormations, cfg, enc, levelByte, fixedLeader, fixedHensei)
	return ids, r.Index
}

func TestEncounterByte(t *testing.T) {
	// docs/triggers.md "The 0x2xxx field ids are NOT an encounter class":
	// ops 18/19 dispatch, everything else is inert (main.gd selftest; the
	// pin values live in testdata/race2_composition.json).
	pin := loadPin[struct {
		Bytes map[string]any `json:"encounter_bytes"`
	}](t, "race2_composition.json").Bytes
	for ev, v := range pin {
		want, ok := v.(float64)
		if !ok {
			continue // the _source note
		}
		if got := EncounterByte(ev); got != int(want) {
			t.Fatalf("EncounterByte(%s) = %X, want %X", ev, got, int(want))
		}
	}
}

type fCompositionPin struct {
	Frame    int   `json:"frame"`
	Want     []int `json:"want"`
	EndIndex int   `json:"end_index"`
}

func TestFComposition(t *testing.T) {
	// The F-variant multi-leader loop (C2:1461, docs/formation-f.md):
	// fixed type-1 records 138 (enc F1, race 1) and 139 (enc FF, race F)
	// reach it through the C2:13C0 dispatch. The decode's per-seed
	// prediction (independent sim over battle_rng.bin, verified
	// draw-for-draw against the live engine battles, formationf.lua) is
	// pinned in testdata/race2_composition.json.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	pin := loadPin[struct {
		FRecords struct {
			F138     *fCompositionPin `json:"138"`
			F139     *fCompositionPin `json:"139"`
			F138Solo *fCompositionPin `json:"138_solo"`
			F139Solo *fCompositionPin `json:"139_solo"`
		} `json:"f_records"`
	}](t, "race2_composition.json").FRecords
	f138 := &d.FixedBattles[0x8A]
	f139 := &d.FixedBattles[0x8B]
	assert := func(what string, ids []int, idx int, p *fCompositionPin) {
		t.Helper()
		if len(ids) != len(p.Want) {
			t.Fatalf("%s = %v, want %v", what, ids, p.Want)
		}
		for i := range p.Want {
			if ids[i] != p.Want[i] {
				t.Fatalf("%s = %v, want %v", what, ids, p.Want)
			}
		}
		if idx != p.EndIndex {
			t.Fatalf("%s index %#X, want %#X", what, idx, p.EndIndex)
		}
	}
	g138, idx138 := composeAt(t, pin.F138.Frame, []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6}, f138.Enc, 0, f138.Level, -1, -1)
	g139, idx139 := composeAt(t, pin.F139.Frame, []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6}, f139.Enc, 0, f139.Level, -1, -1)
	assert("F 138", g138, idx138, pin.F138)
	assert("F 139", g139, idx139, pin.F139)
	s138, s138idx := composeAt(t, pin.F138Solo.Frame, []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6}, f138.Enc, 0, f138.Level, -1, -1)
	s139, s139idx := composeAt(t, pin.F139Solo.Frame, []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6}, f139.Enc, 0, f139.Level, -1, -1)
	assert("F 138 solo", s138, s138idx, pin.F138Solo)
	assert("F 139 solo", s139, s139idx, pin.F139Solo)
}

func TestRandomFBytes(t *testing.T) {
	// The four random F bytes at fresh state ($F533[race] = 0): every add
	// is a band-0 leader of the byte's own race column (single kind), and
	// the tiny $57 budget yields only sizes 1-2 across the 60 legal clock
	// frames (engine draw shape 2 + 3 per slot: the level>>3 rolls are
	// degenerate at level 0 and do not advance the index; main.gd
	// selftest over all 60 frames, here at the documented frames).
	cases := []struct {
		race, leader int
	}{
		{0x0, 0}, {0x1, 16}, {0xB, 176}, {0xF, 240},
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		sizes := map[int]bool{}
		for _, frame := range []int{0, 1, 0x0F, 0x21, 0x3B} {
			ids, _ := composeAt(t, frame, []int{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6}, 0xF0|c.race, 0, 0, -1, -1)
			for _, id := range ids {
				if id != c.leader {
					t.Fatalf("fresh F byte %X group %v, want band-0 leader %d only", 0xF0|c.race, ids, c.leader)
				}
			}
			sizes[len(ids)] = true
		}
		if minSize(sizes) < 1 || maxSize(sizes) > 2 {
			t.Fatalf("fresh F byte %X sizes %v, want 1..2", 0xF0|c.race, keys(sizes))
		}
	}
}

func minSize(m map[int]bool) int {
	mn := 1 << 30
	for k := range m {
		if k < mn {
			mn = k
		}
	}
	return mn
}

func maxSize(m map[int]bool) int {
	mx := 0
	for k := range m {
		if k > mx {
			mx = k
		}
	}
	return mx
}

func keys(m map[int]bool) []int {
	out := make([]int, 0, len(m))
	for k := range m {
		out = append(out, k)
	}
	return out
}

```

```go
// UnmarshalJSON parses the export's [tech-hex, difficulty] pair.
func (s *SparkEntry) UnmarshalJSON(b []byte) error {
	var pair []any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &pair); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if len(pair) != 2 {
		return fmt.Errorf("spark entry needs [tech, difficulty], got %v", pair)
	}
	tech, ok := pair[0].(string)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("spark tech %v is not a hex string", pair[0])
	}
	diff, ok := pair[1].(float64)
	if !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("spark difficulty %v is not a number", pair[1])
	}
	s.Tech, s.Difficulty = tech, int(diff)
	return nil
}

// SparkGroupRow is one spark group: the source hex and its entries.

	Source  string       `json:"source"`

// Data holds every export the battle engine reads.

func readJSON[T any](path string) (T, error) {
	var out T
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return out, fmt.Errorf("read %s: %w", filepath.Base(path), err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &out); err != nil {
		return out, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", filepath.Base(path), err)
	}
	return out, nil
}

// LoadData reads every export the battle engine needs from dir
// (exports/data). The RNG table itself goes through rng.NewBattle by the
// caller; this loader keeps Data engine-neutral.
func LoadData(dir string) (*Data, error) {
	d := &Data{Items: map[string]ItemRow{}, Techniques: map[string]TechRow{},
		EnemyTechs: map[string]EnemyTechRow{}, EnemyTechNames: map[string]string{},
		Formations: map[string]Formation{}}
	allies, err := readJSON[[]AllyRow](filepath.Join(dir, "allies.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	d.Allies = allies
	d.AllyByID = map[int]*AllyRow{}
	for i := range allies {
		id, err := hexID(allies[i].ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("allies.json: %w", err)
		}
		d.AllyByID[id] = &allies[i]
	}
	enemies, err := readJSON[[]EnemyRow](filepath.Join(dir, "enemies.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	d.Enemies = enemies
	d.EnemyByID = map[int]*EnemyRow{}
	for i := range enemies {
		id, err := hexID(enemies[i].ID)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("enemies.json: %w", err)
		}
		d.EnemyByID[id] = &enemies[i]
	}
	items, err := readJSON[[]ItemRow](filepath.Join(dir, "items.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, it := range items {
		d.Items[it.ID] = it
	}
	techs, err := readJSON[[]TechRow](filepath.Join(dir, "techniques.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, t := range techs {
		d.Techniques[t.ID] = t
	}
	etechs, err := readJSON[[]EnemyTechRow](filepath.Join(dir, "enemy_techs.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, t := range etechs {
		d.EnemyTechs[t.ID] = t
	}
	if d.EnemyTechNames, err = readJSON[map[string]string](filepath.Join(dir, "enemy_tech_names.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.Spark, err = readJSON[SparkData](filepath.Join(dir, "spark.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.Levels, err = readJSON[LevelsData](filepath.Join(dir, "levels.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.Growth, err = readJSON[GrowthData](filepath.Join(dir, "growth.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	formations, err := readJSON[[]Formation](filepath.Join(dir, "formations.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	for _, f := range formations {
		d.Formations[f.ID] = f
	}
	if d.EnemyFormations, err = readJSON[EnemyFormations](filepath.Join(dir, "enemy_formations.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.FixedBattles, err = readJSON[[]FixedBattle](filepath.Join(dir, "fixed_battles.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.BattleScripts, err = readJSON[[][]int](filepath.Join(dir, "battle_scripts.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.BattleTalks, err = readJSON[[]TalkRow](filepath.Join(dir, "battle_talks.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.BattleUnlocks, err = readJSON[[]UnlockRow](filepath.Join(dir, "battle_unlocks.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if d.HeroForte, err = readJSON[[][]int](filepath.Join(dir, "hero_forte.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// The 59:FF00 list as exported by cmd/exportbosslist; LoadImmovableList
	// reads the same words straight from the ROM dump (the tests
	// cross-check the two).
	if d.ImmovableIDs, err = readJSON[[]int](filepath.Join(dir, "boss_double_actions.json")); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return d, nil
}

// hexID parses an export id string ("0A") into its integer value.
func hexID(s string) (int, error) {
	var v int
	if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(s, "%x", &v); err != nil {
		return 0, fmt.Errorf("id %q: %w", s, err)
	}
	return v, nil
}

// immovableListOffset is the 59:FF00 word list in the ROM dump: the
// engine-mapped file offset is bank<<16 + (addr & 0xFFFF) — the same
// mapping cmd/exportmap uses for bank F8 (0x380000). Byte-checked against
// docs/battle-enemy-ai.md ("the list holds 124 real ids + three FFFE
// filler words + the FFFF terminator") on patches/bokuno_jp.sfc,
// 2026-11-23.
const immovableListOffset = 0x59*0x10000 + 0xFF00

// LoadImmovableList reads the 59:FF00 FF-terminated word list from the
// ROM dump: the ids that set $22 bit 3 (C2:5665's double-action dispatch).
// Errors on anything but the byte-verified shape: a continuous id run,
// then exactly three FFFE filler words, then the FFFF terminator.
func LoadImmovableList(rom []byte) ([]int, error) {
	if len(rom) < immovableListOffset+2 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("rom too short for 59:FF00 (offset %#x): %d bytes", immovableListOffset, len(rom))
	}
	var ids []int
	fillers := 0
	for i := 0; ; i++ {
		if immovableListOffset+2*i+2 > len(rom) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("59:FF00: rom ends before the FFFF terminator")
		}
		w := int(binary.LittleEndian.Uint16(rom[immovableListOffset+2*i:]))
		switch {
		case w == 0xFFFF:
			if len(ids) == 0 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("59:FF00: empty list")
			}
			if fillers != 3 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("59:FF00: %d FFFE fillers before the terminator, want 3", fillers)
			}
			return ids, nil
		case w == 0xFFFE:
			fillers++
			if fillers > 3 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("59:FF00: more than three FFFE fillers")
			}
		default:
			if fillers != 0 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("59:FF00: real id %#x after a filler word", w)
			}
			ids = append(ids, w)
			if len(ids) > 124 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("59:FF00: more than the documented 124 ids")
			}
		}
	}
}

```

`internal/game/battle/enemyai.go`:

```go
package battle

// The enemy turn's decision chain (dispatcher C2:56D9) and the initiative
// formulas of C2:2556 (allies) and C2:5C3E (enemies), in the engine's
// roll order. Port of godot/enemy_ai.gd; ground truth
// docs/battle-enemy-ai.md. The opening battle's captured rolls and
// outputs pin this (docs/parity.md §4.4).

// Target kinds (the action slot's +5).
const (
	TNone       = "none"        // 0C: no target left
	TAlly       = "ally"        // 0..5: one ally (index)
	TEnemy      = "enemy"       // 80|i: one enemy (index)
	TAllAllies  = "all_allies"  // 00 with range bit 0x20
	TAllEnemies = "all_enemies" // 80 with range bit 0x20
	TEveryone   = "everyone"    // 0A
	TSelf       = "self"        // slot[0] | 80
	TCounter    = "counter"     // 0B: counter stance
)

// AIContext carries what the decision chain reads: round ($26,
// saturating), formationRates (the party formation's five cumulative
// target rates, 5E:A000 row $F322), weighted (use them: C2:BBF7),
// level1308 ($1308 & 0F), globalLevel ($F532), raceLevels ($F533[16]),
// and the combatant lists with the enemy tech table.
type AIContext struct {
	Round          int
	FormationRates []int
	Weighted       bool
	Level1308      int
	GlobalLevel    int
	RaceLevels     [16]int
	Allies         []*Combatant
	Enemies        []*Combatant
	EnemyTechs     map[string]EnemyTechRow
}

// Decision is the round-start action pick: {tech, pattern, weapon
// pattern, target kind, target index}. Tech "" = no action (modes 20-31,
// C2:60B9).
type Decision struct {
	Tech          string
	Pattern       int
	WeaponPattern int
	Kind          string
	Index         int
}

// Empty reports the no-action decision.
func (d Decision) Empty() bool { return d.Tech == "" }

var patternOdds = [4]int{7, 6, 4, 2}                // C2:5A38, indexed by AI mode 0-3
const levelMul = 3                                  // FE:3178 / FE:3179
var pickBits = [5]int{0x80, 0x40, 0x20, 0x10, 0x08} // C2:575D scan order

// Decide runs the dispatcher for one enemy: the slot pick by AI mode, the
// fixed target, the special targeting and the individual target, in the
// engine's roll order.
func Decide(r RNG, e *Combatant, enemyIndex int, ctx *AIContext) Decision {
	pick := ChooseSlot(r, e, ctx)
	if pick == nil {
		return Decision{}
	}
	pattern := pick[0]
	actions := e.Patterns[pattern].Actions
	if len(actions) != 8 {
		panic("battle: a pattern has 8 slots")
	}
	techID := actions[pick[1]]
	tech := ctx.EnemyTechs[techID]
	out := Decision{Tech: techID, Pattern: pattern, WeaponPattern: pick[2],
		Kind: TNone, Index: -1}
	if fixed := FixedTarget(tech, enemyIndex); fixed != nil {
		out.Kind = fixed.Kind
		out.Index = fixed.Index
		return out
	}
	if special := SpecialTarget(r, e, tech, ctx); special != nil {
		out.Kind = special.Kind
		out.Index = special.Index
		return out
	}
	ind := IndividualTarget(r, tech, ctx)
	out.Kind = ind.Kind
	out.Index = ind.Index
	return out
}

// ChooseSlot returns [pattern, slot, weapon pattern] by AI mode: 0-3 the
// chain C2:59FF / 5A43 / 5AE6, 4+ the scripted handlers C2:5E0C. Only
// 0-8 and 31 occur in stat rows; 9-19 are written at run time by the
// multi-action scripts (docs/battle-enemy-ai.md "Scripted modes"). nil =
// no action (mode 20-31).
func ChooseSlot(r RNG, e *Combatant, ctx *AIContext) []int {
	ai := e.AIMode
	mode := ai & 0x1F
	switch mode {
	case 0, 1, 2, 3:
		p := ChoosePattern(r, mode)
		top := UnlockedRange(r, e.ID, ai, ctx)
		return []int{p, r.Roll(0, uint8(top)), p} // C2:5AEC
	case 4, 5: // C2:5E44 / 5E6B
		top := UnlockedRange(r, e.ID, ai, ctx)
		p := mode - 4
		return []int{p, r.Roll(0, uint8(top)), p}
	case 6: // C2:5E92: pattern 1 on odd rounds, weapon always pattern 2's
		top := UnlockedRange(r, e.ID, ai, ctx)
		p := 0
		if ctx.Round&1 == 0 {
			p = 1
		}
		return []int{p, r.Roll(0, uint8(top)), 1}
	case 7: // C2:5ED3: pattern 2 slot 7, then mode 1
		e.AIMode = (ai & 0xE0) | 1
		return []int{1, 7, 1}
	case 8: // C2:5EF3: pattern 2 slots 5-7, then mode 1
		rr := r.Roll(5, 7)
		e.AIMode = (ai & 0xE0) | 1
		return []int{1, rr, 1}
	case 9, 10: // C2:5F24 / 5F48
		p := mode - 9
		return []int{p, r.Roll(0, 7), p}
	case 11: // C2:5F6C
		return []int{0, 4, 0}
	case 12: // C2:5F88
		return []int{0, 0, 0}
	case 16: // C2:6025: weapon pattern 2's
		return []int{0, r.Roll(0, 3), 1}
	case 17: // C2:6049
		return []int{0, r.Roll(0, 7), 1}
	case 18: // C2:606F
		return []int{1, r.Roll(0, 3), 1}
	case 19: // C2:6093
		return []int{1, r.Roll(0, 7), 1}
	}
	if mode < 20 {
		panic("battle: modes 13-15 need the $0A4D script state (C2:5FA4-6024)")
	}
	return nil
}

// ChoosePattern is C2:59FF. A living enemy's 9-byte record +0 has bit 7
// set, so the roll(0,1) branch at C2:5A08 never runs for it.
func ChoosePattern(r RNG, mode int) int {
	rr := r.Roll(1, 8) // C2:5A19
	if patternOdds[mode] >= rr {
		return 0
	}
	return 1
}

// UnlockedRange is C2:5A43: the highest pattern slot the tech roll may
// reach.
func UnlockedRange(r RNG, enemyID, aiMode int, ctx *AIContext) int {
	g := ctx.GlobalLevel
	lvl := g
	if enemyID < 0x100 {
		lvl = ctx.RaceLevels[(enemyID>>4)&0x0F]
	}
	bonus := 0
	if g >= lvl {
		bonus = (g - lvl) >> 5
	}
	bonus += (aiMode & 0xE0) >> 5
	hi := ((levelMul*ctx.Level1308 + levelMul*ctx.Round) >> 4) & 0xFF
	rr := r.Roll(1, uint8(hi)) // C2:5AC7
	return minInt(7, rr+bonus)
}

// FixedTarget is C2:5BD4 on the tech's range byte (+5) and special
// settings (+8). nil = not fixed.
func FixedTarget(tech EnemyTechRow, enemyIndex int) *Decision {
	t5 := tech.Range
	if t5&0x20 != 0 {
		var d *Decision
		switch t5 & 0x06 {
		case 0x02:
			d = &Decision{Kind: TAllEnemies, Index: -1}
		case 0x04:
			d = &Decision{Kind: TAllAllies, Index: -1}
		case 0x06:
			d = &Decision{Kind: TEveryone, Index: -1}
		}
		return d
	}
	if t5&0x06 == 0 {
		return &Decision{Kind: TSelf, Index: enemyIndex}
	}
	if tech.Settings&0x02 != 0 {
		return &Decision{Kind: TCounter, Index: -1}
	}
	return nil
}

// SpecialTarget is C2:575D: the target-bits gate (record +7 & 3: 3
// always, else roll(0,3) below it), then the pick handlers by the tech's
// +9 bits. nil = no special pick.
func SpecialTarget(r RNG, e *Combatant, tech EnemyTechRow, ctx *AIContext) *Decision {
	v := e.TargetBits & 0x03
	if v != 3 && r.Roll(0, 3) >= v { // C2:59EF
		return nil
	}
	pick := tech.TargetPick
	if pick == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	ownSide := tech.Range&0x02 != 0 // C2:59A8
	side := ctx.Allies
	kind := TAlly
	if ownSide {
		side = ctx.Enemies
		kind = TEnemy
	}
	for _, bit := range pickBits {
		if pick&bit == 0 {
			continue
		}
		var list []int
		switch bit {
		case 0x80, 0x40: // C2:57C4: units of that sex (record +3 & E0)
			for i := range side {
				if side[i].Alive && side[i].Species&0xE0 == bit {
					list = append(list, i)
				}
			}
		case 0x20:
			panic("battle: weighted special pick C2:5821 not ported")
		case 0x10: // C2:BC7A: uniform over the ally list
			return uniformAlly(r, ctx)
		case 0x08: // C2:588C: lowest HP, ties listed
			low := -1
			for i := range side {
				if !side[i].Alive {
					continue
				}
				hp := side[i].HP
				if low == -1 || hp < low {
					low = hp
					list = []int{i}
				} else if hp == low {
					list = append(list, i)
				}
			}
		}
		if len(list) > 0 {
			return &Decision{Kind: kind, Index: list[ListPick(r, len(list))]}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// ListPick is C2:5988.
func ListPick(r RNG, n int) int {
	if n == 1 {
		return 0
	}
	return r.Roll(0, uint8(n-1)) // C2:5996
}

// uniformAlly is C2:BC7A: uniform over every ally slot ($152A, dead ones
// included); the caller re-picks a fallen one.
func uniformAlly(r RNG, ctx *AIContext) *Decision {
	allies := ctx.Allies
	if livingCount(allies) == 0 {
		return &Decision{Kind: TNone, Index: -1}
	}
	i := 0
	if len(allies) != 1 {
		i = r.Roll(0, uint8(len(allies)-1)) // C2:BC94
	}
	return &Decision{Kind: TAlly, Index: i}
}

// IndividualTarget is FE:D885 (side) + C2:BB9F (one target on it).
func IndividualTarget(r RNG, tech EnemyTechRow, ctx *AIContext) *Decision {
	if tech.Range&0x02 != 0 { // the enemy's own side: C2:BCA6
		enemies := ctx.Enemies
		i := 0
		if len(enemies) != 1 {
			i = r.Roll(0, uint8(len(enemies)-1)) // C2:BCB6
		}
		return &Decision{Kind: TEnemy, Index: i}
	}
	allies := ctx.Allies
	if livingCount(allies) == 0 {
		return &Decision{Kind: TNone, Index: -1}
	}
	if !ctx.Weighted {
		u := uniformAlly(r, ctx)
		for u.Index >= 0 && !allies[u.Index].Alive {
			u = uniformAlly(r, ctx)
		}
		return u
	}
	// C2:BC37: r over the formation's cumulative rates
	rr := r.Roll(0, 255) // C2:BC5A
	i := 0
	for _, rate := range ctx.FormationRates {
		if rate < rr {
			i++
		}
	}
	for i >= len(allies) || !allies[i].Alive {
		u := uniformAlly(r, ctx)
		i = u.Index
		if u.Kind != TAlly {
			return u
		}
	}
	return &Decision{Kind: TAlly, Index: i}
}

func livingCount(side []*Combatant) int {
	n := 0
	for _, c := range side {
		if c.Alive {
			n++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// ContactAmbush marks the two FE:C60B branches that also run 5E:F180
// ($38 bit 7): the enemies then target uniformly.
const ContactAmbush = 0x100

// ContactType is FE:C60B on the C0:BFC7 inputs (docs/battle-enemy-ai.md
// "Contact type"): op = the queued word's high byte (18 random, 19
// fixed), leaderDir/monsterDir = $D9A9 (monster -1 = no object), spd /
// row / d7 = the leader's $D9BB / $D9BC / $D9D7. Returns $37, ORed with
// ContactAmbush on the two ambush branches.
func ContactType(op, leaderDir, monsterDir, spd, row, d7 int, byParty bool) int {
	if op != 0x18 {
		return 4
	}
	fl := leaderDir & 3
	fm := monsterDir
	if monsterDir < 0 || monsterDir >= 4 {
		fm = fl ^ 1
	}
	touched := monsterDir >= 0
	// $130B: the leader's row is not its base row, except the slow-ground
	// step-down; with no object the row is reset first (C0:BFF3)
	if touched && spd != row && !((d7&0x90) == 0x10 && spd-1 == row) {
		return 2 | ContactAmbush
	}
	if fm == fl^1 {
		return 4
	}
	party := byParty && touched
	if (fl < 2) != (fm < 2) {
		if party {
			return 0
		}
		return 2
	}
	if party {
		return 1
	}
	return 2 | ContactAmbush
}

// LevelBumps is the victory level bump pair (C2:DA7C rank, C2:DAD8 groups
// -> 5B:FF40) on the World's $F532/$F533. race = $5D & 0F for a random
// encounter (op 18), -1 otherwise (row 16, and no $142F/$1430 terms in
// the rank rise). t = levels.json. 17 rolls: the rank roll, then one per
// group whether or not the group bumps.
func LevelBumps(r RNG, w World, race int, t *LevelsData) {
	g := w.GlobalLevel()
	p2f := 0
	p30 := 0
	if race >= 0 {
		p2f = g >> 4
		p30 = w.RaceLevel(race) >> 4
	}
	rise := leadingBelow(t.RankRise, r.Roll(0, 255)) + maxInt(0, p30-p2f) // C2:DA82
	g = minInt(g+rise, t.GlobalCap)
	w.SetGlobalLevel(g)
	p2f = g >> 4
	row := t.GroupRows[16]
	if race >= 0 {
		row = t.GroupRows[race]
	}
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		p30 = w.RaceLevel(i) >> 4
		rr := r.Roll(0, 255) // C2:DB21
		c := row[i]
		if c == 0xFF {
			continue
		}
		b := leadingBelow(t.Curves[c], rr) + maxInt(0, p2f-p30)
		w.SetRaceLevel(i, minInt(w.RaceLevel(i)+b, t.GroupCap))
	}
}

// leadingBelow is 8 minus the entries passed while table[x] < r (the walk
// stops at the first entry >= r).
func leadingBelow(table []int, r int) int {
	n := 8
	for _, v := range table {
		if v >= r {
			break
		}
		n--
	}
	return n
}

// AllyInitiative is C2:2586: 2 * agility + roll(1, agility), at least 3,
// doubled in round 1 when the party struck from the side (FE:D716,
// contact 0). 8-bit sums.
func AllyInitiative(r RNG, agility, roundNo, contact int) int {
	s2 := (2 * minInt(agility, 99)) & 0xFF
	a := (s2 + r.Roll(1, uint8(s2>>1))) & 0xFF
	a = maxInt(a, 3)
	if roundNo == 1 && contact == 0 {
		a = (a << 1) & 0xFF
	}
	return a
}

// EnemyInitiative is C2:5C7B: the enemy's sum also adds the battle-start
// check $4F and the carry of the first add; doubled in round 1 when the
// enemies struck (C2:5CFB, contact 2).
func EnemyInitiative(r RNG, agility, roundNo, contact, check int) int {
	s2 := (2 * minInt(agility, 99)) & 0xFF
	sum := s2 + r.Roll(1, uint8(s2>>1))
	a := (sum&0xFF + check + carry(sum)) & 0xFF
	a = maxInt(a, 3)
	if roundNo == 1 && contact == 2 {
		a = (a << 1) & 0xFF
	}
	return a
}

func carry(sum int) int {
	if sum > 0xFF {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

// BattleStartCheck is C2:1C26: $4F = max(0, $83 - ((roll(1, will + 2 *
// charm) >> 4) + isqrt(ampLV >> 1))) on the record ($BA) the party
// loader left last; $83 = $1308 & 0F. The ally +30h byte is 増幅LV.
func BattleStartCheck(r RNG, level1308, will, charm, ampLV int) int {
	rr := r.Roll(1, uint8(will+2*charm&0xFF)) // C2:1C58
	sum := ((rr >> 4) + IsqrtSub(ampLV>>1)) & 0xFF
	if level1308 >= sum {
		return level1308 - sum
	}
	return 0
}

// IsqrtSub is C2:0393: subtracts 1, 3, 5, ... while no borrow.
func IsqrtSub(x int) int {
	n := 0
	for odd := 1; x >= odd; odd += 2 {
		x -= odd
		n++
	}
	return n
}
```

```go
// The battle engine core: combatant records, the party/encounter setup
// and the battle-start tail. The round engine lives in round.go, the
// end-of-battle chains in victory.go. Reference: godot/battle.gd's logic
// half; ground truth docs/battle-enemy-ai.md, docs/battle-menu.md,
// docs/battle-defeat.md, docs/battle-formulas.md.

// out (the opening battle: $2D = 5, record 10 loaded but not fighting).
const Fighters = 5

// Spoils constants (docs/battle-formulas.md §16.3): $7FF95A resets per
// battle and its in-battle accumulator never fired in the traced battles;
// $7EF4C6 reads 0x70 on a fresh game (its writers are undecoded).

	GoldBattleCap = 1000

	0x00: "剣", 0x10: "大剣", 0x21: "斧", 0x31: "棍棒", 0x42: "小剣",

	0x15: "太陽", 0x16: "月",

var classWLevel = map[int]int{0x00: 0, 0x10: 0, 0x21: 1, 0x31: 0, 0x42: 0,
	0x52: 2, 0x63: 3, 0x74: 4}

// Combatant is one battle record (the GDScript's ally/enemy dicts).
// Unused-side fields stay zero.
type Combatant struct {
	Name   string
	ID     int
	IsAlly bool

	HP    int
	MaxHP int

	AttrDef     [8]int // the §4 attribute-defense bytes

	WeaponAtk   int
	WeaponClass int // -1 = bare-handed

	WLevels       []int
	SLevels       []int

	WP, JP        int
	WPMax, JPMax  int

	GrowthType    int

	// +0x47..+0x4E); only a カウンター技 assigned there counters. Empty

	// buffed stat in record byte 0x0C.

	KeyStat  int
}

// PhantomActor is one battle-254 / 5665 phantom order slot: it shares its
// actor's record, acts its spawn-time decision once per round at its own
// SP position (docs/battle-enemy-ai.md, live trace t255e).
type PhantomActor struct {
	Decision Decision
	SP       int
	Acted    bool
}

// Command is one ally's chosen command for the round (the engine's
// confirmed command window pick).
type CommandKind int

const (
	CmdPlain CommandKind = iota
	CmdTech
	CmdItem
	CmdDefend
)

type Command struct {
	Kind   CommandKind
	ID     string // tech id, or the item id for CmdItem

}

// Config is the battle handoff (main.gd's encounter_* fields).
type Config struct {
	Party     []int        // ally ids in battle order (first 5 fight); nil = the first four named catalog allies
	Enemies   []int        // enemy ids, one slot per the 敵編成 count
	Fixed     *FixedBattle // nil for a random encounter
	Contact   int          // $37, default 4
	Level1308 int          // the map's $1308 & 0F
	Ambush    bool
	Race      int         // -1 for a battle that is not a random encounter
	Formation string      // the party formation id; "" = the World's $F322

}

// NewEngine builds the battle: the party, the enemies (with the fixed
// record's HP scaling / multipliers / type-09 key buff / type-0E slot
// words), the fixed battle's opening message, the type-14 initiative
// check, the battle-start check and the AI unlock rolls. The RNG carries
// the composition's draws (main.gd seeds it from the play clock at the
// handoff).
func NewEngine(d *Data, w World, r RNG, cfg Config) (*Engine, error) {
	e := &Engine{D: d, W: w, R: r, Chosen: map[int]Command{},
		Contact: cfg.Contact, Level1308: cfg.Level1308, Ambush: cfg.Ambush,
		Race: cfg.Race, Fixed: cfg.Fixed, MessageButtonWait: 1}
	if e.Contact == 0 {
		e.Contact = 4
	}
	e.sparkExt = map[string][]SparkEntry{}
	e.sparkCounter = map[string][]SparkEntry{}
	for _, g := range d.Spark.Ext {
		e.sparkExt[g.Source] = g.Entries
	}
	for _, g := range d.Spark.Counter {
		e.sparkCounter[g.Source] = g.Entries
	}
	e.setupParty(cfg.Party, cfg.AllyHP)
	if cfg.Formation != "" {
		e.FormationID = cfg.Formation
	} else if wid := w.WalkID(); wid >= 0 {
		e.FormationID = hexByte(wid)
	}
	if err := e.applyHeroForte(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	e.equipAllies()
	if len(cfg.Enemies) > 0 {
		e.setupEncounterEnemies(cfg.Enemies)
	} else {
		return nil, fmtError("battle: no enemies in the handoff")
	}
	e.log("敵現：" + e.Enemies[0].Name + " ×" + itoa(len(e.Enemies)))
	// the fixed battle's opening message (the FE:915B talk row's +0 byte
	// -> FD:9800 content, verified live: the window plays before any
	// battle roll and consumes no RNG)
	if e.Fixed != nil {
		for _, t := range d.BattleTalks {
			if t.ID == e.Fixed.ID && t.Text != "" {
				e.log(t.Text)
				break
			}
		}
	}
	// C2:0BCF (fixed type 14): the party's mean battle agility against the
	// record's threshold decides who struck first
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x14 {
		sum := 0
		for _, a := range e.Allies {
			sum += a.AGI
		}
		if sum/len(e.Allies) >= e.Fixed.Initiate {
			e.Contact = 1
		} else {
			e.Contact = 2
		}
	}
	e.Check = BattleStartCheck(r, e.Level1308, e.PartyLast.WIL, e.PartyLast.CHA, e.PartyLast.AmpLV)
	e.UnlockRolls()
	e.immovableGate()
	return e, nil
}

func hexByte(v int) string {
	const digits = "0123456789ABCDEF"
	return string([]byte{digits[(v>>4)&0xF], digits[v&0xF]})
}

// hex3 formats a tech id as three hex digits ("03F").
func hex3(v int) string {
	const digits = "0123456789ABCDEF"
	return string([]byte{digits[(v>>8)&0xF], digits[(v>>4)&0xF], digits[v&0xF]})
}

func fmtError(msg string) error { return &engineError{msg} }

type engineError struct{ msg string }

func (e *engineError) Error() string { return e.msg }

func (e *Engine) log(line string) { e.Log = append(e.Log, line) }

// Say appends a line to the engine log (the GDScript's _say).
func (e *Engine) Say(line string) { e.log(line) }

// setupParty builds the fighting allies from the catalog (the battle
// party is the game party in its order: up to six records, the first
// Fighters fight; nil party = the first four named catalog allies).
func (e *Engine) setupParty(partyIDs []int, encounterHP map[int]int) {
	var order []*AllyRow
	if len(partyIDs) == 0 {
		for i := range e.D.Allies {
			a := &e.D.Allies[i]
			if a.Name != "" && len(order) < 4 {
				order = append(order, a)
			}
		}
	} else {
		for _, pid := range partyIDs {
			if len(order) >= 6 {
				break
			}
			order = append(order, e.D.AllyByID[pid])
		}
	}
	var party []*Combatant
	for _, a := range order {
		if a == nil {
			panic("battle: party member missing from allies.json")
		}
		id, err := hexID(a.ID)
		if err != nil {
			panic("battle: allies.json id: " + err.Error())
		}
		hp := a.HP
		if v, ok := encounterHP[id]; ok {
			hp = maxInt(v, 0)
		}
		c := &Combatant{
			Name: a.Name, ID: id, IsAlly: true,
			HP: hp, MaxHP: a.HP,
			STR: a.STR, AGI: a.AGI, DEX: a.DEX, VIT: a.VIT, MAG: a.MAG,
			WIL: a.WIL, CHA: a.CHA,
			AmpLV:   a.AmpLV,
			Techs:   append([]string(nil), a.Techs...),
			WLevels: append([]int(nil), a.WLevels...),
			SLevels: append([]int(nil), a.SLevels...),
			WP:      EnginePool(a.WLevels),
			// the JP pool counts 増幅 too: the live records' JP
			// (トーマス 6, ハリード 6 with 増幅 2) match only with it
			JP:            EnginePool(append(append([]int(nil), a.SLevels...), a.AmpLV)),
			FlashType:     a.FlashType,
			Forte:         a.Forte,
			GrowthRow:     append([]int(nil), a.GrowthRow...),
			GrowthType:    a.GrowthType,
			StartSchool:   a.StartSchool,
			ClassBits:     0,
			SpellRaw:      [2]int{a.SpellRaw[0], a.SpellRaw[1]},
			WPMax:         EnginePool(a.WLevels),
			JPMax:         EnginePool(append(append([]int(nil), a.SLevels...), a.AmpLV)),
			BattleCounter: 0,
			Equipment:     append([]string(nil), a.Equipment...),
			Alive:         true,
			WeaponClass:   -1,
		}
		party = append(party, c)
	}
	if len(party) == 0 {
		panic("battle: empty battle party")
	}
	e.PartyLast = party[len(party)-1]
	if len(party) > Fighters {
		e.Reserve = party[Fighters]
	}
	e.Allies = party[:minInt(Fighters, len(party))]
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		a.Levels = e.recordLevels(a)
	}
	if e.Reserve != nil {
		e.Reserve.Levels = e.recordLevels(e.Reserve)
	}
}

// EnginePool wraps the engine's pool fetch (FE:CCA7, cap 250).
func EnginePool(levels []int) int {
	return enginePoolCap(append([]int(nil), levels...))
}

func enginePoolCap(levels []int) int {
	v := poolValue(levels)
	if v > 250 {
		return 250
	}
	return v
}

func poolValue(levels []int) int {
	// §12.1 WP/JP pool: 最も高い系統×2 + 全系統の合計, levels clamp to 50.
	sum := 0
	best := 0
	for _, v := range levels {
		if v > 50 {
			v = 50
		}
		if v < 0 {
			v = 0
		}
		sum += v
		best = maxInt(best, v)
	}
	return best*2 + sum
}

// recordLevels builds the 12 raw record level bytes +0x25..+0x30: the
// five weapon levels, six school slots (蒼龍 朱鳥 白虎 玄武 太陽 月; 0x80 =
// unlearned), 増幅. The join routine FF:6A37: entry +18 goes to slot
// (b >> 5) & 3, +19 to 太陽 when (b & 0x60) == 0 else 月; the level is
// b & 1F, plus $F532 >> 4 when bit 7 is set (FF:6DAC); level 0 stays
// 0x80. The global level is today's, not the join's (the opening joins at
// $F532 = 0).
func (e *Engine) recordLevels(a *Combatant) []int {
	lv := append([]int(nil), a.WLevels...)
	g := e.W.GlobalLevel()
	grow := func(b int) int {
		if b&0x80 != 0 {
			return (b & 0x1F) + (g >> 4)
		}
		return b & 0x1F
	}
	schools := []int{0x80, 0x80, 0x80, 0x80, 0x80, 0x80}
	s1 := a.SpellRaw[0]
	s2 := a.SpellRaw[1]
	l1 := grow(s1)
	l2 := grow(s2)
	if l1 > 0 {
		schools[(s1>>5)&3] = l1
	}
	if l2 > 0 {
		if s2&0x60 == 0 {
			schools[4] = l2
		} else {
			schools[5] = l2
		}
	}
	lv = append(lv, schools...)
	lv = append(lv, a.AmpLV)
	return lv
}

// applyHeroForte is the hero's new-game bonus (C5:9645 -> 5B:7B8F): the
// 得意武器 row of hero_forte.json raises one level column by 1 (0-4
// weapons, 11 増幅) and fills the second weapon slot. $F309 is read as
// the hero entry's own 得意武器 (the opening capture: ユリアン, $F309 = 0,
// 剣 2 -> 3, WP 9).
func (e *Engine) applyHeroForte() error {
	hero := ProtagonistID(e.W)
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		if a.ID != hero {
			continue
		}
		if a.Forte >= len(e.D.HeroForte) {
			return fmtError("battle: hero forte row missing for " + itoa(a.Forte))
		}
		row := e.D.HeroForte[a.Forte]
		if row[2] != 0 {
			return fmtError("battle: extended-item hero weapon not ported")
		}
		col := row[0]
		if col < 5 {
			a.WLevels = append([]int(nil), a.WLevels...)
			a.WLevels[col]++
			a.WP = enginePoolCap(a.WLevels)
			a.WPMax = a.WP
		} else if col == 11 {
			a.AmpLV++
			a.JP = enginePoolCap(append(append([]int(nil), a.SLevels...), a.AmpLV))
			a.JPMax = a.JP
		} else {
			return fmtError("battle: hero forte column " + itoa(col) + " not ported")
		}
		if row[1] != 0 {
			a.Equipment = append([]string(nil), a.Equipment...)
			a.Equipment[1] = hexByte(row[1])
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// equipAllies is the equipment join (§1/§5 inputs): the first weapon
// record gives the plain-attack 攻 and its class; shield + armor defense
// values sum into 防; their weight slows 素早さ. Weapon weight is NOT
// counted (docs §5 counts armor weight; the weapon column is the §2.1 攻
// input). Armor records also join the §4 attribute-defense bytes
// (FE:CA55/CAA0 — docs/battle-formulas.md §4.7). Shields stay out of the
// passive join (the engine's shield-attribute path is not decoded; the
// fresh party wears none; their layer is the block roll).
func (e *Engine) equipAllies() {
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		a.Def = 0
		a.Weight = 0
		a.WeaponAtk = 0
		a.WeaponClass = -1
		a.AttrDef = [8]int{}
		for _, slot := range a.Equipment {
			if slot == "" {
				continue
			}
			it, ok := e.D.Items[slot]
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			switch it.Kind {
			case "weapon":
				if a.WeaponAtk == 0 {
					a.WeaponAtk = it.Power
					a.WeaponClass = e.classCodeFor(it.Category)
				}
			case "shield":
				a.Def += it.Defense
				a.Weight += it.Weight
			case "armor":
				a.Def += it.PhysDef
				a.Weight += it.Weight
				JoinArmor(&a.AttrDef, it.PhysDef, it.PhysResist, it.MagDef, it.MagResist)
			}
		}
	}
	// the battle record's agility: body-slot weight and the formation
	// position (BattleAgility); weight is then spent, so the speed paths
	// that subtract it see 0
	var rows []Position
	if f, ok := e.D.Formations[e.FormationID]; ok {
		rows = f.Positions
	}
	for i, a := range e.Allies {
		body := 0
		for k := 4; k < 8 && k < len(a.Equipment); k++ {
			if it, ok := e.D.Items[a.Equipment[k]]; ok {
				body += it.Weight
			}
		}
		level := 0
		if !e.Ambush && i < len(rows) {
			level = rows[i].SpeedLevel
		}
		a.AGI = BattleAgility(a.AGI, a.VIT, body, level)
		a.Weight = 0
	}
}

// classCodeFor: 剣（曲刀） -> 剣's column; unknown categories fall back to
// 剣 (the §2.13 open hole for the hack's added classes).
func (e *Engine) classCodeFor(category string) int {
	if v, ok := categoryClass[category]; ok {
		return v
	}
	base := category
	for i := 0; i < len(category); i++ {
		if category[i] == 0xEF { // the（lead byte of the fullwidth paren
			base = category[:i]
			break
		}
	}
	if v, ok := categoryClass[base]; ok {
		return v
	}
	return 0x00
}

// setupEncounterEnemies builds the field-encounter enemies: encounter
// ids, one slot per the 敵編成リスト max count of the group's hensei row
// (the engine fills the group with copies of the leader plus mid-battle
// お供 reinforcements — the composition runs before NewEngine).
func (e *Engine) setupEncounterEnemies(ids []int) {
	e.Enemies = nil
	for _, wanted := range ids {
		row := e.D.EnemyByID[wanted]
		if row == nil {
			panic("battle: enemy " + itoa(wanted) + " missing from enemies.json")
		}
		e.Enemies = append(e.Enemies, e.enemyRecord(row, wanted))
	}
	// C2:1BBB: the flags word's bit 8 scales the row HP by the global
	// enemy level before the multiplier: hp += (hp >> 5) * (level >> 3);
	// the 16-bit add with a BCS check skips the whole add on overflow
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Flags&0x0100 != 0 {
		step := e.W.GlobalLevel() >> 3
		if step > 0 {
			for _, en := range e.Enemies {
				scaled := en.MaxHP + (en.MaxHP>>5)*step
				if scaled <= 0xFFFF {
					en.MaxHP = scaled
					en.HP = scaled
				}
			}
		}
	}
	// C2:1BEF: HP x the record's multiplier (enemy $2000 the low nibble,
	// the rest the high one), 16-bit
	if e.Fixed != nil {
		for i, en := range e.Enemies {
			mul := e.Fixed.HPOthers
			if i == 0 {
				mul = e.Fixed.HPLeader
			}
			en.MaxHP = minInt(en.MaxHP*mul, 0xFFFF)
			en.HP = en.MaxHP
		}
	}
	// C2:1C82 (the common tail, before the battle-start check): type 09's
	// body[2]/body[3] mask/slot — the mask lands in enemy record byte 5
	// and record byte 0x0C gains max(0, 0x40 - hp >> 4) + roll(1,64),
	// clamped FF; both shipped type-09 records use slot 5, the record-0
	// stat byte. The mask's and the stat's gameplay consumers are
	// undecoded (the stat starts at 0, zeroed by C2:1B27); the roll is
	// what the RNG stream needs.
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x09 && e.Fixed.KeySlot != 0xFF {
		ks := e.R.Roll(1, 64)
		e0 := e.Enemies[0]
		e0.RecFlag5 |= e.Fixed.KeyMask
		e0.KeyStat = minInt(maxInt(0, 0x40-(e0.MaxHP>>4))+ks, 0xFF)
	}
	if len(e.Enemies) == 0 {
		panic("battle: encounter produced no enemies")
	}
	// the type-0x0E record slots: a start word at its own position (the
	// loader C2:18EA ORs real words with $8000; C2:1DD1 marks empty slots
	// $2000); deaths and reinforcements keep the words as the engine does
	e.SlotWords = nil
	e.SlotEnemyIdx = nil
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x0E {
		nextE := 0
		for _, wv := range e.Fixed.StartSlots {
			w := wv
			if w == 0xFFFF {
				e.SlotWords = append(e.SlotWords, 0x2000)
				e.SlotEnemyIdx = append(e.SlotEnemyIdx, -1)
			} else {
				e.SlotWords = append(e.SlotWords, 0x8000|(w&0x1FFF))
				e.SlotEnemyIdx = append(e.SlotEnemyIdx, nextE)
				nextE++
			}
		}
	}
}

// enemyRecord builds one enemy combatant from its catalog row. Enemy
// stats come straight from enemies.json (cmd/exportbattle, 25-byte struct
// bytes +6..+12); armor weight 0 (no equipment system).
func (e *Engine) enemyRecord(row *EnemyRow, wanted int) *Combatant {
	c := &Combatant{
		Name: row.Name, ID: wanted,
		HP: row.HP, MaxHP: row.HP,
		STR: row.STR, AGI: row.AGI, DEX: row.DEX, VIT: row.VIT, MAG: row.MAG,
		WIL: row.WIL, CHA: row.CHA,
		TechLV:     row.TechLV,
		Def:        row.PhysDef,
		AttrDef:    e.enemyAttrDef(row.ArmorIDs),
		RiseLV:     row.RiseLV,
		Patterns:   append([]Pattern(nil), row.Patterns...),
		Alive:      true,
		AIMode:     row.AIMode,
		FlashLV:    row.FlashLV,
		TargetBits: row.TargetBits,
		Species:    row.Species,
	}
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		if i < len(row.Drops) {
			c.Drops[i] = row.Drops[i]
		}
		if i < len(row.DropCodes) {
			c.DropCodes[i] = row.DropCodes[i]
		}
	}
	c.Gold = row.Gold
	return c
}

// enemyAttrDef is the §4 attribute-defense join for enemies: the same
// FE:CA55/CAA0 armor join over the enemy struct's armor item ids
// (docs/battle-data.md +21..+23). Shield items are skipped (see
// equipAllies). Live cross-check: 地狼 (armor 7A ビーストメイル phys 16
// resist 0x43, mag 8 resist 0x54) joins to [16,24,16,16,8,16,8,16].
func (e *Engine) enemyAttrDef(armorIDs []string) [8]int {
	var attrDef [8]int
	for _, aid := range armorIDs {
		it, ok := e.D.Items[aid]
		if !ok || it.Kind != "armor" {
			continue
		}
		JoinArmor(&attrDef, it.PhysDef, it.PhysResist, it.MagDef, it.MagResist)
	}
	return attrDef
}
```

```go
package battle

import (

// The fixed-battle, battle-254, escape, scripted-mode, contact-type and
// unlock pins. Sources: battle.gd's _check_opening_round segments (read
// 2026-11-23), whose expected values come from the byte-verified decodes
// (docs/battle-enemy-ai.md "Scripted modes", "The immovable revert

func TestFixed30HP(t *testing.T) {
	// Fixed formation 30 (type 11, HP x5 leader / x2 others): the
	// loader's multipliers on the enemies' table HP.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 0x30)
	if fixed.Type != 17 || fixed.HPLeader != 5 || fixed.HPOthers != 2 {

	}
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)

		base := d.EnemyByID[en.ID].HP
		mul := fixed.HPOthers

		}

		}
```
