```go
		}
	}
}

func TestScript12(t *testing.T) {
	// Fixed 12 (type 11, script 2: gate E7 forces rounds 1-3, C=7, pairs
	// (7,3F)x4): the per-round script's roll shape, the group decision
	// and the priority-1 flags.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 0x12)
	if fixed.ScriptGate != 0xE7 || fixed.Script != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("fixed 12 gate %X script %d, want E7/2", fixed.ScriptGate, fixed.Script)
	}
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: fixed.Enemies, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	ctx := e.AIContext()
	quietIdx := -1
	for k := 0; k < 0x400; k++ {
		if int(readRngTable(t)[k])%8 == 7 { // roll(1,8) = 8 > C=7: does not fire
			quietIdx = k
			break
		}
	}
	// Round 1 is forced (gate bit 7): no gate roll, one attempt roll, the
	// whole group takes tech 3F with one shared target.
	e.Round = 1
	r.Index = quietIdx
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	slots := e.ScriptRound(ctx, -1, nil)
	if len(r.Trace) == 0 || r.Trace[0].Lo != 0 || r.Trace[0].Hi != 3 || int(r.Trace[0].Index) != quietIdx {
		t.Fatalf("script 12 trace = %v, want one roll(0,3) at %#X", r.Trace, quietIdx)
	}
	wantSlots := []int{0, 1, 2}
	if len(slots) != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("script 12 slots = %v, want %v", slots, wantSlots)
	}
	for _, s := range wantSlots {
		if !slots[s] || e.Enemies[s].Decision.Tech != "03F" {
			t.Fatalf("script 12 slot %d decision %+v, want tech 03F", s, e.Enemies[s].Decision)
		}
	}
	if e.Enemies[1].Decision.Index != e.Enemies[2].Decision.Index {
		t.Fatalf("script 12 targets %d/%d, want one shared target",
			e.Enemies[1].Decision.Index, e.Enemies[2].Decision.Index)
	}
	// Round 4 leaves the forced gates: the gate roll only.
	e.Round = 4
	r.Index = quietIdx
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	if got := e.ScriptRound(ctx, -1, nil); got != nil {
		t.Fatalf("script 12 round 4 fired: %v", got)
	}
	if len(r.Trace) != 1 || r.Trace[0].Lo != 1 || r.Trace[0].Hi != 8 {
		t.Fatalf("script 12 round 4 trace = %v, want one roll(1,8)", r.Trace)
	}
	// The whole BeginRound: scripted slots keep their decision and act at
	// priority 1, the rest decide normally.
	e.Round = 1
	r.Index = quietIdx
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.BeginRound()
	for s := 0; s < 3; s++ {
		if e.Enemies[s].Decision.Empty() {
			t.Fatalf("script 12 round: slot %d lost its scripted decision", s)
		}
		sp := e.SP[len(e.Allies)+s]
		if sp != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("script 12 round: slot %d SP %d, want priority 1", s, sp)
		}
	}
}

func TestChainC0(t *testing.T) {
	// Fixed C0 (type 0x0D, the probed chain 24/47/4A/EC/4C): the cursor
	// advance at the member's death, full HP, round reset, and the end at
	// the last member.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 0xC0)
	if fixed.Type != 0x0D {
		t.Fatalf("fixed C0 type %d, want 13", fixed.Type)
	}
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{fixed.Enemies[0]}, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	wantChain := []int{0x24, 0x47, 0x4A, 0xEC, 0x4C}
	if e.Enemies[0].ID != wantChain[0] {
		t.Fatalf("chain starts at %X, want %X", e.Enemies[0].ID, wantChain[0])
	}
	e.Round = 3
	for i := 1; i < len(wantChain); i++ {
		if !e.ChainAdvance() {
			t.Fatalf("chain advance %d returned false", i)
		}
		if e.Enemies[0].ID != wantChain[i] {
			t.Fatalf("chain member %d = %X, want %X", i, e.Enemies[0].ID, wantChain[i])
		}
		if e.Round != 0 {
			t.Fatalf("chain member %d left round %d, want reset 0", i, e.Round)
		}
		if e.Enemies[0].HP != e.Enemies[0].MaxHP || e.Enemies[0].MaxHP <= 0 {
			t.Fatalf("chain member %d spawned at hp %d/%d, want full", i, e.Enemies[0].HP, e.Enemies[0].MaxHP)
		}
	}
	if e.ChainAdvance() {
		t.Fatal("chain advanced past the last member")
	}
}

func TestReinforce11(t *testing.T) {
	// Fixed 11 (type 0x0E: cap 2, chance 50, boss 382 + four empty
	// slots): the reinforcement pass fills dead/empty slots up to the cap;
	// the boss slot is skipped without a roll.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 0x11)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: fixed.Enemies, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	if len(e.Enemies) != 1 || e.Enemies[0].ID != 382 {
		t.Fatalf("fixed 11 boss = %d enemies, first id %d, want [382]", len(e.Enemies), e.Enemies[0].ID)
	}
	if len(e.SlotWords) != 5 || e.SlotWords[0] != 0x8000|382 || e.SlotWords[1] != 0x2000 {
		t.Fatalf("fixed 11 slot words = %v", e.SlotWords)
	}
	// Seeds: fire (roll(1,100) <= 50) then pick, twice.
	fireA := -1
	for k := 0; k < 0x400; k++ {
		if int(readRngTable(t)[k])%100+1 <= 50 && int(readRngTable(t)[k+1])%5 == 3 {
			fireA = k
			break
		}
	}
	r.Index = fireA
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.Reinforce()
	picks := []int{}
	for _, en := range e.Enemies[1:] {
		picks = append(picks, en.ID)
	}
	// Replay the expected pass on a throwaway generator: the boss slot
	// skipped unrolled, each pending slot roll(1,100) then roll(0,4).
	probe := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	probe.Index = fireA
	var expIDs []int
	var expSlots []int
	spawned := 0
	for slot := 0; slot < 5; slot++ {
		if spawned >= 2 {
			break
		}
		if slot == 0 {
			continue // the living boss
		}
		if probe.Roll(1, 100) > 50 {
			continue
		}
		pk := probe.Roll(0, 4)
		expIDs = append(expIDs, fixed.Reinforcements[pk])
		expSlots = append(expSlots, slot)
		spawned++
	}
	if len(e.Enemies) != 1+spawned {
		t.Fatalf("reinforce 11 spawned to %d enemies, want %d", len(e.Enemies), 1+spawned)
	}
	for i := range expIDs {
		if picks[i] != expIDs[i] {
			t.Fatalf("reinforce 11 picks %v, want %v", picks, expIDs)
		}
	}
	if e.SlotEnemyIdx[1] != 1 || e.SlotEnemyIdx[expSlots[1]] != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("reinforce 11 slot indexes = %v, want slot 1 -> 1, %d -> 2", e.SlotEnemyIdx, expSlots[1])
	}
	if e.SlotWords[expSlots[0]] != 0x8000|(expIDs[0]&0x1FFF) {
		t.Fatalf("reinforce 11 slot word %X, want %X", e.SlotWords[expSlots[0]], 0x8000|expIDs[0])
	}
}

func TestType09Buff(t *testing.T) {
	// Fixed 0D (type 09, key mask 10 slot 5): the C2:1C82 tail buff
	// consumes one roll(1,64) at the record build's end and enemy 0
	// carries the mask in its record flag byte 5 plus the buffed stat
	// 0x0C = max(0, 0x40 - hp >> 4) + roll — for enemy 0x2F's 3958 HP the
	// floor term is 0, so the stat is the roll alone. Flags 0: no level
	// scaling, HP = row x 1.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 0x0D)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	r.Index = 0x300
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: fixed.Enemies, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	// The buff roll lands first; the battle-start check's roll(1, 51)
	// (トーマス will 13 + 2 x charm 19) follows it, as C2:1C82 sits
	// before the check in the common tail.
	pin := loadPin[struct {
		Type09 struct {
			Roll        []int `json:"roll"`
			RecordFlag5 int   `json:"record_flag5"`
			HP          int   `json:"hp"`
		} `json:"type09_buff"`
	}](t, "fixed_and_phantom.json").Type09
	if len(r.Trace) < 2 || int(r.Trace[0].Lo) != pin.Roll[0] || int(r.Trace[0].Hi) != pin.Roll[1] || r.Trace[0].Index != pin.Roll[2] {
		t.Fatalf("type-09 trace = %v, want roll(%d,%d) at %#X first", r.Trace, pin.Roll[0], pin.Roll[1], pin.Roll[2])
	}
	if r.Trace[1].Lo != 1 || int(r.Trace[1].Hi) != 13+2*19 {
		t.Fatalf("type-09 second roll = %v, want the battle-start check roll(1,51)", r.Trace[1])
	}
	if e.Enemies[0].RecFlag5 != pin.RecordFlag5 {
		t.Fatalf("type-09 flag byte 5 = %X, want %X", e.Enemies[0].RecFlag5, pin.RecordFlag5)
	}
	if e.Enemies[0].MaxHP != pin.HP {
		t.Fatalf("type-09 hp = %d, want %d", e.Enemies[0].MaxHP, pin.HP)
	}
	wantStat := 1 + int(readRngTable(t)[0x300])%64
	if e.Enemies[0].KeyStat != wantStat {
		t.Fatalf("type-09 stat = %d, want %d", e.Enemies[0].KeyStat, wantStat)
	}
}

func TestLevelScaling(t *testing.T) {
	// Fixed 3F (flags bit 8, mul x1): the row HP scales by the global
	// enemy level before the multiplier: hp += hp>>5 * (level>>3).
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	rowHP := d.EnemyByID[278].HP
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	w.global = 40 // step 5
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 0x3F)
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: fixed.Enemies, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	want := rowHP + (rowHP>>5)*5
	if want > 0xFFFF {
		want = 0xFFFF
	}
	if rowHP <= 0 || e.Enemies[0].MaxHP != want {
		t.Fatalf("level scaling: row %d got %d, want %d", rowHP, e.Enemies[0].MaxHP, want)
	}
}

func TestUnlockRolls(t *testing.T) {
	// C2:C18B: enemy 0x11 is unlock entry 0's first id - one roll(1,100)
	// after the battle-start check, then the bit stops the roll on the
	// next battle; a battle without a listed enemy consumes nothing; 2B
	// adds bit 2.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	mk := func(enemy int) *Engine {
		e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
			Enemies: []int{enemy}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
		}
		return e
	}
	e := mk(0x11)
	r.Index = 0x310
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	w.bits = 0
	e.UnlockRolls()
	if len(r.Trace) != 1 || r.Trace[0].Lo != 1 || r.Trace[0].Hi != 100 || r.Trace[0].Index != 0x310 {
		t.Fatalf("unlock trace = %v, want one roll(1,100) at 0x310", r.Trace)
	}
	if w.bits != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unlock bits = %d, want 1", w.bits)
	}
	e = mk(0x11)
	r.Index = 0x310
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.UnlockRolls()
	if len(r.Trace) != 0 || w.bits != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unlock rerun: trace %d rolls bits %d, want 0 rolls, bits 1", len(r.Trace), w.bits)
	}
	e = mk(0x2B)
	// The build's own unlock pass already fired entry 2; reset to the
	// rerun state (bit 0 set) so the pinned roll is this call's.
	w.bits = 1
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.UnlockRolls()
	if len(r.Trace) != 1 || r.Trace[0].Lo != 1 || r.Trace[0].Hi != 100 {
		t.Fatalf("unlock 2B trace = %v, want one roll(1,100)", r.Trace)
	}
	if w.bits != 0x5 {
		t.Fatalf("unlock 2B bits = %d, want 5", w.bits)
	}
	w.bits = 0
}

func TestPhase5Rolls(t *testing.T) {
	// C2:D1FF (battle phase 5, after every round's actions): roll(0,3)
	// first (the animated-background roll C2:D260), roll(0,7) added for
	// battle type 0x0A (C2:D979 -> 0C8B). Dead enemies make the end check
	// stop the pin before the next round.
	setup := func(e *Engine) {
		e.SP = make([]int, len(e.Allies)+len(e.Enemies))
		e.Acted = make([]bool, len(e.Allies)+len(e.Enemies))
		for i := range e.Acted {
			e.Acted[i] = true
		}
		for _, a := range e.Allies {
			a.Alive = false // the defeat exit keeps the end check roll-free
		}
		e.Round = 1
	}
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{0x20}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	setup(e)
	r.Index = 0x330
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.RunRound()
	if len(r.Trace) != 1 || r.Trace[0].Lo != 0 || r.Trace[0].Hi != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("phase 5 (random) trace = %v, want one roll(0,3)", r.Trace)
	}
	fixed09 := fixedAt(t, 0x09)
	e2, err := NewEngine(d, w, newBattleRNG(t, 0x21), Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: fixed09.Enemies, Fixed: fixed09, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	r2 := e2.R.(*rngBattle)
	setup(e2)
	r2.Index = 0x330
	r2.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e2.RunRound()
	if len(r2.Trace) != 2 || r2.Trace[0].Lo != 0 || r2.Trace[0].Hi != 3 ||
		r2.Trace[1].Lo != 0 || r2.Trace[1].Hi != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("phase 5 (type 0A) trace = %v, want roll(0,3) then roll(0,7)", r2.Trace)
	}
}

func TestFledAlliesLoseTheField(t *testing.T) {
	// FE:CD1E's living count tests rec[7] & 0x84: a fled ally (bit 0x40)
	// does not count, so an all-fled party routes to the wipe (defeat, no
	// victory rolls), while one fled member among living ones keeps the
	// battle running.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{0x20}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		a.Fled = true
	}
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	ended := e.CheckEnd()
	if !ended || !e.Over || e.Won {
		t.Fatalf("全逃走: ended %v over %v won %v, want defeat", ended, e.Over, e.Won)
	}
	if len(r.Trace) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("敗北 consumed %d rolls, want none (a wipe runs no victory rolls)", len(r.Trace))
	}
	if len(e.Log) == 0 || e.Log[len(e.Log)-1] != "敗北…" {
		t.Fatalf("defeat log tail %v, want 敗北…", e.Log[len(e.Log)-1:])
	}
	// The control: one fled member among living allies holds the field.
	e2, err := NewEngine(d, w, newBattleRNG(t, 0x21), Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{0x20}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	e2.Allies[0].Fled = true
	if e2.CheckEnd() {
		t.Fatal("one fled member ended the battle; want it still running")
	}
}

func TestUnlockMarkerSkipsTheRoll(t *testing.T) {
	// FE:9E8E: an unlock entry whose marker byte is nonzero is skipped
	// without a roll (entries 7-15 ship nonzero); a marker-0 entry after

	d := &Data{BattleUnlocks: []UnlockRow{

func TestOrderFlagMarksTheEnds(t *testing.T) {
	// C2:25B5: 行動最後 (+8 bit 0x04) gives 2, 行動最初 (bit 0x08) gives
	// FE, bit 0x04 wins when both set, and the no-target kinds carry no
	// mark.
	e := &Engine{}
	if got := e.OrderFlag(0x04, "tech"); got != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("行動最後 flag = %d, want 2", got)
	}
	if got := e.OrderFlag(0x08, "tech"); got != 0xFE {
		t.Fatalf("行動最初 flag = %X, want FE", got)
	}
	if got := e.OrderFlag(0x0C, "tech"); got != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("both bits = %d, want 行動最後's 2", got)
	}
	if got := e.OrderFlag(0x04, TNone); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("行動最後 on a no-target kind = %d, want 0", got)
	}
	if got := e.OrderFlag(0x04, TCounter); got != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("行動最後 on the counter kind = %d, want 0", got)
	}
}

func TestFleeSkip(t *testing.T) {
	// C2:5BD4 flee (tech[8] bit 2 = the settings byte): a flee-tech
	// decision marks the leave and the action body skips - no damage, no
	// roll, no FE:C016 wait (the pin reads the trace holding only the
	// round-end phase-5 roll).
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{0x10}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	fleeTech := ""
	for _, ft := range []string{"070", "071", "072"} {
		if _, ok := d.EnemyTechs[ft]; ok {
			fleeTech = ft
			break
		}
	}
	if fleeTech == "" {
		t.Fatal("no flee tech in the export")
	}
	hp0 := e.Allies[0].HP
	// The round bookkeeping starts where BeginRound would leave it: the
	// four allies acted at SP 1, the fleeing enemy waiting at 99 in slot
	// 4 (the party is [0,1,2,3], so the enemy's slot index is 4).
	e.SP = []int{1, 1, 1, 1, 99}
	e.Acted = []bool{true, true, true, true, false}
	e.Enemies[0].Decision = Decision{Tech: fleeTech, Kind: TEnemy, Index: 0}
	r.Index = 0x340
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.RunRound()
	if e.Allies[0].HP != hp0 || !e.Enemies[0].Fled {
		t.Fatalf("flee: hp %d -> %d fled %v, want untouched and fled", hp0, e.Allies[0].HP, e.Enemies[0].Fled)
	}
	// The trace holds only the round-end phase-5 roll (0,3) the all-acted
	// branch consumes after the flee's no-op body.
	if len(r.Trace) != 1 || r.Trace[0].Lo != 0 || r.Trace[0].Hi != 3 {
		t.Fatalf("flee trace = %v, want only the phase-5 roll(0,3)", r.Trace)
	}
}

func TestPhantomSpawns(t *testing.T) {
	// Battle 254 (type 0x12): the phantom spawner. Stage 0 odd round: one
	// mode-9 phantom; stage 1: mode 9 + coin -> mode 10; stage 2: mode 9,
	// coin -> mode 18, roll-until-zero, then the standing-mode phantom;
	// the round-end stage update skips stages 4/5 (C2:D8A0).
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 0xFE)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0},
		Enemies: fixed.Enemies, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	pin := loadPin[struct {
		PhantomSpawns struct {
			EnemyID    int `json:"enemy_id"`
			Stage0     int `json:"stage0"`
			Stage1Min  int `json:"stage1_min"`
			Stage1Max  int `json:"stage1_max"`
			Stage2Min  int `json:"stage2_min"`
			Stage2Max  int `json:"stage2_max"`
			StageTimer int `json:"stage_update_timer"`
			StageWant  int `json:"stage_update_want"`
		} `json:"phantom_spawns"`
	}](t, "fixed_and_phantom.json").PhantomSpawns
	if fixed.Type != 0x12 || e.Enemies[0].ID != pin.EnemyID {
		t.Fatalf("battle 254: type %d enemy %X, want 12/%X", fixed.Type, e.Enemies[0].ID, pin.EnemyID)
	}
	ctx := e.AIContext()
	e.Round = 1
	e.PhantomStage = 0
	e.PhantomTimer = 0
	e.PhantomQueue = nil
	r.Index = 0x350
	e.SpawnPhantoms(ctx)
	if len(e.PhantomQueue) != pin.Stage0 {
		t.Fatalf("stage 0 spawned %d phantoms, want %d", len(e.PhantomQueue), pin.Stage0)
	}
	e.PhantomStage = 1
	e.PhantomQueue = nil
	r.Index = 0x360
	e.SpawnPhantoms(ctx)
	ph2 := len(e.PhantomQueue)
	if ph2 < pin.Stage1Min || ph2 > pin.Stage1Max {
		t.Fatalf("stage 1 spawned %d phantoms, want %d-%d", ph2, pin.Stage1Min, pin.Stage1Max)
	}
	e.PhantomStage = 2
	e.PhantomQueue = nil
	r.Index = 0x370
	e.SpawnPhantoms(ctx)
	ph3 := len(e.PhantomQueue)
	if ph3 < pin.Stage2Min || ph3 > pin.Stage2Max {
		t.Fatalf("stage 2 spawned %d phantoms, want %d-%d", ph3, pin.Stage2Min, pin.Stage2Max)
	}
	// The round-end stage update; stage 5 keeps.
	e.PhantomTimer = pin.StageTimer
	e.PhantomStage = 2
	if e.Fixed.Type == 0x12 && e.PhantomStage != 4 && e.PhantomStage != 5 {
		e.PhantomStage = (e.PhantomTimer & 0xF) >> 2
	}
	if e.PhantomStage != pin.StageWant {
		t.Fatalf("stage update gave %d, want %d", e.PhantomStage, pin.StageWant)
	}
	e.PhantomStage = 5
	if e.Fixed.Type == 0x12 && e.PhantomStage != 4 && e.PhantomStage != 5 {
		e.PhantomStage = (e.PhantomTimer & 0xF) >> 2
	}
	if e.PhantomStage != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("stage 5 moved to %d, want kept 5", e.PhantomStage)
	}
}

func TestPhantomSlots(t *testing.T) {
	// The phantom ORDER SLOTS (live-shaped 2026-11-23, t255e): one slot
	// per spawn-time decision, SP = the protagonist's rolled SP halved
	// (k+1) times, the enemy holding no own slot; a slot acts at its own
	// position via RunPhantomSlot.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 0xFE)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0},
		Enemies: fixed.Enemies, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	pin := loadPin[struct {
		PhantomSlots struct {
			ProtagonistSP int    `json:"protagonist_sp"`
			SlotSPs       []int  `json:"slot_sps"`
			FleeTech      string `json:"flee_tech"`
		} `json:"phantom_slots"`
	}](t, "fixed_and_phantom.json").PhantomSlots
	fleeTech := pin.FleeTech
	e.PhantomQueue = []Decision{
		{Tech: fleeTech, Kind: TEnemy, Index: 0},
		{Tech: fleeTech, Kind: TEnemy, Index: 0},
	}
	for range e.Allies {
		e.SP = append(e.SP, 200)
	}
	proto := e.ProtagonistIndex()
	if proto < 0 {
		proto = 0
	}
	e.SP[proto] = pin.ProtagonistSP
	e.BuildPhantomSlots(e.SP[proto])
	if len(e.PhantomActors) != len(pin.SlotSPs) || e.PhantomActors[0].SP != pin.SlotSPs[0] ||
		e.PhantomActors[1].SP != pin.SlotSPs[1] {
		t.Fatalf("phantom slot SPs = %d/%d, want %d/%d",
			e.PhantomActors[0].SP, e.PhantomActors[1].SP, pin.SlotSPs[0], pin.SlotSPs[1])
	}
	if e.PhantomActors[0].Acted {
		t.Fatal("phantom slot 0 started acted")
	}
	// The slots join the order scan: with every combatant acted and sp 0,
	// the highest-SP slot is the phantom's.
	n := e.combatantCount()
	e.SP = make([]int, n)
	e.Acted = make([]bool, n)
	for i := 0; i < n+len(e.PhantomActors); i++ {
		e.setSlotActed(i)
		e.setSlotSP(i, 0)
	}
	e.PhantomActors[0].Acted = false
	e.PhantomActors[0].SP = 48
	e.PhantomActors[1].Acted = false
	e.PhantomActors[1].SP = 24
	picked := e.PickActor()
	if picked != e.combatantCount() {
		t.Fatalf("order picked %d, want the first phantom slot %d", picked, e.combatantCount())
	}
	e.RunPhantomSlot(picked)
	if !e.PhantomActors[0].Acted {
		t.Fatal("RunPhantomSlot did not mark the slot acted")
	}
}

func TestEscapeCells(t *testing.T) {
	// The escape cells (docs/battle-menu.md §C): the round-end target
	// update subtracts $1427, the C550 climb wraps the current level's
	// low nibble past 0x0F, and the gate opens only while the target
	// still sits above it.
	// The GDScript escape-cells block runs with encounter_fixed cleared
	// (the $53 refill is the non-254 branch's +1).
	e := &Engine{}
	e.EscapeTarget = 0
	e.LastCmdCost = 0
	e.PhantomTimer = 0x0D
	e.EscapeCellsRoundEnd()
	if e.EscapeTarget != 1 || e.PhantomTimer&0xF != 0x0D {
		t.Fatalf("cells 1: target %d timer %X, want 1/0D", e.EscapeTarget, e.PhantomTimer&0xF)
	}
	if (e.EscapeTarget & 0xF) > (e.PhantomTimer & 0xF) {
		t.Fatal("gate armed while the target sits below the current level")
	}
	e.EscapeTarget = 5
	e.PhantomTimer = 0x10 // the C550 climb wrapped the low nibble to 0
	e.EscapeCellsRoundEnd()
	// The round-end chase (D956) re-equalizes: the port asserts the
	// decoded cells; HOW the live round-12 gate passed despite the chase
	// is the one open question (docs/battle-menu.md §C).
	if e.EscapeTarget != 6 || e.PhantomTimer&0xF != 0x06 {
		t.Fatalf("cells 2: target %d timer %X, want 6/06", e.EscapeTarget, e.PhantomTimer&0xF)
	}
	e.Res53 = 4
	e.EscapeCellsRoundEnd()
	if e.Res53 != 5 {
		t.Fatalf("res53 refill = %d, want 5 (non-254 refill 1)", e.Res53)
	}
}

func TestPartyWindow(t *testing.T) {
	// The party window (a00a0eb): the armed gate, the $53 confirm gate
	// (C2:31EC, cost byte 5), and the non-victory exit on confirm.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 0xFE)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0},
		Enemies: fixed.Enemies, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	pin := loadPin[struct {
		PartyWindow struct {
			Res53       int `json:"res53"`
			ArmedTarget int `json:"armed_target"`
			ArmedTimer  int `json:"armed_timer"`
			EscapeCost  int `json:"escape_cost"`
		} `json:"party_window"`
	}](t, "fixed_and_phantom.json").PartyWindow
	e.Res53 = pin.Res53
	e.EscapeTarget = pin.ArmedTarget
	e.PhantomTimer = pin.ArmedTimer // low nibble 0 < target: the gate is armed
	if !e.EscapeArmed() {
		t.Fatal("gate not armed at the wrap")
	}
	e.EscapeTarget = 0
	if e.EscapeArmed() {
		t.Fatal("gate armed with the target at 0 (not above the wrapped 0)")
	}
	e.EscapeTarget = pin.ArmedTarget
	e.SelectEscape()
	// e699c71: the escape does not end the battle - the protagonist's
	// rec[7] |= 0x40 (FE:D729) marks only its own body skip, the rounds
	// continue (t255e: escape at round 12, the battle ran to 0x14).
	if e.Res53 != pin.Res53-pin.EscapeCost || e.Over || !e.Allies[e.ProtagonistIndex()].Fled {
		t.Fatalf("escape: res53 %d over %v fled %v, want %d/false/true",
			e.Res53, e.Over, e.Allies[e.ProtagonistIndex()].Fled, pin.Res53-pin.EscapeCost)
	}
}

func TestContactTypes(t *testing.T) {
	// Contact types (op, leader, monster, spd, row, d7, by party) -> $37:
	// ten FE:C60B branches (battle.gd's selftest cases).
	const a = ContactAmbush
	cases := []struct {
		op, leader, monster, spd, row, d7 int
		byParty                           bool
		want                              int
	}{
		{0x19, 0, 2, 3, 3, 0, true, 4},      // fixed formation
		{0x18, 0, -1, 3, 3, 0, false, 4},    // trigger tile: no object
		{0x18, 0, 1, 3, 3, 0, true, 4},      // head-on
		{0x18, 0, 2, 3, 3, 0, true, 0},      // party hits the side
		{0x18, 0, 2, 3, 3, 0, false, 2},     // monster hits the side
		{0x18, 2, 2, 3, 3, 0, true, 1},      // party hits the back
		{0x18, 2, 2, 3, 3, 0, false, 2 | a}, // monster hits the back
		{0x18, 0, 2, 3, 4, 0, true, 2 | a},  // leader dashing
		{0x18, 0, 2, 3, 2, 0x10, true, 0},   // slow ground step-down
		{0x18, 0, 6, 3, 3, 0, false, 4},     // monster pose >= 4: head-on
	}
	for i, c := range cases {
		got := ContactType(c.op, c.leader, c.monster, c.spd, c.row, c.d7, c.byParty)
		if got != c.want {
			t.Fatalf("contact case %d = %d, want %d", i, got, c.want)
		}
	}
}

func TestScriptedModes(t *testing.T) {
	// Scripted AI modes (C2:5E0C) on stat-row enemies, round 1, $1308 0,
	// levels 0: [id, want trace (lo, hi), want [pattern, weapon pattern],
	// want mode after] (battle.gd's selftest cases).
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	cases := []struct {
		enemy    int
		rolls    [][2]int
		pick     []int
		modeWant int
	}{
		{0x0C, [][2]int{{1, 0}, {0, 7}}, []int{0, 0}, 0xE4},  // mode 4, bonus E4 >> 5 = 7
		{0x1A8, [][2]int{{1, 0}, {0, 5}}, []int{1, 1}, 0xA5}, // mode 5
		{0x07, [][2]int{{1, 0}, {0, 5}}, []int{0, 1}, 0xA6},  // mode 6, odd round
		{0x0D, nil, []int{1, 1}, 0x41},                       // mode 7 -> mode 1
		{0x16, [][2]int{{5, 7}}, []int{1, 1}, 0x61},          // mode 8 -> mode 1
		{0x7A, nil, nil, 0x1F},                               // mode 31: no action
	}
	for _, c := range cases {
		w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
		r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
		e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
			Enemies: []int{c.enemy}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("enemy %X: NewEngine: %v", c.enemy, err)
		}
		ctx := e.AIContext()
		ctx.Round = 1
		r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
		pick := ChooseSlot(r, e.Enemies[0], ctx)
		var shape [][2]int
		for _, tr := range r.Trace {
			shape = append(shape, [2]int{int(tr.Lo), int(tr.Hi)})
		}
		var gotPick []int
		if pick != nil {
			gotPick = []int{pick[0], pick[2]}
		}
		if len(shape) != len(c.rolls) {
			t.Fatalf("enemy %X: rolls %v, want %v", c.enemy, shape, c.rolls)
		}
		for i := range shape {
			if shape[i] != c.rolls[i] {
				t.Fatalf("enemy %X: rolls %v, want %v", c.enemy, shape, c.rolls)
			}
		}
		if len(gotPick) != len(c.pick) {
			t.Fatalf("enemy %X: pick %v, want %v", c.enemy, gotPick, c.pick)
		}
		for i := range gotPick {
			if gotPick[i] != c.pick[i] {
				t.Fatalf("enemy %X: pick %v, want %v", c.enemy, gotPick, c.pick)
			}
		}
		if e.Enemies[0].AIMode != c.modeWant {
			t.Fatalf("enemy %X: mode after %X, want %X", c.enemy, e.Enemies[0].AIMode, c.modeWant)
		}
	}
}
```

`internal/game/battle/fixtures_test.go`:

```go
package battle

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"testing"

	"saga3/internal/game/rng"
)

// The battle RNG table (D7:E63C) read once per test binary.
var (
	tableOnce sync.Once
	tableData []byte
	tableErr  error
)

func readRngTable(t *testing.T) []byte {
	t.Helper()
	tableOnce.Do(func() {
		root, err := repoRoot()
		if err != nil {
			tableErr = err
			return
		}
		tableData, tableErr = os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "exports", "data", "battle_rng.bin"))
	})
	if tableErr != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read battle_rng.bin: %v", tableErr)
	}
	return tableData
}

// fixedAt fetches a fixed-battle record with a bounds check.
func fixedAt(t *testing.T, idx int) *FixedBattle {
	t.Helper()
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	if idx >= len(d.FixedBattles) {
		t.Fatalf("fixed battle %#X missing (have %d records)", idx, len(d.FixedBattles))
	}
	return &d.FixedBattles[idx]
}

func assertEq[T comparable](t *testing.T, what string, got, want T) {
	t.Helper()
	if got != want {
		t.Fatalf("%s = %v, want %v", what, got, want)
	}
}

// rngBattle aliases the traced generator so the roll-order pins can read
// Trace/Index.
type rngBattle = rng.Battle

// traceRoll aliases the generator's trace entry.
type traceRoll = rng.TraceEntry

// traceEq asserts one captured roll segment against the pin triples.
func traceEq(t *testing.T, what string, got []traceRoll, want ...[3]int) {
	t.Helper()
	traceEqPin(t, what, got, want)
}

// traceEqPin asserts a segment against the pin file's triples.
func traceEqPin(t *testing.T, what string, got []traceRoll, want [][3]int) {
	t.Helper()
	wantRolls := pinRolls(want)
	if len(got) != len(wantRolls) {
		t.Fatalf("%s: trace has %d rolls, want %d: %v", what, len(got), len(wantRolls), got)
	}
	for i := range got {
		if got[i] != wantRolls[i] {
			t.Fatalf("%s: roll %d = %+v, want %+v", what, i, got[i], wantRolls[i])
		}
	}
}

// testdataDir is this package's testdata folder.
func testdataDir(t *testing.T) string {
	t.Helper()
	_, thisFile, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatal("runtime.Caller failed")
	}
	return filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(thisFile), "testdata")
}

// loadPin reads one testdata JSON document.
func loadPin[T any](t *testing.T, name string) *T {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(testdataDir(t), name))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("read testdata %s: %v", name, err)
	}
	var out T
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &out); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse testdata %s: %v", name, err)
	}
	return &out
}

// pinRolls converts [lo, hi, index] triples into trace entries.
func pinRolls(specs [][3]int) []traceRoll {
	out := make([]traceRoll, 0, len(specs))
	for _, v := range specs {
		out = append(out, traceRoll{Lo: uint8(v[0]), Hi: uint8(v[1]), Index: v[2]})
	}
	return out
}
```

`internal/game/battle/growth.go`:

```go
package battle

// Victory growth (C2:DB7C, the nobody-grew step C2:DF6E, the reserve
// step C2:DFEB), port of godot/battle_growth.gd; ground truth
// docs/battle-enemy-ai.md "Victory growth" (decoded 2026-11-21).

const (
	levelCap = 0x32 // 50
	poolCap  = 250
	hpCap    = 999
	// Message waits: FE:EBC4 (B839, BD28) and B8A3 (4); the button wait
	// C194 that follows depends on input, at least 1 frame.
	MessageWaits = 6
)

// GrowthChance is FE:E8E5: the boundary at diff = raise - lower.
// success iff roll(0,255) + 1 < threshold. Same table as
// internal/growth.Boundary, encoded ascending here (growth.json chance).
func GrowthChance(t *GrowthData, lower, raise int) int {
	diff := raise - lower
	idx := 10 - clampIndex(diff, -10, 10)
	return t.Chance[idx]
}

// FavClass is 5E:F47B: 得意武器 -> class column, -1 = none.
func FavClass(forte int) int {
	if forte <= 6 {
		return forte >> 1
	}
	if forte == 7 {
		return 4
	}
	if forte == 9 {
		return 3
	}
	return -1
}

func poolRaise(levels []int) int {
	total := 0
	top := 0
	for _, v := range levels {
		v &= 0x7F
		total += v
		top = maxInt(top, v)
	}
	return minInt(poolCap, total+2*top)
}

// HPThreshold is C2:DE63: chance((max HP × 6 / 128) & FF, rate[15] + rise).
func HPThreshold(a *Combatant, rise int, t *GrowthData) int {
	row := a.GrowthRow
	if row[15] == 0xFF {
		return 0
	}
	lower := (a.MaxHP * t.HPMul / t.HPDiv) & 0xFF
	return GrowthChance(t, lower, row[15]+rise)
}

// Thresholds is C2:DDCE/DD24/DE63/DEBE: the 16 growth thresholds
// ($1489..$1498: 0-11 classes, 13 WP, 14 JP, 15 HP; 12 unused).
func Thresholds(a *Combatant, rise int, t *GrowthData) [16]int {
	var thr [16]int
	row := a.GrowthRow
	lv := a.Levels
	bits := a.ClassBits
	thr[15] = HPThreshold(a, rise, t)
	if bits&0xF800 != 0 && row[13] != 0xFF { // C2:DDCE
		thr[13] = GrowthChance(t, a.WPMax, poolRaise(lv[0:5]))
	}
	if bits&0x07F0 != 0 && row[14] != 0xFF {
		thr[14] = GrowthChance(t, a.JPMax, poolRaise(lv[5:12]))
	}
	counter := a.BattleCounter
	for i := 0; i < 12; i++ { // C2:DEBE
		if bits&(0x8000>>i) == 0 || row[i] == 0xFF {
			continue
		}
		c := row[i]
		if c < 3 && i == FavClass(a.Forte) {
			c = 2
		}
		r := c + rise
		if counter != 0 {
			r += (counter * t.CounterMul) >> 8
		}
		thr[i] = GrowthChance(t, lv[i], r)
	}
	return thr
}

// Penalty is C2:DF47: isqrt of the raw level bytes (an unlearned 0x80
// counts 128) / 2.
func Penalty(a *Combatant) int {
	total := 0
	for _, v := range a.Levels {
		total += v
	}
	return IsqrtSub(total) >> 1
}

func growthSucceeds(r RNG, thr int) bool {
	return r.Roll(0, 255)+1 < thr
}

func hpGainRoll(r RNG, a *Combatant) { // C2:DCB3
	v := a.VIT >> 2
	gain := r.Roll(1, uint8(v)) + v + 2 // C2:DCC6
	a.MaxHP = minInt(hpCap, a.MaxHP+gain)
}

// GrowthMessage receives one growth line ("class 3 -> 4" / "wp_max -> 10"
// / "max_hp -> 82"); the engine logs it and ticks the message waits.
type GrowthMessage func(a *Combatant, text string)

// RunGrowth is the whole victory growth step: fighters are the battle's
// allies, reserve the party member at formation position 5 (nil = none),
// rise the enemy slot 0's 上昇LV ($2032).
func RunGrowth(r RNG, fighters []*Combatant, reserve *Combatant, rise int, t *GrowthData, message GrowthMessage) {
	any := false
	for _, a := range fighters {
		if !a.Alive {
			continue
		}
		thr := Thresholds(a, rise, t)
		pen := Penalty(a)
		grew := false
		for _, codeV := range t.OrderRows[a.GrowthType] { // C2:DBE6
			code := codeV
			if code == 0xFF || code == 0x0C {
				continue
			}
			ok := false
			text := ""
			if code < 0x0C { // C2:DD54
				l := a.Levels[code]
				if (l == 0 && code >= 5) || l >= levelCap || thr[code] == 0 {
					continue
				}
				ok = growthSucceeds(r, thr[code]) // C2:DD81
				if ok {
					a.Levels[code] = l + 1
					text = "class " + itoa(code) + " -> " + itoa(l+1)
				}
			} else if code == 0x0D || code == 0x0E { // C2:DCED
				if code == 0x0D {
					if a.WPMax >= poolCap {
						a.WPMax = poolCap
						continue
					}
					if thr[code] == 0 {
						continue
					}
					ok = growthSucceeds(r, thr[code]) // C2:DD24
					if ok {
						a.WPMax++
						text = "wp_max -> " + itoa(a.WPMax)
					}
				} else {
					if a.JPMax >= poolCap {
						a.JPMax = poolCap
						continue
					}
					if thr[code] == 0 {
						continue
					}
					ok = growthSucceeds(r, thr[code]) // C2:DD24
					if ok {
						a.JPMax++
						text = "jp_max -> " + itoa(a.JPMax)
					}
				}
			} else { // 0x0F, C2:DC53
				if a.MaxHP >= hpCap {
					a.MaxHP = hpCap
					continue
				}
				if thr[15] == 0 {
					continue
				}
				ok = growthSucceeds(r, thr[15]) // C2:DC7B
				if ok {
					hpGainRoll(r, a)
					text = "max_hp -> " + itoa(a.MaxHP)
				}
			}
			if ok {
				a.BattleCounter = 0
				grew = true
				any = true
				message(a, text)
				for k := 0; k < 16; k++ { // C2:DDB1
					if thr[k] < pen {
						thr[k] = 0
					} else {
						thr[k] -= pen
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if !grew {
			a.BattleCounter = minInt(0xFF, a.BattleCounter+1)
		}
	}
	if !any { // C2:DF6E
		var low *Combatant
		for _, a := range fighters {
			if a.Alive && a.MaxHP < hpCap && (low == nil || a.MaxHP < low.MaxHP) {
				low = a
			}
		}
		if low != nil {
			low.MaxHP++
			message(low, "max_hp -> "+itoa(low.MaxHP))
		}
	}
	if reserve == nil || !reserve.Alive { // C2:DFEB
		return
	}
	hpThr := HPThreshold(reserve, rise, t)
	if reserve.MaxHP >= hpCap {
		reserve.MaxHP = hpCap
	} else if hpThr != 0 && growthSucceeds(r, hpThr) { // C2:DC7B, silent
		hpGainRoll(r, reserve)
	}
	row := reserve.GrowthRow
	ampThr := 0
	if row[12] != 0xFF {
		ampThr = GrowthChance(t, reserve.Levels[11], row[12]+rise) // C2:E053
	}
	if reserve.Levels[11] >= levelCap {
		reserve.Levels[11] = levelCap
	} else if ampThr != 0 && growthSucceeds(r, ampThr) { // C2:E033
		reserve.Levels[11]++
	}
}

func itoa(v int) string {
	if v == 0 {
		return "0"
	}
	neg := v < 0
	if neg {
		v = -v
	}
	var buf [20]byte
	i := len(buf)
	for v > 0 {
		i--
		buf[i] = byte('0' + v%10)
		v /= 10
	}
	if neg {
		i--
		buf[i] = '-'
	}
	return string(buf[i:])
}
```

```go
package battle

import (
	"testing"
)

// The C2:614E bump-side and C2:5665 double-action pins, mirroring
// battle.gd's _sim_order_side and _sim_immovable (commit 8d747dc, read
// 2026-11-23). Sources: the byte-verified dispatch decode
// (docs/battle-enemy-ai.md "Action order C2:614E" + "The immovable revert
// C2:5665") and the live MesenCE probes quoted there (30+ picks in probe
// battle 3; battle 151's initiative pairs 35/1A and 37/1B).

func TestOrderSide(t *testing.T) {
	// A 2+2 battle whose order is [1, 2, 0, 3] only under the engine's
	// side: an ally pick bumps the ENEMY entries, an enemy pick the ALLY
	// entries. The flipped own-side reading builds [1, 0, 2, 3] (its
	// first bump would lift ally 0 over enemy 2 immediately). Engine
	// derivation: pick ally 1 (74) bumps the enemies 72->77, 40->45; the
	// enemy's 77 outranks ally 0's 70, so the enemy slot goes second; its
	// bump lifts ally 0 70->75 past the remaining enemy 45. The walk
	// keeps the SP cells (the taken flag is Acted), so the final cells
	// show the bumps: ally 0 75, enemies 77 / 50.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1},
		Enemies: []int{32, 32}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	e.SP = []int{70, 74, 72, 40}
	e.Acted = []bool{false, false, false, false}
	var order []int
	for {
		k := e.PickActor()
		if k == -1 {
			break
		}
		e.setSlotActed(k)
		e.BumpOpponents(k)
		order = append(order, k)
	}
	wantOrder := []int{1, 2, 0, 3}
	wantSP := []int{75, 74, 77, 50}
	for i := range wantOrder {
		if order[i] != wantOrder[i] {
			t.Fatalf("order bump side: order %v, want %v", order, wantOrder)
		}
	}
	for i := range wantSP {
		if e.SP[i] != wantSP[i] {
			t.Fatalf("order bump side: sp %v, want %v", e.SP, wantSP)
		}
	}
}

func TestImmovableGate(t *testing.T) {
	// The FE:D1BF gate: arms iff the battle set up with one in-list
	// enemy. Battle 151 (ボクオーン 0x14C) and 149 (クジンシー 0x14A) arm;
	// enemy 363 (0x16B, not in the list) and a two-enemy setup do not.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	mk := func(enemies []int, fixed *FixedBattle) *Engine {
		r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
		e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
			Enemies: enemies, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
		}
		return e
	}
	fixed151 := fixedAt(t, 151)
	fixed149 := fixedAt(t, 149)
	if e := mk(fixed151.Enemies, fixed151); !e.ImmovableBoss {
		t.Fatal("5665 gate: battle 151 did not arm")
	}
	if e := mk(fixed149.Enemies, fixed149); !e.ImmovableBoss {
		t.Fatal("5665 gate: battle 149 did not arm")
	}
	if e := mk([]int{363}, nil); e.ImmovableBoss {
		t.Fatal("5665 gate: 0x16B armed")
	}
	if e := mk([]int{fixed151.Enemies[0], fixed151.Enemies[0]}, fixed151); e.ImmovableBoss {
		t.Fatal("5665 gate: $34 = 2 armed")
	}
	// The exported list (cmd/exportbosslist) matches the ROM's 59:FF00
	// words (LoadImmovableList's offset bank<<16 + addr), byte-verified.
	_, rom := loadFixtures(t)
	fromRom, err := LoadImmovableList(rom)
	if err != nil {

	}
	export := []int(d.ImmovableIDs)
	if len(export) != len(fromRom) {
		t.Fatalf("export list %d ids, ROM list %d", len(export), len(fromRom))
	}
	for i := range export {
		if export[i] != fromRom[i] {
			t.Fatalf("export list diverges from the ROM at %d: %d vs %d", i, export[i], fromRom[i])
		}
	}
}

func TestImmovableDoubleAction(t *testing.T) {
	// The 5665 round (live probe battle 151): two 56A5 passes per round -
	// the boss's own entry keeps pass 1's real-mode decision, one virtual
	// order slot carries pass 2 (pattern 2) at the boss's SP >> 1 - one
	// 5C3E initiative roll (the round's last), and both slots act.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	fixed := fixedAt(t, 151)
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: fixed.Enemies, Fixed: fixed, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	// The GDScript harness seeds the generator straight to 0x210 before
	// the round.
	r.Index = 0x210
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.Round = 1
	e.BeginRound()
	bossI := len(e.Allies)
	bossSP := e.SP[bossI]
	// One pass-2 slot at boss_sp >> 1, unacted.
	if len(e.PhantomActors) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("5665 slots = %d, want 1", len(e.PhantomActors))
	}
	if e.PhantomActors[0].SP != bossSP>>1 {
		t.Fatalf("5665 pass-2 sp = %d, want %d (boss sp %d >> 1)", e.PhantomActors[0].SP, bossSP>>1, bossSP)
	}
	if e.PhantomActors[0].Acted {
		t.Fatal("5665 pass-2 slot started acted")
	}
	// Pass 2's decision is a pattern-2 pick (mode 5 reads rec[0x3F+r]).
	if e.PhantomActors[0].Decision.Empty() || e.PhantomActors[0].Decision.Pattern != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("5665 pass 2 = %+v, want a pattern-2 pick", e.PhantomActors[0].Decision)
	}
	// Pass 1's decision is the real mode's pattern-1 pick (rec[0x37+r];
	// ボクオーン's mode 4 runs pattern 1).
	if e.Enemies[0].Decision.Empty() || e.Enemies[0].Decision.Pattern != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("5665 pass 1 = %+v, want the real mode's pattern-1 pick", e.Enemies[0].Decision)
	}
	// The roll stream: exactly two [1,0] unlocked-range rolls (hi =
	// (3*$1308&0F + 3*$26) >> 4 = 0 here) and the round's last roll is
	// the single 5C3E initiative roll.
	nUnlocked := 0
	for _, tr := range r.Trace {
		if tr.Lo == 1 && tr.Hi == 0 {
			nUnlocked++
		}
	}
	if nUnlocked != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("5665 rolls: [1,0] x%d, want exactly 2 (trace %v)", nUnlocked, r.Trace)
	}
	if len(r.Trace) == 0 || r.Trace[len(r.Trace)-1].Lo != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("5665 last roll = %v, want the initiative roll(1,·)", r.Trace[len(r.Trace)-1:])
	}
	// Both order entries reach the round table: the boss acts twice, the
	// real-mode slot first.
	var picks []int
	combatants := e.combatantCount()
	for {
		k := e.PickActor()
		if k == -1 {
			break
		}
		if k < combatants {
			e.Acted[k] = true
		} else {
			e.PhantomActors[k-combatants].Acted = true
		}
		e.BumpOpponents(k)
		picks = append(picks, k)
	}
	bossSeen, pass2Seen := false, false
	bossPos, pass2Pos := -1, -1
	for i, k := range picks {
		if k == bossI {
			bossSeen, bossPos = true, i
		}
		if k == bossI+1 {
			pass2Seen, pass2Pos = true, i
		}
	}
	if !bossSeen || !pass2Seen {
		t.Fatalf("5665 order = %v; want the boss's slot %d and the pass-2 slot %d both in the table", picks, bossI, bossI+1)
	}
	if pass2Pos < bossPos {
		t.Fatalf("5665 order = %v; want the real-mode slot before the halved pass-2 slot", picks)
	}
	// The pass-2 slot's execution lands on the allies through the boss's
	// shared record.
	hpBefore := 0
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		hpBefore += a.HP
	}
	e.RunPhantomSlot(combatants)
	hpAfter := 0
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		hpAfter += a.HP
	}
	if !e.PhantomActors[0].Acted || hpAfter >= hpBefore {
		t.Fatalf("5665 execution: acted=%v ally hp %d -> %d; want the pass-2 action to land",
			e.PhantomActors[0].Acted, hpBefore, hpAfter)
	}
}
```

```go
// The §4/§15 engine-layer math pins. Sources: godot/battle.gd's

func TestAttributeDefense(t *testing.T) {
```

`internal/game/battle/mathapi.go`:

```go
package battle

import (
	ib "saga3/internal/battle"
)

// The battle-engine math layer (docs/battle-formulas.md §4 defense chain
// and §15 tech damage families). The primitives these build on live in
// internal/battle (golden 13/13); this file carries only what that
// package predates: the engine's attribute-defense scan, the engine hit
// forms, the two landing rolls and the three engine families. Ground
// truth: godot/battle_math.gd (kept in lockstep with this file's
// GDScript twin), byte-decoded from the C2 bank 2026-11-18 and
// live-verified (tools/emulator /tmp/defharness run7).

// AttributeDefense is C2:B3ED: the min of the defender's attribute bytes
// over the tech's attribute mask (bits walked b7-first, so bit 7 -> byte
// 0). Mask 0 (attribute-less techs) -> 0; a sum >= 0x80 clamps to 0x80 =
// no damage.
func AttributeDefense(attrMask int, attrDef [8]int) int {
	if attrMask == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	minDef := 255
	for i := 0; i < 8; i++ {
		if attrMask&(1<<(7-i)) != 0 {
			minDef = minInt(minDef, attrDef[i])
		}
	}
	if minDef >= 0x80 {
		return 0x80
	}
	return minDef
}

// ResistMarkValue is the FE:CAFF mark handler: an armor's resist byte low
// nibble adjusts the value a masked attribute gets (1 weak spot 0,
// 2 halve, 3 x1.5, 4 double, 5 triple, 6 unchanged, 7 immunity 0x80).
func ResistMarkValue(value, mark int) int {
	switch mark {
	case 1:
		return 0
	case 2:
		return value / 2
	case 3:
		return value * 3 / 2
	case 4:
		return value * 2
	case 5:
		return value * 3
	case 6:
		return value
	case 7:
		return 0x80
	}
	return value
}

// JoinArmor is FE:CA55/CAA0: join one armor record (PhysDef/PhysResist,
// MagDef/MagResist) into the 8 attribute-defense bytes, in place. Bytes
// 0-3 are physical (斬 打 突 射), 4-7 magic (熱 冷 雷 状).
func JoinArmor(attrDef *[8]int, physDef, physResist, magDef, magResist int) {
	mark := physResist & 0x0F
	mask := physResist & 0xF0
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		bit := 1 << (7 - i)
		if mask&bit != 0 {
			attrDef[i] += ResistMarkValue(physDef, mark)
		} else {
			attrDef[i] += physDef
		}
	}
	mark = magResist & 0x0F
	mask = magResist & 0xF0
	for i := 0; i < 4; i++ {
		bit := 1 << (7 - i)
		if mask&bit != 0 {
			attrDef[4+i] += ResistMarkValue(magDef, mark)
		} else {
			attrDef[4+i] += magDef
		}
	}
}

// HitRateEngine is the §4.1 ENGINE hit forms (C2:8A7B/8B1B/8BA4/8C59),
// replacing the fan table for types 0-3. strV/speedV are the attacker's
// battle record +0x1E/+0x20; weight is the weapon item byte (masked & 7
// here); targetEvade = the defender's (+0x20 + +0x11) clamped <= 99
// before the x2/x3 (see EvadeSum).
func HitRateEngine(techType, baseHit, lv, strV, speedV, weight, targetEvade int) int {
	w4 := (weight & 7) * 4
	switch techType {
	case 0x00:
		return baseHit + speedV + lv + maxInt(strV-w4, 0) - 2*targetEvade
	case 0x01:
		return baseHit + lv/2 + maxInt(strV-w4, 0)*4 - 2*targetEvade
	case 0x02:
		return baseHit + lv + maxInt(speedV-w4, 0)*4 + maxInt(strV-18, 0)*4 - 3*targetEvade
	case 0x03:
		return baseHit + strV + speedV - 2*targetEvade
	}
	return 0
}

// EvadeSum is the defender's evade term (+0x20 + +0x11) clamped to 99
// (C2:8ACD/8B5F) before the rate formulas multiply it.
func EvadeSum(targetSpeed, targetSpeedBonus int) int {
	return minInt(targetSpeed+targetSpeedBonus, 99)
}

// HitLanded is the §4.1 roll verdict: hit iff roll <= rate (rate >= 100 =
// auto-hit, negative = never).
func HitLanded(rate, roll int) bool { return roll <= rate }

// CounterLanded is the §4.2 counter/parry verdict (C2:86C6, per hit
// before the hit roll): tech +6 low 2 bits == 1 halves the rate (the
// 反撃 branch); 防御 doubles (C2:A2A8, fan-supported). Success voids the
// hit.
func CounterLanded(rate, roll int, counterBranch, defending bool) bool {
	v := rate
	if counterBranch {
		v = rate / 2
	}
	if defending {
		v *= 2
	}
	return roll <= v
}

// ShieldBlockLanded is the §4.3 shield block verdict (C2:89EC, once per
// attack); 防御 doubles. Success voids the whole attack.
func ShieldBlockLanded(rate, roll int, defending bool) bool {
	v := rate
	if defending {
		v = rate * 2
	}
	return roll <= v
}

// EnvelopeE0 is the §1 envelope with the engine's defense input $E0
// (C2:99D5): D×(128 − E0 − 体÷2)÷128 − E0×2, floored at 0; $E0 >= 0x80
// (the immunity sentinel) -> 0; 防御 halves. Same arithmetic as
// battle.Envelope with def -> E0.
func EnvelopeE0(d, e0, body int, defending bool) int {
	if e0 >= 0x80 {
		return 0
	}
	return ib.Envelope(d, e0, body, ib.DamageOpts{Defending: defending})
}

// FamilyWeaponD is the §15.1 family C2:8F22 (技タイプ 0x00-0x02):
//
//	D = 威力×4×回数 + (腕+2)×C×成÷4 + max(攻−防÷2, 0)×(C + BA04(腕) + 成)÷2 + 乱
//
// BA04(x) = 0 for x < 10 else (x-10)/4 (C2:BA04); 防 floors in the term3
// clamp. Unlike the fan §2.1 battle.WeaponD: the +2 in term2 (not
// C×(50−C)÷8) and BA04 in term3 (not (能−19)÷2).
func FamilyWeaponD(power, hits, growth, str, atk, def, c, lv, randBonus int) int {
	base := power * 4 * maxInt(hits, 1)
	term2 := (str + 2) * c * growth / 4
	term3 := maxInt(atk-def/2, 0) * (c + ba04(str) + growth) / 2
	return base + term2 + term3 + randBonus
}

// ba04 is C2:BA04: (x-10)/4 for x >= 10, else 0.
func ba04(x int) int {
	if x < 10 {
		return 0
	}
	return (x - 10) / 4
}

// FamilyQuakeD is the §15.2 family C2:91C3 (技タイプ 0x06 earthquake):
//
//	D = 威力×4 + (攻+腕)×C÷4 + max(腕−重×2, 0)×重×C×成÷8 + 乱
//
// weight is the weapon item fetch & 7; no 回数 factor.
func FamilyQuakeD(power, str, atk, weight, c, growth, randBonus int) int {
	base := power * 4
	term2 := (atk + str) * c / 4
	term3 := maxInt(str-weight*2, 0) * weight * c * growth / 8
	return base + term2 + term3 + randBonus
}

// FamilyMartialD is the §15.1's family C2:9007 (技タイプ 0x03 through the
// C2:6586 gate):
//
//	D = 威力×4×回数 + √(√(腕×攻速)×攻速)×C×成 + max(攻速−8,0)÷4×(C+成) + 乱
func FamilyMartialD(power, hits, growth, str, attackSpeedV, c, lv, randBonus int) int {
	base := power * 4 * maxInt(hits, 1)
	inner := isqrt(str * attackSpeedV)
	term2 := isqrt(inner*attackSpeedV) * c * growth
	term3 := maxInt(attackSpeedV-8, 0) / 4 * (c + growth)
	return base + term2 + term3 + randBonus
}

// BattleAgility is the battle record's agility join (+0x20): half the
// four body slots' weight, less (vit-8)/4 allowance (floored at 0; vit
// below 8 replaces the base with vit), then the formation position's
// speed level L: agility ± |L|×(agility>>2), 8-bit. Opening capture:
// ハリード 20 (position 0), ユリアン 17 -> 13, エレン 18 -> 14, サラ 21 ->
// 16, トーマス 18 -> 14.
func BattleAgility(agi, vit, bodyWeight, speedLevel int) int {
	w := bodyWeight >> 1
	base := agi
	if vit >= 8 {
		allow := (vit - 8) >> 2
		if allow < w {
			w -= allow
		} else {
			w = 0
		}
	} else {
		base = vit
	}
	a := maxInt(base-w, 0)
	d := (absInt(speedLevel) * (a >> 2)) & 0xFF
	if speedLevel > 0 {
		a = (a + d) & 0xFF
	} else if speedLevel < 0 {
		a = (a - d) & 0xFF
	}
	return a
}

// RandBonus is the §2.1/§15 乱 roll: roll(1, 3*LV) (C2:90B0); LV 0 gives
// hi 0, which returns 0 and leaves the index.
func RandBonus(r RNG, classLv int) int {
	return r.Roll(1, uint8(classLv*3&0xFF))
}

func isqrt(x int) int {
	if x <= 0 {
		return 0
	}
	r := x
	for r*r > x {
		r = (r + x/r) / 2
	}
	return r
}

func minInt(a, b int) int {
	if a < b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func maxInt(a, b int) int {
	if a > b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func absInt(x int) int {
	if x < 0 {
		return -x
	}
	return x
}

```

```go
// openingBattle builds the opening battle at the pin's seed with the exact
// live handoff: composition first (the main.gd pin), then the engine's
// battle-start check at 0x21A.
func openingBattle(t *testing.T, pin *openingPin) (*Engine, *fakeWorld) {
	t.Helper()
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	r := newBattleRNG(t, pin.Seed.Clock)
	assertEq(t, "seed index", r.Index, pin.Seed.Index)
	ids, idx := composeSeq(t, r, pin.Composition.Party, pin.Composition.Enc, 0, 0, -1, -1)
	if len(ids) != len(pin.Composition.WantIDs) || ids[0] != pin.Composition.WantIDs[0] {
		t.Fatalf("opening composition = %v, want %v", ids, pin.Composition.WantIDs)
	}
	assertEq(t, "composition end index", idx, pin.Composition.EndIndex)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{4, 0, 1, 2, 3, 6})
	w.walkID = 0x0A // the opening battle's $F322
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{4, 0, 1, 2, 3, 6},
		Enemies: []int{0x20}, Contact: 2, Level1308: 0, Race: 2})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	return e, w
}

func TestOpeningSetup(t *testing.T) {
	pin := loadPin[openingPin](t, "opening_battle.json")
	e, _ := openingBattle(t, pin)
	// The hero forte (C5:9645 -> 5B:7B8F): ユリアン 剣 2 -> 3, WP 9, the
	// forte's item in the second weapon slot (the opening capture).
	hero := e.Allies[1]
	assertEq(t, "hero id", hero.ID, pin.Hero.ID)
	if hero.WLevels[0] != pin.Hero.WLevel0 || hero.WPMax != pin.Hero.WPMax ||
		hero.Equipment[1] != pin.Hero.Slot2 {
		t.Fatalf("hero forte: levels %v WP %d slot2 %s, want [%d ...] %d %s",
			hero.WLevels, hero.WPMax, hero.Equipment[1], pin.Hero.WLevel0, pin.Hero.WPMax, pin.Hero.Slot2)
	}
	// The party record the loader left last (the battle-start check's
	// inputs).
	last := e.PartyLast
	if last.Name != pin.PartyLast.Name || last.WIL != pin.PartyLast.Wil ||
		last.CHA != pin.PartyLast.Cha || last.AmpLV != pin.PartyLast.AmpLV {
		t.Fatalf("party last = %s wil %d cha %d amp %d, want %s %d/%d/%d",
			last.Name, last.WIL, last.CHA, last.AmpLV,
			pin.PartyLast.Name, pin.PartyLast.Wil, pin.PartyLast.Cha, pin.PartyLast.AmpLV)
	}
	// The battle agility (battle record +0x20) from the live stats,
	// weight and formation 0A (the capture's records 5-9).
	got := []int{}
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		got = append(got, a.AGI)
	}
	for i := range pin.Agilities {
		if got[i] != pin.Agilities[i] {
			t.Fatalf("battle agility = %v, want %v", got, pin.Agilities)
		}
	}
	// The battle-start check landed 0 ($4F feeds the enemy initiative
	// sums).
	assertEq(t, "battle-start check $4F", e.Check, pin.BattleStart.Check)
}

func TestOpeningRound(t *testing.T) {
	pin := loadPin[openingPin](t, "opening_battle.json")
	e, _ := openingBattle(t, pin)
	r := e.R.(*rngBattle)
	// From the seed: the composition's 12 draws + the battle-start check
	// roll, and nothing else (the AI unlock rolls consume nothing for
	// this battle: 地狼 is not in a marker-0 entry).
	if len(r.Trace) != len(pin.Composition.Rolls)+1 {
		t.Fatalf("pre-round trace = %d rolls, want %d: %v", len(r.Trace), len(pin.Composition.Rolls)+1, r.Trace)
	}
	traceEq(t, "pre-round composition", r.Trace[:len(pin.Composition.Rolls)], pin.Composition.Rolls...)
	last := r.Trace[len(r.Trace)-1]
	if int(last.Lo) != pin.BattleStart.Roll[0] || int(last.Hi) != pin.BattleStart.Roll[1] ||
		last.Index != pin.BattleStart.Index {
		t.Fatalf("battle start = %+v, want %v at %#X", last, pin.BattleStart.Roll, pin.BattleStart.Index)
	}
	// Round 1 from 02B6 (after the capture's 155 intro waits).
	r.Index = pin.Round.StartIndex
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.Round = 0
	e.BeginRound()
	traceEq(t, "opening round", r.Trace, pin.Round.Rolls...)
	for i, v := range pin.Round.Initiative {
		if e.SP[i] != v {
			t.Fatalf("initiative = %v, want %v", e.SP, pin.Round.Initiative)
		}
	}
	d := e.Enemies[0].Decision
	if d.Tech != pin.Round.Decision.Tech || d.Pattern != pin.Round.Decision.Pattern ||
		d.Kind != pin.Round.Decision.Kind || d.Index != pin.Round.Decision.Index {
		t.Fatalf("地狼 decision = %+v, want %+v", d, pin.Round.Decision)
	}
	// The enemy action: the capture's round wait, the 40 waits (FE:C016),
	// then hit / spread / field step and 3 waits; ハリード's HP drops.
	TickN(r, pin.EnemyAction.Waits)
	hpBefore := e.Allies[0].HP
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.EnemyRoundTurn(5)
	e.AfterAction(e.D.EnemyTechs[pin.Round.Decision.Tech].School)
	traceEq(t, "enemy action", r.Trace, pin.EnemyAction.Rolls...)
	assertEq(t, "enemy action end index", r.Index, pin.EnemyAction.EndIndex)
	if pin.EnemyAction.HPDropped && e.Allies[0].HP >= hpBefore {
		t.Fatalf("ハリード hp %d -> %d, want a drop", hpBefore, e.Allies[0].HP)
	}
	// The spark thresholds the engine computed per entry (the live probe
	// at C2:C11E).
	var thr []int
	for _, entry := range e.SparkPool("01", 0) {
		if entry.Difficulty < 0x80 && !containsStr(e.Allies[0].Techs, entry.Tech) {
			thr = append(thr, e.SparkThreshold(e.Allies[0], entry.Tech, entry.Difficulty, e.Enemies[0]))
		}
	}
	if len(thr) != len(pin.SparkThresholds.Want) {
		t.Fatalf("spark thresholds = %v (%d), want %v (%d)", thr, len(thr), pin.SparkThresholds.Want, len(pin.SparkThresholds.Want))
	}
	for i := range thr {
		if thr[i] != pin.SparkThresholds.Want[i] {
			t.Fatalf("spark thresholds = %v, want %v", thr, pin.SparkThresholds.Want)
		}
	}
	// ハリード's plain attack: the pin's spark rolls, hit, spread, field
	// step; the capture's 地狼 fell to it.
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.Chosen = map[int]Command{}
	e.SparkCount = 0
	plain := e.PlainTechFor(e.Allies[0])
	assertEq(t, "ハリード plain tech", plain, pin.AllyAction.PlainTech)
	e.ResolveAllyAction(0, plain, 0)
	e.AfterAction(e.allySchool(0))
	traceEq(t, "ally action", r.Trace, pin.AllyAction.Rolls...)
	assertEq(t, "ally action end index", r.Index, pin.AllyAction.EndIndex)
	if pin.AllyAction.WolfDies && e.Enemies[0].Alive {
		t.Fatalf("地狼 survived at hp %d, want fallen", e.Enemies[0].HP)
	}
	// The victory level bumps: the rank roll, then 16 group rolls; race
	// 2's row bumps group 2 only (roll 0 -> +8).
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	w2 := e.W.(*fakeWorld)
	w2.global = 0
	w2.races = [16]int{}
	LevelBumps(r, w2, 2, &e.D.Levels)
	if len(r.Trace) != pin.LevelBumps.Rolls || r.Trace[0].Index != pin.LevelBumps.FirstIndex {
		t.Fatalf("level bumps = %d rolls from %v, want %d from %#X",
			len(r.Trace), r.Trace[0:], pin.LevelBumps.Rolls, pin.LevelBumps.FirstIndex)
	}
	assertEq(t, "global level", w2.global, pin.LevelBumps.Global)
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		if w2.races[i] != pin.LevelBumps.Races[i] {
			t.Fatalf("race level %d = %d, want %d", i, w2.races[i], pin.LevelBumps.Races[i])
		}
	}
	// Growth (after the waits): the failed rolls, the nobody-grew message
	// (with the capture's button wait 7), then the reserve rolls.
	for i := range e.Allies {
		e.Chosen[i] = Command{Kind: CmdTech, ID: e.PlainTechFor(e.Allies[i])}
	}
	e.MarkCommandClasses()
	TickN(r, pin.Growth.WaitsBefore)
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.MessageButtonWait = pin.Growth.ButtonWait
	hp0 := []int{}
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		hp0 = append(hp0, a.MaxHP)
	}
	e.VictoryGrowth()
	e.MessageButtonWait = 1
	if len(r.Trace) != pin.Growth.FailRolls+len(pin.Growth.ReserveRolls) {
		t.Fatalf("growth trace = %d rolls, want %d: %v", len(r.Trace),
			pin.Growth.FailRolls+len(pin.Growth.ReserveRolls), r.Trace)
	}
	traceEq(t, "growth reserve", r.Trace[pin.Growth.FailRolls:], pin.Growth.ReserveRolls...)
	if r.Trace[0].Index != pin.Growth.FirstIndex {
		t.Fatalf("growth start = %#X, want %#X", r.Trace[0].Index, pin.Growth.FirstIndex)
	}
	hp1 := []int{}
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		hp1 = append(hp1, a.MaxHP)
	}
	wantHP := append([]int(nil), hp0...)
	wantHP[pin.Growth.SaraSlot] = hp0[pin.Growth.SaraSlot] + pin.Growth.SaraHPGain // the nobody-grew lowest-max-HP +1
	for i := range hp1 {
		if hp1[i] != wantHP[i] {
			t.Fatalf("max HP %v -> %v, want %v", hp0, hp1, wantHP)
		}
	}
	if e.Reserve.Name != pin.Growth.Reserve.Name || e.Reserve.MaxHP != pin.Growth.Reserve.MaxHP ||
		e.Reserve.AmpLV != pin.Growth.Reserve.AmpLV {
		t.Fatalf("reserve %s = max HP %d 増幅 %d, want %s %d/%d",
			e.Reserve.Name, e.Reserve.MaxHP, e.Reserve.AmpLV,
			pin.Growth.Reserve.Name, pin.Growth.Reserve.MaxHP, pin.Growth.Reserve.AmpLV)
	}
	// Spoils: the drop slots, the gold roll, then the closing waits to the
	// pin's end index; the type-0x0C run skips the tail's 30.
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.VictorySpoils()
	traceEq(t, "spoils", r.Trace, pin.Spoils.Rolls...)
	assertEq(t, "spoils end index", r.Index, pin.Spoils.EndIndex)
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	idxA := r.Index
	e.VictorySpoils()
	d1 := r.Index - idxA
	e.Fixed = &FixedBattle{Type: 0x0C}
	r.Index = idxA
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.VictorySpoils()
	d2 := r.Index - idxA
	e.Fixed = nil
	if len(r.Trace) != len(pin.Spoils.Rolls) {
		t.Fatalf("spoils tail re-run trace %v", r.Trace)
	}
	for i, tr := range r.Trace {
		if int(tr.Lo) != pin.Spoils.Rolls[i][0] || int(tr.Hi) != pin.Spoils.Rolls[i][1] {
			t.Fatalf("spoils tail roll %d = %v, want %v", i, tr, pin.Spoils.Rolls[i])
		}
	}
	if d1 != d2+pin.Spoils.TailDifference {
		t.Fatalf("spoils tail: normal +%d, type 0x0C +%d, want a %d-wait difference",
			d1, d2, pin.Spoils.TailDifference)
	}
}

func TestOpeningCounterSparkGate(t *testing.T) {
	pin := loadPin[openingPin](t, "opening_battle.json")
	e, _ := openingBattle(t, pin)
	r := e.R.(*rngBattle)
	// The counter spark gate (C2:AC3B): the round bookkeeping starts
	// where BeginRound would leave it.
	e.SP = make([]int, e.combatantCount())
	e.Acted = make([]bool, e.combatantCount())
	csAlly := e.Allies[2] // サラ
	fang := e.D.EnemyTechs["010"]
	saved := csAlly.Techs
	csAlly.Techs = nil
	e.Chosen[2] = Command{Kind: CmdTech, ID: "01", Target: 0}
	e.Acted[2] = false
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	fresh := e.CounterSpark(e.Enemies[0], csAlly, &fang)
	freshRolls := len(r.Trace)
	csAlly.Techs = nil
	e.Acted[2] = true
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	acted := e.CounterSpark(e.Enemies[0], csAlly, &fang)
	actedRolls := len(r.Trace)
	csAlly.Techs = saved
	e.Acted[2] = false
	delete(e.Chosen, 2)
	if fresh || freshRolls != pin.CounterSpark.FreshRolls {
		t.Fatalf("counter spark fresh: fired %v with %d rolls, want no fire and %d roll(s)",
			fresh, freshRolls, pin.CounterSpark.FreshRolls)
	}
	if acted || actedRolls != pin.CounterSpark.ActedRolls {
		t.Fatalf("counter spark after acting: fired %v with %d rolls, want %d",
			acted, actedRolls, pin.CounterSpark.ActedRolls)
	}
}

func TestOpeningActionOrder(t *testing.T) {
	pin := loadPin[openingPin](t, "opening_battle.json")
	e, _ := openingBattle(t, pin)
	// The round's initiatives (the capture's 47 34 34 35 35 108) with all
	// entries waiting. C2:614E order: the enemy (108) first, then the
	// bumped allies 52 39 39 40 40 -> ally 0, 3, 4, 1, 2 (the capture's
	// actors: $2000, then $2280, then $2400). The opening's one-enemy
	// board cannot distinguish the bump polarity - both readings give the
	// same sequence here.
	e.SP = append([]int(nil), pin.ActionOrder.SP...)
	e.Acted = make([]bool, len(pin.ActionOrder.SP))
	var order []int
	for {
		k := e.PickActor()
		if k == -1 {
			break
		}
		e.setSlotActed(k)
		e.BumpOpponents(k)
		order = append(order, k)
	}
	for i := range pin.ActionOrder.Order {
		if order[i] != pin.ActionOrder.Order[i] {
			t.Fatalf("action order = %v, want %v", order, pin.ActionOrder.Order)
		}
	}
	// The bump polarity (byte-verified 2026-11-23, re-measured; the brief
	// "own side" reading had the dispatch inverted): an enemy pick bumps
	// the ALLY entries - 252 -> 253 (the FD cap), 254 stays, 2 stays, 3
	// -> 8 - and the waiting enemy 9 is untouched.
	b := pin.ActionOrder.BumpEnemyPick
	e.SP = append([]int(nil), b.SP...)
	e.Acted = append([]bool(nil), b.Acted...)
	e.BumpOpponents(5)
	for i := range b.Want {
		if e.SP[i] != b.Want[i] {
			t.Fatalf("enemy-pick bump = %v, want %v (other side)", e.SP, b.Want)
		}
	}
	// An ally pick bumps the enemy entries: 9 -> 14, allies untouched.
	b = pin.ActionOrder.BumpAllyPick
	e.SP = append([]int(nil), b.SP...)
	e.Acted = append([]bool(nil), b.Acted...)
	e.BumpOpponents(0)
	for i := range b.Want {
		if e.SP[i] != b.Want[i] {
			t.Fatalf("ally-pick bump = %v, want %v (other side)", e.SP, b.Want)
		}
	}
}
```
