`internal/game/battle/rng.go`:

```go
package battle

// RNG is the battle RNG surface the engine needs (C2:032E roll + FE:C14E
// tick). *rng.Battle (internal/game/rng, the sibling-owned port of
// battle_rng.gd) implements it; roll order pins read its Trace/Index
// directly in the tests.
type RNG interface {
	Roll(lo, hi uint8) int
	Tick()
}

// TickN advances the RNG by n frame waits (FE:C14E; FE:C17A blocks are
// the callers' fixed counts).
func TickN(r RNG, n int) {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		r.Tick()
	}
}

```

`internal/game/battle/round.go`:

```go
package battle

// The round engine (docs/battle-enemy-ai.md "Round order" + "Action
// order C2:614E" + "Per-action wait chunks"): the allies' initiative,
// four frame waits, the driver's per-enemy dispatch (the battle-254
// phantom spawner, the 5665 double-action boss dispatch, the scripted
// modes), the order build and the actions. Reference: godot/battle.gd
// _begin_round / _next_actor and friends.

// BeginRound is C2:2588 through C2:620B: the round's SP rolls, waits and
// decisions. The harness sets Chosen before calling.
func (e *Engine) BeginRound() {
	e.Round++
	e.SP = e.SP[:0]
	e.Acted = e.Acted[:0]
	if e.Round == 1 {
		// battle init: $53 = 1 (FE:C570), the escape gate cells at 0
		e.Res53 = 1
		e.EscapeTarget = 0
		e.LastCmdCost = 0
	}
	for i, a := range e.Allies {
		flag := e.OrderFlag(e.allySettings(i), "")
		if flag == 0 {
			flag = AllyInitiative(e.R, a.AGI, e.Round, e.Contact)
		}
		e.SP = append(e.SP, flag)
		e.Acted = append(e.Acted, false)
	}
	TickN(e.R, 4) // the jsl $FEB8F4 at C2:1E3F before the driver C2:52BC
	ctx := e.AIContext()
	// the type-0x0E chain link (C2:5338) arms a FE:926B entry by M before
	// the script consumer runs
	scriptGate := -1
	var scriptPairs [][]int
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x0E {
		if entry := e.ChainScriptEntry(); entry >= 0 {
			row := e.D.BattleScripts[entry]
			scriptGate = row[0]
			scriptPairs = [][]int{row[1:3], row[3:5], row[5:7], row[7:9]}
		}
	}
	scripted := e.ScriptRound(ctx, scriptGate, scriptPairs)
	// C2:5507 (the driver's per-enemy dispatcher): battle 254 spawns the
	// round's phantoms instead of enemy decisions - each phantom's decide
	// runs at spawn (56A5 -> 56D9) and the picks queue onto enemy 0's
	// single action slot (live-verified 2026-11-23, t255e). The driver's
	// own 5C3E is skipped, but the handlers' common tail C2:5645 re-rolls
	// the enemy initiatives, so enemy 0 still takes a real initiative roll
	// after the spawns.
	e.PhantomQueue = nil
	phantomBattle := e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x12
	if phantomBattle && e.Enemies[0].Alive {
		e.SpawnPhantoms(ctx)
	}
	// C2:5665 ($22 bit 3, set at battle setup): the per-enemy dispatch's
	// first call replaces the enemy's single decision with two 56A5
	// passes - pass 1 the enemy's real mode, pass 2 (mode & E0) | 05 with
	// the mode AS PASS 1 LEFT IT (the PHA at 5670 saves the original byte
	// for the 569C restore) - and returns A = FF, so the bne at 52D9
	// aborts to 5330: the rest of the driver loop and the driver's own
	// 5D77/5C3E/5CB4 pass are skipped. The round-1 back-attack gate sits
	// INSIDE 56A5 (jsr 5D0E -> slot[5] = 0x0D, no rolls), so the guard
	// below leaves the pass decisions empty while the slot still exists.
	bossTwoPass := false
	bossSecond := Decision{}
	for j, en := range e.Enemies {
		if scripted[j] {
			continue // keeps its scripted decision
		}
		en.Decision = Decision{}
		if e.ImmovableBoss && j == 0 && !phantomBattle && en.Alive {
			if !(e.Round == 1 && e.Contact == 1) {
				originalMode := en.AIMode
				en.Decision = Decide(e.R, en, j, ctx)
				en.AIMode = (en.AIMode & 0xE0) | 5
				bossSecond = Decide(e.R, en, j, ctx)
				en.AIMode = originalMode
			}
			bossTwoPass = true
			break // the abort skips the rest of the driver loop
		}
		if !(phantomBattle && j == 0) && en.Alive && !(e.Round == 1 && e.Contact == 1) {
			// the phantom battle's dispatcher replaced enemy 0's decision
			// with the spawns - enemy 0 has no own slot at all (the live
			// trace's round tables hold only ally slots, the commander
			// slot and the phantom slots)
			en.Decision = Decide(e.R, en, j, ctx)
		}
	}
	// Per-phantom order slots (battle 254): SP = the protagonist-
	// commander's rolled SP halved (C2:5645 stores $162B[$31] >> (k+1)
	// byte-wise into the following cells; the port's stand-in = the
	// protagonist ally's SP). SP 0 slots are skipped by the order
	// builder.
	e.PhantomActors = nil
	if phantomBattle {
		baseSP := 0
		if pi := e.ProtagonistIndex(); pi >= 0 {
			baseSP = e.SP[pi]
		}
		e.BuildPhantomSlots(baseSP)
	}
	for j, en := range e.Enemies {
		if scripted[j] {
			e.SP = append(e.SP, 1) // C2:472D: the script group acts at priority 1
			e.Acted = append(e.Acted, false)
			continue
		}
		flag := 0
		if !en.Decision.Empty() {
			flag = e.OrderFlag(e.D.EnemyTechs[en.Decision.Tech].Settings, en.Decision.Kind)
		}
		// C2:5645 (the handlers' common tail) re-rolls the enemy
		// initiatives after the spawns even in the phantom battle - enemy
		// 0's SP is the rolled value, not 0 (live trace: its slot moved
		// between rounds). The single append IS the 5C3E the 5665 abort
		// kept (5665's own at 5689); the driver's own pass is what the
		// abort skipped, so nothing rolls twice.
		sp := EnemyInitiative(e.R, en.AGI, e.Round, e.Contact, e.Check)
		if flag != 0 {
			sp = flag
		}
		e.SP = append(e.SP, sp)
		e.Acted = append(e.Acted, false)
		if phantomBattle && j == 0 {
			// no own action: its actions are the phantom slots
			e.Acted[len(e.Acted)-1] = true
		}
	}
	// 5665's tail (5695-569B): $162B[$31+1] = $162B[$31] >> 1 - the
	// pass-2 slot's order entry, the same halving idiom as the battle-254
	// phantom slots (9D 2C 16 with X = $31 is $162B[$31+1], read by the
	// 614E scan; live probe battle 151: initiative pairs 35/1A and
	// 37/1B, byte-exact 0x35 >> 1 = 0x1A). The boss's own entry keeps
	// pass 1's decision and acts at its own SP.
	if bossTwoPass && e.Enemies[0].Alive {
		e.PhantomActors = append(e.PhantomActors, &PhantomActor{
			Decision: bossSecond, SP: e.SP[len(e.Allies)] >> 1})
	}
	e.MarkCommandClasses()
	e.R.Tick() // C2:620B: the action loop's first wait
}

// BuildPhantomSlots is C2:5645's halving series: one order slot per
// spawn-time decision, SP = the base initiative halved (k+1) times.
func (e *Engine) BuildPhantomSlots(baseSP int) {
	e.PhantomActors = nil
	v := baseSP >> 1
	for _, d := range e.PhantomQueue {
		e.PhantomActors = append(e.PhantomActors, &PhantomActor{Decision: d, SP: v})
		v = v >> 1
	}
}

// immovableGate is FE:D1BF (battle setup): clears $22 bit 3, then sets it
// iff the battle set up with exactly one enemy ($34 == 1) whose id word
// (& 0x1FFF) appears in the 59:FF00 list. Called once from NewEngine, so
// a chain advance (which re-runs the loader but not D1BF) keeps the
// setup-time verdict. Battle 254 never reaches the dispatch (the type-12
// dispatcher 5507 aborts the driver first).
func (e *Engine) immovableGate() {
	e.ImmovableBoss = false
	if len(e.Enemies) != 1 {
		return
	}
	if containsID(e.D.ImmovableIDs, e.Enemies[0].ID&0x1FFF) {
		e.ImmovableBoss = true
	}
}

func containsID(ids []int, id int) bool {
	for _, v := range ids {
		if v == id {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// decideWithMode runs the dispatcher under a forced AI mode (the 5507 /
// 5665 store-then-restore of rec[0x0B]).
func (e *Engine) decideWithMode(en *Combatant, j int, ctx *AIContext, mode int) Decision {
	saved := en.AIMode
	en.AIMode = mode
	d := Decide(e.R, en, j, ctx)
	en.AIMode = saved
	return d
}

// AIContext builds the decision-chain context.
func (e *Engine) AIContext() *AIContext {
	if e.FormationID == "" {
		panic("battle: party formation ($F322) unknown")
	}
	f := e.D.Formations[e.FormationID]
	round := e.Round
	if round > 0xFF {
		round = 0xFF
	}
	var races [16]int
	for i := 0; i < 16; i++ {
		races[i] = e.W.RaceLevel(i)
	}
	return &AIContext{Round: round, FormationRates: f.Rates,
		// C2:BBF7: rates unless $38 bit 7 or formation 0C/0D
		Weighted:  !e.Ambush && e.FormationID != "0C" && e.FormationID != "0D",
		Level1308: e.Level1308, GlobalLevel: e.W.GlobalLevel(),
		RaceLevels: races, Allies: e.Allies, Enemies: e.Enemies,
		EnemyTechs: e.D.EnemyTechs}
}

// PickActor is the order builder C2:614E: the highest initiative not yet
// taken, a tie to the lowest slot (strict >), fallen and sleeping
// combatants included (the order is fixed before any action; they skip at
// their turn). Returns -1 when every entry is taken.
func (e *Engine) PickActor() int {
	best := -1
	total := len(e.Allies) + len(e.Enemies) + len(e.PhantomActors)
	for i := 0; i < total; i++ {
		if e.slotActed(i) || e.slotSP(i) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		if best == -1 || e.slotSP(i) > e.slotSP(best) {
			best = i
		}
	}
	return best
}

func (e *Engine) combatantCount() int { return len(e.Allies) + len(e.Enemies) }

func (e *Engine) slotSP(i int) int {
	n := e.combatantCount()
	if i < n {
		return e.SP[i]
	}
	return e.PhantomActors[i-n].SP
}

func (e *Engine) slotActed(i int) bool {
	n := e.combatantCount()
	if i < n {
		return e.Acted[i]
	}
	return e.PhantomActors[i-n].Acted
}

func (e *Engine) setSlotActed(i int) {
	n := e.combatantCount()
	if i < n {
		e.Acted[i] = true
		return
	}
	e.PhantomActors[i-n].Acted = true
}

func (e *Engine) setSlotSP(i, v int) {
	n := e.combatantCount()
	if i < n {
		e.SP[i] = v
		return
	}
	e.PhantomActors[i-n].SP = v
}

// ProtagonistIndex is the ally slot of the World's select-row protagonist.
func (e *Engine) ProtagonistIndex() int {
	want := ProtagonistID(e.W)
	for i, a := range e.Allies {
		if a.ID == want {
			return i
		}
	}
	return -1
}

// BumpOpponents is FE:D8AE / D8DE after each pick: +5 to the OTHER side's
// entries still waiting (byte-verified 2026-11-23, re-measured: cpx
// #$1597 at 618B, bcs 618E -> JSL FED8AE at 6196 = the ALLY-block bumper
// when the pick is an enemy slot, fall-through JSL FED8DE at 6190 = the
// enemy-block bumper for an ally pick; live-confirmed with a MesenCE
// probe battle, 30+ picks). Each bump skips 0 (taken), values under 3
// (the 行動最後 2 markers) and FD..FF (行動最初 FE and the cap), and
// stores min(entry + 5, FD) - a 16-bit add, so no wrap. (The doc's brief
// "own side" reading had the dispatch polarity inverted and was
// corrected; see docs/battle-enemy-ai.md "Action order C2:614E".)
func (e *Engine) BumpOpponents(actorIdx int) {
	actorIsAlly := actorIdx < len(e.Allies)
	n := e.combatantCount()
	for i := 0; i < n+len(e.PhantomActors); i++ {
		isAlly := i < len(e.Allies)
		if isAlly == actorIsAlly || e.slotActed(i) {
			continue
		}
		v := e.slotSP(i)
		if v >= 3 && v < 0xFD {
			e.setSlotSP(i, minInt(v+5, 0xFD))
		}
	}
}

// FinishAction closes one order entry and bumps (FE:D8AE/D8DE run for
// every pick, a skipped turn included).
func (e *Engine) FinishAction(idx int) {
	e.setSlotActed(idx)
	e.BumpOpponents(idx)
}

// RunActor executes one order entry: a fallen combatant's place still
// bumps; a fled one logs and skips the body (C2:6243); sleeping decays
// (§6.1, no bump-side difference - a skipped turn is not an action);
// confusion swings at a random living combatant; otherwise the ally
// command or the enemy decision runs, then the C2:66C2 -> 69B3 tail.
func (e *Engine) RunActor(idx int) {
	if e.Over {
		return
	}
	n := e.combatantCount()
	if idx >= n {
		// a battle-254/5665 phantom slot: enemy 0 acts through it with the
		// slot's spawn-time decision (the slots share the actor's record)
		e.RunPhantomSlot(idx)
		if e.CheckEnd() {
			return
		}
		e.FinishAction(idx)
		return
	}
	c := e.actorAt(idx)
	if !c.Alive {
		e.FinishAction(idx) // its place in the order still bumps
		return
	}
	if c.Fled {
		// rec[7] bit 0x40 (FE:D729): the body skips at C2:6243 - no tech,
		// no FE:C016 tick, no school pass; the turn slot stays and the
		// ally stays targetable (FED3B6 reads bit 0x40 as zero).
		e.log(c.Name + " は離脱している")
		e.FinishAction(idx)
		return
	}
	if c.Defending {
		c.Defending = false
	}
	if c.Sleep > 0 {
		next := sleepDecay(c.Sleep, minInt(c.VIT, 99))
		if next > 0 {
			c.Sleep = next
			e.log(c.Name + " は眠っている（異常度 " + itoa(next) + "）")
			e.FinishAction(idx)
			return
		}
		c.Sleep = 0
		e.log(c.Name + " は目覚めた")
	}
	if c.Confusion {
		e.ResolveConfusion(idx)
		e.FinishAction(idx)
		return
	}
	if c.IsAlly {
		e.RunChosen(idx)
		e.AfterAction(e.allySchool(idx))
		if e.CheckEnd() {
			return
		}
		e.FinishAction(idx)
		return
	}
	e.log(c.Name + " の行動")
	d := c.Decision
	if !d.Empty() {
		if e.D.EnemyTechs[d.Tech].Settings&0x02 != 0 {
			// C2:5BD4 decides the leave at pick time (tech[8] bit 2):
			// rec[7] |= 0x40 and slot[5] = 0x0B, so the action body skips
			// at C2:624D - no tech execution, no school pass, and no
			// FE:C016 wait (C860 is called only from the executors, never
			// on the shared skip tail at C2:6286). The enemy leaves the
			// field but keeps its turn slot and stays targetable.
			c.Fled = true
		} else {
			TickN(e.R, 40) // FE:C016 via C2:C860, executed actions
			e.EnemyRoundTurn(idx)
			// C2:C550 via 9DC9 (the executor's animation helper):
			// battle 254 escalates the phantom timer on roll 0
			if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x12 && e.R.Roll(0, 3) == 0 {
				e.PhantomTimer++
			}
			e.AfterAction(e.D.EnemyTechs[d.Tech].School)
		}
	}
	e.FinishAction(idx)
}

func (e *Engine) actorAt(idx int) *Combatant {
	if idx < len(e.Allies) {
		return e.Allies[idx]
	}
	return e.Enemies[idx-len(e.Allies)]
}

// RunPhantomSlot is a phantom order slot's turn (docs/battle-enemy-ai.md,
// live trace t255e): the slot shares its actor's record, acts its
// spawn-time decision, and consumes the same waits and the C550 timer
// roll as an executed enemy action.
func (e *Engine) RunPhantomSlot(idx int) {
	pa := e.PhantomActors[idx-e.combatantCount()]
	pa.Acted = true
	// A virtual slot (battle 254's phantom order slots, the immovable
	// boss's pass-2 slot) acts through enemy 0's shared record, so the
	// dead/fled/sleep/confusion gates below read the boss's state.
	c := e.Enemies[0]
	d := pa.Decision
	if d.Empty() || !c.Alive {
		return // the slot's place still bumps (fallen/sleeping rule)
	}
	e.log(c.Name + " の行動")
	if e.D.EnemyTechs[d.Tech].Settings&0x02 != 0 {
		return // the flee-tech skip: no body, no tick, no school pass
	}
	TickN(e.R, 40) // FE:C016 via C2:C860, executed actions
	e.EnemyRoundTurnDict(c, d)
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x12 && e.R.Roll(0, 3) == 0 {
		e.PhantomTimer++
	}
	e.AfterAction(e.D.EnemyTechs[d.Tech].School)
}

// RunRound drives the whole action loop of the current round: picks in
// SP order until the order is exhausted, then the round-end phase
// (C2:D1FF). Reports whether the battle ended.
func (e *Engine) RunRound() bool {
	for {
		idx := e.PickActor()
		if idx == -1 {
			return e.RoundEnd()
		}
		e.RunActor(idx)
		if e.Over {
			return true
		}
	}
}

// RoundEnd is the C2:D1FF branch (battle phase 5, after every round's
// actions, the last round included): the scripted 0F/13 end, the chain
// advance, the animated-background and screen-actor rolls, the battle-254
// stage update, the escape cells, the reinforcements, the poison tick and
// the end check. Reports whether the battle ended.
func (e *Engine) RoundEnd() bool {
	if e.ScriptedRoundEnd() {
		return true
	}
	e.ChainAdvance()
	// C2:D1FF: the animated-background roll C2:D260 (roll(0,3)) runs
	// first; type 0x0A battles add the screen-actor roll C2:D979 -> 0C8B
	// (roll(0,7)); the reinforcements (C2:F57F) come after both
	e.R.Roll(0, 3)
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x0A {
		e.R.Roll(0, 7)
	}
	// C2:D8B2 (battle 254): the stage update - stages 4/5 keep theirs
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x12 && e.PhantomStage != 4 && e.PhantomStage != 5 {
		e.PhantomStage = (e.PhantomTimer & 0xF) >> 2
	}
	// the escape gate's timer pair (C2:D886 -> D934/D956, gated
	// $1424 < 6) and the $53 refill (FE:EA6C)
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x12 {
		e.EscapeCellsRoundEnd()
	}
	e.Reinforce()
	e.TickPoison()
	return e.CheckEnd()
}

// RunChosen is an ally's turn: the command chosen at the round's start; a
// fallen enemy target falls to the first living one (the engine's
// re-target at action time is not decoded).
func (e *Engine) RunChosen(idx int) {
	a := e.Allies[idx]
	cmd, ok := e.Chosen[idx]
	if !ok {
		cmd = Command{Kind: CmdPlain, Target: 0}
	}
	switch cmd.Kind {
	case CmdDefend:
		// C2:B70C logs the confirmed command's cost into $1427 (the escape
		// gate's round-end subtraction); 攻撃/防御 carry cost 0.
		e.LastCmdCost = 0
		a.Defending = true
		e.log(a.Name + " は身を守った")
		return
	case CmdItem:
		e.LastCmdCost = 0
		e.ResolveAllyItem(idx, cmd.ID, cmd.Target)
		return
	case CmdTech:
		techID := cmd.ID
		target := cmd.Target
		if target < 0 || target >= len(e.Enemies) || !e.Enemies[target].Alive {
			target = e.firstLivingEnemyIndex()
			if target < 0 {
				return
			}
		}
		e.LastCmdCost = e.D.Techniques[techID].Cost & 0x1F
		e.ResolveAllyAction(idx, techID, target)
	default: // CmdPlain
		target := cmd.Target
		if target < 0 || target >= len(e.Enemies) || !e.Enemies[target].Alive {
			target = e.firstLivingEnemyIndex()
			if target < 0 {
				return
			}
		}
		e.LastCmdCost = 0
		e.ResolveAllyAction(idx, e.PlainTechFor(a), target)
	}
}

func (e *Engine) firstLivingEnemyIndex() int {
	for j, en := range e.Enemies {
		if en.Alive {
			return j
		}
	}
	return -1
}

// CombatSpeed is the weight-adjusted 素早さ (battle record +0x20); enemies
// carry no weight data.
func (e *Engine) CombatSpeed(c *Combatant) int {
	w := 0
	if c.IsAlly {
		// weight was spent at equip time (equipAllies), so allies see 0
		// here; enemies carry no weight data
		w = c.Weight
	}
	return effSpeed(c.AGI, 0, w)
}

// allySchool is the 術タイプ of the tech the ally's command ran; commands
// without a tech (defend, items) count as 0 (UNVERIFIED: their 69B3 step
// is not decoded).
func (e *Engine) allySchool(idx int) int {
	cmd, ok := e.Chosen[idx]
	if !ok || cmd.Kind == CmdPlain {
		return 0
	}
	if cmd.Kind == CmdDefend || cmd.Kind == CmdItem {
		return 0
	}
	return e.D.Techniques[cmd.ID].School
}

// allySettings is the chosen command tech's settings byte (C2:25B5's
// input); commands without a tech carry 0.
func (e *Engine) allySettings(idx int) int {
	cmd, ok := e.Chosen[idx]
	if !ok || cmd.Kind != CmdTech {
		return 0
	}
	return e.D.Techniques[cmd.ID].Settings
}

// OrderFlag is C2:25B5: 行動最後 (+8 bit 0x04) gives 2, 行動最初 (bit
// 0x08) FE; only for an action with a target (slot +5 & 7F below 0C).
func (e *Engine) OrderFlag(settings int, kind string) int {
	if kind == TNone || kind == TCounter {
		return 0
	}
	if settings&0x04 != 0 {
		return 2
	}
	if settings&0x08 != 0 {
		return 0xFE
	}
	return 0
}

// AfterAction is C2:66C2 -> 69B3 after an executed action: the
// field-shift step reads the tech's 術タイプ (+0x0B): bit 0x40 skips it,
// otherwise without bit 0x80 it costs a roll(0, 3) (the shift itself is
// not ported); then the three waits of C2:6652.
func (e *Engine) AfterAction(school int) {
	if school&0x40 == 0 && school&0x80 == 0 {
		e.R.Roll(0, 3) // C2:69C7
	}
	TickN(e.R, 3)
}

// MarkCommandClasses is C2:60D8 before the action loop: each ally's
// command class marks the +0x34 growth word (0x8000 >> tech class nibble;
// 0F none).
func (e *Engine) MarkCommandClasses() {
	for i, a := range e.Allies {
		cmd, ok := e.Chosen[i]
		if !ok || cmd.Kind != CmdTech {
			continue
		}
		rec, ok2 := e.D.Techniques[cmd.ID]
		if !ok2 {
			continue
		}
		nib := rec.Class & 0x0F
		if nib != 0x0F {
			a.ClassBits |= 0x8000 >> nib
		}
	}
}

// Roll100 is the $0379 rand 1..100.
func (e *Engine) Roll100() int { return e.R.Roll(1, 100) }
```

```go
func TestRace2BattleGolden(t *testing.T) {
	// The decoded road encounter (地狼 x5, race 2 band 0) fought by the
	// scripted fresh party (ユリアン/エレン/サラ/トーマス, exported HP)
	// through the engine's own resolve path - real patterns, real family
	// dispatch, real envelopes. Seeded outcome golden (SELFTEST_CLOCK,
	// ROM battle RNG): STILL a wipe in round 3 - 5 wolves alive, 0
	// allies, max enemy hit 65. The engine-side history: the 牙 hit rate
	// vs the fresh party is 108..118 = always-hit; wolf output per round
	// is ~5x35-62 while the party's whole HP pool is 310; whether the
	// real ROM's fresh party ever meets this encounter at band 0 is
	// UNVERIFIED (docs/battle-enemy-ai.md, battle.gd _sim_race2 header).
	// Worst-case single hit bound: ファングクラッシュ (power 15, growth
	// 5, 乱 9) on サラ's attribute defense 5: envelope_e0(108, 5, 7) = 87.
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	// The GDScript harness runs with the default contact 4 (it never
	// sets encounter_contact), so neither side's round-1 initiative
	// doubles. It also seeds the generator straight to 0x210 - no
	// composition, no battle-start check roll - so the sim replays from
	// 0x210 after the build (the build's own check consumed 0x210; its
	// $4F is 0 either way at level1308 0).
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{32, 32, 32, 32, 32}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	r.Index = 0x210
	assertEq(t, "race2 check $4F", e.Check, 0)
	rounds := 0
	maxHit := 0
	usedMoves := map[string]bool{}
	for rounds < 6 && !e.Over {
		rounds++
		e.Round = rounds
		e.BeginRound()
		for {
			idx := e.PickActor()
			if idx == -1 {
				break
			}
			e.Acted[idx] = true
			actor := e.actorAt(idx)
			if !actor.Alive {
				e.BumpOpponents(idx)
				continue
			}
			if idx < len(e.Allies) {
				enemy := e.FirstLiving(e.Enemies)
				if enemy == nil {
					break
				}
				targetIdx := -1
				for i, en := range e.Enemies {
					if en == enemy {
						targetIdx = i
					}
				}
				e.ResolveAllyAction(idx, e.PlainTechFor(actor), targetIdx)
			} else {
				before := []int{}
				for _, a := range e.Allies {
					before = append(before, a.HP)
				}
				e.EnemyRoundTurn(idx)
				for k := range e.Allies {
					if hit := before[k] - e.Allies[k].HP; hit > maxHit {
						maxHit = hit
					}
				}
				if d := actor.Decision; !d.Empty() {
					usedMoves[e.EnemyTechName(d.Tech)] = true
				}
			}
			e.BumpOpponents(idx)
			if e.CheckEnd() {
				break
			}
		}
	}
	aliveAllies := 0
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		if a.Alive {
			aliveAllies++
		}
	}
	aliveEnemies := 0
	for _, en := range e.Enemies {
		if en.Alive {
			aliveEnemies++
		}
	}
	pin := loadPin[struct {
		Race2Battle struct {
			Rounds       int `json:"rounds"`
			AliveAllies  int `json:"alive_allies"`
			AliveEnemies int `json:"alive_enemies"`
			MaxHit       int `json:"max_hit"`
			WorstCase    int `json:"worst_case_bound"`
		} `json:"race2_battle"`
	}](t, "race2_composition.json").Race2Battle
	if aliveEnemies != pin.AliveEnemies || rounds != pin.Rounds || aliveAllies != pin.AliveAllies || maxHit != pin.MaxHit {
		t.Fatalf("race-2 battle golden: rounds %d alive allies %d alive enemies %d max hit %d, want %d/%d/%d/%d",
			rounds, aliveAllies, aliveEnemies, maxHit,
			pin.Rounds, pin.AliveAllies, pin.AliveEnemies, pin.MaxHit)
	}
	// The §4 chain worst case: no single hit may exceed the bound
	// (ファングクラッシュ on サラ at attribute defense 5).
	if maxHit > pin.WorstCase {
		t.Fatalf("max enemy hit %d exceeds the §4 chain worst-case %d", maxHit, pin.WorstCase)
	}
	for _, move := range []string{"パワーセーブ", "地震"} {
		if usedMoves[move] {
			t.Fatalf("地狼 used %s; pattern 1 carries only the four physical techs", move)
		}
	}
}

func TestUniformTargets(t *testing.T) {
	// Enemy-side target rates: uniform over living allies (no engine rate
	// data exists - docs/battle-data.md 敵編成 section, traced 2026-11-18
	// via tools/emulator enemy_form.lua). Pinned distribution with the
	// selftest seed: 300 rolls over the 3 enemy slots (a regression pin
	// of the battle generator from index 0x210, not engine evidence).
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{0, 0, 0}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	// The selftest trio runs at HP 3000; the counts only need identities.
	for _, en := range e.Enemies {
		en.HP = 3000
		en.MaxHP = 3000
	}
	r.SeedFromClock(0x21)
	r.Trace = nil
	counts := []int{0, 0, 0}
	for i := 0; i < 300; i++ {
		picked := e.RandomLiving(e.Enemies)
		for j := range e.Enemies {
			if picked == e.Enemies[j] {
				counts[j]++
			}
		}
	}
	want := []int{103, 96, 101}
	for i := range want {
		if counts[i] != want[i] {
			t.Fatalf("enemy uniform target: counts %v over 300 rolls, want %v", counts, want)
		}
	}
}

func TestSparkLanding(t *testing.T) {
	// The landing branch of the spark roll (C2:A75A): a 剣Lv-50 actor
	// (diff beyond the table tops out at base 50) must learn one of the
	// 素手-pool techs within 40 attacks; the counter roll runs against the
	// seeded generator (a regression pin from clock 0x21).
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{32}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	// The spark chance bases (live spark row 68:E920 at over 0/+10/-10/-16).
	for _, c := range []struct {
		over, want int
	}{{0, 22}, {10, 48}, {-10, 1}, {-16, 0}} {
		if got := e.SparkBase(c.over); got != c.want {
			t.Fatalf("spark base(%d) = %d, want %d", c.over, got, c.want)
		}
	}
	// The pool structure the roll machinery reads (§4.6 goldens).
	sword := e.SparkPool("01", 0)
	if len(sword) == 0 || sword[0].Tech != "10" || sword[0].Difficulty != 7 {
		t.Fatalf("剣 spark pool head = %v, want [10 7]", sword)
	}
	nagiharai := e.SparkPool("10", 0)
	if len(nagiharai) == 0 || nagiharai[0].Tech != "13" {
		t.Fatalf("なぎ払い spark pool head = %v, want [13 ...]", nagiharai)
	}
	counter := e.sparkCounter["01"]
	if len(counter) == 0 || counter[0].Tech != "0F" || counter[0].Difficulty != 13 {
		t.Fatalf("counter 剣 pool = %v, want [0F 13]", counter)
	}
	// The landing branch itself.
	ally := e.Allies[0]
	ally.WLevels = []int{50, 0, 0, 0, 0}
	ally.Techs = []string{"00"}
	r.SeedFromClock(0x21)
	learned := ""
	for i := 0; i < 40 && learned == ""; i++ {
		learned = e.TrySpark(ally, "00", 0x00, e.Enemies[0])
	}
	if learned == "" {
		t.Fatal("spark roll: base 50 never landed in 40 rolls")
	}
}

func TestAddedEffects(t *testing.T) {
	// §6.2 through real records: the flag lands exactly when the roll
	// clears the threshold; a zero-stat target has 境界値 0, so the sleep
	// applies deterministically (battle.gd _sim_battle's consistency
	// pins, seeded walk).
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{32, 32, 32}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	enemyTechs := e.D.EnemyTechs
	_ = enemyTechs
	target := e.Enemies[2]
	target.Poison = false
	rolled := e.applyAddedEffects("毒突き", []string{"毒"}, target)
	if len(rolled) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("毒突き rolled %d entries, want 1", len(rolled))
	}
	tr := rolled[0]
	if tr.Landed != (tr.Roll >= tr.Threshold) {
		t.Fatalf("毒突き landed %v vs roll %d threshold %d", tr.Landed, tr.Roll, tr.Threshold)
	}
	if target.Poison != tr.Landed {
		t.Fatalf("毒突き poison flag %v vs landed %v", target.Poison, tr.Landed)
	}
	// The landing branch on a zero-stat dummy.
	dummy := &Combatant{Name: "ざつだん", Alive: true, HP: 70, MaxHP: 70}
	sleepTry := e.applyAddedEffects("テスト眠り", []string{"眠り"}, dummy)
	if len(sleepTry) != 1 || !sleepTry[0].Landed || dummy.Sleep <= 0 {
		t.Fatalf("sleep try = %v sleep %d, want one landed roll and sleep > 0", sleepTry, dummy.Sleep)
	}
}

func TestItems(t *testing.T) {
	// §16 battle ITEM pins: the fresh party's equipped 道具 (腕4), the
	// heal value = the 道具 record's 回復力 (傷薬 0x19 x 4 = 100), the
	// overheal cap at max HP, the poison cure (cures_status bit 0x01),
	// the attack-item stub (0 damage), and the no-consumption pins
	// (equipment slot and bag both unchanged - engine evidence: the bag
	// is never read in battle and the slot survives a use;
	// docs/battle-formulas.md §16, tools/emulator item probe).
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{32}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	julian := e.Allies[0]
	item := e.BattleItemFor(julian)
	if item == nil || item.ID != "00" || item.RecoverPower != 100 {
		t.Fatalf("ユリアン 腕4 = %v, want 傷薬 (00) recover 100", item)
	}
	// Heal golden: 50 -> 150 (+100), then the overheal cap 2990 -> 3000.
	julian.MaxHP = 3000
	julian.HP = 50
	e.ResolveAllyItem(0, "00", 0)
	if julian.HP != 150 {
		t.Fatalf("item heal: hp %d, want 150 (+100)", julian.HP)
	}
	julian.HP = 2990
	e.ResolveAllyItem(0, "00", 0)
	if julian.HP != 3000 {
		t.Fatalf("item overheal: hp %d, want 3000 (max_hp cap)", julian.HP)
	}
	// Poison cure: 傷薬 cures_status 0x81 bit 0x01.
	julian.Poison = true
	e.ResolveAllyItem(0, "00", 0)
	if julian.Poison {
		t.Fatal("item cure: poison survived 傷薬 (cures_status 0x81)")
	}
	// Attack item no-op: 精霊石 in サラ's 腕4 is inert through the real
	// path (the item action is tech 08, type 4, whose executor applies

	sara := e.Allies[2]

		t.Fatalf("attack item no-op: 精霊石 changed hp to %d, want untouched 40", sara.HP)
	}

	if julian.Equipment[3] != "00" {

	}

		t.Fatalf("item consumption: bag changed: %v, want unchanged", w.inv)
	}
}

func TestSpoils(t *testing.T) {
	// §16.3 spoils pins: the 地狼 export row (slots 2/3 = 野生の薬 EA /
	// 毛皮 F2, real ROM bytes), slot 0 always drops (ceiling 0), one
	// grant per slot even with two eligible enemies, empty slots never
	// grant, FD rolls only with a weapon (battle.gd _sim_spoils).
	d, _ := loadFixtures(t)
	w := newFakeWorld([]int{0, 1, 2, 3})
	r := newBattleRNG(t, 0x21)
	e, err := NewEngine(d, w, r, Config{Party: []int{0, 1, 2, 3},
		Enemies: []int{32, 32}, Contact: 4, Race: -1, Formation: "0A"})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("NewEngine: %v", err)
	}
	wantDrops := []string{"", "", "EA", "F2"}
	for i, want := range wantDrops {
		if e.Enemies[0].Drops[i] != want {
			t.Fatalf("地狼 drops = %v, want %v", e.Enemies[0].Drops, wantDrops)
		}
	}
	for _, en := range e.Enemies {
		en.Alive = false
		en.Drops = [4]string{"E9", "", "", ""}
		en.DropCodes = [4]int{0xE9, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF}
	}
	e.VictorySpoils()
	if len(w.inv) != 1 || w.inv[0xE9] != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("spoils slot 0: bag %v, want {233: 1} (one grant for two enemies)", w.inv)
	}
	w.inv = map[int]int{}
	for _, en := range e.Enemies {
		en.Drops = [4]string{"", "", "", ""}
		en.DropCodes = [4]int{0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF}
	}
	e.VictorySpoils()
	if len(w.inv) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("spoils empty: bag %v, want empty", w.inv)
	}
	// FD: the enemy's pattern-1 weapon; with none (FF) there is no roll.
	e.Enemies = e.Enemies[:1]
	e0 := e.Enemies[0]
	e0.Alive = false
	e0.DropCodes = [4]int{0xFF, 0xFD, 0xFF, 0xFF}
	e0.Patterns = []Pattern{{Actions: make([]string, 8), Weapon: 0xFF}, {Actions: make([]string, 8), Weapon: 0xFF}}
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.VictorySpoils()
	noneRolls := 0
	for _, tr := range r.Trace {
		if tr.Hi == 15 {
			noneRolls++
		}
	}
	e0.Patterns = []Pattern{{Actions: make([]string, 8), Weapon: 8}, {Actions: make([]string, 8), Weapon: 9}}
	r.Trace = []traceRoll{}
	e.VictorySpoils()
	ownRolls := 0
	for _, tr := range r.Trace {
		if tr.Hi == 15 {
			ownRolls++
		}
	}
	if noneRolls != 0 || ownRolls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("own-weapon drop: %d rolls without a weapon, %d with; want 0, 1", noneRolls, ownRolls)
	}
}

func TestStatusWalk(t *testing.T) {
	// §6.1/§6.3 at battle values (battle.gd's _sim_battle goldens): サラ's
	// sleep 73 (duration(1, 70, 12)) walks 73 -> 41 -> 17 -> wake on her
	// live vit 13; poison at the sim's HP pool ticks 385 (エレン, vit 15)
	// and 387 (スケルトン, vit 14). The primitives live in
	// internal/battle; this pins the walk the round engine drives.
	if got := ib.StatusDuration(1, 70, 12); got != 73 {
		t.Fatalf("duration(1,70,12) = %d, want 73", got)
	}
	walk := []int{73}
	for {
		next := sleepDecay(walk[len(walk)-1], 13)
		if next <= 0 {
			break
		}
		walk = append(walk, next)
	}
	wantWalk := []int{73, 41, 17}
	if len(walk) != len(wantWalk) {
		t.Fatalf("sleep walk = %v, want %v then wake", walk, wantWalk)
	}
	for i := range wantWalk {
		if walk[i] != wantWalk[i] {
			t.Fatalf("sleep walk = %v, want %v", walk, wantWalk)
		}
	}
	if got := ib.PoisonPerTurn(3000, 15); got != 385 {
		t.Fatalf("poison(3000,15) = %d, want 385", got)
	}
	if got := ib.PoisonPerTurn(3000, 14); got != 387 {
		t.Fatalf("poison(3000,14) = %d, want 387", got)
	}
}
```

`internal/game/battle/spark.go`:

```go
package battle

// Spark (閃き) and the added-effect statuses, port of battle.gd's spark
// half (docs/techniques.md "Spark" + docs/battle-formulas.md §4.6/§6.2).

import ib "saga3/internal/battle"

// SparkBase is the live spark row's chance base at over = difficulty +
// 16 (chance rows ascend by over, index 0 = over -16 ... 26 = over +10).
func (e *Engine) SparkBase(diff int) int {
	rows := e.D.Spark.Chance.Spark
	if len(rows) == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return rows[clampIndex(diff+16, 0, len(rows)-1)]
}

// SparkPool is the ext spark group keyed by the used tech (derivation),
// else the group keyed by the tech's weapon class (normal attack).
func (e *Engine) SparkPool(techID string, classCode int) []SparkEntry {
	if g, ok := e.sparkExt[techID]; ok {
		return g
	}
	return e.sparkExt[hexByte(classCode)]
}

// SparkThreshold is the per-entry threshold the engine computed (live
// probe at C2:C11E): row index X = 10 + (difficulty - the TARGET's
// 閃きLV), clamped 0..26 (FE:E8A7; target record +33h; the opening's 地狼
// 3). The row: the tech's FE:353F word with the actor's 閃きタイプ bit
// picks 68:E920 when C2:C03D passes ((max WP + 20) / (max JP + 20, the JP
// term 0 once max WP + 20 >= 80) below 3, and max JP nonzero), else
// 68:E900; without the bit 5B:FEC0. Values from E0 up fold to 0
// (68:E961).
func (e *Engine) SparkThreshold(actor *Combatant, tid string, difficulty int, target *Combatant) int {
	lv := target.FlashLV
	x := 10 + clampIndex(difficulty-lv, -10, 16)
	rows := e.D.Spark.Rows.OffType
	if e.D.Spark.TypeBits[tid]>>uint(actor.FlashType)&1 != 0 {
		c4 := actor.WPMax + 20
		jp := actor.JPMax
		c6 := jp + 20
		if c4 >= 80 {
			c6 = 0 + 20
		}
		wpOK := c4/c6 < 3 && jp != 0
		if wpOK {
			rows = e.D.Spark.Rows.TypeWP
		} else {
			rows = e.D.Spark.Rows.Type
		}
	}
	v := rows[x]
	if v >= 0xE0 {
		return 0
	}
	return v
}

// TrySpark is the spark walk (C2:A75A, roll at C2:C142): per pool entry
// with difficulty below 0x80 not yet known, success iff rand + 1 <
// threshold * (8 - sparks this battle) >> 3; no roll once 8 sparks
// happened ($143C). The first success learns the tech and is returned
// ("" = none). The difficulty >= 0x80 entries' gates (C2:3B9F / 68:0012)
// are not decoded.
func (e *Engine) TrySpark(actor *Combatant, techID string, classCode int, target *Combatant) string {
	for _, entry := range e.SparkPool(techID, classCode) {
		tid := entry.Tech
		difficulty := entry.Difficulty
		if difficulty >= 0x80 || containsStr(actor.Techs, tid) {
			continue
		}
		if e.SparkCount >= 8 {
			return ""
		}
		roll := e.R.Roll(0, 255) + 1
		thr := (e.SparkThreshold(actor, tid, difficulty, target) * (8 - e.SparkCount)) >> 3
		if roll < thr {
			e.SparkCount++
			actor.Techs = append(actor.Techs, tid)
			name := "技" + tid
			if t, ok := e.D.Techniques[tid]; ok {
				name = t.Name
			}
			e.Say(actor.Name + " は " + name + " を閃き覚えた！")
			return tid
		}
	}
	return ""
}

// CounterSpark is the defender's counter spark (C2:AC3B -> AF23 -> AF86
// -> AFD0): an enemy's tech with 特殊効果 (+6) & 0x34 against an ally who
// has not acted yet this round walks the counter group keyed by the
// ally's own queued tech (FE:3F1B); entries already known skip, the
// others roll at C2:C142 with the attacker-side threshold measured
// against the ATTACKER's 閃きLV (record +33h) and the (8 - sparks) scale.
// A success counts as a spark ($143C) and then needs the kind match
// (ADD4: the candidate's +1 byte 2 -> mask 0x20, 4 -> 0x04, else 0x10,
// against the incoming +6; tech 98 bypasses); a match learns the tech,
// voids the hit and the ally uses it at once on the attacker (C2:7074;
// kinds 2 and 4 deal no damage). Not ported: the formation-tech path
// C2:AC6A (needs $20 bit 1), the counter-stance second walk (record +7
// bit 0x40), the in-battle list 7E:F50A skip, and the stance the counter
// leaves behind.
func (e *Engine) CounterSpark(attacker, target *Combatant, tech *EnemyTechRow) bool {
	if tech.Special&0x34 == 0 {
		return false
	}
	d := indexOfAlly(e.Allies, target)
	if d < 0 || e.slotActed(d) {
		return false
	}
	queued := e.PlainTechFor(target)
	if cmd, ok := e.Chosen[d]; ok {
		switch cmd.Kind {
		case CmdTech:
			queued = cmd.ID
		case CmdItem, CmdDefend:
			queued = ""
		}
	}
	for _, entry := range e.sparkCounter[queued] {
		tid := entry.Tech
		if containsStr(target.Techs, tid) {
			continue
		}
		if e.SparkCount >= 8 {
			return false
		}
		roll := e.R.Roll(0, 255) + 1 // C2:C142
		thr := (e.SparkThreshold(target, tid, entry.Difficulty, attacker) * (8 - e.SparkCount)) >> 3
		if roll >= thr {
			continue
		}
		e.SparkCount++
		kind := 0
		if t, ok := e.D.Techniques[tid]; ok {
			kind = t.Power
		}
		mask := 0x10
		if kind == 2 {
			mask = 0x20
		} else if kind == 4 {
			mask = 0x04
		}
		if tech.Special&mask == 0 && tid != "98" {
			continue
		}
		target.Techs = append(target.Techs, tid)
		name := "技" + tid
		if t, ok := e.D.Techniques[tid]; ok {
			name = t.Name
		}
		e.Say(target.Name + " は " + name + " を閃き覚えた！")
		targetIdx := -1
		for i, en := range e.Enemies {
			if en == attacker {
				targetIdx = i
				break
			}
		}
		e.Chosen[d] = Command{Kind: CmdTech, ID: tid, Target: targetIdx}
		e.setSlotActed(d)
		if kind != 2 && kind != 4 {
			e.ResolveAllyAction(d, tid, targetIdx)
		}
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// statusMachinery: the scene has machinery for 毒/眠り/混乱 only; the
// others log as unapplied.
var statusMachinery = map[string]string{"毒": "poison", "眠り": "sleep", "混乱": "confusion"}

// ApplyAddedEffects is §6.2 for an ally-side tech: roll each of the
// tech's statuses against the target's 境界値; lands when (rand mod 100)
// >= threshold. Returns one entry per rolled status.
func (e *Engine) ApplyAddedEffects(tech *TechRow, target *Combatant) []AddedEffectRoll {
	if tech == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return e.applyAddedEffects(tech.Name, tech.Statuses, target)
}

// ApplyAddedEffectsEnemy is §6.2 for an enemy-side tech.
func (e *Engine) ApplyAddedEffectsEnemy(tech *EnemyTechRow, target *Combatant) []AddedEffectRoll {
	if tech == nil {
		return nil
	}
	return e.applyAddedEffects(tech.Name, tech.Statuses, target)
}

// AddedEffectRoll is one rolled status for the consistency asserts.
type AddedEffectRoll struct {
	Status    string
	Roll      int
	Threshold int
	Landed    bool
}

func (e *Engine) applyAddedEffects(name string, statuses []string, target *Combatant) []AddedEffectRoll {
	var rolled []AddedEffectRoll
	if !target.Alive || target.HP == 0 {
		return rolled
	}
	if len(statuses) == 0 {
		return rolled
	}
	skillLv := 20 // the class-level placeholder (docs §6.2)
	for _, s := range statuses {
		effect, ok := statusMachinery[s]
		if !ok {
			e.Say(name + " の追加効果 " + s + " は未実装")
			continue
		}
		threshold := ib.AddedEffectThreshold(target.STR, target.AGI, target.VIT,
			target.MAG, target.WIL, effect, 0)
		roll := e.R.Roll(0, 99)
		landed := roll >= threshold
		if landed {
			switch effect {
			case "poison":
				target.Poison = true
			case "sleep":
				target.Sleep = ib.StatusDuration(skillLv, target.HP, e.R.Roll(0, 63)+1)
			case "confusion":
				target.Confusion = true
			}
			e.Say(target.Name + " は " + s + " にかかった")
		} else {
			e.Say(target.Name + " は " + s + " を受けつけない")
		}
		rolled = append(rolled, AddedEffectRoll{Status: s, Roll: roll, Threshold: threshold, Landed: landed})
	}
	return rolled
}

// TickPoison is §6.3: poison ticks once per round on every living
// poisoned combatant.
func (e *Engine) TickPoison() {
	for i := 0; i < e.combatantCount(); i++ {
		c := e.actorAt(i)
		if !c.Alive || !c.Poison {
			continue
		}
		dmg := ib.PoisonPerTurn(c.MaxHP, c.VIT)
		c.HP = maxInt(c.HP-dmg, 0)
		if c.HP == 0 {
			c.Alive = false
			e.log(c.Name + " は毒で " + itoa(dmg) + " 傷害（倒れた）")
		} else {
			e.log(c.Name + " は毒で " + itoa(dmg) + " 傷害（殘 " + itoa(c.HP) + "）")
		}
	}
}

// FirstLiving is the first living combatant of the pool, or nil.
func (e *Engine) FirstLiving(pool []*Combatant) *Combatant {
	for _, c := range pool {
		if c.Alive {
			return c
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// RandomLiving picks a living combatant uniformly (docs/battle-data.md
// 敵編成 section: the engine has NO per-enemy-slot target rates - enemy
// attacks pick a living ally uniformly).
func (e *Engine) RandomLiving(pool []*Combatant) *Combatant {
	var living []*Combatant
	for _, c := range pool {
		if c.Alive {
			living = append(living, c)
		}
	}
	if len(living) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	return living[e.R.Roll(0, uint8(len(living)-1))]
}

func containsStr(list []string, v string) bool {
	for _, s := range list {
		if s == v {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func indexOfAlly(list []*Combatant, c *Combatant) int {
	for i, v := range list {
		if v == c {
			return i
		}
	}
	return -1
}
```

`internal/game/battle/victory.go`:

```go
package battle

// The end-of-battle chains: the end check and its routing
// (docs/battle-defeat.md), the victory growth/spoils/gold
// (docs/battle-formulas.md §16.3 + docs/battle-enemy-ai.md "Victory
// growth"), the fixed-battle scripts (types 11 / 0D / 0E / 0F / 13), the
// battle-254 phantom spawner and the escape cells (docs/battle-menu.md
// §C), and the AI unlock rolls (C2:C18B).

// CheckEnd is C2:9D8A (the battle-end evaluator), headless-visible
// shapes: no enemies or no living (rec[7] & 0x84 tested - a fled ally
// does not count, FE:CD1E; fled enemies keep the battle running,
// FE:CD7A) settles the outcome. Victory runs the level bumps, FE:EB47's
// 32 waits, growth and spoils (C2:DA6B); a wipe runs no victory rolls
// (docs/battle-defeat.md §5) and reports defeat.
func (e *Engine) CheckEnd() bool {
	if e.Over {
		return true
	}
	enemiesAlive := 0
	for _, en := range e.Enemies {
		if en.Alive {
			enemiesAlive++
		}
	}
	alliesAlive := 0
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		// FE:CD1E's living count tests rec[7] & 0x84 - a fled ally (bit
		// 0x40) does not count, so an all-fled party routes to the wipe.
		if a.Alive && !a.Fled {
			alliesAlive++
		}
	}
	if enemiesAlive == 0 || alliesAlive == 0 {
		e.Over = true
		e.Won = enemiesAlive == 0
		if e.Won {
			e.log("勝利！")
			// C2:DA6B: the level bumps, then FE:EB47's 32 waits, then growth
			LevelBumps(e.R, e.W, e.Race, &e.D.Levels)
			TickN(e.R, 32)
			e.VictoryGrowth()
			e.VictorySpoils()
			e.Finished = true
		} else {
			e.log("敗北…")
			e.Finished = true
		}
		return true
	}
	return false
}

// VictoryGrowth is the C2:DB7C growth step; the rise is enemy slot 0's
// 上昇LV ($2032).
func (e *Engine) VictoryGrowth() {
	RunGrowth(e.R, e.Allies, e.Reserve, e.Enemies[0].RiseLV, &e.D.Growth,
		func(a *Combatant, text string) {
			e.log(a.Name + "：" + text)
			TickN(e.R, MessageWaits+e.MessageButtonWait)
		})
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		a.WLevels = append([]int(nil), a.Levels[0:5]...)
		a.AmpLV = a.Levels[11]
	}
	if e.Reserve != nil {
		e.Reserve.WLevels = append([]int(nil), e.Reserve.Levels[0:5]...)
		e.Reserve.AmpLV = e.Reserve.Levels[11]
	}
}

// VictorySpoils is the battle-end spoils (C2:E0A8 -> C2:E0D8): the
// engine walks the four drop slots; per slot every enemy record in order
// whose candidate is an item rolls rand(0..top) and the first 0 adds
// that item to the bag (FE:EBE4: stack, cap 99), then the next slot.
// 55:C9B0: FD / FE drop the enemy's own pattern-1 / pattern-2 weapon
// (record +47h / +48h), and an empty one skips the roll.
func (e *Engine) VictorySpoils() {
	TickN(e.R, 4) // C2:E088 -> FE:B8F4
	for slot := 0; slot < 4; slot++ {
		top := spoilsChance(slot, SpoilsBonus, SpoilsRankByte>>4)
		for _, en := range e.Enemies {
			code := en.DropCodes[slot]
			if en.Alive || code == 0xFF {
				continue
			}
			hex := en.Drops[slot]
			if code >= 0xFD {
				w := en.Patterns[code-0xFD].Weapon
				if w == 0xFF {
					continue
				}
				hex = hexByte(w)
			}
			if e.R.Roll(0, uint8(top)) != 0 { // C2:E149
				continue
			}
			id, err := hexID(hex)
			if err != nil {
				panic("battle: spoils drop id: " + err.Error())
			}
			e.W.AddItem(id)
			name := hex
			if it, ok := e.D.Items[hex]; ok {
				name = it.Name
			}
			e.log(name + "を手に入れた")
			break
		}
	}
	e.VictoryGold()
	TickN(e.R, 4) // C2:E230 -> FE:B8F4
	// FE:EB47: 30 more waits before the buffer clears hand the screen back
	// (capture btail2: the 34 post-gold waits 035C-037D = these 4 + 30, one
	// loop caller FE:C181); battle type $141A == 0x0C skips them
	if e.Fixed == nil || e.Fixed.Type != 0x0C {
		TickN(e.R, 30)
	}
}

// spoilsChance is the inclusive top of the victory roll for one drop
// slot (8-bit engine arithmetic, 5B:72E5/7DF0; mirrors
// internal/battle.SpoilsChance).
func spoilsChance(slot, bonus, rankNibble int) int {
	if slot == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	base := [4]int{0x00, 0x0F, 0x1F, 0x3F} // C2:E0D4
	a := (base[slot] - ((bonus << (slot - 1)) & 0xFF)) & 0xFF
	t := rankNibble >> 1
	if rankNibble == 15 {
		t = 12
	}
	t >>= 3 - slot
	return (a - t) & 0xFF
}

// VictoryGold is C2:E167: per fallen enemy, base = the drop row byte 8;
// roll(1, 100) below $7EF4C6 >> 3 adds (level + 3) >> 2 + 1 (+1 more when
// that is 1E, 5B:7E30); a nonzero sum n adds (roll(1, n) + n) * (4 +
// level), the battle total capped at 1000, the purse at 30000 (C0:395E).
// level = $5E (FE:D32D): enemy slot 0's id low nibble when id < 100 and
// nibble <= 0A, else $F532 >> 4.
func (e *Engine) VictoryGold() {
	id0 := e.Enemies[0].ID
	level := e.W.GlobalLevel() >> 4
	if id0 < 0x100 && id0&0x0F <= 0x0A {
		level = id0 & 0x0F
	}
	cut := SpoilsRankByte >> 3
	total := 0
	for _, en := range e.Enemies {
		if en.Alive {
			continue
		}
		bonus := 0
		if e.R.Roll(1, 100) < cut { // C2:E1DE
			extra := 0
			if cut == 0x1E {
				extra = 1
			}
			bonus = ((level + 3) >> 2) + extra + 1
		}
		n := (en.Gold + bonus) & 0xFF
		if n == 0 {
			continue
		}
		r := e.R.Roll(1, uint8(n)) // C2:E1FC
		total = minInt(1000, total+(r+n)*(4+level))
	}
	if total > 0 {
		e.W.SetGold(minInt(GoldCap, e.W.Gold()+total))
		e.log(itoa(total) + " オーラム")
	}
}

// ScriptedRoundEnd is C2:62AA -> 63B3 after the round's actions (fixed
// types 0F / 13): in round R enemy 0 casts tech T at a target rolled the
// usual way (FE:D885, C2:BB9F) as one more action (C2:64DB), then the
// battle ends ($50 = 4, $1B bit 0) unless that action decided it; T = FF
// ends it at once. Whether a $50 = 4 end grants growth and spoils is not
// decoded: the port ends it as a non-defeat without them (UNVERIFIED).
func (e *Engine) ScriptedRoundEnd() bool {
	if e.Fixed == nil || (e.Fixed.Type != 0x0F && e.Fixed.Type != 0x13) {
		return false
	}
	if e.Fixed.Round == 0xFF || e.Fixed.Round != e.Round {
		return false
	}
	en := e.Enemies[0]
	tech := e.Fixed.Tech
	if tech != 0xFF && en.Alive {
		tid := hex3(tech)
		t := IndividualTarget(e.R, e.D.EnemyTechs[tid], e.AIContext())
		en.Decision = Decision{Tech: tid, Pattern: 0, WeaponPattern: 0,
			Kind: t.Kind, Index: t.Index}
		TickN(e.R, 40) // FE:C016 via C2:C860
		e.EnemyRoundTurn(len(e.Allies))
		e.AfterAction(e.D.EnemyTechs[tid].School)
		if e.CheckEnd() {
			return true
		}
	}
	e.Over = true
	e.Won = true
	e.log("戦闘終了")
	return true
}

// ChainAdvance is type 0x0D: one chain member at a time. C2:18B9 spawns
// word[0] alone; at the member's death C2:F55D advances the cursor and
// C2:F2DA rebuilds slot 0 with the next word through the type loader
// (full HP, no RNG) and zeroes the round counter; C2:E344 ends the battle
// only once the last member died. Returns whether the battle continues
// with the next member.
func (e *Engine) ChainAdvance() bool {
	if e.Fixed == nil || e.Fixed.Type != 0x0D {
		return false
	}
	words := e.Fixed.Enemies
	if e.ChainCursor >= len(words)-1 {
		return false
	}
	e.ChainCursor++
	e.Round = 0 // C2:F2DA: STZ $26; the next BeginRound makes it 1
	e.setupEncounterEnemies([]int{words[e.ChainCursor]})
	return true
}

// Reinforce is type 0x0E (C2:F57F after the round's actions, when the
// battle continues): slots holding a living enemy are skipped; each dead
// or empty slot rolls roll(1,100) and, on <= spawn_chance, roll(0,4)
// picks the reinforcement word spawned there (full record build, the
// others' HP multiplier); the pass stops at spawn_cap spawns per round.
func (e *Engine) Reinforce() {
	if e.Fixed == nil || e.Fixed.Type != 0x0E {
		return
	}
	chance := e.Fixed.SpawnChance
	cap := e.Fixed.SpawnCap
	if chance == 0 || cap == 0 || len(e.SlotWords) == 0 {
		return
	}
	reinf := e.Fixed.Reinforcements
	spawned := 0
	for slot := 0; slot < len(e.SlotWords); slot++ {
		if spawned >= cap {
			break
		}
		idx := e.SlotEnemyIdx[slot]
		if idx >= 0 && e.Enemies[idx].Alive {
			continue
		}
		if e.R.Roll(1, 100) > chance {
			continue
		}
		pick := e.R.Roll(0, 4)
		w := 0xFFFF
		if pick < len(reinf) {
			w = reinf[pick]
		}
		if w == 0xFFFF {
			continue
		}
		wanted := w & 0x1FFF
		row := e.D.EnemyByID[wanted]
		if row == nil {
			panic("battle: reinforcement " + itoa(wanted) + " missing from enemies.json")
		}
		d := e.enemyRecord(row, wanted)
		d.MaxHP = minInt(d.MaxHP*e.Fixed.HPOthers, 0xFFFF)
		d.HP = d.MaxHP
		e.SlotWords[slot] = 0x8000 | wanted
		e.SlotEnemyIdx[slot] = len(e.Enemies)
		e.Enemies = append(e.Enemies, d)
		spawned++
	}
}

// ChainScriptEntry is the type-0x0E script-chain link ($1469 = [T][T*10
// bytes][M], C2:5338, run at each round start before the script
// consumer): T blocks of five words; a block is consumed when all five
// words match a slot's word & 0x1FFF whose $2000 empty marker is set.
// Dead enemies keep their id word without the marker and blocks hold
// real ids, so with the shipped data no block ever matches and the byte
// after the blocks (M) arms FE:926B entry M every round. Returns the
// armed entry, -1 when none (T = 0, or all blocks consumed).
func (e *Engine) ChainScriptEntry() int {
	chain := e.Fixed.Chain
	if len(chain) == 0 || chain[0] == 0 {
		return -1
	}
	t := chain[0]
	blockWords := chain[1 : 1+10*t]
	for b := 0; b < t; b++ {
		consumed := true
		for s := 0; s < 5; s++ {
			sw := 0
			if s < len(e.SlotWords) {
				sw = e.SlotWords[s]
			}
			if (sw&0x1FFF) != blockWords[b*5+s] || sw&0x2000 == 0 {
				consumed = false
				break
			}
		}
		if !consumed {
			return chain[1+10*t]
		}
	}
	return -1
}

// ScriptRound is the type-11 fixed battle's per-round script (C2:53DC,
// called from the round driver C2:52BC before the decision loop; table
// FE:926B + 9*M). Gate byte: bits 7/6/5 force rounds 1-3 (table C2:5465
// = 80 40 20, no RNG), bits 2-0 the fallback count C (roll(1,8) <= C).
// Fired: up to 3 attempts, pair = roll(0,3); the mask's bits 0-4 mark
// enemy slots (bit 7 set fires with at least one marked enemy alive,
// clear requires all marked alive). Success: the group executes the
// pair's tech with ONE shared target (BB9F at script time) and acts at
// priority 1. No fire or all attempts failed: the round runs normally.
// Returns the scripted slots.
func (e *Engine) ScriptRound(ctx *AIContext, gateOV int, pairsOV [][]int) map[int]bool {
	if gateOV < 0 {
		if e.Fixed == nil || e.Fixed.Type != 0x11 {
			return nil
		}
		pairsOV = e.Fixed.ScriptPairs
		gateOV = e.Fixed.ScriptGate
	}
	if len(pairsOV) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	fire := false
	if e.Round <= 3 && gateOV&(0x80>>(e.Round-1)) != 0 {
		fire = true
	} else {
		fire = e.R.Roll(1, 8) <= (gateOV & 0x07)
	}
	if !fire {
		return nil
	}
	var slots []int
	tech := 0
	for try := 0; try < 3; try++ {
		p := e.R.Roll(0, 3)
		pair := pairsOV[p]
		mask := pair[0]
		slots = nil
		wantCount := 0
		for s := 0; s < 5; s++ {
			if mask&(1<<s) == 0 {
				continue
			}
			if s < len(e.Enemies) {
				wantCount++
				if e.Enemies[s].Alive {
					slots = append(slots, s)
				}
			}
		}
		want := len(slots) > 0
		if mask&0x80 == 0 {
			want = len(slots) == wantCount
		}
		if want {
			tech = pair[1]
			break
		}
		slots = nil
	}
	if len(slots) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	tid := hex3(tech)
	t := IndividualTarget(e.R, e.D.EnemyTechs[tid], ctx)
	out := map[int]bool{}
	for _, s := range slots {
		e.Enemies[s].Decision = Decision{Tech: tid, Pattern: 0, WeaponPattern: 0,
			Kind: t.Kind, Index: t.Index}
		out[s] = true
	}
	return out
}

// SpawnPhantoms is battle 254's phantom spawner (the C2:5533 handler for
// PhantomStage, docs/battle-enemy-ai.md). All coins are roll(0,1)
// (C2:0387); each phantom decides immediately under its AI mode (56A5
// runs 56D9 per slot), and the store-then-load sites (C2:55AF/55DF/55F1)
// discard the A9 byte, so those phantoms keep the standing mode.
func (e *Engine) SpawnPhantoms(ctx *AIContext) {
	decide := func(mode int) {
		e.PhantomQueue = append(e.PhantomQueue, e.decideWithMode(e.Enemies[0], 0, ctx, mode))
	}
	switch e.PhantomStage {
	case 0:
		if e.Round&1 == 1 {
			decide(9) // C2:5547
		} else {
			decide(10)
		}
	case 1: // C2:5563
		decide(9)
		if e.R.Roll(0, 1) == 0 {
			decide(10)
		}
	case 2: // C2:5586
		decide(9)
		took := false
		if e.R.Roll(0, 1) == 0 {
			decide(18)
			took = true
		}
		for e.R.Roll(0, 1) != 0 {
			// C2:55A5: rolls until a zero
		}
		if took {
			decide(18)
		} else {
			decide(9)
		}
	case 3: // C2:55BB
		decide(16)
		decide(17)
		if e.R.Roll(0, 1) == 0 {
			decide(17)
		}
		if e.R.Roll(0, 1) == 0 {
			decide(17)
		}
	case 4, 5: // C2:55FD (STZ $0A4D is script state)
		decide(13)
		if e.R.Roll(0, 1) == 0 {
			decide(14)
		} else {
			decide(15)
		}
	case 6, 7, 8, 9: // C2:5627
		decide(9)
		decide(10)
	}
}

// EscapeCellsRoundEnd is C2:D934/D956 (gated $1424 < 6): the target
// level rises minus the last command's cost, the current level chases
// it; FE:EA6C refills $53 by (max(0, current - target) + 7) >> 3 in
// battle 254 (1 in every other battle), capped at 9.
func (e *Engine) EscapeCellsRoundEnd() {
	if e.PhantomStage < 6 {
		e.EscapeTarget = maxInt(0, ((e.EscapeTarget+1)&0xF)-e.LastCmdCost)
		e.PhantomTimer += maxInt(0, e.EscapeTarget-(e.PhantomTimer&0xF))
	}
	refill := 1
	if e.Fixed != nil && e.Fixed.Type == 0x12 {
		refill = (maxInt(0, (e.PhantomTimer&0xF)-e.EscapeTarget) + 7) >> 3
	}
	e.Res53 = minInt(e.Res53+refill, 9)
}

// EscapeArmed is the party window's append gate (C2:238B):
// ($1429&F) > ($1428&F), docs/battle-menu.md §C.
func (e *Engine) EscapeArmed() bool {
	return (e.EscapeTarget & 0xF) > (e.PhantomTimer & 0xF)
}

// SelectEscape is the confirmed 0x56 (docs/battle-menu.md §C): $53 pays
// the cost 5, $1427 logs it, and FE:D729 (phase-1 tail) marks the
// commander's own record rec[7] |= 0x40. A fled ally keeps its turn slot
// and stays targetable; its action body skips at C2:6243. The battle
// does NOT end ($1B bit 3 is the generic act-end palette request, not an
// exit marker; t255e ran rounds 12 -> 0x14 past the escape).
func (e *Engine) SelectEscape() {
	e.Res53 = maxInt(0, e.Res53-5)
	e.LastCmdCost = 5
	if pi := e.ProtagonistIndex(); pi >= 0 && e.Allies[pi].Alive {
		e.Allies[pi].Fled = true
	}
	e.log(" party escaped")
}

// UnlockRolls is C2:C18B (the common tail's last step, after the
// battle-start check): the first unlock entry (FE:9E8E) whose persistent
// $F4DA bit is unset and whose FF-terminated id list contains one of this
// battle's enemies with id < 0x100 consumes one roll(1,100) per matching
// enemy until one succeeds, then marks the bit and stops. The entry
// marker byte must be 0 (entries 7-15 ship with nonzero markers and are
// skipped without a roll); entry ids >= 0x100 never match.
func (e *Engine) UnlockRolls() {
	bits := e.W.UnlockBits()
	for i := range e.D.BattleUnlocks {
		u := &e.D.BattleUnlocks[i]
		bit := 1 << uint(u.Index)
		if u.Marker != 0 || bits&bit != 0 {
			continue
		}
		hit := false
		for _, idV := range u.IDs {
			for _, en := range e.Enemies {
				eid := en.ID
				if eid != idV || eid >= 0x100 {
					continue
				}
				if e.R.Roll(1, 100) <= u.Threshold {
					bits |= bit
					e.W.SetUnlockBits(bits)
					hit = true
					break
				}
			}
			if hit {
				break
			}
		}
		if hit {
			break
		}
	}
}
```

`internal/game/battle/world.go`:

```go
package battle

// World is the smallest state surface the battle engine reads and writes
// (the game_state.gd fields battle.gd touches). The future
// internal/game/state package implements it; tests use a fake. Inventory
// stacking (FE:EBE4 cap 99) and HP storage stay on the provider.
type World interface {
	// ClockFrame is the play clock's frame ($F30D, 0-59); the battle RNG
	// seeds from it times 16 (FE:C5A8).
	ClockFrame() int
	GlobalLevel() int         // $F532
	SetGlobalLevel(v int)     // the victory rank rise (C2:DA84)
	RaceLevel(race int) int   // $F533[race]
	SetRaceLevel(race, v int) // the victory group bumps (C2:DB23)
	UnlockBits() int          // $F4DA (the AI unlock bits)
	SetUnlockBits(v int)
	PartyIDs() []int        // $F319's members, leader first
	PartyHP(allyID int) int // the HP the field hands the battle
	AddItem(itemID int)     // one spoils grant (stacked by the provider)
	ItemCount(itemID int) int
	Gold() int
	SetGold(v int)       // C0:395E: the engine caps at 30000
	ProtagonistRow() int // the character-select row (SELECT_ROWS lookup)
	WalkID() int         // $F322, -1 = never written
}

// SelectRows is game_state.gd's SELECT_ROWS: the ally id per select row.
var SelectRows = [8]int{0, 3, 5, 4, 2, 1, 6, 7}

// ProtagonistID maps the World's select row to its ally id.
func ProtagonistID(w World) int {
	return SelectRows[clampIndex(w.ProtagonistRow(), 0, len(SelectRows)-1)]
}

func clampIndex(v, lo, hi int) int {
	if v < lo {
		return lo
	}
	if v > hi {
		return hi
	}
	return v
}
```

```go
package battle

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"testing"
)

// repoRoot walks up from this file to the go.mod.
func repoRoot() (string, error) {
	_, thisFile, _, ok := runtime.Caller(0)
	if !ok {
		return "", os.ErrInvalid
	}
	dir := filepath.Dir(thisFile)
	for i := 0; i < 6; i++ {
		if _, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(dir, "go.mod")); err == nil {
			return dir, nil
		}
		dir = filepath.Dir(dir)
	}
	return "", os.ErrNotExist
}

var (
	loadOnce sync.Once
	loadData *Data
	loadRom  []byte
	loadErr  error
)

// loadFixtures reads exports/data in place and the ROM dump once per test
// binary. The battle RNG table itself goes through rng.NewBattle at the
// call sites that need the traced generator.
func loadFixtures(t *testing.T) (*Data, []byte) {
	t.Helper()
	loadOnce.Do(func() {
		root, err := repoRoot()
		if err != nil {
			loadErr = err
			return
		}
		loadData, loadErr = LoadData(filepath.Join(root, "exports", "data"))
		if loadErr != nil {
			return
		}
		loadRom, loadErr = os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, "patches", "bokuno_jp.sfc"))
	})
	if loadErr != nil {
		t.Fatalf("load fixtures: %v", loadErr)
	}
	return loadData, loadRom
}
```

`internal/game/field/checks.go`:

```go
package field

// The walk gate (C0:57FF), object collision (C0:7731/7892) and the bump
// latch (C0:7797-780D), ported from godot/action_runner.gd (which matched
// the engine trails byte for byte; docs/action-scripts.md has the per-op
// evidence and docs/map-format.md the F9:A400 class-table rows).

// stamp is a shape's place in an occupancy bitmap: bitmap byte offset,
// bit shift, the mask rows, and the plane it lives on.
type stamp struct {
	off   int
	shift uint
	rows  []byte
	plane int
}

// planeIndex maps the object's plane bits to its occupancy bitmap (0x80
// objects live on the second plane).
func planeIndex(p int) int {
	if p == 0x80 {
		return 1
	}
	return 0
}

// shapeAt is C0:79DC: bitmap byte offset and bit shift of a shape placed
// at pixel (x, y), wrapped at the map's pixel size.
func (f *Field) shapeAt(h Hitbox, x, y int) *stamp {
	px := wrapPos(x+h.XOff, f.WrapX)
	py := wrapPos(y+h.YOff, f.WrapY)
	rows := append([]byte(nil), h.Rows...)
	return &stamp{
		off:   (py>>3)*f.bmStride + (px >> 5),
		shift: uint((px >> 2) & 7),
		rows:  rows,
	}
}

// apply stamps or unstamps a shape on a plane's bitmap.
func (f *Field) apply(st *stamp, plane int, on bool) {
	bm := f.Planes[plane]
	off := st.off
	for _, b := range st.rows {
		i := off
		w := (int(b) << st.shift) & 0xFFFF
		if i+1 < len(bm) {
			if on {
				bm[i] |= byte(w & 0xFF)
				bm[i+1] |= byte(w >> 8)
			} else {
				bm[i] &= ^byte(w & 0xFF)
				bm[i+1] &= ^byte(w >> 8)
			}
		}
		off += f.bmStride
	}
}

// hits tests a shape against a bitmap.
func (f *Field) hits(st *stamp, plane int) bool {
	bm := f.Planes[plane]
	off := st.off
	for _, b := range st.rows {
		i := off
		w := (int(b) << st.shift) & 0xFFFF
		if i+1 < len(bm) && (int(bm[i])|(int(bm[i+1])<<8))&w != 0 {
			return true
		}
		off += f.bmStride
	}
	return false
}

// stampObject records and stamps o's shape on its plane.
func (f *Field) stampObject(o *Object, st *stamp, plane int) {
	o.Stamp = st
	st.plane = plane
	f.apply(st, plane, true)
}

// classAt returns the class-table row of tile (tx, ty): the four bytes
// $D8FC-$D8FF read through F9:A400 (attr_class.bin). The grid must be
// loaded; a caller without one builds the Field from a spec that carries
// attr/low only when the map has a gate.
func (f *Field) classAt(tx, ty int) [4]int {
	c := int(f.Attr[ty][tx]) * 4
	return [4]int{int(f.Classes[c]), int(f.Classes[c+1]), int(f.Classes[c+2]), int(f.Classes[c+3])}
}

// planeBits is C0:54B0: plane bits from a tile class (0x40 and 0x80 swap,
// 0xC0 -> 0).
func planeBits(fc int) int {
	p := fc & 0xC0
	if p == 0 {
		return 0
	}
	return p ^ 0xC0
}

// gateClass is C0:57FF: the class row of the target pixel (tx, ty), ok =
// false when the gate blocks. The $D0DD (open map) and $D991 branches are
// not modeled (the trails do not reach them).
func (f *Field) gateClass(o *Object, tx, ty int) ([4]int, bool) {
	if tx < 0 || ty < 0 { // C0:5835: the tile word's high byte reads 1F
		return [4]int{}, false
	}
	cx := tx >> 3
	cy := ty >> 3
	if cx < f.Bounds[0] || cx >= f.Bounds[2] || cy < f.Bounds[1] || cy >= f.Bounds[3] {
		return [4]int{}, false
	}
	cx = wrapPos(cx, f.WrapX>>3)
	cy = wrapPos(cy, f.WrapY>>3)
	cls := f.classAt(cx, cy)
	fc := cls[0]
	fe := cls[2]
	if fe&0x88 == 0x08 || (fe&0x80 == 0 && fe&0x02 != 0) { // C0:5881
		return [4]int{}, false
	}
	if f.Low[cy][cx]&0x08 != 0 { // C0:58CC
		return [4]int{}, false
	}
	flags := o.GateFlags | o.Plane
	if flags&0x30 == 0x10 { // C0:58F7
		if fc&0x10 != 0 {
			return [4]int{}, false
		}
	} else if fc&0xC0 == 0xC0 || flags&0xF0&fc != 0 { // C0:5906-591C
		return [4]int{}, false
	}
	if fc&(8>>(o.MDir&3)) != 0 { // C0:5922: the entered side
		return [4]int{}, false
	}
	return cls, true
}

// checks is C0:5C91 / C0:57FF / C0:7731 for the tile ahead: prox = the
// proximity jump, block = the gate or another shape, empty = the step
// passes (and the shape moves). Runs the bump latch on a leader-shape
// block (C0:7797-780D).
func (f *Field) checks(slot int, o *Object) checkResult {
	if f.inProximity(o) {
		return checkProx
	}
	offX, offY := f.Tables.WalkOffset(o.MDir)
	tx := o.X + offX
	ty := o.Y + offY
	cls, ok := f.gateClass(o, tx, ty)
	f.LastBlockGate = !ok
	if !ok {
		return checkBlock
	}
	// C0:7892: the target's class picks the plane unless $D8FD bit 7
	// keeps the object's own.
	keep := cls[1]&0x80 != 0
	var testPlane int
	if keep {
		testPlane = planeIndex(o.Plane)
	} else if cls[0]&0xC0 == 0x40 {
		testPlane = 1
	}
	f.apply(o.Stamp, planeIndex(o.Plane), false) // C0:7956
	st := f.shapeAt(o.hitbox(o.Dir&3), tx, ty)
	if f.hits(st, testPlane) {
		f.apply(o.Stamp, planeIndex(o.Plane), true) // C0:7797 restamps the old spot
		// C0:77A4: a block on the leader's stamp, on a shared plane, is a
		// bump. The leader is slot 0 (live) or the frozen leader stamp.
		var ls *stamp
		lplane := -1
		if ls = f.LeaderStamp; ls != nil {
			lplane = ls.plane
		}
		if l0, has0 := f.slot(0); !f.LeaderFrozen && has0 && l0.Stamp != nil && slot != 0 {
			ls = l0.Stamp
			lplane = ls.plane
		}
		if ls != nil && lplane == testPlane {
			saved := f.Planes[0]
			lone := make([]byte, len(saved))
			f.Planes[0] = lone
			f.apply(ls, 0, true)
			onLeader := f.hits(st, 0)
			f.Planes[0] = saved
			if onLeader && !f.bumpedHas(slot) {
				f.Bumped = append(f.Bumped, slot)
				if o.GateFlags&3 == 1 && f.Latch == 0 { // C0:77EF-780D
					f.LatchDir = o.Dir
					f.Latch = slot >> 6
				}
			}
		}
		return checkBlock
	}
	f.stampObject(o, st, testPlane)
	if !keep {
		o.Plane = planeBits(cls[0]) // C0:54A8
	}
	f.footprint(o)
	o.D6, o.D7, o.D8 = cls[1], cls[2], cls[3] // C0:5485
	return checkPass
}

type checkResult int

const (
	checkPass checkResult = iota
	checkBlock
	checkProx
)

func (f *Field) bumpedHas(slot int) bool {
	for _, s := range f.Bumped {
		if s == slot {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func (o *Object) hitbox(d int) Hitbox {
	return o.Hitboxes[d&3]
}

// inProximity is C0:5C91: the leader inside the box of (c7 & 7F) tiles
// around the object (c7 bit 7: outside it) takes the proximity jump.
func (f *Field) inProximity(o *Object) bool {
	if o.C7 == 0 {
		return false
	}
	lx, ly := f.leaderPos()
	var inside bool
	if f.OpenMap {
		// C0:5BFD: per axis the tile distance, strictly below the range;
		// x wraps past half the map, y never wraps (C0:5C51 compares
		// 16-bit against $D0C3 = height | width<<8).
		rt := o.C7 & 0x7F
		inside = openDist(lx-o.X, f.WrapX>>3) < rt && absInt(ly-o.Y)>>3 < rt
	} else {
		r := (o.C7 & 0x7F) * 8
		inside = o.X+r >= lx && lx+1+r >= o.X && o.Y+r >= ly && ly+1+r >= o.Y
	}
	return inside != (o.C7&0x80 != 0)
}

// openDist is C0:5C02-5C42: |d| in tiles; at or past half the map
// (|d| / 4 >= tiles) the way round instead.
func openDist(d, tiles int) int {
	a := absInt(d) >> 2
	if a < tiles {
		return a >> 1
	}
	return tiles - (a >> 1)
}

func absInt(v int) int {
	if v < 0 {
		return -v
	}
	return v
}

// leader5585 is C0:5585 on slot 0 (the leader's wait end or tile end): a
// new tile with low-buffer bit 3 (an event rect, C0:55E8-5609) leaves the
// latch for a later call; otherwise C0:5635 dispatches it. The $D991
// branch and the $D99A bit 3 skip are not modeled.
func (f *Field) leader5585(o *Object) {
	t := pos2Tile(o.X, o.Y, f.WrapX, f.WrapY)
	if t != f.LeaderTile {
		f.LeaderTile = t
		if f.Low[t.Y][t.X]&8 != 0 {
			return
		}
	}
	if f.Latch == 0 {
		return
	}
	if f.Latch == LatchDispatched {
		f.Latch = 0
		return
	}
	if o, ok := f.slot(f.Latch * slotStride); ok {
		o.Dir = f.LatchDir // C0:5651
		f.Dispatched = append(f.Dispatched, f.Latch*slotStride)
	}
	f.Latch = LatchDispatched
}

// LatchDispatched marks a consumed latch until the next C0:5585 clears it
// ($D6B6 = $FF after a dispatch).
const LatchDispatched = 0xFF

// pos2Tile converts live pixels to the wrapped tile.
func pos2Tile(x, y, wrapX, wrapY int) Tile {
	return Tile{X: wrapPos(x, wrapX) >> 3, Y: wrapPos(y, wrapY) >> 3}
}

// Tile is one map tile coordinate.
type Tile struct{ X, Y int }

// footprint is C0:5413-544B -> 7C75: a passed step leaves a footprint on
// the tile the object stands on when that tile's class has byte 3 bit 1
// and not byte 2 bit 5, unless $D9B2 bits 4-5 are 0x10: the first time
// (low-buffer bit 1, set here) the footprint layer's word gains facing+1.
func (f *Field) footprint(o *Object) {
	if o.D7&0x20 != 0 || o.D8&0x02 == 0 || (o.GateFlags|o.Plane)&0x30 == 0x10 {
		return
	}
	t := pos2Tile(o.X, o.Y, f.WrapX, f.WrapY)
	b := f.Low[t.Y][t.X]
	if b&3 != 3 {
		if b&2 != 0 {
			return
		}
		f.Low[t.Y][t.X] = b | 2
	}
	f.Footprints = append(f.Footprints, Footprint{X: t.X, Y: t.Y, Delta: (o.Dir & 3) + 1})
}

// Footprint is one step's tile stamp: the word delta is facing+1.
type Footprint struct {
	X, Y  int
	Delta int
}

```

`internal/game/field/data.go`:

```go
package field

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"saga3/internal/mapfmt"
	"saga3/internal/triggers"
)

// Loaders for the engine-neutral exports/data exports, read in place
// (docs/migration.md: no copies). All return errors; nothing falls back.
// The FromBytes cores are the parsers; the path variants are thin
// wrappers for shell callers.

// LoadMapSpec reads one map.json gate block.
func LoadMapSpec(path string) (MapSpec, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return MapSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("load map: %w", err)
	}
	return LoadMapSpecFromBytes(b)
}

// LoadMapSpecFromBytes parses one map.json gate block.
func LoadMapSpecFromBytes(b []byte) (MapSpec, error) {
	var raw struct {
		Width  int     `json:"width"`
		Height int     `json:"height"`
		Attr   [][]int `json:"attr"`
		Low    [][]int `json:"low"`
		Bounds [4]int  `json:"bounds"`
		Open   bool    `json:"open"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &raw); err != nil {
		return MapSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("parse map.json: %w", err)
	}
	spec := MapSpec{
		Width: raw.Width, Height: raw.Height, Attr: raw.Attr, Low: raw.Low,
		Bounds: raw.Bounds, Open: raw.Open,
	}
	if spec.Width == 0 || spec.Height == 0 {
		return MapSpec{}, fmt.Errorf("map.json: bad size %dx%d", spec.Width, spec.Height)
	}
	return spec, nil
}

// MapExtras is the map-level data the field wiring needs beyond the gate.
type MapExtras struct {
	Slope    [2]int // [1, slope] when slope >= 0, [0, 0] otherwise (C0:7E7A)
	Edges    [4]int
	EdgesOn  bool
	Base     int // encounter_party_base ($D2FE)
	NPCs     []NpcRecord
	Walkable [][]int // the full-map walk grid (map-format.md: tile resolution)
}

// LoadMapExtras reads the rest of one map.json for the field wiring.
func LoadMapExtras(path string) (MapExtras, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return MapExtras{}, fmt.Errorf("load map extras: %w", err)
	}
	return LoadMapExtrasFromBytes(b)
}

// LoadMapExtrasFromBytes parses the map-level wiring fields.
func LoadMapExtrasFromBytes(b []byte) (MapExtras, error) {
	var raw struct {
		Slope    int       `json:"slope"`
		Edges    [4]int    `json:"edge_events"`
		Base     int       `json:"encounter_party_base"`
		Walkable [][]int   `json:"walkable"`
		NPCs     []NpcJSON `json:"npcs"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &raw); err != nil {
		return MapExtras{}, fmt.Errorf("parse map.json: %w", err)
	}
	ex := MapExtras{Slope: [2]int{0, 0}, Edges: raw.Edges, Base: raw.Base, Walkable: raw.Walkable}
	if raw.Slope >= 0 {
		ex.Slope = [2]int{1, raw.Slope}
	}
	for _, w := range raw.Edges {
		if w != 0 {
			ex.EdgesOn = true
			break
		}
	}
	for _, n := range raw.NPCs {
		rec, err := n.record()
		if err != nil {
			return MapExtras{}, err
		}
		ex.NPCs = append(ex.NPCs, rec)
	}
	return ex, nil
}

// NpcJSON is map.json's NPC entry shape.
type NpcJSON struct {
	X         int          `json:"x"`
	Y         int          `json:"y"`
	Event     string       `json:"event"`
	Graphic   int          `json:"graphic"`
	Index     int          `json:"index"`
	Facing    int          `json:"facing"`
	Speed     int          `json:"speed"`
	Script    int          `json:"script"`
	Judged    bool         `json:"judged"`
	PlaceID   int          `json:"place_id"`
	PlaceLo   int          `json:"place_lo"`
	GateFlags int          `json:"gate_flags"`
	Hitbox    []hitboxJSON `json:"hitbox"`
}

type hitboxJSON struct {
	XOff int     `json:"xoff"`
	YOff int     `json:"yoff"`
	Rows [][]int `json:"rows"`
}

// appearanceJSON is one FE:77BB pair: {leader, hensei}.
type appearanceJSON struct {
	Leader int `json:"leader"`
	Hensei int `json:"hensei"`
}

func (h hitboxJSON) hitbox() (Hitbox, error) {
	if len(h.Rows) == 0 {
		return Hitbox{}, fmt.Errorf("hitbox with no rows")
	}
	hb := Hitbox{XOff: h.XOff, YOff: h.YOff}
	for _, row := range h.Rows {
		if len(row) != 1 {
			return Hitbox{}, fmt.Errorf("hitbox row with %d bytes, want 1", len(row))
		}
		hb.Rows = append(hb.Rows, byte(row[0]))
	}
	return hb, nil
}

func (n NpcJSON) record() (NpcRecord, error) {
	rec := NpcRecord{
		Index: n.Index, X: n.X, Y: n.Y, Facing: n.Facing, Event: n.Event,
		Graphic: n.Graphic, Speed: n.Speed, Script: n.Script,
		Judged: n.Judged, PlaceID: n.PlaceID, PlaceLo: n.PlaceLo,
		GateFlags: n.GateFlags,
	}
	if len(n.Hitbox) != 4 {
		return NpcRecord{}, fmt.Errorf("npc %s: %d hitboxes, want 4 (one per facing)", n.Event, len(n.Hitbox))
	}
	for i, h := range n.Hitbox {
		hb, err := h.hitbox()
		if err != nil {
			return NpcRecord{}, fmt.Errorf("npc %s: %w", n.Event, err)
		}
		rec.Hitboxes[i] = hb
	}
	return rec, nil
}

// LoadFormations reads data/enemy_formations.json.
func LoadFormations(path string) (*FormationTables, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load formations: %w", err)
	}
	return LoadFormationsFromBytes(b)
}

// LoadFormationsFromBytes parses the exported formation tables.
func LoadFormationsFromBytes(b []byte) (*FormationTables, error) {
	var raw struct {
		Appearance     [][]appearanceJSON `json:"appearance"`
		CompanionBonus int                `json:"companion_bonus"`
		Companions     [][][2]int         `json:"companions"`
		Hensei         []struct {
			Count     int `json:"count"`
			HeightMax int `json:"height_max"`
			WidthMax  int `json:"width_max"`
		} `json:"hensei"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &raw); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse enemy_formations.json: %w", err)
	}
	if len(raw.Appearance) != 16 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("enemy_formations.json: %d races, want 16", len(raw.Appearance))
	}
	// The companion list carries patterns 0-E; F is the multi-leader
	// variant and composes no companions (C2:1461), so the export omits
	// it (15 patterns).
	if len(raw.Companions) != 15 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("enemy_formations.json: %d companion patterns, want 15", len(raw.Companions))
	}
	ef := &FormationTables{CompanionBonus: raw.CompanionBonus}
	for race, bands := range raw.Appearance {
		if len(bands) != 16 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("enemy_formations.json: race %d has %d bands, want 16", race, len(bands))
		}
		for band, pair := range bands {
			ef.Appearance[race][band] = AppearancePair(pair)
		}
	}
	for _, h := range raw.Hensei {
		ef.Hensei = append(ef.Hensei, Hensei{Count: h.Count, WidthMax: h.WidthMax, HeightMax: h.HeightMax})
	}
	for pattern, comps := range raw.Companions {
		for _, c := range comps {
			ef.Companions[pattern] = append(ef.Companions[pattern], CompanionEntry{Level: c[0], ID: c[1]})
		}
	}
	return ef, nil
}

// LoadEnemyFit reads data/enemies.json into the fit table (enemy id ->
// formation cell size).
func LoadEnemyFit(path string) (map[int]EnemyFit, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load enemies: %w", err)
	}
	return LoadEnemyFitFromBytes(b)
}

// LoadEnemyFitFromBytes parses the exported enemy records.
func LoadEnemyFitFromBytes(b []byte) (map[int]EnemyFit, error) {
	var rows []struct {
		ID        string `json:"id"`
		FitWidth  int    `json:"fit_width"`
		FitHeight int    `json:"fit_height"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &rows); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse enemies.json: %w", err)
	}
	m := map[int]EnemyFit{}
	for _, r := range rows {
		v := 0
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(r.ID, "%x", &v); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("enemy id %q: %w", r.ID, err)
		}
		m[v] = EnemyFit{Width: r.FitWidth, Height: r.FitHeight}
	}
	return m, nil
}

// LoadLevels reads data/levels.json.
func LoadLevels(path string) (*LevelsTable, error) {

	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load levels: %w", err)

// LoadLevelsFromBytes parses the exported bump tables.
func LoadLevelsFromBytes(b []byte) (*LevelsTable, error) {
	var raw struct {
		Curves    [][]int `json:"curves"`
		GlobalCap int     `json:"global_cap"`
		GroupCap  int     `json:"group_cap"`
		GroupRows [][]int `json:"group_rows"`
		RankRise  []int   `json:"rank_rise"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &raw); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse levels.json: %w", err)
	}
	t := &LevelsTable{GlobalCap: raw.GlobalCap, GroupCap: raw.GroupCap}
	if len(raw.RankRise) != 8 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("levels.json: rank_rise has %d entries, want 8", len(raw.RankRise))
	}
	if len(raw.Curves) != 8 || len(raw.GroupRows) != 17 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("levels.json: %d curves / %d group rows, want 8 / 17", len(raw.Curves), len(raw.GroupRows))
	}
	for i, v := range raw.RankRise {
		t.RankRise[i] = byte(v)
	}
	for i, row := range raw.Curves {
		if len(row) != 8 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("levels.json: curve %d has %d entries, want 8", i, len(row))
		}
		for j, v := range row {
			t.Curves[i][j] = byte(v)
		}
	}
	for i, row := range raw.GroupRows {
		if len(row) != 16 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("levels.json: group row %d has %d entries, want 16", i, len(row))
		}
		for j, v := range row {
			t.GroupRows[i][j] = byte(v)
		}
	}
	return t, nil
}
```
