`internal/game/flow/actors_test.go`:

```go
package flow

import (
	"compress/gzip"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"

	"saga3/internal/game/field"
	"saga3/internal/game/vm"
)

// The objOp 2E event-actor pins. The spawn path is the VM's `17 2e` case
// -> GameState.SpawnActor -> Game.spawnActor -> the field's object table;
// the trail golden drives it with exports/tests/trails/0250a.trail.gz (the
// one capture with an ACTOR line: slot 2C0, graphic 5B, tile 20,52 at
// pass 16, installed script 00A2 at pass 22, then the chase) and asserts
// the actor's positions per pass.

// vmActorEvent is a two-op synthetic event holding the catalog's only
// `17 2e` (event 0019, FA:0c7c) so the pin runs the landed VM dispatch.
func vmActorEvent() []vm.Op {
	return []vm.Op{
		{Kind: "cmd", Addr: "FA:0000", Hex: "17 2e", Note: "objOp"},
		{Kind: "cmd", Addr: "FA:0002", Hex: "2e", Note: "endMes"},
	}
}

// findSnap returns the snapshot for a slot.
func findSnap(snap []ObjectSnap, slot int) (ObjectSnap, bool) {
	for _, ob := range snap {
		if ob.Slot == slot {
			return ob, true
		}
	}
	return ObjectSnap{}, false
}

// TestObjOp2EViaVM runs `17 2e` through the landed VM op case: the actor
// joins the live object table at the first free slot with the tile,
// figure and pose facing the EF cells name, and FieldObjects reports it.
func TestObjOp2EViaVM(t *testing.T) {
	g, _ := newGame(t)
	// 0049: one placed NPC (slot 0x40), the leader boots out of reach.
	if err := g.EnterField("0049", 24, 60); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if g.State.Spawner == nil {
		t.Fatal("a map load left State.Spawner unset")
	}
	v := vm.New(g.a.Catalog)
	v.State = g.State
	// the 0250a capture's ACTOR values: EF00=graphic 5B, EF01/EF02=tile
	// (20,52), EF03 pose 0
	g.State.SetVar(0, 0x5B)
	g.State.SetVar(1, 20)
	g.State.SetVar(2, 52)
	g.State.SetVar(3, 0)
	v.LoadEvent(vmActorEvent(), 0)
	v.NextPage()
	if !v.IsFinished() {
		t.Fatal("the synthetic event did not finish")
	}
	// the actor takes the first free slot: after 0049's six placed
	// records, that is (6+1)*0x40 (the placed slots keep the (index+1)
	// stride across the table)
	actorSlot := field.SlotNumber(len(g.field.md.NPCs))
	ob, ok := findSnap(g.FieldObjects(), actorSlot)
	if !ok {
		t.Fatalf("no actor snapshot at slot %X: %+v", actorSlot, g.FieldObjects())
	}
	if ob.Leader || ob.X != 20*8 || ob.Y != 52*8 || ob.Dir != 4 || ob.Graphic != 0x5B || ob.Tag != 0x80 || ob.Inert {
		t.Fatalf("actor snapshot wrong: %+v", ob)
	}
	// FindObject resolves the actor through its 0x81 id (C0:E994)
	if slot := g.field.f.FindObject(0x81, -1); slot != actorSlot {
		t.Fatalf("FindObject(81) = %X, want the actor's %X", slot, actorSlot)
	}
}

// ---- the 0250a replay (the ACTOR grammar's one capture) ----------------

type actTrailLine struct {
	slot                 int
	scr, pos, t7, t8, op int
	x, y, dir, spd       int
	c4                   int
	c6                   byte
	c7, c8, mdir         int
	tag                  int
	hasTag, b2           bool
	plane                int
}

type actTrailPass struct {
	window     bool
	rngA, rngB int
}

type actTrailInstall struct{ pass, tag, id int }

type actTrailActor struct {
	pass, slot, gfx int
	x, y, ef3       int
}

type actTrail struct {
	passes   map[int]actTrailPass
	lines    map[int]map[int]actTrailLine
	installs []actTrailInstall
	actor    actTrailActor
	hasActor bool
}

var (
	reActPASS = regexp.MustCompile(`^PASS (\d+) frame=\d+ w76=(\w+) rnga=(\w+) rngb=(\w+)$`)
	reActTR   = regexp.MustCompile(`^TR f=(\d+) y=(\w+) scr=(\w+) pos=(\w+) t7=(\w+) t8=(\w+) op=(\w+) x=(\w+) yy=(\w+) dir=(\w+) bb=(\w+) c3=\w+ c4=(\w+) c6=(\w+) d99a=\w+ c7=(\w+) c8=(\w+) ba=(\w+)(?: tag=(\w+))?(?: b2=(\w+))?(?: \w+=\w+)*$`)
	reActINS  = regexp.MustCompile(`^INSTALL pass=(\d+) tag=(\w+) id=(\w+)`)
	reActACT  = regexp.MustCompile(`^ACTOR pass=(\d+) slot=(\w+) gfx=(\w+) x=(\d+) y=(\d+) ef3=(\w+)`)
)

func actHx(s string) int {
	v, err := strconv.ParseInt(s, 16, 64)
	if err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("hex %q: %v", s, err))
	}
	return int(v)
}

func actDec(s string) int {
	v, err := strconv.Atoi(s)
	if err != nil {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("decimal %q: %v", s, err))
	}
	return v
}

func parseActorTrail(t *testing.T, name string) *actTrail {
	t.Helper()
	f, err := os.Open("../../../exports/tests/trails/" + name + ".trail.gz")
	if err != nil {
		t.Skipf("trail %s not available: %v", name, err)
	}
	defer f.Close()
	gz, err := gzip.NewReader(f)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(gz)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	d := &actTrail{passes: map[int]actTrailPass{}, lines: map[int]map[int]actTrailLine{}}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(raw), "\n") {
		if m := reActPASS.FindStringSubmatch(line); m != nil {
			d.passes[actDec(m[1])] = actTrailPass{window: actHx(m[2]) != 0, rngA: actHx(m[3]), rngB: actHx(m[4])}
			continue
		}
		if m := reActTR.FindStringSubmatch(line); m != nil {
			p := actDec(m[1])
			l := actTrailLine{
				slot: actHx(m[2]),
				scr:  actHx(m[3]), pos: actHx(m[4]), t7: actHx(m[5]), t8: actHx(m[6]), op: actHx(m[7]),
				x: actHx(m[8]), y: actHx(m[9]), dir: actHx(m[10]), spd: actHx(m[11]),
				c4: actHx(m[12]), c6: byte(actHx(m[13])), c7: actHx(m[14]), c8: actHx(m[15]), mdir: actHx(m[16]),
			}
			if m[17] != "" {
				l.tag = actHx(m[17])
				l.hasTag = true
			}
			if m[18] != "" {
				l.b2 = true
				l.plane = actHx(m[18]) & 0xC0
			}
			if d.lines[p] == nil {
				d.lines[p] = map[int]actTrailLine{}
			}
			d.lines[p][l.slot] = l
			continue
		}
		if m := reActINS.FindStringSubmatch(line); m != nil {
			d.installs = append(d.installs, actTrailInstall{pass: actDec(m[1]), tag: actHx(m[2]), id: actHx(m[3])})
			continue
		}
		if m := reActACT.FindStringSubmatch(line); m != nil {
			d.actor = actTrailActor{pass: actDec(m[1]), slot: actHx(m[2]), gfx: actHx(m[3]), x: actDec(m[4]), y: actDec(m[5]), ef3: actHx(m[6])}
			d.hasActor = true
		}
	}
	return d
}

// actResync loads the interpreter half of one object from the engine
// sample (the replay division: positions, motion and stamps stay the
// model's; script cursor, op, waits, motion counters and the plane come
// from the engine's record of the pass's start).
func actResync(o *field.Object, l actTrailLine) {
	o.Scr = l.scr
	o.Pos = l.pos
	o.T7 = l.t7
	o.T8 = l.t8
	o.Op = byte(l.op)
	o.Dir = l.dir
	o.Spd = l.spd & 0x0F
	o.C4 = l.c4
	o.C7 = l.c7
	o.C8 = l.c8
	o.MDir = l.mdir
	o.Tag = l.tag
	if l.b2 {
		o.Plane = l.plane
	}
}

// TestEventActorSpawnTrail replays the 0250a capture through the flow's
// frame: the object pass runs on the live field with the party step and
// the flow wiring (tickField), the ACTOR line at pass 16 spawns through
// State.Spawner (the VM's call), the INSTALL at pass 22 installs through
// the field's live face, and every sampled slot's position must match
// the engine's next sample. The actor's first sample is checked WITHOUT
// the resync: the spawn copy must reproduce the engine's full record.
func TestEventActorSpawnTrail(t *testing.T) {
	d := parseActorTrail(t, "0250a")
	if !d.hasActor {
		t.Fatal("trail 0250a parsed without its ACTOR line")
	}
	g, _ := newGame(t)
	// the capture's leader stands at tile (12,58) for all 158 passes
	if err := g.EnterField("0250", 12, 58); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	f := g.field.f
	// the replay spawns every slot from the trail's first samples; wipe
	// the map.json pre-spawn's stamps so only trail positions occupy the
	// bitmaps (the field suite's replay builds a fresh field), then
	// restamp the leader as switchMap left it
	for i := range f.Planes {
		clear(f.Planes[i])
	}
	hb := field.LeaderHitbox()
	boxes := [4]field.Hitbox{hb, hb, hb, hb}
	f.SetObject(0, boxes, 0, -1, 0, nil)

	nums := make([]int, 0, len(d.passes))
	for n := range d.passes {
		nums = append(nums, n)
	}
	sort.Ints(nums)
	first := d.passes[nums[0]]
	g.State.FieldRNG.A = uint8(first.rngA)
	g.State.FieldRNG.B = uint8(first.rngB)

	spawned := map[int]bool{0: true, d.actor.slot: true} // the leader is live; the actor comes from the spawn
	installsAt := map[int][]actTrailInstall{}
	for _, ins := range d.installs {
		installsAt[ins.pass] = append(installsAt[ins.pass], ins)
	}
	spawnDone := false

	for _, p := range nums[:len(nums)-1] {
		next := p + 1
		if _, ok := d.passes[next]; !ok || d.lines[next] == nil {
			break
		}
		cur := d.lines[p]

		// first-sample spawns, then the interpreter-half resync of every
		// sampled slot
		slots := make([]int, 0, len(cur))
		for s := range cur {
			slots = append(slots, s)
		}
		sort.Ints(slots)
		for _, s := range slots {
			if spawned[s] {
				continue
			}
			l := cur[s]
			o := f.Spawn(s, [8]int{l.scr, l.pos, l.t7, l.t8, l.op, l.x, l.y, l.dir})
			f.SetExtras(s, l.spd&0x0F, l.c4, l.c6, l.c7, l.c8)
			o.MDir = l.mdir
			rec := g.field.md.NPCs[l.tag]
			plane := -1
			if l.b2 {
				plane = l.plane
			}
			f.SetObject(s, rec.Hitboxes, rec.GateFlags, plane, 0, nil)
			o.Tag = l.tag
			spawned[s] = true
		}
		for _, s := range slots {
			if o := f.Objects[s]; o != nil {
				actResync(o, cur[s])
			}
		}

		// the actor spawn: after pass 16's frame the queue runs the
		// capture's `17 2e` — the copy sees the leader as pass 17 samples
		// it (the actions replay's rule), then State.SpawnActor fires the
		// flow handler exactly as the VM's op case does
		if d.actor.pass == p && !spawnDone {
			spawnDone = true
			if lead, ok := d.lines[next][0]; ok {
				actResync(f.Objects[0], lead)
			}
			g.State.SetVar(0, d.actor.gfx)
			g.State.SetVar(1, d.actor.x)
			g.State.SetVar(2, d.actor.y)
			g.State.SetVar(3, d.actor.ef3)
			g.State.SpawnActor()
			ob, ok := findSnap(g.FieldObjects(), d.actor.slot)
			if !ok {
				t.Fatalf("pass %d: the spawned actor is not in FieldObjects at slot %03X: %+v",
					p, d.actor.slot, g.FieldObjects())
			}
			if ob.X != d.actor.x*8 || ob.Y != d.actor.y*8 || ob.Dir != 4 || ob.Graphic != d.actor.gfx || ob.Tag != 0x80 {
				t.Fatalf("pass %d: actor snapshot %+v, want tile (%d,%d) graphic %X pose facing 4",
					p, ob, d.actor.x, d.actor.y, d.actor.gfx)
			}
		}

		g.Tick()

		// installs run between passes (the queue drains at the next
		// frame's start): the field's live install face resolves the
		// event actor through its 0x81 id
		for _, ins := range installsAt[p] {
			slot := f.FindObject(ins.tag, -1)
			if slot <= 0 {
				t.Fatalf("pass %d: install tag %X resolved no slot", p, ins.tag)
			}
			f.Install(slot, ins.id, true)
		}

		// position asserts against the engine's next sample; the actor's
		// spawn pass additionally pins the whole copied record (the
		// engine's first sample is the spawn's output, before its first
		// step)
		for _, s := range slots {
			l2, ok := d.lines[next][s]
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			o := f.Objects[s]
			if o == nil {
				continue
			}
			if o.X != l2.x || o.Y != l2.y {
				t.Fatalf("pass %d slot %03X: got (%d,%d) want (%d,%d) op %02X",
					next, s, o.X, o.Y, l2.x, l2.y, l2.op)
			}
			if s == d.actor.slot && p == d.actor.pass {
				want := fmt.Sprintf("scr=%04X pos=%04X t7=%02X t8=%02X op=%02X x=%04X y=%04X dir=%02X spd=%02X c4=%02X c6=%02X c7=%02X c8=%02X ba=%02X tag=%02X plane=%02X",
					l2.scr, l2.pos, l2.t7, l2.t8, l2.op, l2.x, l2.y, l2.dir, l2.spd&0x0F, l2.c4, l2.c6, l2.c7, l2.c8, l2.mdir, l2.tag, l2.plane)
				got := fmt.Sprintf("scr=%04X pos=%04X t7=%02X t8=%02X op=%02X x=%04X y=%04X dir=%02X spd=%02X c4=%02X c6=%02X c7=%02X c8=%02X ba=%02X tag=%02X plane=%02X",
					o.Scr, o.Pos, o.T7, o.T8, o.Op, o.X, o.Y, o.Dir, o.Spd, o.C4, o.C6, o.C7, o.C8, o.MDir, o.Tag, o.Plane)
				if got != want {
					t.Fatalf("pass %d: the spawn copy diverges from the engine's first sample\n got %s\nwant %s", next, got, want)
				}
				continue // the copy IS the pin; no resync on the spawn pass
			}
			actResync(o, l2)
		}

		// RNG continuity is informational (the field suite's rule: the
		// event VM rolls the shared stream outside the object loop)
		want := d.passes[next]
		if a, b := g.State.FieldRNG.A, g.State.FieldRNG.B; uint8(want.rngA) != a || uint8(want.rngB) != b {
			t.Logf("rng diverges in pass %d: flow %02X/%d, engine %02X/%d", p, a, b, want.rngA, want.rngB)
		}
	}

	// the actor survived the whole capture on its recorded slot
	if _, ok := findSnap(g.FieldObjects(), d.actor.slot); !ok {
		t.Fatalf("the actor left slot %03X by the capture's end", d.actor.slot)
	}
}
```

```go
package flow

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"

	"saga3/internal/game/battle"
	"saga3/internal/game/field"
	"saga3/internal/game/state"
	"saga3/internal/game/vm"
)

// Assets holds the engine-neutral exports the flow reads in place
// (docs/migration.md: no copies). Construct once with LoadAssets; maps
// load lazily per switch (mapView's per-load shape).
type Assets struct {
	DataDir string

	Catalog    *vm.FileCatalog
	Allies     map[int]state.AllySeed
	Formations *field.FormationTables
	Fit        map[int]field.EnemyFit
	FieldTable *field.Tables
	Classes    []byte
	BankF8     []byte
	BattleRNG  []byte // the battle RNG table D7:E63C (battle_rng.bin)
	BattleData *battle.Data
	// Hitboxes is the per-graphic collision shape table
	// (data/graphic_hitboxes.json, four facings per graphic); objOp 2E's
	// event actor takes its graphic's shape (map_view _hitbox_of).
	Hitboxes [][4]field.Hitbox

	// Trans is the loaded page-translation table (main.gd _translation);
	// nil is the Japanese default. Set after LoadAssets with
	// LoadTranslation — cmd/saga3's --lang owns the flag.
	Trans *Translation

	jumpTable []Destination
	itemNames map[int]string
	maps      map[string]*MapData
}

// the Assets maps are the vm's name tables (startEvent's v.Names).
var _ vm.NameResolver = (*Assets)(nil)

// LoadAssets reads every export the flow needs up front: the event
// catalog (scan-only, ops decode on demand), the ally seeds, the
// formation tables, the field tables and the F8 bank.
func LoadAssets(dataDir string) (*Assets, error) {
	cat, err := vm.LoadCatalog(filepath.Join(dataDir, "events.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load event catalog: %w", err)
	}
	allies, err := state.LoadAllySeeds(filepath.Join(dataDir, "allies.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load ally seeds: %w", err)
	}
	formations, err := field.LoadFormations(filepath.Join(dataDir, "enemy_formations.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load formations: %w", err)
	}
	fit, err := field.LoadEnemyFit(filepath.Join(dataDir, "enemies.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load enemy fit: %w", err)
	}
	tables, err := field.LoadTables(filepath.Join(dataDir, "field_tables.bin"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load field tables: %w", err)
	}
	classes, err := field.LoadClasses(filepath.Join(dataDir, "attr_class.bin"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load attr classes: %w", err)
	}
	bank, err := field.LoadBankF8(filepath.Join(dataDir, "bank_f8.bin"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load bank F8: %w", err)
	}
	brngTable, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(dataDir, "battle_rng.bin"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load battle rng table: %w", err)
	}
	bdata, err := battle.LoadData(dataDir)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load battle data: %w", err)
	}
	jt, err := loadJumpTable(filepath.Join(dataDir, "jump_table.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	hitboxes, err := loadHitboxes(filepath.Join(dataDir, "graphic_hitboxes.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	itemNames, err := loadItemNames(filepath.Join(dataDir, "items.json"))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &Assets{
		DataDir:    dataDir,
		Catalog:    cat,
		Allies:     allies,
		Formations: formations,
		Fit:        fit,
		FieldTable: tables,
		Classes:    classes,
		BankF8:     bank,
		BattleRNG:  brngTable,
		BattleData: bdata,
		Hitboxes:   hitboxes,
		jumpTable:  jt,
		itemNames:  itemNames,
		maps:       map[string]*MapData{},
	}, nil
}

// loadItemNames reads the item catalog's id -> name table (the menus'
// 道具 rows and detail headers; field_menus.gd _load_item_details).
func loadItemNames(path string) (map[int]string, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load items: %w", err)
	}
	var rows []struct {
		ID   string `json:"id"`
		Name string `json:"name"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &rows); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	out := make(map[int]string, len(rows))
	for _, r := range rows {
		var v int
		if _, err := fmt.Sscanf(r.ID, "%x", &v); err != nil {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: item id %q: %w", path, r.ID, err)
		}
		out[v] = r.Name
	}
	return out, nil
}

// loadJumpTable parses data/jump_table.json (cmd/exportmap's dump of the
// global table 0x3CFB00; op 11 resolves through it). 256 entries, no gaps.
func loadJumpTable(path string) ([]Destination, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load jump table: %w", err)
	}
	var raw []struct {
		ToMap   string `json:"to_map"`
		ToX     int    `json:"to_x"`
		ToY     int    `json:"to_y"`
		Stay    bool   `json:"stay"`
		Arrival *int   `json:"arrival"`
		NoFade  bool   `json:"no_fade"`
		Music   *int   `json:"music"`
		Facing  int    `json:"facing"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &raw); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	if len(raw) != 256 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: %d entries, want 256", path, len(raw))
	}
	out := make([]Destination, len(raw))
	for i, r := range raw {
		out[i] = Destination{
			ToMap: r.ToMap, ToX: r.ToX, ToY: r.ToY, Stay: r.Stay,
			Arrival: intField(r.Arrival, 0), NoFade: r.NoFade,
			Music: intField(r.Music, -1), Facing: r.Facing,
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func intField(p *int, def int) int {
	if p == nil {
		return def
	}
	return *p
}

// loadHitboxes parses data/graphic_hitboxes.json: one row per graphic,
// four facings each (the same shape map.json's per-NPC hitbox rows use).
func loadHitboxes(path string) ([][4]field.Hitbox, error) {
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load hitboxes: %w", err)
	}
	var rows [][4]struct {
		XOff int     `json:"xoff"`
		YOff int     `json:"yoff"`
		Rows [][]int `json:"rows"`
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &rows); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse %s: %w", path, err)
	}
	out := make([][4]field.Hitbox, len(rows))
	for g, row := range rows {
		for i, h := range row {
			if len(h.Rows) == 0 {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: graphic %d facing %d: hitbox with no rows", path, g, i)
			}
			hb := field.Hitbox{XOff: h.XOff, YOff: h.YOff}
			for _, r := range h.Rows {
				if len(r) != 1 {
					return nil, fmt.Errorf("%s: graphic %d facing %d: hitbox row with %d bytes, want 1", path, g, i, len(r))
				}
				hb.Rows = append(hb.Rows, byte(r[0]))
			}
			out[g][i] = hb
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

// Destination is one op-11/op-10 record: where a move lands and the
// arrival bits it carries (main.gd _on_map_jump/_on_map_move's fields).
// Music -1 = the record says nothing about the track.
type Destination struct {
	ToMap   string `json:"to_map"`
	ToX     int    `json:"to_x"`
	ToY     int    `json:"to_y"`
	Stay    bool   `json:"stay"`
	Arrival int    `json:"arrival"`
	NoFade  bool   `json:"no_fade"`
	Music   int    `json:"music"`
	Facing  int    `json:"facing"`
}

// EventPoint is one map.json trigger row: stepping on the tile starts
// the event (or its encounter battle).
type EventPoint struct {
	X, Y  int
	Event string
}

// ExitPoint is one map.json exit row: stepping on the tile switches maps.
type ExitPoint struct {
	X, Y     int
	ToMap    string
	ToX, ToY int
}

// Chest is one map.json chest row (FF:1D03): x/y tile, the flags byte
// (low 2 bits the money multiplier, bit 2 money, bit 3 own event), the
// content word, the open-flag id and the chest's own event word.
type Chest struct {
	X, Y     int
	Flags    int
	Content  int
	OpenFlag int
	Event    int
}

// MapData is one map.json's flow-side fields: the gate grids through
// field.MapSpec, the placed NPCs as records, and the wiring rows.
type MapData struct {
	Spec         field.MapSpec
	BGM          int
	Slope        [2]int
	Edges        [4]int
	EdgesOn      bool
	Base         int // encounter_party_base ($D2FE)
	NPCs         []field.NpcRecord
	Destinations []Destination
	Exits        []ExitPoint
	Triggers     []EventPoint
	Chests       []Chest
}

// Map loads (and caches) one map's data; not exported = the map exists
// check goes through HasMap.
func (a *Assets) Map(id string) (*MapData, error) {
	if m, ok := a.maps[id]; ok {
		return m, nil
	}
	path := filepath.Join(a.DataDir, "maps", id, "map.json")
	spec, err := field.LoadMapSpec(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load map %s: %w", id, err)
	}
	ex, err := field.LoadMapExtras(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load map %s: %w", id, err)
	}
	var raw struct {
		BGM          int          `json:"bgm"`
		Destinations []destRow    `json:"destinations"`
		Exits        []rawExit    `json:"exits"`
		Triggers     []rawTrigger `json:"triggers"`
		Chests       []rawChest   `json:"chests"`
	}
	b, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("load map %s: %w", id, err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &raw); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parse map %s: %w", id, err)
	}
	md := &MapData{
		Spec: spec, BGM: raw.BGM,
		Slope: ex.Slope, Edges: ex.Edges, EdgesOn: ex.EdgesOn, Base: ex.Base,
		NPCs: ex.NPCs,
	}
	for _, d := range raw.Destinations {
		md.Destinations = append(md.Destinations, Destination{
			ToMap: d.ToMap, ToX: d.ToX, ToY: d.ToY, Stay: d.Stay,
			Arrival: intField(d.Arrival, 0), NoFade: d.NoFade,
			Music: intField(d.Music, -1), Facing: d.Facing,
		})
	}
	for _, e := range raw.Exits {
		md.Exits = append(md.Exits, ExitPoint(e))
	}
	for _, t := range raw.Triggers {
		md.Triggers = append(md.Triggers, EventPoint(t))
	}
	for _, c := range raw.Chests {
		md.Chests = append(md.Chests, Chest(c))
	}
	a.maps[id] = md
	return md, nil
}

// HasMap reports whether the export carries the map (map_view.has_map).
func (a *Assets) HasMap(id string) bool {
	_, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(a.DataDir, "maps", id, "map.json"))
	return err == nil
}

// destRow mirrors a map.json destination record: the optional keys are
// pointers so an absent music reads -1 (no record) and an absent arrival
// 0, as main.gd's d.get defaults keep.
type destRow struct {
	ToMap   string `json:"to_map"`
	ToX     int    `json:"to_x"`
	ToY     int    `json:"to_y"`
	Stay    bool   `json:"stay"`
	Arrival *int   `json:"arrival"`
	NoFade  bool   `json:"no_fade"`
	Music   *int   `json:"music"`
	Facing  int    `json:"facing"`
}

type rawExit struct {
	X     int    `json:"x"`
	Y     int    `json:"y"`
	ToMap string `json:"to_map"`
	ToX   int    `json:"to_x"`
	ToY   int    `json:"to_y"`
}

type rawTrigger struct {
	X     int    `json:"x"`
	Y     int    `json:"y"`
	Event string `json:"event"`
}

type rawChest struct {
	X        int `json:"x"`
	Y        int `json:"y"`
	Flags    int `json:"flags"`
	Content  int `json:"content"`
	OpenFlag int `json:"open_flag"`
	Event    int `json:"event"`
}

// ItemName reads the item catalog name for the menus' 道具 rows; the
// static export is the display source (field_menus.gd _inventory_rows).
func (a *Assets) ItemName(id int) string {
	return a.itemNames[id]
}

// AllyName reads the static ally name for the menus' 狀態 rows.
func (a *Assets) AllyName(id int) string {
	if seed, ok := a.Allies[id]; ok {
		return seed.Name
	}
	return ""
}
```

`internal/game/flow/battle.go`:

```go
package flow

import (
	"saga3/internal/game/battle"
	"saga3/internal/game/field"
	"saga3/internal/game/rng"
	"saga3/internal/game/state"
)

// ---- field -> battle handoff (main.gd _start_field_battle) ---------------
//
// The battle-encounter class: NPC event ids 0x18xx/0x19xx (docs/
// triggers.md). The engine's touch dispatcher (C0:AB2E) enqueues the id
// word byteswapped; op bytes 0x18/0x19 (C0:AB49/AB4D) are the battle
// dispatch, race = the byte's low nibble, high nibble the companion
// pattern. The 0x2xxx ids are NOT encounters (their queue words' low
// byte >= 0x20 and the queue processor 5A:E654 skips them; traced live:
// the road battle fired on word 0x6218 while a 0x2000 bump dispatched
// nothing).

// startFieldBattle starts the battle for event id ev (0x18xx/0x19xx)
// touched on the placed slot (-1 = a trigger tile, no object) from the
// party side or the monster's own step. The composition rolls on a
// battle RNG seeded from the play clock at the handoff (FE:C5A8); the
// engine then takes the generator with the composition's draws still
// counted (main.gd hands the same object).
func (g *Game) startFieldBattle(ev, slot int, byParty bool) {
	if g.field == nil || g.BattleUp {
		return
	}
	op := ev >> 8
	enc := ev & 0xFF
	brng, err := rng.NewBattle(g.a.BattleRNG)
	if err != nil {
		g.diag("battle rng: %v", err)
		return
	}
	brng.SeedFromClock(int(g.State.Clock[3])) // FE:C5A8
	base := g.field.md.Base
	levels := field.EncounterLevels{Global: g.State.GlobalLevel, Races: g.State.EnemyLevels}
	partyCount := g.State.PartySize()
	var enemies []int
	contact := 0
	race := -1
	if op == 0x19 {
		// a fixed formation (FE:7F5B, fixed_battles.json): list types
		// carry their enemies; 01 composes like a random encounter, 03
		// around its fixed leader
		if enc >= len(g.a.BattleData.FixedBattles) {
			g.diag("fixed battle %02X outside the table (%d records)", enc, len(g.a.BattleData.FixedBattles))
			return
		}
		fixed := g.a.BattleData.FixedBattles[enc]
		switch fixed.Type {
		case 0x01:
			enemies, err = field.Compose(brng, g.a.Formations, fitOf(g.a.Fit),
				levels, fixed.Enc, base, partyCount, fixed.Level, -1, -1)
		case 0x03:
			enemies, err = field.Compose(brng, g.a.Formations, fitOf(g.a.Fit),
				levels, fixed.Enc, base, partyCount, fixed.Level, fixed.Leader, fixed.Hensei)
		default:
			enemies = append([]int(nil), fixed.Enemies...)
			if fixed.Type == 0x0D {
				// C2:18B9: one chain member at a time (the cursor advances
				// at the member's death, battle.gd _chain_advance)
				enemies = enemies[:1]
			}
		}
		if err != nil {
			g.diag("fixed compose: %v", err)
			return
		}
		contact = 4 // FE:C60B: op 19 skips the contact rule
	} else {
		enemies, err = field.Compose(brng, g.a.Formations, fitOf(g.a.Fit),
			levels, enc, base, partyCount, 0, -1, -1)
		if err != nil {
			g.diag("compose: %v", err)
			return
		}
		race = enc & 0x0F // op 18 (random encounter) bumps the race's group
		// $37 on the C0:BFC7 inputs (FE:C60B): the leader's and monster's
		// live fields
		contact = battle.ContactType(op, g.objectDir(0), g.objectDir(slot),
			g.objectSpd(0), g.objectRow(0), g.objectD7(0), byParty && slot >= 0)
	}
	cfg := battle.Config{
		Party:     g.State.Party(),
		Enemies:   enemies,
		Contact:   contact,
		Level1308: base & 0x0F, // $1308 = the map's $D2FE low nibble
		Ambush:    contact&battle.ContactAmbush != 0,
		Race:      race,
		AllyHP:    g.State.HP,
	}
	engine, err := battle.NewEngine(g.a.BattleData, gameWorld{g.State}, brng, cfg)
	if err != nil {
		g.diag("battle handoff: %v", err)
		return
	}
	g.battle = engine
	g.BattleUp = true
	if slot >= 0 {
		// the engine rewrites the touched slot to the inert id 0x2000 at
		// dispatch (C0:D74A/D993)
		g.field.f.DefeatMonster(slot)
		g.field.defeated[slot] = true
	}
}

// finishBattle routes the battle's end (main.gd _on_battle_finished).
// Victory syncs the fighters' HP back into the state and returns to the
// field at the same spot (the 1.8 s settle is the shell's). The wipe
// routing is MEASURED (docs/battle-defeat.md §6, c716a83): the defeat
// window's confirm ends the battle, the field return is momentary, and
// the post-battle event script soft-boots the console to the title
// (C0:250E, op 0x3B) — so nothing carries over: the battle HP never
// reaches the persistent state, and the defeat press has already gated
// the wait. The title cursor keeps its row (main.gd never resets it).
func (g *Game) finishBattle() {
	e := g.battle
	if e == nil {
		return
	}
	g.battle = nil
	g.BattleUp = false
	if !e.Won {
		g.Screen = ScreenTitle
		return
	}
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		g.State.HP[a.ID] = a.HP
	}
}

// FinishBattle finishes the running battle (the shell calls it once the
// battle reports its end).
func (g *Game) FinishBattle() { g.finishBattle() }

// BattleFinished reports whether the running battle has settled (the end
// check ran) and its outcome; false, false = still fighting.
func (g *Game) BattleFinished() (settled, won bool) {
	if g.battle == nil {
		return false, false
	}
	return g.battle.Finished, g.battle.Won
}

// Battle returns the running engine, nil when none is up (the shell
// drives it headlessly and calls FinishBattle at its end).
func (g *Game) Battle() *battle.Engine { return g.battle }

// ---- object fields the contact rule reads ($D9A9/$D9BB/$D9BC/$D9D7) ----

func (g *Game) objectDir(slot int) int {
	if o, ok := g.field.f.Objects[slot]; ok {
		return o.Dir
	}
	return -1
}

func (g *Game) objectSpd(slot int) int {
	if o, ok := g.field.f.Objects[slot]; ok {
		return o.Spd
	}
	return 0
}

func (g *Game) objectRow(slot int) int {
	if o, ok := g.field.f.Objects[slot]; ok {
		return o.Row
	}
	return 0
}

func (g *Game) objectD7(slot int) int {
	if o, ok := g.field.f.Objects[slot]; ok {
		return o.D7
	}
	return 0
}

// fitOf adapts the fit map to Compose's lookup.
func fitOf(m map[int]field.EnemyFit) func(int) field.EnemyFit {
	return func(id int) field.EnemyFit { return m[id] }
}

// ---- the battle.World adapter (the handoff's state side) ------------------

// gameWorld adapts *state.GameState to battle.World. The state package
// does not know battle (its migration slice landed without it); the flow
// owns the handoff, so the adapter lives here rather than in state.
type gameWorld struct{ gs *state.GameState }

func (w gameWorld) ClockFrame() int        { return int(w.gs.Clock[3]) }
func (w gameWorld) GlobalLevel() int       { return w.gs.GlobalLevel }
func (w gameWorld) SetGlobalLevel(v int)   { w.gs.GlobalLevel = v }
func (w gameWorld) RaceLevel(race int) int { return w.gs.EnemyLevels[race] }
func (w gameWorld) SetRaceLevel(r, v int)  { w.gs.EnemyLevels[r] = v }
func (w gameWorld) UnlockBits() int        { return w.gs.AIUnlockBits }
func (w gameWorld) SetUnlockBits(v int)    { w.gs.AIUnlockBits = v }
func (w gameWorld) PartyIDs() []int        { return w.gs.Party() }
func (w gameWorld) PartyHP(id int) int     { return w.gs.HP[id] }
func (w gameWorld) AddItem(id int)         { w.gs.AddItem(id) }
func (w gameWorld) ItemCount(id int) int   { return w.gs.ItemCount(id) }
func (w gameWorld) Gold() int              { return w.gs.Gold() }
func (w gameWorld) ProtagonistRow() int    { return w.gs.ProtagonistRow }
func (w gameWorld) WalkID() int            { return w.gs.ProtagonistWalkID }

// SetGold is C0:395E: the engine caps at 30000 (the state's receive cap;
// the pay floor keeps 0).
func (w gameWorld) SetGold(v int) {
	if v > state.GoldCap {
		v = state.GoldCap
	}
	if v >= w.gs.Gold() {
		w.gs.GainGold(v - w.gs.Gold())
		return
	}
	w.gs.PayGold(w.gs.Gold() - v)
}
```

`internal/game/flow/battle_test.go`:

```go
package flow

import (
	"testing"

	"saga3/internal/game/rng"
)

// The field -> battle handoff and the end routing (main.gd
// _start_field_battle / _on_battle_finished; docs/battle-defeat.md §6):
// the talk on a placed monster starts the composed battle, the field
// slot goes inert, victory syncs the fighters' HP into the state, and
// the wipe routes to the title with NOTHING carried over — the battle HP
// never reaches the persistent state.
func TestBattleHandoffAndRouting(t *testing.T) {
	g, gs := newGame(t)
	// 0049's entry 0 stands at (24,50), event 1801: the encounter byte
	// 01 (race 1), op 18 (map_view spawn list; docs/triggers.md). The
	// leader steps into it from the tile below — the party side of the
	// touch dispatcher (C0:8049's blocked step).
	if err := g.EnterField("0049", 24, 51); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 20 && !g.BattleUp; i++ {
		g.Input(KeyEvent{Key: KeyUp, Pressed: true})
		g.Tick()
		g.Input(KeyEvent{Key: KeyUp, Pressed: false})
		g.Tick()
	}
	if !g.BattleUp {
		t.Fatal("the bump into a 1801 monster must start the battle")
	}
	if g.LeaderFacing() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("leader facing %d at the bump, want 0 (into the monster)", g.LeaderFacing())
	}
	e := g.Battle()
	if e == nil || len(e.Enemies) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("battle handoff: engine %v enemies %d", e != nil, len(e.Enemies))
	}
	// the composition runs race 1 ($141B & 0x0F) at 0049's base 57
	// ($D2FE): the party term (0x30 + 6 - roll(1,8)) floors the level at
	// 46..54 -> bands 2-3, so the leader is race 1's band-2 or band-3
	// appearance leader (FE:77BB pairs; the band model itself is
	// field.Compose's pinned territory)
	bandLeaders := map[int]bool{
		g.a.Formations.Appearance[1][2].Leader: true,
		g.a.Formations.Appearance[1][3].Leader: true,
	}
	if !bandLeaders[e.Enemies[0].ID] {
		t.Fatalf("enemy leader id %02X, want a race-1 band-2/3 leader %v (base 57's party term)",
			e.Enemies[0].ID, bandLeaders)
	}
	// the touched slot went inert at dispatch (C0:D74A/D993: 0x2000)
	if slot := g.fieldSlotAt(24, 50); slot < 0 || !g.field.defeated[slot] {
		t.Fatalf("the touched slot did not go inert (slot %d)", slot)
	}
	// the engine's RNG carries the composition's draws (main.gd hands
	// the same generator; FE:C5A8 seeds from the clock)
	rb, ok := e.R.(*rng.Battle)
	if !ok || rb.Index <= 0 {
		t.Fatalf("engine rng %T index, want the *rng.Battle past the composition draws", e.R)
	}

	// victory: the enemies fall, the end check settles, and the fighters'
	// HP syncs back into the state (main.gd's _on_battle_finished won
	// branch)
	for _, en := range e.Enemies {
		en.Alive = false
	}
	if !e.CheckEnd() || !e.Won {
		t.Fatalf("CheckEnd won=%v over=%v, want a settled victory", e.Won, e.Over)
	}
	enginesHP := map[int]int{}
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		enginesHP[a.ID] = a.HP
	}
	g.FinishBattle()
	if g.BattleUp {
		t.Fatal("the battle must come down after a victory")
	}
	for id, hp := range enginesHP {
		if gs.HP[id] != hp {
			t.Fatalf("ally %02X HP %d, want the battle's %d (victory sync)", id, gs.HP[id], hp)
		}
	}
	if g.Screen != ScreenField {
		t.Fatalf("screen %d after a victory, want the field at the same spot", g.Screen)
	}

	// the wipe: the party falls, the confirm routes to the title, and no
	// HP carries (docs/battle-defeat.md §6: the post-battle script
	// soft-boots to the title, C0:250E op 0x3B)
	press(g, KeyUp)
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	if !g.BattleUp {
		t.Fatal("the second talk must start a battle")
	}
	e = g.Battle()
	for _, a := range e.Allies {
		a.Alive = false
	}
	if !e.CheckEnd() || e.Won {
		t.Fatalf("CheckEnd won=%v, want a settled wipe", e.Won)
	}
	hpBefore := map[int]int{}
	for id, hp := range gs.HP {
		hpBefore[id] = hp
	}
	g.FinishBattle()
	if g.Screen != ScreenTitle {
		t.Fatalf("screen %d after a wipe, want the title", g.Screen)
	}
	for id, hp := range hpBefore {
		if gs.HP[id] != hp {
			t.Fatalf("state HP[%02X] = %d after the wipe, want the pre-battle %d — nothing carries (§6)",
				id, gs.HP[id], hp)
		}
	}
}

// The battle owns the keyboard while it is up (main.gd's guard): no
// press reaches the screens, the field or the menus until it comes down.
func TestBattleOwnsKeyboard(t *testing.T) {
	g, _ := newGame(t)
	if err := g.EnterField("0049", 24, 51); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 20 && !g.BattleUp; i++ {
		g.Input(KeyEvent{Key: KeyUp, Pressed: true})
		g.Tick()
		g.Input(KeyEvent{Key: KeyUp, Pressed: false})
		g.Tick()
	}
	if !g.BattleUp {
		t.Fatal("the bump into a 1801 monster must start the battle")
	}
	press(g, KeyMenu)
	if g.Menus.IsOpen() {
		t.Fatal("KeyMenu opened the field menus while the battle was up")
	}
}

// fieldSlotAt finds the placed slot whose NPC center sits on the tile.
func (g *Game) fieldSlotAt(x, y int) int {
	return g.npcSlotAt(x, y)
}
```

`internal/game/flow/chests_test.go`:

```go
package flow

import (
	"testing"
)

// Chests (main.gd _open_chest, C0:A97E-AA46): the talk reaches the
// chest's 4x4 graphic band, an item chest queues its content word
// through event 0108, a money chest queues content times the flags
// multiplier through 0208, and an opened chest answers nothing.
func TestChestItemMoneyAndOpenOnce(t *testing.T) {
	// the money chest: 003B (33,31), flags 69 (bit 2 money, multiplier
	// 69&3 = 1 -> x10), content 50 -> 500 -> vars F4 01 00
	g, gs := newGame(t)
	if err := g.EnterField("003B", 33, 32); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tap(g, KeyUp, 1) // face the chest band
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	if g.EventID() != "0208" {
		t.Fatalf("money chest started event %s, want 0208", g.EventID())
	}
	if gs.Vars[1] != 244 || gs.Vars[2] != 1 || gs.Vars[3] != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("money vars %v, want 500 = content 50 x multiplier 10 split F4 01 00", gs.Vars[1:4])
	}
	if !gs.TreasureOpen(144) {
		t.Fatal("the money chest left its open flag unset")
	}
	press(g, KeyConfirm) // the opened chest answers nothing
	if g.Dialogue.Open || g.EventID() != "0208" {
		t.Fatalf("reopen: dialogue %v event %s, want nothing requeued", g.Dialogue.Open, g.EventID())
	}
	opens := 0
	for _, id := range g.EventsRun() {
		if id == "0208" {
			opens++
		}
	}
	if opens != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("event 0208 ran %d times, want once — the opened chest must not requeue its grant", opens)
	}

	// the item chest: 0038 (13,21), flags 64 (bit 2 clear -> item),
	// content 95 -> var 1, event 0108
	g4, gs4 := newGame(t)
	if err := g4.EnterField("0038", 13, 22); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tap(g4, KeyUp, 1)
	press(g4, KeyConfirm)
	if g4.EventID() != "0108" {
		t.Fatalf("item chest started event %s, want 0108", g4.EventID())
	}
	if gs4.Vars[1] != 95 {
		t.Fatalf("item content var %d, want the chest's 95", gs4.Vars[1])
	}

	// the band edges: the talk answers two tiles above the chest's tile
	// (y-2) and two tiles across (x+2), but not a tile past either
	g2, gs2 := newGame(t)
	if err := g2.EnterField("003B", 33, 28); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tap(g2, KeyDown, 1) // face down at (33,29), the band's top row
	press(g2, KeyConfirm)
	if !gs2.TreasureOpen(144) {
		t.Fatal("the talk at the band's top row (y-2) missed the chest")
	}
	g3, _ := newGame(t)
	if err := g3.EnterField("003B", 35, 32); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tap(g3, KeyUp, 1) // face up at (35,31), the band's x+2 column
	press(g3, KeyConfirm)
	if g3.EventID() != "0208" {
		t.Fatalf("the talk at the band's x+2 column started %s, want 0208", g3.EventID())
	}
	g5, _ := newGame(t)
	if err := g5.EnterField("003B", 33, 26); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	tap(g5, KeyDown, 1) // face down at (33,27), a tile above the band
	press(g5, KeyConfirm)
	if g5.Dialogue.Open || g5.EventID() != "0000" {
		t.Fatalf("the talk above the band opened %v event %s, want nothing in reach",
			g5.Dialogue.Open, g5.EventID())
	}
}
```

`internal/game/flow/cutscene_test.go`:

```go
package flow

import (
	"crypto/md5"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// The opening-cutscene comparison re-hosted at flow level (golden:
// exports/tests/cutscene_opening.json, the MesenCE capture of a new game
// with A pressed every 16 frames, read in place; the ROM log side stays
// in the fixture). The GDScript checker (tests/cutscenecheck.gd) aligns
// by scene = a run of rows on one map, never by frame, and compares: the
// scene map sequence, the per-scene text units' slot digests, the last
// music track a scene sent, and the leader position at the scene's first
// text and at its end.
//
// Out of scope here, with their owners: brightness $2100 and the screen
// digest (the checker itself prints them as not modelled), the screen
// edge's rests (the camera is the render half's — field/roam.go leaves
// the camera to the shell), and the 0250 extension's pass-by-pass
// comparison (it needs --inject-rng: the engine's field RNG reseed at the
// anchor comes from the PPU H counter, which the port cannot derive,
// docs/parity.md "Field RNG"). The extension's battle-handoff wiring is
// pinned by TestBattleHandoffAndRouting instead.
func TestCutsceneOpening(t *testing.T) {
	fx := readCutsceneFixture(t)
	slots := glyphSlots(t)

	g, _ := newGame(t)
	// the capture's new game: title row 0, select row 0, default name
	// (cutscenecheck _run)
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	press(g, KeyBack)

	type row struct {
		t      int
		mapID  string
		lx, ly int
		track  int
	}
	var rows []row
	type unit struct {
		t     int
		slots []int
	}
	var units []unit
	lastPage := "\x00"
	lastKey := ""
	idle := 0
	for tick := 1; tick <= 40000 && idle < 1500; tick++ {
		// the capture's cadence: A every 16 frames
		if tick%16 == 0 {
			if len(g.Dialogue.Choices) > 0 {
				g.Choose(0)
			} else {
				press(g, KeyConfirm)
			}
		}
		g.Tick()
		if g.BattleUp {
			break // the extension's battle: the capture's end point
		}
		// units: one per segment of every page shown (the checker's
		// _add_unit loop over _seg_ends when the label text changes)
		if g.Dialogue.Open && g.Dialogue.Page != lastPage {
			lastPage = g.Dialogue.Page
			for _, seg := range g.Dialogue.Segments {
				s := slotsOf(seg, slots)
				if len(s) == 0 {
					continue
				}
				units = append(units, unit{t: tick, slots: s})
				rows = append(rows, g.snapshotRow(tick))
			}
			lastKey = ""
			continue
		}
		// rows: on a map change, an event change, or every 60th tick
		key := g.MapID + "|" + g.EventID()
		why := ""
		switch {
		case len(rows) == 0 || rows[len(rows)-1].mapID != g.MapID:
			why = "map"
		case key != lastKey:
			why = "event"
		case tick%60 == 0:
			why = "tick"
		}
		lastKey = key
		if why != "" {
			rows = append(rows, g.snapshotRow(tick))
		}
		if !g.inEvent {
			idle++
		} else {
			idle = 0
		}
	}

	// scene assembly (the checker's _scenes): runs of one map, 0000
	// skipped
	type scene struct {
		mapID string
		rows  []row
	}
	var scenes []scene
	for _, r := range rows {
		if r.mapID == "" || r.mapID == "0000" {
			continue
		}
		if len(scenes) == 0 || scenes[len(scenes)-1].mapID != r.mapID {
			scenes = append(scenes, scene{mapID: r.mapID})
		}
		scenes[len(scenes)-1].rows = append(scenes[len(scenes)-1].rows, r)
	}
	gotMaps := make([]string, len(scenes))
	for i, sc := range scenes {
		gotMaps[i] = sc.mapID
	}
	wantMaps := cutsceneSceneMaps(t, fx)
	if len(gotMaps) != len(wantMaps) {
		t.Fatalf("scenes %v, want the capture's %v", gotMaps, wantMaps)
	}
	for i := range gotMaps {
		if gotMaps[i] != wantMaps[i] {
			t.Fatalf("scene %d map %s, want %s", i, gotMaps[i], wantMaps[i])
		}
	}

	// per scene: the text units' digests, the last track, and the leader
	// at the scene's first text and at its end (the checker's
	// _first_mismatch fields, minus the two not modelled)
	startT := 0
	for i := range scenes {
		endT := 1 << 40
		if i+1 < len(scenes) {
			endT = scenes[i+1].rows[0].t
		}
		var mine []unit
		for _, u := range units {
			if u.t >= startT && u.t < endT {
				mine = append(mine, u)
			}
		}
		startT = endT
		wantUnits := fx.sceneUnits(i)
		if len(mine) != len(wantUnits) {
			t.Fatalf("scene %d (%s): %d text units, want %d", i, scenes[i].mapID, len(mine), len(wantUnits))
		}
		for k := range mine {
			if got := unitDigest(mine[k].slots); got != wantUnits[k] {
				t.Fatalf("scene %d (%s) unit %d digest %s, want %s", i, scenes[i].mapID, k, got, wantUnits[k])
			}
		}
		if want := fx.sceneTrack(i); scenes[i].rows[len(scenes[i].rows)-1].track != want {
			t.Fatalf("scene %d (%s) last track %d, want %d", i, scenes[i].mapID,
				scenes[i].rows[len(scenes[i].rows)-1].track, want)
		}
		for _, moment := range []string{"first text", "end"} {
			pick := scenes[i].rows[len(scenes[i].rows)-1]
			if moment == "first text" && len(mine) > 0 {
				ft := mine[0].t
				for _, r := range scenes[i].rows {
					if r.t >= ft {
						pick = r
						break
					}
				}
			}
			wx, wy := fx.sceneLeader(i, moment)
			if pick.lx != wx || pick.ly != wy {
				t.Fatalf("scene %d (%s) leader at %s: (%d,%d), want (%d,%d)", i, scenes[i].mapID,
					moment, pick.lx, pick.ly, wx, wy)
			}
		}
	}
}

// snapshotRow is one row of the checker's trail (_add_row): the leader's
// pixel position, the map id, the track and the event context.
func (g *Game) snapshotRow(tick int) struct {
	t      int
	mapID  string
	lx, ly int
	track  int
} {
	lx, ly := -1, -1
	if g.field != nil {
		if o, ok := g.field.f.Objects[0]; ok {
			lx, ly = o.X, o.Y
		}
	}
	mapID := g.MapID
	if mapID == "" {
		mapID = "0000"
	}
	return struct {
		t      int
		mapID  string
		lx, ly int
		track  int
	}{tick, mapID, lx, ly, g.Track}
}

// ---- the fixture side (read in place) ----

type cutsceneFX struct {
	Rows []struct {
		T   int    `json:"t"`
		Map string `json:"map"`
		LX  int    `json:"lx"`
		LY  int    `json:"ly"`
		BGM int    `json:"bgm"`
	} `json:"rows"`
	Units []struct {
		T int    `json:"t"`
		D string `json:"d"`
	} `json:"units"`
}

func readCutsceneFixture(t *testing.T) *cutsceneFX {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile("../../../exports/tests/cutscene_opening.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Skipf("cutscene fixture not available: %v", err)
	}
	var fx cutsceneFX
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &fx); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse cutscene fixture: %v", err)
	}
	return &fx
}

// bounds returns the scene's row-time window [lo, hi) on the ROM's own
// clock (the checker's _scene_units).
func (fx *cutsceneFX) bounds(scene int) (lo, hi int, ok bool) {
	starts := []int{}
	for i, r := range fx.Rows {
		if r.Map != "0000" && (i == 0 || fx.Rows[i-1].Map != r.Map) {
			starts = append(starts, r.T)
		}
	}
	if scene >= len(starts) {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	lo = starts[scene]
	hi = 1 << 40
	if scene+1 < len(starts) {
		hi = starts[scene+1]
	}
	return lo, hi, true
}

func (fx *cutsceneFX) sceneMaps() []string {
	var out []string
	for _, r := range fx.Rows {
		if r.Map == "0000" {
			continue
		}
		if len(out) == 0 || out[len(out)-1] != r.Map {
			out = append(out, r.Map)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func cutsceneSceneMaps(t *testing.T, fx *cutsceneFX) []string {
	t.Helper()
	return fx.sceneMaps()
}

// sceneUnits are the scene's unit digests (the checker's _scene_units
// window; the fixture keeps the digests, not the slots).
func (fx *cutsceneFX) sceneUnits(scene int) []string {
	lo, hi, ok := fx.bounds(scene)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	var out []string
	for _, u := range fx.Units {
		if u.T >= lo && u.T < hi {
			out = append(out, u.D)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// sceneTrack is the last track the scene sent (the checker's music
// check).
func (fx *cutsceneFX) sceneTrack(scene int) int {
	lo, hi, ok := fx.bounds(scene)
	if !ok {
		return -1
	}
	track := -1
	for _, r := range fx.Rows {
		if r.Map != "0000" && r.T >= lo && r.T < hi {
			track = r.BGM
		}
	}
	return track
}

// sceneLeader is the leader position at the moment named (the checker's
// "first text" row and the scene's end row).
func (fx *cutsceneFX) sceneLeader(scene int, moment string) (int, int) {
	lo, hi, ok := fx.bounds(scene)
	if !ok {
		return -1, -1
	}
	if moment == "first text" {
		var firstUnitT int
		for _, u := range fx.Units {
			if u.T >= lo && u.T < hi {
				firstUnitT = u.T
				break
			}
		}
		for _, r := range fx.Rows {
			if r.Map != "0000" && r.T >= lo && r.T < hi && r.T >= firstUnitT {
				return r.LX, r.LY
			}
		}
		return -1, -1
	}
	var last struct{ lx, ly int }
	for _, r := range fx.Rows {
		if r.Map != "0000" && r.T >= lo && r.T < hi {
			last.lx, last.ly = r.LX, r.LY
		}
	}
	return last.lx, last.ly
}

// ---- glyphs and digests (the checker's slot model) ----

// glyphSlots reads data/glyphs_jp.json (the assignment cmd/dumpevents
// uses) and keeps the unambiguous slots: only glyphs whose slot no other
// glyph shares, plus the space at 0, the ー chouon at 149 (slot 149 is
// both 一 and ー, bokuno.Chouon), and the digits at 0x300+d.
func glyphSlots(t *testing.T) map[rune]int {
	t.Helper()
	b, err := os.ReadFile("../../../data/glyphs_jp.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Skipf("glyph table not available: %v", err)
	}
	var raw map[string]int
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &raw); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("parse glyphs: %v", err)
	}
	count := map[int]int{}
	for _, s := range raw {
		count[s]++
	}
	out := map[rune]int{' ': 0}
	for ch, s := range raw {
		if count[s] == 1 {
			out[[]rune(ch)[0]] = s
		}
	}
	out['ー'] = 149
	for d := 0; d < 10; d++ {
		out[rune('0'+d)] = 0x300 + d
	}
	return out
}

// slotsOf maps a segment's text to glyph slots (the checker's
// _slots_of): control characters draw no glyph, unknown text maps to
// 0xFFF.
func slotsOf(text string, slots map[rune]int) []int {
	var out []int
	for _, ch := range text {
		if ch < 0x20 {
			continue
		}
		if s, ok := slots[ch]; ok {
			out = append(out, s)
		} else {
			out = append(out, 0xFFF)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// unitDigest is the checker's _digest: the slots' hex, blank slot 0
// skipped, md5, first 12 hex digits.
func unitDigest(slots []int) string {
	var b strings.Builder
	for _, s := range slots {
		if s == 0 {
			continue
		}
		fmt.Fprintf(&b, "%03X", s)
	}
	sum := md5.Sum([]byte(b.String()))
	return hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])[:12]
}
```

```go
package flow

import (
	"testing"

// Dialogue paging (main.gd _show_page/_advance_pressed): a 2C-marked page
// opens on its first segment, each press reveals the next segment, and
// the press after the last one pulls the next page.
func TestDialogueSegmentsRevealPerPress(t *testing.T) {
	g, _ := newGame(t)
	if err := g.EnterField("0250", 12, 58); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	g.startEvent(0x0800)
	for i := 0; i < 40 && (len(g.Dialogue.Choices) > 0 || len(g.Dialogue.Segments) < 2); i++ {
		press(g, KeyConfirm)
	}
	if len(g.Dialogue.Choices) > 0 || len(g.Dialogue.Segments) < 2 {
		t.Fatalf("0800: reached choices %v with %d segments, want a marked page with several and none pending",
			g.Dialogue.Choices, len(g.Dialogue.Segments))
	}
	if g.Dialogue.Shown != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("shown %d on the page's arrival, want 1 (one segment)", g.Dialogue.Shown)
	}
	first := g.Dialogue.Page
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	if g.Dialogue.Shown != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("shown %d after one press, want the second segment revealed", g.Dialogue.Shown)
	}
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	if g.Dialogue.Page == first {
		t.Fatal("the press after the last segment must pull the next page")
	}
}

// A pending selection menu holds the dialogue: the press cannot pass it —
// the choice must go through Choose, which clears the pending rows and
// leaves the chosen page for the next press (main.gd's option-button
// contract with event_vm).
func TestDialogueChoicePageHoldsUntilChoose(t *testing.T) {
	g, _ := newGame(t)
	if err := g.EnterField("0250", 12, 58); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	g.startEvent(0x0685)
	for i := 0; i < 8 && len(g.Dialogue.Choices) == 0; i++ {
		press(g, KeyConfirm)
	}
	if len(g.Dialogue.Choices) == 0 {
		t.Fatal("0685 never raised its selection menu")
	}
	page, shown := g.Dialogue.Page, g.Dialogue.Shown
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	if len(g.Dialogue.Choices) == 0 || g.Dialogue.Page != page || g.Dialogue.Shown != shown {
		t.Fatalf("press with pending choices: choices %v page %q shown %d, want the menu held at %q",
			g.Dialogue.Choices, head60(g.Dialogue.Page), g.Dialogue.Shown, head60(page))
	}
	g.Choose(0)
	if len(g.Dialogue.Choices) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("choices %v after Choose, want them cleared", g.Dialogue.Choices)
	}
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	if len(g.Dialogue.Choices) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("choices %v after the post-Choose press, want the menu gone", g.Dialogue.Choices)
	}
}

// The queue's music word 1Dxx switches the track once the field idles
// (C0:C5C4); a word outside the call/music classes is dropped without a

func TestQueueMusicWordPlaysAndOtherWordsDrop(t *testing.T) {

}
```

```go
// Package flow ports the game-flow layer (godot/main.gd's flow half,
// select_screen.gd, naming_screen.gd, field_menus.gd's logic, and the
// queue-drain half of save_manager.gd's callers): the title/select/naming
// screens, the event playback through internal/game/vm, the field loop
// over internal/game/field, the battle handoff to internal/game/battle,
// the field menus and the save/CONTINUE round-trip through
// internal/game/state. Pure logic: no ebiten import — the Ebiten shell
// drives Input/Tick and draws Screen.
//
// The dependency surface is the landed packages, never re-ported here:
// vm (events), state (game state + saves, implements vm.State), field
// (map loads, party step, encounters, trigger wiring), actions (the
// trail-replay runner; not driven by the flow), battle (headless engine),
// rng. One deliberate addition: the static op-09 enqueue walker
// (godot/action_scripts.gd) lives here as the no-field fallback of the
// install hook — the state package records installs until a field takes
// them, and the queue they feed is drained by this package's field loop
// (state.vmstate.InstallAction documents the contract).
//
// Screen state the shell draws (main.gd's shapes kept where sensible):
// Screen (title/select/naming/field), the screens' cursor rows, Dialogue
// (open page, shown segments, pending choices), MapID plus the leader's
// tile and facing, Track (the playing BGM track), Arrival (the switch
// record the shell plays), and BattleUp. Not modeled here, with their
// owners: the typewriter pacing and the timed step costs of field pages
// (event_vm page_steps — the vm package documents the slice), the
// arrival fade sequence and camera (gfx/render half; the flow carries
// Arrival's settings), brightness $2100 and the screen digest (the
// cutscene fixture's own checker prints them as not modelled), and the
// leader instructions / follower spawns / live action-script installs on
// the field (field.Field has no install path — reported as an interface
// gap; the flow falls back to the static enqueue walker, which is the
// VM-only shape the selftest pins).
//
// Goldens re-hosted from godot/main.gd's selftest and
// exports/tests/cutscene_opening.json: the protagonist-route dispatches per
// select row, the row-0 opening trail (chain + map jumps + the
// `10 01` move to 0250 (12,58)), the four-scene cutscene comparison
// (map sequence, text-unit slot digests, tracks, leader positions), the
// title→new-game→select→naming→field e2e with the save/CONTINUE
// round-trip, the field menus' keyboard semantics, and the wipe/victory
// battle routing (docs/battle-defeat.md §6: nothing carries a wipe out).
package flow
```

`internal/game/flow/e2e_test.go`:

```go
package flow

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// TestEndToEnd is the e2e selftest sequence re-hosted on the flow
// machine (main.gd --selftest's end-to-end block, driven through the
// real vm/state/field/actions building blocks): title -> NEW GAME ->
// select (row 3 = ハリード, ally 04) -> naming -> the opening -> field
// walks -> the field menus' keyboard -> the 0002 NPC dialogue through
// the static install queue -> the exit crossing 0049 -> 0048 -> the
// save/CONTINUE round-trip.
func TestEndToEnd(t *testing.T) {
	g, gs := newGame(t)

	// title -> select row 3 -> naming (Esc keeps ハリード) -> the opening
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	tap(g, KeyDown, 3)
	press(g, KeyConfirm)
	if g.NamingBuffer() != "ハリード" {
		t.Fatalf("naming buffer %q, want the picked row's default", g.NamingBuffer())
	}
	press(g, KeyBack)
	idle := 0
	for i := 0; i < 8000 && idle < 300; i++ {
		if len(g.Dialogue.Choices) > 0 {
			g.Choose(0)
			continue
		}
		press(g, KeyConfirm)
		g.Tick()
		if !g.inEvent {
			idle++
		} else {
			idle = 0
		}
	}
	if g.Screen != ScreenField || g.MapID != "0250" {
		t.Fatalf("after the opening: screen %d map %s, want the field on 0250", g.Screen, g.MapID)
	}
	if x, y := g.LeaderTile(); x != 12 || y != 58 {
		t.Fatalf("leader (%d,%d), want the handover (12,58)", x, y)
	}
	if got := gs.ProtagonistName; got != "ハリード" {
		t.Fatalf("name %q, want ハリード", got)
	}

	// field walk: holding Up walks north from (12,58) — 8 passes a tile
	// plus the arming pass, so 16 frames land exactly one tile north
	// (main.gd's party-walk shape; the step rules themselves are the
	// field package's trail pins)
	tap(g, KeyUp, 8)
	if x, y := g.LeaderTile(); x != 12 || y != 57 {
		t.Fatalf("after one tile up: (%d,%d), want (12,57)", x, y)
	}
	if g.LeaderFacing() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("facing %d after walking north, want 0 (up)", g.LeaderFacing())
	}

	// the field menus' keyboard: M opens, arrows move and switch tabs,
	// Esc closes (field_menus.gd handle_key; Enter and Space both confirm
	// — the deliberate deviation documented there, kept)
	press(g, KeyMenu)
	if !g.Menus.IsOpen() || g.Menus.Tab() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("menus open %v tab %d, want the 狀態 tab", g.Menus.IsOpen(), g.Menus.Tab())
	}
	allies := g.Menus.Allies()
	if len(allies) != 6 || allies[0].Name != "ハリード" || allies[0].ID != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("狀態 rows %v, want the six opening members with the leader renamed", allies)
	}
	press(g, KeyDown)
	if g.Menus.AllyIndex() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("ally index %d after Down, want 1", g.Menus.AllyIndex())
	}
	press(g, KeyRight)
	if g.Menus.Tab() != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("tab %d after Right, want 1 (道具)", g.Menus.Tab())
	}
	// the row-3 opening grants no items; the rows are the inventory's
	// derivation either way (the focused 道具 pin is TestMenusItems)
	if len(g.Menus.Items()) != len(gs.Inventory) {
		t.Fatalf("道具 rows %d, want the inventory's %d entries",
			len(g.Menus.Items()), len(gs.Inventory))
	}
	press(g, KeyLeft)
	if g.Menus.Tab() != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("tab %d after Left, want 0", g.Menus.Tab())
	}
	press(g, KeyBack)
	if g.Menus.IsOpen() {
		t.Fatal("Esc must close the menus")
	}

	// the 0002 NPC dialogue through the static install queue: objOp
	// `17 20` on object C0 with script 0x945 (`09 00 02 FF`, the
	// selftest's field-install shape) queues word 0002, the drain starts
	// the event, and its page is the pier dialogue
	gs.InstallAction(0xC0, 0x945, true)
	g.Tick()
	if g.EventID() != "0002" {
		t.Fatalf("event after the install drain %s, want 0002", g.EventID())
	}
	if !g.Dialogue.Open || !strings.Contains(g.Dialogue.Page, "北海の向こうにある") {
		t.Fatalf("0002 page %q, want the pier dialogue", g.Dialogue.Page)
	}
	for g.inEvent {
		if len(g.Dialogue.Choices) > 0 {
			g.Choose(0)
			continue
		}
		press(g, KeyConfirm)
		g.Tick()
	}
	if g.EventID() != "0002" {
		t.Fatalf("last event %s, want 0002 (main.gd keeps the id)", g.EventID())
	}

	// exit crossing 0049 -> 0048: place the pier approach, walk north
	// onto the exit tile (16,19) — main.gd _on_tile_entered's exit branch
	if err := g.EnterField("0049", 16, 20); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	for i := 0; i < 40; i++ {
		g.Input(KeyEvent{Key: KeyUp, Pressed: true})
		g.Tick()
		if g.MapID == "0048" {
			g.Input(KeyEvent{Key: KeyUp, Pressed: false})
			break
		}
		g.Input(KeyEvent{Key: KeyUp, Pressed: false})
		g.Tick()
	}
	if g.MapID != "0048" {
		t.Fatalf("after the exit walk: map %s, want 0048", g.MapID)
	}
	x, y := g.LeaderTile()
	if x != 47 || y != 23 {
		t.Fatalf("arrival tile (%d,%d), want the exit record's (47,23)", x, y)
	}

	// the save/CONTINUE round-trip (the selftest's save pin at flow
	// level): the mutated state survives, CONTINUE lands on the saved
	// tile
	before := gs.Gold()
	gs.GainGold(1500) // the 0029..002F grant's size, as the selftest mutates
	if err := g.Save(); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	g2, _ := newGame(t)
	g2.SavePath = g.SavePath
	press(g2, KeyDown)
	press(g2, KeyConfirm)
	if g2.Screen != ScreenField {
		t.Fatalf("CONTINUE screen %d, want the field", g2.Screen)
	}
	if g2.State.Gold() != before+1500 {
		t.Fatalf("CONTINUE gold %d, want the saved %d", g2.State.Gold(), before+1500)
	}
	if x, y := g2.LeaderTile(); x != 47 || y != 23 {
		t.Fatalf("CONTINUE tile (%d,%d), want the saved position (47,23)", x, y)
	}
	if got := g2.State.ProtagonistName; got != "ハリード" {
		t.Fatalf("CONTINUE name %q, want the saved ハリード", got)
	}
}
```
