`internal/game/vm/parity_test.go`:

```go
package vm

import (
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"sort"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

// The parity-gate lockstep, re-hosted as a plain go test (docs/parity.md
// §12). The committed testdata is one full ROM capture, scripts/
// parity_gate.sh run-236 (the ROM-side capture is deterministic:
// run-235 and run-236 are byte-identical in jobs.json and rom.log):
//
//	jobs.json            the replay jobs — per segment: event id + the
//	                     WRAM snapshot the gates read (cmd/paritygate prepare)
//	rom_meta.json        every captured segment in run order (with snapshots)
//	rom_decisions.json   the ROM's GATE/TGT lines distilled from the run's
//	                     rom.log, with the same line grammar cmd/paritygate
//	                     parses; cross-checked against `paritygate compare`
//	                     output for this run
//	events.json          the catalog subset the replay dispatches through —
//	                     the job ids plus every event the golden replay
//	                     DISP/CALLs (godot.log ok=true lines), extracted
//	                     from exports/data/events.json
//	events_index.json    end16 rows for those events
//	events_names.json    actor/place name tables
//
// The test replays each job's event from its snapshot through this package's
// VM (CallsEnabled + TraceEnabled, like godot main.gd --paritygate), then
// diffs the trace's GATE/DISP/CALL/SELGOTO/JUMP lines against the ROM
// decisions with the same rules cmd/paritygate uses: per-segment lockstep,
// conflicts fail, coverage gaps report but do not fail.
const testdataDir = "testdata"

func readJSONFile(t *testing.T, path string, v any) {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, v); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

type parityJob struct {
	Key   string            `json:"key"`
	ID    string            `json:"id"`
	State map[string]string `json:"state"`
}

type paritySegment struct {
	Key   string            `json:"key"`
	ID    string            `json:"id"`
	Frame int               `json:"frame"`
	Snap  map[string]string `json:"snap"`
}

type romGate struct {
	Seg    string `json:"seg"`
	Addr   string `json:"addr"`
	Family string `json:"family"`
	Dec    bool   `json:"dec"`
}

type romTarget struct {
	Seg  string `json:"seg"`
	Kind string `json:"kind"`
	Addr string `json:"addr,omitempty"`
	Val  string `json:"val"`
}

type romDecisions struct {
	SourceRun string      `json:"source_run"`
	Gates     []romGate   `json:"gates"`
	Targets   []romTarget `json:"targets"`
}

// traceField extracts a key=value field, the way cmd/paritygate parses log
// lines.
func traceField(line, key string) string {
	i := strings.Index(line, key)
	if i < 0 {
		return ""
	}
	rest := line[i+len(key):]
	j := strings.IndexAny(rest, " \t")
	if j < 0 {
		return rest
	}
	return rest[:j]
}

// jobTrace is one replay's parsed trace — the fields parseGodotLog keeps.
type jobTrace struct {
	Gates     []romGate
	Targets   []romTarget
	Disps     []string
	CalledIDs []string
	HadRand   bool
	Cause     string
}

// parseJobTrace turns the VM trace into the comparison records. The trace
// line grammar is the GDScript reference's, byte for byte.
func parseJobTrace(trace []string) jobTrace {
	jt := jobTrace{Cause: "job finished"}
	for _, line := range trace {
		switch {
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "GATE "):
			jt.Gates = append(jt.Gates, romGate{
				Addr:   strings.ToUpper(traceField(line, "addr=")),
				Family: traceField(line, "note="),
				Dec:    traceField(line, "dec=") == "TRUE",
			})
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "SELGOTODISP"):
			jt.Targets = append(jt.Targets, romTarget{Kind: "SELGOTODISP", Val: strings.ToUpper(traceField(line, "id="))})
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "SELGOTO "):
			jt.Targets = append(jt.Targets, romTarget{Kind: "SELGOTO", Val: strings.ToUpper(traceField(line, "target="))})
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "JUMP "):
			jt.Targets = append(jt.Targets, romTarget{Kind: strings.ToUpper(traceField(line, "kind=")), Val: strings.ToUpper(traceField(line, "target="))})
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "JUMPL "):
			jt.Targets = append(jt.Targets, romTarget{Kind: "JUMPL", Val: strings.ToUpper(traceField(line, "target="))})
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "CALLL "):
			jt.Targets = append(jt.Targets, romTarget{Kind: "CALLL", Val: strings.ToUpper(traceField(line, "target="))})
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "DISP "):
			if traceField(line, "ok=") == "true" {
				jt.Disps = append(jt.Disps, strings.ToUpper(traceField(line, "to=")))
			}
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "CALL "):
			if traceField(line, "ok=") == "true" {
				jt.CalledIDs = append(jt.CalledIDs, strings.ToUpper(traceField(line, "id=")))
			}
		case strings.HasPrefix(line, "RAND "):
			jt.HadRand = true
		}
	}
	return jt
}

// replayJobs runs every parity job through the Go VM from its snapshot.
func replayJobs(t *testing.T, cat *FileCatalog, jobs []parityJob) map[string]jobTrace {
	t.Helper()
	out := map[string]jobTrace{}
	for _, job := range jobs {
		native, err := strconv.ParseUint(job.ID, 16, 16)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("job %s: bad id %q: %v", job.Key, job.ID, err)
		}
		if !cat.HasEvent(int(native)) {
			t.Fatalf("job %s: catalog lacks %s (testdata/events.json subset is not closed)", job.Key, job.ID)
		}
		st := loadSnapshotState(job.State)
		vm := New(cat)
		vm.State = st
		vm.TraceEnabled = true
		vm.CallsEnabled = true
		vm.LoadEvent(cat.RawOps(int(native)), int(native))
		vm.AllPages()
		// The subset catalog must cover every dispatch the replay takes:
		// an unresolved DISP/CALL is a hole in testdata, not a coverage gap.
		for _, line := range vm.Trace {
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "DISP ") && traceField(line, "ok=") == "false" {
				t.Fatalf("job %s: %s (catalog subset hole)", job.Key, line)
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "CALL ") && traceField(line, "ok=") == "false" {
				t.Fatalf("job %s: %s (catalog subset hole)", job.Key, line)
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(line, "JUMPFAIL") {
				t.Fatalf("job %s: %s", job.Key, line)
			}
		}
		out[job.Key] = parseJobTrace(vm.Trace)
	}
	return out
}

// ---- comparison, the cmd/paritygate compareCore rules ------------------------

type parityReport struct {
	conflicts  int
	compared   int
	matched    int
	gapSegs    int
	randomSegs int
	conflictLn []string
	gapLn      []string
	segLines   []string
	tgtMatched int
}

func segIDOf(id string) uint16 {
	v, err := strconv.ParseUint(id, 16, 16)
	if err != nil {
		panic("bad segment id " + id)
	}
	return uint16(v)
}

// compareGolden diffs every segment's ROM decisions against its replay.
// Ported from cmd/paritygate compareCore; ROM-only entries are the
// documented structural gaps (bank-72 subroutine bodies, the FC:0812
// runtime boundary) and report without failing.
func compareGolden(segs []paritySegment, gates []romGate, targets []romTarget, jobs map[string]jobTrace, gateAddrs map[string]bool) *parityReport {
	rep := &parityReport{}
	for si, seg := range segs {
		if seg.ID == "0000" || len(seg.Snap) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		var romGates []romGate
		var romTgts []romTarget
		for _, g := range gates {
			if segIDOf(g.Seg) == segIDOf(seg.ID) {
				romGates = append(romGates, g)
			}
		}
		for _, tg := range targets {
			if segIDOf(tg.Seg) == segIDOf(seg.ID) {
				romTgts = append(romTgts, tg)
			}
		}
		job, ok := jobs[seg.Key]
		if !ok {
			rep.gapSegs++
			rep.gapLn = append(rep.gapLn, fmt.Sprintf("GAP %s id=%s: no replay job", seg.Key, seg.ID))
			continue
		}
		// gates: lockstep walk. A conflict is only the same gate address
		// with a different decision.
		segMatched, romExtra := 0, 0
		gi := 0
		for _, r := range romGates {
			if gi < len(job.Gates) && r.Addr == job.Gates[gi].Addr {
				rep.compared++
				rep.matched++
				segMatched++
				if r.Dec != job.Gates[gi].Dec {
					rep.conflicts++
					rep.conflictLn = append(rep.conflictLn, fmt.Sprintf(
						"CONFLICT %s gate %s (%s): ROM=%s godot=%s",
						seg.Key, r.Addr, r.Family, boolStr(r.Dec), boolStr(job.Gates[gi].Dec)))
				}
				gi++
			} else {
				romExtra++
			}
		}
		godotExtra := len(job.Gates) - gi
		if godotExtra > 0 {
			rep.gapLn = append(rep.gapLn, fmt.Sprintf(
				"GODOT-ONLY %s id=%s: %d gates the ROM trail never took (e.g. %s)",
				seg.Key, seg.ID, godotExtra, job.Gates[gi].Addr))
		}
		status := "OK"
		if len(job.Gates) == 0 && len(romGates) > 0 {
			rep.gapSegs++
			status = "SHORT"
			rep.gapLn = append(rep.gapLn, fmt.Sprintf(
				"GAP %s id=%s: godot produced 0/%d gates (cause=%s)",
				seg.Key, seg.ID, len(romGates), job.Cause))
		} else if job.HadRand && godotExtra > 0 {
			rep.randomSegs++
			status = "RANDOM-TRUNCATED"
		}
		// dispatch targets: lockstep by kind + value.
		tgi := 0
		for _, r := range romTgts {
			if tgi < len(job.Targets) && r.Kind == job.Targets[tgi].Kind && r.Val == job.Targets[tgi].Val {
				rep.tgtMatched++
				tgi++
			} else if tgi < len(job.Targets) && r.Kind == job.Targets[tgi].Kind && r.Val != job.Targets[tgi].Val {
				rep.conflicts++
				rep.conflictLn = append(rep.conflictLn, fmt.Sprintf(
					"CONFLICT %s target %s at op %s: ROM=%s godot=%s",
					seg.Key, r.Kind, r.Addr, r.Val, job.Targets[tgi].Val))
				tgi++
			}
			// ROM-only targets (subroutine bodies outside the catalog)
			// report as coverage, not failure.
		}
		// dispatch chain: the next ROM segment's id must be dispatched here.
		if si < len(segs)-1 {
			next := segs[si+1]
			if next.ID != "0000" && len(next.Snap) > 0 {
				found := false
				for _, d := range job.Disps {
					if d == next.ID {
						found = true
						break
					}
				}
				for _, c := range job.CalledIDs {
					if c == next.ID {
						found = true
						break
					}
				}
				if !found {
					if job.HadRand {
						rep.randomSegs++
						rep.gapLn = append(rep.gapLn, fmt.Sprintf(
							"CHAIN-RANDOM %s id=%s: next dispatch %s not reached (random branch)", seg.Key, seg.ID, next.ID))
					} else {
						rep.gapSegs++
						rep.gapLn = append(rep.gapLn, fmt.Sprintf(
							"CHAIN-GAP %s id=%s: godot never dispatched %s (cause=%s)",
							seg.Key, seg.ID, next.ID, job.Cause))
					}
				}
			}
		}
		rep.segLines = append(rep.segLines, fmt.Sprintf(
			"segment %s id=%s rom_gates=%d matched=%d rom_only=%d godot_only=%d rom_tgts=%d tgt_matched=%d %s",
			seg.Key, seg.ID, len(romGates), segMatched, romExtra, godotExtra, len(romTgts), tgtMatchedIn(seg, romTgts, job), status))
	}
	// alignment health: ROM gate addresses should land on decoded gate ops.
	if len(gateAddrs) > 0 {
		unknown := 0
		for _, g := range gates {
			if !gateAddrs[g.Addr] {
				unknown++
			}
		}
		if unknown > 0 {
			rep.segLines = append(rep.segLines, fmt.Sprintf(
				"ALIGNMENT: %d/%d ROM gate addresses are not decoded gate ops in events.json", unknown, len(gates)))
		}
	}
	return rep
}

// tgtMatchedIn counts the segment's matched targets (the segLines number).
func tgtMatchedIn(seg paritySegment, romTgts []romTarget, job jobTrace) int {
	n := 0
	tgi := 0
	for _, r := range romTgts {
		if tgi < len(job.Targets) && r.Kind == job.Targets[tgi].Kind {
			if r.Val == job.Targets[tgi].Val {
				n++
			}
			tgi++
		}
	}
	return n
}

// ---- snapshot state -------------------------------------------------------------

// snapshotState mirrors game_state.gd for the parity replay: the WRAM
// snapshot regions (main.gd _parity_load_state) plus its memory model.
// The snapshot carries no equipment, so PartyHasItem is the bag only.
type snapshotState struct {
	vanilla, packed4 [256]byte
	ext              [256]byte
	vars             [256]byte
	scratch          [256]byte
	menuSel          int
	menuCount        int
	gold             int
	bank             [2]int
	party            []int
	inventory        map[int]int
	walkID           int
	fieldA, fieldB   int // the field RNG state ($0A/$0B), fresh like GameState's
}

func loadSnapshotState(s map[string]string) *snapshotState {
	st := &snapshotState{inventory: map[int]int{}, walkID: -1}
	dec := func(key string) []byte {
		raw, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(s[key])
		if err != nil {
			panic("snapshot " + key + ": " + err.Error())
		}
		return raw
	}
	copy(st.vanilla[:], dec("van"))
	copy(st.packed4[:], dec("var")) // packed4: engine RAM base unknown; zeros on both sides
	copy(st.ext[:], dec("ext"))
	copy(st.scratch[:], dec("scr"))
	men := dec("men")
	st.menuSel = int(men[0])
	st.menuCount = int(men[2])
	gld := dec("gld")
	st.gold = int(gld[0]) | int(gld[1])<<8
	st.bank[0] = int(gld[2]) | int(gld[3])<<8
	st.bank[1] = int(gld[4]) | int(gld[5])<<8
	pty := dec("pty")
	for k := 10; k < 16; k++ { // pty[10..15] = WRAM $F323-$F328 party slots
		if pty[k] != 0xFF {
			st.party = append(st.party, int(pty[k]))
		}
	}
	st.walkID = int(pty[9])
	inv := dec("inv")
	for k := 0; k < 32; k++ {
		if inv[k*2] != 0xFF && inv[k*2+1] > 0 {
			st.inventory[int(inv[k*2])] = int(inv[k*2+1])
		}
	}
	return st
}

func (s *snapshotState) GetVanilla(id int) int  { return nibbleAt(s.vanilla[:], id&0xFF) }
func (s *snapshotState) SetVanilla(id, v int)   { setNibbleAt(s.vanilla[:], id&0xFF, v) }
func (s *snapshotState) GetPacked4(id int) int  { return nibbleAt(s.packed4[:], id&0xFF) }
func (s *snapshotState) SetPacked4(id, v int)   { setNibbleAt(s.packed4[:], id&0xFF, v) }
func (s *snapshotState) GetExt(id int) int      { return nibbleAt(s.ext[:], id&0x1FF) }
func (s *snapshotState) GetVar(a int) int       { return int(s.vars[a&0xFF]) }
func (s *snapshotState) SetVar(a, v int)        { s.vars[a&0xFF] = byte(v & 0xFF) }
func (s *snapshotState) GetVarWord(a int) int   { return s.GetVar(a) | s.GetVar(a+1)<<8 }
func (s *snapshotState) SetVarWord(a, v int)    { s.SetVar(a, v&0xFF); s.SetVar(a+1, (v>>8)&0xFF) }
func (s *snapshotState) MenuSelection() int     { return s.menuSel }
func (s *snapshotState) SetMenuSelection(v int) { s.menuSel = v }
func (s *snapshotState) SetMenuOpen(int)        {}
func (s *snapshotState) MenuCount() int         { return s.menuCount }
func (s *snapshotState) SetMenuCount(v int)     { s.menuCount = v }
func (s *snapshotState) Gold() int              { return s.gold }
func (s *snapshotState) PayGold(amount int)     { s.gold = maxInt(s.gold-amount, 0) }
func (s *snapshotState) GainGold(amount int)    { s.gold = minInt(s.gold+amount, 30000) }
func (s *snapshotState) AddBankGold(slot, amount int) {
	s.bank[slot] = minInt(s.bank[slot]+amount, 0xFFFF)
}
func (s *snapshotState) AddItem(id int) {
	s.inventory[id] = minInt(s.inventory[id]+1, 99)
}
func (s *snapshotState) PartyHasItem(id int) bool { return s.inventory[id] > 0 }
func (s *snapshotState) Party() []int             { return s.party }
func (s *snapshotState) GetScratch(i int) int     { return int(s.scratch[i&0xFF]) }
func (s *snapshotState) SetScratch(i, v int)      { s.scratch[i&0xFF] = byte(v & 0xFF) }

// SetPartyList maps record slots through the record table, dropping $FF
// empties and duplicates (game_state.gd set_party_list).
func (s *snapshotState) SetPartyList(slots []int) {
	s.party = nil
	for _, k := range slots {
		if k == 0xFF || k >= len(recordIDs) {
			continue
		}
		id := recordIDs[k]
		found := false
		for _, p := range s.party {
			if p == id {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			s.party = append(s.party, id)
		}
	}
}

// CustomNameFor: the replay's snapshot never sets the entered name
// (protagonist_name ""), so every actor falls through to the table name.
func (s *snapshotState) CustomNameFor(actorID int) string {
	if actorID == selectRows[0] {
		return ""
	}
	return ""
}

// FieldRand rolls the field RNG exactly as C0:0733 does from the fresh
// state (godot field_rng.gd a=0, b=0). The golden replay takes no 4F_16;
// if one ever runs, this keeps it deterministic and GDScript-equal.
func (s *snapshotState) FieldRand(lo, hi int) int {
	s.fieldA = (s.fieldA*3 + s.fieldB) & 0xFF
	s.fieldB++
	if s.fieldB >= 0x0F {
		s.fieldB = 0
	}
	n := (hi - lo + 1) & 0xFF
	if n == 0 {
		return s.fieldA
	}
	return lo + s.fieldA%n
}

func (s *snapshotState) SpawnActor() {}

func (s *snapshotState) InstallAction(int, int, bool) {}

// MemReadByte models the WRAM addresses game_state.gd models; unknown
// addresses return -1 and the VM records the read as a transparent op.
func (s *snapshotState) MemReadByte(addr int) int {
	switch {
	case addr >= 0xEF00 && addr <= 0xEFFF:
		return s.GetVar(addr - 0xEF00)
	case addr >= 0xF46A && addr < 0xF46A+128:
		return int(s.vanilla[addr-0xF46A])
	case addr >= 0xF4EA && addr < 0xF4EA+32:
		return 0
	case addr >= 0xF30A && addr < 0xF30A+4:
		return 0
	case addr == 0xF000:
		return selectRows[0]
	case addr == 0xF319:
		return len(s.party)
	case addr == 0xF322:
		return s.walkID & 0xFF
	case addr >= 0xF323 && addr <= 0xF328:
		if i := addr - 0xF323; i < len(s.party) {
			return s.party[i]
		}
		return 0xFF
	}
	return -1
}

// MemStoreByte models the one address the dump set writes ($F322).
func (s *snapshotState) MemStoreByte(addr, value int) bool {
	if addr == 0xF322 {
		s.walkID = value & 0xFF
		return true
	}
	return false
}

var _ State = (*snapshotState)(nil)

// ---- tests -----------------------------------------------------------------------

// TestParityGateLockstep re-hosts the parity gate's lockstep as a plain go
// test. Target line, from today's `paritygate compare` on this capture:
//
//	PARITY PASS: 9 gate decisions and 9 dispatch targets agree
//
// with compared=9 matched=9 conflicts=0 over 6 segments and 26 ROM gate
// decisions, and the documented structural gaps reported, not failing.
func TestParityGateLockstep(t *testing.T) {
	cat, err := LoadCatalog(testdataDir + "/events.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var jobs []parityJob
	readJSONFile(t, testdataDir+"/jobs.json", &jobs)
	var segs []paritySegment
	readJSONFile(t, testdataDir+"/rom_meta.json", &segs)
	var dec romDecisions
	readJSONFile(t, testdataDir+"/rom_decisions.json", &dec)

	traces := replayJobs(t, cat, jobs)
	gateAddrs := catalogGateAddrs(t, cat)
	rep := compareGolden(segs, dec.Gates, dec.Targets, traces, gateAddrs)

	for _, l := range rep.segLines {
		t.Logf("%s", l)
	}
	t.Logf("coverage: compared=%d matched=%d conflicts=%d gap_segments=%d random_segments=%d",
		rep.compared, rep.matched, rep.conflicts, rep.gapSegs, rep.randomSegs)
	for _, l := range rep.gapLn {
		t.Logf("%s", l)
	}

	// The golden verdict, pinned line for line against the capture's
	// `paritygate compare` output (run-236).
	wantSeg := []string{
		"segment 0800#1 id=0800 rom_gates=0 matched=0 rom_only=0 godot_only=22 rom_tgts=1 tgt_matched=1 OK",
		"segment 0BF1#1 id=0BF1 rom_gates=18 matched=1 rom_only=17 godot_only=0 rom_tgts=0 tgt_matched=0 OK",
		"segment 0846#1 id=0846 rom_gates=4 matched=4 rom_only=0 godot_only=0 rom_tgts=0 tgt_matched=0 OK",
		"segment 0848#1 id=0848 rom_gates=0 matched=0 rom_only=0 godot_only=0 rom_tgts=0 tgt_matched=0 OK",
		"segment 0849#1 id=0849 rom_gates=1 matched=1 rom_only=0 godot_only=19 rom_tgts=0 tgt_matched=0 OK",
		"segment 084A#1 id=084A rom_gates=3 matched=3 rom_only=0 godot_only=16 rom_tgts=0 tgt_matched=0 OK",
	}
	if len(rep.segLines) != len(wantSeg) {
		t.Fatalf("segment lines %+v, want the run-236 golden (%d lines)", rep.segLines, len(wantSeg))
	}
	for i := range wantSeg {
		if rep.segLines[i] != wantSeg[i] {
			t.Fatalf("segment line %d:\n got %s\nwant %s", i, rep.segLines[i], wantSeg[i])
		}
	}
	wantGap := []string{
		"GODOT-ONLY 0800#1 id=0800: 22 gates the ROM trail never took (e.g. FC:DF97)",
		"CHAIN-GAP 0BF1#1 id=0BF1: godot never dispatched 0846 (cause=job finished)",
		"CHAIN-GAP 0848#1 id=0848: godot never dispatched 0849 (cause=job finished)",
		"GODOT-ONLY 0849#1 id=0849: 19 gates the ROM trail never took (e.g. FC:199A)",
		"GODOT-ONLY 084A#1 id=084A: 16 gates the ROM trail never took (e.g. FC:20D8)",
	}
	if len(rep.gapLn) != len(wantGap) {
		t.Fatalf("gap lines %+v, want the run-236 golden (%d lines)", rep.gapLn, len(wantGap))
	}
	for i := range wantGap {
		if rep.gapLn[i] != wantGap[i] {
			t.Fatalf("gap line %d:\n got %s\nwant %s", i, rep.gapLn[i], wantGap[i])
		}
	}
	if rep.conflicts != 0 || rep.compared != 9 || rep.matched != 9 {
		t.Fatalf("verdict compared=%d matched=%d conflicts=%d, want the PARITY PASS golden 9/9/0",
			rep.compared, rep.matched, rep.conflicts)
	}
	if rep.tgtMatched != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("matched targets %d, want 1 (the CALLL 72:91C0 of 0800#1)", rep.tgtMatched)
	}
	// 26 ROM gate decisions across the six segments, as the capture has.
	if len(dec.Gates) != 26 {
		t.Fatalf("rom decisions %d, want 26", len(dec.Gates))
	}
}

// TestParityComparatorMutation proves the comparator works: a flipped ROM
// decision in a copy of the testdata must produce exactly one CONFLICT
// naming the gate, and a flipped dispatch target must conflict too (the
// global rule: a check counts as tested once seen failing).
func TestParityComparatorMutation(t *testing.T) {
	cat, err := LoadCatalog(testdataDir + "/events.json")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	var jobs []parityJob
	readJSONFile(t, testdataDir+"/jobs.json", &jobs)
	var segs []paritySegment
	readJSONFile(t, testdataDir+"/rom_meta.json", &segs)
	var dec romDecisions
	readJSONFile(t, testdataDir+"/rom_decisions.json", &dec)
	traces := replayJobs(t, cat, jobs)
	gateAddrs := catalogGateAddrs(t, cat)

	// Flip the first ROM decision (0BF1's FC:df97 chkFlag TRUE): the
	// comparator must flag exactly that conflict.
	flipped := dec
	flipped.Gates = append([]romGate(nil), dec.Gates...)
	flipped.Gates[0].Dec = !flipped.Gates[0].Dec
	rep := compareGolden(segs, flipped.Gates, flipped.Targets, traces, gateAddrs)
	if rep.conflicts != 1 || len(rep.conflictLn) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("flipped decision: conflicts=%d (%+v), want exactly 1", rep.conflicts, rep.conflictLn)
	}
	want := "CONFLICT 0BF1#1 gate FC:DF97 (chkFlag): ROM=FALSE godot=TRUE"
	if rep.conflictLn[0] != want {
		t.Fatalf("conflict line %q, want %q", rep.conflictLn[0], want)
	}

	// Flip the CALLL target value: one target conflict.
	flippedT := dec
	flippedT.Targets = append([]romTarget(nil), dec.Targets...)
	flippedT.Targets[0].Val = "72:92C0"
	repT := compareGolden(segs, flippedT.Gates, flippedT.Targets, traces, gateAddrs)
	if repT.conflicts != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("flipped target: conflicts=%d (%+v), want exactly 1", repT.conflicts, repT.conflictLn)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(repT.conflictLn[0], "CONFLICT 0800#1 target CALLL at op 0806: ROM=72:92C0 godot=72:91C0") {
		t.Fatalf("target conflict line %q", repT.conflictLn[0])
	}
}

// catalogGateAddrs collects the decoded cmd-op addresses of the subset
// catalog — the alignment-health diagnostic's known set (cmd/paritygate
// knownGates over the same events).
func catalogGateAddrs(t *testing.T, cat *FileCatalog) map[string]bool {
	t.Helper()
	out := map[string]bool{}
	ids := cat.AllIDs()
	sort.Strings(ids)
	for _, id := range ids {
		v, err := strconv.ParseUint(id, 16, 16)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("bad catalog id %q: %v", id, err)
		}
		for _, op := range cat.RawOps(int(v)) {
			if op.Kind == "cmd" && op.Addr != "" {
				out[strings.ToUpper(op.Addr)] = true
			}
		}
	}
	return out
}
```

`internal/game/vm/state.go`:

```go
package vm

// State is the game-state surface the event VM reads and mutates
// (consumer-defined; godot/game_state.gd is the reference implementation
// and lands in Go as its own migration slice). Every method corresponds to
// one VM access in event_vm.gd; nothing else reaches the game state.
type State interface {
	// Nibble flag spaces (vm-semantics §2.5): vanilla (ops 33/34/35/36/37/38),
	// packed4 (op 49 family), ext (0D 00/01 gates). Even id = high nibble.
	GetVanilla(id int) int
	SetVanilla(id, value int)
	GetPacked4(id int) int
	SetPacked4(id, value int)
	GetExt(id int) int

	// EF00 variables (ops 40/41/48 write; 45/3A/getItem/money ops read).
	GetVar(a int) int
	SetVar(a, value int)
	GetVarWord(a int) int
	SetVarWord(a, value int)

	// WRAM byte model: op 45 chkMem reads the byte at the EF00 word
	// address; op 4F_45 stores through it. MemReadByte returns -1 and
	// MemStoreByte false for addresses the state does not model, which the
	// VM records as transparent ops (game_state.gd mem_read_byte /
	// mem_store_byte).
	MemReadByte(addr int) int
	MemStoreByte(addr, value int) bool

	// Selection menu state ($D3BF/$D3C0/$D3C1): optA/optB/optC write it,
	// selGoto reads it (vm-semantics §2.3).
	MenuSelection() int
	SetMenuSelection(v int)
	SetMenuOpen(v int)
	MenuCount() int
	SetMenuCount(v int)

	// Runtime state (vm-semantics §6): gold 16-bit with the pay floor 0
	// and receive cap 30000, two bank deposits capped 0xFFFF, the 32-slot
	// inventory (count saturates at 99), the party slot list (4F_31).
	Gold() int
	PayGold(amount int)
	GainGold(amount int)
	AddBankGold(slot, amount int)
	AddItem(id int)
	PartyHasItem(id int) bool
	Party() []int
	SetPartyList(slots []int)

	// Scratch array at WRAM $7FF900 (0d 30/31 variable spill pair).
	GetScratch(i int) int
	SetScratch(i, value int)

	// CustomNameFor resolves the actor-name rule: the leader record's
	// actor id maps to the entered name ($F000/$F300), "" for everyone
	// else and when the default name was kept.
	CustomNameFor(actorID int) string

	// FieldRand rolls the field RNG (C0:0733) for the 4F_16 random
	// branch. lo..hi inclusive, 8-bit width semantics.
	FieldRand(lo, hi int) int

	// Field-side effects of objOps. SpawnActor backs objOp 17 2e;
	// InstallAction backs objOp 17 1f/17 20 (event_driven like
	// game_state.gd install_action).
	SpawnActor()
	InstallAction(obj, id int, eventDriven bool)
}
```

`internal/game/vm/vm.go`:

```go
package vm

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

// Window/page op classes (event_vm.gd constants). PAGE_OPS open a window;
// CLOSE_OPS close one; both end the page next_page() returns.
var pageOps = map[string]bool{"win4D": true, "winSelf": true, "winOther": true, "specialWin": true}
var closeOps = map[string]bool{"closeWin": true}

// Return and page-boundary op notes.
const (
	returnOp   = "endMes" // op 2E: frame return, not a window close (C0:2779)
	pauseOp    = "pause"  // op 2C: blink the cursor until a button; page carries the mark
	pauseMark  = "\f"
	terminator = "end" // op 43: STZ $77; JMP $3783 — ends the caller too
)

// Dispatch words that are call-with-return when CallsEnabled is on
// (engine C0:B847, vm-semantics §2.8). $0049 translates to the map-jump
// handler and stays transparent; $004C/$0031 translate to calls of
// $000C/$000E.
var callWordNotes = map[string]bool{
	"op00": true, "op01": true, "op02": true, "op03": true, "op04": true,
	"op05": true, "op06": true, "op07": true, "op08": true, "op09": true,
	"op0A": true, "op0C": true, "op0E": true, "syscall": true, "pad": true,
}

// State writers (op 36, op 35, op 37/38, op 49 subs 02-05).
var writerNotes = map[string]bool{
	"setFlag": true, "op35": true, "op37": true, "op38": true,
	"op49_02_bitwrite": true, "op49_03_write": true, "op49_04_inc": true, "op49_05_dec": true,
}

// Runtime-state op notes (vm-semantics §6): EF00 writers, getItem, the
// money ops, the party writer, the pointer store, the EF00 increment and
// the 0d 30/31 spill pair.
var runtimeNotes = map[string]bool{
	"set1B": true, "set2B": true, "fill": true, "getItem": true,
	"4F_10": true, "4F_19": true, "4F_31": true, "4F_45": true, "4F_55": true,
	"swapOut": true, "swapBack": true,
}

// possession gates: 0d 07 vi / 0d 09 id ("party carries item"; the ref
// tool's inparty names are misleading, docs/vm-semantics.md §6.2).
var possessionGates = map[string]bool{"inparty?": true, "inparty_id?": true}

// Name-insertion op notes.
var nameOps = map[string]bool{"spk4A": true, "4F_2F": true, "op3B": true, "op39": true, "op3A": true, "4F_50": true}

// VM executes one event's op stream. The parity harness sets TraceEnabled
// + CallsEnabled and drives LoadEvent/AllPages like godot main.gd
// --paritygate does; interactive callers drive NextPage/Choose.
type VM struct {
	ops       []Op
	addrIndex map[string]int
	pc        int
	finished  bool
	end16     string // frame's end address "BANK:xxxx"; "" = unbounded

	// TransparentOps records the notes of ops the VM ran through without a
	// decoded behavior (event_vm.gd transparent_ops).
	TransparentOps []string

	// State is the game state; set before the first NextPage.
	State State
	// Catalog enables tail dispatch, calls and name tables; nil disables
	// dispatch (every DISP/CALL resolves false).
	Catalog Catalog
	// Names supplies item/ally names for the name-insertion ops; nil
	// leaves them at the placeholder.
	Names NameResolver

	// CurrentEventID is the native id of the event now executing (the
	// 4F_16 relative-dispatch base, $D51B).
	CurrentEventID int

	// MenuOptions collects the option texts shown between optA and each
	// optB/optC. PendingChoices is set when a choice handler is installed
	// and a selGoto pauses the VM.
	MenuOptions    []string
	PendingChoices []string
	// ChoiceHandler, when set, makes selGoto pause: the VM returns the
	// page, the UI shows MenuOptions and calls Choose. Nil (the default,
	// and the parity harness) runs the engine's selection state instead.
	ChoiceHandler func(choices []string)

	// Field handlers (nil = the op is transparent, like an unset Callable
	// in the reference). MapMove backs op 10 (map move), MapJump op 11;
	// both enqueue until the shown page is dismissed (vm-semantics §2.8).
	// FollowerSpawn backs objOp 17 2c; LeaderInstruction objOp 17 43.
	MapMove           func(index int)
	MapJump           func(index int)
	FollowerSpawn     func(member int)
	LeaderInstruction func(op, operand int)

	// Parity instrumentation (event_vm.gd): TraceEnabled appends one line
	// per executed op/gate/dispatch to Trace; CallsEnabled runs the
	// dispatch words 00-0E as call-with-return with a call-frame stack.
	TraceEnabled bool
	Trace        []string
	CallsEnabled bool
	callStack    []callFrame

	optionText   string        // text accumulated for the current menu option
	pendingMoves []pendingMove // ops 10/11 enqueued while a page is up
}

type callFrame struct {
	ops       []Op
	pc        int
	id        int
	addrIndex map[string]int
	end16     string
}

type pendingMove struct {
	run   func(index int)
	index int
}

// New returns a VM bound to a catalog (nil allowed).
func New(catalog Catalog) *VM {
	return &VM{Catalog: catalog, addrIndex: map[string]int{}}
}

// LoadEvent installs an event's raw op stream (event_vm.gd load_event).
// The engine pops a frame the moment its PC reaches the event's end16
// (C0:1BB6 -> C0:3756); dump op streams include shared code past it that
// belongs to neighbouring fragments, so execution stops there.
func (v *VM) LoadEvent(rawOps []Op, nativeID int) {
	v.ops = rawOps
	// A fresh index: call frames keep a reference to the caller's, and a
	// join record carries its target as addr — indexing it would make the
	// target jump to itself (internal/bokuno WalkReachable).
	v.addrIndex = make(map[string]int, len(rawOps))
	for i, op := range rawOps {
		if op.Kind != "join" {
			v.addrIndex[op.Addr] = i
		}
	}
	v.pc = 0
	v.finished = len(rawOps) == 0
	v.TransparentOps = nil
	v.CurrentEventID = nativeID
	v.end16 = ""
	if v.Catalog != nil && nativeID > 0 {
		v.end16 = v.Catalog.End16(nativeID)
	}
}

// IsFinished reports whether the event ran to its end.
func (v *VM) IsFinished() bool { return v.finished }

// NextPage runs ops until the next page boundary (window open/close or
// terminator) and returns the page text. "" means the event is finished.
// Tail dispatch into another event continues transparently — the caller
// only sees pages.
func (v *VM) NextPage() string {
	v.flushMoves()
	page := ""
	// One labeled loop, like the GDScript while: every case ends in
	// continue, return, or an explicit break pageLoop (a bare break would
	// only leave the switch).
pageLoop:
	for guard := 0; !v.finished && guard < 100000; guard++ {
		if v.atFrameEnd() {
			// PC reached the frame end: pop (engine C0:1BB6 -> C0:3756,
			// which loops while parents sit at their own end).
			popped := v.popFrame()
			for popped && v.atFrameEnd() {
				popped = v.popFrame()
			}
			if !popped {
				v.finished = true
				break pageLoop
			}
			continue
		}
		op := v.ops[v.pc]
		v.tr("STEP addr=%s", op.Addr)
		switch {
		case op.Kind == "text":
			page += op.Text
			v.optionText += op.Text
			v.pc++
			continue
		case op.Kind == "jumpL" || op.Kind == "jump16" || op.Kind == "join":
			target := op.Target
			// jump16 targets are absolute in the current bank; the dumper
			// omits the bank when it equals the op's own bank (parity fix,
			// docs/parity.md §12.4-3).
			if !strings.Contains(target, ":") {
				bank, _ := addrParts(op.Addr)
				t, err := strconv.ParseUint(target, 16, 16)
				if err != nil {
					panic("vm: malformed jump target " + strconv.Quote(target))
				}
				target = addrStr(bank, int(t))
			}
			i := v.indexAt(target)
			// jumpL targets are traced at the cmd note (JUMPL with the far
			// target); trace here only what the note cannot see.
			if op.Kind == "jump16" {
				v.tr("JUMP kind=jump16 addr=%s target=%s ok=%s", op.Addr, target, okStr(i >= 0))
			}
			if i < 0 {
				v.tr("JUMPFAIL kind=%s target=%s", op.Kind, target)
				v.pc = len(v.ops)
				v.finished = true
			} else {
				v.pc = i
			}
			continue
		}
		note := op.Note
		switch {
		case pageOps[note] || closeOps[note]:
			v.pc++
			if page != "" {
				return page
			}
			continue
		case note == returnOp:
			v.tr("RET2E addr=%s depth=%d", op.Addr, len(v.callStack))
			if v.popFrame() {
				continue
			}
			v.finished = true
			break pageLoop
		case note == "nl":
			page += "\n"
			v.optionText += "\n"
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == pauseOp:
			if page != "" {
				page += pauseMark
			}
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == terminator:
			// op 43 forces depth 0, so it ends the caller too (C0:277D).
			v.tr("END43 addr=%s depth=%d", op.Addr, len(v.callStack))
			v.callStack = nil
			v.finished = true
			break pageLoop
		case op.GateTrue != "":
			gatePass := v.evalGate(note, op)
			v.tr("GATE addr=%s note=%s dec=%s", op.Addr, note, boolStr(gatePass))
			target := op.GateFalse
			if gatePass {
				target = op.GateTrue
			}
			if strings.HasPrefix(target, "event ") {
				id, err := strconv.ParseUint(target[6:], 16, 16)
				if err != nil {
					panic("vm: malformed gate target " + strconv.Quote(target))
				}
				if !v.dispatch(int(id)) {
					break pageLoop
				}
			} else {
				i := v.indexAt(target[5:])
				if i < 0 {
					v.pc = len(v.ops)
					v.finished = true
				} else {
					v.pc = i
				}
			}
			continue
		case note == "skip":
			// op 4E nn: unconditional forward skip, footprint nn + 2 bytes
			// (C0:2254); its operand is a byte count, not an op count.
			nn := 0
			if parts := strings.Split(op.Hex, " "); len(parts) > 1 {
				p, err := strconv.ParseUint(parts[1], 16, 8)
				if err != nil {
					panic("vm: malformed skip operand " + op.Hex)
				}
				nn = int(p)
			}
			bank, a := addrParts(op.Addr)
			i := v.indexAt(addrStr(bank, a+2+nn))
			if i < 0 {
				v.pc = len(v.ops)
				v.finished = true
			} else {
				v.pc = i
			}
			continue
		case note == "selGoto" && v.ChoiceHandler != nil:
			v.PendingChoices = append([]string(nil), v.MenuOptions...)
			return page // caller shows the choices, then calls Choose
		case note == "selGoto":
			r := v.State.MenuSelection()
			if r == 0xFF {
				// engine C0:2E7A: r = $D3C1 - 1, then AND #$00FF — a 0
				// count wraps to 255, it does not become -1 (parity fix,
				// docs/parity.md §12.4-4).
				r = (v.State.MenuCount() - 1) & 0xFF
			}
			bank, a := addrParts(op.Addr)
			recAddr := a + 1 + 2*r
			i := v.indexAt(addrStr(bank, recAddr))
			if i < 0 {
				v.finished = true
				continue
			}
			b := firstByteOf(v.ops[i])
			v.tr("SELGOTO addr=%s sel=%d target=%s", op.Addr, r, addrStr(bank, recAddr))
			if b >= 0 && b < 0x0C {
				// big-endian pair: dispatch event (b, next byte)
				id := 0
				if parts := strings.Split(v.ops[i].Hex, " "); len(parts) >= 2 {
					b1, e1 := strconv.ParseUint(parts[0], 16, 8)
					b2, e2 := strconv.ParseUint(parts[1], 16, 8)
					if e1 != nil || e2 != nil {
						panic("vm: malformed selGoto record " + v.ops[i].Hex)
					}
					id = int(b1)<<8 | int(b2)
					v.tr("SELGOTODISP id=%04X", id)
				}
				if !v.dispatch(id) {
					break pageLoop
				}
			} else {
				v.pc = i
			}
			continue
		case note == "4F_16":
			// 4f 16 nn random branch (C0:2EF3): $0D = nn-1, roll 0..nn-1 on
			// the shared field RNG (nn = 0 rolls 0..255); r == 0 continues,
			// else dispatches the current event id + r.
			nn := 0
			if parts := strings.Split(op.Hex, " "); len(parts) > 2 {
				p, err := strconv.ParseUint(parts[2], 16, 8)
				if err != nil {
					panic("vm: malformed 4F_16 operand " + op.Hex)
				}
				nn = int(p)
			}
			roll := v.State.FieldRand(0, (nn-1)&0xFF)
			v.tr("RAND addr=%s nn=%d roll=%d", op.Addr, nn, roll)
			if roll == 0 {
				v.pc++
			} else if !v.dispatch((v.CurrentEventID + roll) & 0xFFFF) {
				break pageLoop
			}
			continue
		case note == "jumpL" || note == "callL":
			// far jump/call targets (0d 17/18, vm-semantics §2.4): traced
			// for parity; the target code usually lies outside the event
			// catalog, so execution stays here (transparent) unless the
			// k-entry below resolves it. callL (5A:B9B0) pushes a return
			// record and runs the target until its op 2E; the export
			// decodes the target as a segment of this event
			// (WalkReachable), so the frame keeps the ops.
			if fb := hexBytes(op.Hex); len(fb) >= 5 {
				tgt := addrStr(fb[4], fb[2]|fb[3]<<8)
				ti := v.indexAt(tgt)
				v.tr("%s addr=%s target=%s ok=%s", strings.ToUpper(note), op.Addr, tgt, okStr(ti >= 0))
				if note == "callL" && v.CallsEnabled && ti >= 0 {
					v.pushFrame()
					v.pc = ti
					continue
				}
			}
			v.pc++
			continue
		case v.CallsEnabled && callWordNotes[note]:
			// dispatch words 00-0E: call-with-return (engine C0:B847).
			if cw := hexBytes(op.Hex); len(cw) >= 2 {
				word := cw[0] | cw[1]<<8
				if word == 0x0049 {
					v.pc++ // $0049 -> $000D map jump: transparent here
					continue
				}
				// C0:B847 XBAs the queue word: `0b 39` calls event $0B39
				// (live: `08 46` in event 0800 -> $D51B = 0846).
				cid := cw[0]<<8 | cw[1]
				if word == 0x004C {
					cid = 0x000C
				} else if word == 0x0031 {
					cid = 0x000E
				}
				if v.callEvent(cid, op.Addr) {
					continue
				}
			}
			v.pc++
			continue
		case writerNotes[note]:
			v.applyWrite(note, op)
			v.pc++
			continue
		case runtimeNotes[note]:
			v.applyRuntimeOp(note, op)
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == "op4C":
			// gold gate: gold >= EF00 word1. TRUE -> S+1, FALSE -> S+2
			// (engine C0:2B4E; event 004E sets EF01 = price first).
			afford := v.State.Gold() >= v.State.GetVarWord(1)
			v.tr("GATE addr=%s note=op4C dec=%s", op.Addr, boolStr(afford))
			bank, a := addrParts(op.Addr)
			off := 2
			if afford {
				off = 1
			}
			if !v.gotoAddr(addrStr(bank, a+off)) {
				break pageLoop
			}
			continue
		case possessionGates[note]:
			// 0d 07 vi: party carries item vars[vi]; 0d 09 id: direct id.
			// Same gate contract as 33/34/45: TRUE -> S+3, FALSE -> S+5.
			b := hexBytes(op.Hex)
			held := false
			if note == "inparty?" {
				held = v.State.PartyHasItem(v.State.GetVar(b[2]))
			} else {
				held = v.State.PartyHasItem(b[2])
			}
			v.tr("GATE addr=%s note=%s dec=%s", op.Addr, note, boolStr(held))
			bank, a := addrParts(op.Addr)
			off := 5
			if held {
				off = 3
			}
			if !v.gotoAddr(addrStr(bank, a+off)) {
				break pageLoop
			}
			continue
		case note == "optA":
			v.State.SetMenuOpen(0)
			v.State.SetMenuCount(0)
			v.State.SetMenuSelection(0xFF)
			v.MenuOptions = nil
			v.optionText = ""
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == "optB" || note == "optC":
			v.MenuOptions = append(v.MenuOptions, v.optionText)
			v.optionText = ""
			// engine: only op 26 INCs $D3C1 (C0:1F55); op 27's whole body
			// C0:1F9E..C0:2043 ends JMP $1C7A without touching it, so optC
			// entries display but must not count (a counted optC shifts
			// selGoto's r = $D3C1-1 fallback onto the wrong option).
			if note == "optB" {
				v.State.SetMenuCount(v.State.MenuCount() + 1)
			}
			v.pc++
			continue
		case nameOps[note]:
			// 4A / 4F_2F actor and 3B place resolve via the catalog's
			// tables; 39 party member / 3A + 4F_50 item resolve through
			// the runtime state.
			name := v.insertName(note, op)
			page += name
			v.optionText += name
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == "objOp" && op.Hex == "17 2e":
			v.tr("ACTOR gfx=%02X at=%d,%d", v.State.GetVar(0), v.State.GetVar(1), v.State.GetVar(2))
			v.State.SpawnActor()
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == "objOp" && op.Hex == "17 2c" && v.FollowerSpawn != nil:
			v.tr("FOLLOWER member=%d", v.State.GetVar(0))
			v.FollowerSpawn(v.State.GetVar(0))
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == "objOp" && op.Hex == "17 1f":
			// objOp 1F (C0:B1F7): install without $D99A bit 7.
			v.tr("ACTION1F obj=%02X id=%04X", v.State.GetVar(0), v.State.GetVarWord(1))
			v.State.InstallAction(v.State.GetVar(0), v.State.GetVarWord(1), false)
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == "objOp" && op.Hex == "17 20":
			// install an object action script: object EF00[0], script EF01.
			v.tr("ACTION obj=%02X id=%04X", v.State.GetVar(0), v.State.GetVarWord(1))
			v.State.InstallAction(v.State.GetVar(0), v.State.GetVarWord(1), true)
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == "objOp" && op.Hex == "17 43" && v.LeaderInstruction != nil:
			v.tr("LEADER1B operand=5B")
			v.LeaderInstruction(0x1B, 0x5B)
			v.pc++
			continue
		case note == "op32":
			// 32 b0 b1: tail-dispatch event b0<<8|b1 (C0:2F14 XBA -> $1B4C);
			// 0846 ends `32 08 48` -> 0848 (live `id=0848` at frame 11542).
			d32 := hexBytes(op.Hex)
			if !v.dispatch(d32[1]<<8 | d32[2]) {
				break pageLoop
			}
			continue
		case note == "op10" && v.MapMove != nil:
			mm := hexBytes(op.Hex)
			v.tr("MAPMOVE addr=%s index=%02X", op.Addr, mm[1])
			v.pendingMoves = append(v.pendingMoves, pendingMove{run: v.MapMove, index: mm[1]})
			v.pc++
			if page != "" {
				break pageLoop // the page shows before the queued move runs
			}
			v.flushMoves()
			continue
		case note == "mapJump" && v.MapJump != nil:
			mj := hexBytes(op.Hex)
			v.tr("MAPJUMP addr=%s index=%02X", op.Addr, mj[1])
			v.pendingMoves = append(v.pendingMoves, pendingMove{run: v.MapJump, index: mj[1]})
			v.pc++
			if page != "" {
				break pageLoop
			}
			v.flushMoves()
			continue
		default:
			// everything else is transparent for now
			v.TransparentOps = append(v.TransparentOps, note)
			v.pc++
			continue
		}
	}
	if v.pc >= len(v.ops) {
		v.finished = true
	}
	return page
}

// Choose resolves a paused selection menu: applies the engine's selection
// state and continues execution (the 2F branch runs on the next
// NextPage).
func (v *VM) Choose(index int) {
	v.State.SetMenuSelection(index)
	v.ChoiceHandler = nil
	v.NextPage()
}

// AllPages runs the event to its end and returns every page (event_vm.gd
// all_pages).
func (v *VM) AllPages() []string {
	var pages []string
	for guard := 0; !v.finished && guard < 1000; guard++ {
		p := v.NextPage()
		if p == "" {
			break
		}
		pages = append(pages, p)
	}
	return pages
}

// ---- trace ---------------------------------------------------------------

// atFrameEnd reports whether the PC reached the frame's end (engine
// C0:1BB6): past the stream, or on the event's end16 op.
func (v *VM) atFrameEnd() bool {
	return v.pc >= len(v.ops) || (v.end16 != "" && v.ops[v.pc].Addr == v.end16)
}

func (v *VM) tr(format string, args ...any) {
	if v.TraceEnabled {
		v.Trace = append(v.Trace, fmt.Sprintf(format, args...))
	}
}

func boolStr(b bool) string {
	if b {
		return "TRUE"
	}
	return "FALSE"
}

func okStr(b bool) string {
	if b {
		return "true"
	}
	return "false"
}

// ---- calls and dispatches --------------------------------------------------

// pushFrame stores the caller's frame (engine C0:1B22, 5-byte record).
func (v *VM) pushFrame() {
	v.callStack = append(v.callStack, callFrame{
		ops: v.ops, pc: v.pc, id: v.CurrentEventID, addrIndex: v.addrIndex, end16: v.end16,
	})
}

// callEvent runs the queue-word call-with-return (engine C0:B847 -> JSR
// $C0:1B22): push the caller frame, load the callee; the frame pop
// resumes at the byte after the call word, i.e. index + 1.
func (v *VM) callEvent(nativeID int, fromAddr string) bool {
	if v.Catalog == nil || !v.Catalog.HasEvent(nativeID) {
		v.tr("CALL addr=%s id=%04X ok=false", fromAddr, nativeID)
		return false
	}
	v.tr("CALL addr=%s id=%04X ok=true", fromAddr, nativeID)
	v.pushFrame()
	v.LoadEvent(v.Catalog.RawOps(nativeID), nativeID)
	return true
}

// popFrame restores the caller (engine C0:3756). Returns false when the
// stack is empty (the root frame ended -> event finished).
func (v *VM) popFrame() bool {
	if len(v.callStack) == 0 {
		return false
	}
	f := v.callStack[len(v.callStack)-1]
	v.callStack = v.callStack[:len(v.callStack)-1]
	v.ops = f.ops
	v.addrIndex = f.addrIndex
	// the caller's frame end: live, 0800 ends at its own FC:08EF right
	// after the `08 46` call returns (`SCRIPTEND vmpc=FC08EF depth=0`)
	v.end16 = f.end16
	v.pc = f.pc + 1
	v.CurrentEventID = f.id
	v.finished = false
	v.tr("RET id=%04X depth=%d", v.CurrentEventID, len(v.callStack))
	return true
}

// dispatch tail-dispatches: replace the current script with event id's
// stream. Returns false when the catalog lacks the event (VM finishes).
func (v *VM) dispatch(nativeID int) bool {
	if v.Catalog == nil || !v.Catalog.HasEvent(nativeID) {
		v.tr("DISP from=%04X to=%04X ok=false", v.CurrentEventID, nativeID)
		v.finished = true
		return false
	}
	v.tr("DISP from=%04X to=%04X ok=true", v.CurrentEventID, nativeID)
	v.LoadEvent(v.Catalog.RawOps(nativeID), nativeID)
	return true
}

// ---- addressing ------------------------------------------------------------

func (v *VM) indexAt(addr string) int {
	i, ok := v.addrIndex[addr]
	if !ok {
		return -1
	}
	return i
}

// gotoAddr moves execution to the op at addr; false when the stream
// lacks it (VM finishes, matching the missing-target behavior of gates).
func (v *VM) gotoAddr(addr string) bool {
	i := v.indexAt(addr)
	if i < 0 {
		v.finished = true
		return false
	}
	v.pc = i
	return true
}

// flushMoves runs the ops 10/11 words enqueued while a page was up
// (event_vm.gd _flush_moves).
func (v *VM) flushMoves() {
	moves := v.pendingMoves
	v.pendingMoves = nil
	for _, m := range moves {
		m.run(m.index)
	}
}

// ---- gate evaluation --------------------------------------------------------

// flagOperand is the exporter's operand object for the flag ops (JSON in
// Op.Operand, internal/bokuno ops.go operandOf).
type flagOperand struct {
	ID        int    `json:"id"`
	Window    int    `json:"window"`
	Mask      int    `json:"mask"`
	RawArg    int    `json:"rawArg"`
	Value     int    `json:"value"`
	OperandV  int    `json:"operand"`
	Operation string `json:"operation"`
}

func (v *VM) operandOf(op Op) flagOperand {
	var o flagOperand
	if op.Operand != "" {
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(op.Operand), &o); err != nil {
			panic("vm: malformed operand " + op.Operand + ": " + err.Error())
		}
	}
	return o
}

// evalGate returns true when the gate passes (TRUE continuation) —
// vm-semantics §2.1: 33/34/45 (C0:2F5F/2FC1/2F22), the 49-family checks,
// and the 0D 00/01 checks (5A:B05E/B09B).
func (v *VM) evalGate(note string, op Op) bool {
	o := v.operandOf(op)
	inWindow := func(vv int) bool { return o.Window>>4 <= vv && vv <= o.Window&0xF }
	bitSet := func(vv, arg int) bool {
		bit := vv&(arg&0xF) != 0
		if arg&0x80 != 0 {
			bit = !bit
		}
		return bit
	}
	switch note {
	case "chkFlag":
		return inWindow(v.State.GetVanilla(o.ID))
	case "chkBit":
		arg := o.Window
		if hasOperandKey(op.Operand, "rawArg") {
			arg = o.RawArg
		}
		return bitSet(v.State.GetVanilla(o.ID), arg)
	case "chkMem":
		// 45 a b: the export carries no operand, the bytes are the source.
		b := hexBytes(op.Hex)
		addr := v.State.GetVarWord(b[1])
		vv := v.State.MemReadByte(addr)
		if vv < 0 {
			v.TransparentOps = append(v.TransparentOps, fmt.Sprintf("chkMem<-%04x", addr))
		}
		return vv == b[2]
	case "op49_00_check":
		return inWindow(v.State.GetPacked4(o.ID))
	case "op49_01_bitcheck":
		arg := o.Mask
		if hasOperandKey(op.Operand, "rawArg") {
			arg = o.RawArg
		}
		return bitSet(v.State.GetPacked4(o.ID), arg)
	case "chk4":
		return inWindow(v.State.GetExt(o.ID))
	case "chk01":
		arg := o.Mask
		if hasOperandKey(op.Operand, "rawArg") {
			arg = o.RawArg
		}
		return bitSet(v.State.GetExt(o.ID), arg)
	}
	return false
}

// hasOperandKey reports whether an operand JSON object carries a key. The
// GDScript reference falls back through operand.get("rawArg",
// operand.get("window", 0)) — rawArg when present, else the named
// fallback.
func hasOperandKey(operand, key string) bool {
	if operand == "" {
		return false
	}
	var m map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(operand), &m); err != nil {
		panic("vm: malformed operand " + operand + ": " + err.Error())
	}
	_, has := m[key]
	return has
}

// ---- state-mutating writers ---------------------------------------------------

func (v *VM) applyWrite(note string, op Op) {
	o := v.operandOf(op)
	id := o.ID
	switch note {
	case "setFlag": // op 36
		v.State.SetVanilla(id, o.Value)
	case "op35": // 35: or/and with mask
		vv := v.State.GetVanilla(id)
		if o.Operation == "or" {
			v.State.SetVanilla(id, vv|o.Mask)
		} else {
			v.State.SetVanilla(id, vv&o.Mask)
		}
	case "op37":
		v.State.SetVanilla(id, v.State.GetVanilla(id)+1) // saturating below 0x10
	case "op38":
		v.State.SetVanilla(id, v.State.GetVanilla(id)-1)
	case "op49_02_bitwrite":
		vv := v.State.GetPacked4(id)
		if o.Operation == "or" {
			v.State.SetPacked4(id, vv|o.OperandV)
		} else {
			v.State.SetPacked4(id, vv&o.OperandV)
		}
	case "op49_03_write":
		v.State.SetPacked4(id, o.Value)
	case "op49_04_inc":
		v.State.SetPacked4(id, v.State.GetPacked4(id)+1)
	case "op49_05_dec":
		v.State.SetPacked4(id, v.State.GetPacked4(id)-1)
	}
}

// applyRuntimeOp applies the runtime-state ops (vm-semantics §6). Byte
// layouts are the engine decodes cited there.
func (v *VM) applyRuntimeOp(note string, op Op) {
	b := hexBytes(op.Hex)
	switch note {
	case "set1B": // 40 id val: EF00[id] = val (C0:2226)
		if len(b) >= 3 {
			v.State.SetVar(b[1], b[2])
		}
	case "set2B": // 41 id lo hi: EF00[id..+1] = lo|hi<<8 (C0:223C)
		if len(b) >= 4 {
			v.State.SetVarWord(b[1], b[2]|b[3]<<8)
		}
	case "fill": // 48 id n bytes...: EF00[id..id+n-1] (C0:21FD, n==0 means 1)
		if len(b) >= 3 {
			count := b[2]
			if count <= 0 {
				count = 1
			}
			for k := 0; k < count && k < len(b)-3; k++ {
				v.State.SetVar(b[1]+k, b[3+k])
			}
		}
	case "getItem": // 42 x: give item EF00[x], count saturates at 99 (C0:2E1F)
		if len(b) >= 2 {
			v.State.AddItem(v.State.GetVar(b[1]))
		}
	case "4F_10": // pay: gold -= EF00 word0, floor 0 (C0:29A1)
		v.State.PayGold(v.State.GetVarWord(0))
	case "4F_19": // EF03 == 0: gold += EF01 word, cap 30000 (C0:3947);
		// otherwise the amount goes to the two bank deposits.
		if v.State.GetVar(3) == 0 {
			v.State.GainGold(v.State.GetVarWord(1))
		} else {
			v.State.AddBankGold(0, v.State.GetVarWord(1))
			v.State.AddBankGold(1, v.State.GetVarWord(3))
		}
	case "4F_31": // 4f 31 b0..b5: party slots $F323-$F328 = b0..b5 (C0:20EC);
		// $FF = empty slot, dropped. This is the only event op that writes
		// membership (vm-semantics §6.3).
		if len(b) >= 8 {
			v.State.SetPartyList([]int{b[2], b[3], b[4], b[5], b[6], b[7]})
		}
	case "4F_45": // 4f 45 a b: WRAM[$7E:EF00word(b)] = EF00[EF00[a]] (C0:3688).
		// The dump set only writes $F322 through this op.
		if len(b) >= 4 {
			value := v.State.GetVar(v.State.GetVar(b[2]))
			addr := v.State.GetVarWord(b[3])
			if !v.State.MemStoreByte(addr, value) {
				v.TransparentOps = append(v.TransparentOps, fmt.Sprintf("4F_45->%04x", addr))
			}
		}
	case "4F_55": // 4f 55 x: EF00[x] += 1, no store when it would wrap to 0 (C0:2DD5)
		vv := v.State.GetVar(b[2]) + 1
		if vv <= 0xFF {
			v.State.SetVar(b[2], vv)
		}
	case "swapOut": // 0d 30 a b: scratch[b] = EF00[0]; first operand dead
		// (read then discarded, engine 5A:C000).
		if len(b) >= 4 {
			v.State.SetScratch(b[3], v.State.GetVar(0))
		}
	case "swapBack": // 0d 31 a b: EF00[b] = scratch[a], scratch[a] = 0
		// (engine 5A:C020).
		if len(b) >= 4 {
			v.State.SetVar(b[3], v.State.GetScratch(b[2]))
			v.State.SetScratch(b[2], 0)
		}
	}
}

// ---- name insertion -----------------------------------------------------------

// insertName resolves name-insertion ops (event_vm.gd _insert_name). A
// name the tables lack renders as the placeholder, never as "".
func (v *VM) insertName(note string, op Op) string {
	parts := strings.Split(op.Hex, " ")
	id := -1
	if len(parts) >= 2 {
		p, err := strconv.ParseUint(parts[1], 16, 8)
		if err != nil {
			panic("vm: malformed name op " + op.Hex)
		}
		id = int(p)
	}
	name := ""
	switch note {
	case "spk4A": // 4A id: actor name, entered name for the leader (C0:3188)
		name = v.actorName(id)
	case "4F_2F": // 4F 2F x: actor name of EF00[x] (C0:31A6), same leader rule
		if b := hexBytes(op.Hex); len(b) >= 3 {
			name = v.actorName(v.State.GetVar(b[2]))
		}
	case "op3B":
		if v.Catalog != nil {
			name = v.Catalog.PlaceName(id)
		}
	case "op39": // party member name, slot = operand (engine C0:31F2:
		// record at $F000 + 128*slot)
		party := v.State.Party()
		if id >= 0 && id < len(party) && v.Names != nil {
			name = v.Names.AllyName(party[id])
		}
	case "4F_50": // item name of EF00[0] (engine C0:2D37 -> JSL $55CB80)
		if v.Names != nil {
			name = v.Names.ItemName(v.State.GetVar(0))
		}
	default: // op3A: item name of EF00[operand] (engine C0:32EC)
		if id >= 0 && v.Names != nil {
			name = v.Names.ItemName(v.State.GetVar(id))
		}
	}
	if name == "" {
		return "〔名字〕"
	}
	return name
}

func (v *VM) actorName(id int) string {
	if custom := v.State.CustomNameFor(id); custom != "" {
		return custom
	}
	if v.Catalog != nil {
		return v.Catalog.ActorName(id)
	}
	return ""
}
```

`internal/game/vm/vm_test.go`:

```go
package vm

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"

// ---- fakes -----------------------------------------------------------------

// testState is the State fake: game_state.gd's spaces with a scripted
// field RNG. Equipment stays empty, so PartyHasItem is the bag only —
// the parity snapshot state carries no equipment either.
type testState struct {
	vanilla, packed4 [256]byte
	ext              [512]byte
	vars             [256]byte
	scratch          [256]byte
	menuSel          int
	menuOpen         int
	menuCount        int
	gold             int
	bank             [2]int
	party            []int
	inventory        map[int]int
	walkID           int      // WRAM $F322, -1 = never written
	protagonistName  string   // WRAM $F300, "" = the default table name
	rolls            []int    // scripted FieldRand results, consumed in order
	actorSpawns      int      // SpawnActor calls
	actionInstalls   [][3]int // InstallAction (obj, id, eventDriven 0/1)
	moved            []int    // flushed map move/jump indices
}

func newTestState() *testState {
	return &testState{inventory: map[int]int{}, walkID: -1}
}

// recordIDs is the opening member-record table (vm-semantics §6.5
// correction: 4F_31 lists record slots; game_state.gd RECORD_IDS).
var recordIDs = [6]int{0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6}

// selectRows maps the character-select row to the ally id (game_state.gd
// SELECT_ROWS; FE:961B+1). Row 0 is the default pick.
var selectRows = [8]int{0, 3, 5, 4, 2, 1, 6, 7}

func (s *testState) GetVanilla(id int) int  { return nibbleAt(s.vanilla[:], id&0xFF) }
func (s *testState) SetVanilla(id, v int)   { setNibbleAt(s.vanilla[:], id&0xFF, v) }
func (s *testState) GetPacked4(id int) int  { return nibbleAt(s.packed4[:], id&0xFF) }
func (s *testState) SetPacked4(id, v int)   { setNibbleAt(s.packed4[:], id&0xFF, v) }
func (s *testState) GetExt(id int) int      { return nibbleAt(s.ext[:], id&0x1FF) }
func (s *testState) GetVar(a int) int       { return int(s.vars[a&0xFF]) }
func (s *testState) SetVar(a, v int)        { s.vars[a&0xFF] = byte(v & 0xFF) }
func (s *testState) GetVarWord(a int) int   { return s.GetVar(a) | s.GetVar(a+1)<<8 }
func (s *testState) SetVarWord(a, v int)    { s.SetVar(a, v&0xFF); s.SetVar(a+1, (v>>8)&0xFF) }
func (s *testState) MenuSelection() int     { return s.menuSel }
func (s *testState) SetMenuSelection(v int) { s.menuSel = v }
func (s *testState) SetMenuOpen(v int)      { s.menuOpen = v }
func (s *testState) MenuCount() int         { return s.menuCount }
func (s *testState) SetMenuCount(v int)     { s.menuCount = v }
func (s *testState) Gold() int              { return s.gold }
func (s *testState) PayGold(amount int)     { s.gold = maxInt(s.gold-amount, 0) }
func (s *testState) GainGold(amount int)    { s.gold = minInt(s.gold+amount, 30000) }
func (s *testState) AddBankGold(slot, amount int) {
	s.bank[slot] = minInt(s.bank[slot]+amount, 0xFFFF)
}
func (s *testState) AddItem(id int) {
	s.inventory[id] = minInt(s.inventory[id]+1, 99)
}
func (s *testState) PartyHasItem(id int) bool { return s.inventory[id] > 0 }
func (s *testState) Party() []int             { return s.party }
func (s *testState) GetScratch(i int) int     { return int(s.scratch[i&0xFF]) }
func (s *testState) SetScratch(i, v int)      { s.scratch[i&0xFF] = byte(v & 0xFF) }

// SetPartyList maps record slots through the record table, dropping $FF
// empties and duplicates (game_state.gd set_party_list).
func (s *testState) SetPartyList(slots []int) {
	s.party = nil
	for _, k := range slots {
		if k == 0xFF || k >= len(recordIDs) {
			continue
		}
		id := recordIDs[k]
		found := false
		for _, p := range s.party {
			if p == id {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			s.party = append(s.party, id)
		}
	}
}

// CustomNameFor: the leader record's actor id maps to the entered name
// ($F000/$F300 rule, C0:3188/31A6); row 0's pick is ally 0.
func (s *testState) CustomNameFor(actorID int) string {
	if actorID == selectRows[0] {
		return s.protagonistName
	}
	return ""
}

// FieldRand pops the scripted rolls; an unscheduled roll is a harness bug
// and fails loudly.
func (s *testState) FieldRand(lo, hi int) int {
	if len(s.rolls) == 0 {
		panic("FieldRand: no scripted roll left")
	}
	r := s.rolls[0]
	s.rolls = s.rolls[1:]
	return r
}

func (s *testState) SpawnActor() { s.actorSpawns++ }

func (s *testState) InstallAction(obj, id int, eventDriven bool) {
	ed := 0
	if eventDriven {
		ed = 1
	}
	s.actionInstalls = append(s.actionInstalls, [3]int{obj, id, ed})
}

// MemReadByte models the WRAM addresses game_state.gd models (game_state.gd
// mem_read_byte; $F30E is not modeled and returns -1 there too).
func (s *testState) MemReadByte(addr int) int {
	switch {
	case addr >= 0xEF00 && addr <= 0xEFFF:
		return s.GetVar(addr - 0xEF00)
	case addr >= 0xF46A && addr < 0xF46A+128:
		return int(s.vanilla[addr-0xF46A])
	case addr >= 0xF4EA && addr < 0xF4EA+32:
		return 0 // treasure bytes, zero in the snapshots
	case addr >= 0xF30A && addr < 0xF30A+4:
		return 0 // play clock bytes, zero in the snapshots
	case addr == 0xF000:
		return selectRows[0]
	case addr == 0xF319:
		return len(s.party)
	case addr == 0xF322:
		return s.walkID & 0xFF
	case addr >= 0xF323 && addr <= 0xF328:
		if i := addr - 0xF323; i < len(s.party) {
			return s.party[i]
		}
		return 0xFF
	}
	return -1
}

// MemStoreByte models the one address the dump set writes ($F322).
func (s *testState) MemStoreByte(addr, value int) bool {
	if addr == 0xF322 {
		s.walkID = value & 0xFF
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func nibbleAt(arr []byte, id int) int {
	b := arr[id>>1]
	if id%2 == 0 {
		return int(b >> 4)
	}
	return int(b & 0xF)
}

func setNibbleAt(arr []byte, id, v int) {
	v &= 0xF
	i := id >> 1
	if id%2 == 0 {
		arr[i] = (arr[i] & 0x0F) | byte(v<<4)
	} else {
		arr[i] = (arr[i] & 0xF0) | byte(v)
	}
}

func minInt(a, b int) int {
	if a < b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

func maxInt(a, b int) int {
	if a > b {
		return a
	}
	return b
}

// fakeCatalog is the Catalog fake for hand-built event streams.
type fakeCatalog struct {
	events map[int][]Op
	end16s map[int]string
	actors map[int]string
	places map[int]string
}

func (f *fakeCatalog) HasEvent(id int) bool    { _, ok := f.events[id]; return ok }
func (f *fakeCatalog) RawOps(id int) []Op      { return f.events[id] }
func (f *fakeCatalog) End16(id int) string     { return f.end16s[id] }
func (f *fakeCatalog) ActorName(id int) string { return f.actors[id] }
func (f *fakeCatalog) PlaceName(id int) string { return f.places[id] }

// cmd builds a cmd op.
func cmd(addr, hex, note string) Op {
	return Op{Kind: "cmd", Addr: addr, Hex: hex, Note: note}
}

// gate builds a 3-byte gate cmd op with both continuations and the
// exporter's operand object. 33/34/45 gates are 3 bytes: TRUE continues at
// S+3, FALSE at S+5 (vm-semantics §2.1).
func gate(addr, hex, note, operand string) Op {
	op := cmd(addr, hex, note)
	op.Operand = operand
	op.GateTrue = "addr " + addrStr(0xFA, mustAddr(addr)+3)
	op.GateFalse = "addr " + addrStr(0xFA, mustAddr(addr)+5)
	return op
}

func mustAddr(addr string) int {
	_, a := addrParts(addr)
	return a
}

func text(addr, s string) Op {
	return Op{Kind: "text", Addr: addr, Hex: "81", Text: s}
}

// runPages replays an event to its end and returns the pages plus the
// trace.
func runPages(t *testing.T, cat Catalog, id int, ops []Op, st *testState) ([]string, []string) {
	t.Helper()
	vm := New(cat)
	vm.State = st
	vm.TraceEnabled = true
	vm.CallsEnabled = true
	vm.LoadEvent(ops, id)
	pages := vm.AllPages()
	return pages, vm.Trace
}

// traceLines filters the trace for one prefix.
func traceLines(trace []string, prefix string) []string {
	var out []string
	for _, l := range trace {
		if len(l) >= len(prefix) && l[:len(prefix)] == prefix {
			out = append(out, l)
		}
	}
	return out
}

func lastPage(pages []string) string {
	if len(pages) == 0 {
		return "<none>"
	}
	return pages[len(pages)-1]
}

// ---- gates -----------------------------------------------------------------

// TestGateChkFlagWindow: op 33 reads the flag's nibble and passes when
// window>>4 <= value <= window&0xF (C0:2F5F, machine-verified;
// vm-semantics §2.1). `33 86 66` is event 0001's flag 134 window 66 =
// range [6,6].
func TestGateChkFlagWindow(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: {
		gate("FA:0100", "33 86 66", "chkFlag",
			`{"space":"flag.vanilla","id":134,"window":102,"rangeStart":6,"rangeEnd":6,"write":false}`),
		text("FA:0103", "TRUE"),
		cmd("FA:0104", "2a", "closeWin"),
		text("FA:0105", "FALSE"),
		cmd("FA:0106", "2a", "closeWin"),
	}}}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		flag int
		want string
	}{{6, "TRUE"}, {5, "FALSE"}, {7, "FALSE"}} {
		st := newTestState()
		setNibbleAt(st.vanilla[:], 134, c.flag)
		pages, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)
		if pages[0] != c.want {
			t.Fatalf("flag %d: pages %v, want first page %s", c.flag, pages, c.want)
		}
	}
}

// TestGateChkBitInvert: op 34 tests (value & (arg&0xF)) != 0, and arg&0x80
// inverts the result (C0:2FC1, machine-verified; vm-semantics §2.1).
// `34 20 87`: id 0x20, mask 7, inverted; the exporter carries the raw arg
// in the window field for op 34 (no rawArg key).
func TestGateChkBitInvert(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: {
		gate("FA:0100", "34 20 87", "chkBit",
			`{"space":"flag.vanilla","id":32,"window":135,"write":false}`),
		text("FA:0103", "TRUE"),
		cmd("FA:0104", "2a", "closeWin"),
		text("FA:0105", "FALSE"),
		cmd("FA:0106", "2a", "closeWin"),
	}}}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		flag int
		want string
	}{{0, "TRUE"}, {1, "FALSE"}, {7, "FALSE"}} {
		st := newTestState()
		setNibbleAt(st.vanilla[:], 0x20, c.flag)
		pages, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)
		if pages[0] != c.want {
			t.Fatalf("chkBit flag %#x: pages %v, want first page %s", c.flag, pages, c.want)
		}
	}
}

// TestExtSpaceGates: the 0D 00/01 family reads the ext nibble space with
// the same contracts as the vanilla gates — chk4 passes inside the window
// (5A:B05E), chk01 tests a bit with the rawArg inversion (5A:B09B); the
// op 49 packed4 gates mirror both on their space (vm-semantics §2.1/§2.5).
func TestExtSpaceGates(t *testing.T) {
	runGate := func(t *testing.T, note, operand string, extVal, packed4Val int) string {
		t.Helper()
		cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: {
			gate("FA:0100", "0d 00 01 06", note, operand),
			text("FA:0103", "TRUE"),
			cmd("FA:0104", "2a", "closeWin"),
			text("FA:0105", "FALSE"),
			cmd("FA:0106", "2a", "closeWin"),
		}}}
		st := newTestState()
		setNibbleAt(st.ext[:], 262, extVal) // id 0x106
		setNibbleAt(st.packed4[:], 0x20, packed4Val)
		pages, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)
		return pages[0]
	}
	for _, c := range []struct {
		note, operand      string
		extVal, packed4Val int
		want               string
	}{
		// chk4: window 102 = range [6,6].
		{"chk4", `{"space":"flag.ext","id":262,"window":102}`, 6, 0, "TRUE"},
		{"chk4", `{"space":"flag.ext","id":262,"window":102}`, 5, 0, "FALSE"},
		{"chk4", `{"space":"flag.ext","id":262,"window":102}`, 7, 0, "FALSE"},
		// chk01: the mask field carries the raw arg 0x87 — bit 7, inverted.
		{"chk01", `{"space":"flag.ext","id":262,"mask":135}`, 0, 0, "TRUE"},
		{"chk01", `{"space":"flag.ext","id":262,"mask":135}`, 1, 0, "FALSE"},
		// op49_00_check: the packed4 window gate.
		{"op49_00_check", `{"id":32,"window":102}`, 0, 6, "TRUE"},
		{"op49_00_check", `{"id":32,"window":102}`, 0, 7, "FALSE"},
		// op49_01_bitcheck: rawArg 0x87 present — inverted bit test.
		{"op49_01_bitcheck", `{"id":32,"mask":7,"rawArg":135}`, 0, 0, "TRUE"},
		{"op49_01_bitcheck", `{"id":32,"mask":7,"rawArg":135}`, 0, 1, "FALSE"},
		// op49_01_bitcheck without rawArg falls back to the mask, no inversion.
		{"op49_01_bitcheck", `{"id":32,"mask":7}`, 0, 1, "TRUE"},
	} {
		if got := runGate(t, c.note, c.operand, c.extVal, c.packed4Val); got != c.want {
			t.Fatalf("%s operand %s (ext %d packed4 %d): page %s, want %s",
				c.note, c.operand, c.extVal, c.packed4Val, got, c.want)
		}
	}
}

// TestSkipFootprint: op 4E nn advances PC by nn + 2 bytes total — a byte
// count, not an op count (C0:2254; vm-semantics §2.2). Engine example
// 0001: `4e 05` at 73:03a9 skips to 73:03b0.
func TestSkipFootprint(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: {
		cmd("FA:0100", "4e 05", "skip"),
		text("FA:0102", "skipped-over"),
		text("FA:0107", "landed"),
	}}}
	st := newTestState()
	pages, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)
	if len(pages) != 1 || pages[0] != "landed" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want [landed]", pages)
	}
}

// selGotoMenu builds a menu event: optA, option text(s), optB per option,
// a window close, then selGoto with two `4e 02` records (the dump idiom,
// vm-semantics §2.3). Each record's branch ends the event with op 43, so
// the page names the record selGoto took.
func selGotoMenu(twoOptions bool) []Op {
	ops := []Op{
		cmd("FA:0110", "25", "optA"),
		text("FA:0111", "opt one"),
		cmd("FA:0117", "26", "optB"),
	}
	if twoOptions {
		ops = append(ops, text("FA:0118", "opt two"), cmd("FA:0119", "26", "optB"))
	}
	ops = append(ops,
		cmd("FA:011a", "2a", "closeWin"),
		cmd("FA:011b", "2f", "selGoto"), // records at FA:011c / FA:011e
		cmd("FA:011c", "4e 02", "skip"), // record 0 -> FA:0120
		cmd("FA:011e", "4e 02", "skip"), // record 1 -> FA:0122
		text("FA:0120", "zero"),
		cmd("FA:0121", "43", "end"),
		text("FA:0122", "one"),
		cmd("FA:0123", "43", "end"),
	)
	return ops
}

// TestSelGotoFallbackWrap: no selection (0xFF) picks r = $D3C1-1, ANDed
// with $00FF — a 0 count wraps to 255, it does not become -1 (engine
// C0:2E7A; the parity fix in docs/parity.md §12.4-4). One registered
// option picks record 0; two pick record 1.
func TestSelGotoFallbackWrap(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: selGotoMenu(false)}}
	st := newTestState()
	st.menuSel = 0xFF
	pages, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)
	if lastPage(pages) != "zero" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want record 0 for one option", pages)
	}
	cat2 := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: selGotoMenu(true)}}
	st2 := newTestState()
	st2.menuSel = 0xFF
	pages2, _ := runPages(t, cat2, 1, cat2.events[1], st2)
	if lastPage(pages2) != "one" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want record 1 for two options", pages2)
	}
}

// TestOptCDoesNotCount: op 27 displays an option but does not increment
// $D3C1 — its whole body C0:1F9E..C0:2043 ends JMP $1C7A without touching
// it (vm-semantics §2.3). Two optB + one optC therefore leave count 2 and
// the fallback (selection $FF) lands on record 1, not record 0 or 2.
func TestOptCDoesNotCount(t *testing.T) {
	ops := []Op{
		cmd("FA:0110", "25", "optA"),
		text("FA:0111", "opt one"),
		cmd("FA:0117", "26", "optB"),
		text("FA:0118", "opt two"),
		cmd("FA:0119", "26", "optB"),
		text("FA:011a", "opt three"),
		cmd("FA:011b", "27", "optC"), // op 27: displays, must not count
		cmd("FA:011c", "2a", "closeWin"),
		cmd("FA:011d", "2f", "selGoto"), // records at FA:011e / FA:0120 / FA:0122
		cmd("FA:011e", "4e 02", "skip"), // record 0 -> FA:0122
		cmd("FA:0120", "4e 02", "skip"), // record 1 -> FA:0124
		cmd("FA:0122", "4e 02", "skip"), // record 2 -> FA:0126
		text("FA:0124", "one"),
		cmd("FA:0125", "43", "end"),
		text("FA:0126", "two"),
		cmd("FA:0127", "43", "end"),
	}
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: ops}}
	st := newTestState()
	st.menuSel = 0xFF
	pages, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)
	if st.menuCount != 2 {
		t.Fatalf("menu count %d after two optB + one optC, want 2", st.menuCount)
	}
	if lastPage(pages) != "one" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want record 1 (optC must not count)", pages)
	}
}

// TestSelGotoZeroCountWrapsPastEnd: the engine's fallback r = $D3C1-1 is
// ANDed with $00FF — a 0 count wraps to 255, it does not become -1
// (engine C0:2E7A; docs/parity.md §12.4-4). The byte before this selGoto
// is a real op, so an unwrapped -1 would land there and loop instead of
// finishing on the record miss.
func TestSelGotoZeroCountWrapsPastEnd(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: {
		cmd("FA:011a", "2a", "closeWin"), // the op an unwrapped -1 would target
		cmd("FA:011b", "2f", "selGoto"),  // record 255 -> FA:031a, past the stream
		text("FA:0120", "unreached"),
		cmd("FA:0121", "43", "end"),
	}}}
	st := newTestState()
	st.menuSel = 0xFF // no selection made; the count is 0 (no optB ran)
	vm := New(cat)
	vm.State = st
	vm.LoadEvent(cat.events[1], 1)
	vm.AllPages()
	if !vm.IsFinished() {
		t.Fatal("selGoto with 0 count must wrap to 255 and finish on the record miss")
	}
}

// TestSelGotoRecordDispatchesBigEndianID: a selGoto record whose first
// byte is below $0C dispatches the big-endian event id formed with the
// next byte (`0b 39` -> $0B39; engine C0:2E8E).
func TestSelGotoRecordDispatchesBigEndianID(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{
		1: {
			cmd("FA:0110", "25", "optA"),
			text("FA:0111", "opt one"),
			cmd("FA:0117", "26", "optB"),
			cmd("FA:011a", "2a", "closeWin"),
			cmd("FA:011b", "2f", "selGoto"), // record 0 at FA:011c
			cmd("FA:011c", "0b 39", "pad"),  // dispatch $0B39
			text("FA:011e", "no dispatch happened"),
			cmd("FA:011f", "43", "end"),
		},
		0x0B39: {
			text("FC:0500", "B39 PAGE"),
			cmd("FC:0501", "2a", "closeWin"),
			cmd("FC:0502", "43", "end"),
		},
	}}
	st := newTestState()
	st.menuSel = 0
	pages, trace := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)
	if len(pages) != 2 || lastPage(pages) != "B39 PAGE" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want the menu page then the $0B39 dispatch page", pages)
	}
	d := traceLines(trace, "SELGOTODISP")
	if len(d) != 1 || d[0] != "SELGOTODISP id=0B39" {
		t.Fatalf("dispatch lines %v, want SELGOTODISP id=0B39", d)
	}
}

// ---- frame ends, jumps and calls ---------------------------------------------

// TestEnd16FramePop: a frame pops the moment its PC reaches the event's
// end16; dump op streams include shared code past it that belongs to
// neighbouring fragments and must not execute (engine C0:1BB6 -> C0:3756;
// docs/parity.md §12.3, 0BF1's end16 DFA0).
func TestEnd16FramePop(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{
		events: map[int][]Op{0x0042: {
			text("FC:00f0", "own page"),
			text("FC:0100", "SHARED PAST END16"),
		}},
		end16s: map[int]string{0x0042: "FC:0100"},
	}
	st := newTestState()
	pages, _ := runPages(t, cat, 0x0042, cat.events[0x0042], st)
	if len(pages) != 1 || pages[0] != "own page" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want the own page only", pages)
	}
}

// TestJump16BankRelative: a jump16 target without a bank is absolute in
// the op's own bank — the dumper omits the bank when it equals the op's
// own (docs/parity.md §12.4-3, 016A's target 8ef0).
func TestJump16BankRelative(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: {
		cmd("FC:0010", "0d 16 20 00", "jump16"),
		{Kind: "jump16", Addr: "FC:0010", Target: "0020"},

		text("FC:0020", "target"),

	if len(pages) != 1 || pages[0] != "target" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want [target]", pages)
	}
}

// TestQueueWordCallReturn: with CallsEnabled the dispatch words 00-0E are
// call-with-return — the word is XBA'd into the callee id (`08 46` calls
// 0846) and the pop resumes at the byte after the word (engine C0:B847;
// vm-semantics §2.8). Op 2E is a frame return, not a window close
// (C0:2779): the callee's page only ends where its window closes.
func TestQueueWordCallReturn(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{
		0x0800: {
			cmd("FC:0100", "08 46", "op08"), // queue word $4608 -> XBA -> 0846
			text("FC:0101", "after"),
			cmd("FC:0105", "43", "end"),
		},
		0x0846: {
			text("FC:1394", "callee"),
			cmd("FC:1395", "2a", "closeWin"),
			cmd("FC:1396", "2e", "endMes"),
		},
	}}
	st := newTestState()
	pages, trace := runPages(t, cat, 0x0800, cat.events[0x0800], st)
	if len(pages) != 2 || pages[0] != "callee" || pages[1] != "after" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want [callee after]", pages)
	}
	calls := traceLines(trace, "CALL ")
	if len(calls) != 1 || calls[0] != "CALL addr=FC:0100 id=0846 ok=true" {
		t.Fatalf("calls %v", calls)
	}
	rets := traceLines(trace, "RET ")
	if len(rets) != 1 || rets[0] != "RET id=0800 depth=0" {
		t.Fatalf("rets %v", rets)
	}
}

// TestQueueWord004CCallsEvent000C: queue word $004C translates to a call
// of $000C (engine C0:B847; vm-semantics §2.8) — the word is not used as
// an event id itself.
func TestQueueWord004CCallsEvent000C(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{

			cmd("FC:0100", "4c 00", "op0C"), // queue word $004C
			text("FC:0101", "after"),
			cmd("FC:0105", "43", "end"),
		},
		0x000C: {
			text("FC:0600", "COMMON PAGE"),
			cmd("FC:0601", "2a", "closeWin"),
			cmd("FC:0602", "2e", "endMes"),
		},
	}}
	st := newTestState()
	pages, trace := runPages(t, cat, 0x0800, cat.events[0x0800], st)
	if len(pages) != 2 || pages[0] != "COMMON PAGE" || pages[1] != "after" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want [COMMON PAGE after]", pages)
	}
	calls := traceLines(trace, "CALL ")
	if len(calls) != 1 || calls[0] != "CALL addr=FC:0100 id=000C ok=true" {

	}
}

// TestOp43EndsCaller: op 43 is C0:277D `STZ $77; JMP $3783` — depth forced
// to 0, so a 43 inside a called event ends the caller too, and the VM
// reports finished once the run stops (vm-semantics §2.9).
func TestOp43EndsCaller(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{
		0x0800: {
			cmd("FC:0100", "08 46", "op08"),
			text("FC:0101", "never"),
		},
		0x0846: {
			cmd("FC:1394", "43", "end"),
		},
	}}
	vm := New(cat)
	vm.State = newTestState()
	vm.TraceEnabled = true
	vm.CallsEnabled = true
	vm.LoadEvent(cat.events[0x0800], 0x0800)
	pages := vm.AllPages()
	if len(pages) != 0 {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want none", pages)
	}
	if !vm.IsFinished() {
		t.Fatal("op 43 left the VM unfinished; it must end the caller too")
	}
	ends := traceLines(vm.Trace, "END43 ")
	if len(ends) != 1 || ends[0] != "END43 addr=FC:1394 depth=1" {
		t.Fatalf("END43 lines %v", ends)
	}
}

// TestOp4CGoldGate: op 4C passes when gold >= EF00 word1; TRUE continues
// at S+1, FALSE at S+2 (engine C0:2B4E; event 004E sets EF01 = the 10000
// price first, vm-semantics §6.2 dump instance).
func TestOp4CGoldGate(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: {

	st2.gold = 9999
	pages2, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st2)

	}

// TestPossessionGates: 0d 07 vi checks the party carries the item whose id
// the VM reads from EF00[vi] — the reference reads one byte (get_var),
// PLAUSIBLE-class like the whole family (vm-semantics §6.2; event 016A
// sets EF00 = 0x13D before `0d 07 00`). TRUE -> S+3, FALSE -> S+5.
func TestPossessionGates(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{1: {
		cmd("FA:0100", "41 00 3d 01", "set2B"), // EF00 word = 0x13D
		cmd("FA:0104", "0d 07 00", "inparty?"), // TRUE S+3, FALSE S+5
		cmd("FA:0107", "4e 03", "skip"),        // TRUE arm skips to FA:010c
		text("FA:0109", "carried-false"),
		cmd("FA:010a", "2a", "closeWin"),
		text("FA:010c", "carried-true"),
		cmd("FA:010d", "2a", "closeWin"),
	}}}
	st := newTestState()
	st.inventory[0x3D] = 1 // the low byte the reference reads
	pages, trace := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)
	if len(pages) != 1 || pages[0] != "carried-true" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want [carried-true]", pages)
	}
	if g := traceLines(trace, "GATE "); len(g) != 1 || g[0] != "GATE addr=FA:0104 note=inparty? dec=TRUE" {
		t.Fatalf("gate lines %v", g)
	}
	st2 := newTestState()
	pages2, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st2)
	if pages2[0] != "carried-false" {
		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want first page carried-false", pages2)
	}
}

// TestRandomBranch: 4f 16 nn rolls 0..nn-1 on the field RNG; r == 0
// continues in place, else tail-dispatches current id + r (C0:2EED;
// vm-semantics §2.6: event 0001's `4f 16 06` runs one of 0002..0007).
func TestRandomBranch(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{events: map[int][]Op{
		0x0001: {
			cmd("73:03ab", "4f 16 06", "4F_16"),
			text("73:03ae", "stayed"),
		},
		0x0004: { // 0001 + 3
			text("73:0400", "dispatched"),
		},
	}}
	st := newTestState()
	st.rolls = []int{0}
	pages, trace := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)
	if len(pages) != 1 || pages[0] != "stayed" {
		t.Fatalf("roll 0: pages %v, want [stayed]", pages)
	}
	if r := traceLines(trace, "RAND "); len(r) != 1 || r[0] != "RAND addr=73:03ab nn=6 roll=0" {
		t.Fatalf("rand lines %v", r)
	}
	st2 := newTestState()
	st2.rolls = []int{3}
	pages2, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st2)
	if len(pages2) != 1 || pages2[0] != "dispatched" {
		t.Fatalf("roll 3: pages %v, want [dispatched]", pages2)
	}
}

// TestNameInsertionLeaderCustom: op 4A resolves the actor name through the
// catalog, but the party leader's id resolves to the entered name first
// (C0:3188: id == WRAM[$F000] -> copy $F300). A name the tables lack
// renders as the placeholder, never as "".
func TestNameInsertionLeaderCustom(t *testing.T) {
	cat := &fakeCatalog{
		events: map[int][]Op{1: {
			cmd("FC:0100", "4a 00", "spk4A"),
			text("FC:0102", " speaking"),
			cmd("FC:010b", "2a", "closeWin"),

			cmd("FC:010e", "2a", "closeWin"),
		}},
		actors: map[int]string{0: "ユリアン"},
	}
	st := newTestState()
	pages, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)

	}

	}
	st.protagonistName = "ななし"
	pages2, _ := runPages(t, cat, 1, cat.events[1], st)

		t.Fatalf("pages %v, want the entered name for the leader", pages2)
```
