```lua
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	if p == nil and frames > 11000 and frames < START and frames % 30 == 0 and wr(0x76) ~= 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	if frames < START then return end
	if injected_at == nil then
		step = step + 1
		if step > #JUMPS then
			print(string.format("SWEEP-END frame=%d", frames))
			emu.stop(0)
			return
		end
		if wr(0xD6BD) ~= 0xFF or wr(0x76) ~= 0 then
			-- an arrival event left a window open or the queue busy:
			-- press A every 30 frames as during boot, then retry
			if frames % 30 == 0 then emu.setInput({ a = 1 }, 0, 0) end
			step = step - 1
			return
		end
		if RETARGET ~= nil then
			local off = 0x3CFB00 + 5 * JUMPS[step] + 1
			emu.write(off, RETARGET, emu.memType.snesPrgRom)
			local r = {}
			for i = -1, 3 do r[#r + 1] = string.format('%02X', emu.read(off + i, emu.memType.snesPrgRom)) end
			print('RETARGET rec=' .. table.concat(r, ' '))
		end
		cfg_before = wr(0xD2E3)
		emu.write(0xD6BE, JUMPS[step], emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		emu.write(0xD6BD, 0x11, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		injected_at = frames
		changed_at = nil
		print(string.format("INJECT frame=%d index=%02X cfg=%02X", frames, JUMPS[step], cfg_before))
		return
	end
	if map_before == nil then map_before = wr16(0xD0A7) & 0x3FF end
	if changed_at == nil and (wr(0xD2E3) ~= cfg_before or (wr16(0xD0A7) & 0x3FF) ~= map_before) then changed_at = frames end
	local since = (move_i == 0) and changed_at or move_changed
	if move_i < #MOVES and since ~= nil and frames >= since + 60 then
		if wr(0xD6BD) ~= 0xFF or wr(0x76) ~= 0 then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then emu.setInput({ a = 1 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		move_from = wr16(0xD0A7) & 0x3FF
		move_i = move_i + 1
		move_changed = nil
		emu.write(0xD6BE, MOVES[move_i], emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		emu.write(0xD6BD, 0x10, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		moved_at = frames
		print(string.format("MOVEINJECT frame=%d dest=%02X from=%04X", frames, MOVES[move_i], move_from))
		return
	end
	if move_i > 0 and moved_at ~= nil and move_changed == nil and (wr16(0xD0A7) & 0x3FF) ~= move_from then move_changed = frames end
	local settled = (#MOVES == 0 and changed_at ~= nil and frames >= changed_at + 60) or (move_i == #MOVES and move_changed ~= nil and frames >= move_changed + 60)
	if settled and trail_from == nil then trail_from = frames; passes = 0
		print(string.format("TRAILMAP index=%02X map=%04X frame=%d", JUMPS[step], wr16(0xD0A7) & 0x3FF, frames)) end
	local ready = (trail_from ~= nil and passes >= 2600) or frames >= injected_at + TIMEOUT + 5000
	if ready then
		local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
		print(string.format("SWEEP index=%02X cfg=%02X changed=%s", JUMPS[step], cfg, tostring(changed_at ~= nil)))
		-- $D0A7 = current map word (music<<10 | map id): the jump handler
		-- saves it to $FE01 as the return point (C0:C115).
		print(string.format("GEO frame=%d cfg=%02X D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X zone=%02X leader=(%d,%d) map=%04X",
			frames, cfg, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), wr(0xD990), wr16(0xD9AA) // 8, wr16(0xD9AC) // 8,
			wr16(0xD0A7) & 0x3FF))
		trail_from = nil
		injected_at = nil
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/assemble_catalog.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Assemble exports/data/sfx/<tag>_<name>.ogg + catalog.json from a rip run.

For each effect id: choose the dump variant (PRE/POST/LATE) whose render has
the highest max_volume (the variant where the effect sounds), re-render it
with a 0.3 s fade-out tail into exports/data/sfx/<tag>_<name>.ogg, and emit
catalog.json mirroring the BGM catalog contract.

Usage: assemble_catalog.py <runlog> <dumpdir> <mapping.json> <outdir>
mapping.json: {"e46": {"tag": "18", "name": "hit_a"}, ...}
"""
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

runlog, dumpdir, mapping_path, outdir = (Path(p) for p in sys.argv[1:5])
outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
mapping = json.loads(mapping_path.read_text())

# capture frames + packet fields from the run log
caps = {}
for line in open(runlog, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
    m = re.match(r"CAPTURE frame=(\d+) id=([0-9A-F]{2}) name=(\w+)", line)
    if m:
        caps[m.group(3)] = int(m.group(1))

def band_energy(path):
    """4-8 kHz band mean of the first 0.6 s - the PoC's effect discriminator."""
    wav = path.with_suffix(".tmp.wav")
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-v", "error", "-i", str(path), "-t", "0.6", str(wav)], check=True)
    r = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-i", str(wav), "-af", "highpass=f=2000,highpass=f=4000,volumedetect",
                        "-f", "null", "-"], capture_output=True, text=True)
    wav.unlink()
    m = re.search(r"mean_volume: (-?[0-9.]+) dB", r.stderr)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else -99.0

def duration(path):
    r = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
                        "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", str(path)],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    try:
        return float(r.stdout.strip())
    except ValueError:
        return 0.0

effects = []
for name, spec in sorted(mapping.items()):
    variants = {}
    for tag2 in ("PRE", "POST", "LATE"):
        p = dumpdir / f"{name}_{tag2}.ogg"
        if p.exists():
            variants[tag2] = p
    if not variants:
        print(f"SKIP {name}: no renders")
        continue
    best_tag2, best_p = max(variants.items(), key=lambda kv: band_energy(kv[1]))
    src = variants[best_tag2]
    ogg_name = f"{spec['tag']}_{spec['name']}.ogg"
    dst = outdir / ogg_name
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-v", "error", "-i", str(src),
                    "-af", "afade=t=out:st=2.6:d=0.4",
                    "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "5", str(dst)], check=True)
    mean = re.search(r"mean_volume: (-?[0-9.]+) dB",
                     subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-i", str(dst),
                                     "-af", "volumedetect", "-f", "null", "-"],
                                    capture_output=True, text=True).stderr)
    effects.append({
        "id": int(name[1:], 16) if name.startswith("e") else None,
        "hex": name[1:] if name.startswith("e") else name,
        "tag": spec["tag"],
        "name": spec["name"],
        "ogg": f"sfx/{ogg_name}",
        "duration_sec": round(duration(dst), 2),
        "mean_volume_db": float(mean.group(1)) if mean else None,
        "capture_frame": caps.get(name),
        "variant": best_tag2,
        "status": "ok",
    })
    print(f"OK {name} -> {ogg_name} variant={best_tag2} "
          f"dur={effects[-1]['duration_sec']} mean={effects[-1]['mean_volume_db']}dB")

catalog = {"rom": "patches/bokuno_jp.sfc", "effects": effects}
(outdir / "catalog.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(catalog, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")
print("catalog ->", outdir / "catalog.json")

```

`tools/emulator/attack_item.lua`:

```lua
-- attack_item.lua - decode the attack-item (精霊石/火星の砂/永久氷晶) damage
-- inputs (docs/battle-formulas.md §16.2 open hole, 2026-11-19).
--
-- Round 4. Round 3 proved: battle item use = 技タイプ 0x04 (tech 08「術」),
-- executor C2:700E reads the item record via $E4 (AI used 傷薬: FE0001 ->
-- $DA = 0x19 回復力, FE0002 -> $DF = 0x81 cure bits, bit7 -> heal path);
-- and the opening ensemble battle's actor 5 (record $2580) carries item 05
-- 精霊石 in 腕4 (QUAD ...30FFFF05). This round steers THAT actor: the live
-- actor record pointer is read from WRAM $09B8 (the dp=0900 working page's
-- $B8, consistent across rounds 2-3 dpscan lines); when it equals $2580 a
-- Right x3 / A / A ladder fires to open the 道具 page and use the item on
-- the enemy side.
--
-- New watch: reads of the 通常攻撃指定 walk table 5E:5DC0-5EBFFF (the
-- action build should resolve the item's FE:379F spec there and pick the
-- pseudo-tech), plus the tech tables FE:1D00 (which row gets read = the
-- pseudo-tech id).
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/attack_item.lua --timeout=3600
--      > /tmp/attackitem/run4.log

local END_FRAME = 70000
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local CUTSCENE_SONG = 41
local VICTORY_SONG = 3

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local WALK_FROM = 35000
local LAST_FRAME = 53000
local LEGS = { "up", "left", "up", "left", "up", "left", "up", "left" }
local LEG_FRAMES = 900
local leg_i = 1
local leg_start = 0

local TARGET_B8 = 0x2500

local battle = false
local real_battle = false
local real_start = nil
local frames = 0
local done = false
local ladder_start = 0
local last_cur = -1
local advance_at = 0
local arm_n = 0
local last_arm = -30000
local MEMBER_B8 = { [0x2280] = true, [0x2300] = true, [0x2380] = true,
	[0x2400] = true, [0x2480] = true, [0x2500] = true }

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc)
end

local CAP = { ITEMREC = 300, ATTACKSPEC = 300, DISPATCH = 200, SPECWALK = 200, TECHPERF = 200 }
local seen = {}
local dropped = {}
local function log(cat, line)
	seen[cat] = (seen[cat] or 0) + 1
	if seen[cat] <= CAP[cat] then
		print(string.format("%s frame=%d %s", cat, frames, line))
		if seen[cat] % 40 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	else
		dropped[cat] = (dropped[cat] or 0) + 1
	end
end

local function dpscan(tag)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local cands = {}
	for pg = 0, 255 do
		local b8 = wr16(pg * 0x100 + 0xB8)
		if b8 >= 0x2280 and b8 < 0x3000 then
			cands[#cands + 1] = string.format(
				"dp=%04X B8=%04X DA=%02X DC=%02X DD=%02X E0=%02X E1=%02X E2=%02X E4=%02X 9E=%02X 9F=%02X DF=%02X",
				pg * 0x100, b8,
				wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xDA), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xDC), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xDD),
				wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xE0), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xE1), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xE2),
				wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xE4), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0x9E), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0x9F),
				wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xDF))
		end
	end
	print(string.format("%s frame=%d at %02X:%04X A=%04X X=%04X Y=%04X | %s",
		tag, frames, st.k, st.pc, st.a or -1, st.x or -1, st.y or -1,
		table.concat(cands, " ; ")))
	flush_pad()
end

local function watch(addr, name)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		local ok, err = pcall(dpscan, name)
		if not ok then
			print(name .. "-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

print("ATTACK-ITEM-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	log("ITEMREC", string.format("a=%06X val=%02X pc=%s", a, val, pctag()))
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xFE0000, 0xFE001F, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xFE3790, 0xFE38A0, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

	log("SPECWALK", string.format("a=%06X val=%02X pc=%s", a, val, pctag()))
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0x5E5DC0, 0x5EBFFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xFE1D00, 0xFE2CFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		if frames > WALK_FROM then
			real_battle = true
			real_start = frames
			print(string.format("REAL-BATTLE frame=%d", frames))
			flush_pad()
		end
	elseif id ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and id ~= VICTORY_SONG
		and battle and real_start == nil and frames > WALK_FROM then
		battle = false
		print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
	end
end

local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local function save_shot()
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #png, 3 do
		local n = png:byte(i) * 65536 + (png:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (png:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	print(string.format("SHOT frame=%d len=%d b64=%s", frames, #png, table.concat(out)))
end

local function dump_quads(tag)
	local quad = {}
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local base = 0x2280 + 0x80 * i
		quad[#quad + 1] = string.format("%02X%02X%02X%02X",
			wr(base + 0x47), wr(base + 0x48), wr(base + 0x49), wr(base + 0x4A))
	end
	print(string.format("QUAD frame=%d bt=%d %s %s", frames,
		real_start ~= nil and frames - real_start or -1, tag, table.concat(quad, ",")))
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		if real_battle and real_start ~= nil then
			local cur = wr16(0x09B8)
			if cur ~= last_cur then
				last_cur = cur
				if MEMBER_B8[cur] then
					if frames - last_arm > 400 then
						-- every ally's window gets the item-page ladder:
						-- Right x1 (most carry one weapon page), A x3 with
						-- retries. The heal items burn turns so the wolves
						-- survive into Monica's (slot 5, 精霊石) turn.
						ladder_start = frames
						last_arm = frames
						arm_n = arm_n + 1
						print(string.format("LADDER-ARM frame=%d n=%d cur=%04X", frames, arm_n, cur))
						flush_pad()
					end
				elseif frames - last_arm > 400 then
					print(string.format("ACTOR frame=%d cur=%04X", frames, cur))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
			if ladder_start > 0 then
				local lt = frames - ladder_start
				if lt == 60 then p = { right = 1 } end
				if lt == 220 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 380 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 540 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 700 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 900 then dump_quads("post-use") end
			end
			if frames % 300 == 0 then save_shot() end
		end
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME and not real_battle then
			local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
			if busy and frames < 45000 then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				if leg_start == 0 then
					leg_start = frames
					print(string.format("LEG frame=%d dir=%s px=%d py=%d", frames,
						LEGS[leg_i], wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC)))
				end
				local t = frames - leg_start
				if t < LEG_FRAMES then
					p = { [LEGS[leg_i]] = 1 }
				else
					leg_i = leg_i + 1
					if leg_i > #LEGS then leg_i = 1 end
					leg_start = frames
					p = { [LEGS[leg_i]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			local parts = {}
			for k, v in pairs(seen) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s=%d%s", k, v,
				dropped[k] and ("(-" .. dropped[k] .. ")") or "") end
			table.sort(parts)
			print("SUMMARY " .. table.concat(parts, " "))
			print("ATTACK-ITEM-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

```lua
-- battle_item.lua - the battle ITEM command decode (docs/battle-formulas.md
-- §16, 2026-11-19). Reproduces the evidence:
--   1. Pressed new-game boot (walkfig5 schedule) reaches the real opening
--      ensemble battle (~frame 45099, BGM song 1).
--   2. The command window cycles ATTACK CATEGORIES with Left/Right: each
--      page = one equipped weapon class, then the 道具 page (the ally's
--      equipped 腕4 item), then 素手. Screenshots every 20 frames bt
--      380..2600; the 傷薬 page lands ~bt 1181 (frame ~46280).
--   3. The party bag WRAM $7EF32A-$7EF369 is NEVER read during battle
--      (BAGREAD count 0) — battle items are the equipped 腕4 copy only.
--   4. The 道具 name (and the empty-slot placeholder カムシーン, item $FF)
--      is read at battle init through the length loop FE:B5A6 — NAME lines.
--   5. The slot quad bytes $7EF000+0x80*slot+0x47..+0x4A (腕1..腕4) are

	for i = 1, #png, 3 do
		local n = png:byte(i) * 65536 + (png:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (png:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		out[#out + 1] = string.sub("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/", n // 262144 + 1, n // 262144 + 1)

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
```

```lua
-- battle_item_consume.lua - the §16.3 open hole (docs/battle-formulas.md):
-- does the engine consume anything after a battle? The battle itself does
-- not consume the equipped 道具 (§16.2), so the question is the post-battle
-- flow. Watches:
--   VICTORY: exec of C2:DA6B, the decoded post-battle flow entry
--   (roadmap 2b-field: it bumps $F532/$F533 after battle).
--   INVRD / INVWR: reads and writes across $7EF32A-$7EF3FF, the verified
--   inventory region (roadmap Runtime state). A consumption would show as
--   INVWR with a decremented count and a pc inside the post-battle bank.
--   ITEMEXEC: C2:700E so a real in-battle item use is on record this run.
-- Play flow = attack_item.lua verbatim (pressed boot to the bump battle
-- at ~45099; heal-item ladder on every ally so someone actually uses 傷薬
-- and the wolves survive into more turns), run to frame 75000 so the
-- victory flow fires (the ensemble battle resolves after the wolves or
-- the party fall).
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/battle_item_consume.lua
--      --timeout=3600 > /tmp/itemconsume/run1.log

local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local CUTSCENE_SONG = 41
local VICTORY_SONG = 3

PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }

	[0x2400] = true, [0x2480] = true }

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc)
end

-- inventory snapshot: 16 word-ish slots at $7EF32A (count+id pairs are the
-- engine's known shape; print raw bytes, the diff is what matters)
local function invsnap(tag)
	local t = {}
	for i = 0, 63 do t[#t + 1] = string.format("%02X", wr(0xF32A + i)) end
	print(string.format("INV frame=%d bt=%s %s %s", frames,
		real_start ~= nil and tostring(frames - real_start) or "-", tag,
		table.concat(t, "")))
end

local CAP = { INVRD = 8000, INVWR = 8000, DISPATCH = 200, GIVE = 50, GETITEM = 50, IDWR = 800, ADDLOOP = 200 }
local seen = {}
local dropped = {}
local function log(cat, line)
	seen[cat] = (seen[cat] or 0) + 1
	if seen[cat] <= CAP[cat] then
		print(string.format("%s frame=%d %s", cat, frames, line))
		if seen[cat] % 40 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	else
		dropped[cat] = (dropped[cat] or 0) + 1
	end
end

print("ITEM-CONSUME-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	log("INVRD", string.format("a=%06X val=%02X pc=%s", a, val, pctag()))
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0x7EF32A, 0x7EF3FF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	log("INVWR", string.format("a=%06X val=%02X pc=%s", a, val, pctag()))
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x7EF32A, 0x7EF3FF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- the item-grant helpers: 5E:100C wrote the boot seed AND (suspected) the
-- post-victory 野生の薬 grant; C0:2E1F is the getItem VM op. Exec watches
-- put the grant call site on record.
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	log("GIVE", "exec 5E:100C pc=" .. pctag())
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x5E100C, 0x5E100C, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	log("GETITEM", "exec C0:2E1F pc=" .. pctag())
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC02E1F, 0xC02E1F, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- who sets the grant id? $7E:0946 (dp page 09 var $46 = the id the
-- FE:EBEx add loop writes into the bag) and $7E:09FF (count bit7 source).
local function recflags(b)
	return string.format("rec=%04X w0=%04X b5=%02X b7=%02X", b, wr16(b), wr(b + 5), wr(b + 7))
end
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local b8 = wr16((st.d or 0) + 0xB8)
	log("IDWR", string.format("a=%06X val=%02X pc=%s A=%02X X=%04X D=%04X %s", a, val, pctag(),
		st.a or -1, st.x or -1, st.d or -1, recflags(b8)))
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x7E0946, 0x7E0946, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
-- run 5: every battle record's eligibility bytes at the roll entry
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local parts = {}
	for i = 0, 15 do parts[#parts + 1] = recflags(0x2280 + 0x80 * i) end
	print(string.format("RECS frame=%d D=%04X n34=%02X %s", frames, st.d or -1,
		wr((st.d or 0) + 0x34), table.concat(parts, " | ")))
	flush_pad()
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC2E0D8, 0xC2E0D8, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	log("ADDLOOP", "exec FE:EBE7 pc=" .. pctag())
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xFEEBE7, 0xFEEBE7, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	log("DISPATCH", string.format("a=%06X type=%d pc=%s", a, (a - 0xC26E85) / 2, pctag()))
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xC26E85, 0xC26EE8, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local victory_fired = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	victory_fired = victory_fired + 1
	print(string.format("VICTORY frame=%d n=%d pc=%s", frames, victory_fired, pctag()))
	if victory_fired % 8 == 1 then invsnap("victory") end
	flush_pad()
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC2DA6B, 0xC2DA6B, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- run 4: the §16.3 roll inputs at the roll entry C2:E0A8: bonus B =
-- $7FF95A (battle accumulator, cap 12) and the rank byte $7EF4C6 (its
-- high nibble feeds the chance), plus the per-slot ceilings the roll
-- stores in $0A3B on each pass.
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	print(string.format("ROLLIN frame=%d B=%02X F4C6=%02X F959=%02X pc=%s", frames,
		emu.read(0x7FF95A, emu.memType.snesMemory), emu.read(0x7EF4C6, emu.memType.snesMemory),
		emu.read(0x7FF959, emu.memType.snesMemory), pctag()))
	flush_pad()
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC2E0A8, 0xC2E0A8, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	print(string.format("CEIL frame=%d slot=%d ceil=%02X", frames, wr(0x0A3A), val))
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x7E0A3B, 0x7E0A3B, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	print(string.format("BWR frame=%d B<-%02X pc=%s", frames, val, pctag()))
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x7FF95A, 0x7FF95A, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		if frames > WALK_FROM then
			real_battle = true
			real_start = frames
			print(string.format("REAL-BATTLE frame=%d", frames))
			invsnap("battle-start")
			flush_pad()
		end
	elseif id ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and id ~= VICTORY_SONG
		and battle and real_start == nil and frames > WALK_FROM then
		battle = false
		print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
	end
end

local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		if real_battle and real_start ~= nil then
			local cur = wr16(0x09B8)
			if cur ~= last_cur then
				last_cur = cur
				if MEMBER_B8[cur] then
					if frames - last_arm > 400 then
						ladder_start = frames
						last_arm = frames
						arm_n = arm_n + 1
						print(string.format("LADDER-ARM frame=%d n=%d cur=%04X", frames, arm_n, cur))
						flush_pad()
					end
				end
			end
			if ladder_start > 0 then
				local lt = frames - ladder_start
				if lt == 60 then p = { right = 1 } end
				if lt == 220 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 380 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 540 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 700 then p = { a = 1 } end
			end
		end
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME and not real_battle then
			local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
			if busy and frames < 45000 then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				if leg_start == 0 then leg_start = frames end
				local t = frames - leg_start
				if t < LEG_FRAMES then
					p = { [LEGS[leg_i]] = 1 }
				else
					leg_i = leg_i + 1
					if leg_i > #LEGS then leg_i = 1 end
					leg_start = frames
					p = { [LEGS[leg_i]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			invsnap("final")
			local parts = {}
			for k, v in pairs(seen) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s=%d%s", k, v,
				dropped[k] and ("(-" .. dropped[k] .. ")") or "") end
			table.sort(parts)
			print("SUMMARY " .. table.concat(parts, " "))
			print("ITEM-CONSUME-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/battle_sfx.lua`:

```lua
-- battle_sfx.lua - reach the opening's scripted battles headless, log every
-- S-CPU -> SPC request packet, and capture screenshots of the battle UI
-- (docs/sfx.md battle catalog slice).
--
-- Callback skeleton is the byte-verified sfx_trace.lua set (a watcher built
-- from scratch ran on a shifted timeline - docs/sfx.md dead ends); input
-- policy is the walk13 oam_walk.lua one (opening PRESSES; from 20800 A every
-- 30 frames while busy, walk program when idle), which clears the opening
-- event chain 0848..084C -> 0B49 and walks the opening forest.
--
-- Opening flow reached (run6, 2026-11-16): cutscene music 41 at 24376 (false
-- battle trigger in v2 - cutscenes share the battle track), field music 33
-- at 28376, then scripted battles: BGM id=1 (バトル1) at 29444/31190/34420,
-- each won in one round by A-mashing (8-10 confirm blips, hits at +2500,
-- victory jingle id=3 at +3000). Song 1 is the battle discriminator, 33 the
-- field track.
--
--   BGM lines    - song dispatch from the BGM play writer C6:0A75 packet
--                  (id = docs/music.md track id)
--   MSG lines    - 4-byte effect packets completing at the C6:0630 writer
--   CAPSTATE/DUMPDATA shot - PNG screenshots (b64; reassemble with
--                 oam_reassemble.py, view with shot_ascii.py)
--   battle mode  - on BGM id==1: mash A (attack + target confirms for every
--                 member); with TECH_ENABLED a fixed navigate-to-tech
--                 sequence selects the leader's third list tech
--                 (verified run10: downs +258/+270, A +285/+330/+380 ->
--                 かすみ二段, see docs/sfx.md battle slice).

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local FIELD_SONG = 33      -- opening-area field BGM (run6 BGM lines)
local BATTLE_SONG = 1      -- バトル1 (docs/music.md) - the battle marker
local VICTORY_SONG = 3     -- 勝利! (docs/music.md)
local WALK_FROM = 20800    -- walk13 policy start
local LAST_FRAME = 34000
local TECH_ENABLED = false -- set true for the tech-use run

local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local tech_done = false
local victory = false
local victory_frame = nil

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local b1 = bytes[i]
		local b2 = bytes[i + 1]
		local b3 = bytes[i + 2]
		local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
		local c = {
			math.floor(n / 262144) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64,
			n % 64,
		}
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot()
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X",
		frames,
		emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
		emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
	print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		-- b64encode takes a 1-indexed byte table, not a string
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND shot")
end

-- flush helper: stdout is block-buffered under -testRunner redirection; a
-- marker line can sit unflushed when the 100 s runner timeout loses the
-- buffer, so a 4 KiB pad print pushes every pending line out.
local function flush_pad()
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

print("SFX-LOADED")

-- packet assembly (sfx_dump.lua pattern): port writes arrive 3,2,1 then the
-- $2140 tag write completes the packet.
local port1, port2, port3 = nil, nil, nil

local cmd2140 = 0

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end

-- Song dispatch detection: the BGM play writer C6:0A75 completes its packet
-- on the $2140 tag write (docs/sfx.md); the id is the docs/music.md track id.
local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == VICTORY_SONG then
		if not victory then
			victory = true
			victory_frame = frames
			print(string.format("VICTORY frame=%d", frames))
			flush_pad()
		end
	elseif id == 41 and frames >= 20000 then
		-- the pre-battle cutscene shares track 41 (バトル2); its native dialog
		-- windows wait for A while $76==0 (oam_walk.lua walk7 lesson), so from
		-- here on mash A unconditionally. battle_start/tech anchor stay on the
		-- real battle below.
		battle = true
	elseif id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		tech_done = not TECH_ENABLED
		print(string.format("BATTLE-START frame=%d", frames))
		flush_pad()
	elseif (id == FIELD_SONG or id == 36) and battle and battle_start
		and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d victory=%s", frames, tostring(victory)))
		flush_pad()
	end
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local tag, st = pctag()
	if addr == 0x2143 then
		port3 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2142 then
		port2 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		if st.pc == 0x0630 and st.k == 0xC6 and frames >= 20000 then
			print(string.format("MSG frame=%d tag=%02X id=%02X a2=%s a3=%s",
				frames, val, port1, tostring(port2), tostring(port3)))
		end
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1, port2, port3 = nil, nil, nil
	end
	if addr == 0x2140 and frames >= 20000 then
		cmd2140 = cmd2140 + 1
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

local function tech_input(bt)
	-- member turn window (verified run10): the tech list is open by
	-- battle-BGM+256; two downs move the cursor two rows, A selects, A
	-- confirms, A confirms the target. The list is shown with cursor on
	-- row 1; downs reach row 3 (かすみ二段, a two-stage slash).
	if bt >= 258 and bt < 264 then return { down = 1 } end
	if bt >= 270 and bt < 276 then return { down = 1 } end
	if bt == 285 or bt == 330 or bt == 380 then return { a = 1 } end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			local ti = (not tech_done) and tech_input(bt) or nil
			if bt > 420 then tech_done = true end
			if ti ~= nil then
				p = ti
			elseif (battle_start == nil or tech_done) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				-- no mash A while member 1's sequence is pending; battle_start
				-- nil = the pre-battle cutscene, whose dialogs need the mash
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - WALK_FROM
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

local last_vm = nil
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local flag = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_lo = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_hi = emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_lo = emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_hi = emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_bk = emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local vm = string.format("%02X %02X%02X%02X %04X", flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo)
		if vm ~= last_vm then
			print(string.format("VM frame=%d 76=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X D51B=%04X",
				frames, flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo))
			last_vm = vm
		end
		if frames % 200 == 0 then
			print(string.format("COUNT frame=%d battle=%s song=%s",
				frames, tostring(battle), tostring(last_bgm)))
		end
		-- screenshots: dense during battle, at victory, sparse on the field
		if battle and battle_start and (frames - battle_start) % 100 == 0
			and frames - battle_start < 3600 then
			shot()
		elseif victory_frame and frames - victory_frame == 200 then
			shot()
		elseif frames >= 26000 and frames % 2000 == 0 then
			shot()
		end
		if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print(string.format("SUMMARY cmd2140=%d victory=%s", cmd2140, tostring(victory)))
			print("BATTLESFX-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

```lua
-- rip machinery (sfx_dump.lua pattern, docs/sfx.md PoC): one PRE dump at the
-- packet's $2141 write and one POST dump a frame later (effect keyed), once
-- per distinct id. The victory jingle travels as a BGM play packet (C6:0A70
-- writer); its POST lands 55 frames later, after the sequence/sample upload.
-- Markers DUMP<name>-BEGIN/END delimit rip.lua-compatible dumps for
-- spc_build.py; rip_build.py splits + builds + renders.
local RIP_ENABLED = true
local TARGET_SFX = { [0x10] = "beep" }   -- named ids; everything else with
local TARGET_BGM = { [0x03] = "victory" } -- a3=4 is caught by the catch-all
local CATCH_ALL = true
local CAP_MAX = 24
local captured = {}
local capture_n = 0
local post_q = {}          -- { { name=, frame= }, ... }

local function dump(name)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.spc)
	local kon = emu.read(0x4C, emu.memType.spcDspRegisters)
	print("DUMP" .. name .. "-BEGIN")
	print(string.format("RIPINFO target=%s hijack_frame=%d dump_frame=%d kon=%02X spcpc=%04X a=%02X x=%02X y=%02X ps=%02X sp=%02X",
		name, frames, frames, kon, st.pc, st.a, st.x, st.y, st.ps, st.sp))
	local ram = {}
	for i = 0, 0xFFFF do
		ram[#ram + 1] = emu.read(i, emu.memType.spcRam)
	end
	for i = 1, #ram, 900 * 3 do
		local chunk = {}
		for j = i, math.min(i + 900 * 3 - 1, #ram) do
			chunk[#chunk + 1] = ram[j]
		end
		print("SPCDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	local dsp = {}
	for i = 0, 0x7F do
		dsp[#dsp + 1] = emu.read(i, emu.memType.spcDspRegisters)
	end
	print("DSPDATA " .. b64encode(dsp))
	print("RIPDONE")
	print("DUMP" .. name .. "-END")
	flush_pad()
end

print("SFX-LOADED")

-- packet assembly (sfx_dump.lua pattern): port writes arrive 3,2,1 then the
-- $2140 tag write completes the packet.
local port1, port2, port3 = nil, nil, nil

local cmd2140 = 0

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end

-- Song dispatch detection: the BGM play writer C6:0A75 completes its packet
-- on the $2140 tag write (docs/sfx.md); the id is the docs/music.md track id.
local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == VICTORY_SONG then
		if not victory then
			victory = true
			victory_frame = frames
			print(string.format("VICTORY frame=%d", frames))
			if RIP_ENABLED and not captured["victory"] then
				captured["victory"] = true
				post_q[#post_q + 1] = { name = "victory", frame = frames, bgm = true }
				local ok, err = pcall(dump, "victory_PRE")
				if not ok then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err)) end
			end
			flush_pad()
		end
	elseif id == 41 and frames >= 20000 then
		-- the pre-battle cutscene shares track 41 (バトル2); its native dialog
		-- windows wait for A while $76==0 (oam_walk.lua walk7 lesson), so from
		-- here on mash A unconditionally. battle_start/tech anchor stay on the
		-- real battle below.
		battle = true
	elseif id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		tech_done = not TECH_ENABLED
		print(string.format("BATTLE-START frame=%d", frames))
		flush_pad()
	elseif (id == FIELD_SONG or id == 36) and battle and battle_start
		and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d victory=%s", frames, tostring(victory)))
		flush_pad()
	end
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local tag, st = pctag()
	if addr == 0x2143 then
		port3 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2142 then
		port2 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
		if frames >= 28000 and val ~= nil and st.k == 0xC6 and port3 == 4 then
			local nm = TARGET_SFX[val]
			if nm == nil and CATCH_ALL and capture_n < CAP_MAX then
				capture_n = capture_n + 1
				nm = string.format("e%02X", val)
			end
			if nm ~= nil and not captured[val] then
				captured[val] = true
				post_q[#post_q + 1] = { name = nm, frame = frames }
				post_q[#post_q + 1] = { name = nm, frame = frames, late = true }
				print(string.format("CAPTURE frame=%d id=%02X name=%s", frames, val, nm))
				local ok, err = pcall(dump, nm .. "_PRE")
				if not ok then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err)) end
			end
		elseif frames >= 28000 and val ~= nil and st.k == 0xC6
			and st.pc == 0x0A70 and TARGET_BGM[val] and not captured["b" .. val] then
			captured["b" .. val] = true
			post_q[#post_q + 1] = { name = TARGET_BGM[val], frame = frames, bgm = true }
			print(string.format("CAPTURE-BGM frame=%d id=%02X name=%s", frames, val, TARGET_BGM[val]))
			local ok, err = pcall(dump, TARGET_BGM[val] .. "_PRE")
			if not ok then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err)) end
		end
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		if st.pc == 0x0630 and st.k == 0xC6 and frames >= 20000 then
			print(string.format("MSG frame=%d tag=%02X id=%02X a2=%s a3=%s",
				frames, val, port1, tostring(port2), tostring(port3)))
		end
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1, port2, port3 = nil, nil, nil
	end
	if addr == 0x2140 and frames >= 20000 then
		cmd2140 = cmd2140 + 1
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

local function tech_input(bt)
	-- member 1 command window (run8 evidence: opens by bt 256, the first A
	-- confirm blip; cursor starts on 攻撃). Two downs reach the 技 row, A
	-- opens the tech list (バックスタッブ, Julian tech 0F), A confirms it,
	-- A confirms the target.
	if bt >= 258 and bt < 264 then return { down = 1 } end
	if bt >= 270 and bt < 276 then return { down = 1 } end
	if bt == 285 or bt == 330 or bt == 380 then return { a = 1 } end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			local ti = (not tech_done) and tech_input(bt) or nil
			if bt > 420 then tech_done = true end
			if ti ~= nil then
				p = ti
			elseif (battle_start == nil or tech_done) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				-- mash only after member 1's sequence is done, so a stray A
				-- cannot confirm 攻撃 before the tech is set; battle_start nil
				-- = the cutscene before the real battle (dialogs need A)
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - WALK_FROM
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

local last_vm = nil
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local flag = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_lo = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_hi = emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_lo = emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_hi = emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_bk = emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local vm = string.format("%02X %02X%02X%02X %04X", flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo)
		if vm ~= last_vm then
			print(string.format("VM frame=%d 76=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X D51B=%04X",
				frames, flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo))
			last_vm = vm
		end
		if frames % 200 == 0 then
			print(string.format("COUNT frame=%d battle=%s song=%s",
				frames, tostring(battle), tostring(last_bgm)))
		end
		-- POST dumps: SFX one frame after its packet; BGM 55 frames after
		-- (the play packet's sequence/sample upload takes ~35 frames)
		for i = #post_q, 1, -1 do
			local p = post_q[i]
			local due = p.frame + (p.bgm and 55 or (p.late and 30 or 1))
			if frames >= due then
				table.remove(post_q, i)
				local tag2 = p.late and "_LATE" or "_POST"
			local ok, err = pcall(dump, p.name .. tag2)
				if not ok then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err)) end
			end
		end
		-- stop early once the first victory is captured and dumps are done
		if victory_frame and #post_q == 0 and frames >= victory_frame + 200 and not done then
			done = true
			print("RIP-COMPLETE frame=" .. frames)
			print("BATTLESFX-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		-- screenshots: dense during battle, at victory, sparse on the field
		if battle and battle_start then
			local bt = frames - battle_start
			if bt >= 220 and bt <= 460 and bt % 20 == 0 then
				shot()  -- the member 1 navigation window, densely
			elseif bt % 200 == 0 and bt > 0 and bt < 3600 then
				shot()
			end
		elseif victory_frame and frames - victory_frame == 200 then
			shot()
		elseif frames >= 26000 and frames % 2000 == 0 then
			shot()
		end
		if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print(string.format("SUMMARY cmd2140=%d victory=%s", cmd2140, tostring(victory)))
			print("BATTLESFX-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/boot_probe.lua`:

```lua
-- M0 boot probe (parity.md M0): headless run, WRAM address-form asserts, determinism line.
-- Output channel: print() (emu.log only feeds the UI script window; displayMessage does
-- not reach stdout either — verified empirically against MesenCE 2.2.1).
--
-- Address-form finding (M0 step 2): emu.memType.SnesWorkRam takes FULL CPU addresses
-- (bank<<16 | offset). $7E:xxxx hits WRAM directly; $00:00xx works only through the
-- SNES $0000-$1FFF WRAM mirror, so $00:76 == $7E:0076. But $00:D51B is NOT the WRAM
-- cell (bank 00 $8000+ maps to ROM on ExHiROM) — scripts must use the 0x7ED51B form.

local frames = 0
local done = false

local function dump()
	local flag_dp   = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.SnesWorkRam)          -- $00:0076 (mirror)
	local flag_bank = emu.read(0x7E0076, emu.memType.SnesWorkRam)      -- $7E:0076 (real)
	local ev_dp     = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.SnesWorkRam)        -- $00:D51B (NOT WRAM)
	local ev_bank   = emu.read(0x7ED51B, emu.memType.SnesWorkRam)      -- $7E:D51B (real)
	local pc_lo = emu.read(0x7E0078, emu.memType.SnesWorkRam)
	local pc_hi = emu.read(0x7E0079, emu.memType.SnesWorkRam)
	local pc_bk = emu.read(0x7E007A, emu.memType.SnesWorkRam)
	print(string.format(
		"PROBE frame=%d 76dp=%02X 76bank=%02X 00D51B=%02X 7ED51B=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
		frames, flag_dp, flag_bank, ev_dp, ev_bank, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo))
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	if frames % 300 == 0 then
		dump()
	end
	-- emu.stop does not synchronously halt callbacks; guard so stdout is byte-stable.
	if frames >= 1200 and not done then
		done = true
		print(string.format("PROBE-DONE frames=%d", frames))
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

```

`tools/emulator/bt_watch.lua`:

```lua
-- bt_watch.lua - live exec watches for the caster-side Status2 damage
-- modifiers (docs/battle-formulas.md section 13, status2.go).
--
-- Boot: UNATTENDED with the /tmp/mesence save present (boots straight into
-- the story montage at ~frame 6933; cycles 35->01->39->22->1A->24 with demo
-- battles). Zero input, no $4218/$4219 reads (run.sh gotcha 1), helpers in
-- dependency order (run.sh gotcha 2).
--
-- Watched PCs (exec callbacks, CPU-form snesMemory addresses; all verified
-- by cmd/disasm65816 on patches/bokuno_jp.sfc):
--   T       68:3020  fetch dispatcher JSL'd from C2:8F63 - every
--                    technique-type-0 per-hit D fetch. Logs $9E (action id),
--                    $DF (added-effect id), $E4 (fetch index), X, $B8.
--   VA      68:300B  variant-A modifier call site ($9E < $97 AND $E4 bit7).
--   VB      68:301B  variant-B modifier call site ($9E < $97, bit7 clear).
--   EPA     68:3006  enemy plain fetch  LDA $5B3481,X ($9E >= $97, bit7).
--   EPB     68:3016  enemy plain fetch  LDA $FE0001,X ($9E >= $97, !bit7).
--   BD      5A:C0E1  inside 5A:C0D0 after both bonus adds: $0EBC (0x08
--                    bonus) and $0EBE (0x40 bonus) hold the live values.
--   BD2     5A:C170  same inside the 5A:C160 variant.
--   G1      5A:C2DC  dormant 0x74 gate fetch LDA $603500,X.
--   G2      5A:C192  variant-B gate fetch LDA $603500,X (AND #$08).
--   P2      5A:37C0  P2 stub entry (C2:9A43 replacement) - logs $DF.
--   P2S     5A:3790  HP snapshot hook (JSL'd from FE:D368).
--   P2B10   5A:37FE  bit-0x10 branch taken; P2B10R 5A:382E logs A = the
--                    (snapshot - current) x 4 bonus just before STA $0EB0.
--   P2B20   5A:3848  bit-0x20 branch taken; P2B20R 5A:3877 logs A = LP
--                    bonus + old $0EB0 right after ADC $0EB0.
--
-- The BGM dispatcher watch (SONG lines, C6:0A75 via $2140 tag) marks battle
-- windows (song 01 = battle). Screenshots every 2400 frames confirm the
-- montage segments visually.

local END_FRAME = 130000
local SHOT0 = 6934
local SHOT_EVERY = 2400

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local shotNext = SHOT0
local fp = nil

local CAP = {
	T = 2000, VA = 300, VB = 300, EPA = 400, EPB = 400,
	BD = 100, BD2 = 100, G1 = 20, G2 = 100,
	P2 = 2000, P2S = 2000, P2B10 = 40, P2B10R = 40, P2B20 = 40, P2B20R = 40,
}
local seen = {}
local dropped = {}

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function rdcpu(addr) return emu.read(addr, emu.memType.snesMemory) end
local function signed(v) if v >= 128 then return v - 256 end return v end
local function log(cat, line)
	seen[cat] = (seen[cat] or 0) + 1
	if seen[cat] <= CAP[cat] then
		print(string.format("%s frame=%d %s", cat, frames, line))
		if seen[cat] % 40 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	else
		dropped[cat] = (dropped[cat] or 0) + 1
	end
end

local function watch(addr, name, fn)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr2, val)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn)
		if not ok then
			print(string.format("%s-ERR frame=%d %s", name, frames, tostring(err)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

print("BT-WATCH-LOADED")
flush_pad()

-- BGM dispatcher: the tag write C6:0A75 completes on $2140 (titleprobe).
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			print(string.format("SONG frame=%d id=%02X", frames, port1))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end
	port1 = nil
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- T: fetch dispatcher.
watch(0x683020, "T", function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	log("T", string.format("9E=%02X DF=%02X E4=%02X X=%04X B8=%04X A=%04X k=%02X pc=%04X",
		wr(0x9E), wr(0xDF), wr(0xE4), st.x, wr16(0xB8), st.a, st.k, st.pc))
end)

-- VA/VB: the modifier call sites ($9E < $97).
watch(0x68300B, "VA", function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	log("VA", string.format("9E=%02X DF=%02X E4=%02X X=%04X", wr(0x9E), wr(0xDF), wr(0xE4), st.x))
end)
watch(0x68301B, "VB", function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	log("VB", string.format("9E=%02X DF=%02X E4=%02X X=%04X", wr(0x9E), wr(0xDF), wr(0xE4), st.x))
end)

-- EPA/EPB: the plain enemy fetches ($9E >= $97).
watch(0x683006, "EPA", function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local x = st.x
	log("EPA", string.format("9E=%02X X=%04X byte5B3481,X=%02X", wr(0x9E), x, rdcpu(0x5B3481 + x)))
end)
watch(0x683016, "EPB", function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local x = st.x
	log("EPB", string.format("9E=%02X X=%04X byteFE0001,X=%02X", wr(0x9E), x, rdcpu(0xFE0001 + x)))
end)

-- BD/BD2: inside the modifier routines after both bonus adds.
local current_bd = "BD"
local function bdlog()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local x = st.x
	log(current_bd, string.format(
		"9E=%02X DF=%02X X=%04X 0EBC=%3d 0EBE=%3d itemByte+1=%02X itemByte+0=%02X vanillaByte=%02X",
		wr(0x9E), wr(0xDF), x, signed(wr(0x0EBC)), signed(wr(0x0EBE)),
		rdcpu(0x5B3481 + x), rdcpu(0x5B3480 + x), rdcpu(0xFE0001 + x)))
end
watch(0x5AC0E1, "BD", function() current_bd = "BD" bdlog() end)
watch(0x5AC170, "BD2", function() current_bd = "BD2" bdlog() end)

-- G1/G2: gate-table fetches.
watch(0x5AC2DC, "G1", function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	log("G1", string.format("DF=%02X gate=%02X", wr(0xDF), rdcpu(0x603500 + st.x)))
end)
watch(0x5AC192, "G2", function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	log("G2", string.format("DF=%02X gate=%02X", wr(0xDF), rdcpu(0x603500 + st.x)))
end)

-- P2 stub.
watch(0x5A37C0, "P2", function()
	log("P2", string.format("DF=%02X B8=%04X C4=%04X 8C=%04X", wr(0xDF), wr16(0xB8), wr16(0xC4), wr16(0x8C)))
end)
watch(0x5A3790, "P2S", function()
	local b8 = wr16(0xB8)
	local slot = math.floor((b8 - 0x2280) / 0x80)
	log("P2S", string.format("B8=%04X slot=%d hp=%d", b8, slot, wr16(0x2280 + slot * 0x80 + 0x14)))
end)
watch(0x5A37FE, "P2B10", function()
	local b8 = wr16(0xB8)
	local slot = math.floor((b8 - 0x2280) / 0x80)
	log("P2B10", string.format("B8=%04X slot=%d hpNow=%d snap=%d",
		b8, slot, wr16(0x2280 + slot * 0x80 + 0x14), wr16(0x0EA0 + slot * 2)))
end)
watch(0x5A382E, "P2B10R", function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	log("P2B10R", string.format("A=%d (0x10 bonus before STA 0EB0)", st.a))
end)
watch(0x5A3848, "P2B20", function()
	local b8 = wr16(0xB8)
	local slot = math.floor((b8 - 0x2280) / 0x80)
	log("P2B20", string.format("B8=%04X slot=%d lpCur=%d lpMax=%d",
		b8, slot, wr(0x2280 + slot * 0x80 + 0x18), wr(0x2280 + slot * 0x80 + 0x19)))
end)
watch(0x5A3877, "P2B20R", function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	log("P2B20R", string.format("A=%d 0EB0=%d (A = LP bonus + old 0EB0)", st.a, wr16(0x0EB0)))
end)

-- Map/battle context per frame.
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		local cur_fp = string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
		if cur_fp ~= fp then
			fp = cur_fp
			print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d D51B=%04X 76=%02X",
				frames, cur_fp, wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC), wr16(0xD51B), wr(0x76)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames == shotNext then
			shotNext = shotNext + SHOT_EVERY
			local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
			local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
			local out = {}
			for i = 1, #png, 3 do
				local n = png:byte(i) * 65536 + (png:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (png:byte(i + 2) or 0)
				local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
				out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
					.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
			end
			print(string.format("SHOT frame=%d len=%d b64=%s", frames, #png, table.concat(out)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames >= END_FRAME then
			local parts = {}
			for k, v in pairs(seen) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s=%d%s", k, v,
				dropped[k] and ("(-" .. dropped[k] .. ")") or "") end
			table.sort(parts)
			print("SUMMARY " .. table.concat(parts, " "))
			for k, v in pairs(dropped) do print(string.format("DROPPED %s=%d", k, v)) end
			print("BT-WATCH-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			flush_pad()
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/bt_watch4.lua`:

```lua
-- bt_watch4.lua - identify the demo battle's modified-cast tech id.
--
-- Run 3 proved, via write callbacks on $0EBC/$0EBE, that at frame 9748
-- (recurring every 16120 frames) the demo battle casts a tech whose
-- added-effect id $DF = 0x72 (黄龍剣) through variant B (5A:C160): the
-- bit-0x08 branch stored $0EBC = 5AC200[FE0001,X & 7F] = 5AC200[8] = -7
-- (weapon = item 8 長剣, 攻 byte 0x08), bit 0x40 stayed 0, and the sum
-- carried out in A was 8 + (-7) + 0 = 1 (C1F9 STZs the accumulators after).
--
-- The memory reads in runs 1-3 used dp = 0, but the live $DF at the gate
-- was 0x72, so the battle damage code runs with a NON-ZERO direct page
-- (Mesen's state table exposes no dp field; st.dp/st.p are nil). This run
-- brute-forces the page: at the watched PCs, for every page P in 0x00-0xFF
-- read word P*0x100+0xB8; pages whose $B8 lands inside the battle struct
-- area [0x2280, 0x3000) are candidates. Logs $9E/$DF read under each
-- candidate at 5A:C160 entry (EA/EB) and 5A:37C0 (P2) - the candidate
-- whose DF = 0x72 at frame 9748 is the direct page, and its $9E is the
-- tech id. Everything else as run 3 (write callbacks on 0EBC/0EBE, SONG,
-- screenshots, unattended boot, zero input).

local END_FRAME = 30000
local SHOT0 = 6934
local SHOT_EVERY = 2400

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local shotNext = SHOT0
local fp = nil

local CAP = { T = 30, EA = 30, EB = 30, P2 = 100, P2S = 40, WBC = 60, WBE = 60, DPSCAN = 60 }
local seen = {}
local dropped = {}

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function signed(v) if v >= 128 then return v - 256 end return v end
local function log(cat, line)
	seen[cat] = (seen[cat] or 0) + 1
	if seen[cat] <= CAP[cat] then
		print(string.format("%s frame=%d %s", cat, frames, line))
		if seen[cat] % 40 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	else
		dropped[cat] = (dropped[cat] or 0) + 1
	end
end

-- Candidate direct pages for this PC snapshot: pages whose $B8 points into
-- the battle struct area.
local function dpscan()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local cands = {}
	for pg = 0, 255 do
		local b8 = wr16(pg * 0x100 + 0xB8)
		if b8 >= 0x2280 and b8 < 0x3000 then
			cands[#cands + 1] = string.format("dp=%04X B8=%04X 9E=%02X 9F=%02X DF=%02X E4=%02X",
				pg * 0x100, b8, wr(pg * 0x100 + 0x9E), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0x9F), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xDF), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xE4))
		end
	end
	log("DPSCAN", string.format("at %02X:%04X A=%04X X=%04X | %s",
		st.k, st.pc, st.a or -1, st.x or -1, table.concat(cands, " ; ")))
end

local function watch(addr, name, fn)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr2, val)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn)
		if not ok then
			print(string.format("%s-ERR frame=%d %s", name, frames, tostring(err)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

print("BT-WATCH4-LOADED")
flush_pad()

for addr, cat in pairs({ [0x0EBC] = "WBC", [0x0EBE] = "WBE" }) do
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a2, val)
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		log(cat, string.format("val=%3d at %02X:%04X A=%04X X=%04X Y=%04X",
			signed(val), st.k, st.pc, st.a or -1, st.x or -1, st.y or -1))
	end, emu.callbackType.write, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			print(string.format("SONG frame=%d id=%02X", frames, port1))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end
	port1 = nil
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

watch(0x5AC160, "EB", dpscan)
watch(0x5AC0D0, "EA", dpscan)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		local cur_fp = string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
		if cur_fp ~= fp then
			fp = cur_fp
			print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d D51B=%04X 76=%02X",
				frames, cur_fp, wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC), wr16(0xD51B), wr(0x76)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames == shotNext then
			shotNext = shotNext + SHOT_EVERY
			local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
			local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
			local out = {}
			for i = 1, #png, 3 do
				local n = png:byte(i) * 65536 + (png:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (png:byte(i + 2) or 0)
				local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
				out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
					.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
			end
			print(string.format("SHOT frame=%d len=%d b64=%s", frames, #png, table.concat(out)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames >= END_FRAME then
			local parts = {}
			for k, v in pairs(seen) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s=%d%s", k, v,
				dropped[k] and ("(-" .. dropped[k] .. ")") or "") end
			table.sort(parts)
			print("SUMMARY " .. table.concat(parts, " "))
			print("BT-WATCH4-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			flush_pad()
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/chain_capture.lua`:

```lua
-- chain_capture.lua - the full chain run: boot -> walk13 -> pocket walk ->
-- story event 084E (0x250 north edge) -> camp 0x24E -> Loane 0x4B -> walk
-- the g=C2 blob townsfolk into view -> dense OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot
-- captures for the band->OAM pin (docs/sprites.md blob capture) plus
-- per-leg WRAM dumps for the Loane position-cell hunt.
--
-- STALE POLICY WARNING (2026-11-17): this file predates the walk8-11
-- lessons in docs/sprites.md. Its eventSeen still trusts battle songs and
-- its post-event input is unconditional A on the idle field, which opens
-- the ring menu and freezes the party (walk7). Before running it, port
-- chain_walk.lua's final three-state input policy (A only while busy or
-- within 600 frames of busy or in battle; B closes the $D3C0 menu; legs
-- walk otherwise; settle A-taps against native A-windows).
--
-- Phase 4 watches $D2E3 (object config fingerprint: 0x250=02, 0x24F=02,
-- camp 0x24E=2E, Loane 0x4B=13, computed from the record headers) and
-- treats the chain as over when busy has been clear for END_QUIET frames
-- with no battle song. Then the APPROACH leg list runs on Loane (spawn
-- (31,77); g=C2 at (23,66)/(37,51)/(23,39); approach target: column 23
-- just south of the (23,66) NPC). Captures every CAP_EVERY frames during
-- and after the approach; each leg also leaves a WRAM dump for the
-- offline position-cell diff.

local ST0 = 35200
local MAX_LEGS = 30
local HOLD = 900
local SETTLE = 300
local END_QUIET = 2400
local CAP_EVERY = 1200
local LAST_FRAME = 220000
-- approach legs after the chain ends (tuned against Loane spawn (31,77):
-- l8+u11 puts the party at (23,67) facing the g=C2 NPC at (23,66); a
-- 900-frame leg covers ~16 tiles (pos_hunt5 -256 px), so fractions of a
-- leg approximate smaller steps)
local APPROACH = {
	{ dir = "up", f = 660 },   -- 31,77 -> ~31,66 (column 31 is clear)
	{ dir = "left", f = 480 }, -- -> ~23,66 area, NPC one tile north
	{ dir = "left", f = 900 }, -- continue west if the NPC was not met
	{ dir = "up", f = 450 },
}

local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local CUTSCENE_SONG = 41
local VICTORY_SONG = 3
local D2E3_LOANE = 0x13

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false
local eventSeen = false
local busyRun = 0
local quietRun = 0
local loane = false
local approach = false
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local last_bgm = nil
local last_d2e3 = nil
local legIdx = 0
local legHoldUntil = 0
local legDumpAt = 0
local westStall = 0
local upStall = 0
local legPlan = {}
local appIdx = 0
local appHoldUntil = 0
local appEndAt = 0
local lastCap = 0

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes[i] * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	local chunk = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = readfn(i) -- numbers; b64encode indexes bytes[i]
		if #chunk == 3000 then
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
			chunk = {}
		end
	end
	if #chunk > 0 then
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function flush_pad()
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function mapid()
	return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
end
local function tracked()
	local s = {}
	for _, o in ipairs({ 0xDBA8, 0xDBB4, 0xDBE8, 0xDBF4, 0x0D9A8 }) do
		s[#s + 1] = string.format("%04X=%d", o, wr(o) + wr(o + 1) * 256)
	end
	return table.concat(s, " ")
end

-- full capture named for oam_decode.py: CAPSTATE first, then the dumps
local function capture(tag)
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X song=%s %s",
		frames, wr(0x76), mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), tostring(last_bgm), tracked()))
	dump("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
	dump("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
	dump("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
	print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND shot")
	print("CAP " .. tag .. " frame=" .. frames)
	flush_pad()
end

print("CHAIN-CAPTURE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

local port1 = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	elseif id == VICTORY_SONG then
		print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	elseif id ~= BATTLE_SONG and id ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and id ~= VICTORY_SONG
		and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		battle_start = nil
		print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	end
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames >= ST0 then
		local d2e3 = wr(0xD2E3)
		if last_d2e3 == nil then last_d2e3 = d2e3 end
		if d2e3 ~= last_d2e3 then
			print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d D2E3=%02X (was %02X) MAP=%04X busy=%d",
				frames, d2e3, last_d2e3, mapid(), busy and 1 or 0))
			if busy then
				eventSeen = true
			end
			if d2e3 == D2E3_LOANE then
				loane = true
				print("LOANE-ARRIVAL frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
			last_d2e3 = d2e3
			flush_pad()
		end
		if busy then
			busyRun = busyRun + 1
			quietRun = 0
			if busyRun == 30 or busyRun == 120 then
				eventSeen = true
				print(string.format("EVENT-LOOP frame=%d busyRun=%d D51B=%04X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
					frames, busyRun,
					wr(0xD51C) * 256 + wr(0xD51B), wr(0x7A), wr(0x79), wr(0x78)))
				flush_pad()
			end
		else
			busyRun = 0
			if eventSeen and not approach then
				quietRun = quietRun + 1
			end
		end
	end
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [({ "down", "right" })[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	elseif frames >= ST0 then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif eventSeen and not approach then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif approach then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			elseif frames < appHoldUntil then
				p = { [APPROACH[appIdx].dir] = 1 }
			end
		else
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			elseif frames < legHoldUntil then
				p = { [legPlan.dir] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("INPUT-CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames == ST0 then
		print(string.format("ST0 frame=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X %s",
			frames, mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), tracked()))
		dump("w" .. frames, wr, 131072)
		legPlan = { dir = "left", a8 = wr(0xDBA8) + wr(0xDBA9) * 256, e8 = wr(0xDBE8) + wr(0xDBE9) * 256 }
		legHoldUntil = frames + HOLD
		legDumpAt = frames + HOLD + SETTLE
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames > ST0 and frames % 100 == 0 and frames < legDumpAt and not eventSeen then
		print(string.format("T frame=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X song=%s %s",
			frames, wr(0x76), mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), tostring(last_bgm), tracked()))
	end
	if not eventSeen and frames > ST0 and frames == legDumpAt then
		local prevA8 = wr(0xDBA8) + wr(0xDBA9) * 256
		local prevE8 = wr(0xDBE8) + wr(0xDBE9) * 256
		dump("w" .. frames, wr, 131072)
		local da = prevA8 - (legPlan.a8 or prevA8)
		local de = prevE8 - (legPlan.e8 or prevE8)
		print(string.format("LEG %d dir=%s end frame=%d dA8=%d dE8=%d MAP=%04X 76=%02X %s",
			legIdx, legPlan.dir or "?", frames, da, de, mapid(), wr(0x76), tracked()))
		if legPlan.dir == "left" then
			westStall = (da == 0 and de == 0) and westStall + 1 or 0
		elseif legPlan.dir == "up" then
			upStall = (da == 0 and de == 0) and upStall + 1 or 0
		end
		flush_pad()
		legIdx = legIdx + 1
		if legIdx >= MAX_LEGS or (westStall >= 2 and upStall >= 2) then
			print(string.format("CHAIN-WALK-STALLED frame=%d legs=%d westStall=%d upStall=%d",
				frames, legIdx, westStall, upStall))
			print(string.format("ENDSTATE MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X %s",
				mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), tracked()))
			flush_pad()
			done = true
			emu.stop(0)
			return
		end
		if legIdx % 3 == 2 or westStall >= 2 then
			legPlan = { dir = (upStall >= 2) and "left" or "up", a8 = prevA8, e8 = prevE8 }
		else
			legPlan = { dir = "left", a8 = prevA8, e8 = prevE8 }
		end
		legHoldUntil = frames + HOLD
		legDumpAt = frames + HOLD + SETTLE
	end
	-- chain over: quiet long enough (event done on Loane) -> approach
	if eventSeen and loane and not approach and not battle
		and quietRun >= END_QUIET and busyRun == 0 then
		approach = true
		appIdx = 1
		dump("wApp0", wr, 131072)
		print(string.format("APPROACH-START frame=%d MAP=%04X %s", frames, mapid(), tracked()))
		appHoldUntil = frames + APPROACH[1].f
		appEndAt = frames + APPROACH[1].f + 300
		flush_pad()
	end
	if approach and frames == appEndAt then
		local a = APPROACH[appIdx]
		print(string.format("APPLEG %d dir=%s f=%d end frame=%d MAP=%04X %s",
			appIdx, a.dir, a.f, frames, mapid(), tracked()))
		dump("wApp" .. frames, wr, 131072)
		capture("app" .. appIdx)
		appIdx = appIdx + 1
		if appIdx > #APPROACH or frames >= LAST_FRAME - 5000 then
			print("CHAIN-CAPTURE-DONE frame=" .. frames)
			print(string.format("ENDSTATE MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X %s",
				mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), tracked()))
			flush_pad()
			done = true
			emu.stop(0)
			return
		end
		appHoldUntil = frames + APPROACH[appIdx].f
		appEndAt = frames + APPROACH[appIdx].f + 300
	end
	-- dense captures during the approach window (blob may enter view mid-leg)
	if approach and frames % CAP_EVERY == 0 and frames ~= appEndAt then
		capture("mid" .. frames)
	end
	if eventSeen and not approach and not done and frames % 8000 == 0 then
		print(string.format("CHAIN frame=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X song=%s %s",
			frames, mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), tostring(last_bgm), tracked()))
		dump("w" .. frames, wr, 131072)
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("CHAIN-CAPTURE-DONE frame=" .. frames)
		print(string.format("ENDSTATE MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X %s",
			mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), tracked()))
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/chain_probe.lua`:

```lua
-- chain_probe.lua - probe the 0x250 north-edge walk for the story chain:
-- reach map 0x250 free walk with the proven walk13 program, then hold UP
-- legs (900 frames, the verified movement threshold) toward the north edge
-- where EdgeEvents[0] = event 084E lives (dumptriggers -map: edge [2126 8192 8192
-- 8192]; 084E battles, then mapJump 11 0C -> camp 0x24E (31,21), later
-- 11 0E -> Loane 0x4B (31,77)).
--
-- water_sweep.lua's up/left legs moved nothing (DBA8/DBE8 static through
-- 30000 frames), which this probe must explain. It dumps full WRAM every
-- 4000 frames for offline controlled diffs (a leg moves only one axis, so
-- cells tracking Y fall out of the w0-vs-w4000 diff), tracks the x
-- candidates, polls $D2E3 for map loads (084E's mapJump changes it), and
-- logs the SPC BGM dispatch (battle_sfx.lua pattern) so the 084E battle is
-- visible as song 1.
--
-- Input policy from ST0=35200: A every 30 frames while busy, battle policy
-- while the battle song runs (battle_sfx.lua verbatim), otherwise the up
-- leg hold. The harness stops 24000 frames after ST0 if no event fired
-- (NOEVENT), else it keeps the chain policy until CHAIN_LAST.

local ST0 = 35200
local PROBE_END = ST0 + 24000 -- stop here when no event fired
local CHAIN_LAST = 150000     -- hard stop once the chain runs
local WRAM_EVERY = 4000
local T_EVERY = 100
local TRACK = { 0xDBA8, 0xDBB4, 0xDBE8, 0xDBF4, 0xDB68 }

local FIELD_SONG = 33
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local CUTSCENE_SONG = 41
local VICTORY_SONG = 3

PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats

local frames = 0
local done = false
local eventSeen = false        -- a long busy window or BGM dispatch after ST0
local busyRun = 0
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local tech_done = true         -- no tech menu; A-mash wins (run6)
local last_bgm = nil
local last_d2e3 = nil

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes[i] * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	local chunk = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = readfn(i) -- numbers; b64encode indexes bytes[i]
		if #chunk == 3000 then
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
			chunk = {}
		end
	end
	if #chunk > 0 then
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function flush_pad()
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function mapid()
	return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
end

flush_pad()

-- Song dispatch: the BGM play writer C6:0A75 completes its packet on the
-- $2140 tag write (battle_sfx.lua / docs/sfx.md).
local port1 = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		eventSeen = true
		print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	elseif id == VICTORY_SONG then
		print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	elseif id == CUTSCENE_SONG and frames >= ST0 then
		battle = true
		battle_start = nil
		eventSeen = true
	elseif id ~= BATTLE_SONG and id ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and id ~= VICTORY_SONG
		and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		battle_start = nil
		print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	end
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
		if addr == 0x2141 then
			port1 = val
		elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
			detect_bgm(port1)
			port1 = nil
		end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames >= ST0 then
		local d2e3 = wr(0xD2E3)
		if last_d2e3 == nil then last_d2e3 = d2e3 end
		if d2e3 ~= last_d2e3 then
			print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d D2E3=%02X (was %02X) MAP=%04X busy=%d",
				frames, d2e3, last_d2e3, mapid(), busy and 1 or 0))
			if busy then
				eventSeen = true
			end
			last_d2e3 = d2e3
			flush_pad()
		end
		if busy then
			busyRun = busyRun + 1
			if busyRun == 30 or busyRun == 120 then
				-- any long busy window after ST0 is the chain running (the
				-- native event windows wait for A while $76 reads 0 - the
				-- walk7 lesson - so eventSeen switches to unconditional A)
				eventSeen = true
				print(string.format("EVENT-LOOP frame=%d busyRun=%d D51B=%04X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
					frames, busyRun,
					wr(0xD51C) * 256 + wr(0xD51B), wr(0x7A), wr(0x79), wr(0x78)))
				flush_pad()
			end
		else
			busyRun = 0
		end
	end
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		-- walk13: advance dialogs, hold the walk program when idle
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [({ "down", "right" })[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	elseif frames >= ST0 then
		if battle then
			-- battle_sfx run6 policy: no A while member 1's sequence is
			-- pending (0..420), then mash A every 30 frames
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif eventSeen then
			-- unconditional A: the chain's native windows wait for A with
			-- $76==0, so a busy-gated mash stalls inside them (walk7/walk12)
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			else
				local t = frames - ST0
				if t % 2000 < 900 then
					p = { up = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("INPUT-CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames == ST0 then
		print(string.format("ST0 frame=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X DBA8=%d",
			frames, mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), wr(0xDBA8) + wr(0xDBA9) * 256))

		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames > ST0 and frames % T_EVERY == 0 then

		for _, o in ipairs(TRACK) do
			s[#s + 1] = string.format("%04X=%d", o, wr(o) + wr(o + 1) * 256)
		end
```
