```lua
			frames, wr(0x76), mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), tostring(last_bgm), table.concat(s, " ")))
	end
	if frames > ST0 and frames % WRAM_EVERY == 0 then
		dump("w" .. frames, wr, 131072)
		dump("oam" .. frames, function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		flush_pad()
	end
	local stopFrame = eventSeen and CHAIN_LAST or PROBE_END
	if frames >= stopFrame and not done then
		done = true
		print(string.format("CHAIN-PROBE-DONE frame=%d eventSeen=%s song=%s",
			frames, tostring(eventSeen), tostring(last_bgm)))
		print(string.format("ENDSTATE MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X DBA8=%d DBE8=%d",
			mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76),
			wr(0xDBA8) + wr(0xDBA9) * 256, wr(0xDBE8) + wr(0xDBE9) * 256))
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/chain_walk.lua`:

```lua
-- chain_walk.lua - walk the party out of the post-walk13 area toward the
-- 0x250 north-edge story event 084E (EdgeEvents[0], dumptriggers -map; 084E chains
-- battle -> camp 0x24E (31,21) -> Loane 0x4B (31,77)).
--
-- Run evidence baked into the design:
-- - probe1 (plain ROM): 14 up legs from the walk13 end state (DBA8=767
--   DBE8=511) moved nothing; the first L900 leg moves DBA8/DBE8 -256 px
--   (walk2 LEG 0: dA8=-256 dE8=-256), so WEST walks from this spot.
-- - Battles interrupt freely while walking: walk2 hit three BGM-1 battles
--   (37660/40284/43081, the opening's scripted sequence shifted per run -
--   run6 saw the same three at 29444/31190/34420) with battle-result
--   event windows (D51B=0E64 PC=FC:C830, then 0B44) whose busy stretches
--   must NOT count as the story chain. eventSeen therefore requires
--   busyRun >= 30 away from any battle (frames > lastBattleEnd + 3000)
--   or a map load under busy ($D2E3 change: the chain's mapJumps).
-- - Legs are re-planned state-driven: a battle that interrupts a leg
--   leaves the scheduler free to start the next leg once the field is
--   quiet again (legPlan/legHoldUntil stale after every battle).
--
-- Leg plan: two west legs, then one up probe, until both stall twice, the
-- chain fires, or MAX_LEGS run out.

local ST0 = 35200
local MAX_LEGS = 84
local HOLD = 450
local SETTLE = 150
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local CUTSCENE_SONG = 41
local VICTORY_SONG = 3
local BATTLE_COOLDOWN = 3000
local TRACK = { 0xDBA8, 0xDBB4, 0xDBE8, 0xDBF4, 0x0D9A8, 0x00968, 0x00976, 0xD3C0 }

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false
local eventSeen = false
local busyRun = 0
local lastBusy = 0
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local lastBattleEnd = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local last_d2e3 = nil
local legActive = false

local legHoldUntil = 0
local legDumpAt = 0
local legIdx = 0
local westStall = 0
local upStall = 0

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes[i] * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	local chunk = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = readfn(i) -- numbers; b64encode indexes bytes[i]
		if #chunk == 3000 then
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
			chunk = {}
		end
	end
	if #chunk > 0 then
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function flush_pad()
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function mapid()
	return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
end
local function tracked()
	local s = {}
	for _, o in ipairs(TRACK) do
		s[#s + 1] = string.format("%04X=%d", o, wr(o) + wr(o + 1) * 256)
	end
	return table.concat(s, " ")
end

-- oam + screenshot at a leg end: the x-cells alone cannot say where the
-- party is (walk4 LEG 9: an up leg jumped DBA8 +512), so every second leg
-- leaves a screen evidence point (oam_decode.py/shot_ascii.py render them;
-- CAPSTATE names the files for oam_decode.py). Defined after wr/mapid/
-- tracked: Lua locals must exist before the function body reads them.
local function shotdump()
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X %s",
		frames, wr(0x76), mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), tracked()))
	dump("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
	print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND shot")
end

flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then

local function startLeg()
	legIdx = legIdx + 1
	if legIdx > MAX_LEGS then
		print(string.format("CHAIN-WALK-MAXLEGS frame=%d legs=%d", frames, legIdx - 1))
		print(string.format("ENDSTATE MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X %s",
			mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), tracked()))
		flush_pad()
		done = true
		emu.stop(0)
		return
	end
	local dir
	-- serpentine sweep of the cutscene arena: the locked-camera scene at
	-- (60,22) holds the party in a screen-sized box; a VM position check
	-- inside it must be crossed on foot. 450-frame holds (~2 tiles) walk a
	-- boustrophedon: 6 holds across, one down, flip direction, 7 rows.
	local rowLegs = 6
	local phase = (legIdx - 1) % (rowLegs + 1) + 1
	local row = math.floor((legIdx - 1) / (rowLegs + 1))
	if phase <= rowLegs then
		dir = (row % 2 == 0) and "right" or "left"
	else
		dir = "down"
	end
	legPlan = { dir = dir, a8 = wr(0xDBA8) + wr(0xDBA9) * 256, e8 = wr(0xDBE8) + wr(0xDBE9) * 256 }
	legActive = true
	legStart = frames
	legHoldUntil = frames + HOLD
	legDumpAt = frames + HOLD + SETTLE
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if busy then
		lastBusy = frames
	end
	if frames >= ST0 then
		local d2e3 = wr(0xD2E3)
		if last_d2e3 == nil then last_d2e3 = d2e3 end
		if d2e3 ~= last_d2e3 then
			print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d D2E3=%02X (was %02X) MAP=%04X busy=%d",
				frames, d2e3, last_d2e3, mapid(), busy and 1 or 0))
			if busy then
				-- a map load while the game is busy is the chain's mapJump
				eventSeen = true
			end
			last_d2e3 = d2e3
			flush_pad()
		end
		local nearBattle = frames < lastBattleEnd + BATTLE_COOLDOWN
		if busy and not battle and not nearBattle then
			busyRun = busyRun + 1
			if busyRun == 30 or busyRun == 120 then
				eventSeen = true
				print(string.format("EVENT-LOOP frame=%d busyRun=%d D51B=%04X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
					frames, busyRun,
					wr(0xD51C) * 256 + wr(0xD51B), wr(0x7A), wr(0x79), wr(0x78)))
				flush_pad()
			end
		else
			busyRun = 0
		end
	end
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [({ "down", "right" })[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	elseif frames >= ST0 then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			-- three-state field policy. walk7 froze the party for 29000
			-- frames because eventSeen kept mashing A on the idle field:
			-- the ring menu opened ($D3C0, vm-semantics.md) and swallowed
			-- every direction hold (16 byte-identical screenshots). A only
			-- while the event is actually active; B closes the menu; the
			-- legs walk whenever the field is idle.
			local menuOpen = wr(0xD3C0) ~= 0
			local eventActive = busy or frames < lastBusy + 600
			if menuOpen and not busy then
				if frames % 60 == 0 then
					p = { b = 1 }
				end
			elseif eventActive then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			elseif legActive and frames < legHoldUntil then
				p = { [legPlan.dir] = 1 }
			elseif legActive and frames % 100 == 0 then
				-- settle window between holds: tap A so native event
				-- windows (which wait for A with $76==0) cannot hold the
				-- scene frozen; B closes the ring menu if the taps opened it
				if menuOpen then
					p = { b = 1 }
				else
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("INPUT-CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames == ST0 then
		print(string.format("ST0 frame=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X %s",
			frames, mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), tracked()))
		dump("w" .. frames, wr, 131072)
		startLeg()
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames > ST0 and frames % 100 == 0 and not battle then
		print(string.format("T frame=%d 76=%02X menu=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X song=%s %s",
			frames, wr(0x76), wr(0xD3C0), mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), tostring(last_bgm), tracked()))
	end

		and busyRun == 0 and frames >= legDumpAt and (not busy) then
		local nowA8 = wr(0xDBA8) + wr(0xDBA9) * 256
		local nowE8 = wr(0xDBE8) + wr(0xDBE9) * 256
		local da = nowA8 - legPlan.a8
		local de = nowE8 - legPlan.e8
		dump("w" .. frames, wr, 131072)

			legIdx, legPlan.dir, frames, da, de, tostring(full), mapid(), wr(0x76), tracked()))
		if legIdx % 2 == 0 then
			shotdump()
		end

			westStall = (da == 0 and de == 0 and full) and westStall + 1 or 0
		elseif legPlan.dir == "up" then
			upStall = (da == 0 and de == 0 and full) and upStall + 1 or 0
		end
		legActive = false
		flush_pad()
		if not done then
			startLeg()
		end
	end
	if eventSeen and not done and frames % 8000 == 0 then
		print(string.format("CHAIN frame=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X song=%s %s",
			frames, mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), tostring(last_bgm), tracked()))
		dump("w" .. frames, wr, 131072)
		flush_pad()
	end
	if eventSeen and not done and frames >= 190000 then
		done = true
		print("CHAIN-WALK-DONE frame=" .. frames)
		print(string.format("ENDSTATE MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X %s",
			mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), tracked()))
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
```

```lua
-- candidate buffers ($7F:0000-17FF low/footprint region and $7F:1800-2FFF
-- attr region) during probe legs on map 0x250, logging unique reader PCs

	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

local function leader()

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name, words)
	local n = words * 2
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, n - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(emu.read(0x10000 + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

	if addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == BATTLE_SONG then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == VICTORY_SONG then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
			elseif port1 ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and battle and battle_start
				and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- pointer-cell watch ($7E:0019-$001B)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < 28000 then return end
		local key = string.format("%04X", addr)
		if ptrLog[key] == nil then
			ptrLog[key] = { n = 0 }
		end
		local e = ptrLog[key]
		e.n = e.n + 1
		if e.n <= 6 then
			local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
			print(string.format("PTRWRITE frame=%d addr=%04X val=%02X pc=%02X/%04X", frames, addr, val or 0, st.k, st.pc))
		end
	end)
	if not ok then print("PTRCB-ERR " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x0019, 0x001B, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- reader PCs, both regions (probe phase only)
local function reader_cb(tab, lo, hi)
	return function(addr, val)
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			if frames < 34000 then return end
			local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
			local key = string.format("%02X/%04X", st.k, st.pc)
			if tab[key] == nil then
				tab[key] = { n = 0, first = frames, y = st.y, val = val or 0 }
				print(string.format("READER %s first=%d Y=%04X val=%02X", key, frames, st.y, val or 0))
				if #readersLow + #readersAttr < 60 then flush_pad() end
			end
			tab[key].n = tab[key].n + 1
		end)
		if not ok then print("RCB-ERR " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
	end
end
emu.addMemoryCallback(reader_cb(readersLow, 0x0000, 0x17FF), emu.callbackType.read, 0x10000, 0x117FF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
emu.addMemoryCallback(reader_cb(readersAttr, 0x1800, 0x2FFF), emu.callbackType.read, 0x11800, 0x12FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- gate C0:58CC read log (all reads, capped)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < 34000 then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc ~= 0x58CC then return end
		gateN = gateN + 1
		if gateN <= 250 then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			local s = string.format("GATE frame=%d Y=%04X attr=%02X px=%d py=%d zone=%02X busy=%d",
				frames, st.y, val or 0, lx, ly, wr(0xD990), wr(0x76))
			gateLog[#gateLog + 1] = s
			print(s)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then print("GATECB-ERR " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0x10000, 0x117FF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < ST0 then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [({ "down", "right" })[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	elseif frames >= ST0 and frames < END_FRAME then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif legDir ~= nil and frames < legHoldUntil then
			p = { [legDir] = 1 }
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("INPUT-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames == DUMP_A and not dumpA then
		dumpA = true
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("STATE-A frame=%d leaderX=%d leaderY=%d D2E3=%02X zone=%02X 19=%02X%02X 76=%02X",
			frames, lx, ly, wr(0xD2E3), wr(0xD990), wr(0x1A), wr(0x19), wr(0x76)))
		dump_bank7f("bank7f_A", 0x4000)
		legIdx = 1
		legDir = "up"
		legHoldUntil = frames + HOLD
		flush_pad()
	elseif dumpA and frames >= legHoldUntil and legDir ~= nil and frames >= DUMP_A + HOLD then
		legIdx = legIdx + 1
		if legIdx > 10 or frames >= END_FRAME - 1500 then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("STATE-B frame=%d leaderX=%d leaderY=%d legs=%d gate=%d", frames, lx, ly, legIdx, gateN))
			local parts = {}
			for k, v in pairs(readersLow) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("LOW %s n=%d", k, v.n) end
			for k, v in pairs(readersAttr) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("ATTR %s n=%d", k, v.n) end
			table.sort(parts)
			for _, s in ipairs(parts) do print(s) end
			print("PTRSUMMARY")
			for k, v in pairs(ptrLog) do print("PTR " .. k .. " n=" .. v.n) end
			dump_bank7f("bank7f_B", 0x4000)
			print("CS-GATE-DONE")
			flush_pad()
			done = true
			emu.stop(0)
			return
		end
		legDir = ({ "up", "left", "up", "right", "up", "left", "up", "down", "up", "left" })[legIdx]
		legHoldUntil = frames + HOLD
	end
	if not done and frames >= END_FRAME then
		print("CS-GATE-TIMEOUT frame=" .. frames)
		done = true
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

```lua
-- (docs/map-format.md "Chip default passability"): a focused write watch
-- over the attr region $7F:1800-$2FFF across the 0x250 load, logging
-- every CPU write with its PC. Its log pinned the build order — the
-- default walk byte replicated over the whole grid (FF/15AE+15CF), the
-- object composer's property bytes (FF/0DDE, 3895 writes), and the
-- footprint RLE into the separate $7F:0000 buffer (FF/1540) — see
-- docs/map-format.md and internal/mapfmt/chipattr.go.

	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

local function leader()
	return wr(0xD9AA) + wr(0xD9AB) * 256, wr(0xD9AC) + wr(0xD9AD) * 256

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name, words)
	local n = words * 2
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, n - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(emu.read(0x10000 + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

print("CS-GRID5-LOADED")
flush_pad()

			end
```

`tools/emulator/cs_grid6.lua`:

```lua
-- cs_grid6.lua - the negative result that closed the "runtime
-- chip-default pass" question (docs/map-format.md): cs_grid5's watch
-- stopped at frame 28700 while the settled capture read ~3515 tiles
-- away from the then-current model, so a later pass was suspected. This
-- run keeps the attr-region write watch alive through frame 43100 and
-- logs only writes whose value differs from the previous write to the
-- same offset (shadow-diff). Result: 10271 writes, all inside the load
-- window, zero afterwards — no runtime pass exists; the delta was the
-- model missing the composer's true counts and the FF/1540 overlay RLE
-- (both decoded in docs/map-format.md).
--
-- Input policy and timing are byte-identical to cs_grid5 (crossing into
-- map 0x250 at frame 28435 deterministically).

local DUMP_END = 43200
local END_FRAME = 43200

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local done = false
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local crossed = -1

local shadow = {}
local diffN = 0
local pcCount = {}
local LOAD_END = 28700

local function flush_pad()
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function leader()
	return wr(0xD9AA) + wr(0xD9AB) * 256, wr(0xD9AC) + wr(0xD9AD) * 256
end

local function hist()
	local c = {}
	for i = 0, 6143 do
		local v = wr(0x11800 + i)
		c[v] = (c[v] or 0) + 1
	end
	local parts = {}
	for v, n in pairs(c) do
		parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02X=%d", v, n)
	end
	table.sort(parts)
	return table.concat(parts, " ")
end

print("CS-GRID6-LOADED")
flush_pad()

-- $D2E3 write watch: the map-load fingerprint (02 = map 0x250).
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if val == 0x02 and crossed < 0 then
		crossed = frames
		print("CROSSING frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD2E3, 0xD2E3, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- attr-region write watch with shadow diff
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < 28400 or frames > DUMP_END then return end
		local off = addr - 0x11800
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		local old = shadow[off]
		shadow[off] = val
		if frames <= LOAD_END then
			-- known load window: count only
			diffN = diffN + 1
			return
		end
		if old == val then return end
		local key = string.format("%02X/%04X", st.k, st.pc)
		pcCount[key] = (pcCount[key] or 0) + 1
		diffN = diffN + 1
		print(string.format("RW frame=%d off=%04X old=%02X new=%02X pc=%02X/%04X",
			frames, off, old or 0, val, st.k, st.pc))
		if diffN % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("RWC-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x11800, 0x12FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [({ "down", "right" })[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("INPUT-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if crossed > 0 and frames > crossed and (frames - crossed) % 400 == 0 and frames < 34500 then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CK frame=%d px=%d py=%d 76=%02X hist %s", frames, lx, ly, wr(0x76), hist()))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames == 43100 and not done then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d leaderX=%d leaderY=%d D2E3=%02X zone=%02X crossed=%d diffW=%d",
			frames, lx, ly, wr(0xD2E3), wr(0xD990), crossed, diffN))
		local keys = {}
		for k in pairs(pcCount) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
		table.sort(keys, function(a, b) return (pcCount[a] or 0) > (pcCount[b] or 0) end)
		for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
			print(string.format("PCSUM %s %d", k, pcCount[k]))
		end
		print("CS-GRID6-DONE")
		flush_pad()
		done = true
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	if not done and frames >= END_FRAME then
		print("CS-GRID6-TIMEOUT frame=" .. frames)
		done = true
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/cs_grid7.lua`:

```lua
-- cs_grid7.lua - engine-true attr capture of maps 0x249 and 0x24A
-- (docs/map-format.md "Chip default passability" follow-up): the same
-- watch method as cs_grid5/cs_grid6, widened to the WHOLE $7F bank
-- ($7F:0000-$7FFF, raw WRAM 0x10000-0x17FFF) so both per-tile buffers
-- are captured on every load the grid5 input policy walks through:
-- the party crosses 0x249 -> 0x24A -> 0x250 (crossing into 0x250 at
-- frame 28435 deterministically). Logs every CPU write with its PC and
-- dumps the settled bank after each map load; the offline analysis
-- reconstructs the attr grid ($7F:$1C+tile) and the $7F:0000 low
-- buffer (C0:58CC gate) per map and diffs them against the model.
--
-- Input policy and timing are byte-identical to cs_grid5 (which the
-- previous round proved deterministic).

local LOG_FROM = 11000
local END_FRAME = 33100

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local crossed = -1

local lastCfg = nil
local loadFrame = nil
local loadVal = nil
local dumpedFor = nil
local gwN = 0

local function flush_pad()
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function wr16(off)
	return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256
end
local function leader()
	return wr(0xD9AA) + wr(0xD9AB) * 256, wr(0xD9AC) + wr(0xD9AD) * 256
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, 0x7FFF do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(emu.read(0x10000 + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

print("CS-GRID7-LOADED")
flush_pad()

-- $D2E3 write watch: the map-load fingerprint (0x26=0x249, 07=0x24A,
-- 02=0x250). grid6's lesson: poll the cell too, some loads bypass the
-- write watch.
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if val ~= lastCfg then
			lastCfg = val
			loadFrame = frames
			loadVal = val
			dumpedFor = nil

			flush_pad()
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("LOAD-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD2E3, 0xD2E3, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- whole-$7F-bank write log with PC (attr grid + $7F:0000 low buffer)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < LOG_FROM or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)

		if gwN % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end)

		print("GWC-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x10000, 0x17FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

	frames = frames + 1
```

```lua
-- cs_loane.lua - teleport to Loane (map 0x4B) via the crafted savestate
-- (/tmp/cs-agent/walk/loane_state.mss = the walk13-lineage state with the
-- VM hijack at $7E:D56D patched to `11 0e` = mapJump table index 0x0E ->
-- Loane 0x4B (31,77); op-0x11 table at file 3CFB00, verified: entry 0x0E
-- = record "84 4b 84 1f 4d" = map 0x4B, arrival (31,77)). The state was
-- dumped from a bokuno_jp.sfc prologue run by journey_teleport.lua and
-- rebuilt by craft_state.py's method (mss parse/edit_wram/rebuild).
--
-- Deliverables:
--   - OAM/CGRAM/VRAM + screenshot captures in Loane for the g=C2
--     townsfolk blob pin (docs/sprites.md; townsfolk at tiles

	elseif rem == 2 then

local function dump(name, readfn, count)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames >= 34000 and frames % 100 == 0 then
		print(string.format("PRELOAD frame=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X", frames, wr(0x76), mapid(), wr(0xD2E3)))
	end
	if not loaded then return end
	-- Loane discriminators: stride $D0D1 = 0x40 (64 tiles wide) and the
	-- record's object config byte $D2E3 = 0x02 (0x250 shares it; the
	-- stride separates them).

		inLoane = true

		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("LOANE frame=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X D0D1=%02X leader=(%d,%d)",
			frames, mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0xD0D1), lx, ly))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if inLoane and townAt ~= nil and caps < 8 and frames >= townAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), mapid(), lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))

		dump("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		if caps == 2 then
			-- one full attr-region dump for the water-boundary analysis
			dump("attr", function(i) return wr(0x1800 + i) end, 6144)
		end

	end
	-- task 5: after capture 4, walk south legs to the coast
	if inLoane and caps >= 4 and legDir == nil and not done then
		legIdx = legIdx + 1
		if legIdx > 10 then
			done = true
			print("CS-LOANE-DONE frame=" .. frames)
			flush_pad()
			emu.stop(0)
			return
		end
		legDir = ({ "down", "down", "left", "down", "down", "right", "down", "down", "left", "down" })[legIdx]
		legX0, legY0 = leader()
		legHoldUntil = frames + HOLD
		print(string.format("WLEG %d dir=%s start=(%d,%d) frame=%d", legIdx, legDir, legX0, legY0, frames))
	elseif inLoane and legDir ~= nil and frames >= legHoldUntil + SETTLE then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("WLEG %d dir=%s end dX=%d dY=%d pos=(%d,%d) busy=%d",
			legIdx, legDir, lx - legX0, ly - legY0, lx, ly, wr(0x76)))
		legDir = nil
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("CS-LOANE-DONE frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
```

`tools/emulator/cutselect.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Cut the 8 protagonist figures from select-screen captures, take 2.

Single frame per page (the idle animation only shifts poses; any clean
frame shows the full figure). Figure pixels are keyed against the
parchment background shades sampled from figure-free columns of the same
cell rows. Output: 16x24 RGBA, figure bottom-aligned, at native res.
"""
import struct, zlib, os, sys

CELLS = {
    0: (44, 100, 92, 166),
    1: (44, 168, 92, 234),
    2: (44, 234, 92, 298),
    3: (44, 298, 92, 362),
}
BG_COLS = (88, 96)  # figure-free columns inside every cell
ALLIES = {"m": ["00", "03", "05", "04"], "f": ["02", "01", "06", "07"]}
FRAME = {"m": 7600, "f": 7600}
OUT = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/tmp/walkfig-decode/protag"


def read_png_rgb(path):
    d = open(path, "rb").read()
    pos = 8
    idat = b""
    while pos < len(d):
        ln = struct.unpack(">I", d[pos:pos + 4])[0]
        typ = d[pos + 4:pos + 8]
        body = d[pos + 8:pos + 8 + ln]
        if typ == b"IHDR":
            w, h = struct.unpack(">II", body[:8])
        elif typ == b"IDAT":
            idat += body
        pos += 12 + ln
    raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
    stride = w * 3
    out = bytearray(w * h * 3)
    prev = bytearray(stride)
    p = 0
    for y in range(h):
        f = raw[p]
        line = bytearray(raw[p + 1:p + 1 + stride])
        p += 1 + stride
        if f == 1:
            for i in range(3, stride):
                line[i] = (line[i] + line[i - 3]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 2:
            for i in range(stride):
                line[i] = (line[i] + prev[i]) & 0xFF
        elif f == 3:
            for i in range(stride):
                a = line[i - 3] if i >= 3 else 0
                line[i] = (line[i] + (a + prev[i]) // 2) & 0xFF
        elif f == 4:
            for i in range(stride):
                a = line[i - 3] if i >= 3 else 0
                b = prev[i]
                c = prev[i - 3] if i >= 3 else 0
                pp = a + b - c
                pa, pb, pc = abs(pp - a), abs(pp - b), abs(pp - c)
                pr = a if (pa <= pb and pa <= pc) else (b if pb <= pc else c)
                line[i] = (line[i] + pr) & 0xFF
        prev = line
        out[y * stride:(y + 1) * stride] = line
    return w, h, out


def write_png(path, w, h, rgba):
    def chunk(typ, body):
        return struct.pack(">I", len(body)) + typ + body + \
            struct.pack(">I", zlib.crc32(typ + body) & 0xFFFFFFFF)
    raw = b"".join(b"\x00" + bytes(rgba[y * w * 4:(y + 1) * w * 4]) for y in range(h))
    open(path, "wb").write(b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n" +
        chunk(b"IHDR", struct.pack(">IIBBBBB", w, h, 8, 6, 0, 0, 0)) +
        chunk(b"IDAT", zlib.compress(raw)) + chunk(b"IEND", b""))


for page, d in (("m", "/tmp/walkfig-decode/sel_m"), ("f", "/tmp/walkfig-decode/sel_f")):
    w, h, img = read_png_rgb(os.path.join(d, "frame_%d.png" % FRAME[page]))
    for slot, (x0, y0, x1, y1) in CELLS.items():
        # parchment shades sampled once from the big clean right panel
        # (x 300-500): covers every background gradient band
        shades = set()
        for y in range(20, 420, 2):
            for x in range(300, 500, 2):
                i = (y * w + x) * 3
                shades.add((img[i], img[i + 1], img[i + 2]))

        def bg(c):
            return min(sum(abs(a - b) for a, b in zip(c, s))
                       for s in shades) <= 14
        mask = []
        for y in range(y0, y1):
            row = []
            for x in range(x0, x1):
                i = (y * w + x) * 3
                c = (img[i], img[i + 1], img[i + 2])
                row.append(0 if bg(c) else 1)
            mask.append(row)
        ys = [y for y, row in enumerate(mask) if any(row)]
        xs = [x for x in range(x1 - x0) if any(mask[y][x] for y in range(len(mask)))]
        if not ys:
            print("slot %d %s: EMPTY" % (slot, page))
            continue
        by0, by1, bx0, bx1 = min(ys), max(ys) + 1, min(xs), max(xs) + 1
        # erode noise: drop boundary rows/cols with fewer than 2 fg px
        while by1 - by0 > 4 and sum(mask[by0]) < 2:
            by0 += 1
        while by1 - by0 > 4 and sum(mask[by1 - 1]) < 2:
            by1 -= 1
        while bx1 - bx0 > 4 and sum(1 for y in range(by0, by1) if mask[y][bx0]) < 2:
            bx0 += 1
        while bx1 - bx0 > 4 and sum(1 for y in range(by0, by1) if mask[y][bx1 - 1]) < 2:
            bx1 -= 1
        # tight native-res crop (2x screenshot -> 1x native), no padding:
        # the renderer draws the texture as-is (sizes already vary, e.g. 97)
        bw, bh = bx1 - bx0, by1 - by0
        nw, nh = (bw + 1) // 2, (bh + 1) // 2
        canvas = bytearray(nw * nh * 4)
        for y in range(by0, by1):
            for x in range(bx0, bx1):
                if not mask[y][x]:
                    continue
                i = ((y0 + y) * w + (x0 + x)) * 3
                nx, ny = (x - bx0) // 2, (y - by0) // 2
                j = (ny * nw + nx) * 4
                canvas[j:j + 3] = img[i:i + 3]
                canvas[j + 3] = 255
        ally = ALLIES[page][slot]
        dd = os.path.join(OUT, ally)
        os.makedirs(dd, exist_ok=True)
        write_png(os.path.join(dd, "down.png"), nw, nh, canvas)
        print("slot %d %s ally %s native %dx%d" % (slot, page, ally, nw, nh))
print("done")

```

`tools/emulator/dupnpc_249.lua`:

```lua
-- dupnpc_249.lua - runtime truth for map 0x249's 14 block-2 entries
-- (docs/sprites.md open item: 12 entries inherit identical coordinates).
--
-- STATUS: this script never produced a line. The static decode it was to
-- confirm is complete and decisive without it (docs/triggers.md): no
-- 0x249 entry carries flag bit6, so the walker's INC $8E bypasses the
-- placement gate for every entry and all 14 slots spawn. Kept as the
-- record of what was tried, for the next attempt:
--
--   1. exec callbacks at C0:3E07 / C0:4A9C / C0:4A78 (full CPU addresses,
--      rip.lua's registration) - never fire. A control watch on rip.lua's
--      proven bank-5E address (dupnpc_execprobe variant) fired once, so
--      the mechanism works for bank 5E; bank C0 does not match.
--   2. write watch on WRAM 0xD9 (INC $D9 at C0:3E80), PC-filtered - no
--      fire in 3000 s.
--   3. write watch on WRAM 0xB90E (the per-entry restore store at
--      C0:4A3D), no filter - no fire in 5400 s, although the analogous
--      write watch on WRAM 0xD2E3 (shot_d2e3_probe.lua) is byte-proven
--      working. Unresolved: why bank-C0 exec matches and these WRAM
--      write watches stay silent where the same forms work elsewhere.
--
-- Input: the walk13 PRESSES boot to new game only (no walk program).

local frames = 0
local done = false
local LAST_FRAME = 30000

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

print("DUPNPC-LOADED")

local function wr(addr)
	return emu.read(addr, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

local function mapid()
	return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
end

local function pad()
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

-- per-entry log: the restore at C0:4A3D writes $B90E once per entry.
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	print(string.format(
		"ENTRY frame=%d pc=%02X:%04X map=%04X val=%02X d8=%02X d9=%02X pos=%02X,%02X f=%02X g=%02X ev=%02X%02X q=%02X%02X",
		frames, st.k, st.pc, mapid(), val, wr(0xD8), wr(0xD9),
		wr(0xB910), wr(0xB911), wr(0xB912), wr(0xB913),
		wr(0xB915), wr(0xB914), wr(0xB917), wr(0xB916)))
	pad()
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xB90E, 0xB90E, emu.memType.snesWorkRam, emu.cpuType.snes)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("DUPNPC-DONE frames=" .. frames)
		pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/enc_dispatch.lua`:

```lua
-- enc_dispatch.lua - catch how a field battle is dispatched: write watches
-- on $141B (encounter race/band descriptor byte, S_C2_09F4), $1306/$1314
-- (op-18/19 queue-word scenario id and marker), the VM queue region
-- $D6BB-$D6CF, the battle-record id $D51B, plus reads of the FE:77BB
-- appearance-pair table (race/band index) and reads of the per-character
-- event-id word at WRAM $D9D0-$D9D7 (touch dispatcher candidates).
--
-- Walk policy = form_battle7.lua verbatim (intro mash, then down/right on
-- the road; the road battle fires around frame 29425 there).
--
-- Patched by sed before runs: END_FRAME.

local END_FRAME = 36000

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local FIELD_SONG = 33
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local WALK_FROM = 20800
local LAST_FRAME = 36000

local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end

print("ENCDISP-LOADED")
flush_pad()

local function statetag()
	local tag, st = pctag()
	return string.format("pc=%s a=%04X x=%04X y=%04X db=%02X", tag, st.a or -1,
		st.x or -1, st.y or -1, st.db or -1)
end

local ARM = 19500

-- $141B: encounter descriptor byte (race in low nibble, $F0-flag family)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < ARM then return end
	print(string.format("W141B frame=%d val=%02X %s", frames, val, statetag()))
	flush_pad()
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x141B, 0x141B, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- $1306 / $1314: op 18/19 queue-word scenario id and marker
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < ARM then return end
	print(string.format("W1306 frame=%d val=%02X %s", frames, val, statetag()))
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x1306, 0x1306, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < ARM then return end
	print(string.format("W1314 frame=%d val=%02X %s", frames, val, statetag()))
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x1314, 0x1314, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- VM dispatch queue bytes ($D6BD array, write index $D6BB, slots $D6CD+)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < ARM then return end
	print(string.format("WQUEUE frame=%d addr=%04X val=%02X %s", frames, a, val, statetag()))
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD6BB, 0xD6CF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- current dispatch id $D51B (which event id the VM is running)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < ARM then return end
	print(string.format("WD51B frame=%d val=%02X %s", frames, val, statetag()))
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD51B, 0xD51C, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- FE:77BB appearance-pair reads: X = race*32+band*2 at 5A:7674
local fereads = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < ARM then return end
	if fereads < 40 then
		fereads = fereads + 1
		print(string.format("FEREAD frame=%d addr=%06X val=%02X %s",
			frames, a, val, statetag()))
	end
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xFE77BB, 0xFE77BB + 512 - 1,
	emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- per-character event-id word reads ($D9D0-$D9D7 window): the touch
-- dispatcher candidate; capped because the render loop also reads records
local npc_reads = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < ARM then return end
	if npc_reads < 250 then
		npc_reads = npc_reads + 1
		print(string.format("RNPCID frame=%d addr=%04X val=%02X %s",
			frames, a, val, statetag()))
		if npc_reads % 40 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xD9D0, 0xD9D7,
	emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == 41 and frames >= 20000 then
		battle = true
	elseif id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		print(string.format("BATTLE-START frame=%d", frames))
		flush_pad()
	elseif (id == FIELD_SONG or id == 36) and battle and battle_start
		and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d", frames))
		flush_pad()
	end
end

local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local tag = pctag()
		if string.find(tag, "C6:0A75") then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
			if battle then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - WALK_FROM
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print(string.format("COUNTS fe=%d npc=%d", fereads, npc_reads))
			print("ENCDISP-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

```lua
-- encounter_comp.lua - the field-encounter composition (C2:13EA) inputs
-- and result, for the port's composition model (docs/field-monsters.md
-- "Encounter composition"). Play flow = battle_item_consume.lua (pressed
-- boot, walk legs to the 0x250 bump battles, heal-item ladder).
-- Logs at C2:13EA entry: $141B (race byte), $F319 (party count), $1308,
-- $F532 (global level), $F533[race]; at the exit (C2:1410 RTS): dp $56/
-- $57/$58/$5A/$5B/$5C/$34 and every enemy record's id word; at FE:D097's
-- RTL: $8A/$8C/$56 per evaluation.

-- (to 200k frames) and watches the companion try/add sites.
--

--      --timeout=7200 > /tmp/encounter/run3.log
-- does the engine consume anything after a battle? The battle itself does
-- not consume the equipped 道具 (§16.2), so the question is the post-battle
-- flow. Watches:
--   VICTORY: exec of C2:DA6B, the decoded post-battle flow entry
--   (roadmap 2b-field: it bumps $F532/$F533 after battle).
--   INVRD / INVWR: reads and writes across $7EF32A-$7EF3FF, the verified
--   inventory region (roadmap Runtime state). A consumption would show as
--   INVWR with a decremented count and a pc inside the post-battle bank.
--   ITEMEXEC: C2:700E so a real in-battle item use is on record this run.
-- Play flow = attack_item.lua verbatim (pressed boot to the bump battle
-- at ~45099; heal-item ladder on every ally so someone actually uses 傷薬

-- the party fall).

for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end

PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc)

-- inventory snapshot: 16 word-ish slots at $7EF32A (count+id pairs are the
-- engine's known shape; print raw bytes, the diff is what matters)
local function invsnap(tag)
	local t = {}
	for i = 0, 63 do t[#t + 1] = string.format("%02X", wr(0xF32A + i)) end
	print(string.format("INV frame=%d bt=%s %s %s", frames,
		real_start ~= nil and tostring(frames - real_start) or "-", tag,
		table.concat(t, "")))
end

local CAP = { INVRD = 8000, INVWR = 8000, DISPATCH = 200, GIVE = 50, GETITEM = 50, IDWR = 800, ADDLOOP = 200 }
local seen = {}
local dropped = {}
local function log(cat, line)
	seen[cat] = (seen[cat] or 0) + 1
	if seen[cat] <= CAP[cat] then
		print(string.format("%s frame=%d %s", cat, frames, line))
		if seen[cat] % 40 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	else
		dropped[cat] = (dropped[cat] or 0) + 1
	end
end

print("ENCOUNTER-LOADED")
flush_pad()

local function dp(off)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return wr((st.d or 0) + off)
end
local function dp16(off) return dp(off) + dp(off + 1) * 256 end

-- run 2: who writes $D2FE (copied to $1308 at the bump, C0:C042 area)
local d2fe_n = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	d2fe_n = d2fe_n + 1

			wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))

	print(string.format("COMP-OUT frame=%d 56=%02X 57=%02X 58=%02X 5A=%02X 5B=%02X 5C=%02X 34=%02X 16D2=%04X/%04X/%04X recs=%s",
		frames, dp(0x56), dp(0x57), dp(0x58), dp(0x5A), dp(0x5B), dp(0x5C), dp(0x34),
		wr16(0x16D2), wr16(0x16D4), wr16(0x16D6), table.concat(recs, " ")))

	print(string.format("D097 frame=%d 8A=%04X 8C=%04X 56=%02X 82=%02X", frames,
		dp16(0x8A), dp16(0x8C), dp(0x56), dp(0x82)))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xFED0AE, 0xFED0AE, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		if frames > WALK_FROM then
			real_battle = true
			real_start = frames
			print(string.format("REAL-BATTLE frame=%d", frames))
			flush_pad()
		end
	elseif id ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and id ~= VICTORY_SONG
		and battle and real_start == nil and frames > WALK_FROM then
		battle = false
		print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
	elseif id ~= VICTORY_SONG and real_battle and frames > WALK_FROM then
		-- run 3: back on the field after a battle -> walk on for more bumps
		real_battle = false
		real_start = nil
		ladder_start = 0
		print(string.format("FIELD-AGAIN frame=%d song=%d", frames, id))
	end
end

local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		if real_battle and real_start ~= nil then
			local cur = wr16(0x09B8)
			if cur ~= last_cur then
				last_cur = cur
				if MEMBER_B8[cur] then
					if frames - last_arm > 400 then
						ladder_start = frames
						last_arm = frames
						arm_n = arm_n + 1
						print(string.format("LADDER-ARM frame=%d n=%d cur=%04X", frames, arm_n, cur))
						flush_pad()
					end
				end
			end
			if ladder_start > 0 then
				local lt = frames - ladder_start
				if lt == 60 then p = { right = 1 } end
				if lt == 220 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 380 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 540 then p = { a = 1 } end
				if lt == 700 then p = { a = 1 } end
			end
		end
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME and not real_battle then
			local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
			if busy and frames < 45000 then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				if leg_start == 0 then leg_start = frames end
				local t = frames - leg_start
				if t < LEG_FRAMES then
					p = { [LEGS[leg_i]] = 1 }
				else
					leg_i = leg_i + 1
					if leg_i > #LEGS then leg_i = 1 end
					leg_start = frames
					p = { [LEGS[leg_i]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("ENCOUNTER-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

```lua
-- standard encounter chain. Watches reads of the enemy main stat table
-- (FE:3F8B, 256 x 25B) and the enemy name table (FE:0A80) in the battle

-- record base. Run 2 (git history) carries the formation-region

	if not in_window() then return end

			frames, a, off // 25, off % 25, val, statetag()))
	end

	emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

-- scan all low WRAM for a little-endian word; return up to 12 hit bases
local function scan_word(lo, hi, w)
	local hits = {}
	local b0 = w % 256
	local b1 = math.floor(w / 256) % 256
	for a = lo, hi - 1 do
		if emu.read(a, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) == b0
			and emu.read(a + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) == b1 then
			hits[#hits + 1] = a
			if #hits >= 12 then break end
		end
	end
	return hits
end

local function dump_range(tag, first, last)
	local parts = {}
	for a = first, last do
		parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02X", emu.read(a, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	end
	print(string.format("DUMP %s %04X-%04X %s", tag, first, last, table.concat(parts)))
end

local function scan_and_dump(frame_tag, words)
	for _, w in ipairs(words) do
		local hits = scan_word(0x0000, 0x7FFE, w)
		print(string.format("HPSCAN %s word=%04X hits=%d %s",
			frame_tag, w, #hits, table.concat(
				(function() local t={} for _,h in ipairs(hits) do t[#t+1]=string.format("%04X",h) end return t end)(),
				" ")))
		flush_pad()
		for _, h in ipairs(hits) do
			local lo = math.max(h - 0x14, 0)
			dump_range(string.format("HPW%04X@%04X", w, h), lo, lo + 0x5F)
		end
	end
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
			if battle then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - WALK_FROM
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if frames == 29600 and not dumped[1] then
			dumped[1] = true
			scan_and_dump("f29600", { 0x01F5, 0x00F9, 0x01FA })
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames == 38000 and not dumped[2] then
			dumped[2] = true
			scan_and_dump("f38000", { 0x01F5, 0x00F9, 0x01FA })
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print(string.format("ESREAD-COUNTS %d", es_reads))
			print("ENEMYFORM3-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/equip_cal.lua`:

```lua
-- equip_cal.lua - calibrate the ENGINE equipment screen's first navigation
-- step (docs/attack-item-decode-notes.md equip route). The 装備 menu entry
-- lands on the STATUS page (character list + stat panel with the equipment
-- icons, /tmp/attackitem/equip1/eq_600.png); this run branches the first
-- press {right,left,down,a,b,y} from a savestate taken right after that A,
-- one screenshot per branch, to identify the key that opens the
-- slot/item selection.
--
-- Machinery: field_menu_trace.lua (NMI exec-hook savestates, 120-frame
-- press cadence, DUMPDATA screenshot chunks).
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/equip_cal.lua --timeout=3600
--      > /tmp/attackitem/equipcal1.log

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local BUSY_RUN = 600
local busy_zero = 0
local s_taken = false
local END_FRAME = 42000

local phase = "walk"
local open_t0 = nil
local did_select = false
local equip_a = false
local equip_t0 = nil

local s1
local want_snap = nil
local want_load = nil

local BRANCHES = { 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6 }
local BRANCHES2 = { "down", "right", "left", "a", "b", "y" }
local br2_i = 0
local s2
local br_i = 0
local SCHED = {}
local bag_reads = ""

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr8(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr8(off) + wr8(off + 1) * 256 end
local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr8(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr8(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = (bytes[i] or 0) * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "=" end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot(tag)
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d phase=%s", frames, phase))
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. tag)
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. tag)
	flush_pad()
end

local function bagdump()
	local t = {}
	for i = 0, 31 do
		local id = wr8(0x7EF32A + i * 2)
		local n = wr8(0x7EF32A + i * 2 + 1)
		if id ~= 0 or n ~= 0 then t[#t + 1] = string.format("%02Xx%d", id, n) end
	end
	if #t == 0 then return "empty" end
	return table.concat(t, ",")
end

print("EQUIP-CAL-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if want_snap then
		want_snap = nil
		local ok, obj = pcall(emu.createSavestate)
		if ok then s1 = obj; print("SNAP s1 ok") end
	end
	if want_snap2 then
		want_snap2 = nil
		local ok, obj = pcall(emu.createSavestate)
		if ok then s2 = obj; print("SNAP s2 ok") end
	end
	if want_load then
		want_load = nil
		if s1 then
			local ok, err = pcall(emu.loadSavestate, s1)
			print("LOAD s1 " .. tostring(ok) .. " " .. tostring(err or ""))
		end
	end
	if want_load2 then
		want_load2 = nil
		if s2 then
			local ok, err = pcall(emu.loadSavestate, s2)
			print("LOAD s2 " .. tostring(ok) .. " " .. tostring(err or ""))
		end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x00FF07, 0x00FF07, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = wr8(0x76) ~= 0

		if p == nil and not s_taken and frames >= 20800 then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 60 == 0 then p = { right = 1 } else p = { down = 1 } end
			end
		end

		if phase == "walk" and not s_taken and frames >= 19000 then
			local cfg = wr8(0xD2E3)
			if busy or (cfg ~= 0x02 and cfg ~= 0x07) then busy_zero = 0
			else
				busy_zero = busy_zero + 1
				if busy_zero == BUSY_RUN then
					phase = "open"
					open_t0 = frames + 20
					print(string.format("CLEARING frame=%d fp=%s bag(battleaddr)=%s",
						frames, fingerprint(), bagdump()))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
		end

		if phase == "open" and open_t0 ~= nil and frames >= open_t0 then
			local t = frames - open_t0
			if not did_select then
				did_select = true
				p = { select = 1 }
				print("OPEN select")
			elseif t == 80 then
				want_snap = true
				shot("menu_80")
				phase = "cal"
				print("CAL-START")
			end
		end

		-- scheduled events (cal machinery)
		if SCHED[1] and frames >= SCHED[1][1] then
			local ev = table.remove(SCHED, 1)
			local kind = ev[2]
			if kind == "REWIND" then
				want_load = true
				print(string.format("CAL rewind for branch %d", br_i))
			elseif kind == "SNAPS2" then
				want_snap2 = true
				phase = "cal2"
			elseif kind == "REWIND2" then
				want_load2 = true
			elseif kind == "PRESS" then
				p = { [ev[3]] = 1 }
			elseif kind:sub(1, 5) == "SHOT_" then
				shot(kind:sub(6))
			elseif kind == "NEXT" then
				-- schedule the next branch
			end
		end

		-- cal driver: each branch = rewind S1, then its own press offsets
		-- (the menu polls input several times per frame, so a 1-frame A
		-- can register on different poll phases across runs; calibrate
		-- the A timing by rewind-branching within one run).
		-- Branch 6 (+140) lands on ハリード's 装備 status page: snapshot
		-- it as S2, then branch the second-stage keys from S2.
		if phase == "cal" and br_i < #BRANCHES and #SCHED == 0 and s1 then
			br_i = br_i + 1
			local delta = (br_i - 1) * 8
			print(string.format("CAL branch %d a_at=+%d", br_i, 100 + delta))
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 4, "REWIND" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 100 + delta, "PRESS", "a" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 400 + delta, "SHOT_a" .. (100 + delta) }
			if br_i >= #BRANCHES then
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 700 + delta, "REWIND" }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 800 + delta, "PRESS", "a" }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 1140 + delta, "SNAPS2" }
			end
		end
		if phase == "cal2" and br2_i < #BRANCHES2 and #SCHED == 0 and s2 then
			br2_i = br2_i + 1
			local btn = BRANCHES2[br2_i]
			print(string.format("CAL2 branch %d btn=%s", br2_i, btn))
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 4, "REWIND2" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 130, "PRESS", btn }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 400, "SHOT_s2_" .. btn }
			if br2_i >= #BRANCHES2 then
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 700, "DONE" }
			end
		end
		if SCHED[1] and SCHED[1][2] == "DONE" and frames >= SCHED[1][1] then
			table.remove(SCHED, 1)
			done = true
			print("EQUIP-CAL-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			flush_pad()
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end

		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("EQUIP-CAL-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

```lua
-- equip_item.lua - equip 精霊石 (bag item from the opening chain,
-- vm-semantics.md "兵士の鎧3, ブロードソード1, 精霊石4") onto a 腕 slot

-- its UI (character select? slot list? item list?). Success criterion
-- for later rounds: a 腕 byte $7EF000+0x80*i+0x47..+0x4A becomes 05.

local SAMPLE = {}
for off = 0x0000, 0x7FFF, 2 do SAMPLE[#SAMPLE + 1] = off end
local function sample()
	local t = {}
	for _, off in ipairs(SAMPLE) do t[#t + 1] = string.format("%02X", wr8(off)) end
	return table.concat(t)
end
local base1 = nil
local function dumpdiff(tag)
	if not base1 then return end
	local cur = sample()
	local diffs = {}
	for i = 1, #SAMPLE do
		if base1:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1) ~= cur:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1) then
			diffs[#diffs + 1] = string.format("%04X=%s>%s", SAMPLE[i],
				base1:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1), cur:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1))
		end
	end
	print(string.format("WRAMDIFF frame=%d phase=%s tag=%s count=%d", frames, phase, tag, #diffs))
	for i, d in ipairs(diffs) do
		if i > 120 then print("WRAMDIFF ... truncated"); break end
		print("WRAMDIFF " .. d)
	end
	flush_pad()
end

local function quads()
	local q = {}
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local b = 0x7EF000 + 0x80 * i
		q[#q + 1] = string.format("%02X%02X%02X%02X",
			wr8(b + 0x47), wr8(b + 0x48), wr8(b + 0x49), wr8(b + 0x4A))
	end
	return table.concat(q, ",")
end
local function bagdump()
	local t = {}
	for i = 0, 31 do
		local id = wr8(0x7EF32A + i * 2)
		local n = wr8(0x7EF32A + i * 2 + 1)
		if id ~= 0 or n ~= 0 then t[#t + 1] = string.format("%02Xx%d", id, n) end
	end
	return table.concat(t, ",")
end

	if want_snap then
		local which = want_snap
		want_snap = nil
		local ok, obj = pcall(emu.createSavestate)
		if ok and which == "s0" then
			snap0 = obj
			s0_taken = true
			print("SNAP s0 ok")
		end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x00FF07, 0x00FF07, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = wr8(0x76) ~= 0

		if p == nil and not s0_taken and frames >= 20800 then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 60 == 0 then p = { right = 1 } else p = { down = 1 } end
			end
		end

		if phase == "walk" and not s0_taken and frames >= 19000 then
			local cfg = wr8(0xD2E3)
			if busy or (cfg ~= 0x02 and cfg ~= 0x07) then busy_zero = 0
			else
				busy_zero = busy_zero + 1
				if busy_zero == BUSY_RUN then
					want_snap = "s0"
					phase = "open"
					open_t0 = frames + 20
					print(string.format("SNAPREQ frame=%d fp=%s leader=%04X,%04X bag=%s quads=%s",
						frames, fingerprint(), wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC), bagdump(), quads()))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
		end

		if phase == "open" and open_t0 ~= nil and frames >= open_t0 then
			local t = frames - open_t0
			if not did_select then
				did_select = true
				p = { select = 1 }
				print("OPEN select")
			elseif t == 90 then
				base1 = sample()
				print(string.format("OPEN-STATE bag=%s quads=%s", bagdump(), quads()))
				flush_pad()
			end
		end

		-- equip: SELECT opened the menu, A confirms 装備 (default cursor)
		if phase == "open" and did_select and frames >= open_t0 + 120 and not equip_a then
			equip_a = true
			p = { a = 1 }
			phase = "equip"
			equip_t0 = frames
			print("EQUIP a")
		end
		if phase == "equip" and equip_t0 ~= nil then
			local t = frames - equip_t0
			if t >= 0 and t <= 2400 and t % 60 == 0 then
				shot("eq_" .. t)
				print(string.format("EQUIPSTATE frame=%d t=%d quads=%s bag=%s", frames, t, quads(), bagdump()))
				dumpdiff("eqdiff_" .. t)
			end
			if t > 2600 then
				print("EQUIP-DONE frames=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
				for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
				emu.stop(0)
				done = true
			end
		end

		if frames % 1800 == 0 and phase == "walk" then
			print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s busy=%s", frames, fingerprint(), tostring(busy)))
		end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("EQUIP-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end

		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

```lua
-- equip_step1.lua - the attack-item manual-use test, stage 1
-- (docs/attack-item-decode-notes.md): find the FIELD-time party record /
-- bag addresses and calibrate the first key off the 装備 status page.
--
-- After the A@+120 lands on the status page (equip1's proven timing):
--   1. WRAM scan $7E0000-$7FFFFF for the party quads (トーマス
--      42 39 FF 01 / モニカ 30 FF FF 05 / ユリアン 08 xx FF 00) and a
--      bag-shaped [05,04] (精霊石 x4) pair — the field-time base of
--      $7EF000/$7EF32A (both read zero at field time in equip1).
--   2. Snapshot S2, branch the first key {right,left,x,y,a,start} with
--      40-frame settle shots — the branch whose shot opens the slot /
--      equipment list carries the navigation forward.
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/equip_step1.lua --timeout=3600
--      > /tmp/attackitem/step1.log

PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }

local s_taken = false

local phase = "walk"
local open_t0 = nil
local did_select = false
local s2
local want_snap = nil
local want_load2 = nil
local br_i = 0
local BRANCHES = { "right", "left", "x", "y", "a", "start" }
local SCHED = {}

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr8(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr8(off) + wr8(off + 1) * 256 end
local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr8(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr8(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = (bytes[i] or 0) * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "=" end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot(tag)
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d phase=%s", frames, phase))
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. tag)
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. tag)
	flush_pad()
end

-- scan WRAM for the party-record quads and a 精霊石 bag pair
local function wramscan(tag)
	local hits = {}
	for base = 0x7E0000, 0x7F0000 - 4, 1 do
		local a = wr8(base)
		if a == 0x42 and wr8(base + 1) == 0x39 and wr8(base + 2) == 0xFF and wr8(base + 3) == 0x01 then
			hits[#hits + 1] = string.format("thomas@%06X", base)
		elseif a == 0x30 and wr8(base + 1) == 0xFF and wr8(base + 2) == 0xFF and wr8(base + 3) == 0x05 then
			hits[#hits + 1] = string.format("monica@%06X", base)
		elseif a == 0x08 and wr8(base + 2) == 0xFF and wr8(base + 3) == 0x00 then
			hits[#hits + 1] = string.format("julian?@%06X (%02X%02X%02X%02X)", base,
				a, wr8(base + 1), wr8(base + 2), wr8(base + 3))
		elseif a == 0x05 and wr8(base + 1) == 0x04 then
			hits[#hits + 1] = string.format("seiseki04@%06X", base)
		end
	end
	print(string.format("WRAMSCAN frame=%d tag=%s hits=%d", frames, tag, #hits))
	for _, h in ipairs(hits) do print("WRAMSCAN " .. h) end
	flush_pad()
end

print("EQUIP-STEP1-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if want_snap then
		want_snap = nil
		local ok, obj = pcall(emu.createSavestate)
		if ok then s2 = obj; print("SNAP s2 ok") end
	end
	if want_load2 then
		want_load2 = nil
		if s2 then
			local ok, err = pcall(emu.loadSavestate, s2)
			print("LOAD s2 " .. tostring(ok) .. " " .. tostring(err or ""))
		end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x00FF07, 0x00FF07, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = wr8(0x76) ~= 0

		if p == nil and not s_taken and frames >= 20800 then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 60 == 0 then p = { right = 1 } else p = { down = 1 } end
			end
		end

		if phase == "walk" and not s_taken and frames >= 19000 then
			local cfg = wr8(0xD2E3)
			if busy or (cfg ~= 0x02 and cfg ~= 0x07) then busy_zero = 0
			else
				busy_zero = busy_zero + 1
				if busy_zero == BUSY_RUN then
					phase = "open"
					open_t0 = frames + 20
					print(string.format("CLEARING frame=%d fp=%s", frames, fingerprint()))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
		end

		if phase == "open" and open_t0 ~= nil and frames >= open_t0 then
			local t = frames - open_t0
			if not did_select then
				did_select = true
				p = { select = 1 }
				print("OPEN select")
			elseif t == 120 then
				p = { a = 1 }
				print("EQUIP a")
			elseif t == 400 then
				shot("status_400")
				wramscan("status")
				want_snap = true
				phase = "cal"
				print("CAL-START")
			end
		end

		if phase == "cal" and br_i < #BRANCHES and #SCHED == 0 and s2 then
			br_i = br_i + 1
			local btn = BRANCHES[br_i]
			print(string.format("CAL2 branch %d btn=%s", br_i, btn))
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 4, "REWIND" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 130, "PRESS", btn }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 400, "SHOT_s2_" .. btn }
			if br_i >= #BRANCHES then
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 700, "DONE" }
			end
		end
		if SCHED[1] and frames >= SCHED[1][1] then
			local ev = table.remove(SCHED, 1)
			local kind = ev[2]
			if kind == "REWIND" then
				want_load2 = true
			elseif kind == "PRESS" then
				p = { [ev[3]] = 1 }
			elseif kind:sub(1, 5) == "SHOT_" then
				shot(kind:sub(6))
			elseif kind == "DONE" then
				done = true
				print("EQUIP-STEP1-DONE frames=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
				for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
				emu.stop(0)
			end
		end
		if frames >= 42000 and not done then
			done = true
			print("EQUIP-STEP1-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

```lua
-- equip_step2.lua - the attack-item manual-use test, stage 2
-- (docs/attack-item-decode-notes.md): everything rewind-relative so the
-- menu's multi-poll phase chaos cannot bite. Flow:
--   SELECT -> S1 (menu open) -> rewind-branch A@+140 (cal3/cal4: lands on
--   ハリード's 装備 status page) -> S3 snapshot -> branch the first key
--   {right,left,a,x,y,b,up,down} from S3, each: WRAM sample + shot.
-- Offline: pick the branch that opens the equipment slot list; the
-- WRAM samples also carry the menu-state bytes for machine detection.
-- Also: full 128KB WRAM scan for the party quads + 精霊石 bag pair.
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/equip_step2.lua --timeout=3600
--      > /tmp/attackitem/step2.log

local frames = 0
local done = false

PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }

local SCHED = {}

local function wr8(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr8(off) + wr8(off + 1) * 256 end
local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr8(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr8(0xD0D1))
end

local function b64(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do

			math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }

			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "=" end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot(tag)

	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. tag)

-- menu-state sample: low WRAM + the menu work area
local SAMPLE = {}
for off = 0x0000, 0x1FFF, 1 do SAMPLE[#SAMPLE + 1] = off end
for off = 0x2000, 0x2FFF, 1 do SAMPLE[#SAMPLE + 1] = off end
local function sample()
	local t = {}
	for _, off in ipairs(SAMPLE) do t[#t + 1] = string.format("%02X", wr8(off)) end
	return table.concat(t)
end
local function dumpsample(tag, base)
	local cur = sample()
	print(string.format("SAMPLE frame=%d tag=%s len=%d", frames, tag, #cur))
	if base then
		local diffs = {}
		for i = 1, #SAMPLE do
			if base:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1) ~= cur:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1) then
				diffs[#diffs + 1] = string.format("%04X=%s>%s", SAMPLE[i],
					base:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1), cur:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1))
			end
		end
		print(string.format("SAMPLEDIFF tag=%s count=%d", tag, #diffs))
		for i, d in ipairs(diffs) do
			if i > 60 then print("SAMPLEDIFF ... truncated"); break end
			print("SAMPLEDIFF " .. d)
		end
	else
		for i = 1, #cur, 2000 do
			print("SAMPLEDATA " .. cur:sub(i, math.min(i + 1999, #cur)))
		end
	end
	flush_pad()
end

-- full 128KB WRAM scan
local function wramscan(tag)
	local hits = {}
	for base = 0x7E0000, 0x7FFFFC, 1 do
		local a = wr8(base)
		if a == 0x42 and wr8(base + 1) == 0x39 and wr8(base + 2) == 0xFF and wr8(base + 3) == 0x01 then
			hits[#hits + 1] = string.format("thomas@%06X", base)
		elseif a == 0x30 and wr8(base + 1) == 0xFF and wr8(base + 2) == 0xFF and wr8(base + 3) == 0x05 then
			hits[#hits + 1] = string.format("monica@%06X", base)
		elseif a == 0x0B and wr8(base + 1) == 0x39 and wr8(base + 2) == 0xFF then
			hits[#hits + 1] = string.format("harii@%06X (%02X%02X%02X%02X)", base,
				a, wr8(base + 1), wr8(base + 2), wr8(base + 3))
		elseif a == 0x05 and wr8(base + 1) == 0x04 then
			hits[#hits + 1] = string.format("seiseki04@%06X", base)
		end
	end
	print(string.format("WRAMSCAN frame=%d tag=%s hits=%d", frames, tag, #hits))
	for _, h in ipairs(hits) do print("WRAMSCAN " .. h) end
	flush_pad()
end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()

			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 60 == 0 then p = { right = 1 } else p = { down = 1 } end
			end
		end

		if phase == "walk" and not s_taken and frames >= 19000 then
			local cfg = wr8(0xD2E3)
			if busy or (cfg ~= 0x02 and cfg ~= 0x07) then busy_zero = 0
			else

				if busy_zero == BUSY_RUN then
					phase = "open"
					open_t0 = frames + 20
					print(string.format("CLEARING frame=%d fp=%s", frames, fingerprint()))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
		end

			local t = frames - open_t0
			if not did_select then

				print("OPEN select")
			elseif t == 80 then
				want_snap1 = true
				phase = "cal1"
				print("CAL1-START")
			end
		end

		-- cal1: single rewind-branch, A@+140 -> ハリード's status page
		if phase == "cal1" and #SCHED == 0 and s1 then
			print("CAL1 branch a140")
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 4, "REWIND1" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 140, "PRESS", "a" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 400, "SHOT_status" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 410, "SCAN" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 420, "SNAP3" }
		end

		-- cal2: first-key branches from S3
		if phase == "cal2" and br_i < #BRANCHES and #SCHED == 0 and s3 then
			br_i = br_i + 1
			local btn = BRANCHES[br_i]

			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 400, "SHOT_s3_" .. btn }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 410, "DIFF3", btn }
			if br_i >= #BRANCHES then
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 700, "DONE" }
			end
		end

		if SCHED[1] and frames >= SCHED[1][1] then
			local ev = table.remove(SCHED, 1)
			local kind = ev[2]
			if kind == "REWIND1" then want_load1 = true
			elseif kind == "REWIND3" then want_load3 = true
			elseif kind == "PRESS" then p = { [ev[3]] = 1 }
			elseif kind == "SHOT_status" then shot("status_a140")

	end)

		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```
