`tools/emulator/equip_watch.lua`:

```lua
-- equip_watch.lua - capture the attack-item damage params from the
-- EQUIPMENT SCREEN's own evaluation path (docs/attack-item-decode-notes.md).
--
-- The 装備 status page runs C2:4918 per drawn member: per 腕 slot it
-- reads the item's FE:379F spec -> $42, JSR $04A8 (spec -> tech-row
-- pointer $FE:1D00+spec*14 via 5B:7770, or the 5B:4AC0 ext path), loads
-- the row into $DA/$DC/... and computes the damage in $018C. Watching
-- 0xC2018C exec with the dpscan + FE:1D00-1D80 reads while cycling the
-- member pages captures the engine's attack-item row (威力/成) without
-- needing a battle use.
--
-- Flow: walk4 intro -> clearing -> SELECT -> A@+120 (equip1's proven
-- 装備 landing) -> DOWN every 240 frames x12 (cycle members; the menu
-- polls input several times per frame so registration count varies —
-- coverage over precision) -> shots + WRAM quads every 240.
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/equip_watch.lua --timeout=3600
--      > /tmp/attackitem/equipwatch1.log

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local BUSY_RUN = 600
local busy_zero = 0
local s_taken = false
local END_FRAME = 36000

local phase = "walk"
local open_t0 = nil
local did_select = false
local equip_t0 = nil

local CAP = { SPECROW = 200, EVAL = 60 }
local seen = {}
local dropped = {}

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr8(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr8(off) + wr8(off + 1) * 256 end
local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr8(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr8(0xD0D1))
end
local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc)
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = (bytes[i] or 0) * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "=" end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot(tag)
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d phase=%s", frames, phase))
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. tag)
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. tag)
	flush_pad()
end

local function log(cat, line)
	seen[cat] = (seen[cat] or 0) + 1
	if seen[cat] <= CAP[cat] then
		print(string.format("%s frame=%d %s", cat, frames, line))
		if seen[cat] % 20 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	else
		dropped[cat] = (dropped[cat] or 0) + 1
	end
end

local function dpscan(tag)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local cands = {}
	for pg = 0, 255 do
		local b8 = wr16(pg * 0x100 + 0xB8)
		if b8 >= 0x2280 and b8 < 0x3000 then
			cands[#cands + 1] = string.format(
				"dp=%04X B8=%04X DA=%02X DC=%02X DD=%02X E0=%02X E1=%02X E2=%02X E4=%02X 9E=%02X DF=%02X 42=%02X",
				pg * 0x100, b8,
				wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xDA), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xDC), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xDD),
				wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xE0), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xE1), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xE2),
				wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xE4), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0x9E), wr(pg * 0x100 + 0xDF),
				wr(pg * 0x100 + 0x42))
		end
	end
	log(tag, string.format("at %02X:%04X A=%04X X=%04X Y=%04X | %s",
		st.k, st.pc, st.a or -1, st.x or -1, st.y or -1,
		table.concat(cands, " ; ")))
end

print("EQUIP-WATCH-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(dpscan, "EVAL")
	if not ok then print("EVAL-ERR " .. tostring(err)); flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC2018C, 0xC2018C, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- the spec tech rows FE:1D00-1D80 (CPU) = file 0x3E1D00
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	log("SPECROW", string.format("a=%06X val=%02X pc=%s", a, val, pctag()))
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xFE1D00, 0xFE1D80, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- the hack-ext enemy tech table 5B:4AC0 (spec*16 rows)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	log("SPECROW", string.format("a=%06X val=%02X pc=%s", a, val, pctag()))
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0x5B4AC0, 0x5B4B40, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = wr8(0x76) ~= 0

		if p == nil and not s_taken and frames >= 20800 then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 60 == 0 then p = { right = 1 } else p = { down = 1 } end
			end
		end

		if phase == "walk" and not s_taken and frames >= 19000 then
			local cfg = wr8(0xD2E3)
			if busy or (cfg ~= 0x02 and cfg ~= 0x07) then busy_zero = 0
			else
				busy_zero = busy_zero + 1
				if busy_zero == BUSY_RUN then
					phase = "open"
					open_t0 = frames + 20
					print(string.format("CLEARING frame=%d fp=%s", frames, fingerprint()))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
		end

		if phase == "open" and open_t0 ~= nil and frames >= open_t0 then
			local t = frames - open_t0
			if not did_select then
				did_select = true
				p = { select = 1 }
				print("OPEN select")
			elseif t == 120 then
				p = { a = 1 }
				equip_t0 = frames
				phase = "equip"
				print("EQUIP a")
			end
		end

		if phase == "equip" and equip_t0 ~= nil then
			local t = frames - equip_t0
			-- cycle members: DOWN every 240 frames (multi-poll registration
			-- varies; coverage over precision), shots alongside
			if t > 200 and t % 240 == 0 then p = { down = 1 } end
			if t > 200 and t % 240 == 120 then
				shot("eq_" .. t)
				print(string.format("EQSTATE frame=%d t=%d", frames, t))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if t > 3200 then
				print("EQUIP-WATCH-DONE frames=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
				for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
				emu.stop(0)
				done = true
			end
		end

		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			local parts = {}
			for k, v in pairs(seen) do parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%s=%d%s", k, v,
				dropped[k] and ("(-" .. dropped[k] .. ")") or "") end
			table.sort(parts)
			print("SUMMARY " .. table.concat(parts, " "))
			print("EQUIP-WATCH-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/eventinject.lua`:

```lua
-- eventinject.lua - dispatch event words through the engine's own queue
-- and trace the VM's frame and script ends.
--
-- Boots the row-0 opening like mapsweep.lua, then for each word in JUMPS
-- (event call words hi<<8|lo, e.g. 0x049A) writes it into the empty
-- queue ($D6BD/$D6BE) once the field is idle; the drain (C0:B847)
-- dispatches it. Logs ID ($D51B changes), OP43 (C0:277D), OP2E
-- (C0:2779) and SCRIPTEND (C0:3783) with $77, and presses A every 30
-- frames while a window is open. Live 2026-11-20: 049A (`0c be`, `43`)
-- -> D51B 0CBE, OP43 frame 19618 with $77=01, SCRIPTEND same frame
-- $77=00. Text-run 43s (event 0005) never reach C0:277D: the text
-- interpreter consumes them.
--
-- Usage: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/eventinject.lua --timeout=2000
-- (edit JUMPS first).

local JUMPS = { 0x049A }
local START = 19500
local SETTLE = 300
local TIMEOUT = 1500

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7780] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local function wr(o) return emu.read(o, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(o) return wr(o) | (wr(o + 1) << 8) end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local a, b, c = bytes:byte(i, i + 2)
		b = b or 0
		c = c or 0
		local n = a * 65536 + b * 256 + c
		local q = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(q[1] + 1, q[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(q[2] + 1, q[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(q[3] + 1, q[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(q[4] + 1, q[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, 0x7FFF do bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(wr(0x10000 + i)) end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s)))) end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local step = 0          -- index into JUMPS currently loading (0 = none yet)
local injected_at = nil
local cfg_before = nil
local changed_at = nil

print("SWEEP-LOADED")
local lastId = -1
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	print(string.format("OP43 frame=%d d51b=%04X $77=%02X sp=%04X", frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0x77), st.sp))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC0277D, 0xC0277D, emu.cpuType.snes)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	print(string.format("OP2E frame=%d d51b=%04X", frames, wr16(0xD51B)))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC02779, 0xC02779, emu.cpuType.snes)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	print(string.format("SCRIPTEND frame=%d d51b=%04X $77=%02X", frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0x77)))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC03783, 0xC03783, emu.cpuType.snes)
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	if p == nil and frames > 11000 and frames < START and frames % 30 == 0 and wr(0x76) ~= 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	if frames < START then return end
	if injected_at == nil then
		step = step + 1
		if step > #JUMPS then
			print(string.format("SWEEP-END frame=%d", frames))
			emu.stop(0)
			return
		end
		if wr(0xD6BD) ~= 0xFF or wr(0x76) ~= 0 then
			-- an arrival event left a window open or the queue busy:
			-- press A every 30 frames as during boot, then retry
			if frames % 30 == 0 then emu.setInput({ a = 1 }, 0, 0) end
			step = step - 1
			return
		end
		cfg_before = wr(0xD2E3)
		emu.write(0xD6BE, JUMPS[step] & 0xFF, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		emu.write(0xD6BD, JUMPS[step] >> 8, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		injected_at = frames
		changed_at = nil
		print(string.format("INJECT frame=%d index=%02X cfg=%02X", frames, JUMPS[step], cfg_before))
		return
	end
	if wr(0x76) ~= 0 and frames % 30 == 0 then emu.setInput({ a = 1 }, 0, 0) end
	local id = wr16(0xD51B)
	if id ~= lastId then print(string.format("ID frame=%d d51b=%04X", frames, id)); lastId = id end
	if changed_at == nil and wr(0xD2E3) ~= cfg_before then changed_at = frames end
	local ready = (changed_at ~= nil and frames >= changed_at + SETTLE) or frames >= injected_at + TIMEOUT
	if ready then
		local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
		print(string.format("SWEEP index=%02X cfg=%02X changed=%s", JUMPS[step], cfg, tostring(changed_at ~= nil)))
		-- $D0A7 = current map word (music<<10 | map id): the jump handler
		-- saves it to $FE01 as the return point (C0:C115).
		print(string.format("GEO frame=%d cfg=%02X D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X zone=%02X leader=(%d,%d) map=%04X",
			frames, cfg, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), wr(0xD990), wr16(0xD9AA) // 8, wr16(0xD9AC) // 8,
			wr16(0xD0A7) & 0x3FF))
		dump_bank7f(string.format("sweep_f%d_cfg%02X_i%02X", frames, cfg, JUMPS[step]))
		injected_at = nil
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/field_menu_trace.lua`:

```lua
-- field_menu_trace.lua - the field-menu / commander-mode capture harness
-- (docs/battle-data.md "The field menu is reachable"). Runs the whole
-- chain in one -testRunner session:
--
--   1. cold-boot intro (walk4 presses; START@8600 finishes the name),
--      from 20800: A tap every 30 while $76 busy, south-walk when free
--      (castle map 05 dialogs -> ride scene 26/0800/40 -> road 07 ->
--      clearing 02/3000/60 = the genuinely free field at ~28400)
--   2. SELECT opens the field menu on the clearing (commands 装備/技/術/
--      持ち物/イベント/陣形/環境/セーブ, cursor 装備, wraps mod 8;
--      presses during the cursor-move animation are dropped)
--   3. cal phase: per branch k=1..8, rewind S1 (menu-open savestate),
--      press down k times (40-frame spacing) + A + screenshot cal_k —
--      savestate rewinds make the menu input deterministic, so exactly
--      one k lands on 陣形; offline, pick that k
--   4. work phase: replay k downs live from S1 -> the 陣形 screen ->
--      snapshot S1b -> editor-key branches -> commander guess
--      {a,down,down,a} -> close -> walk north (walk4's chain: clearing
--      -> edge event 084E -> camp -> road 0x253 -> band battles)
--      until the BGM dispatcher plays song 1 (battle)
--   5. bt phase: rewind S3 (bt=460 command window) per branch button
--      {b,select,y,start}, press twice, screenshots; watches: TBLREAD
--      (FE:68CB formation table, all four bus mirrors), RECW (battle
--      record writes $2280-27FF inside the menu window), W1306
--
-- Savestate rules (probe_state2/3.lua, this session): createSavestate/
-- loadSavestate work ONLY inside an exec memory callback; the NMI stub
-- $00FF07 (jml ($1300), once per frame) is the reliable hook; rewind is

for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local SNAP_MIN = 19000
local BUSY_RUN = 600
local busy_zero = 0
local s0_taken = false

local LAST_FRAME = 90000

local VARIANTS = {
	{ name = "a",      seq = { "a" } },
	{ name = "d_a",    seq = { "down", "a" } },
	{ name = "a_d_a",  seq = { "a", "down", "a" } },
	{ name = "a_dd_a", seq = { "a", "down", "down", "a" } },
	{ name = "r_a",    seq = { "right", "a" } },
	{ name = "b",      seq = { "b" } },
}
local CMDR_SEQ = { "a", "down", "down", "a" }

local open_t0 = nil

local cal_t0 = nil

local nav_wait = 0

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = (bytes[i] or 0) * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end
local function statetag()
	local tag, st = pctag()
	return string.format("pc=%s a=%04X x=%04X y=%04X", tag, st.a or -1, st.x or -1, st.y or -1)
end

local function shot(name)
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d phase=%s btn=%s", frames, phase, tostring(cur_btn)))
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function wr8(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr8(off) + wr8(off + 1) * 256 end
local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr8(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr8(0xD0D1))
end

local SAMPLE = {}
for off = 0x0000, 0x7FFF, 2 do SAMPLE[#SAMPLE + 1] = off end
for off = 0x8000, 0x1FFFF, 4 do SAMPLE[#SAMPLE + 1] = off end
local function sample()
	local t = {}
	for _, off in ipairs(SAMPLE) do t[#t + 1] = string.format("%02X", wr8(off)) end
	return table.concat(t)
end
local function dumpdiff(tag, base, label)
	if not base then return end
	local cur = sample()
	local diffs = {}
	for i = 1, #SAMPLE do
		if base:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1) ~= cur:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1) then
			diffs[#diffs + 1] = string.format("%04X=%s>%s", SAMPLE[i],
				base:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1), cur:sub(i * 2 - 1, i * 2 - 1))
		end
	end
	print(string.format("WRAMDIFF phase=%s btn=%s tag=%s vs=%s count=%d",
		phase, tostring(cur_btn), tag, label, #diffs))
	for i, d in ipairs(diffs) do
		if i > 200 then print("WRAMDIFF ... truncated"); break end
		print("WRAMDIFF " .. d)
	end
	flush_pad()
end

-- FE:68CB read watch (all known mirrors)
local TBL0 = 0xFE68CB
local tbl_reads = 0
local function tbl_cb(a, val)
	tbl_reads = tbl_reads + 1
	local row = (a - TBL0) // 11
	print(string.format("TBLREAD frame=%d phase=%s bt=%s addr=%06X row=%02X off=%d val=%02X %s",
		frames, phase, battle_start and tostring(frames - battle_start) or "-",
		a, row, (a - TBL0) % 11, val, statetag()))
	flush_pad()
end
for _, base in ipairs({ 0xFE68CB, 0x3E68CB, 0xFF68CB, 0x3F68CB }) do
	emu.addMemoryCallback(tbl_cb, emu.callbackType.read, base, base + 32 * 11 - 1,
		emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

-- record-region writes: trace only (menu window)
local rec_writes = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if menu_window and rec_writes < 900 then
		rec_writes = rec_writes + 1
		print(string.format("RECW frame=%d bt=%d addr=%04X val=%02X %s",
			frames, frames - battle_start, a, val, statetag()))
		if rec_writes % 40 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2280, 0x27FF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	print(string.format("W1306 frame=%d bt=%s val=%02X %s", frames,
		battle_start and tostring(frames - battle_start) or "-", val, statetag()))
	flush_pad()
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x1306, 0x1306, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- BGM watch: form_menu's dispatcher hook (SPC port write $2141 then
-- $2140 at pc C6:0A75; the id arrives in port1)
local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local tag = pctag()
		if string.find(tag, "C6:0A75") then
			local id = port1
			port1 = nil
			if id == 1 and battle_start == nil and frames > 15000 then
				battle_start = frames
				print(string.format("BATTLE-START frame=%d song=%d", frames, id))
				flush_pad()
			end
		else
			port1 = nil
		end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2141, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- exec-context callback: savestate snapshot/restore
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	local okx, errx = pcall(function()
	if want_snap then
		local which = want_snap
		want_snap = nil
		local ok, obj = pcall(emu.createSavestate)
		if ok then
			if which == "s0" then snap0 = obj; s0_taken = true
			elseif which == "s1" then
				snap1 = obj; base1 = sample()
				-- the s1 snapshot is taken twice: menu-open (phase open,
				-- the cal base) and the 陣形 screen (phase work, the
				-- variant base) — dispatch on the CURRENT phase
				if phase == "open" then
					phase = "cal"
					cal_t0 = frames + 30
				else
					phase = "var"
					var_t0 = frames + 30
				end
			elseif which == "s2" then snap2 = obj; base2 = sample()
			elseif which == "s3" then snap3 = obj end
			print(which:upper() .. "-CREATED frame=" .. frames)
			-- screenshots are taken from inputPolled context only (a
			-- takeScreenshot inside the exec callback crashed the
			-- process in the first run12 attempt)
			if which ~= "s0" then
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 2, "SHOT_" .. which }
			end
			if which == "s2" then phase = "cmdr"; close_t0 = frames + 10 end
			if which == "s3" then phase = "bt"; bt_frame = frames + 30; menu_window = true end
		else
			print(which:upper() .. "-FAIL " .. tostring(obj))
		end
		flush_pad()
	end
	if want_load then
		local which = want_load
		want_load = nil
		local s = which == "s1" and snap1 or which == "s2" and snap2 or snap3
		if s then
			local ok, err = pcall(emu.loadSavestate, s)
			if not ok then print(which:upper() .. "-REWIND-FAIL " .. tostring(err)); flush_pad() end
		end
	end
	end)
	if not okx then
		print("EXEC-ERR " .. tostring(errx))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x00FF07, 0x00FF07, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

print("RUN15-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local busy = wr8(0x76) ~= 0

		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		if p == nil and not s0_taken and frames >= 20800 then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 60 == 0 then p = { right = 1 } else p = { down = 1 } end
			end
		end

		if frames % 1800 == 0 and phase == "walk" then
			print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s busy=%s leader=%04X,%04X",
				frames, fingerprint(), tostring(busy), wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC)))
		end
		if frames % 100 == 0 then
			print(string.format("GB frame=%d phase=%s cal_k=%d sched=%d", frames, phase, cal_k, #SCHED))
		end

		if phase == "walk" and not s0_taken and frames >= SNAP_MIN then
			local cfg = wr8(0xD2E3)
			if busy or (cfg ~= 0x02 and cfg ~= 0x07) then busy_zero = 0
			else
				busy_zero = busy_zero + 1
				if busy_zero == BUSY_RUN then
					want_snap = "s0"
					print(string.format("SNAPREQ frame=%d fp=%s leader=%04X,%04X",
						frames, fingerprint(), wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC)))
					phase = "open"
					open_t0 = frames + 20
				end
			end
		end

		-- open: select, settle, snapshot S1, then calibrate.
		-- LATCHES, not equality: once the menu is open the game polls
		-- input several times per frame and the poll-unit counter jumps
		-- (run13 stalled forever on the skipped t==90)
		if phase == "open" and open_t0 ~= nil and frames >= open_t0 then
			local t = frames - open_t0
			if not did_select and t >= 0 then
				did_select = true
				p = { select = 1 }
				print("OPEN select")
			end
			if did_select and not did_snapreq and t >= 90 then
				did_snapreq = true
				want_snap = "s1"
				open_t0 = nil
			end
		end

		-- cal: branch k = 1..K_MAX; B: replay work_k live
		if phase == "cal" and cal_t0 ~= nil and frames >= cal_t0 then
			cal_k = cal_k + 1
			if cal_k > K_MAX then
				print("RUN12-CAL-DONE")
				flush_pad()
				phase = "work"
				work_t0 = frames + 10
				cal_t0 = nil
			else
				print(string.format("CAL frame=%d k=%d (rewinding S1)", frames, cal_k))
				flush_pad()
				want_load = "s1"
				for j = 1, cal_k do
					SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 10 + (j - 1) * 120, "down" }
				end
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 10 + cal_k * 120 + 120, "a" }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 10 + cal_k * 120 + 300, "SHOT_cal_" .. cal_k }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 10 + cal_k * 120 + 310, "CALNEXT" }
				cal_t0 = nil
			end
		end

		-- work: replay the calibrated schedule live from S1 -> 陣形 screen
		if phase == "work" and work_t0 ~= nil and frames >= work_t0 then
			want_load = "s1"
			work_t0 = nil
			for j = 1, work_k do
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 10 + (j - 1) * 120, "down" }
			end
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 10 + work_k * 120 + 120, "a" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 10 + work_k * 120 + 300, "SHOT_menu_formation" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 10 + work_k * 120 + 320, "SNAP1B" }
		end

		-- scheduled events
		if SCHED[1] and frames >= SCHED[1][1] then
			local ev = table.remove(SCHED, 1)
			local kind = ev[2]
			if kind:sub(1, 5) == "SHOT_" then
				shot(kind:sub(6))
			elseif kind:sub(1, 5) == "DIFF_" then
				dumpdiff(kind:sub(6), base1, "S1")
			elseif kind == "SNAP1" then
				want_snap = "s1"
			elseif kind == "CALNEXT" then
				phase = "cal"
				cal_t0 = frames + 2
			elseif kind == "SNAP1B" then
				want_snap = "s1"
			elseif kind == "NEXTVAR" then
				cur_btn = nil
				phase = "var"
				var_t0 = frames + 2
			elseif kind == "SNAP2" then
				want_snap = "s2"
			elseif kind == "CLOSE" then
				p = { b = 1 }
			elseif kind == "CLOSEDONE" then
				closedone = true
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 200, "BATTLEWAIT-DONE" }
			elseif kind == "BATTLEWAIT-DONE" then
				if battle_start ~= nil then
					want_snap = "s3"
				else
					SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 300, "BATTLEWAIT-DONE" }
				end
			elseif kind == "NEXTBT" then
				cur_btn = nil
				phase = "bt"
				bt_frame = frames + 2
			else
				p = { [kind] = 1 }
			end
		end

		-- variant loop from S1
		if phase == "var" and var_t0 ~= nil and frames >= var_t0 then
			var_i = var_i + 1
			if var_i > #VARIANTS then
				var_t0 = nil
				phase = "cmdr"
				cmdr_t0 = frames + 10
				print("RUN15-VARIANTS-DONE tblreads=" .. tbl_reads)
				flush_pad()
			else
				local v = VARIANTS[var_i]
				cur_btn = v.name
				print(string.format("VAR frame=%d %s (rewinding S1)", frames, v.name))
				flush_pad()
				want_load = "s1"
				var_t0 = nil
				for j, key in ipairs(v.seq) do
					SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + (j - 1) * 90, key }
				end
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + #v.seq * 90 + 10, "SHOT_" .. v.name .. "_a" }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + #v.seq * 90 + 220, "SHOT_" .. v.name .. "_b" }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + #v.seq * 90 + 420, "DIFF_" .. v.name }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + #v.seq * 90 + 430, "NEXTVAR" }
			end
		end

		-- cmdr: apply CMDR_SEQ from S1, then S2
		if phase == "cmdr" and cmdr_t0 ~= nil and frames >= cmdr_t0 then
			want_load = "s1"
			cmdr_t0 = nil
			cur_btn = "cmdr"
			for j, key in ipairs(CMDR_SEQ) do
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + (j - 1) * 90, key }
			end
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + #CMDR_SEQ * 90 + 10, "SHOT_cmdr_a" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + #CMDR_SEQ * 90 + 220, "SHOT_cmdr_b" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + #CMDR_SEQ * 90 + 430, "DIFF_cmdr" }
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8 + #CMDR_SEQ * 90 + 440, "SNAP2" }
		end

		if phase == "cmdr" and snap2 ~= nil and close_t0 ~= nil and frames >= close_t0 then
			close_t0 = nil
			for j = 1, 4 do
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + j * 30, "b" }
			end
			SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 140, "CLOSEDONE" }
		end
		if phase == "cmdr" and snap2 ~= nil and battle_start == nil
			and closedone and frames >= 20800 then
			if not busy then
				-- walk4's chain goes NORTH from the clearing (BFS to (89,4),
				-- edge event 084E -> camp 0x24E -> road 0x253 -> band battles)
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 60 == 0 then p = { right = 1 } else p = { up = 1 } end
			end
		end

		if phase == "bt" and battle_start ~= nil and bt_frame ~= nil
			and frames - battle_start >= 460 and frames >= bt_frame then
			bt_i = bt_i + 1
			if bt_i > #bt_branches then
				done = true
				print("RUN15-BT-DONE tblreads=" .. tbl_reads)
				flush_pad()
			else
				cur_btn = bt_branches[bt_i]
				print(string.format("BT frame=%d bt=%d button=%s (rewinding S3)",
					frames, frames - battle_start, cur_btn))
				flush_pad()
				want_load = "s3"
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 8, cur_btn }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 10, cur_btn }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 48, "SHOT_bt_" .. cur_btn .. "_40" }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 108, "SHOT_bt_" .. cur_btn .. "_100" }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 198, "SHOT_bt_" .. cur_btn .. "_190" }
				SCHED[#SCHED + 1] = { frames + 210, "NEXTBT" }
				bt_frame = nil
			end
		end

		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0, down = 0, right = 0, up = 0, b = 0,
			select = 0, y = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if frames % 400 == 0 then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("RUN15-FINISHED frames=" .. frames .. " tblreads=" .. tbl_reads
				.. " battle=" .. tostring(battle_start))
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/field_mon_trace.lua`:

```lua
-- field_mon_trace.lua - monster field-movement trace. Unattended boot
-- (SRAM present -> the story montage auto-plays, walknpc2-established)
-- while logging, every TRACE_EVERY frames, the party tile plus every NPC
-- slot's id word / pixel position / behavior bits.
--
-- Array facts byte-verified in the repo: the NPC slot array is indexed
-- X = slot*0x40 with the leader's live pixel position at $D9AA/$D9AC
-- (docs/sprites.md "Actor-array cells"), the per-slot id word at $D9D2,X
-- stored big-endian-ish (id>>8 at $D9D2, id&0xFF at $D9D3, spawn
-- C0:4AAA-4AAE) and behavior bits at $D9B2,X (spawn C0:4B31-4B59).
-- Party tile cells $B910/$B911 and map cell $2011/$2012 (high byte
-- first) per walknpc2.lua / docs/sprites.md. Map-load fingerprint
-- $D2E3/$D0C5/$D0D1 per ground_shots249.lua.
--
-- BGM battle detection copied from enc_dispatch.lua (port writes at
-- $2140/$2143 with pc C6:0A75). Run:
--   tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/field_mon_trace.lua --timeout=900

local END_FRAME = 78000
local TRACE_EVERY = 30
local TRACE_FROM = 6000

local frames = 0
local done = false

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

print("FIELDMON-LOADED")
flush_pad()

local slots = {}
for k = 0, 15 do
	local off = k * 0x40
	slots[k] = {
		idh = 0xD9D2 + off,
		idl = 0xD9D3 + off,
		px = 0xD9AA + off,
		py = 0xD9AC + off,
		beh = 0xD9B2 + off,
		flg = 0xD9A7 + off,
	}
end

local function trace_state()
	local map = emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
		+ emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local fp = string.format("%02X%02X%02X",
		emu.read(0xD2E3, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
		emu.read(0xD0C5, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
		emu.read(0xD0D1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	local ptx = emu.read(0xB910, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local pty = emu.read(0xB911, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local parts = {}
	for k = 0, 15 do
		local s = slots[k]
		local idh = emu.read(s.idh, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local idl = emu.read(s.idl, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local px = emu.read(s.px, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			+ emu.read(s.px + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
		local py = emu.read(s.py, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			+ emu.read(s.py + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
		local beh = emu.read(s.beh, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local flg = emu.read(s.flg, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X%02X,%d,%d,%02X,%02X",
			k, idh, idl, px, py, beh, flg)
	end
	print(string.format("STATE frame=%d map=%04X fp=%s ptile=%d,%d slots %s",
		frames, map, fp, ptx, pty, table.concat(parts, " ")))
end

local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc) == "C6:0A75" then
			if port1 ~= last_bgm then
				last_bgm = port1
				print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, port1))
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if frames >= TRACE_FROM and frames % TRACE_EVERY == 0 then
			trace_state()
		end
		if frames % 300 == 0 then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("FIELDMON-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/field_mon_walk.lua`:

```lua
-- field_mon_walk.lua - scripted free walk on the road map 0x250 logging
-- monster NPC slots while battles fire, to capture: (1) monster wander/
-- chase movement against the true party tile ($B910/$B911 are proven
-- party reads in free-walk field mode, walknpc2.lua), (2) the respawn
-- rewrite of a defeated monster's slot id word to 0x2000 (write watch on
-- $D9D2-$D9D3 with the writer PC), (3) the per-race enemy level $F533
-- (read/write watches) and the FE:77BB appearance-pair index
-- X = race*32 + band*2 (read watch) across chained battles.
--
-- Walk policy = enc_dispatch.lua verbatim (intro mash, then down/right on
-- the road; the road battle fires around frame 29425 there).
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/field_mon_walk.lua --timeout=1500

local END_FRAME = 80000
local TRACE_EVERY = 30
local TRACE_FROM = 20800

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local FIELD_SONG = 33
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local WALK_FROM = 20800
local LAST_FRAME = END_FRAME - 2000

local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local battle_ends = 0

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

print("FIELDMONW-LOADED")
flush_pad()

local function statetag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("pc=%02X:%04X a=%04X x=%04X y=%04X", st.k, st.pc,
		st.a or -1, st.x or -1, st.y or -1)
end

-- respawn capture: id-word writes for the first 8 slots
local idwrites = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < TRACE_FROM then return end
	if idwrites < 500 then
		idwrites = idwrites + 1
		print(string.format("WID frame=%d addr=%04X val=%02X %s",
			frames, a, val, statetag()))
		if idwrites % 30 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD9D2, 0xD9F3, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- enemy race levels $F533-$F542 (8 races? bank is $F533[race], race 0-F)
local lvwrites = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < TRACE_FROM then return end
	if lvwrites < 200 then
		lvwrites = lvwrites + 1
		print(string.format("WF533W frame=%d addr=%04X val=%02X %s",
			frames, a, val, statetag()))
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xF532, 0xF545, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

local lvreads = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < TRACE_FROM then return end
	if lvreads < 100 then
		lvreads = lvreads + 1
		print(string.format("WF533R frame=%d addr=%04X val=%02X %s",
			frames, a, val, statetag()))
	end
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xF532, 0xF545, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- FE:77BB appearance-pair reads: X = race*32 + band*2 at 5A:7674
local fereads = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if frames < TRACE_FROM then return end
	if fereads < 100 then
		fereads = fereads + 1
		print(string.format("FEREAD frame=%d addr=%06X val=%02X %s",
			frames, a, val, statetag()))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xFE77BB, 0xFE77BB + 512 - 1,
	emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local function trace_state()
	local map = emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
		+ emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local fp = string.format("%02X%02X%02X",
		emu.read(0xD2E3, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
		emu.read(0xD0C5, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
		emu.read(0xD0D1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	local ptx = emu.read(0xB910, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local pty = emu.read(0xB911, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local parts = {}
	for k = 0, 15 do
		local off = k * 0x40
		local idh = emu.read(0xD9D2 + off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local idl = emu.read(0xD9D3 + off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local px = emu.read(0xD9AA + off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			+ emu.read(0xD9AB + off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
		local py = emu.read(0xD9AC + off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			+ emu.read(0xD9AD + off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
		local beh = emu.read(0xD9B2 + off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local flg = emu.read(0xD9A7 + off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X%02X,%d,%d,%02X,%02X",
			k, idh, idl, px, py, beh, flg)
	end
	print(string.format("STATE frame=%d map=%04X fp=%s ptile=%d,%d b=%d slots %s",
		frames, map, fp, ptx, pty, battle and 1 or 0, table.concat(parts, " ")))
end

local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc) == "C6:0A75" then
			if port1 ~= last_bgm then
				last_bgm = port1
				print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, port1))
				if port1 == BATTLE_SONG then
					battle = true
					battle_start = frames
					print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
					flush_pad()
				elseif (port1 == FIELD_SONG or port1 == 36 or port1 == 3)
					and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
					battle = false
					battle_ends = battle_ends + 1
					print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d ends=%d", frames, battle_ends))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
			if battle then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - WALK_FROM
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if frames >= TRACE_FROM and frames % TRACE_EVERY == 0 and not battle then
			trace_state()
		end
		if frames % 300 == 0 then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("FIELDMONW-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/find_song_dispatch.lua`:

```lua
-- Discover the SNES-side song-dispatch path: which code reads the song pointer
-- table $C6:0FC6, and which code writes the $2140/$2141 command pair (8F xx).
-- MesenCE state tables use lowercase keys (a, x, y, pc, k, dbr, ps).

local frames = 0
local reads = {}
local writers = {}

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, value)
	local tag, st = pctag()
	if reads[tag] == nil then reads[tag] = 0 end
	reads[tag] = reads[tag] + 1
	if reads[tag] <= 5 then
		print(string.format("TBLREAD frame=%d val=%02X at %s A=%04X X=%04X Y=%04X", frames, value, tag, st.a, st.x, st.y))
	end
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xC60FC6, 0xC6103E, emu.memType.SnesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, value)
	if addr == 0x2140 then
		local tag = pctag()
		if writers[tag] == nil then writers[tag] = 0 end
		writers[tag] = writers[tag] + 1
		if value >= 0x80 and writers[tag] <= 5 then
			print(string.format("CMD2140 frame=%d val=%02X at %s", frames, value, tag))
		end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2140, emu.memType.SnesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	if frames >= 3600 then
		local t = {}
		for k, v in pairs(reads) do t[#t+1] = string.format("TBLREAD-SUMMARY %s count=%d", k, v) end
		for k, v in pairs(writers) do t[#t+1] = string.format("CMD2140-SUMMARY %s count=%d", k, v) end
		table.sort(t)
		for _, line in ipairs(t) do print(line) end
		print("DISPATCH-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

```

`tools/emulator/form_battle.lua`:

```lua
-- form_battle.lua - trace who reads the char-table 固有陣形 byte
-- (char_stats_table FE:0600 +0x27, ally i at FE:0600+i*0x30+0x27) during
-- the opening battles, and with which index/registers.
--
-- Flow is the byte-verified battle_sfx.lua one (opening PRESSES; from
-- 20800: A every 30 frames while $76 busy, walk program when idle, BGM
-- id==1 from C6:0A75 marks battle start). One read callback over the
-- eight allies' formation-byte addresses in bank FE logs every read with
-- the CPU state. Read callbacks only fire on data reads, not opcode
-- fetches.
--
-- Patched by sed before runs: END_FRAME.

local END_FRAME = 36000

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }  -- gender confirm
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }  -- character confirm (row 0, ユリアン)
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 } -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }  -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 } -- confirm stats

local FIELD_SONG = 33
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local WALK_FROM = 20800
local LAST_FRAME = 36000

local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local victory = false

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end

print("FORMBATTLE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

-- Read watch: the 固有陣形 byte of allies 00-07 (FE:0600 + i*0x30 + 0x27).
local FORM_BASE = 0xFE0600
local FORM_OFF = 0x27
local STRIDE = 0x30
local form_reads = {}
for i = 0, 7 do
	local ally = i
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
		local tag, st = pctag()
		local n = form_reads[ally] or 0
		if n < 60 then
			form_reads[ally] = n + 1
			print(string.format(
				"FORMREAD frame=%d ally=%d addr=%06X val=%02X pc=%s x=%04X y=%04X db=%02X dp=%s",
				frames, ally, addr, val, tag, st.x or -1, st.y or -1,
				st.db or -1, tostring(st.dp)))
			if form_reads[ally] % 20 == 0 then flush_pad() end
		end
	end, emu.callbackType.read,
		FORM_BASE + ally * STRIDE + FORM_OFF,
		FORM_BASE + ally * STRIDE + FORM_OFF,
		emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

-- Battle discriminator (battle_sfx detect_bgm, minus victory bookkeeping).
local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		print(string.format("BATTLE-START frame=%d", frames))
		flush_pad()
	elseif (id == FIELD_SONG or id == 36) and battle and battle_start
		and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d victory=%s", frames, tostring(victory)))
		flush_pad()
	end
end

local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local tag = pctag()
		if string.find(tag, "C6:0A75") then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
			if battle then
				local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			else
				local t = frames - WALK_FROM
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			local counts = {}
			for k, v in pairs(form_reads) do
				counts[#counts + 1] = string.format("ally%d=%d", k, v)
			end
			table.sort(counts)
			print("FORMREAD-COUNTS " .. table.concat(counts, " "))
			print("FORMBATTLE-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

```lua
-- form_battle7.lua - the formation-table non-use evidence: table read
-- callbacks on all bus mirrors, repeated full-WRAM scans and a battle
-- record dump. Runs paired with form_battle.lua; renamed from the
-- scratch form_battle2-6 sequence (2-6 logs were intermediate).
--
-- Full-WRAM scans at frames 29400 (pre-battle), 29460 (post-init) and
-- 30800 (battle end) look for the table's row-0 rate bytes 37 69 9B CD
-- FF: SNES DMA can move ROM->WRAM with no CPU reads, so a zero CPU-read
-- count alone does not exclude a DMA copy at battle init.
--
-- Patched by sed before runs: END_FRAME.

local done = false

		st.x or -1, st.y or -1)

			frames, a, row, (a - TBL0) % TBLN, val, statetag()))

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
			if battle then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else

				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if frames == 200 and not probed then
			probed = true
			print(string.format("MIRROR-PROBE fe=%02X f3=%02X ff=%02X f3f=%02X",
				emu.read(0xFE68CB, emu.memType.snesMemory),
				emu.read(0x3E68CB, emu.memType.snesMemory),
				emu.read(0xFF68CB, emu.memType.snesMemory),
				emu.read(0x3F68CB, emu.memType.snesMemory)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if (frames == 29400 or frames == 29460 or frames == 30800) and not scanned[frames] then
			scanned[frames] = true
			local hits = {}
			for a = 0, 0x1FFFB do
				if emu.read(a, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) == 0x37
					and emu.read(a + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) == 0x69
					and emu.read(a + 2, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) == 0x9B
					and emu.read(a + 3, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) == 0xCD
					and emu.read(a + 4, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) == 0xFF then
					hits[#hits + 1] = string.format("%04X", a)
				end
			end
			print(string.format("WRAM-COPY-ROW0 frame=%d count=%d %s",
				frames, #hits, table.concat(hits, " ")))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames == 29450 and not battle_dumped then
			battle_dumped = true
			for base = 0x2280, 0x2600, 0x80 do
				local parts = {}
				for i = 0, 0x7F do
					parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02X", emu.read(base + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
				end
				print(string.format("BATTLE-REC %04X %s", base, table.concat(parts)))
			end
			for base = 0xF000, 0xF2FF, 0x80 do
				local parts = {}
				for i = 0, 0x7F do
					parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02X", emu.read(base + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
				end
				print(string.format("PARTY-REC %04X %s", base, table.concat(parts)))
			end
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("TBLREAD-COUNTS " .. tostring(tbl_reads))
			print("FORMBATTLE7-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/form_menu.lua`:

```lua
-- form_menu.lua - the battle 陣形 menu trace harness (docs/battle-data.md
-- "Formation ownership bitmap and the 陣形 menu"). Reaches the opening
-- battle (form_battle7 flow), dumps the ownership bitmap pages and the
-- party/battle records, watches the 陣形テーブル FE:68CB-6A2A reads on
-- all bus mirrors, $1306 writes, and record-region writes; after the
-- battle it pauses walking and sends Start/Select in the post-victory
-- field window with dense screenshots.
--
-- Runs so far (2026-11-18, logs /tmp/formmenu/run1-18): the commander-
-- mode gate stands — the field menu never opened, FE:68CB reads stayed
-- 0, and the second encounter fires stochastically. Cheapest next step
-- is in the docs section (savestate retries at a genuinely free field,
-- emu.createSavestate/loadSavestate).
--
-- Watchouts learned the hard way, all still true here:
--   - menu-window presses must be set BEFORE emu.setInput (the window
--     was silently dead for 10 runs when they were set after it)
--   - Lua has no += (a single `battle_count += 1` silently killed the
--     whole script: Mesen keeps running the naked ROM, stdout shows only
--     the ROM header + "[CPU] Uninitialized memory read" spam)
--   - two Mesen instances CAN run at once if each gets its own copy of
--     the tree and ROM (cp -a /tmp/mesence + a renamed .sfc); SRMs are
--     per-ROM-file-name
--
-- Cold boot: delete the .srm before running (bokuno_jp_iso.srm for the
-- isolated tree).

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local FIELD_SONG = 33
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local WALK_FROM = 20800
local LAST_FRAME = 40000

local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end

print("FORMMENU3-LOADED")
flush_pad()

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local b1 = bytes[i]
		local b2 = bytes[i + 1]
		local b3 = bytes[i + 2]
		local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
		local c = {
			math.floor(n / 262144) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64,
			n % 64,
		}
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot(name)
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d", frames))
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

-- party 陣形テーブル read watch (all known mirrors)
local TBL0 = 0xFE68CB
local TBLN = 11
local tbl_reads = 0
local function statetag()
	local tag, st = pctag()
	return string.format("pc=%s a=%04X x=%04X y=%04X", tag, st.a or -1,
		st.x or -1, st.y or -1)
end
local function tbl_cb(a, val)
	tbl_reads = tbl_reads + 1
	local row = (a - TBL0) // TBLN
	print(string.format("TBLREAD frame=%d addr=%06X row=%02X off=%d val=%02X %s",
		frames, a, row, (a - TBL0) % TBLN, val, statetag()))
	flush_pad()
end
for _, base in ipairs({ 0xFE68CB, 0x3E68CB, 0xFF68CB, 0x3F68CB }) do
	emu.addMemoryCallback(tbl_cb, emu.callbackType.read, base, base + 32 * TBLN - 1, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

-- $1306 formation-id writes
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	print(string.format("W1306 frame=%d val=%02X %s", frames, val, statetag()))
	flush_pad()
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x1306, 0x1306, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- record-region writes, only inside the menu window
local menu_window = false
local rec_writes = 0
local function rec_watch(a, val)
	if menu_window and rec_writes < 600 then
		rec_writes = rec_writes + 1
		print(string.format("RECW frame=%d addr=%04X val=%02X %s", frames, a, val, statetag()))
		if rec_writes % 40 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end
end
emu.addMemoryCallback(rec_watch, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2280, 0x27FF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
emu.addMemoryCallback(rec_watch, emu.callbackType.write, 0xF000, 0xF2FF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- bitmap dump
local function dump_bitmap(tag)
	local function region(name, base, n)
		local parts = {}
		for i = 0, n - 1 do
			parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02X", emu.read(base + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
		end
		print(string.format("BITMAP %s frame=%d %s=%s", tag, frames, name, table.concat(parts)))
	end
	region("f320", 0xF320, 16)
	region("f528", 0xF528, 16)
	region("f4ff", 0xF4FF, 16)
	region("143b", 0x143B, 16)
	flush_pad()
end

-- battle-record / party-record dump
local function dump_records()
	for base = 0x2280, 0x2600, 0x80 do
		local parts = {}
		for i = 0, 0x7F do
			parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02X", emu.read(base + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
		end
		print(string.format("BATTLE-REC %04X %s", base, table.concat(parts)))
	end
	for base = 0xF000, 0xF2FF, 0x80 do
		local parts = {}
		for i = 0, 0x7F do
			parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02X", emu.read(base + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
		end
		print(string.format("PARTY-REC %04X %s", base, table.concat(parts)))
	end
	flush_pad()
end

local shot_bt_extra = {}
local last_bgm = nil
local battle_count = 0
local SCHED = {}          -- filled on BATTLE-END below
local menu_base = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == 41 and frames >= 20000 then
		battle = true
	elseif id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		print(string.format("BATTLE-START frame=%d", frames))
		menu_window = false
		flush_pad()
	elseif (id == FIELD_SONG or id == 36) and battle and battle_start
		and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		menu_window = false
		battle_count = battle_count + 1
		print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d count=%d", frames, battle_count))
		flush_pad()
	end
end

local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local tag = pctag()
		if string.find(tag, "C6:0A75") then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }
-- menu probes: bt offsets from battle start
local SELECT_BT = {}
local shot_bt = {}
-- field-menu reconnaissance: pause walking, open the menu, watch it

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
		local recon = battle_count >= 1 and menu_base ~= nil
			and frames >= menu_base and frames <= menu_base + 5000
			if battle_count >= 1 and menu_base == nil then menu_base = frames end
		if p == nil and not recon and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
			if battle and battle_start ~= nil then
				local bt = frames - battle_start
				if SELECT_BT[bt] then p = { select = 1 } end
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif battle then
				-- pre-battle cutscene dialogs: mash A
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - WALK_FROM
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		if menu_base ~= nil then
			local mt = frames - menu_base
			if (mt == 150 or mt == 250) and not busy then p = { start = 1 } end
			if (mt == 350 or mt == 450 or mt == 550) and not busy then p = { select = 1 } end
			if busy and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			if mt >= 120 and mt <= 11000 and mt % 20 == 0 then shot("m" .. mt) end
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		for _, s in ipairs(SCHED) do
			if s[1] == frames and p == nil then p = { [s[2]] = 1 } end
		end
		if battle_start ~= nil then
			local bt = frames - battle_start
			if bt == 60 then dump_bitmap("init") dump_records() end
			if bt == 300 then dump_bitmap("menu-entry") end
			if shot_bt[bt] and bt <= 700 then shot("bt" .. bt) end
			if bt == 700 then
				dump_bitmap("post")
				dump_records()
				menu_window = false
			end
			if bt >= 290 and bt <= 700 and not menu_window then
				menu_window = true
			end
		end
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("TBLREAD-COUNTS " .. tostring(tbl_reads))
			print("FORMMENU3-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/form_watch.lua`:

```lua
-- form_watch.lua - who writes the formation id $1306 and what the preset
-- party loader (FE:C3C6, table FE:9F2E) stores, per protagonist select row.
--
-- Plays the bokuno_jp opening (cold boot -> title -> gender -> character
-- select -> name -> weapon -> stats), pressing DOWN ROW times on the
-- character-select screen, then logs every WRAM write to $1306,
-- $F319/$F322 and the party slots $F323-$F328 with the writing CPU PC.
-- Ends at frame END_FRAME.
--
-- ROW and END_FRAME are patched by sed before each run.

local ROW = 0
local END_FRAME = 26000

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }                 -- gender confirm
for i = 0, ROW - 1 do
	PRESSES[7700 + 40 * i] = { down = 1 } -- move cursor to row ROW
end
PRESSES[7700 + 40 * ROW + 80] = { a = 1 } -- confirm character
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }             -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }                 -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }                -- confirm stats

local frames = 0
local done = false

print(string.format("FORMWATCH-LOADED row=%d", ROW))

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc)
end

local WATCH = {
	[0x1306] = "FORM",
	[0xF319] = "CNT",
	[0xF322] = "WALK",
	[0xF323] = "P0",
	[0xF324] = "P1",
	[0xF325] = "P2",
	[0xF326] = "P3",
	[0xF327] = "P4",
	[0xF328] = "P5",
	[0x007D] = "SEQ",
}

-- walk13's merged policy from 20800: advance dialogs ($76 busy -> A every
-- 30 frames), walk otherwise; carries the chain through the opening
-- battle to the road scenes where op 1a fires.
local WALK = { "right", "down", "left", "up" }

for addr in pairs(WATCH) do
	-- watch_probe.lua's verified signature: (fn, type, first, last, cpu, memType);
	-- WRAM watches take raw offsets.
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
		if frames <= END_FRAME then
			print(string.format("W frame=%d %s=%02X pc=%s", frames, WATCH[a], val, pctag()))
		end
	end, emu.callbackType.write, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < END_FRAME - 2000 then
		local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [WALK[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then
		-- MesenCE -testRunner stdout is 4KB block-buffered and a timeout
		-- kill loses the buffer; keep it rolling so events survive.
		print(string.rep("pad#", 40))
	end
	if frames % 2000 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X 1306=%02X F319=%02X F322=%02X party=%02X %02X %02X %02X %02X %02X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x1306, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xF319, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xF322, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xF323, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xF324, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xF325, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xF326, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xF327, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xF328, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
	end
	if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("FORMWATCH-DONE")
		-- MesenCE -testRunner stdout is 4KB block-buffered and emu.stop
		-- exits without flushing; push the buffered tail out with filler.
		for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/formationf.lua`:

```lua
-- formationf.lua - live trace of the F-variant composition (C2:1461) for
-- fixed type-1 records: skip-intro savestate, inject the battle through
-- the $D6BD/$D6BE queue word, log the composition rolls at C2:032E
-- (armed at the C2:13EA entry, dumped at the C2:1410 exit) and the enemy
-- record words at $2000+$80*i. docs/formation-f.md.
local BATTLE_ID = 0x8A   -- record 138; sed to 0x8B (139) per target

-- B64: paste the captured field savestate here (docs/mesence-skip-intro.md
-- step 1 capture; /tmp/saga3-srm-probe/field.b64 if still present). Regenerate:
--   python3 - <<'PY'
--   b64 = open('/tmp/saga3-srm-probe/field.b64').read().strip()
--   print('local B64 = table.concat({')
--   for i in range(0, len(b64), 30000): print('\t"%s",' % b64[i:i+30000])
--   print('})')
--   PY
local B64 = table.concat({
	"<paste-chunks>",
})

local frames = 0
local unb64ed = false
local loaded = false
local comp_armed = false
local comp_done = false
local comp_out_frame = 0
local rolls = {}
local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function unb64(s)
	s = s:gsub("=+$", "")
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 1, #s - 3, 4 do
		local n = (alphabet:find(s:sub(i, i)) - 1) * 262144
			+ (alphabet:find(s:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) - 1) * 4096
			+ (alphabet:find(s:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) - 1) * 64
			+ (alphabet:find(s:sub(i + 3, i + 3)) - 1)
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256)
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 256) % 256)
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(n % 256)
	end
	local rem = #s % 4
	if rem == 2 or rem == 3 then
		local i = #s - rem + 1
		local n = (alphabet:find(s:sub(i, i)) - 1) * 262144
			+ (alphabet:find(s:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) - 1) * 4096
			+ (rem == 3 and (alphabet:find(s:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) - 1) * 64 or 0)
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 65536) % 256)
		if rem == 3 then bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(math.floor(n / 256) % 256) end
	end
	return table.concat(bytes)
end
local function wr(a) return emu.read(a, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end


local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function dp(off)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return emu.read((st.d or 0) + off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function dp16(off) return dp(off) + dp(off + 1) * 256 end

-- composition entry: race byte, state inputs, seed, RNG index
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	comp_armed = true
	rolls = {}
	local race = wr(0x141B) & 0x0F
	print(string.format("COMP-IN f%d 141B=%02X F319=%02X 1308=%02X F532=%02X F533r=%02X F30D=%02X idx=%04X D=%04X 141A=%02X 141C=%02X",
		frames, wr(0x141B), wr(0xF319), wr(0x1308), wr(0xF532), wr(0xF533 + race),
		wr(0xF30D), wr16(0x0914), emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes).d or 0,
		wr(0x141A), wr(0x141C)))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC213EA, 0xC213EA, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- every range roll inside the composition window: lo/hi args and the
-- index before the advance (exec callbacks see pre-store values)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if not comp_armed then return end
	rolls[#rolls + 1] = string.format("%02X/%02X@%04X", dp(0xBF), dp(0xC0), dp16(0x14))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC2032E, 0xC2032E, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- composition exit: dp trail, kind list, enemy record words
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if not comp_armed then return end
	comp_armed = false
	comp_done = true
	comp_out_frame = frames
	local recs = {}
	for i = 0, 7 do recs[#recs + 1] = string.format("%04X", wr16(0x2000 + 0x80 * i)) end
	print(string.format("COMP-OUT f%d 56=%02X 57=%02X 58=%02X 5A=%02X 5B=%02X 5C=%02X 34=%02X 5D=%02X 16D2=%04X/%04X/%04X recs=%s",
		frames, dp(0x56), dp(0x57), dp(0x58), dp(0x5A), dp(0x5B), dp(0x5C), dp(0x34), dp(0x5D),
		wr16(0x16D2), wr16(0x16D4), wr16(0x16D6), table.concat(recs, " ")))
	print("ROLLS " .. table.concat(rolls, " "))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC21410, 0xC21410, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	if frames == 600 and not unb64ed then
		unb64ed = true
		local ok, st = pcall(unb64, B64)
		print("UNB64 ok=" .. tostring(ok) .. " len=" .. (ok and #st or tostring(st)))
		if not ok then emu.stop(-1) return end
		local nmi = emu.read(0xFFEB, emu.memType.snesMemory) * 256 + emu.read(0xFFEA, emu.memType.snesMemory)
		local function hook()
			if loaded then return end
			loaded = true
			local ok2, err = pcall(emu.loadSavestate, st)
			print("LOAD ok=" .. tostring(ok2) .. " err=" .. tostring(err))
		end
		emu.addMemoryCallback(hook, emu.callbackType.exec, nmi, nmi,
			emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
	end
	if frames == 700 and loaded then
		emu.write(0xD6BD, 0x19, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		emu.write(0xD6BE, BATTLE_ID, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		print(string.format("INJECT f%d id=%02X map=%02X%02X", frames, BATTLE_ID, wr(0x2011), wr(0x2012)))
	end
	if frames % 500 == 0 and not comp_done then
		print(string.format("STATE f%d busy=%d map=%02X%02X q=%02X %02X %02X id1306=%02X t141A=%02X rng=%02X seed=%02X",
			frames, wr(0x76), wr(0x2011), wr(0x2012), wr(0xD6BB), wr(0xD6BD), wr(0xD6BE),
			wr(0x1306), wr(0x141A), wr(0x0914), wr(0xF30D)))
	end
	if comp_done and frames >= comp_out_frame + 60 then
		print("FFDONE f" .. frames)
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	if frames >= 9000 then
		print("TIMEOUT-STOP f" .. frames)
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/ground_shots249.lua`:

```lua
-- ground_shots249.lua - capture ground-truth screenshots and CGRAM while
-- the party is REALLY on map 0x249 (the shotcap-r2 captures labelled 0249
-- were read from the scratch MAP cell after the walk had already crossed
-- into 0x250 - docs/map-format.md "the map-id cell is scratch during
-- walks"; the stable load fingerprint is $D2E3/$D0C5/$D0D1).
--
-- Same boot flow as shot_maprender.lua, down-only walk legs from 20800
-- (the same program as ground_vram2.lua, deterministic), but shots land
-- at 22000/26000/30000, inside the 0x249 span the ground_vram2 STATE
-- lines logged (MAP fingerprint 26/0800/40 before the crossing, 02/3000/60
-- after). Each shot dumps the frame PNG plus a 512-byte CGRAM snapshot
-- and the load fingerprint so the captured map is identifiable.
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/ground_shots249.lua -timeout=400

local SHOT_FRAMES = { [22000] = true, [26000] = true, [30000] = true }

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

print("GROUND-SHOTS249-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { down = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, s)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if SHOT_FRAMES[frames] then
		local fp = string.format("cfg=%02X d0c5=%04X d0d1=%04X MAP=%04X 76=%02X",
			wr(0xD2E3), wr(0xD0C5) + wr(0xD0C6) * 256, wr(0xD0D1) + wr(0xD0D2) * 256,
			wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012), wr(0x76))
		print("STATE frame=" .. frames .. " " .. fp)
		dump("shot_" .. frames, emu.takeScreenshot())
		local cg = {}
		for i = 0, 511 do
			cg[#cg + 1] = string.char(emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam))
		end
		dump("cgram_" .. frames, table.concat(cg))
		print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
	end
	if frames >= 31000 and not done then
		done = true
		print("GROUND-SHOTS249-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/ground_vram2.lua`:

```lua
-- ground_vram2.lua - ground-truth CGRAM readback and DMA register log on
-- map 0x249: dumps the PPU's CGRAM (512B) with direct emu.read at
-- settled frames, plus per-frame DMA register snapshots across the map
-- load window, to compare the engine's running palettes against
-- internal/mapfmt's palette-set decode.
--
-- TWO VRAM dead ends, both measured (2026-11-17):
-- 1. emu.read(emu.memType.snesVideoRam) returns stale garbage (no
--    tilemap words; docs/map-format.md "Render verification").
-- 2. A CPU write watch on PPU $2118/$2119 (emu.addMemoryCallback on
--    snesMemory, the removed ground_vram.lua) saw ZERO writes while the
--    same watch on $2122 counted 67k CGRAM writes: the tilemap rows
--    reach VRAM through DMA (channel 2 below, control 0x18, source
--    $7E:E2xx row buffer), invisible to CPU-bus callbacks.
--
-- Input policy is shot_maprender.lua verbatim (boot to standing still on
-- 0x249 by frame 34000).

-- (512 bytes) and "vram_<frame>" (32768 bytes, DEAD END, kept for
-- reference); STATE lines.

local DMA_TO = 31500

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }

			end
		end
	end

end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, rd, n)

	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, n - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(rd(i))
	end

end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames >= DMA_FROM and frames <= DMA_TO and frames % 8 == 0 then
		local parts = {}
		for ch = 0, 7 do
			local b = 0x4300 + ch * 0x10
			local ctrl = emu.read(b + 1, emu.memType.snesMemory)
			if ctrl ~= 0 then
				local src = emu.read(b + 2, emu.memType.snesMemory) + emu.read(b + 3, emu.memType.snesMemory) * 256
					+ emu.read(b + 4, emu.memType.snesMemory) * 65536
				local dst = emu.read(b + 5, emu.memType.snesMemory) + emu.read(b + 6, emu.memType.snesMemory) * 256
				parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X %06X->%04X", ch, ctrl, src, dst)
			end
		end
		print(string.format("DMA frame=%d MAP=%04X %s", frames,
			wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012), table.concat(parts, "  ")))
		print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
	end
	if DUMP_FRAMES[frames] then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X cfg=%02X d0c5=%04X d0d1=%04X",
			frames, wr(0x76), wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012),
			wr(0xD2E3), wr(0xD0C5) + wr(0xD0C6) * 256, wr(0xD0D1) + wr(0xD0D2) * 256))
		dump("cgram_" .. frames, function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump("vram_" .. frames, function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
	end
	if frames >= 45000 and not done then
		done = true
		print("GROUND-VRAM2-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

```lua
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)

		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then

	end
	return table.concat(out)
end
```

```lua
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end

local function fingerprint()

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end
```
