```lua
-- NOTE: no $7F write watch in this round - the GW line volume throttled
-- the emulator to ~25 fps; the streaming question is settled (zero
-- post-load writes, winorigin2) and the settled grids come from the
-- GEO hook's bank dumps below.

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < (onSceneMap() and 1000000000 or MARK_ROAD) then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if wr(0xD2E3) == 0x35 then sceneSeen = true end
	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
		elseif cfg == 0x01 and frames >= 10800 then
			-- run37: Monica's first map after the 0840 escape scene starts
			-- (the Loane castle interior candidate: 0x25B/212/2F8 are the
			-- 32x64/64x96 cfg-01 maps; the probe diff picks the id)
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E
		and not (sceneSeen and onSceneMap()) then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest exit-tile goal if this fingerprint has one,
		-- else the nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				local goals = EXIT_GOALS[fp]
				if goals then
					for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, g.x, g.y) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, g.x, g.y)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				else
					for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
					-- walk11: no ladder. once sceneSeen the planner is off
					-- entirely; the pocket gets total silence
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk on 0x35 only (the road maps stay walk4-exact)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if onSceneMap() and waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				local stuckLim = onSceneMap() and 3600 or STUCK_ROAD
				if frames - stuckSince > stuckLim and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3) - walk13: NOT on
		-- the 0x35 scene map. walk11's busy-A taps fired inside every
		-- pocket dispatch window and every one aborted; walk12's first
		-- window (input latch stuck by its logging error) advanced at
		-- +548 into map 01. Round 13 tests the pocket with ZERO input
		-- edges of any size.
		if not (sceneSeen and onSceneMap()) then
			if battle then
				local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
				if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			end
		end
	end

	-- busy-stall breaker: when a busy stretch outlives 12000 frames,
	-- cycle START / B / down / A windows (dialog ladders that plain
	-- A taps do not advance)
	-- walk11: the walk10 busy-stall breaker is disarmed - no button may
	-- fire after the 0x35 arrival; the plain busy-A taps below only run
	-- while a scene is actually up ($76 != 0)

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		dump_bytes("bank7f", function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 600 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
			frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520),
			wr(0x76), px, py, wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/loane_star.lua`:

```lua
-- loane_star.lua - recon: boot -> new game (trace_events.lua M1 schedule)
-- with dense screenshots + VM/map-load logging, to find the destiny-star
-- prompt screen and its option layout live (docs/loane-004b.md item 1).
--
-- Run: /tmp/loane-mesence/Mesen -testRunner tools/emulator/loane_star.lua
--   /home/newlix/projects/saga3/patches/bokuno_jp.sfc -enableStdout --timeout=3000
-- with NO srm in /tmp/loane-mesence/Saves (cold boot; Saves/*.srm deleted).
--
-- Screenshots come from emu.getScreenBuffer() (256x239 ints 0xRRGGBB),
-- base64 on stdout as SHOTBEGIN/SHOTDATA/SHOTEND; /tmp/loane/shotpng.py
-- reassembles PNGs. Log lines: VM (76/PC/D51B), MAPLOAD (D2E3 changes),
-- PICK ($3D84 picked actor / $EF00 select pick / $F300 name buffer).
--
-- GOTCHAS (docs/parity.md §9-§11, run.sh header): input ONLY from the
-- inputPolled callback; button tables lowercase; RAW WRAM offsets for
-- snesWorkRam; every risky call inside pcall; helpers defined before the
-- locals they use; ONE inputPolled registration.

local frames = 0
local SHOT0 = 6800
local SHOT1 = 64000
local SHOT_EVERY = 800
local STOP_FRAME = 64200
-- dialog-advance taps: from A0 on, A every A_EVERY frames unconditionally
-- (run0 parked at FC:1506 inside 0846 with 76=01 from 13811; walk13's
-- busy-A taps are the proven advance; unconditional A is the journey
-- policy that broke through nested intro events, sprites.md session 2).
-- No B, no directions: B skips cutscene text and derails (sprites.md).
local A0 = 14000
local A1 = 64000
local A_EVERY = 30

-- M1 schedule (trace_events.lua): START mash skips the prologue, title by
-- ~333, protagonist select ~1080; A 7000 gender 男, A 7800 character
-- (row 0 ユリアン), START 8600 default name, A 9000/9800/10600 the setup
-- confirms; opening scene ~10620, cutscene auto-advances to ~20800.
local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[11400] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[12200] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[13000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[13800] = { a = 1 }

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes[i] * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
		end
		local rem = #bytes % 3
		if rem == 1 then
			out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
		elseif rem == 2 then
			out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
		end
		return table.concat(out)
	end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function w16(off)
	return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256
end
local function mapid()
	return w16(0x2011)
end

local function dump_shot(tag)
	print("SHOTBEGIN " .. tag)
	local buf = emu.getScreenBuffer()
	local chunk = {}
	for i = 0, #buf - 1 do
		local px = buf[i + 1]
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = math.floor(px / 65536) % 256
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = math.floor(px / 256) % 256
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = px % 256
		if #chunk >= 3000 then
			print("SHOTDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
			chunk = {}
		end
	end
	if #chunk > 0 then
		print("SHOTDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	print("SHOTEND " .. tag .. " frame=" .. frames .. " n=" .. #buf)
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 2048))
end

print("LOANE-STAR-LOADED")

local last_vm = nil
local last_map = nil
local last_d2e3 = nil
local shot_n = 0
local screen_ok = nil

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		if p == nil and frames >= A0 and frames <= A1 and frames % A_EVERY == 0 then
			p = { a = 1 }
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("INPUT-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local flag = wr(0x76)
		local depth = wr(0x77)
		local ev = w16(0xD51B)
		local d2e3 = wr(0xD2E3)
		local vm = string.format("%02X %02X %04X %02X", flag, depth, ev, d2e3)
		if vm ~= last_vm then
			print(string.format("VM frame=%d 76=%02X depth=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X D2E3=%02X MAP=%04X",
				frames, flag, depth, wr(0x7A), wr(0x79), wr(0x78), ev,
				wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51D), d2e3, mapid()))
			last_vm = vm
		end
		local mp = mapid()
		if mp ~= last_map then
			print(string.format("MAPID frame=%d MAP=%04X (was %04X) D2E3=%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d",
				frames, mp, last_map or 0, d2e3, flag, w16(0xD9AA), w16(0xD9AC)))
			last_map = mp
		end
		if d2e3 ~= last_d2e3 then
			print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d D2E3=%02X (was %02X) MAP=%04X 76=%02X",
				frames, d2e3, last_d2e3 or 0, mp, flag))
			last_d2e3 = d2e3
		end
		if frames >= 6500 and frames <= 12000 and frames % 100 == 0 then
			print(string.format("PICK frame=%d $3D84=%02X $EF00=%02X name=%02X %02X %02X %02X D0D1=%d D0C5=%d",
				frames, wr(0x3D84), wr(0xF000), wr(0xF300), wr(0xF301), wr(0xF302), wr(0xF303),
				wr(0xD0D1), w16(0xD0C5)))
		end
		if frames >= SHOT0 and frames <= SHOT1 and (frames - SHOT0) % SHOT_EVERY == 0 then
			if screen_ok == nil then
				local sok, serr = pcall(function() return #emu.getScreenBuffer() end)
				if sok then
					screen_ok = serr
					print("SCREEN-OK len=" .. tostring(screen_ok))
				else
					screen_ok = false
					print("SCREEN-FAIL " .. tostring(serr))
				end
			end
			if screen_ok and screen_ok > 0 then
				shot_n = shot_n + 1
				dump_shot("s" .. frames)
			end
		end
		if frames >= STOP_FRAME then
			print(string.format("LOANE-STAR-DONE frame=%d shots=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X", frames, shot_n, mapid(), wr(0xD2E3)))
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/loane_star2.lua`:

```lua
-- loane_star2.lua - montage-route recon: unattended with-save boot enters
-- the story montage (35->01->39->22->1A->24 cycle, docs/map-format.md
-- "TITLE/CONTINUE FLOW DECODED"); its map-0x24 tail is the interactive
-- setup (A taps open the name-entry UI, START finishes it, then the
-- destiny-star prompt appears, titlecont run13). This harness rides the
-- cycle, opens the setup, and captures the star prompt screens.
--
-- Run: /tmp/loane-mesence/Mesen -testRunner tools/emulator/loane_star2.lua
--   /home/newlix/projects/saga3/patches/bokuno_jp.sfc -enableStdout --timeout=4000
-- with an intro-boundary srm in /tmp/loane-mesence/Saves/bokuno_jp.srm.
--
-- Input rules measured in the earlier rounds: any press before 6933
-- cancels the montage into the title (so NO presses until the tail);
-- A taps in the $76==0 tail window open the naming UI; further A taps
-- would type kana into the name buffer ($F300), so taps stop as soon as
-- $3D89 (the name-length cursor, docs/naming.md) goes nonzero; START
-- finishes naming; then A picks the highlighted star.
--
-- Screenshots: SHOTBEGIN/SHOTDATA/SHOTEND (getScreenBuffer RGB), PNG via
-- /tmp/loane/shotpng.py. GOTCHAS: ONE inputPolled registration, lowercase
-- button tables, RAW WRAM offsets, pcall everything, helpers before use.

local frames = 0
local STOP_FRAME = 46000

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes[i] * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
		end
		local rem = #bytes % 3
		if rem == 1 then
			out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
		elseif rem == 2 then
			out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
		end
		return table.concat(out)
	end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function w16(off)
	return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256
end
local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), w16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local function dump_shot(tag)
	print("SHOTBEGIN " .. tag)
	local buf = emu.getScreenBuffer()
	local chunk = {}
	for i = 0, #buf - 1 do
		local px = buf[i + 1]
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = math.floor(px / 65536) % 256
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = math.floor(px / 256) % 256
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = px % 256
		if #chunk >= 3000 then
			print("SHOTDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
			chunk = {}
		end
	end
	if #chunk > 0 then
		print("SHOTDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	print("SHOTEND " .. tag .. " frame=" .. frames .. " n=" .. #buf)
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 2048))
end

print("LOANE-STAR2-LOADED")

local fp = nil
local last_ev = nil
local tail_seen = false
local tail_frame = nil
local naming_frame = nil
local start_frame = nil
local pick_frame = nil
local shot_next = 0
local press_name = "-"

-- the montage map-0x24 fingerprint (docs: settled montage value 24/3000/40)
local TAIL_CFG = 0x24

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = nil
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()
	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X",
			frames, cur_fp, w16(0xD9AA), w16(0xD9AC), w16(0xD51B),
			wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520), wr(0x76)))
		if string.match(cur_fp, "^24/") and tail_seen == false then
			tail_seen = true
			tail_frame = frames
			shot_next = frames + 60
			print("TAIL-ARRIVE frame=" .. frames)
		end
		fp = cur_fp
	end
	local ev = w16(0xD51B)
	if ev ~= last_ev then
		last_ev = ev
	end

	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local namelen = wr(0x3D89)
	if tail_seen and naming_frame == nil and namelen > 0 then
		naming_frame = frames
		print(string.format("NAMING-OPEN frame=%d len=%d actor=%02X mode=%02X cur=%02X/%02X name=%02X %02X %02X %02X",
			frames, namelen, wr(0x3D84), wr(0x3D85), wr(0x3D87), wr(0x3D88),
			wr(0xF300), wr(0xF301), wr(0xF302), wr(0xF303)))
	end

	if tail_seen and frames >= (tail_frame or 0) + 2400 and start_frame == nil then
		-- fallback: naming UI never reported (len cell read 0) - START anyway
		start_frame = frames
		print("START-FALLBACK frame=" .. frames)
	end
	if naming_frame ~= nil and start_frame == nil and frames >= naming_frame + 120 then
		start_frame = frames
		print("START-PRESS frame=" .. frames)
	end
	if start_frame ~= nil and pick_frame == nil and frames >= start_frame + 600 then
		pick_frame = frames
		print("PICK-PRESS frame=" .. frames)
	end

	if p == nil and tail_seen and naming_frame == nil and busy == false
		and frames > (tail_frame or 0) + 60 and frames % 60 == 0 then
		p = { a = 1 }
		press_name = "a"
	elseif start_frame == frames then
		p = { start = 1 }
		press_name = "start"
	elseif pick_frame == frames then
		p = { a = 1 }
		press_name = "a"
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)

	if frames % 300 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d fp=%s 76=%02X D51B=%04X namelen=%02X px=%d py=%d press=%s",
			frames, cur_fp, wr(0x76), ev, namelen, w16(0xD9AA), w16(0xD9AC), press_name))
	end
	if tail_seen and frames >= shot_next and frames <= (tail_frame or 0) + 12000 then
		shot_next = frames + 300
		dump_shot("s" .. frames)
	end
	if frames >= STOP_FRAME then
		print(string.format("LOANE-STAR2-DONE frame=%d fp=%s D2E3=%02X", frames, cur_fp, wr(0xD2E3)))
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/loane_star3.lua`:

```lua
-- loane_star3.lua - montage route, full setup drive: unattended with-save
-- boot -> story montage -> map-0x24 tail (fp 24/3000/40) -> A taps open
-- the naming UI -> START finishes -> dense A taps walk the card/weapon/
-- stats screens until the destiny-star prompt -> A picks (option index
-- from PICK_DOWN down-presses before the pick A).
--
-- Watches: MAPLOAD fingerprints, D51B dispatch trail, star cells
-- $D370-$D373 (flags 112-115, the 0B40 state machine run through event
-- 0846's chkBit 114 gate at FC:31cd before its `11 0e` -> 004B (31,77)),
-- battle songs (A mash, chain_capture policy).
--
-- Pick variant: PICK_DOWN (down-press count, spaced 90 frames) inserted
-- between the naming START and the pick A; copy this file and edit the
-- constant for each option.
--
-- GOTCHAS: ONE inputPolled callback; no $4218/19 reads; RAW WRAM offsets;
-- pcall everything; helpers defined before use.

local frames = 0
local STOP_FRAME = 100000
local PICK_DOWN = 0

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes[i] * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
		end
		local rem = #bytes % 3
		if rem == 1 then
			out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
		elseif rem == 2 then
			out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
		end
		return table.concat(out)
	end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function w16(off)
	return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256
end
local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), w16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local function dump_shot(tag)
	print("SHOTBEGIN " .. tag)
	local buf = emu.getScreenBuffer()
	local chunk = {}
	for i = 0, #buf - 1 do
		local px = buf[i + 1]
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = math.floor(px / 65536) % 256
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = math.floor(px / 256) % 256
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = px % 256
		if #chunk >= 3000 then
			print("SHOTDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
			chunk = {}
		end
	end
	if #chunk > 0 then
		print("SHOTDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	print("SHOTEND " .. tag .. " frame=" .. frames .. " n=" .. #buf)
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 2048))
end

print("LOANE-STAR3-LOADED PICK_DOWN=" .. PICK_DOWN)

local fp = nil
local tail_frame = nil
local naming_frame = nil
local start_frame = nil
local pick_frame = nil
local setup_done = false
local shot_next = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local last_starchange = ""
local star_base = nil
local down_left = PICK_DOWN
local next_down = 0

local function starcells()
	-- vanilla flag space: $7E:F46A + id>>1, even id = high nibble
	-- (vm-semantics.md 2.5). flags 112/113 -> $F4A2, 114/115 -> $F4A3.
	local a, b = wr(0xF4A2), wr(0xF4A3)
	return string.format("112=%X 113=%X 114=%X 115=%X",
		a >> 4, a & 0xF, b >> 4, b & 0xF)
end

-- BGM dispatch watch (chain_capture recipe): song ids over the run
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	local a = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes).a
	local song = math.floor(a / 3)
	if song ~= last_bgm then
		last_bgm = song
		print(string.format("SONG frame=%d id=%d", frames, song))
		if song == 1 then
			battle = true
			battle_start = frames
			print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
		elseif battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 and song ~= 1 then
			battle = false
			battle_start = nil
			print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
		end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x5E191B, 0x5E191B, emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()
	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X",
			frames, cur_fp, w16(0xD9AA), w16(0xD9AC), w16(0xD51B),
			wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520), wr(0x76)))
		if string.match(cur_fp, "^24/") and tail_frame == nil then
			tail_frame = frames
			shot_next = frames + 60
			print("TAIL-ARRIVE frame=" .. frames)
		elseif tail_frame ~= nil and not string.match(cur_fp, "^24/") then
			-- the montage cycled past 24 (or the setup completed)
			setup_done = true
			print("TAIL-LEAVE frame=" .. frames .. " fp=" .. cur_fp)
		end
		fp = cur_fp
	end

	-- star cells (raw offsets for flags 112-115 = $D370-$D373)
	local sc = starcells()
	if sc ~= last_starchange then
		last_starchange = sc
		print(string.format("STAR frame=%d cells=%s 76=%02X", frames, sc, wr(0x76)))
	end

	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local namelen = wr(0x3D89)
	if tail_frame ~= nil and naming_frame == nil and namelen > 0 then
		naming_frame = frames
		print(string.format("NAMING-OPEN frame=%d len=%d actor=%02X name=%02X %02X %02X %02X",
			frames, namelen, wr(0x3D84), wr(0xF300), wr(0xF301), wr(0xF302), wr(0xF303)))
	end

	local p = nil
	if tail_frame ~= nil and naming_frame == nil and busy == false
		and frames > tail_frame + 60 and frames % 60 == 0 then
		p = { a = 1 }
	end
	if naming_frame ~= nil and start_frame == nil and frames >= naming_frame + 120 then
		start_frame = frames
		print("START-PRESS frame=" .. frames)
	end
	if start_frame == frames then
		-- the naming panel's START (スタートボタン:終了) closes the UI. The
		-- first draft set start_frame inside the input elseif chain, so the
		-- variable printed but no button ever went out and every later
		-- screen misread as "stuck" (runs 4/5).
		p = { start = 1 }
	end
	if start_frame ~= nil and frames > start_frame then
		if down_left > 0 and next_down == 0 then
			next_down = start_frame + 900
		end
		if next_down > 0 and down_left > 0 and frames >= next_down and frames % 300 == 0 then
			p = { down = 1 }
			down_left = down_left - 1
			print("DOWN-PRESS frame=" .. frames .. " left=" .. down_left)
			if down_left == 0 then
				pick_frame = frames + 300
				print("PICK-SCHEDULED frame=" .. pick_frame)
			end
		elseif down_left == 0 and pick_frame == nil and frames >= start_frame + 900 then
			pick_frame = frames + 300
			print("PICK-SCHEDULED frame=" .. pick_frame)
		elseif pick_frame == frames then
			p = { a = 1 }
			print("PICK-PRESS frame=" .. frames)
		elseif frames > (pick_frame or 0) and frames % 300 == 0 then
			-- post-pick advance: A every 300 while the setup screens are up
			-- (fp still 24; the post-START card accepts A but a press every
			-- 60 typed kana into a still-open naming UI in run 4); after
			-- TAIL-LEAVE tap only while busy - on a free field A opens the
			-- ring menu and freezes the party (walk7)
			if not setup_done or busy then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	if battle and p == nil and frames - (battle_start or frames) > 420 and frames % 30 == 0 then
		p = { a = 1 }
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)

	if frames % 600 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d fp=%s 76=%02X D51B=%04X namelen=%02X px=%d py=%d star=%s",
			frames, cur_fp, wr(0x76), w16(0xD51B), namelen, w16(0xD9AA), w16(0xD9AC), starcells()))
	end
	if tail_frame ~= nil and frames >= shot_next then
		if frames < (pick_frame or 0) + 6000 then
			shot_next = frames + 150
		else
			shot_next = frames + 1200
		end
		dump_shot("s" .. frames)
	end
	if frames >= STOP_FRAME then
		print(string.format("LOANE-STAR3-DONE frame=%d fp=%s star=%s", frames, cur_fp, starcells()))
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/mapsweep.lua`:

```lua
-- mapsweep.lua - batch map verification: force map loads through the
-- global jump table and dump the settled per-tile buffers.
--
-- Plays the row-0 opening (cold boot; delete
-- /tmp/mesence/Saves/bokuno_jp.srm first) to the field on map 0x250, then
-- for each index in JUMPS writes the queue word `11 xx` into the empty
-- deferred queue head ($D6BD/$D6BE, the slot C0:AF91 fills), so the
-- engine's own drain runs the map jump (C0:C109). SETTLE frames after the
-- $D2E3 change (or TIMEOUT frames with none) it prints
--   SWEEP index=xx cfg=yy
--   GEO ... (cs_grid7.lua format)
--   DUMPBEGIN sweep_f<frame>_cfg<yy>_i<xx> ... bank $7F:0000-7FFF ...
-- for `gridprint <rom> sweep <log>` to diff against mapfmt.AttrGrid.
-- JUMPS is patched by sed before a run.

local JUMPS = { 0x00, 0x0C, 0x0E }
local START = 19500
local SETTLE = 900
local TIMEOUT = 1500

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7780] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local function wr(o) return emu.read(o, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(o) return wr(o) | (wr(o + 1) << 8) end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local a, b, c = bytes:byte(i, i + 2)
		b = b or 0
		c = c or 0
		local n = a * 65536 + b * 256 + c
		local q = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(q[1] + 1, q[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(q[2] + 1, q[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(q[3] + 1, q[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(q[4] + 1, q[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, 0x7FFF do bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(wr(0x10000 + i)) end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s)))) end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local step = 0          -- index into JUMPS currently loading (0 = none yet)
local injected_at = nil
local cfg_before = nil
local changed_at = nil

print("SWEEP-LOADED")
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	if p == nil and frames > 11000 and frames < START and frames % 30 == 0 and wr(0x76) ~= 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	if frames < START then return end
	if injected_at == nil then
		step = step + 1
		if step > #JUMPS then
			print(string.format("SWEEP-END frame=%d", frames))
			emu.stop(0)
			return
		end
		if wr(0xD6BD) ~= 0xFF or wr(0x76) ~= 0 then
			-- an arrival event left a window open or the queue busy:
			-- press A every 30 frames as during boot, then retry
			if frames % 30 == 0 then emu.setInput({ a = 1 }, 0, 0) end
			step = step - 1
			return
		end
		cfg_before = wr(0xD2E3)
		emu.write(0xD6BE, JUMPS[step], emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		emu.write(0xD6BD, 0x11, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		injected_at = frames
		changed_at = nil
		print(string.format("INJECT frame=%d index=%02X cfg=%02X", frames, JUMPS[step], cfg_before))
		return
	end
	if changed_at == nil and wr(0xD2E3) ~= cfg_before then changed_at = frames end
	local ready = (changed_at ~= nil and frames >= changed_at + SETTLE) or frames >= injected_at + TIMEOUT
	if ready then
		local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
		print(string.format("SWEEP index=%02X cfg=%02X changed=%s", JUMPS[step], cfg, tostring(changed_at ~= nil)))
		-- $D0A7 = current map word (music<<10 | map id): the jump handler
		-- saves it to $FE01 as the return point (C0:C115).
		print(string.format("GEO frame=%d cfg=%02X D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X zone=%02X leader=(%d,%d) map=%04X",
			frames, cfg, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), wr(0xD990), wr16(0xD9AA) // 8, wr16(0xD9AC) // 8,
			wr16(0xD0A7) & 0x3FF))
		dump_bank7f(string.format("sweep_f%d_cfg%02X_i%02X", frames, cfg, JUMPS[step]))
		injected_at = nil
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/mask_layertables.lua`:

```lua
-- mask_layertables.lua - dump the engine's layer-toggle/mask work area
-- (WRAM $D330-$D3FF) plus the row-builder record arrays ($D5A0-$D5DF) on a
-- chosen frame, so the toggle-table content can be correlated with the
-- rect geometry of the map on screen (docs/map-format.md "Layer toggle and
-- mask zones").
--
-- Edit DUMP_FRAMES / DONE_FRAME (frame timeline = oam_walk.lua's
-- inputPolled counter): START mash 300-6800 skips the prologue, the
-- confirm presses at 7000..10600 reach the opening field scene
-- (~frame 10800).
--
-- API forms verified in docs/parity.md §11 and on this machine
-- (2026-11-16): raw WRAM offsets + snesWorkRam; input only reaches the
-- game from the inputPolled callback.

local DUMP_FRAMES = { [12000] = true }
local DONE_FRAME = 12500

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats

local frames = 0
local done = false

local function hexdump(base, count)
	local parts = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02X", emu.read(base + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	end
	return table.concat(parts)
end

local function word(a)
	return emu.read(a, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) + emu.read(a + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
end

local function dump_tables(tag)
	print(("LAYERTABS %s frame=%d map=%04X"):format(tag, frames,
		emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
	print("   D330 " .. hexdump(0xD330, 0xD0))
	local idx = word(0xD5A5)
	print(("   D5A5=%04X p9F=%04X pA2=%04X pA5=%04X zone=%04X"):format(
		idx, word(0xD5B6 + idx * 2), word(0xD5B2 + idx * 2), word(0xD5B4 + idx * 2), word(0xD5B0 + idx * 2)))
	print("   D5A0 " .. hexdump(0xD5A0, 0x40))
end

print("MASKLAYERTABLES-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	emu.setInput(PRESSES[frames] or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if DUMP_FRAMES[frames] then
		dump_tables("t" .. frames)
	end
	if frames == DONE_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("MASKLAYERTABLES-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/mon_oam.lua`:

```lua
-- mon_oam.lua - monster figure capture by OAM/VRAM dump on map 0x250.
-- Same verified intro timeline and STATE trace as monfig.lua, but instead
-- of screenshots it dumps OAM + CGRAM at a frame schedule while the party
-- sits parked on (17,26) (monfig run1 state: frames 28600-80000, camera

-- exact composed sprite strips (docs/sprites.md: the game bakes the
-- per-band shift into VRAM at upload), so decoding OAM against VRAM/CGRAM
-- gives the figure pixels without any screenshot diffing.
--
-- Offline: tools/emulator/oam_reassemble.py splits the log; mon_oam_decode.py
-- matches each frame's sprites to the trace's monster slots and composes the
-- per-kind figures.

	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out + 1] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out + 1] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)

		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

print("MONOAM-LOADED")

local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end

local function trace_state()
	local map = wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
	local fp = string.format("%02X%02X%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
	local parts = {}
	for k = 0, 15 do
		local off = k * 0x40
		local idh = wr(0xD9D2 + off)
		local idl = wr(0xD9D3 + off)
		local px = wr(0xD9AA + off) + wr(0xD9AB + off) * 256
		local py = wr(0xD9AC + off) + wr(0xD9AD + off) * 256
		local kind = wr(0xD9A6 + off)
		local beh = wr(0xD9B2 + off)
		local flg = wr(0xD9A7 + off)
		parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X%02X,%d,%d,%02X,%02X,%02X",
			k, idh, idl, px, py, kind, beh, flg)
	end
	print(string.format("STATE frame=%d map=%04X fp=%s ptile=%d,%d busy=%d battle=%d slots %s",
		frames, map, fp, wr(0xB910), wr(0xB911), wr(0x76), battle and 1 or 0,
		table.concat(parts, " ")))
end

local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc) == "C6:0A75" then
			if port1 ~= last_bgm then
				last_bgm = port1
				print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, port1))
				if port1 == BATTLE_SONG then
					battle = true
					battle_start = frames
					print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
					flush_pad()
				elseif (port1 == FIELD_SONG or port1 == 36 or port1 == 3)
					and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
					battle = false
					battle_ends = battle_ends + 1
					print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d ends=%d", frames, battle_ends))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
		if p == nil and frames >= TRACE_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
			if battle then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - TRACE_FROM
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if frames >= TRACE_FROM and frames % TRACE_EVERY == 0 and not battle then
			trace_state()
		end
		if OAM_DUMPS[frames] and not battle then
			dump("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
			dump("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		end
		if VRAM_DUMPS[frames] and not battle then
			dump("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		end
		if SHOTS[frames] and not battle then
			dump("shot", emu.takeScreenshot())
		end
		if frames % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("MONOAM-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/monfig.lua`:

```lua
-- monfig.lua - monster walk-figure capture on map 0x250. Same verified
-- intro timeline and walk policy as field_mon_walk.lua, but every 100
-- frames (outside battles) it prints one STATE line (party tile, map id,
-- every NPC slot's id/pixel/kind/behavior/flag words) followed by a PNG
-- screenshot dump. Offline, slot pixel positions minus the scroll (SAD
-- alignment against exports/data/maps/0250/map.png, sprites.md) place every
-- wandering monster on screen, and the pair diff between two shots
-- cancels the static background - the same pipeline as walkfig.lua's
-- leader export, with the wandering monsters as the moving subjects.
--
-- The party may stay parked on (17,26) the whole run (field_mon_walk
-- run1's unresolved input anomaly); for figure extraction that is an
-- advantage, not a problem: the party becomes part of the static
-- background and only monsters move.
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/monfig.lua -timeout=1700

local END_FRAME = 80000
local SHOT_EVERY = 100
local TRACE_FROM = 20800

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local FIELD_SONG = 33
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local WALK_FROM = 20800
local LAST_FRAME = END_FRAME - 2000

local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local battle_ends = 0

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = {
			math.floor(n / 262144) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64,
			n % 64,
		}
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, s)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

print("MONFIG-LOADED")
flush_pad()

local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end

local function trace_state()
	local map = wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
	local fp = string.format("%02X%02X%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
	local parts = {}
	for k = 0, 15 do
		local off = k * 0x40
		local idh = wr(0xD9D2 + off)
		local idl = wr(0xD9D3 + off)
		local px = wr(0xD9AA + off) + wr(0xD9AB + off) * 256
		local py = wr(0xD9AC + off) + wr(0xD9AD + off) * 256
		local kind = wr(0xD9A6 + off)
		local beh = wr(0xD9B2 + off)
		local flg = wr(0xD9A7 + off)
		parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X%02X,%d,%d,%02X,%02X,%02X",
			k, idh, idl, px, py, kind, beh, flg)
	end
	print(string.format("STATE frame=%d map=%04X fp=%s ptile=%d,%d busy=%d battle=%d slots %s",
		frames, map, fp, wr(0xB910), wr(0xB911), wr(0x76), battle and 1 or 0,
		table.concat(parts, " ")))
end

local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc) == "C6:0A75" then
			if port1 ~= last_bgm then
				last_bgm = port1
				print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, port1))
				if port1 == BATTLE_SONG then
					battle = true
					battle_start = frames
					print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
					flush_pad()
				elseif (port1 == FIELD_SONG or port1 == 36 or port1 == 3)
					and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
					battle = false
					battle_ends = battle_ends + 1
					print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d ends=%d", frames, battle_ends))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
			if battle then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - WALK_FROM
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if frames >= TRACE_FROM and frames % SHOT_EVERY == 0 and not battle then
			trace_state()
			dump("shot", emu.takeScreenshot())
		end
		if frames % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("MONFIG-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/name_handler.lua`:

```lua
-- name_handler.lua (derived from name_window.lua) - what the engine's speaker-name window shows for op 4A
-- (`4a <actor>`, 19323 uses; operands are actor ids plus the specials
-- FD/FC). The 4A handler C0:226F only sets $D599 = 2 and advances, so the
-- operand is consumed somewhere else; this run puts that on record.
-- Round 1 (fixed-interval shots, no presses after 10600) sat on one 4D
-- line for 10k frames: dialogue only advances on A.
--
-- Flow: standard pressed boot, then A every 90 frames from 11000 to
-- advance the opening dialogue. Exec watch on C0:226F logs the VM pc
-- ($78/$7A, read as a full CPU address) and the bytes there; a
-- screenshot follows 40 frames after each of the first 16 hits. Reads of
-- $D599 after a hit name the window builder that consumes the style.
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/name_window.lua --timeout=1500
--      > /tmp/namewin/run3.log

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local END_FRAME = 40000
local MAX_SHOTS = 16

local frames = 0
local done = false
local hits = 0
local shot_at = {}

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function rd(addr) return emu.read(addr, emu.memType.snesMemory) end
local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc)
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = (bytes[i] or 0) * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot(tag)
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d d599=%02X", frames, wr(0xD599)))
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. tag)
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. tag)
	flush_pad()
end

-- Round 5: find bokuno's real 4A handler. Event 0800 carries `4a 01` at
-- FC:1A71 (engine printed "なあエレン、" inline in round 4's shots); the
-- PC that READS the operand byte FC:1A72 is the handler. C0:226F (the
-- vanilla table entry) never executes.
print("NAME-HANDLER-LOADED")
flush_pad()
local reads = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	reads = reads + 1
	if reads > 40 then return end
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	print(string.format("OPRD frame=%d a=%06X val=%02X pc=%02X:%04X A=%04X X=%04X Y=%04X D=%04X DB=%02X",
		frames, a, val, st.k, st.pc, st.a, st.x, st.y, st.d or -1, st.dbr or -1))
	flush_pad()
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xFC1A71, 0xFC1A72, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		if p == nil and frames >= 11000 and frames % 90 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		if frames >= 16000 and not done then
			done = true
			print(string.format("NAME-HANDLER-FINISHED frames=%d reads=%d", frames, reads))
			for _ = 1, 200 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/name_window.lua`:

```lua
-- name_window.lua - what the engine's speaker-name window shows for op 4A
-- (`4a <actor>`, 19323 uses; operands are actor ids plus the specials
-- FD/FC). The 4A handler C0:226F only sets $D599 = 2 and advances, so the
-- operand is consumed somewhere else; this run puts that on record.

-- line for 10k frames: dialogue only advances on A.

-- advance the opening dialogue. Exec watch on C0:226F logs the VM pc

PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }

local MAX_SHOTS = 16

local frames = 0
local done = false
local hits = 0

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc)
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = (bytes[i] or 0) * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot(tag)
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d d599=%02X", frames, wr(0xD599)))
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. tag)
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. tag)
	flush_pad()

print("NAME-WINDOW-LOADED")
flush_pad()

-- Round 3 found C0:226F never executes: bokuno dispatches VM ops through
-- its own tables (roadmap: 5A:ADA0 / 5A:FE00), so the probe watches the
-- RESULT instead — any write of $D599 (02 = the speaker window style).
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if val ~= 2 then return end
	hits = hits + 1
	local pc = wr(0x78) + wr(0x79) * 256
	local bank = wr(0x7A)
	local addr = bank * 0x10000 + pc
	local bytes = {}
	for i = -2, 5 do bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.format("%02X", rd(addr + i)) end
	print(string.format("D599W2 frame=%d n=%d pc=%s vmpc=%02X:%04X bytes(-2..)=%s leader=%02X f300=%02X%02X%02X%02X",
		frames, hits, pctag(), bank, pc, table.concat(bytes, " "), wr(0xF000),
		wr(0xF300), wr(0xF301), wr(0xF302), wr(0xF303)))
	if hits <= MAX_SHOTS then shot_at[frames + 40] = hits end
	flush_pad()
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x7ED599, 0x7ED599, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		if p == nil and frames >= 11000 and frames % 90 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		local n = shot_at[frames]
		if n then shot("op4a_" .. n) end
		if frames % 2000 == 0 and frames >= 11000 then shot("tick_" .. frames) end
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print(string.format("NAME-WINDOW-FINISHED frames=%d op4a=%d", frames, hits))
			for _ = 1, 200 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/naming_probe.lua`:

```lua
-- naming_probe.lua (kept verification harness, docs/naming.md) - cold boot (no SRM), play the intro like a player:
-- START skips the prologue, A confirms NEW GAME on the title, A picks the
-- default character on the male page, then the naming window opens and the
-- harness probes the grid cursor and the confirm keys.
local frames = 0
local presses = {}
local named = nil
local lastState = ""
local last76 = nil

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end

local function ui_state()
	return string.format("84=%02X 85=%02X 87=%02X 88=%02X 89=%02X F300=%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X",
		wr(0x3D84), wr(0x3D85), wr(0x3D87), wr(0x3D88), wr(0x3D89),
		wr(0xF300), wr(0xF301), wr(0xF302), wr(0xF303),
		wr(0xF304), wr(0xF305), wr(0xF306), wr(0xF307))
end

local function press(frame, keys)
	presses[frame] = keys
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot(tag)
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. tag)
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. tag)
	flush_pad()
end

print("NAMING-PROBE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

-- player press schedule
press(300, { start = 1 })
press(360, { start = 1 })
press(460, { a = 1 })     -- title: NEW GAME
-- adaptive taps while the character pages run; each step logs the screen
for i, t in ipairs({ 900, 1200, 1500, 1800, 2100 }) do
	press(t, { a = 1 })
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = presses[frames]
		local v76 = wr(0x76)
		if v76 ~= last76 then
			last76 = v76
			print(string.format("W76 frame=%d val=%02X %s", frames, v76, ui_state()))
		end

		-- periodic screenshot to follow the pages
		if frames % 300 == 0 and frames <= 3600 and named == nil then
			shot("s" .. frames)
			print(string.format("STATE frame=%d %s", frames, ui_state()))
		end

		-- naming UI detector: the default name lands in F300
		if named == nil and wr(0xF300) ~= 0 then
			named = frames
			print(string.format("NAMING frame=%d %s", frames, ui_state()))
			flush_pad()
			shot("naming")
			for i = 1, 8 do press(frames + 120 + i * 30, { down = 1 }) end
			for i = 1, 8 do press(frames + 520 + i * 30, { right = 1 }) end
			press(frames + 950, { a = 1 })
			press(frames + 1050, { a = 1 })
			press(frames + 1150, { b = 1 })
			press(frames + 1250, { start = 1 })
		end

		if named ~= nil then
			local rel = frames - named
			local s = ui_state()
			if s ~= lastState then
				lastState = s
				print(string.format("UI frame=%d rel=%d press=%s %s",
					frames, rel, p and "YES" or "-", s))
			end
			if rel == 60 or rel == 450 or rel == 900 or rel == 1350 then
				print(string.format("CHECK rel=%d frame=%d %s", rel, frames, s))
				shot("rel" .. rel)
			end
			if rel >= 1500 then
				print("NAMING-PROBE-FINISHED")
				flush_pad()
				emu.stop(0)
			end
		end

		if frames >= 30000 and named == nil then
			print("NAMING-PROBE-TIMEOUT")
			shot("timeout")
			flush_pad()
			emu.stop(1)
		end

		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/oam_capture.lua`:

```lua
-- oam_capture.lua - dump OAM, VRAM and CGRAM at a chosen frame (docs/sprites.md
-- per-band X offset task). The dump is base64 on stdout (the only channel in
-- -testRunner mode); tools/emulator/oam_decode.py reassembles it into binary
-- files under /tmp/parity-agent/.
--
-- @@FRAME@@ is substituted by the caller (scripts get no CLI args); the dump
-- fires at that frame, then the run stops. Screenshots are avoided (they
-- stall testRunner badly).
--
-- State gates dumped alongside so the consumer can tell what the game was
-- doing: frame flag $76, dispatch id $D51B, script PC $78/79/7A.
--
-- Input (verified flow, probe_start2): START mash 300-6800 skips the opening
-- prologue and confirms the title menu; A confirms gender (male cursor) and
-- character (Julian, top of the list); START finishes name entry with the
-- default name; A confirms weapon/stats. The opening map scene (village,
-- walking sprites) shows from ~frame 10800.
--
-- All input is set in the inputPolled callback - the only one that reaches
-- the joypad latch (see docs/parity.md M1 log).

local DUMP_FRAME = 20000  -- @@FRAME@@
local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats

local frames = 0
local done = false

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

print("OAMCAP-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	emu.setInput(PRESSES[frames] or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	-- frames increments in the inputPolled callback (once per frame); this
	-- startFrame callback only dumps when the counter reaches the target.
	if frames == DUMP_FRAME then
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
		-- OAM: 512-byte table + 32-byte upper attribute bits
		dump("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		-- CGRAM: 256 bytes
		dump("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 256)
		-- VRAM: full 32 KiB
		dump("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		print("OAMCAP-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	if frames > DUMP_FRAME + 600 and not done then
		done = true
		print("OAMCAP-TIMEOUT")
		emu.stop(1)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/oam_decode.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reassemble an oam_capture.lua dump from the MesenCE stdout log into binary
files: /tmp/parity-agent/cap_<frame>/{oam,cgram,vram}.bin

Usage: oam_decode.py <capture.log> [outdir]
"""
import base64
import os
import re
import sys

log_path = sys.argv[1]
out_dir = sys.argv[2] if len(sys.argv) > 2 else "/tmp/parity-agent"

state = None
frame = None
cur = None
buf = []
files = {}
for line in open(log_path, errors="replace"):
    m = re.match(r"CAPSTATE frame=(\d+) (.*)", line)
    if m:
        frame = int(m.group(1))
        state = m.group(2)
        continue
    if line.startswith("DUMPBEGIN "):
        cur = line.split()[1]
        buf = []
    elif line.startswith("DUMPDATA "):
        buf.append(line[len("DUMPDATA "):].strip())
    elif line.startswith("DUMPEND "):
        name = line.split()[1]
        data = base64.b64decode("".join(buf))
        dest = os.path.join(out_dir, f"cap_{frame}_{name}.bin")
        open(dest, "wb").write(data)
        print(f"{dest}: {len(data)} bytes  ({state})")
        cur = None

if frame is None:
    sys.exit("no CAPSTATE line found - capture did not reach the dump frame")

```

`tools/emulator/oam_reassemble.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reassemble oam_walk.lua dumps from the MesenCE stdout log into binary files.

Like oam_decode.py, but also tracks the `STATE frame=N` lines the walk
harness prints for its OAM-only snapshots, so per-frame files never cross-
attribute (oam_decode.py names every dump after the last CAPSTATE, which
overwrites the full dump of an earlier frame with OAM snapshots of later
ones).

Usage: oam_reassemble.py <capture.log> <outdir>
"""
import base64
import os
import re
import sys

log_path, out_dir = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]

frame = None
state = ""
cur = None
buf = []
for line in open(log_path, errors="replace"):
    m = re.match(r"(?:CAPSTATE|STATE) frame=(\d+)(?: (.*))?", line)
    if m:
        frame = int(m.group(1))
        state = m.group(2) or ""
        continue
    if line.startswith("DUMPBEGIN "):
        cur = line.split()[1]
        buf = []
    elif line.startswith("DUMPDATA "):
        buf.append(line[len("DUMPDATA "):].strip())
    elif line.startswith("DUMPEND ") and cur is not None:
        data = base64.b64decode("".join(buf))
        dest = os.path.join(out_dir, f"cap_{frame}_{cur}.bin")
        open(dest, "wb").write(data)
        print(f"{dest}: {len(data)} bytes  ({state})")
        cur = None

```

```lua
-- oam_walk.lua - drive the opening headless past the cutscene and its
-- native dialog windows, walk the player south/east, and dump
-- OAM/CGRAM/VRAM plus PNG screenshots along the way (oam_capture.lua is
-- the single-frame version; this one is the timeline harness for
-- docs/sprites.md).
--
-- Input lessons (verified by runs walk5-walk13, 2026-11-16):
-- - START mash 300-6800 skips the prologue to protagonist select; A confirms
--   gender/character, START takes the default name, A confirms weapon/stats
--   (docs/parity.md M1).
-- - The post-cutscene chain (events 0848..084C, then 0B49) contains native
--   event windows (`pause` ops) that wait for A while the VM flag $76
--   reads 0 - so "press only while $76!=0" stalls forever inside them
--   (walk7/walk12). The chain needs unconditional periodic A (walk5 first
--   showed it, walking merged in walk13).
-- - A held on a genuinely idle free field opens the ring menu (walk8 stuck
--   there from ~31000 on); walking with held directions is safe.
-- - A fixed walk program without A presses stalls inside the first dialog
--   (walk7); the dialog chain and the walk have to be interleaved (walk13).
--
-- Current policy from frame 20800 to 34000: while busy press A every 30
-- frames (advance dialogs), while idle hold the walk program's direction
-- (down 900 frames, right 900 frames, alternating - southeast toward the
-- opening village's placed character, map 0x249: spawn (16,16), NPC
-- g=61 at (36,52), docs/triggers.md jump table entry 5). At 34000 input
-- stops and dumps continue, catching whatever dialog/scene is open.
--
-- Dumps (base64 on stdout, reassembled with tools/emulator/oam_reassemble.py):
--   OAM snapshot every 2000 frames from 12000, every 500 from 34000
--   OAM + CGRAM (FULL 512 bytes, sprite half included) + VRAM + PNG
--   screenshot every 4000 frames from 34000
--
-- All input is set in the inputPolled callback - the only one that reaches
-- the joypad latch (docs/parity.md M1 log).

PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats

-- townsfolk g=1e..25 at (4..16, 12..16); they render from the ORIGINAL
-- table $F9A000 (engine ids < 0x70, kind 01 - verified filmstrips), not
-- from 5A8370. Map 0x249's g=61 is kind 05 (not a townsfolk blob) for the
-- same reason. See docs/sprites.md "Runtime graphic-table resolution".
local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }
local SPR_EVERY = 4000
local SPR_FROM = 34000
local OAM_FROM = 12000
local OAM_EVERY = 2000
local OAM_DENSE_EVERY = 500
local OAM_DENSE_FROM = 34000
local LAST_FRAME = 50000

local frames = 0
local done = false
local busySeen = false
local idleRun = 0
local walkStart = 0

local frames = 0
local done = false

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

print("OAMWALK-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		-- merged policy: advance every dialog (the native windows wait for A
		-- with $76=0, so press regardless) and walk when idle
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

	local dense = frames >= OAM_DENSE_FROM and frames % OAM_DENSE_EVERY == 0
	if dense or (frames % OAM_EVERY == 0 and frames >= OAM_FROM) then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
		dump("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
	end
	if frames >= SPR_FROM and (frames - SPR_FROM) % SPR_EVERY == 0 then
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X OBSEL=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x2101, emu.memType.snesPpu),
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
		dump("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		print("OAMWALK-DUMP frame=" .. frames)
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("OAMWALK-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/oam_wram.lua`:

```lua
-- oam_wram.lua - WRAM map-id hunt for the opening timeline (docs/sprites.md
-- companion to oam_walk.lua). Dumps the whole 128 KiB WRAM in 4 KB chunks,
-- one chunk per frame (a single 32 KB read loop crashed the testRunner
-- nondeterministically in runs walk1-walk3; chunks of 4 KB are stable).
--
-- Boot input matches oam_walk.lua up to frame 10600; from 20800 the same
-- A-advance policy (A every 60 frames while $76 != 0) drives the opening
-- dialog chain. Dumps fire twice, 8000 frames apart, so a small python/go
-- diff can find cells that changed between two scene states: the map id,
-- the player position and the camera.
--
-- Dumps: base64 on stdout, reassembled with tools/emulator/oam_reassemble.py
-- (file names carry the chunk index: wram22000_00 .. wram22000_1f).

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local CHUNK = 4096
local CHUNKS = 32 -- 128 KiB WRAM
local DUMP_SETS = { 22000, 30000, 38000 }
local LAST_FRAME = 38600

local frames = 0
local done = false

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, base, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(emu.read(base + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

print("OAMWRAM-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 then
		if emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0 then
			if frames % 60 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local set = nil
	for _, f in ipairs(DUMP_SETS) do
		if frames >= f and frames < f + CHUNKS then
			set = f
			break
		end
	end
	if set then
		local idx = frames - set
		dump(string.format("wram%d_%02x", set, idx), idx * CHUNK, CHUNK)
		if idx == CHUNKS - 1 then
			print("OAMWRAM-SET " .. set)
		end
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("OAMWRAM-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```
