`tools/emulator/parity_gate.lua`:

```lua
-- parity_gate.lua - M3 gate/branch parity, ROM-side capture
-- (docs/parity.md §6 M3).
--
-- Boots the ROM headless (MesenCE -testRunner), plays boot -> new game ->
-- opening cutscene with the fixed M1 input schedule, and records what the
-- event VM does:
--
--   SEG line    - a tail-dispatch store into $D51B (raw offset): the new
--                 dispatch id. Also snapshots the WRAM state the gates read
--                 (vanilla nibble flags, EF00 variables, ext flags, menu
--                 state, gold/bank, party, inventory, scratch) at the
--                 dispatch store - i.e. the exact pre-event state.
--   PCW lines   - ordered writes to the script PC $78/$79/$7A while
--                 $76 == 1, each entry tagged with the current dispatch id
--                 (updated by the SEG watch). From the trail the checker
--                 reconstructs every interpreter position and each gate's
--                 TRUE/FALSE decision.
--   VM lines    - per-frame interpreter state changes (M1 format), for
--                 diagnostics.
--
-- All addresses are RAW WRAM offsets (docs/parity.md §10: emu.read/write on
-- snesWorkRam take raw offsets, not CPU addresses). Output channel is
-- print() only. Run via tools/emulator/run.sh (see scripts/parity_gate.sh).
--
-- Watch-attachment policy: both watches attach once at the first $76 == 1
-- frame. An always-on watch from frame 0 sees boot's WRAM-clear DMA touch
-- $78-$7A every frame and stalls the run to minutes-per-frame (M1 recon),
-- and nothing event-related happens before the cutscene.

local END_FRAME = 24000

-- Watches attach at WATCH_FRAME: after boot's WRAM-clear DMA (which stalls
-- an always-on watch to minutes-per-frame, M1 recon) but before the first
-- event dispatch (~frame 10621), so the opening event's own SEG/SNAP are
-- captured.
local WATCH_FRAME = 9000

-- Input schedule, measured in the M1 recon (docs/parity.md §10): START mash
-- skips the prologue, A confirms gender/character/weapon/stats, later A
-- presses advance the opening cutscene pages (11400-13800) and the
-- road-scene dialogs.
local presses = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do presses[f] = { start = 1 } end
presses[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
presses[7800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
presses[8600] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
presses[9000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
presses[9800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm weapon
presses[10600] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats
presses[11400] = { a = 1 }     -- advance opening scene
for f = 12000, END_FRAME - 400, 600 do
	presses[f] = { a = 1 }     -- advance cutscene pages through the chain
end

local frames = 0
local done = false
local last_vm = nil
local watches_on = false
local seg_lo, seg_hi = 0, 0
local pcw = {}       -- PC writes since last frame print, tagged with seg id
local PCW_CAP = 8192

print("PARITY-LOADED")
print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))

-- base64 of the bytes read from a list of {off, len} raw-WRAM regions
local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function read_region(off, len)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, len - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(emu.read(off + i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	end
	return table.concat(bytes)
end

-- State regions the event-VM gates and writers touch (raw WRAM offsets):
--   vanilla nibble flags $7E:F46A.. (docs/vm-semantics.md §2.5)
--   EF00 variables       $7E:EF00..EFFF (§6.1)
--   ext flags            $7F:FF90.. (§2.5; raw = 0x10000 + 0xFF90)
--   scratch              $7F:FF00 (0d 30/31 spill; raw 0x10000 + 0xF900)
--   menu state           $D3BF/$D3C0/$D3C1 (§2.3)
--   gold/bank            $F31A..$F31F (§6.1)
--   party                $F319 count, $F322 walk id, $F323-$F328 slots (§6.3)
--   inventory            $F32A.. 32 slots x 2 bytes (§6.1)
local REGIONS = {
	{ "van", 0xF46A, 0x100 },
	{ "var", 0xEF00, 0x100 },
	{ "ext", 0x1FF90, 0x100 },
	{ "scr", 0x1F900, 0x100 },
	{ "men", 0xD3BF, 3 },
	{ "gld", 0xF31A, 6 },
	{ "pty", 0xF319, 16 },
	{ "inv", 0xF32A, 64 },
}

local function snapshot()
	local parts = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(REGIONS) do
		parts[#parts + 1] = r[1] .. "=" .. b64encode(read_region(r[2], r[3]))
	end
	print(string.format("SNAP frame=%d id=%04X %s", frames, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo, table.concat(parts, " ")))
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

local function attach_watches()
	if watches_on then return end
	watches_on = true

	-- dispatch store watch ($D51B/$D51C): tags the segment and snapshots.
	-- The range-watch addr argument arrives as the full CPU address
	-- (0x7ED51B/0x7ED51C, measured); mask it to the WRAM offset. The word
	-- is stored little-endian (lo then hi); SEG/SNAP print once, when both
	-- bytes of the dispatch word have landed.
	local have_lo, have_hi = false, false
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
		local off = addr % 0x10000
		if off == 0xD51B then
			seg_lo = val
			have_lo = true
		elseif off == 0xD51C then
			seg_hi = val
			have_hi = true
		end
		if have_lo and have_hi then
			have_lo, have_hi = false, false
			print(string.format("SEG frame=%d id=%04X", frames, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo))
			snapshot()
		end
	end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD51B, 0xD51C, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

	-- Gate decisions, exec-watched at the handler instruction each gate's
	-- TRUE / FALSE continuation enters through (decoded from the handlers,
	-- see docs/parity.md §12). At every watched address the script PC
	-- $78/$79 (raw WRAM) still points at S+2, so the gate op's own address
	-- is S = PC - 2.
	--   op33 chkFlag  C0:2F5F: TRUE 2F8C, FALSE 2FA5
	--   op34 chkBit   C0:2FC1: TRUE 2FE4 (BRA) / 2FE8 (BMI), FALSE 2FEA
	--     (2FF0 is the FALSE fall-through merge, not TRUE-only)
	--   op45 chkMem   C0:2F22: TRUE 2F3C (the BRA; 2F46 is the merge point
	--     the FALSE path falls through into - not TRUE-only), FALSE 2F3E
	--   0d 00 chk4    5A:B05E: TRUE B08B, FALSE B08F
	--   0d 01 chk01   5A:B09B: TRUE B0BE (BRA) / B0C2 (BMI), FALSE B0C4
	--     (B0CA is the FALSE fall-through merge, not TRUE-only)
	local function gate_cb(family, dec)
		return function()
			local lo = emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			local hi = emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			local s = hi * 256 + lo - 2
			local bk = emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			print(string.format("GATE frame=%d seg=%04X addr=%02X:%04x family=%s dec=%s",
				frames, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo, bk, s, family, dec))
		end
	end
	local gate_addrs = {
		{ 0x00C02F8C, "chkFlag", "TRUE" }, { 0x00C02FA5, "chkFlag", "FALSE" },
		{ 0x00C02FE4, "chkBit", "TRUE" }, { 0x00C02FE8, "chkBit", "TRUE" },
		{ 0x00C02FEA, "chkBit", "FALSE" },
		{ 0x00C02F3C, "chkMem", "TRUE" }, { 0x00C02F3E, "chkMem", "FALSE" },
		{ 0x005AB08B, "chk4", "TRUE" }, { 0x005AB08F, "chk4", "FALSE" },
		{ 0x005AB0BE, "chk01", "TRUE" }, { 0x005AB0C2, "chk01", "TRUE" },
		{ 0x005AB0C4, "chk01", "FALSE" },
	}
	for _, w in ipairs(gate_addrs) do
		emu.addMemoryCallback(gate_cb(w[2], w[3]), emu.callbackType.exec, w[1], w[1],
			emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)
	end

	-- Dispatch targets, exec-watched where each handler has the target
	-- fully assembled:
	--   selGoto C0:2E73: dispatch case 2E9C ($8D word = native id),
	--     inline case 2E96 ($78 = record address, interpreter continues)
	--   jump16 5A:B980: 2E9... 2F89... at B989 ($78 = target - 1, same bank)
	--   jumpL  5A:B990: at B9A5 (A = target word, bank already in $7A;
	--     $78 still = S+4, so the op address is dp() - 4)
	--   callL  5A:B9B0: at B9E9 (A = target word - 1, bank in $7A,
	--     $78 = S+4, op address dp() - 4)
	local function dp()
		return emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) + emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
	end
	local function word_at(off)
		return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) + emu.read(off + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
	end
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		print(string.format("TGT frame=%d seg=%04X kind=SELGOTODISP id=%04X",
			frames, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo, word_at(0x8D)))
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x00C02E9C, 0x00C02E9C, emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		print(string.format("TGT frame=%d seg=%04X kind=SELGOTO addr=%02X:%04x",
			frames, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo,
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam), dp()))
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x00C02E96, 0x00C02E96, emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		print(string.format("TGT frame=%d seg=%04X kind=JUMP16 addr=%04x target=%02X:%04x",
			frames, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo, dp() - 1,
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam), dp()))
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x005AB989, 0x005AB989, emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("TGT frame=%d seg=%04X kind=JUMPL addr=%04x target=%02X:%04x",
			frames, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo, dp() - 4,
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam), st.a % 0x10000))
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x005AB9A5, 0x005AB9A5, emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("TGT frame=%d seg=%04X kind=CALLL addr=%04x target=%02X:%04x",
			frames, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo, dp() - 4,
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam), (st.a + 1) % 0x10000))
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x005AB9E9, 0x005AB9E9, emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)

	-- script-PC write watch ($78/$79/$7A): the interpreter trail
	for _, a in ipairs({ 0x78, 0x79, 0x7A }) do
		emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
			if #pcw < PCW_CAP then
				pcw[#pcw + 1] = string.format("%02X=%02X@%04X", addr, val, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo)
			end
		end, emu.callbackType.write, a, a, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	end

	print(string.format("WATCHES-ON frame=%d", frames))
end

-- Input MUST be driven from inputPolled: setInput from startFrame never
-- reaches the joypad latch (M1 recon, docs/parity.md §10).
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	emu.setInput(presses[frames] or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local flag = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		if frames >= WATCH_FRAME then
			attach_watches()
		end
		if frames % 500 == 0 then
			local depth = emu.read(0x77, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			local pc_lo = emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			local pc_hi = emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			local pc_bk = emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			local ev_lo = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			local ev_hi = emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			print(string.format("POLL frame=%d 76=%02X depth=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X D51B=%04X",
				frames, flag, depth, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo))
		end
		if #pcw > 0 then
			print(string.format("PCW frame=%d seg=%04X n=%d %s", frames, seg_hi * 256 + seg_lo,
				#pcw, table.concat(pcw, " ")))
			if #pcw > 200 then
				print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
			end
			pcw = {}
		end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("PARITY-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

```

`tools/emulator/pidoam_journey.lua`:

```lua
-- pidoam_journey.lua - continue past walk13's stall point and find how the
-- intro advances out of the opening village, with a WRAM map-id scan
-- (docs/sprites.md blob-capture task; walk13 = tools/emulator/oam_walk.lua).
--
-- Policy frame 20800+: walk13's merged policy, but input never stops:
--   busy ($76 != 0) -> A every 30 frames (dialogs, incl. the ones that wait
--   with $76 == 0), idle -> walk down/right 900/100 alternating.
-- If a periodic A opens the ring menu on a genuinely idle field (walk8), the
-- run log shows D3C0 != 0; B is pressed then (menu-close) and the frame is
-- noted.
--
-- Frame 33000: scan all WRAM (raw offsets 0..0x1FFFF) for little-endian
-- words 0x0249 / 0x0246 / 0x024A / 0x024B (candidate current-map cells:
-- the intro chain jumps 11 03/04/05 through 0x24B -> 0x24A -> 0x249, and
-- 0x246 is the other intro village). The scan prints every hit; the STATE
-- lines after it re-print the hit cells so cells that move as the game
-- changes maps can be told from constants.

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }
local OAM_FROM = 34000
local OAM_EVERY = 2000
local CAP_EVERY = 4000
local CAP_FROM = 34000
local STATE_EVERY = 1000
local STATE_FROM = 30000
local SCAN_AT = 33000
local LAST_FRAME = 70000

local MAP_WORDS = { [0x0249] = true, [0x0246] = true, [0x024A] = true, [0x024B] = true }
local mapCells = nil  -- list of WRAM offsets whose word matched at SCAN_AT

local frames = 0
local done = false
local menuFrames = {}

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function rd16(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(off + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

print("PIDOAM-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 then
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames == SCAN_AT then
		mapCells = {}
		for off = 0, 0x1FFFF - 1 do
			if MAP_WORDS[rd16(off)] then
				mapCells[#mapCells + 1] = off
			end
		end
		print(string.format("MAPSCAN frame=%d hits=%d", frames, #mapCells))
		for i, off in ipairs(mapCells) do
			print(string.format("MAPHIT %04X word=%04X", off, rd16(off)))
		end
	end
	if frames >= STATE_FROM and frames % STATE_EVERY == 0 then
		local line = string.format("STATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X D3BF=%02X D3C0=%02X D3C1=%02X D519=%04X D599=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			rd16(0xD51B),
			emu.read(0xD3BF, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3C0, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3C1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			rd16(0xD519),
			emu.read(0xD599, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
		if mapCells then
			local vals = {}
			for i, off in ipairs(mapCells) do
				vals[#vals + 1] = string.format("%04X=%04X", off, rd16(off))
			end
			line = line .. " MAP " .. table.concat(vals, ",")
		end
		print(line)
	end
	if frames >= OAM_FROM and frames % OAM_EVERY == 0 then
		dump("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
	end
	if frames >= CAP_FROM and frames % CAP_EVERY == 0 then
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X OBSEL=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			rd16(0xD51B),
			emu.read(0x2101, emu.memType.snesPpu),
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
		dump("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		print("OAMWALK-DUMP frame=" .. frames)
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("OAMWALK-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/pidoam_journey2.lua`:

```lua
-- pidoam_journey2.lua - protagonist-select probe + journey harness.
-- Downs = number of down-presses on the character-select cursor before
-- confirming with A (0 = default = Julian, start map 0x249; Mikael is the
-- only protagonist whose start is the 宿営地 camp, maps 0x24C/0x24D/0x24E/
-- 0x24F). After the intro, busy -> A every 30 frames; menu-open (D3C0) ->
-- B instead (ring-menu guard, walk8 lesson); idle -> walk program.
-- Logs the current map id from $7E:2011 (pinned by journey1's WRAM scan)
-- every 500 frames from 12000, and dumps OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot at the
-- first arrival after frame 20000 and every 4000 after.

local DOWNS = 3
local IDLE_A = false
-- forest NE push, pathfind on map 0x249 from spawn (16,16)
local STEP_PROGRAM = { { "up", 400 }, { "right", 1000 } }

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
for i = 1, DOWNS do PRESSES[7600 + i * 150] = { down = 1 } end
PRESSES[8600] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
PRESSES[9300] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9700] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
PRESSES[10300] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[11000] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats

local OAM_EVERY = 500
local OAM_FROM = 21000
local CAP_EVERY = 2000
local CAP_FROM = 22000
local STATE_EVERY = 500
local STATE_FROM = 12000
local LAST_FRAME = 95000

local frames = 0
local done = false

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function mapid()
	-- bytes: 0x2011 = high byte (pinned as rd16(0x2011) == 0x0249 in journey1)
	return emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

print("PIDOAM-J2-LOADED downs=" .. DOWNS .. " idleA=" .. tostring(IDLE_A))

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	local menu = emu.read(0xD3C0, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 12000 then
		if IDLE_A then
			-- The 0Bxx dialog syscalls wait for A with $76 == 0 (walk5/walk13
			-- lesson), so A must be pressed unconditionally; the ring-menu
			-- guard swaps in B when the menu is open (walk8 lesson).
			if frames % 60 == 0 then
				p = menu and { b = 1 } or { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif menu then
			-- walk13 policy: A only while the VM is busy; B only to close a
			-- ring menu that a stray A opened on a free field.
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { b = 1 }
			end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		end
		if p == nil and not busy and not menu then
			-- STEP_PROGRAM: {{dir, frames}, ...} walked in order from
			-- free-walk start (pathfind on map 0x249: spawn (16,16), north
			-- edge (16,0) is 16 tiles up, NE corner (56,0) is 40 tiles
			-- right along row 0; ~12 frames per tile, generous margin).
			local t = frames - 12000
			local remaining = t
			for _, step in ipairs(STEP_PROGRAM) do
				if remaining < step[2] then
					p = { [step[1]] = 1 }
					break
				end
				remaining = remaining - step[2]
			end
			if p == nil then
				-- program exhausted: hold east along the top edge (the
				-- exit search continues)
				p = { right = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames >= STATE_FROM and frames % STATE_EVERY == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X D3BF=%02X D3C0=%02X D599=%02X MAP=%04X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3BF, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3C0, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD599, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			mapid(),
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
	end
	if frames >= OAM_FROM and frames % OAM_EVERY == 0 then
		dump("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
	end
	if frames >= CAP_FROM and frames % CAP_EVERY == 0 then
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X MAP=%04X OBSEL=%02X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			mapid(),
			emu.read(0x2101, emu.memType.snesPpu)))
		dump("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		print("OAMWALK-DUMP frame=" .. frames)
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("OAMWALK-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/pidoam_journey3.lua`:

```lua
-- pidoam_journey3.lua - protagonist-select + forest-exit push, walk13
-- timing (tools/emulator/oam_walk.lua) with two changes:
--   1. downs cursor presses between the gender confirm (7000) and the
--      character confirm (7800): row 0 = Julian, row 2 = Mikael (verified
--      via event 0845, the camp-gate scene), rows 1/3 = the other males.
--   2. the idle walk program is STEP_PROGRAM (pathfind on map 0x249:
--      spawn (16,16); north edge (16,0) is 16 tiles up; (56,0) is 40 more
--      right; ~12 frames per tile, generous margins).
-- Policy is walk13's exact one: from 20800, busy ($76!=0) -> A every 30
-- frames, menu-open (D3C0) -> B, idle -> STEP_PROGRAM. Dumps as in
-- oam_walk.lua, plus a full CAPSTATE every 2000 frames from 24000.

local DOWNS = 0
-- forest NE push
-- walk13's proven cycling program (verified visible player movement):
-- 900-frame legs, 100-frame pause, down/right alternating.
local STEP_PROGRAM = { { "down", 900 }, { "right", 900 } }
local OAM_FROM = 20800
local OAM_EVERY = 1000
local CAP_FROM = 24000
local CAP_EVERY = 2000
local STATE_FROM = 20800
local STATE_EVERY = 500
local LAST_FRAME = 150000

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
for i = 1, DOWNS do PRESSES[7250 + i * 150] = { down = 1 } end
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats

local frames = 0
local done = false
local fieldAt = nil
local idleCount = nil

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function mapid()
	-- bytes: 0x2011 = high byte (journey1 WRAM scan; in-field values like
	-- 0x0249 read back as rd16(0x2011))
	return emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

print("PIDOAM-J3-LOADED downs=" .. DOWNS)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 then
		-- walk13's exact policy (A only while busy; held direction while
		-- idle; NO menu handling - B during cutscene windows skips text and
		-- derails the intro, verified 2026-11-16 with the D3C0 guard).
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			-- The step clock starts at the field: the first idle stretch
			-- after frame 24000 (the park; before that, idle gaps between
			-- cutscene dialogs would consume one-shot steps - verified
			-- 2026-11-16, the up leg fired inside the cutscenes).
			if fieldAt == nil then
				if idleCount == nil then idleCount = 0 end
				idleCount = idleCount + 1
				if idleCount >= 60 and frames >= 24000 then fieldAt = frames end
			end
			if fieldAt == nil then
				p = nil
			else
				-- cycling 900-frame legs with a 100-frame pause (walk13)
				local t = frames - fieldAt
				local leg = math.floor(t / 1000) % #STEP_PROGRAM + 1
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [STEP_PROGRAM[leg][1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames >= STATE_FROM and frames % STATE_EVERY == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X D3BF=%02X D3C0=%02X D599=%02X MAP=%04X PC=%02X:%02X%02X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3BF, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3C0, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD599, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			mapid(),
			emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
	end
	if frames >= OAM_FROM and frames % OAM_EVERY == 0 then
		dump("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
	end
	if frames >= CAP_FROM and frames % CAP_EVERY == 0 then
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X MAP=%04X OBSEL=%02X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			mapid(),
			emu.read(0x2101, emu.memType.snesPpu)))
		dump("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		print("OAMWALK-DUMP frame=" .. frames)
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("OAMWALK-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/pidoam_posfind.lua`:

```lua
-- pidoam_posfind.lua - find the party-position WRAM cells by differential
-- scan. Boot to the forest free-walk (walk13 timing, downs=0), then:
--   scan A at 21000: all offsets 0..0x1FFFE where byte[off] <= 63 and
--     byte[off+1] <= 63 (candidate (x,y) tile pairs),
--   walk UP 1500 frames (BFS-verified open from spawn (16,16)),
--   scan B: keep candidates whose byte[off+1] decreased by 1..64,
--   walk RIGHT 1500 frames,
--   scan C: keep candidates whose byte[off] increased by 1..64 since scan B.
-- Prints the surviving cells with their values at every checkpoint.

local OAM_FROM = 20800
local OAM_EVERY = 2000
local SCAN_A = 21500
local UP_END = 23000
local SCAN_B = 23100
local RIGHT_END = 24600
local SCAN_C = 24700
local LAST_FRAME = 30000

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false
local candA, candB = nil, nil

local function scanPairs()
	local c = {}
	for off = 0, 0x1FFFE do
		local a = emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local b = emu.read(off + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		if a <= 63 and b <= 63 then
			c[off] = { a, b }
		end
	end
	return c
end

print("POSFIND-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	local menu = emu.read(0xD3C0, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 then
		if menu then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { b = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			if frames < UP_END then
				p = { up = 1 }
			elseif frames < RIGHT_END then
				p = { right = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames == SCAN_A then
		candA = scanPairs()
		print("POSSCAN A frame=" .. frames .. " candidates=" .. keys(candA))
	elseif frames == SCAN_B then
		candB = {}
		local n = 0
		for off, v in pairs(candA) do
			local y0 = emu.read(off + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			local d = v[2] - y0
			if d >= 1 and d <= 64 then
				candB[off] = { emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam), y0 }
				n = n + 1
			end
		end
		print("POSSCAN B frame=" .. frames .. " survivors=" .. n)
		for off, v in pairs(candB) do
			print(string.format("POSCAND B %05X %d,%d", off, v[1], v[2]))
		end
	elseif frames == SCAN_C then
		local n = 0
		for off, v in pairs(candB) do
			local x0 = emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			local d = x0 - v[1]
			if d >= 1 and d <= 64 then
				print(string.format("POSHIT %05X now %d,%d (B: %d,%d)", off, x0, emu.read(off + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam), v[1], v[2]))
				n = n + 1
			end
		end
		print("POSSCAN C frame=" .. frames .. " hits=" .. n)
	end
	if frames >= OAM_FROM and frames % OAM_EVERY == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X D3C0=%02X MAP=%04X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3C0, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("POSFIND-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

function keys(t)
	local n = 0
	for _ in pairs(t) do n = n + 1 end
	return n
end
```

`tools/emulator/pidoam_posfind2.lua`:

```lua
-- pidoam_posfind2.lua - second position-cell hunt: 16-bit word pairs.
-- Boot to the forest free-walk (walk13 timing), then:
--   scan A at 21500: offsets 0..0x1FFFB where u16le(off) <= 1120 and
--     u16le(off+2) <= 1120 (candidate (x,y) pixel pairs, map is 64x64
--     tiles = 1024 px; a little slack for off-map values),
--   walk UP 1500 frames (BFS-verified open from spawn), scan B: y word
--     decreased by 1..1120,
--   walk RIGHT 1500 frames, scan C: x word increased by 1..1120 with y
--     unchanged. Print survivors, then track them every 250 frames to
--     frame 30000.

local SCAN_A = 21500
local UP_END = 23000
local SCAN_B = 23100
local RIGHT_END = 24600
local SCAN_C = 24700
local TRACK_END = 30000
local LAST_FRAME = 30000

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false
local candA, candB = nil, nil

local function w16(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) + emu.read(off + 1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
end

local function scanPairs()
	local c = {}
	for off = 0, 0x1FFFB do
		local x = w16(off)
		if x <= 1120 then
			local y = w16(off + 2)
			if y <= 1120 then
				c[off] = { x, y }
			end
		end
	end
	return c
end

local function count(t)
	local n = 0
	for _ in pairs(t) do n = n + 1 end
	return n
end

print("POSFIND2-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	local menu = emu.read(0xD3C0, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 then
		if menu then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { b = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			if frames < UP_END then
				p = { up = 1 }
			elseif frames < RIGHT_END then
				p = { right = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames == SCAN_A then
		candA = scanPairs()
		print("POS2 A frame=" .. frames .. " candidates=" .. count(candA))
	elseif frames == SCAN_B then
		candB = {}
		for off, v in pairs(candA) do
			local y0 = w16(off + 2)
			local d = v[2] - y0
			if d >= 1 and d <= 1120 then
				candB[off] = { w16(off), y0 }
			end
		end
		print("POS2 B frame=" .. frames .. " survivors=" .. count(candB))
	elseif frames == SCAN_C then
		local keep = {}
		for off, v in pairs(candB) do
			local x0 = w16(off)
			local d = x0 - v[1]
			local y0 = w16(off + 2)
			if d >= 1 and d <= 1120 and y0 == v[2] then
				keep[off] = { x0, y0 }
			end
		end
		print("POS2 C frame=" .. frames .. " hits=" .. count(keep))
		for off, v in pairs(keep) do
			print(string.format("POS2HIT %05X now %d,%d", off, v[1], v[2]))
		end
		candB = keep
	elseif frames % 250 == 0 and frames > SCAN_C and frames <= TRACK_END and candB then
		local s = {}
		for off, _ in pairs(candB) do
			s[#s + 1] = string.format("%05X=%d,%d", off, w16(off), w16(off + 2))
		end
		print("POS2TRACK frame=" .. frames .. " " .. table.concat(s, " "))
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("POSFIND2-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/pidoam_select.lua`:

```lua
-- pidoam_select.lua - probe the character-select screen layout: play the
-- known opening through gender confirm (A at 7000), then screenshot the
-- character-select screen around frames 7000-8200 so the cursor layout and
-- the row of the default character can be read from the PNGs (shot_ascii).
-- One extra down-press at 7700 shows whether the cursor moves (two shots).

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
PRESSES[7700] = { down = 1 }   -- probe: move cursor once
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local SHOTS = { [6800]=1, [7000]=1, [7100]=1, [7300]=1, [7500]=1,
                [7600]=1, [7800]=1, [7900]=1, [8000]=1, [8200]=1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

print("PIDOAM-SELECT-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	if p == nil and frames > 7000 and frames < 8600 and frames % 2 == 0 then
		-- keep confirming gender dialogs if any window waits
		if emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0 and frames % 30 == 0 then
			p = { a = 1 }
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if SHOTS[frames] then
		print(string.format("SELECT frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X D3BF=%02X D3C0=%02X D3C1=%02X MAP=%04X",
			frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3BF, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3C0, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0xD3C1, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
			emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot" .. frames)
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot" .. frames)
	end
	if frames >= 13000 and not done then
		done = true
		print("OAMWALK-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/pocket_probe2.lua`:

```lua
-- pocket_probe2.lua - instrument the move gate's attr-byte fetch while
-- the party attempts steps out of the 0x250 arrival spot. cs_grid7's
-- captured grid says the tiles around the arrival are 0x1E walls, yet
-- earlier sessions saw the party walk; the gate fetches [$1C],Y with
-- Y = (D0D1 * (py>>3)) + (px>>3) (S_C0_5BC6), which may not be one grid
-- byte per 16px tile. This run logs every gate read of the attr grid
-- (PC C0/5BE1) and low buffer (PC C0/58CC) with the position cells, so
-- the true position->byte mapping can be reconstructed offline.
local END_FRAME = 34600
local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }
local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local lastLog = -10000
local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function leader()
	return wr(0xD9AA) + wr(0xD9AB) * 256, wr(0xD9AC) + wr(0xD9AD) * 256
end
print("POCKET-PROBE2-LOADED")
flush_pad()
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then battle = true; battle_start = frames
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false; battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
-- attr-grid gate fetch reads
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < 28800 or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.k ~= 0xC0 or st.pc < 0x5BE1 or st.pc > 0x5BE3 then return end
		if frames - lastLog < 300 then return end
		lastLog = frames
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("FETCH frame=%d addr=%04X pc=%04X px=%d py=%d s99=%d s9C=%d D8FC=%04X D8FE=%04X stride=%d",
			frames, addr - 0x10000, st.pc, lx, ly, wr(0x99), wr(0x9C),
			wr(0xD8FC) + wr(0xD8FD) * 256, wr(0xD8FE) + wr(0xD8FF) * 256, wr(0xD0D1)))
		flush_pad()
	end)
	if not ok then print("FETCH-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0x11800, 0x12FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames >= 20800 and frames < 28900 then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [({ "down", "right" })[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	elseif frames >= 28900 and frames < END_FRAME then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			local t = frames - 28900
			local dir = ({ "up", "right" })[math.floor(t / 600) % 2 + 1]
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if t % 600 == 0 then
				local lx, ly = leader()
				print(string.format("LEG frame=%d dir=%s px=%d py=%d D2E3=%02X", frames, dir, lx, ly, wr(0xD2E3)))
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
	end
	if frames % 2000 == 0 then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s D2E3=%02X", frames, lx, ly, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), wr(0xD2E3)))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d px=%d py=%d", frames, lx, ly))
		print("POCKET-PROBE2-DONE")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then print("ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/pos_hunt.lua`:

```lua
-- pos_hunt.lua - party-position WRAM cell hunt, sequential-leg design.
--
-- NOTE: NOTE 2026-11-22: emu.write works in -testRunner with (address, value, memType); the old no-op note was a reversed-arguments probe error (docs/parity.md section 11)
-- and emu.createSavestate is refused there (state_probe), so there is no
-- restore-to-base in this run. Instead the party WALKS OUT AND BACK:
-- each leg holds one direction then its opposite, and the dumps around a
-- pair give value -> v+a -> v again. A cell that behaves that way on the
-- right/left pair while the up/down pair leaves it unchanged is a
-- position or camera-scroll X cell; mirrored for Y. The trailing idle
-- dump separates pure time drift (counters, RNG).
--
-- Input policy: walk13/shot_maprender verbatim through frame 34000
-- (proven free walk; the party stands settled on map 0x249 by 34600).
-- Legs from 35200: R20 L20 U20 D20 L20 R20, 600-frame settle + full-WRAM
-- dump after each, then 600 idle frames and one final dump.
--
-- Dumps reassemble with tools/emulator/oam_reassemble.py. Diff with the
-- pair-symmetry filter in /tmp/journey2-agent (posdiff.py logic).

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }
local D0_FRAME = 35200
local SETTLE = 600
-- 900-frame legs (the walk13-proven length): 20- and 120-frame holds
-- produced no WRAM movement at all (pos_hunt3/4 - the party needs the
-- long hold before stepping, same as walk13's 900-frame legs). One leg
-- per direction; a position/scroll cell tracks every leg monotonically
-- with the leg's direction sign.
local LEGS = { "L900", "R900", "U900", "D900", "idle" }
local LEN = { L900 = 900, R900 = 900, U900 = 900, D900 = 900 }
local DIR = { L900 = "left", R900 = "right", U900 = "up", D900 = "down" }

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false
local legIdx = 0          -- 0 = base dump pending, then one leg per entry
local legHoldUntil = nil
local legDumpAt = nil

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dumpwram(name)
	dump(name, function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end, 131072)
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

local function mapid()
	return emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

print("POS-HUNT-LOADED")
print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if frames < D0_FRAME then
		-- intro + walk phase, shot_maprender policy verbatim
		if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		-- leg phase keeps the A-while-busy policy: a story position check
		-- (the intro's forest-exit gate) fires a cutscene mid-leg and the
		-- cutscene waits for A (pos_hunt4 froze here without it)
	else
		-- leg phase: held direction + A while busy
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif legIdx >= 1 and legIdx <= #LEGS and DIR[LEGS[legIdx]] and frames < legHoldUntil then
			p = { [DIR[LEGS[legIdx]]] = 1 }
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames == D0_FRAME then
		print(string.format("ST0 frame=%d MAP=%04X 76=%02X", frames, mapid(),
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
		dumpwram("wram0")
		dump("oam0", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump("cgram0", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump("vram0", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot0")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot0")
		print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
		legIdx = 1
		legHoldUntil = frames + LEN[LEGS[1]]
		legDumpAt = frames + LEN[LEGS[1]] + SETTLE
		return
	end
	if legIdx >= 1 and frames == legDumpAt then
		local name = LEGS[legIdx]
		print(string.format("LEG %s end frame=%d MAP=%04X 76=%02X", name, frames, mapid(),
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
		if name == "idle" then
			dumpwram("wram_idle")
			if not done then
				done = true
				print("POS-HUNT-DONE")
				print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
				emu.stop(0)
			end
			return
		end
		dumpwram("wram_" .. name)
		legIdx = legIdx + 1
		local nxt = LEGS[legIdx]
		if DIR[nxt] then
			legHoldUntil = frames + LEN[nxt]
			legDumpAt = frames + LEN[nxt] + SETTLE
		else
			legHoldUntil = nil
			legDumpAt = frames + SETTLE
		end
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

```lua
-- pos_y.lua - Y-cell hunt + X-candidate tracking.
--
-- pos_hunt5 pinned the X candidates (posdiff5: cells moving -256px on the
-- 900-frame west leg and returning exactly on the east leg; top candidate
-- $7E:DBA8 le = 767 -> 511 -> 767) but the party's northward walk was
-- blocked within 200 px, so no Y cell surfaced. This run replays the
-- teleport run's proven long program (900-frame up legs with 50-frame
-- left nudges - the party crossed 0x249 -> 0x24A -> 0x250 with it) while
-- logging the X candidate and dumping WRAM every 4000 frames, so cells
-- that decrease monotonically during the up-legs are the Y/scroll cells.

			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)

	elseif rem == 2 then

	end

	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

	return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
end

print("POS-Y-LOADED")
print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames < ST0_FRAME then
		if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
			if busy then

				end
			else

				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	else
		-- zigzag: alternating 900-frame west and north legs, A while busy.
		-- (Empirical: holds <=120 frames never start a walk - pos_hunt3/4 -
		-- while walk13's 900-frame legs do; the up-first variant of this

				end
			end
		end

end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames == ST0_FRAME then

		print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))

		end

			table.concat(s, " ")))
	end

		dump("wram_" .. frames, function(i) return wr(i) end, 131072)
		print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
	end
	if frames >= ST0_FRAME + ZIG_END and not done then
		done = true
		print("POS-Y-DONE")
		print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
		emu.stop(0)
	end
```

`tools/emulator/protag_route.lua`:

```lua
-- protag_route.lua - which opening route event 0800 takes per select row.
--
-- Plays cold boot -> title -> select (DOWN x ROW) -> default name ->
-- weapon -> stats (form_watch.lua's verified press schedule), then logs
-- every change of the dispatch id $D51B, every chkMem compare (C0:2F38,
-- with the pointer and $F000), every map load, each global jump record read, op 2E (C0:2779), op 43 (C0:277D) and script end
-- (C0:3783) with the call depth $77. Input is driven from inputPolled;
-- delete /tmp/mesence/Saves/bokuno_jp.srm first for a cold boot.
-- ROW is patched by sed before each run:
--   sed "s/^local ROW = 0/local ROW = 3/" protag_route.lua > route3.lua

local ROW = 0
local END_FRAME = 30000

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
for i = 0, ROW - 1 do PRESSES[7700 + 40 * i] = { down = 1 } end
PRESSES[7700 + 40 * ROW + 80] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_d2e3 = nil
local hits = 0
print(string.format("ROUTE-LOADED row=%d", ROW))

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc)
end

-- 16-bit store, low byte first: log the id once the high byte lands and
-- only when it changed.
local last_id = -1
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	local id = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) | (val << 8)
	if id ~= last_id and hits < 4000 then
		hits = hits + 1
		last_id = id
		print(string.format("ID frame=%d id=%04X pc=%s", frames, id, pctag()))
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD51C, 0xD51C, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- chkMem (C0:2F22) compares at C0:2F38 `CMP [$78]`: A = the byte read
-- through the EF00 pointer, [$78] = the operand b. Log every compare with
-- the VM pc and the leader record byte $F000.
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function rd(addr) return emu.read(addr, emu.memType.snesMemory) end
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if hits >= 4000 then return end
	hits = hits + 1
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local vm = wr(0x7A) * 0x10000 + wr(0x78) + wr(0x79) * 256
	print(string.format("CHK frame=%d vmpc=%06X a=%02X b=%02X ptr=%04X F000=%02X", frames, vm,
		st.a & 0xFF, rd(vm), st.x, wr(0xF000)))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC02F38, 0xC02F38, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	print(string.format("F000W frame=%d val=%02X", frames, val))
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xF000, 0xF000, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- op 2E (C0:2779 -> frame pop C0:3756) and the script end C0:3783: depth
-- $77 and the VM pc at each, to see whether 2E ends a depth-0 script
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if hits >= 4000 then return end
	hits = hits + 1
	local vm = wr(0x7A) * 0x10000 + wr(0x78) + wr(0x79) * 256
	print(string.format("OP2E frame=%d vmpc=%06X depth=%d", frames, vm, wr(0x77)))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC02779, 0xC02779, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if hits >= 4000 then return end
	hits = hits + 1
	local vm = wr(0x7A) * 0x10000 + wr(0x78) + wr(0x79) * 256
	print(string.format("OP43 frame=%d vmpc=%06X depth=%d", frames, vm, wr(0x77)))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC0277D, 0xC0277D, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if hits >= 4000 then return end
	hits = hits + 1
	local vm = wr(0x7A) * 0x10000 + wr(0x78) + wr(0x79) * 256
	print(string.format("SCRIPTEND frame=%d vmpc=%06X depth=%d", frames, vm, wr(0x77)))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC03783, 0xC03783, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- op 11 map jumps read their record from the global table FC:FB00 +
-- 5*xx (file 0x3CFB00): log the index at each record's first byte
-- (the callback gets the CPU address FC:FBxx, so take the low word)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a)
	local off = (a & 0xFFFF) - 0xFB00
	if hits < 4000 then
		hits = hits + 1
		print(string.format("JUMPREC frame=%d index=%02X byte=%d", frames, off // 5, off % 5))
	end
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0x3CFB00, 0x3CFFFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesPrgRom)

-- any caller of the chkMem transform, in case bokuno moved the handler
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if hits >= 4000 then return end
	hits = hits + 1
	local vm = wr(0x7A) * 0x10000 + wr(0x78) + wr(0x79) * 256
	print(string.format("XFORM frame=%d vmpc=%06X", frames, vm))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x6836F0, 0x6836F0, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	-- map loads: $D2E3 changes when a map loads; the id is $2011/$2012
	-- (chain_capture.lua's recipe)
	local d2e3 = emu.read(0xD2E3, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	if last_d2e3 ~= nil and d2e3 ~= last_d2e3 then
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d MAP=%04X", frames,
			emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)))
	end
	last_d2e3 = d2e3
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	-- after the stats confirm, advance any open dialogue ($76 busy)
	if p == nil and frames > 11000 and frames % 30 == 0
		and emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0 then
		p = { a = 1 }
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	if frames >= END_FRAME then
		print(string.format("ROUTE-END frame=%d hits=%d", frames, hits))
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/release_probe.lua`:

```lua
-- release_probe.lua - instrumented run for the map-0x250 "frozen arena"
-- (chain-walk session; findings in docs/map-format.md and
-- docs/vm-semantics.md §6.6): the intro VM has ended normally there, the
-- only exit is EdgeEvents[0]=084E at the north edge (y=0), and the field
-- is free to walk — so from ST0=35200 this script WALKS: a right-hand
-- wall-follower (600-frame legs, clockwise rotation on a <4px leader-move
-- leg) threading the tree-trunk maze toward y=0, with the proven policies
-- (A every 30 while busy/battle via the SPC BGM dispatch, B for the ring
-- menu).
--
-- Input replay: chain_walk.lua's exact program to frame 35200 (PRESSES at
-- 300-10600, walk13's down/right idle legs 20800-34000) — the deterministic
-- arena state.
--
-- Instruments:
-- - $76 write transitions: frame, cpu PC, VM PC ($78/$79/$7A), D51B -> where
--   the intro VM actually stops.
-- - BG1/BG2 scroll register writes ($210D-2110), logged on value change with
--   the writer PC -> who owns the camera and does it ever move.
-- - OAM first 12 sprites every 100 frames; LEG lines at every leg boundary.
-- - state line; BGM battle detection (chain_walk's dispatch).
-- - WRAM dumps at 35200/48000/90000/end, screenshots every 2000 frames
--   from 35200 (dumpmaps compare).
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/release_probe.lua --timeout=3000

local ST0 = 35200
local END_FRAME = 168000
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local CUTSCENE_SONG = 41
local VICTORY_SONG = 3

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last76 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local last_bgm = nil
local lastScroll = {}
local lastD900 = nil
local legDir = "up"
local legX, legY = nil, nil
local legEnd = ST0
local dumpAt = {}
dumpAt[ST0] = true
dumpAt[48000] = true
dumpAt[END_FRAME] = true
local endDone = false

-- b64encode copied verbatim from chain_walk.lua (numeric table in, string out).
local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes[i] * 65536 + (bytes[i + 1] or 0) * 256 + (bytes[i + 2] or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
		local rem = #bytes % 3
		if rem == 1 then
			out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
		elseif rem == 2 then
			out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
		end
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	local chunk = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		chunk[#chunk + 1] = readfn(i)
		if #chunk == 3000 then
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
			chunk = {}
		end
	end
	if #chunk > 0 then
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function flush_pad()
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function mapid()
	return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
end
local function oamline()
	local s = {}
	for i = 0, 11 do
		s[#s + 1] = string.format("%d:%d,%d,%02X%02X", i,
			emu.read(i * 4, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam),
			emu.read(i * 4 + 1, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam),
			emu.read(i * 4 + 3, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam),
			emu.read(512 + i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam))
	end
	return table.concat(s, " ")
end

print("RELEASE-PROBE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

local port1 = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	elseif id == VICTORY_SONG then
		print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	elseif id ~= BATTLE_SONG and id ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and id ~= VICTORY_SONG
		and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		battle_start = nil
		print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
	end
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- $76 transitions: the exact frame the intro VM stops (and every start).
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if val ~= last76 then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("V76 frame=%d val=%02X cpu=%02X:%04X vm=%02X:%02X%02X D51B=%04X D2E3=%02X MAP=%04X",
			frames, val, st.k, st.pc, wr(0x7A), wr(0x79), wr(0x78),
			wr(0xD51B) + wr(0xD51C) * 256, wr(0xD2E3), mapid()))
		flush_pad()
		last76 = val
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x76, 0x76, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- Scroll register writes, value-change logged with writer PC. Bank FF:02xx
-- writes a 0C/00 reset pair every frame (run1 flood); skip that writer — the
-- field camera is a different PC.
local scrollRegs = { [0x210D] = "BG1H", [0x210E] = "BG1V", [0x210F] = "BG2H", [0x2110] = "BG2V" }
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local name = scrollRegs[addr]
	if name == nil then return end
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	if st.k == 0xFF then return end
	if lastScroll[addr] ~= val then
		print(string.format("SCROLL frame=%d %s=%02X cpu=%02X:%04X 76=%02X",
			frames, name, val, st.k, st.pc, wr(0x76)))
		lastScroll[addr] = val
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x210D, 0x2110, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- Leader actor cell writes (candidate position cells; PC = movement code).
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if lastD900 ~= nil and val ~= lastD900 then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("POS frame=%d D9%04X=%02X cpu=%02X:%04X 76=%02X", frames, addr, val, st.k, st.pc, wr(0x76)))
	end
	lastD900 = val
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD900, 0xD90F, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	-- walk13's leg program, copied from chain_walk.lua (frames 20800-34000):
	-- without it the intro handoff diverges and the arena state at ST0 is
	-- never reached (run1 lesson: the replay sat in the 0846 cutscene).
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif wr(0x76) ~= 0 then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [({ "down", "right" })[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	elseif frames >= ST0 then
		local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif wr(0xD3C0) ~= 0 then
			if frames % 60 == 0 then
				p = { b = 1 }
			end
		else
			-- wall-follower: hold legDir for 600-frame legs; sample the leader
			-- sprite (OAM 0, the party leader in every run) at leg boundaries
			-- and rotate clockwise (up→right→down→left) when a leg moved the
			-- leader under 4 px. Right-hand rule threads the tree-trunk maze
			-- where the fixed staircase of run3 looped in place (run3 log:
			-- identical screenshots at 80000 and 136000, R/L legs cancelling).
			if frames >= legEnd then
				local x = emu.read(0, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam)
				local y = emu.read(1, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam)
				local moved = true
				if legX ~= nil then
					-- wrap-aware 8-bit diff: OAM x wraps at 0/255 when the leader
					-- crosses the screen edge (run4 lesson: x 116→252 read as
					-- "moved" and skipped the rotation)
					local dx = (x - legX) % 256
					local dy = (y - legY) % 256
					if dx > 128 then dx = dx - 256 end
					if dy > 128 then dy = dy - 256 end
					moved = math.abs(dx) + math.abs(dy) > 4
				end
				if not moved then
					legDir = ({ up = "right", right = "down", down = "left", left = "up" })[legDir]
				end
				legX, legY = x, y
				legEnd = frames + 600
				print(string.format("LEG frame=%d dir=%s moved=%s x=%d y=%d", frames, legDir, tostring(moved), x, y))
			end
			p = { [legDir] = 1 }
		end
		if frames % 100 == 0 then
			print(string.format("T frame=%d 76=%02X menu=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X song=%s %s",
				frames, wr(0x76), wr(0xD3C0), mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), tostring(last_bgm), oamline()))
		end
		if frames % 2000 == 0 then
			local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
			print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
			for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
				print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode({ png:byte(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png)) }))
			end
			print("DUMPEND shot")
			flush_pad()
		end
	end
	if dumpAt[frames] then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X 76=%02X D51B=%04X D2D8=%02X",
			frames, mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x76), wr(0xD51B) + wr(0xD51C) * 256, wr(0xD2D8)))
		dump("w" .. frames, wr, 131072)
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames >= END_FRAME and not endDone then
		endDone = true
		print("RELEASE-PROBE-DONE frame=" .. frames)
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/rip.lua`:

```lua
-- SPC rip via driver-dispatch hijack (MesenCE -testRunner).
--
-- Mechanism (verified against MesenCE 2.2.1 + bokuno_jp.sfc):
--   The SNES-side song dispatcher is the function whose first table access is
--   the instruction `LDA $C60FC6,X` at SNES $5E:191B (file 0x5E191B). On entry
--   A = X = song_id * 3 (original ids 0x00-0x5B; CMP #$0114 = 92*3 above the
--   caller). An exec callback on $5E191B forces X = TARGET*3 so the dispatcher
--   resolves our track's sequence pointer from the $C6:0FC6 table, uploads it
--   to the SPC and plays it. Hijack applies to every dispatch in the run.
--
-- Output (stdout, via print() — emu.log does NOT reach stdout in testRunner):
--   RIPINFO target=.. hijack_frame=.. dump_frame=.. spc pc/a/x/y/ps/sp
--   SPCDATA <base64 chunks of the 64 KiB SPC700 RAM>
--   DSPDATA <base64 of DSP registers $00-$7F>
--   The shell driver (rip_track.sh) reassembles a .spc file from these lines.
--
-- @@TARGET@@ is substituted by rip_track.sh (scripts get no CLI args).

local TARGET = 0x00  -- RIP-TARGET (decimal id, substituted by rip_track.sh)
local DUMP_FRAME = 2400  -- ~37 s in-song at 60 fps

local frames = 0
local hijack_frame = nil

-- load marker: rip_track.sh greps this; a Lua syntax error would otherwise fail silently
print("RIP-LOADED target=" .. TARGET)

emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	-- LuaCallHelper consumes params last-to-first: the table comes FIRST.
	emu.setCpuState({a = TARGET * 3, x = TARGET * 3}, emu.cpuType.snes)
	if hijack_frame == nil then
		hijack_frame = frames
	end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x5E191B, 0x5E191B, emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local b1 = bytes[i]
		local b2 = bytes[i + 1]
		local b3 = bytes[i + 2]
		local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
		local c = {
			math.floor(n / 262144) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64,
			n % 64,
		}
		-- strings are not indexable in Lua; sub() is the only char access
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	-- pad the final partial group so b64decode yields the exact byte count
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	-- no padding needed for interior chunks; the builder trims each decode by 3-divisibility
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.spc)
	print(string.format("RIPINFO target=%d hijack_frame=%s dump_frame=%d spcpc=%04X a=%02X x=%02X y=%02X ps=%02X sp=%02X",
		TARGET, tostring(hijack_frame), frames, st.pc, st.a, st.x, st.y, st.ps, st.sp))

	local ram = {}
	for i = 0, 0xFFFF do
		ram[#ram + 1] = emu.read(i, emu.memType.spcRam)
	end
	for i = 1, #ram, 900 * 3 do
		local chunk = {}
		for j = i, math.min(i + 900 * 3 - 1, #ram) do
			chunk[#chunk + 1] = ram[j]
		end
		print("SPCDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end

	local dsp = {}
	for i = 0, 0x7F do
		dsp[#dsp + 1] = emu.read(i, emu.memType.spcDspRegisters)
	end
	print("DSPDATA " .. b64encode(dsp))
	print("RIPDONE")
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	-- emu.stop does not synchronously halt callbacks; guard so stdout is byte-stable.
	if frames == DUMP_FRAME then
		local ok, err = pcall(dump)
		if not ok then
			print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err))
			emu.stop(1)
			return
		end
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	if frames > DUMP_FRAME + 600 then
		print("RIPTIMEOUT")
		emu.stop(1)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

```

`tools/emulator/rip_build.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Split a battle_sfx rip log into per-dump .spc files, render each through
the libgme chain (ffmpeg), and print ffprobe verification lines.

Usage: rip_build.py <log> <outdir>
Each DUMP<name>-BEGIN..DUMP<name>-END block in the log becomes
<outdir>/<name>.spc + <name>.ogg. Prints one VERIFY line per dump.
"""
import base64
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

log, outdir = sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2])
outdir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

blocks = {}
name = None
for line in open(log, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
    m = re.match(r"DUMP(\w+)-BEGIN", line)
    if m:
        name = m.group(1)
        blocks[name] = []
        continue
    if name and re.match(r"DUMP\w+-END", line):
        name = None
        continue
    if name:
        blocks[name].append(line)

if not blocks:
    sys.exit("no dump blocks in " + log)

spc_build = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "spc_build.py")
for name, lines in blocks.items():
    dlog = outdir / f"{name}.log"
    dlog.write_text("".join(lines), encoding="utf-8")
    spc = outdir / f"{name}.spc"
    r = subprocess.run(["python3", "-I", spc_build, str(spc), str(dlog)],
                       capture_output=True, text=True)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        print(f"VERIFY {name} BUILD-FAIL {r.stdout.strip()} {r.stderr.strip()}")
        continue
    wav = outdir / f"{name}.wav"
    ogg = outdir / f"{name}.ogg"
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-v", "error", "-i", str(spc), "-t", "3", str(wav)], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-y", "-v", "error", "-i", str(wav),
                    "-c:a", "libvorbis", "-q:a", "5", str(ogg)], check=True)
    wav.unlink()
    dur = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_entries", "format=duration",
                          "-of", "default=noprint_wrappers=1:nokey=1", str(ogg)],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip()
    vol = subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-i", str(ogg),
                          "-af", "volumedetect", "-f", "null", "-"],
                         capture_output=True, text=True).stderr
    mean = re.search(r"mean_volume: (-?[0-9.]+) dB", vol)
    mx = re.search(r"max_volume: (-?[0-9.]+) dB", vol)
    print(f"VERIFY {name} dur={dur} mean={mean.group(1) if mean else '?'}dB max={mx.group(1) if mx else '?'}dB spc={spc}")

```

`tools/emulator/rip_track.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Rip one BGM track from patches/bokuno_jp.sfc to exports/data/bgm/<name>.ogg.
# Usage: tools/emulator/rip_track.sh <track-id-decimal> <name> [dump_frame]
# Requires: MesenCE extracted to /tmp/mesence (see run.sh), ffmpeg with libgme.
# The .spc and the emulator binary stay local-only (docs/music.md license rules).
set -euo pipefail

id=$1
name=$2
dump_frame=${3:-2400}
repo=/home/newlix/projects/saga3
work=/tmp/bgm_rip/$name
mkdir -p "$work"

# rip.lua has no CLI args; inject the target id and dump frame.
sed -e "s/^local TARGET = 0x00.*/local TARGET = $id/" \
    -e "s/^local DUMP_FRAME = 2400.*/local DUMP_FRAME = $dump_frame/" \
    "$repo/tools/emulator/rip.lua" > "$work/rip.lua"

env -u DISPLAY "$repo/tools/emulator/run.sh" "$work/rip.lua" -timeout=300 \
    > "$work/stdout.log" 2>&1
grep -q '^RIP-LOADED' "$work/stdout.log" || { echo "rip.lua failed to load:"; grep -v "Uninitialized" "$work/stdout.log" | head; exit 1; }
grep -q '^RIPDONE' "$work/stdout.log" || { tail -5 "$work/stdout.log"; exit 1; }

python3 "$repo/tools/emulator/spc_build.py" "$work/track.spc" "$work/stdout.log"

# libgme's natural render is one loop + fade tail (~30-40 s) and -stream_loop
# hangs on the non-seekable gme stream; some tracks never signal end at all, so
# cap the render with -t. Two copies concat'd put the seam on the loop point,
# same as Godot's whole-file looping.
ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -t 40 -i "$work/track.spc" "$work/track.wav"
ffmpeg -y -hide_banner -loglevel error -i "$work/track.wav" -i "$work/track.wav" \
    -filter_complex "[0:a][1:a]concat=n=2:v=0:a=1" -c:a libvorbis -q:a 5 \
    "$repo/exports/data/bgm/$name.ogg"
echo "wrote $repo/exports/data/bgm/$name.ogg"

```

`tools/emulator/run.sh`:

```sh
#!/bin/bash
# Run MesenCE headless (-testRunner) against bokuno_jp.sfc with a Lua script.
# Usage: tools/emulator/run.sh <script.lua> [extra Mesen args...]
# The test runner kills the emu after --timeout SECONDS (default 100) and
# exits 255 (stop code -1); pass e.g. --timeout=3000 for long runs.
#
# SRAM GOTCHA (2026-11-17, corrected by titleprobe/titlecont rounds): MesenCE
# persists battery RAM to /tmp/mesence/Saves/bokuno_jp.srm ACROSS runs.
# With a save present:
#   - UNATTENDED boot (no presses at all): no title screen at all - the
#     game enters the story montage by itself at ~frame 6933 (song 2B at
#     6879, MAPLOAD 35/0000/00 at 6933) and loops 35->01->39->22->1A->24
#     forever. Any press before 6933 cancels this and shows the title.
#   - With presses: title menu appears (English: NEW GAME / CONTINUE,
#     cursor default NEW GAME - the old "default cursor is つづき" note was
#     wrong; walk7's "continue" was actually its input-dead unattended
#     boot). CONTINUE = cursor DOWN once, then A; it replays the intro
#     setup (character -> name -> destiny star on map 0x24) like a new
#     game. Delete the .srm for a cold boot; keep it to resume.
#
# INPUT GOTCHAS (both silently eat every press for the whole run):
#   1. Reading $4218/$4219 via emu.read(snesMemory) from the inputPolled
#      callback breaks emu.setInput from then on (titleprobe run2/run5
#      stalled on the setup UI; the identical script without the reads
#      worked). Never read the joypad register block in Lua.
#   2. A helper function defined BEFORE the `local` it references
#      captures the global (nil) and NAV-ERRORs every frame inside the
#      pcall - setInput is then skipped every frame (walk7loane.lua's
#      onSceneMap/wr ordering; walk7's whole 320k-frame run had dead
#      input). Keep helpers in dependency order and grep your log for
#      NAV-ERR before trusting a press schedule.
set -euo pipefail
script=$1
shift
exec /tmp/mesence/Mesen -testRunner "$script" \
    /home/newlix/projects/saga3/patches/bokuno_jp.sfc \
    -enableStdout "$@"

```

`tools/emulator/selsnap.lua`:

```lua
-- selsnap.lua - screenshot the engine's character-select screen while the
-- candidate figures are displayed (gender confirm, then a hold window
-- before the character confirm). MALE=1 confirms the default gender;
-- MALE=0 presses down first (female page).
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh <script> --timeout=300

local MALE = __MALE__

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
if MALE == 0 then
	PRESSES[7000] = { down = 1 }
	PRESSES[7060] = { a = 1 }
else
	PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
end
-- no character confirm: the screen holds with the figures on display

local frames = 0
local function wrv(a) return emu.read(a, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64(s)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		local chunk = s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))
		local t = {}
		for j = 1, #chunk do t[j] = chunk:byte(j) end
		for j = 1, #t, 3 do
			local k = t[j] * 65536 + (t[j + 1] or 0) * 256 + (t[j + 2] or 0)
			local c = { math.floor(k / 262144) % 64, math.floor(k / 4096) % 64,
				math.floor(k / 64) % 64, k % 64 }
			out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
				.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
		end
	end
	local rem = #s % 3
	if rem == 1 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "=" end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, s)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	if frames >= 7150 and frames <= 7790 and frames % 20 == 0 then
		print(string.format("SHOT frame=%d busy=%02X", frames, wrv(0x76)))
		dump("shot", emu.takeScreenshot())
	end
	if frames > 7900 then
		print("SELSNAP-DONE")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

print("SELSNAP MALE=" .. MALE)
flush_pad()
```

`tools/emulator/sfx2_field2.lua`:
