```lua
-- sfx2_field2.lua - field/scene SFX slice, second take (docs/sfx.md): the
-- full opening chain through battles 1-3 and the post-battle walk to
-- frame 64000, dumping PRE/POST/LATE SPC state for every sound packet id
-- that exports/data/sfx does not carry yet.
--
-- Input policy is the run6 producer verbatim
-- (/tmp/battlesfx-agent/battle_sfx_rip.lua, 2026-11-16): walk13 oam_walk
-- policy, battle mash with member 1's tech window at battle_start+700,
-- FIELD_SONG=36 battle detection (any non-field song arms battle mode).
-- run2 (sfx2_field.lua, repo battle_sfx_rip policy) diverged after battle 1
-- and missed battles 2-3; this script's policy is the one whose timeline is
-- known to reach them. Capture/logging additions do not touch input.
--
-- Skipped capture ids (already ripped or not sounds, docs/sfx.md decode):
-- 01 (driver task control), 03 (victory, BGM channel), 10 (menu blip).

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local FIELD_SONG = 36      -- opening forest BGM (jump table, map 0x249)
local VICTORY_SONG = 3     -- 勝利! (docs/music.md)
local WALK_FROM = 20800    -- walk13 policy start
local LAST_FRAME = 64000

local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local tech_done = false
local victory = false
local victory_frame = nil

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local b1 = bytes[i]
		local b2 = bytes[i + 1]
		local b3 = bytes[i + 2]
		local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
		local c = {
			math.floor(n / 262144) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64,
			n % 64,
		}
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

print("SFX2-LOADED")

-- packet assembly (sfx_dump.lua pattern): port writes arrive 3,2,1 then the
-- $2140 tag write completes the packet from the C6:0630 sender.
local port1, port2, port3 = nil, nil, nil

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end

-- flush helper: stdout is block-buffered under -testRunner redirection; a
-- 4 KiB pad print pushes every pending line out.
local function flush_pad()
	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

local function dump(name)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.spc)
	local kon = emu.read(0x4C, emu.memType.spcDspRegisters)
	print("DUMP" .. name .. "-BEGIN")
	print(string.format("RIPINFO target=%s hijack_frame=%d dump_frame=%d kon=%02X spcpc=%04X a=%02X x=%02X y=%02X ps=%02X sp=%02X",
		name, frames, frames, kon, st.pc, st.a, st.x, st.y, st.ps, st.sp))
	local ram = {}
	for i = 0, 0xFFFF do
		ram[#ram + 1] = emu.read(i, emu.memType.spcRam)
	end
	for i = 1, #ram, 900 * 3 do
		local chunk = {}
		for j = i, math.min(i + 900 * 3 - 1, #ram) do
			chunk[#chunk + 1] = ram[j]
		end
		print("SPCDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	local dsp = {}
	for i = 0, 0x7F do
		dsp[#dsp + 1] = emu.read(i, emu.memType.spcDspRegisters)
	end
	print("DSPDATA " .. b64encode(dsp))
	print("RIPDONE")
	print("DUMP" .. name .. "-END")
	flush_pad()
end

local SKIP_CAPTURE = { [0x01] = true, [0x03] = true, [0x10] = true }
local captured = {}
local post_q = {}   -- { { name=, frame=, late=bool }, ... }

-- Song dispatch detection: the BGM play writer C6:0A75 completes its packet
-- on the $2140 tag write; the id is the 92-entry track id (docs/music.md).
local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if frames >= 15000 then
		if id == VICTORY_SONG then
			if not victory then
				victory = true
				victory_frame = frames
				print(string.format("VICTORY frame=%d", frames))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif id ~= FIELD_SONG and id ~= 0 and not battle then
			battle = true
			battle_start = frames
			tech_done = false
			print(string.format("BATTLE-START frame=%d song=%d", frames, id))
			flush_pad()
		elseif id == FIELD_SONG and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
			battle = false
			print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d victory=%s", frames, tostring(victory)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local tag, st = pctag()
	if addr == 0x2143 then
		port3 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2142 then
		port2 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
		if frames >= 15000 and val ~= nil and st.k == 0xC6 and st.pc == 0x0625 then
			local skip = SKIP_CAPTURE[val] and port3 == 4
			if not skip and not captured[tostring(port3) .. ":" .. val] then
				captured[tostring(port3) .. ":" .. val] = true
				local nm = string.format("e%02X", val)
				post_q[#post_q + 1] = { name = nm, frame = frames }
				post_q[#post_q + 1] = { name = nm, frame = frames, late = true }
				print(string.format("CAPTURE frame=%d id=%02X a3=%s name=%s", frames, val, tostring(port3), nm))
				local ok, err = pcall(dump, nm .. "_PRE")
				if not ok then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err)) end
			end
		end
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		if st.pc == 0x0630 and st.k == 0xC6 and frames >= 20000 then
			print(string.format("MSG frame=%d tag=%02X id=%02X a2=%s a3=%s",
				frames, val, port1, tostring(port2), tostring(port3)))
		end
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1, port2, port3 = nil, nil, nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local busy_now = false
local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

local function tech_input(bt)
	-- member 1 command window: cursor starts on 攻撃; down down = 技 row,
	-- A opens the tech list, A confirms the first tech (バックスタッブ)
	if bt >= 700 and bt < 706 then return { down = 1 } end
	if bt >= 712 and bt < 718 then return { down = 1 } end
	if bt == 730 or bt == 790 then return { a = 1 } end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			local ti = (not tech_done) and tech_input(bt) or nil
			if bt > 800 and not tech_done then tech_done = true end
			if ti ~= nil then
				p = ti
			elseif frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - WALK_FROM
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	busy_now = busy
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

local last_vm = nil
local last_map = nil
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local flag = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_lo = emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_hi = emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_bk = emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_lo = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_hi = emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local vm = string.format("%02X %02X%02X%02X %04X", flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo)
		if vm ~= last_vm then
			print(string.format("VM frame=%d 76=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X D51B=%04X",
				frames, flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo))
			last_vm = vm
		end
		local map = emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
			+ emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		if map ~= last_map then
			print(string.format("MAP frame=%d id=%04X", frames, map))
			last_map = map
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames % 200 == 0 then
			print(string.format("COUNT frame=%d battle=%s song=%s", frames, tostring(battle), tostring(last_bgm)))
		end
		for i = #post_q, 1, -1 do
			local q = post_q[i]
			local due = q.frame + (q.late and 30 or 1)
			if frames >= due then
				table.remove(post_q, i)
				local tag2 = q.late and "_LATE" or "_POST"
				local ok2, err2 = pcall(dump, q.name .. tag2)
				if not ok2 then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err2)) end
			end
		end
		if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("SFX2-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/sfx3_bankcell.lua`:

```lua
-- sfx3_bankcell.lua - runtime state of the SPC bank-table cells at play
-- time (docs/sfx.md open item: the word[$F160] + track*word[$F168] lookup
-- guarded by $F164 != 0).
--
-- Static decode found three things the doc's reading does not show:
--   - the play-tail lookup at SPC $0C24 multiplies the ARMED SLOT VALUE
--     $F164, not the play-packet id: address = word[$F160] +
--     $F164 * word[$F168] (two MUL YA). The player tick at $15B8 keeps
--     this invariant (decrement $F164, add $F168/$F169 to $F160/$F161),
--     so the product is the END of the armed region; at play time it is
--     a validity probe only - a zero high byte clears $F164/$F161
--     (disarm). The play packet id lands in $BD and never enters it.
--   - effects (tags 18-1B) run $0DA3/$0DAB/$0DB3/$0DBB, which read
--     per-voice sequence pointers from the ARAM table at $3100, indexed
--     id*4 - no slot lookup at all.
--   - the $1781 dispatch table is indexed by tag&0F across tags 10-1F:
--     tags 10-17 echo first ($0D06 via the $17A1 table) then run the
--     play handlers $0BFB/$0C03/$0BF8/$0C00 (the tail); tags 18-1F run
--     their handler directly.
-- This script logs the slot cells and the $3100 table entries at play
-- time so the static reading can be checked against runtime values.
--
-- Input: the walk13 PRESSES boot only. Logs BANKCELL lines 2 frames after
-- the first tag-10 BGM play packet and the first tag-18 effect packet
-- (the SPC dequeue task runs within a frame of the tag write).

local frames = 0
local done = false
local LAST_FRAME = 26000

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

print("BANKCELL-LOADED")

local port1 = nil
local pending = {}

local function spc(addr)
	return emu.read(addr, emu.memType.spcRam)
end

local function log_bankcell(kind, id)
	local base = spc(0xF160) + spc(0xF161) * 256
	local stride = spc(0xF168) + spc(0xF169) * 256
	local armed = spc(0xF164)
	local slot2 = spc(0xF166)
	local bd = spc(0xBD)
	local probe = (base + armed * stride) % 65536
	print(string.format(
		"BANKCELL kind=%s id=%02X bd=%02X f160=%04X f164=%02X f166=%02X stride=%04X probe=%04X t_lo=%02X%02X t_hi=%02X%02X",
		kind, id, bd, base, armed, slot2, stride, probe,
		spc(0x3100 + id * 4), spc(0x3101 + id * 4),
		spc(0x3102 + id * 4), spc(0x3103 + id * 4)))
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	if addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		if st.k == 0xC6 and st.pc == 0x0A75 then
			print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%02X", frames, port1))
			if not pending.bgm then
				pending.bgm = frames + 2
				pending.bgm_id = port1
			end
		elseif st.k == 0xC6 and st.pc == 0x0630 and (val == 0x18 or val == 0x19) then
			print(string.format("SND frame=%d tag=%02X id=%02X", frames, val, port1))
			if not pending.snd then
				pending.snd = frames + 2
				pending.snd_id = port1
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	if pending.bgm and frames >= pending.bgm then
		log_bankcell("bgm", pending.bgm_id)
		pending.bgm = nil
	end
	if pending.snd and frames >= pending.snd then
		log_bankcell("snd", pending.snd_id)
		pending.snd = nil
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("BANKCELL-DONE frames=" .. frames)
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

```

```lua
-- sfx3_maptrans.lua - map-transition SFX slice (docs/sfx.md open item):
-- walk the party out of the opening map into map 0x250 and log every
-- sound packet across the transition, dumping PRE/POST/LATE SPC state
-- for sound ids exports/data/sfx does not carry yet.
--
-- Input policy is water_sweep.lua verbatim (journey2 session, the run
-- proven to cross into map 0x250 at ~frame 35300 of its timeline - see
-- its sweep.log): walk13 PRESSES; 20800-34000 busy-gated A + down/right
-- 900-frame legs; 34000-35200 idle; from 35200 (ST0_FRAME) busy-gated A +
-- alternating 900-frame up / 1000-frame left legs. Route history in this
-- slice: down/right alone never crosses (run4, 13600 walk legs, no
-- transition - the exit is the VM story gate north of the park);
-- up/left from spawn hits the intro battle position check instead
-- (run5: BGM id 1 at 29371, then a stalled battle - battle menus need
-- the unconditional mash this policy does not give); battles first
-- (run3, run6 producer + victory-3/song-33 release) then down/right
-- resumed walking but never left 0x249. The sweep order - park wander
-- first, north exit second - is the crossing that works.
--

-- DSP regs; PRE at the tag write, POST +1 frame, LATE +30 frames).
-- Skipped capture ids: everything exports/data/sfx already carries

		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end

	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

	print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
end

print("SFX3-LOADED")

	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local tag, st = pctag()
	if addr == 0x2143 then
		port3 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2142 then
		port2 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		if st.pc == 0x0630 and st.k == 0xC6 and frames >= 15000 then
			print(string.format("MSG frame=%d tag=%02X id=%02X a2=%s a3=%s",
				frames, val, port1, tostring(port2), tostring(port3)))

			-- bank 10/20 play); driver-control tags (80/82/8E/F2) log but
			-- never dump.
			if (val == 0x18 or val == 0x19) and frames >= 15000 then
				local skip = SKIP_CAPTURE[port1]
				if not skip and not captured[port1] then
					captured[port1] = true
					local nm = string.format("e%02X", port1)
					post_q[#post_q + 1] = { name = nm, frame = frames }
					post_q[#post_q + 1] = { name = nm, frame = frames, late = true }
					print(string.format("CAPTURE frame=%d id=%02X a2=%s a3=%s name=%s",
						frames, port1, tostring(port2), tostring(port3), nm))
					local ok, err = pcall(dump, nm .. "_PRE")
					if not ok then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err)) end
				end
			end
		end
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1, port2, port3 = nil, nil, nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if frames < ST0_FRAME then
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < WALK_END then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			else
				local t = frames - WALK_FROM
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					local prog = { "down", "right" }
					p = { [prog[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	else
		if p == nil then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			else
				local t = frames - ST0_FRAME
				if t % 2000 < 900 then
					p = { up = 1 }
				elseif t % 2000 < 1900 then
					p = { left = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

local last_map = nil
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local map = emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256
			+ emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		if map ~= last_map then
			print(string.format("MAP frame=%d id=%04X", frames, map))
			last_map = map
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames % 200 == 0 then
			print(string.format("COUNT frame=%d song=%s", frames, tostring(last_bgm)))
		end
		for i = #post_q, 1, -1 do
			local q = post_q[i]
			local due = q.frame + (q.late and 30 or 1)
			if frames >= due then
				table.remove(post_q, i)
				local tag2 = q.late and "_LATE" or "_POST"
				local ok2, err2 = pcall(dump, q.name .. tag2)
				if not ok2 then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err2)) end
			end
		end
		if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print("SFX3-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/sfx_dump.lua`:

```lua
-- sfx_dump.lua: SFX rip PoC (docs/sfx.md) - capture the menu confirm beep as
-- mid-play .spc dumps and prove they render through libgme.
--
-- Built ON TOP of the verified sfx_trace.lua skeleton: a watcher script
-- written from scratch (all-passive callbacks) ran on a shifted timeline -
-- see docs/sfx.md, "dead ends". This script keeps the trace skeleton's
-- callback set and adds:
--   PRE  - dumped at the $2141 write of the first UI-sound packet (id 01,
--          from frame 5000 on), before the SPC sees the request
--   POST - dumped one frame after the packet tag write (beep keyed)
--   LATE - dumped 45 frames later (beep over, BGM continues)
-- Markers DUMP<name>-BEGIN/END delimit rip.lua-compatible dumps; verify via
-- tools/emulator/spc_build.py + ffmpeg (see docs/sfx.md PoC section).
-- Verification result 2026-11-16: POST carries +5..9 dB of 2-8 kHz energy
-- over PRE and returns to baseline by LATE - the effect is in the dump.
-- The script keeps SONG/CMD/VM lines for context; stops after LATE.

local frames = 0
local done = false

local presses = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do presses[f] = { start = 1 } end
presses[7000] = { a = 1 }
presses[7800] = { a = 1 }
presses[8600] = { start = 1 }
presses[9000] = { a = 1 }
presses[9800] = { a = 1 }
presses[10600] = { a = 1 }

print("SFX-LOADED")

-- dump machinery (docs/sfx.md PoC): PRE inside the beep packet (id 01 at the
-- $2141 write, before the SPC sees the request), POST at packet+1 frame (beep
-- keyed), LATE at packet+45 (beep over). Markers delimit rip.lua-compatible
-- dumps for spc_build.py.
local trigger = nil
local dumped_pre, dumped_post, dumped_late = false, false, false
local port1, port2, port3 = nil, nil, nil

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local b1 = bytes[i]
		local b2 = bytes[i + 1]
		local b3 = bytes[i + 2]
		local n = b1 * 65536 + (b2 or 0) * 256 + (b3 or 0)
		local c = {
			math.floor(n / 262144) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64,
			n % 64,
		}
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.spc)
	local kon = emu.read(0x4C, emu.memType.spcDspRegisters)
	print("DUMP" .. name .. "-BEGIN")
	print(string.format("RIPINFO target=%s hijack_frame=%d dump_frame=%d kon=%02X spcpc=%04X a=%02X x=%02X y=%02X ps=%02X sp=%02X",
		name, frames, frames, kon, st.pc, st.a, st.x, st.y, st.ps, st.sp))
	local ram = {}
	for i = 0, 0xFFFF do
		ram[#ram + 1] = emu.read(i, emu.memType.spcRam)
	end
	for i = 1, #ram, 900 * 3 do
		local chunk = {}
		for j = i, math.min(i + 900 * 3 - 1, #ram) do
			chunk[#chunk + 1] = ram[j]
		end
		print("SPCDATA " .. b64encode(chunk))
	end
	local dsp = {}
	for i = 0, 0x7F do
		dsp[#dsp + 1] = emu.read(i, emu.memType.spcDspRegisters)
	end
	print("DSPDATA " .. b64encode(dsp))
	print("RIPDONE")
	print("DUMP" .. name .. "-END")
end

local cmd2140 = 0
local cmd2141 = 0
local cmd2142 = 0
local cmd2143 = 0

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local tag, st = pctag()
	if addr == 0x2143 then
		port3 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2142 then
		port2 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
		if not dumped_pre and frames >= 5000 and st.pc == 0x0625 and st.k == 0xC6 and val == 0x01 then
			dumped_pre = true
			print(string.format("PRE-TRIGGER frame=%d", frames))
			local ok, err = pcall(dump, "PRE")
			if not ok then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err)) end
		end
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		if st.pc == 0x0630 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			print(string.format("MSG frame=%d tag=%02X id=%02X a2=%s a3=%s",
				frames, val, port1, tostring(port2), tostring(port3)))
			if trigger == nil and val == 0xF2 then
				trigger = frames
			end
		end
		port1, port2, port3 = nil, nil, nil
	end
	if addr == 0x2140 then
		cmd2140 = cmd2140 + 1
		if frames >= 500 then
			print(string.format("CMD frame=%d port=2140 val=%02X at %s A=%04X X=%04X Y=%04X",
				frames, val, tag, st.a, st.x, st.y))
		end
	elseif addr == 0x2141 then
		cmd2141 = cmd2141 + 1
		if frames >= 500 then
			print(string.format("CMD frame=%d port=2141 val=%02X at %s", frames, val, tag))
		end
	elseif addr == 0x2142 then
		cmd2142 = cmd2142 + 1
		if frames >= 500 then
			print(string.format("CMD frame=%d port=2142 val=%02X at %s", frames, val, tag))
		end
	else
		cmd2143 = cmd2143 + 1
		if frames >= 500 then
			print(string.format("CMD frame=%d port=2143 val=%02X at %s", frames, val, tag))
		end
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- Song dispatcher marker (same hook as trace_events.lua).
local last_song = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	local a = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes).a
	local song = math.floor(a / 3)
	if song ~= last_song then
		last_song = song
		print(string.format("SONG frame=%d id=%d", frames, song))
	end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x5E191B, 0x5E191B, emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	emu.setInput(presses[frames] or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

local last_vm = nil
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local flag = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_lo = emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_hi = emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_bk = emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_lo = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_hi = emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local vm = string.format("%02X %02X%02X%02X %04X", flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo)
		if vm ~= last_vm then
			print(string.format("VM frame=%d 76=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X D51B=%04X",
				frames, flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo))
			last_vm = vm
		end
		if frames % 1000 == 0 then
			print(string.format("COUNT frame=%d c2140=%d c2141=%d c2142=%d c2143=%d",
				frames, cmd2140, cmd2141, cmd2142, cmd2143))
		end
		if trigger ~= nil and not dumped_post and frames >= trigger + 1 then
			dumped_post = true
			local ok, err = pcall(dump, "POST")
			if not ok then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err)) end
		end
		if dumped_post and not dumped_late and frames >= trigger + 45 then
			dumped_late = true
			local ok, err = pcall(dump, "LATE")
			if not ok then print("DUMP-ERR " .. tostring(err)) end
			print("SFX5-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		if frames >= 14500 and not done then
			done = true
			print(string.format("SUMMARY c2140=%d c2141=%d c2142=%d c2143=%d",
				cmd2140, cmd2141, cmd2142, cmd2143))
			print("SFX2-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/shot_ascii.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Render an oam_walk.lua screenshot dump (SNES 256x224 PNG reassembled by
oam_reassemble.py) as coarse ASCII, for eyeballing what the headless run
had on screen without reading the PNG.

Usage: shot_ascii.py <cap_<frame>_shot.bin> [downscale]
"""
import struct
import sys
import zlib

data = open(sys.argv[1], "rb").read()
down = int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv) > 2 else 4

assert data[:8] == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", "not a PNG"
pos = 8
w = h = 0
bpp = 4
idat = b""
while pos < len(data):
    ln = struct.unpack(">I", data[pos:pos + 4])[0]
    typ = data[pos + 4:pos + 8]
    body = data[pos + 8:pos + 8 + ln]
    if typ == b"IHDR":
        w, h, depth, ctype = struct.unpack(">IIBB", body[:10])
        assert depth == 8, f"depth {depth}"
        bpp = {0: 1, 2: 3, 4: 2, 6: 4}[ctype]
    elif typ == b"IDAT":
        idat += body
    pos += 12 + ln

raw = zlib.decompress(idat)
stride = w * bpp
px = bytearray(w * h * bpp)
prev = bytearray(stride)
o = 0
for y in range(h):
    f = raw[o]
    o += 1
    line = bytearray(raw[o:o + stride])
    o += stride
    if f == 1:
        for i in range(bpp, stride):
            line[i] = (line[i] + line[i - bpp]) & 0xFF
    elif f == 2:
        for i in range(stride):
            line[i] = (line[i] + prev[i]) & 0xFF
    elif f == 3:
        for i in range(stride):
            a = line[i - bpp] if i >= bpp else 0
            line[i] = (line[i] + ((a + prev[i]) >> 1)) & 0xFF
    elif f == 4:
        for i in range(stride):
            a = line[i - bpp] if i >= bpp else 0
            b = prev[i]
            c = prev[i - bpp] if i >= bpp else 0
            p = a + b - c
            pa, pb, pc = abs(p - a), abs(p - b), abs(p - c)
            pr = a if (pa <= pb and pa <= pc) else (b if pb <= pc else c)
            line[i] = (line[i] + pr) & 0xFF
    px[y * stride:(y + 1) * stride] = line
    prev = line

print(f"{w}x{h} bpp={bpp}")
CH = " .:-=+*#%@"
for y in range(0, h, down):
    row = []
    for x in range(0, w, down):
        i = (y * w + x) * bpp
        r, g, b = px[i], px[i + 1], px[i + 2]
        lum = (r * 30 + g * 59 + b * 11) // 100
        row.append(CH[min(lum * 10 // 256, 9)])
    print("".join(row))

```

`tools/emulator/shot_d2e3_probe.lua`:

```lua
-- shot_d2e3_probe.lua - find where the engine reads the object-config
-- byte it stores into $D2E3 before JSL $FF0668 (C0/3D32-3D36).
--
-- Attaches a write watch on WRAM $D2E3 (raw offset form, verified in
-- docs/parity.md section 11); on each write captures the CPU state
-- (PC, Y, direct page) and dumps 96 bytes at the direct-page pointer
-- $B7/$B8/$B9 plus a window around PC, so the source of the byte can be
-- identified statically afterwards.
--
-- Input policy: oam_walk.lua walk13 verbatim to reach map 0x249.

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false
local writes = 0

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, s)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

print("D2E3-PROBE-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

local function onD2E3()
	if writes >= 8 then
		return
	end
	writes = writes + 1
	local st
	if emu.getCpuState ~= nil then
		st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	else
		st = emu.getCpuState()
	end
	local pc = (st.k or 0) * 65536 + (st.pc or 0)
	local y = st.y or 0
	local b7 = emu.read(0xB7, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local b8 = emu.read(0xB8, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local b9 = emu.read(0xB9, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local ptr = b7 + b8 * 256 + b9 * 65536
	print(string.format("D2E3WRITE #%d frame=%d val=%02X pc=%02X:%04X y=%04X dpB7=%02X%02X%02X a=%04X x=%04X db=%02X",
		writes, frames, emu.read(0xD2E3, emu.memType.snesWorkRam),
		(st.k or 0), st.pc or 0, y, b9, b8, b7,
		st.a or 0, st.x or 0, st.dbr or 0))
	-- dump 96 bytes at the [$B7]+y-16 region and a window around PC
	local bytes = {}
	local base = ptr + ((y or 0) & 0xFFFF) - 16
	for i = 0, 95 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(emu.read((base + i) & 0x1FFFF, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	end
	dump(string.format("ptr_%d", writes), table.concat(bytes))
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function() onD2E3() end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD2E3, 0xD2E3, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames >= 40000 and not done then
		done = true
		print("D2E3-PROBE-DONE writes=" .. writes)
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

```lua
-- shot_jumptable.lua - dump direct-page $7E-$90 (the layer record op
-- jump table, filled by the engine at runtime) at several frames during
-- the opening boot. Input: walk13 presses through frame 11000.
local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
```

`tools/emulator/shot_maprender.lua`:

```lua
-- shot_maprender.lua - ground-truth capture for the submap renderer:
-- play the opening to free walking on map 0x249 (opening village), then
-- stand still and take full-frame PNG screenshots for pixel comparison
-- against internal/mapfmt's render.
--
-- Input policy is oam_walk.lua's walk13 verbatim (START mash 300-6800,
-- the confirm presses at 7000..10600, then from 20800: while $76!=0 press
-- A every 30 frames, while idle hold down/right 900 frames each), with
-- input stopping at 34000 so the party stands still for the shots.
--
-- Output: STATE lines with the map id (raw WRAM 0x2011/0x2012, verified
-- in pidoam_journey3.lua) and base64 PNG dumps named shot, every 2000
-- frames from 34000 to 46000. Reassemble with
-- tools/emulator/oam_reassemble.py; shot dumps become cap_<frame>_shot.bin
-- (PNG bytes; rename to .png).

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }
local SHOT_EVERY = 2000
local SHOT_FROM = 34000
local SHOT_TO = 46000

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm weapon
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats

local frames = 0
local done = false

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, s)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function mapid()
	return emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

print("SHOT-MAPRENDER-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames >= SHOT_FROM and frames <= SHOT_TO and frames % SHOT_EVERY == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X", frames,
			emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam), mapid()))
		dump("shot", emu.takeScreenshot())
		print("SHOT-DUMP frame=" .. frames)
	end
	if frames > SHOT_TO and not done then
		done = true
		print("SHOT-MAPRENDER-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/shot_wramdump.lua`:

```lua
-- shot_wramdump.lua - dump WRAM object tables on map 0x249 as ground truth
-- for the submap object-stream decoder (internal/mapfmt/objects.go).
--
-- The engine's object decompressor (FF/0E44) writes chip entries as
-- 3-byte records (chip lo / palette byte / pos x|y<<4) into an array
-- based at $7E:2400 (X-indexed) and per-object start/end offsets into a
-- descriptor array based at $7E:2000 (X stored at ($96),Y=0, end at
-- ($96)+0x1FE). Dumping $7E:2000-$7E:10000 captures both.
--
-- Input policy: oam_walk.lua walk13 verbatim (reaches free walking on
-- map 0x249 by ~frame 30000). Dumps once at 36000 and 42000, standing
-- still. Reassemble with tools/emulator/oam_reassemble.py.

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }
local DUMPS = { 36000, 42000 }

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false
local dumped = {}

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, s)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function mapid()
	return emu.read(0x2011, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) * 256 + emu.read(0x2012, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

print("SHOT-WRAMDUMP-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	for _, f in ipairs(DUMPS) do
		if frames == f and not dumped[f] then
			dumped[f] = true
			print(string.format("STATE frame=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X", frames,
				emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam), mapid()))
			local bytes = {}
			for i = 0x2000, 0xFFFF do
				bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
			end
			dump("wram", table.concat(bytes))
			print("WRAMDUMP frame=" .. frames)
		end
	end
	if frames > 44000 and not done then
		done = true
		print("SHOT-WRAMDUMP-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/sp_dma.lua`:

```lua
-- sp_dma.lua - locate the OAM shadow buffer behind the DMA upload.
--
-- Findings this builds on (2026-11-17, docs/sprites.md): frame-end OAM
-- (startFrame dumps) contains the wandering NPC strips (tiles 12/28/44
-- moving 1 px/frame in step with the leader's down leg, map 0x250 camera
-- window (2,36) verified by dumpmaps compare 100%) but NOT the party
-- figure the screenshot shows at screen (80,208). So the party's OAM
-- entries come from a buffer the CPU maintains in WRAM and DMA-uploads
-- (zero snesSpriteRam CPU writes: run3's write watch fired nothing).
--
-- This probe prints the DMA register state at startFrame (channels 0-7:
-- control $430x+1, source $430x+2..4) so the OAM channel's source address
-- falls out, plus one full WRAM dump during the walking window for the
-- shadow search, plus the same dense OAM/aw captures as sp_probe.
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/sp_dma.lua -timeout=3000

local END_FRAME = 37400
local CAP_START = 30000
local DENSE_LO = 35880
local DENSE_HI = 37200
local LEG_HOLD = 900
local IDLE_HOLD = 3600

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local legDir = nil
local legStart = 0

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end
local function mem(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesMemory) end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_shot()
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND shot")
end

print("SP-DMA-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames >= CAP_START and p == nil and not battle then
		local held = frames - legStart
		local limit = (legDir == nil) and IDLE_HOLD or LEG_HOLD
		if held >= limit then
			legStart = frames
			if legDir == nil then legDir = "down"
			elseif legDir == "down" then legDir = "right"
			else legDir = nil end
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("LEG frame=%d dir=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s",
				frames, legDir or "idle", lx, ly, tostring(busy)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif legDir then
			p = { [legDir] = 1 }
		end
	elseif battle and frames >= CAP_START then
		local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
		if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames < CAP_START then return end
	local dense = frames >= DENSE_LO and frames <= DENSE_HI
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0

	-- DMA register state every 32 frames (and every dense frame at the
	-- start of the dense window): channels 0-7, control + source address
	if dense or frames % 32 == 0 then
		local parts = {}
		for ch = 0, 7 do
			local b = 0x4300 + ch * 0x10
			local ctrl = mem(b + 1)
			if ctrl ~= 0 then
				local src = mem(b + 2) + mem(b + 3) * 256 + mem(b + 4) * 65536
				local dst = mem(b + 5) + mem(b + 6) * 256
				local cnt = mem(b + 7) + mem(b + 8) * 256
				parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X %06X->%04X n%d", ch, ctrl, src, dst, cnt)
			end
		end
		print(string.format("DMA frame=%d %s", frames, table.concat(parts, "  ")))
		flush_pad()
	end

	if dense and frames % 4 == 0 then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d leg=%s busy=%d battle=%d cfg=%02X px=%d py=%d",
			frames, legDir or "idle", busy and 1 or 0, battle and 1 or 0, wr(0xD2E3), lx, ly))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 8 == 0 then
		dump_bytes("aw", function(i) return wr(0xD9A8 + i) end, 0x458)
	end
	if frames == 36800 or frames == 37200 then
		-- full WRAM: $7E0000-$7FFFFF in 64 KB banks
		dump_bytes("wram7e", function(i) return wr(i) end, 0x10000)
		dump_bytes("wram7f", function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x10000)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_shot()
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 400 == 0 then
		dump_shot()
	end
	if frames % 400 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	local stop = frames >= END_FRAME
	if stop then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d px=%d py=%d", frames, lx, ly))
		print("SP-DMA-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-DUMP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

```

```lua
local inWindow = false
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	local f = frames
	local w = (f >= 35920 and f <= 35990) or (f >= 36760 and f <= 36840)
	if w and not inWindow then
		inWindow = true
		print("WINDOW-START frame=" .. f)
	elseif not w and inWindow then
		inWindow = false
		print("WINDOW-END frame=" .. f)
		flush_pad()
	end
	if not w then return end
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local lx, ly = leader()
	print(string.format("STATE frame=%d leg=%s busy=%d battle=%d cfg=%02X px=%d py=%d",
		f, legDir or "idle", busy and 1 or 0, battle and 1 or 0, wr(0xD2E3), lx, ly))
	dump_shot()
	dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
	dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
	dump_bytes("aw", function(i) return wr(0xD9A8 + i) end, 0x458)
	dump_bytes("stage", function(i) return wr(0x6E00 + i) end, 0x800)
	if f % 4 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	local stop = f >= END_FRAME
	if stop then
		local lx2, ly2 = leader()
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d px=%d py=%d", f, lx2, ly2))
		print("SP-POSE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-DUMP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/sp_probe.lua`:

```lua
-- sp_probe.lua - OAM write-timing probe for the walk-animation frame grid.
--
-- Finding this builds on (docs/sprites.md, 2026-11-17): startFrame OAM
-- dumps in the FIELD show only junk rows + a few leftover entries, while
-- the screenshots show the party figure - the field engine rewrites OAM
-- mid-frame (tree-canopy sprite multiplexing is the likely reason: the
-- forest screen carries far more sprites than the 128 OAM slots). This
-- probe measures the rewrite and samples OAM densely inside the
-- verified walking window (leader walks down 35933-37000, run1/run2
-- deterministic) so the leader's strip entries are caught whatever the
-- write phase.
--
-- Timeline = sp_walk.lua's exact input program (intro presses + down/
-- right/idle legs). Dumps:
--   STATE + oam every 4 frames inside DENSE_LO..DENSE_HI, every 64 frames
--   outside; aw (actor array) every 8; vram every 1000, cgram at 36000,
--   screenshot every 400; per-frame OAM-write count + offset histogram.
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/sp_probe.lua -timeout=3000

local END_FRAME = 38000
local CAP_START = 30000
local DENSE_LO = 35880
local DENSE_HI = 37200
local LEG_HOLD = 900
local IDLE_HOLD = 3600

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local legDir = nil
local legStart = 0
local writeN = 0          -- OAM writes this frame
local writeMin, writeMax = -1, -1
local writeLo = nil       -- frame number the writes belong to

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_shot()
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND shot")
end

print("SP-PROBE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

-- OAM write watch: snesSpriteRam writes = the game's OAM updates
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	writeN = writeN + 1
	local o = addr
	if writeMin == -1 or o < writeMin then writeMin = o end
	if o > writeMax then writeMax = o end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x0000, 0x543, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam)

-- input (byte-exact sp_walk.lua inputPolled program)
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	-- report the previous frame's write histogram
	if writeLo ~= nil and writeN > 0 then
		print(string.format("OAMW frame=%d n=%d off=%03X..%03X", writeLo, writeN, writeMin, writeMax))
		writeN, writeMin, writeMax = 0, -1, -1
		writeLo = nil
	end
	writeLo = frames
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames >= CAP_START and p == nil and not battle then
		local held = frames - legStart
		local limit = (legDir == nil) and IDLE_HOLD or LEG_HOLD
		if held >= limit then
			legStart = frames
			if legDir == nil then legDir = "down"
			elseif legDir == "down" then legDir = "right"
			else legDir = nil end
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("LEG frame=%d dir=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s",
				frames, legDir or "idle", lx, ly, tostring(busy)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif legDir then
			p = { [legDir] = 1 }
		end
	elseif battle and frames >= CAP_START then
		local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
		if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

-- dumps at startFrame (the counter and leg state are one inputPolled ahead;
-- the label matches the frame whose OAM the previous frame wrote)
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames < CAP_START then return end
	local dense = frames >= DENSE_LO and frames <= DENSE_HI
	local oamMod = dense and 4 or 64
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames % oamMod == 0 then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d leg=%s busy=%d battle=%d cfg=%02X px=%d py=%d dense=%d",
			frames, legDir or "idle", busy and 1 or 0, battle and 1 or 0, wr(0xD2E3), lx, ly, dense and 1 or 0))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 8 == 0 then
		dump_bytes("aw", function(i) return wr(0xD9A8 + i) end, 0x458)
	end
	if frames % 1000 == 0 then
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
	end
	if frames == 36000 then
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
	end
	if frames % 400 == 0 then
		dump_shot()
	end
	if frames % 200 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	local stop = frames >= END_FRAME
	if stop then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d px=%d py=%d", frames, lx, ly))
		print("SP-PROBE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-DUMP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

```

`tools/emulator/sp_shadow.lua`:

```lua
-- sp_shadow.lua - per-frame OAM-shadow capture for the walk frame grid.
--
-- Established by the preceding probes (2026-11-17, docs/sprites.md):
--   * the field engine DMA-uploads OAM from TWO channels, both targeting
--     $2104 (run4's DMA lines: ch0 src $7E:2220, ch6 src $7E:AF20); the
--     second overwrites the first, so the party's entries never survive
--     in frame-end OAM on the road map while wandering NPCs do;
--   * a scene-dependent full OAM shadow sits at $7E:AD00 (run4 WRAM dump:
--     frame-end OAM bytes found verbatim at $7E:AD00);
--   * the input program below is sp_walk.lua's, whose verified timeline
--     (runs 1/2) walks the leader down on map 0x250 between frames
--     35933-36819 (1 px/frame) with the party at screen (80,208).
--
-- Dense window DENSE_LO..DENSE_HI: every frame dumps STATE, frame-end
-- OAM, and the three shadow candidates $7E:AD00 / $7E:2220 / $7E:AF20
-- (544 B each) plus the DMA register line; outside it, every 16 frames.
-- Full $7E/$7F bank dumps at 36000 and 36800 give the staging buffers.
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/sp_shadow.lua -timeout=3000

local END_FRAME = 37400
local CAP_START = 20800
local DENSE_LO = 35880
local DENSE_HI = 37200

local IDLE_HOLD = 3600

PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }

PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }

PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end
local function mem(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesMemory) end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)

	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end

end

local function dump_shot()
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND shot")
end

print("SP-SHADOW-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames >= CAP_START and p == nil and not battle then
		local held = frames - legStart
		local limit = (legDir == nil) and IDLE_HOLD or LEG_HOLD
		if held >= limit then
			legStart = frames
			if legDir == nil then legDir = "down"
			elseif legDir == "down" then legDir = "right"
			else legDir = nil end
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("LEG frame=%d dir=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s",
				frames, legDir or "idle", lx, ly, tostring(busy)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif legDir then
			p = { [legDir] = 1 }
		end
	elseif battle and frames >= CAP_START then
		local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
		if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames < CAP_START then return end
	local dense = frames >= DENSE_LO and frames <= DENSE_HI
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0

	if dense or frames % 16 == 0 then
		local parts = {}
		for ch = 0, 7 do
			local b = 0x4300 + ch * 0x10
			local dst = mem(b + 1)
			if dst ~= 0xFF then
				local src = mem(b + 2) + mem(b + 3) * 256 + mem(b + 4) * 65536
				parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X->%04X %06X", ch, mem(b), dst, src)
			end
		end
		print(string.format("DMA frame=%d %s", frames, table.concat(parts, "  ")))
	end

	if dense or frames % 16 == 0 then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d leg=%s busy=%d battle=%d cfg=%02X px=%d py=%d dense=%d",
			frames, legDir or "idle", busy and 1 or 0, battle and 1 or 0, wr(0xD2E3), lx, ly, dense and 1 or 0))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("sh_ad00", function(i) return wr(0xAD00 + i) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("sh_2220", function(i) return wr(0x2220 + i) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("sh_af20", function(i) return wr(0xAF20 + i) end, 544)
		if frames % 4 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end
	if frames % 8 == 0 then
		dump_bytes("aw", function(i) return wr(0xD9A8 + i) end, 0x458)
	end
	if frames == 36000 or frames == 36800 or frames == 37200 then
		dump_bytes("wram7e", function(i) return wr(i) end, 0x10000)
		dump_bytes("wram7f", function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x10000)
		dump_shot()
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 400 == 0 then
		dump_shot()
		flush_pad()
	end
	local stop = frames >= END_FRAME
	if stop then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d px=%d py=%d", frames, lx, ly))
		print("SP-SHADOW-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-DUMP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/sp_stage.lua`:

```lua
-- Dense window DENSE_LO..DENSE_HI: every frame dumps the staging buffer
-- $7E6E00-$7E75FF (64 tiles: base tile + the 16-tile-stride rows of a
-- 16x24 figure plus neighbours), frame-end OAM, the actor-array window,
-- STATE and the DMA register line. VRAM full dumps at four instants;
-- cgram at 36000; screenshots every 200 frames.
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/sp_stage.lua -timeout=3000
--
-- Established by the preceding probes (2026-11-17, docs/sprites.md):
--   * DMA channel 7 streams VRAM from the WRAM staging buffer $7E:6E00
--     (ch2 streams from $7EE2D6); run5's WRAM dump shows the leader's
--     FULL composed 16x24 figure staged there as 8x8 tiles in SNES-native
--     order, 2 tiles per 16-px row - the compositing of the filmstrip
--     bands happens here, in WRAM, byte-verifiable;
--   * the frame-end OAM ($7E:AD00 shadow, byte-equal to OAM) only carries
--     the wandering small actors; the party's entries are transient and

			else legDir = nil end
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("LEG frame=%d dir=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s",
				frames, legDir or "idle", lx, ly, tostring(busy)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif legDir then
			p = { [legDir] = 1 }
		end
	elseif battle and frames >= CAP_START then
		local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
		if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames < CAP_START then return end
	local dense = frames >= DENSE_LO and frames <= DENSE_HI
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0

	if dense or frames % 16 == 0 then
		local parts = {}
		for ch = 0, 7 do
			local b = 0x4300 + ch * 0x10
			local dst = mem(b + 1)
			if dst ~= 0xFF then
				local src = mem(b + 2) + mem(b + 3) * 256 + mem(b + 4) * 65536
				parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X->%04X %06X", ch, mem(b), dst, src)
			end
		end
		print(string.format("DMA frame=%d %s", frames, table.concat(parts, "  ")))
	end

	if dense or frames % 16 == 0 then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d leg=%s busy=%d battle=%d cfg=%02X px=%d py=%d dense=%d",
			frames, legDir or "idle", busy and 1 or 0, battle and 1 or 0, wr(0xD2E3), lx, ly, dense and 1 or 0))
		dump_bytes("stage", function(i) return wr(0x6E00 + i) end, 0x800)
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		if frames % 4 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end
	if frames % 4 == 0 then
		dump_bytes("aw", function(i) return wr(0xD9A8 + i) end, 0x458)
	end
	if frames == 36000 or frames == 36400 or frames == 36800 or frames == 37200 then
		dump_bytes("wram7e", function(i) return wr(i) end, 0x10000)
		dump_bytes("wram7f", function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x10000)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
	end
	if frames == 36000 then
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
	end
	if frames % 200 == 0 then
		dump_shot()
		flush_pad()
	end
	local stop = frames >= END_FRAME
	if stop then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d px=%d py=%d", frames, lx, ly))
		print("SP-STAGE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-DUMP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/sp_walk.lua`:

```lua
-- sp_walk.lua - dense walk-animation capture for the sprite frame grid
-- (docs/sprites.md's standing open question: direction x frame -> OAM
-- band slots / VRAM tiles, plus the animation-phase cell).
--
-- Timeline (the verified pieces, kept frame-exact):
--   * intro presses = walk4loane/walk13loane's exact schedule (frames
--     300..10600) - the only policy that reaches the free-walk village;
--   * from frame 20800: A every 30 while busy ($76 != 0, the dialog
--     policy walk13 verified), held-direction legs otherwise: down 900 /
--     right 900 / idle 3600, cycling. down/right is walk8/9's battle-free
--     program on the intro maps; the idle windows park the party so the
--     wandering NPCs (maps 0x249/0x24A/0x250) strut on their own.
--
-- Captures (from CAP_START = 20800, every frame):
--   STATE frame=... leg=... + per-frame OAM (544 B) and the actor-array
--   WRAM window $D9A8-$DDFF (per-actor stride 0x40; the leader px cell
--   $D9AA and the DBA8/DBE8 cells live inside it). VRAM+CGRAM full dumps
--   every 4000 frames (sprite tiles are uploaded at map load and static;
--   repeated dumps verify that), a PNG screenshot every 1600 frames for
--   the screenshot-vs-OAM validation docs/sprites.md asks for.
--
-- Reassembly: tools/emulator/oam_reassemble.py (STATE lines + DUMP blocks).
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/sp_walk.lua -timeout=3600

local END_FRAME = 52000
local CAP_START = 20800
local LEG_HOLD = 900
local IDLE_HOLD = 3600

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local legN = 0             -- completed legs
local legDir = nil         -- current held direction, nil while idle
local legStart = 0

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_shot()
	local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
	print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
	for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND shot")
end

print("SP-WALK-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0

	if frames >= CAP_START and p == nil and not battle then
		-- leg scheduler: down LEG_HOLD, right LEG_HOLD, idle IDLE_HOLD
		local held = frames - legStart
		local limit = (legDir == nil) and IDLE_HOLD or LEG_HOLD
		if held >= limit then
			legStart = frames
			if legDir == nil then legDir = "down"
			elseif legDir == "down" then legDir = "right"
			else legDir = nil end
			legN = legN + 1
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("LEG frame=%d n=%d dir=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s",
				frames, legN, legDir or "idle", lx, ly, tostring(busy)))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif legDir then
			p = { [legDir] = 1 }
		end
	elseif battle and frames >= CAP_START then
		local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
		if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
	end

	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

-- Dumps run in startFrame: OAM there holds the state the last frame's
-- vblank DMA wrote (oam_capture.lua's working timing); inputPolled reads
-- caught the buffer mid-update (verified against screenshots: run1's
-- inputPolled dumps showed junk rows instead of the on-screen figures).
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	if frames < CAP_START then return end
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local lx, ly = leader()
	print(string.format("STATE frame=%d leg=%s busy=%d battle=%d cfg=%02X px=%d py=%d",
		frames, legDir or "idle", busy and 1 or 0, battle and 1 or 0, wr(0xD2E3), lx, ly))
	dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
	-- actor array window: per-actor stride 0x40, bases congruent 0x28
	-- (mod 0x40) from $D9A8 (leader px $D9AA, phase cells $DBA8/$DBE8)
	dump_bytes("aw", function(i) return wr(0xD9A8 + i) end, 0x458)
	if frames % 4000 == 0 then
		local ok2, obsel = pcall(function() return emu.read(0x2101, emu.memType.snesPpu) end)
		print(string.format("OBSEL frame=%d val=%s", frames, ok2 and string.format("%02X", obsel) or "READ-FAIL"))
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 1600 == 0 then
		dump_shot()
	end
	if frames % 400 == 0 then flush_pad() end

	local stop = frames >= END_FRAME
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d px=%d py=%d legs=%d", frames, lx, ly, legN))
		print("SP-WALK-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("SP-DUMP-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

```

`tools/emulator/spc_build.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build a .spc file from MesenCE rip.lua stdout, then validate the conversion.

Reads captured stdout, assembles the SPC700 sound file (format v0.30):
  0x000-0x020 signature, 0x21-0x22 = 1A 1A, 0x23 = no-ID666 marker,
  0x24 = 30, 0x25-26 PC LE, 0x27 A, 0x28 P, 0x29 X, 0x2A Y, 0x2B SP,
  0x100-0xFFFF SPC700 RAM, 0x10100-0x1017F DSP registers.
Exits non-zero if the rip is incomplete.
"""
import base64
import sys


def build(spc_path: str, log_path: str) -> dict:
    ram = bytearray()
    dsp = bytearray()
    info = {}
    for line in open(log_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace"):
        line = line.rstrip("\n")
        if line.startswith("RIPINFO "):
            for field in line.split()[1:]:
                k, _, v = field.partition("=")
                info[k] = v
        elif line.startswith("SPCDATA "):
            ram += base64.b64decode(line[len("SPCDATA "):])
        elif line.startswith("DSPDATA "):
            dsp += base64.b64decode(line[len("DSPDATA "):])
        elif line == "RIPDONE":
            info["done"] = "1"
    if "done" not in info or "hijack_frame" not in info or info.get("hijack_frame") == "nil":
        sys.exit(f"incomplete rip: RIPINFO={info}, ram={len(ram)} bytes")
    if len(ram) != 65536:
        sys.exit(f"RAM dump is {len(ram)} bytes, expected 65536")
    if len(dsp) != 128:
        sys.exit(f"DSP dump is {len(dsp)} bytes, expected 128")

    pc = int(info["spcpc"], 16)
    out = bytearray(66048)
    out[0:33] = b"SNES-SPC700 Sound File Data v0.30"
    out[0x21] = 0x1A
    out[0x22] = 0x1A
    out[0x23] = 0x1B  # no ID666 tag
    out[0x24] = 0x30  # version minor
    out[0x25] = pc & 0xFF
    out[0x26] = pc >> 8
    out[0x27] = int(info["a"], 16)
    out[0x28] = int(info["ps"], 16)
    out[0x29] = int(info["x"], 16)
    out[0x2A] = int(info["y"], 16)
    out[0x2B] = int(info["sp"], 16)
    out[0x100:0x10100] = ram
    out[0x10100:0x10180] = dsp
    with open(spc_path, "wb") as f:
        f.write(out)
    info["ram_len"] = str(len(ram))
    return info


if __name__ == "__main__":
    spc_path, log_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    info = build(spc_path, log_path)
    print("built", spc_path, info)

```

`tools/emulator/stream_waits.lua`:

```lua
-- stream_waits.lua - the per-action wait/roll stream of one real battle.
--
-- Boot+walk schedule copied from attack_item.lua (opening ensemble battle,
-- five allies vs one 地狼, first battle ~frame 45076). In the battle an A
-- press every 16 frames drives the command/target menus and the victory
-- screens. Logs:
--   ROLL  frame, lo, hi, idx=$0914, caller=ret-1  at C2:032E entry
--   WAIT  frame, caller=ret-1                     at each wait RETURN point
--         (C182 = the C17A counted loop, B840/B8C0/B8CD = the B839-family
--         helpers, C01F/C058 = the C016 routine's outer waits, BD4A = the
--         BD28-helper wait, C198 = the $0E flag wait, plus the direct C14E
--         returns in C2/FE)
--   STEP  engine step markers at the decoded routine entries
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/stream_waits.lua --timeout=3600
--      > /tmp/stream/waits.log   (delete /tmp/mesence/Saves/*.srm first)

local END_FRAME = 53000
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local CUTSCENE_SONG = 41
local VICTORY_SONG = 3

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local WALK_FROM = 35000
local LAST_FRAME = 53000
local LEGS = { "up", "left", "up", "left", "up", "left", "up", "left" }
local LEG_FRAMES = 900
local leg_i = 1
local leg_start = 0

local battle = false
local real_battle = false
local real_start = nil
local frames = 0
local done = false
local n_roll = 0
local n_wait = 0

local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end

-- return address at a subroutine entry: stack page $01, S points at the low
-- byte pushed last (JSR: 2 bytes; JSL: 3 bytes, bank at S+2).
local function caller(st)
	local s = st.sp & 0xFF
	local lo = wr(0x100 + s)
	local hi = wr(0x100 + ((s + 1) & 0xFF))
	local bank = wr(0x100 + ((s + 2) & 0xFF))
	return hi * 256 + lo, bank
end

local function log(cat, line)
	print(string.format("%s frame=%d %s", cat, frames, line))
end

local function watch_ret(addr, name)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		n_wait = n_wait + 1
		log("WAIT", string.format("at=%s n=%d idx=%04X", name, n_wait, wr16(0x0914)))
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

local function watch_step(addr, name)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		log("STEP", string.format("%s pc=%02X:%04X A=%02X slot=%04X idx=%04X", name,
			st.k, st.pc, st.a & 0xFFFF, wr16(0x099E), wr16(0x0914)))
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

print("STREAM-WAITS-LOADED")

-- rolls
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	local ret, bank = caller(st)
	n_roll = n_roll + 1
	log("ROLL", string.format("lo=%02X hi=%02X caller=%02X:%04X n=%d idx=%04X",
		wr(0x09BF), wr(0x09C0), bank, (ret - 1) & 0xFFFF, n_roll, wr16(0x0914)))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC2032E, 0xC2032E, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- wait return points
watch_ret(0xFEC182, "C181")   -- inside the C17A counted loop (per wait)
watch_ret(0xFEB840, "B83F")   -- B839 helper (1 wait + ABus pad)
watch_ret(0xFEB8C0, "B8BB")   -- B8B4 helper (1 wait, $1B bit2 wrap)
watch_ret(0xFEB8CD, "B8CC")   -- B8C9 button/timeout wait (per frame)
watch_ret(0xFEC01F, "C01E")   -- C016 routine head wait
watch_ret(0xFEC058, "C057")   -- C016 routine tail wait
watch_ret(0xFEBD4A, "BD49")   -- BD28-helper wait (cursor settle)
watch_ret(0xFEC198, "C197")   -- C194 flag wait (per frame until $0E)
watch_ret(0xFEE8A6, "E8A5")   -- C2:E8A2 direct wait
watch_ret(0xFEEE2C, "EE2B")   -- C2:EE28 direct wait
watch_ret(0xFEFE08, "FE07")   -- C2:FE04 direct wait
watch_ret(0xFEFF09, "FF08")   -- C2:FF05 direct wait
watch_ret(0xFEFF0F, "FF0E")   -- C2:FF0B direct wait

-- step markers
watch_step(0xC252BC, "DRIVER")
watch_step(0xC25556, "ALLY-INIT")
watch_step(0xC25C3E, "ENEMY-INIT")
watch_step(0xC2614E, "ORDER")
watch_step(0xC26206, "ACTLOOP")
watch_step(0xC26A47, "BODY")
watch_step(0xC2C860, "ANIM-C860")
watch_step(0xFEC016, "ANIM-C016")
watch_step(0xC266C2, "POSTACT")
watch_step(0xC26652, "TAILWAIT")
watch_step(0xC2DA2E, "VICTORY")
watch_step(0xC2DB7C, "GROWTH")
watch_step(0xC2E149, "DROPS")
watch_step(0xC2E1DE, "GOLD")
watch_step(0xC2A70F, "SPARK")
watch_step(0xC26EEE, "EXEC0")
watch_step(0xC286C4, "ROLL-COUNTER")
watch_step(0xC28A6D, "ROLL-HIT")
watch_step(0xC28FBB, "ROLL-SPREAD")
watch_step(0xC290B2, "ROLL-90B4")
watch_step(0xC269C5, "ROLL-69C7")

local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	log("BGM", string.format("id=%d", id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG and frames > WALK_FROM then
		battle = true
		if real_start == nil then
			real_battle = true
			real_start = frames
			log("NOTE", string.format("REAL-BATTLE start=%d", frames))
		end
	elseif id ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and id ~= VICTORY_SONG and battle then
		battle = false
		log("NOTE", string.format("BATTLE-END start=%d", real_start or -1))
	end
end

local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		if real_battle then
			if frames % 16 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME and not real_battle then
			local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
			if busy and frames < 45000 then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				if leg_start == 0 then
					leg_start = frames
					log("LEG", string.format("dir=%s px=%d py=%d", LEGS[leg_i], wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC)))
				end
				local t = frames - leg_start
				if t < LEG_FRAMES then
					p = { [LEGS[leg_i]] = 1 }
				else
					leg_i = leg_i + 1
					if leg_i > #LEGS then leg_i = 1 end
					leg_start = frames
					p = { [LEGS[leg_i]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		if frames % 600 == 0 then
			log("TICK", string.format("roll=%d wait=%d idx=%04X", n_roll, n_wait, wr16(0x0914)))
		end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			log("NOTE", string.format("FINISHED rolls=%d waits=%d", n_roll, n_wait))
			emu.stop(0)
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```
