`tools/emulator/subobj_watch.lua`:

```lua
-- subobj_watch.lua - subscreen-OBJ palette slot lifecycle probe
-- (docs/subscreen-obj.md). Logs $D6E1/$D6E2 (the slot list), $D6B8 (the
-- objOp-69 firing counter), $BAB5-BAB7 and the map cell, print-on-change.
-- Boot/press schedule cribbed verbatim from journey_teleport.lua.
--
-- Run: cp -a /tmp/mesence /tmp/subobj-mesence &&
--   /tmp/subobj-mesence/Mesen -testRunner tools/emulator/subobj_watch.lua
--   patches/bokuno_jp.sfc -enableStdout --timeout=555   (24000 frames)
local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local STOP_FRAME = 24000

local frames = 0
local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function mapid()
	return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
end
local lastmap = -1
local lastsig = ""

print("SUBOBJ-LOADED")
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	local m = mapid()
	if m ~= lastmap then
		print(string.format("SUBOBJ f=%d MAP=%04X", frames, m))
		lastmap = m
	end
	if frames < 10400 then
		return
	end
	local e1 = wr(0xD6E1)
	local list = {}
	for i = 0, 7 do list[#list + 1] = string.format("%02X", wr(0xD6E2 + i)) end
	local sig = string.format("%02X:%s d6b8=%02X b5=%02X b6=%02X b7=%02X",
		e1, table.concat(list, " "), wr(0xD6B8), wr(0xBAB5), wr(0xBAB6), wr(0xBAB7))
	if sig ~= lastsig then
		print(string.format("SUBOBJ f=%d m=%04X %s", frames, m, sig))
		lastsig = sig
	end
	if frames >= STOP_FRAME then
		print("SUBOBJ-DONE")
		emu.stop()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/tech_damage.lua`:

```lua
-- tech_damage.lua - engine ground truth for the enemy tech damage path.
--
-- Watches, inside the battle window:
--   TECHREAD - reads of the enemy tech perf table FE:1D00 (main, 256x16B)
--              and 5B:4AC0 (ext, 256x16B): the offset names the tech id the
--              engine is acting on (docs/techniques.md enemy tech record).
--   PATREAD  - reads of the pattern table FE:5ECB (256x8B): pattern id +
--              slot the enemy action picker chose (docs/battle-data.md).
--   RECDIFF  - per-frame byte diffs of the battle records at WRAM
--              $2280+0x80*slot (HP word at +0x14, docs/battle-formulas.md
--              section 13.2): every damage/status write lands here.
--   RECDUMP  - full 0x80B record dumps at battle start+400 for both sides.
--
-- Flow = battle_sfx.lua's pressed-boot policy (PRESSES clear the intro,
-- walk program from 20800, A-mash in battle), which deterministically
-- reaches the opening battles (BGM 1 at ~29444/31190/34420 - battle_sfx
-- run6, enemyform2: the first battle loads 地狼 x5 via the random chain).

local END_FRAME = 36500

local frames = 0
local done = false

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local FIELD_SONG = 33
local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local WALK_FROM = 20800
local LAST_FRAME = 36400

local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local battle_no = 0

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end

print("TECHDAMAGE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

local function in_window()
	return battle and battle_start ~= nil
		and frames >= battle_start and frames <= battle_start + 2600
end

-- enemy tech perf tables: main FE:1D00 256x16B, ext 5B:4AC0 256x16B
local tech_reads = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if not in_window() then return end
	if tech_reads >= 400 then return end
	tech_reads = tech_reads + 1
	local tag, _ = pctag()
	if a >= 0xFE1D00 and a < 0xFE2D00 then
		local off = a - 0xFE1D00
		print(string.format("TECHREAD frame=%d tbl=main tech=%03X off=%02X val=%02X pc=%s",
			frames, off // 16, off % 16, val, tag))
	else
		local off = a - 0x5B4AC0
		print(string.format("TECHREAD frame=%d tbl=ext tech=%03X off=%02X val=%02X pc=%s",
			frames, off // 16, off % 16, val, tag))
	end
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xFE1D00, 0xFE2CFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if not in_window() then return end
	if tech_reads >= 400 then return end
	tech_reads = tech_reads + 1
	local tag, _ = pctag()
	local off = a - 0x5B4AC0
	print(string.format("TECHREAD frame=%d tbl=ext tech=%03X off=%02X val=%02X pc=%s",
		frames, off // 16, off % 16, val, tag))
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0x5B4AC0, 0x5B5ABF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- pattern table FE:5ECB 256x8B
local pat_reads = 0
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
	if not in_window() then return end
	if pat_reads >= 300 then return end
	pat_reads = pat_reads + 1
	local off = a - 0xFE5ECB
	local tag, _ = pctag()
	print(string.format("PATREAD frame=%d pat=%03X slot=%d val=%02X pc=%s",
		frames, off // 8, off % 8, val, tag))
end, emu.callbackType.read, 0xFE5ECB, 0xFE66CA, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- battle records: diff WRAM $2280..$277F (10 x 0x80B) every frame in battle
local REC_BASE = 0x2280
local REC_LEN = 0x500
local prev_rec = nil
local recdiffs = 0
local function poll_records()
	local cur = {}
	for a = REC_BASE, REC_BASE + REC_LEN - 1 do
		cur[#cur + 1] = emu.read(a, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	end
	if prev_rec ~= nil then
		for i = 1, REC_LEN do
			if cur[i] ~= prev_rec[i] then
				if recdiffs < 800 then
					recdiffs = recdiffs + 1
					local slot = (i - 1) // 0x80
					local off = (i - 1) % 0x80
					print(string.format("RECDIFF frame=%d slot=%d off=%02X old=%02X new=%02X",
						frames, slot, off, prev_rec[i], cur[i]))
				end
			end
		end
	end
	prev_rec = cur
end

local function dump_slot(slot)
	local base = REC_BASE + slot * 0x80
	local parts = {}
	for a = base, base + 0x7F do
		parts[#parts + 1] = string.format("%02X", emu.read(a, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
	end
	print(string.format("RECDUMP frame=%d slot=%d %s", frames, slot, table.concat(parts)))
end

local dumped_battle = -1
local function maybe_dump()
	if battle and battle_no ~= dumped_battle and frames >= battle_start + 400 then
		dumped_battle = battle_no
		for slot = 0, 9 do dump_slot(slot) end
		flush_pad()
	end
end

local last_bgm = nil
local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == 41 and frames >= 20000 then
		-- cutscenes share the battle track (battle_sfx v2 note): flag battle
		-- so the policy A-mashes the dialogs instead of walking
		battle = true
	elseif id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		battle_no = battle_no + 1
		prev_rec = nil
		print(string.format("BATTLE-START frame=%d", frames))
		flush_pad()
	elseif (id == FIELD_SONG or id == 36 or id == 3) and battle and battle_start
		and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		print(string.format("BATTLE-END frame=%d", frames))
		flush_pad()
	end
end

local port1 = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local tag = pctag()
		if string.find(tag, "C6:0A75") then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

local WALK_PROGRAM = { "down", "right" }

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]
		local busy = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) ~= 0
		if p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and frames < LAST_FRAME then
			if battle then
				local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
				if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - WALK_FROM
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK_PROGRAM[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK_PROGRAM + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
		if in_window() then
			poll_records()
			maybe_dump()
		end
		if frames % 150 == 0 and not done then flush_pad() end
		if frames >= END_FRAME and not done then
			done = true
			print(string.format("COUNTS tech=%d pat=%d recdiff=%d battles=%d",
				tech_reads, pat_reads, recdiffs, battle_no))
			print("TECHDAMAGE-FINISHED frames=" .. frames)
			for _ = 1, 400 do print("FLUSH-PAD " .. string.rep("#", 60)) end
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FRAME-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/titlecont.lua`:

```lua
-- titlecont.lua - find the REAL continue input on the title menu.
-- Companion to titleprobe.lua (which proves the unattended with-save
-- boot enters the looping story-recap demo at 6933 and never shows a
-- title). This harness skips the prologue with START presses, then
-- presses a cursor-down and a confirm on the title, and logs what the
-- game loads: MAPLOAD lines carry $D51B/$D51D/$76 so a restored-save
-- load (35/0000/00 with the party at px=160 py=472) is distinguishable
-- from the demo cycle (same fingerprint, but the demo advances to
-- 01/39/22/1A/24 within ~550 frames while a restored pocket sits).
-- GOTCHAS carried over (see titleprobe.lua header): no $4218/$4219
-- reads, no screenshots before the press schedule is done, every helper
-- defined before first use (a global referenced before its `local`
-- NAV-ERRORs every frame and silently kills all input - walk7's bug).

-- Press schedule (frames). Default: START 300/360 skip the prologue,
-- DOWN at 400 moves the title cursor to つづき, A at 500 confirms.
local PRESSES = {}
PRESSES[300] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[360] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[400] = { down = 1 }
PRESSES[500] = { a = 1 }

local END_FRAME = 20000
local SHOT_FROM = 1500   -- screenshots only after the presses are done
local SHOT_EVERY = 2400

local frames = 0
local fp = nil
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local shotNext = SHOT_FROM
local lastPress = "-"

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader()
	local x = wr16(0xD9AA)
	local y = wr16(0xD9AC)
	return x, y
end

local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

print("TITLE-CONT-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			print(string.format("SONG frame=%d id=%02X", frames, port1))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end
	port1 = nil
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	if p ~= nil then
		local names = {}
		for k in pairs(p) do names[#names + 1] = k end
		table.sort(names)
		lastPress = table.concat(names, "+")
		print(string.format("PRESS frame=%d %s", frames, lastPress))
		flush_pad()
	end
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()
	local lx, ly = leader()
	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X",
			frames, cur_fp, lx, ly, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520), wr(0x76)))
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 300 == 0 then
		print(string.format(
			"STATE frame=%d 76=%02X D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X cfg=%02X px=%d py=%d lastPress=%s",
			frames, wr(0x76), wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520),
			wr(0xD2E3), lx, ly, lastPress))
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames == shotNext then
		shotNext = shotNext + SHOT_EVERY
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		dump_bytes(string.format("shot%d", frames), function(i)
			return png:byte(i + 1)
		end, #png)
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames >= END_FRAME then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s", frames, fp or "?"))
		print("TITLE-CONT-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/titleprobe.lua`:

```lua
-- titleprobe.lua - decode the with-save boot (roadmap item 4, walk7's
-- "SRAM-continue"). ROUND-10 FINDING (2026-11-17): walk7's boot was
-- UNATTENDED, not continue-driven - walk7loane.lua calls onSceneMap()
-- (defined before the `local wr` it references) every frame from frame 1,
-- the pcall NAV-ERRORs and emu.setInput never runs, so its PRESSES never
-- reached the game. Three verbatim reproductions in a fresh emulator dir
-- (/tmp/titleagent runs 4/6/7) all NAV-ERR from frame 1 and all load the
-- story montage at frame 6933 anyway: with the 0x35 save in
-- <emudir>/Saves/bokuno_jp.srm, an unattended boot skips the title and
-- enters the montage by itself (song 2B at 6879, MAPLOAD 35/0000/00 at
-- 6933). Cold boots with working input (walk4/8/10) replay the intro
-- instead (mapload 05 at 10808). This harness boots unattended on
-- purpose: no PRESSES, no $4218/$4219 reads (reading the joypad register
-- block via emu.read from the inputPolled callback silently kills
-- emu.setInput for the rest of the run - /tmp/titleagent run2/run5
-- stalled on the protagonist-select screen while the identical script
-- without the reads sailed through), no mid-run Lua that can NAV-ERR.
-- Evidence: SONG lines (dispatcher C6:0A75), MAPLOAD fingerprints,
-- STATE lines, screenshots at frame 6934 and every 2400 after (input
-- is pinned to zero, so screenshots cannot disturb a press schedule).
-- The montage cycles 35 -> 01 -> 39 -> 22 -> 1A -> 24 -> 35 every
-- ~16k frames (walk7's 320k-frame log shows 4+ identical cycles); the
-- screenshots answer whether it ever exits to a title menu.
--
-- Usage: <mesence>/Saves/bokuno_jp.srm = save to continue from (delete
-- for a cold boot); Mesen -testRunner titleprobe.lua bokuno_jp.sfc

	end

		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)

			frames, cur_fp, lx, ly, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520), wr(0x76)))
```

`tools/emulator/trace_check/main.go`:

```go
// Command trace_check validates a parity harness M1 ROM-side trace
// (tools/emulator/trace_events.lua) against the event pointer tables the
// project already decodes (internal/bokuno).
//
// Usage: go run ./tools/emulator/trace_check <patches/bokuno_jp.sfc> <trace.log>
//
// Trace lines used: "VM frame=N 76=F depth=D PC=bb:hhhh END=eeee D51B=iiii"
// (emitted per frame on VM state change). Each new dispatch id observed with
// the frame flag set is one observation, checked against Ops.NativeRange:
//
//  1. the id resolves, the observed PC is in the entry bank and within
//     [entry, end16] (PC may have advanced before the frame boundary sample);
//  2. at least 5 ops decode consecutively at the resolved entry (OpLenAt).
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"

	"saga3/internal/bokuno"
)

type observation struct {
	frame                int
	id                   int
	firstBank, firstAddr int
	seenPC               bool
	r                    bokuno.Range
	resolved             bool
}

type checker struct {
	ops    *bokuno.Ops
	rom    []byte
	disp   []*observation
	fails  int
	lastID int
}

var (
	reVM  = regexp.MustCompile(`^VM frame=(\d+) 76=([0-9A-F]{2}) depth=([0-9A-F]{2}) PC=([0-9A-F]{2}):([0-9A-F]{4}) END=([0-9A-F]{4}) D51B=([0-9A-F]{4})`)
	rePCW = regexp.MustCompile(`^PCW frame=(\d+) n=(\d+) (.*)$`)
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "usage: trace_check <rom.sfc> <trace.log>")
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	rom, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	log, err := os.Open(os.Args[2])
	if err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	c := &checker{ops: bokuno.NewOps(rom), rom: rom}
	scan := bufio.NewScanner(log)
	scan.Buffer(make([]byte, 1024*1024), 1024*1024)
	for scan.Scan() {
		line := scan.Text()
		switch {
		case reVM.MatchString(line):
			c.onVM(line)
		case rePCW.MatchString(line):
			c.onPCW(line)
		}
	}
	c.report()
}

// onVM treats every VM state change with a new dispatch id as one event
// observation; a new id with the frame flag clear is still observed (the
// engine sets the flag right after the resolver runs).
func (c *checker) onVM(line string) {
	m := reVM.FindStringSubmatch(line)
	frame, _ := strconv.Atoi(m[1])
	bankU, _ := strconv.ParseUint(m[4], 16, 32)
	addrU, _ := strconv.ParseUint(m[5], 16, 32)
	idU, _ := strconv.ParseUint(m[7], 16, 32)
	if int(idU) == c.lastID {
		return
	}
	c.lastID = int(idU)
	d := &observation{
		frame: frame, id: int(idU),
		firstBank: int(bankU), firstAddr: int(addrU), seenPC: true,
	}
	r, ok := c.ops.NativeRange(int(idU))
	d.resolved = ok
	d.r = r
	c.disp = append(c.disp, d)
}

// onPCW records PC writes; unused for the entry assertion (VM lines already
// carry the first sampled PC) but kept for the intra-frame trace.
func (c *checker) onPCW(line string) {}

func (c *checker) report() {
	for _, d := range c.disp {
		if d.id == 0 {
			continue
		}
		if !d.resolved {
			c.fails++
			fmt.Printf("FAIL id=%04X frame=%d: NativeRange could not resolve\n", d.id, d.frame)
			continue
		}
		entryBank := d.r.EntryCPU >> 16
		entryAddr := d.r.EntryCPU & 0xffff
		if !d.seenPC {
			c.fails++
			fmt.Printf("FAIL id=%04X frame=%d: no PC observed for the event\n", d.id, d.frame)
			continue
		}
		if d.firstBank != entryBank {
			c.fails++
			fmt.Printf("FAIL id=%04X frame=%d: entry bank %02X != observed PC bank %02X\n",
				d.id, d.frame, entryBank, d.firstBank)
			continue
		}
		end := d.r.End16
		if d.firstAddr < entryAddr || d.firstAddr > end {
			c.fails++
			fmt.Printf("FAIL id=%04X frame=%d: observed PC %04X outside [entry %04X, end16 %04X]\n",
				d.id, d.frame, d.firstAddr, entryAddr, end)
			continue
		}
		exact := " (PC == entry)"
		if d.firstAddr != entryAddr {
			exact = fmt.Sprintf(" (PC advanced %d bytes into the event before first sample)", d.firstAddr-entryAddr)
		}
		off := d.r.Start
		ops := 0
		for ops < 5 {
			l := c.ops.OpLenAt(off)
			if l == 0 {
				break
			}
			off += l
			ops++
		}
		if ops < 5 {
			c.fails++
			fmt.Printf("FAIL id=%04X frame=%d: only %d ops decode at entry (offset %06X)\n",
				d.id, d.frame, ops, d.r.Start)
			continue
		}
		fmt.Printf("PASS id=%04X frame=%d entry=%02X:%04X end16=%04X src=%s%s ops>=5\n",
			d.id, d.frame, entryBank, entryAddr, d.r.End16, d.r.Source, exact)
	}
	status := "PASS"
	if c.fails > 0 || len(c.disp) == 0 {
		status = "FAIL"
	}
	fmt.Printf("SUMMARY dispatches=%d fails=%d -> %s\n", len(c.disp), c.fails, status)
	if status == "FAIL" {
		os.Exit(1)
	}
}
```

`tools/emulator/trace_events.lua`:

```lua
-- trace_events.lua - parity harness M1 ROM-side capture (docs/parity.md §6 M1).
--
-- Boots the ROM headless (MesenCE -testRunner), plays through boot -> new
-- game with a fixed input schedule (measured in the M1 recon), and traces
-- the event VM:
--   VM lines       - VM state transitions (76, depth, PC, END, dispatch id)
--     logged on every change; WRAM addresses are RAW OFFSETS (see docs/
--     parity.md §10 - the 0x7Exxxx CPU form reads bank 7F / garbage).
--   PCW lines      - ordered writes to the script PC $78/$79/$7A; the write
--     watches are attached ONLY while the frame flag $76 == 1 (an always-on
--     WRAM write watch halts the CPU per write and WRAM-clear DMA stalls
--     the run to minutes-per-frame - measured).
--
-- Output channel is print() only (emu.log does not reach stdout in
-- testRunner mode). Run via tools/emulator/run.sh; the checker is
-- tools/emulator/trace_check/.
--
-- CORRECTED 2026-11-22: emu.write works in -testRunner as (address, value, memType); the old no-op note was a reversed-arguments probe error (docs/parity.md section 11)
-- (readback stays 00 for every memory type and callback context, verified by
-- probe), so WRAM-injection anchors (docs/parity.md §8) cannot run headless;
-- this trace only records what the game dispatches on its own.

local frames = 0
local done = false
local last_vm = nil
local pcw = nil      -- PC writes while 76==1, ordered, capped
local PCW_CAP = 512

-- Input schedule, measured in the M1 recon (inputPolled only - setInput from
-- startFrame never reaches the joypad latch): mashing START skips the
-- opening prologue (title music by frame ~333), the title menu opens and
-- confirms new game, protagonist select shows the male list (~frame 1080),
-- and spaced presses walk gender (A, cursor on 男) -> character (A, top of
-- the list) -> name entry (START finishes with the default name) -> confirm
-- dialogs (A) -> game start (~frame 10800, opening map scene).
local presses = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do presses[f] = { start = 1 } end
presses[7000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm gender male
presses[7800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm character
presses[8600] = { start = 1 }  -- name entry: default name
presses[9000] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm dialog
presses[9800] = { a = 1 }      -- confirm weapon
presses[10600] = { a = 1 }     -- confirm stats
presses[11400] = { a = 1 }     -- advance opening scene
presses[12200] = { a = 1 }
presses[13000] = { a = 1 }
presses[13800] = { a = 1 }

print("TRACE-LOADED")

-- Song-dispatch exec watch (read-only progress marker: song ids over the
-- run - 72 prologue, 43 title, 41 new-game cutscene).
local last_song = nil
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	local a = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes).a
	local song = math.floor(a / 3)
	if song ~= last_song then
		last_song = song
		print(string.format("SONG frame=%d id=%d", frames, song))
	end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0x5E191B, 0x5E191B, emu.memType.snesMemory, emu.cpuType.snes)

-- NOTE: dispatch capture is the per-frame VM change log below (D51B read
-- fresh each frame). An exec hook on C0:1B50 (the dispatch store) was tried
-- and removed; the zero-state traces that motivated removing it turned out
-- to be the WRAM address-form bug, not the hook (docs/parity.md §10).

local function pcwrite(addr, val)
	if not pcw then return end
	if #pcw >= PCW_CAP then return end
	pcw[#pcw + 1] = string.format("%02X=%02X", addr, val)
end

-- PC-write watches are attached ONLY while the frame flag is set: WRAM-clear
-- DMA touches $78-$7A constantly at boot, and an always-on watch halts the
-- CPU per write and stalls the run (measured in the M1 recon).
local pcw_refs = nil

local function pcw_attach()
	if pcw_refs then return end
	pcw_refs = {}
	for _, a in ipairs({ 0x78, 0x79, 0x7A }) do
		pcw_refs[#pcw_refs + 1] = emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val) pcwrite(addr, val) end,
			emu.callbackType.write, a, a, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	end
end

local function pcw_detach()
	if not pcw_refs then return end
	for _, ref in ipairs(pcw_refs) do
		for _, a in ipairs({ 0x78, 0x79, 0x7A }) do
			emu.removeMemoryCallback(ref, emu.callbackType.write, a, a,
				emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		end
	end
	pcw_refs = nil
end

-- Input MUST be driven from inputPolled: setInput from startFrame never shows
-- up in the joypad latch ($4218/$4219 stay 00 - measured in the M1 recon),
-- and the game never sees it.
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	emu.setInput(presses[frames] or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local flag = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		if flag == 1 then
			pcw_attach()
		else
			pcw_detach()
		end
		pcw = {}
		local depth = emu.read(0x77, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_lo = emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_hi = emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_bk = emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local end_lo = emu.read(0x7B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local end_hi = emu.read(0x7C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_lo = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_hi = emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local vm = string.format("%02X %02X %02X%02X%02X %04X", flag, depth, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo)
		if vm ~= last_vm then
			print(string.format("VM frame=%d 76=%02X depth=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X END=%02X%02X D51B=%04X",
				frames, flag, depth, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, end_hi, end_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo))
			last_vm = vm
		end
		if #pcw > 0 then
			print(string.format("PCW frame=%d n=%d %s", frames, #pcw, table.concat(pcw, " ")))
		end
		if frames % 500 == 0 then
			print(string.format("POLL frame=%d 76=%02X depth=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X D51B=%04X",
				frames, flag, depth, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo))
		end

		if frames >= 12500 and not done then
			done = true
			print("TRACE-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

```lua
local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)

end

-- NOTE: no $7F write watch in this round - the GW line volume throttled
-- the emulator to ~25 fps; the streaming question is settled (zero
-- post-load writes, winorigin2) and the settled grids come from the
-- GEO hook's bank dumps below.

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < (onSceneMap() and 1000000000 or MARK_ROAD) then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if wr(0xD2E3) == 0x35 then sceneSeen = true end
	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest exit-tile goal if this fingerprint has one,
		-- else the nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				local goals = EXIT_GOALS[fp]
				if goals then
					for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, g.x, g.y) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, g.x, g.y)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				else
					for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
					-- input ladder on the scene map: A for a while, then
					-- START, then B, then a down hold, cycling per 2400
					if sceneSeen then
						local ph = math.floor(frames / 2400) % 4
						if ph == 0 then p = { a = 1 }
						elseif ph == 1 and frames % 60 == 0 then p = { start = 1 }
						elseif ph == 2 and frames % 60 == 0 then p = { b = 1 }
						elseif ph == 3 then p = { down = 1 } end
					end
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk on 0x35 only (the road maps stay walk4-exact)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if onSceneMap() and waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				local stuckLim = onSceneMap() and 3600 or STUCK_ROAD
				if frames - stuckSince > stuckLim and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3)
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- busy-stall breaker: when a busy stretch outlives 12000 frames,
	-- cycle START / B / down / A windows (dialog ladders that plain
	-- A taps do not advance)
	local busyNow = busy
	if busyNow and not lastBusy then busySince = frames end
	if not busyNow then busySince = nil end
	lastBusy = busyNow
	if busyNow and sceneSeen and busySince ~= nil and frames - busySince > 12000 then
		local ph = math.floor((frames - busySince - 12000) / 1200) % 4
		if ph == 0 and frames % 60 == 0 then p = { start = 1 }
		elseif ph == 1 and frames % 60 == 0 then p = { b = 1 }
		elseif ph == 2 then p = { down = 1 }
		end
	end

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 600 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
			frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520),
			wr(0x76), px, py, wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

```lua
	["35/0800/40"] = { { x = 22, y = 39 }, { x = 22, y = 14 } },
}

	[0x00]=1,[0x01]=1,[0x02]=1,[0x03]=1,[0x04]=1,[0x05]=1,[0x07]=1,
	[0x08]=1,[0x09]=1,[0x0C]=1,[0x20]=1,[0x21]=1,[0x22]=1,[0x23]=1,
	[0x24]=1,[0x25]=1,[0x26]=1,[0x27]=1,[0x29]=1,[0x2A]=1,[0x2B]=1,
	[0x2C]=1,[0x2D]=1,[0x2F]=1,[0x30]=1,[0x34]=1,[0x35]=1,

local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end

	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

	end

-- NOTE: no $7F write watch in this round - the GW line volume throttled
-- the emulator to ~25 fps; the streaming question is settled (zero
-- post-load writes, winorigin2) and the settled grids come from the
-- GEO hook's bank dumps below.

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < (onSceneMap() and 1000000000 or MARK_ROAD) then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if wr(0xD2E3) == 0x35 then sceneSeen = true end
	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E
		and not (sceneSeen and onSceneMap()) then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest exit-tile goal if this fingerprint has one,
		-- else the nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				local goals = EXIT_GOALS[fp]
				if goals then
					for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, g.x, g.y) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, g.x, g.y)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				else
					for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
					-- walk11: no ladder. once sceneSeen the planner is off
					-- entirely; the pocket gets total silence
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk on 0x35 only (the road maps stay walk4-exact)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if onSceneMap() and waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				local stuckLim = onSceneMap() and 3600 or STUCK_ROAD
				if frames - stuckSince > stuckLim and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3)
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- busy-stall breaker: when a busy stretch outlives 12000 frames,
	-- cycle START / B / down / A windows (dialog ladders that plain
	-- A taps do not advance)
	-- walk11: the walk10 busy-stall breaker is disarmed - no button may
	-- fire after the 0x35 arrival; the plain busy-A taps below only run
	-- while a scene is actually up ($76 != 0)

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 600 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
			frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520),
			wr(0x76), px, py, wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

```lua
-- camp-journey chain. Round 3 (walk3loane.lua) reached the 0x250 north

--
-- Round 4 reads the walk model LIVE from WRAM instead of embedding
-- grids, so any chain map works:
--   * attr grid: WRAM $7F:(D0D5>>1), W = D0D1, H = (D0D5>>1)/W;
--     winorigin2.lua proved tile = (px>>3, py>>3) and the grid is the

--   * low buffer: WRAM $7F:0000, bit 3 = event point (blocks);

--   * map state = the fingerprint TRIPLE (cfg $D2E3, D0C5, D0D1) —
--     cfg alone collides (02 = 0x250 AND 0x253).
--
-- Goal heuristic per road map: BFS to the nearest walkable tile on the
-- north bound row (y == $D2EE), then hold up to push the edge event
-- (0x250's event fired exactly this way; no event-point tiles exist on
-- these maps). Camp (cfg 0x2E): wait, the chain advances by itself.
-- Loane (cfg 0x13): capture bank $7F + OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot
-- (townsfolk blob pin, docs/sprites.md) and stop.
--
-- Battle policy: SPC BGM watch (song 1 = battle) + A mash every 30
-- frames after 420 battle frames; busy ($76 != 0): A tap every 30.

local END_FRAME = 260000
-- walk4's exact timings on the road maps; generous only on 0x35
local STUCK_ROAD = 1100
local MARK_ROAD = 5400
-- exportmap exit tiles per fingerprint triple (walk4/5 findings); the
-- generic goal stays the north bound for fingerprints not listed here
local EXIT_GOALS = {
	["35/0800/40"] = { { x = 22, y = 39 }, { x = 22, y = 14 } },
}
local PLAN0 = 28900        -- planner start (0x250 arrival clearing)
local STUCK = STUCK_ROAD         -- frames without tile progress before a mark
local MARK_TTL = MARK_ROAD
local EDGE_GIVEUP = 7200   -- pushing a bound column this long = try another

local OPEN_ATTR = {
	[0x00]=1,[0x01]=1,[0x02]=1,[0x03]=1,[0x04]=1,[0x05]=1,[0x07]=1,
	[0x08]=1,[0x09]=1,[0x0C]=1,[0x20]=1,[0x21]=1,[0x22]=1,[0x23]=1,
	[0x24]=1,[0x25]=1,[0x26]=1,[0x27]=1,[0x29]=1,[0x2A]=1,[0x2B]=1,
	[0x2C]=1,[0x2D]=1,[0x2F]=1,[0x30]=1,[0x34]=1,[0x35]=1,
	[0x40]=1,[0x41]=1,[0x42]=1,[0x43]=1,[0x44]=1,[0x45]=1,[0x46]=1,
	[0x47]=1,[0x48]=1,[0x49]=1,[0x4A]=1,[0x4B]=1,[0x4C]=1,[0x4D]=1,
	[0x4E]=1,[0x4F]=1,[0x52]=1,
	[0x60]=1,[0x61]=1,[0x62]=1,[0x63]=1,[0x64]=1,[0x65]=1,[0x66]=1,
	[0x67]=1,[0x68]=1,[0x69]=1,[0x6A]=1,[0x6B]=1,[0x6C]=1,[0x6D]=1,
	[0x6E]=1,[0x6F]=1,[0x70]=1,[0x71]=1,[0x72]=1,[0x73]=1,[0x74]=1,
	[0x75]=1,[0x76]=1,[0x77]=1,[0x78]=1,[0x79]=1,[0x7A]=1,[0x7B]=1,
	[0x7C]=1,
	[0x80]=1,[0x81]=1,[0x82]=1,[0x83]=1,[0x84]=1,
}

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local fp = nil             -- fingerprint triple string
local plan = nil
local lastTX, lastTY = -1, -1
local stuckSince = 0
local blocked = {}         -- "x,y" -> frame laid
local edgeHold = 0
local loaneAt = nil
local caps = 0
local gwN = 0

local geoFp = nil

local roadAt = nil         -- frames spent idle on an unresolvable road
local busySince = nil

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function onSceneMap() return wr(0xD2E3) == 0x35 end
local sceneSeen = false
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end

local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

print("WALK4-LOANE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- NOTE: no $7F write watch in this round - the GW line volume throttled
-- the emulator to ~25 fps; the streaming question is settled (zero
-- post-load writes, winorigin2) and the settled grids come from the
-- GEO hook's bank dumps below.

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < (onSceneMap() and 1000000000 or MARK_ROAD) then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if wr(0xD2E3) == 0x35 then sceneSeen = true end
	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E
		and not (sceneSeen and onSceneMap()) then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest exit-tile goal if this fingerprint has one,
		-- else the nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				local goals = EXIT_GOALS[fp]
				if goals then
					for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, g.x, g.y) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, g.x, g.y)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				else
					for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
					-- walk11: no ladder. once sceneSeen the planner is off
					-- entirely; the pocket gets total silence
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk on 0x35 only (the road maps stay walk4-exact)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if onSceneMap() and waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				local stuckLim = onSceneMap() and 3600 or STUCK_ROAD
				if frames - stuckSince > stuckLim and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3)
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- busy-stall breaker: when a busy stretch outlives 12000 frames,
	-- cycle START / B / down / A windows (dialog ladders that plain
	-- A taps do not advance)
	-- walk11: the walk10 busy-stall breaker is disarmed - no button may
	-- fire after the 0x35 arrival; the plain busy-A taps below only run
	-- while a scene is actually up ($76 != 0)

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 600 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
			frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520),
			wr(0x76), px, py, wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
		flush_pad()
	end

	-- walk12: per-frame dispatch-window instrumentation on 0x35.
	-- CAUTION (kept for the record): as first run, the WIN line called
	-- leader() mid-argument-list - Lua truncates a multi-return call to
	-- one value there, the format was short one argument, and the pcall
	-- NAV-ERRORed on every busy frame of the first window, which SKIPPED
	-- emu.setInput and held the previous input latch (A) through the
	-- window. That held latch coincided with the pocket advancing at
	-- +548 into map 01 (round 12's surprise result); E15 held A
	-- deliberately and did NOT advance, so the advance is attributed to
	-- the latch/timing perturbation, not to held A as a recipe. Use
	-- walk13loane.lua for the clean silence test.
	if onSceneMap() and sceneSeen then
		local wx, wy = leader()
		if busy then
			print(string.format("WIN frame=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d flag54=%02X",
				frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520), wr(0x76),
				wx, wy, wr(0xF46A + 27)))
		end
		if frames % 8300 < 30 and frames > 105000 then
			local fb = {}
			for i = 0, 47 do fb[#fb + 1] = string.format("%02X", wr(0xF46A + i)) end
			print(string.format("FLAGS frame=%d %s", frames, table.concat(fb)))
		end
		if busy and frames % 150 == 0 then
			local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
			print("DUMPBEGIN wshot" .. frames)
			for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
				print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
			end
			print("DUMPEND wshot" .. frames)
		end
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

```lua
-- the cfg fingerprint COLLIDES with 0x250's; round 3 misidentified it

--
-- Round 4 reads the walk model LIVE from WRAM instead of embedding
-- grids, so any chain map works:
--   * attr grid: WRAM $7F:(D0D5>>1), W = D0D1, H = (D0D5>>1)/W;
--     winorigin2.lua proved tile = (px>>3, py>>3) and the grid is the
--     full map, never rewritten after load;
--   * low buffer: WRAM $7F:0000, bit 3 = event point (blocks);
--   * walkable attrs = the move gate's F9:A400 table rows, precomputed
--     for a zone-0 party with all quadrant bits clear (mapfmt
--     AttrWalkable; the 86-entry open set below);
--   * bounds $D2EE/$D2F0 (Y), $D2EF/$D2F1 (X) are TILE margins;
--   * map state = the fingerprint TRIPLE (cfg $D2E3, D0C5, D0D1) —
--     cfg alone collides (02 = 0x250 AND 0x253).
--
-- Goal heuristic per road map: BFS to the nearest walkable tile on the
-- north bound row (y == $D2EE), then hold up to push the edge event
-- (0x250's event fired exactly this way; no event-point tiles exist on
-- these maps). Camp (cfg 0x2E): wait, the chain advances by itself.
-- Loane (cfg 0x13): capture bank $7F + OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot
-- (townsfolk blob pin, docs/sprites.md) and stop.

-- Battle policy: SPC BGM watch (song 1 = battle) + A mash every 30
-- frames after 420 battle frames; busy ($76 != 0): A tap every 30.

local END_FRAME = 260000
-- walk4's exact timings on the road maps; generous only on 0x35
local STUCK_ROAD = 1100
local MARK_ROAD = 5400
-- exportmap exit tiles per fingerprint triple (walk4/5 findings); the
-- generic goal stays the north bound for fingerprints not listed here
local EXIT_GOALS = {
	["35/0800/40"] = { { x = 22, y = 39 }, { x = 22, y = 14 } },
}
local PLAN0 = 28900        -- planner start (0x250 arrival clearing)
local STUCK = STUCK_ROAD         -- frames without tile progress before a mark
local MARK_TTL = MARK_ROAD
local EDGE_GIVEUP = 7200   -- pushing a bound column this long = try another

local OPEN_ATTR = {
	[0x00]=1,[0x01]=1,[0x02]=1,[0x03]=1,[0x04]=1,[0x05]=1,[0x07]=1,
	[0x08]=1,[0x09]=1,[0x0C]=1,[0x20]=1,[0x21]=1,[0x22]=1,[0x23]=1,
	[0x24]=1,[0x25]=1,[0x26]=1,[0x27]=1,[0x29]=1,[0x2A]=1,[0x2B]=1,
	[0x2C]=1,[0x2D]=1,[0x2F]=1,[0x30]=1,[0x34]=1,[0x35]=1,
	[0x40]=1,[0x41]=1,[0x42]=1,[0x43]=1,[0x44]=1,[0x45]=1,[0x46]=1,
	[0x47]=1,[0x48]=1,[0x49]=1,[0x4A]=1,[0x4B]=1,[0x4C]=1,[0x4D]=1,

	[0x6E]=1,[0x6F]=1,[0x70]=1,[0x71]=1,[0x72]=1,[0x73]=1,[0x74]=1,
	[0x75]=1,[0x76]=1,[0x77]=1,[0x78]=1,[0x79]=1,[0x7A]=1,[0x7B]=1,
	[0x7C]=1,
	[0x80]=1,[0x81]=1,[0x82]=1,[0x83]=1,[0x84]=1,

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }

local battle_start = nil

local plan = nil

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function onSceneMap() return wr(0xD2E3) == 0x35 end
local sceneSeen = false
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end

local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

print("WALK4-LOANE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- NOTE: no $7F write watch in this round - the GW line volume throttled
-- the emulator to ~25 fps; the streaming question is settled (zero
-- post-load writes, winorigin2) and the settled grids come from the
-- GEO hook's bank dumps below.

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < (onSceneMap() and 1000000000 or MARK_ROAD) then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if wr(0xD2E3) == 0x35 then sceneSeen = true end
	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E
		and not (sceneSeen and onSceneMap()) then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest exit-tile goal if this fingerprint has one,
		-- else the nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				local goals = EXIT_GOALS[fp]
				if goals then
					for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, g.x, g.y) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, g.x, g.y)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				else
					for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
					-- walk11: no ladder. once sceneSeen the planner is off
					-- entirely; the pocket gets total silence
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk on 0x35 only (the road maps stay walk4-exact)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if onSceneMap() and waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				local stuckLim = onSceneMap() and 3600 or STUCK_ROAD
				if frames - stuckSince > stuckLim and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3) - walk13: NOT on
		-- the 0x35 scene map. walk11's busy-A taps fired inside every
		-- pocket dispatch window and every one aborted; walk12's first
		-- window (input latch stuck by its logging error) advanced at
		-- +548 into map 01. Round 13 tests the pocket with ZERO input
		-- edges of any size.
		if not (sceneSeen and onSceneMap()) then
			if battle then
				local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
				if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			elseif busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			end
		end
	end

	-- busy-stall breaker: when a busy stretch outlives 12000 frames,
	-- cycle START / B / down / A windows (dialog ladders that plain
	-- A taps do not advance)
	-- walk11: the walk10 busy-stall breaker is disarmed - no button may
	-- fire after the 0x35 arrival; the plain busy-A taps below only run
	-- while a scene is actually up ($76 != 0)

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 600 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
			frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520),
			wr(0x76), px, py, wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```
