```lua
-- walk3loane.lua - walk round 3: planner-driven walk 0x250 north edge
-- -> edge event 084E -> camp 0x24E -> Loane 0x4B, with the Loane
-- attr/low/OAM/blob capture on arrival.
--
-- Engine model (winorigin2.lua, 2026-11-17, verified):
--   * the walk grid is the FULL MAP at tile resolution, never rewritten
--     after load; the gate fetch is attr[(py>>3)*D0D1 + (px>>3)] and
--     $D9AA/$D9AC hold the leader's position in 8px units, so the
--     party's map tile IS (px>>3, py>>3) - no window origin exists;
--   * the load-time bounds $D2EF/$D2F1 (X) and $D2EE/$D2F0 (Y) are map
--     TILE margins (0x250: X [2,93), Y [4,62)) set once by C0:4F6E;
--     there are no event-point tiles on 0x250, so the N-edge event 084E
--     fires by pushing the bounds edge (hold up at row 4);
--   * walkability = the gate's F9:A400 table row (mapfmt AttrWalkable)
--     plus the low buffer's bit-3 event tiles; the model grids embedded
--     below were printed by `gridprint` (AttrWalkable + LowGrid bit 3).

-- clearing (frame 28900, deterministic like every prior round) ->

local CFG2MAP = {
	[0x26] = "0249", [0x07] = "024A", [0x02] = "0250",
	[0x2E] = "024E", [0x13] = "004B",

local ST0 = 20800          -- blind-walk start
local PLAN0 = 28900        -- planner start (party in the arrival clearing)
local END_FRAME = 200000
local NORTH_ROW = 4        -- the 0x250 bounds' Y minimum: push here
local MARK_TTL = 5400      -- a marked tile stays blocked this many frames
local STUCK = 1100         -- frames without tile progress before a mark
local CAMP_WAIT = 40000    -- max frames to wait on the camp for the chain
local CAMP_IDLE_A = 600    -- A tap cadence while free on the camp

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local curCfg = nil
local mapName = nil
local plan = nil           -- list of {x=,y=} tiles from the current tile

local stuckSince = 0

local loadCfg = nil

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

print("WALK3-LOANE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

-- BGM dispatch watch (battle detection)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- write-watch: the whole $7F bank with PC (streaming evidence + the
-- gridprint capture format)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < ST0 or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("GW frame=%d off=%04X val=%02X pc=%02X/%04X",
			frames, addr - 0x10000, val or 0, st.k, st.pc))
		gwN = gwN + 1
		if gwN % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end)
	if not ok then print("GWC-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x10000, 0x17FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

local function markKey(x, y) return x .. "," .. y end

local function walkable(x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= G250_W or y >= G250_H then return false end
	local t = blocked[markKey(x, y)]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < MARK_TTL then return false end
	return G250[y + 1]:sub(x + 1, x + 1) == "."
end

local function bfs(sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and walkable(nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- plan from (tx,ty) to the nearest walkable NORTH_ROW tile
local function replan(tx, ty)
	local best = nil
	for x = 0, G250_W - 1 do
		if walkable(x, NORTH_ROW) then
			local p = bfs(tx, ty, x, NORTH_ROW)
			if p and (best == nil or #p < #best) then best = p end
		end
	end
	return best
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)

	-- map fingerprint poll (some loads bypass write watches)
	if cfg ~= curCfg then
		local m = CFG2MAP[cfg]
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d cfg=%02X map=%s px=%d py=%d",
			frames, cfg, m or "?", leader()))
		flush_pad()
		curCfg = cfg
		mapName = m
		plan = nil
		geoDone = false
		loadFrame = frames
		loadCfg = cfg
		if m == "024E" then
			campAt = frames
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif m == "004B" then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end
	-- GEO + settled bank dump 1800 frames after each map load
	if loadFrame ~= nil and not geoDone and frames >= loadFrame + 1800 then
		geoDone = true
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("GEO frame=%d cfg=%02X D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X zone=%02X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
			frames, loadCfg or cfg, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), wr(0xD990),
			lx, ly, wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
		dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X", frames, loadCfg or cfg))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local px, py = leader()
	local tx, ty = math.floor(px / 8), math.floor(py / 8)

	if frames >= ST0 and frames < PLAN0 then
		-- deterministic blind walk to the arrival clearing
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			local t = frames - ST0
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [({ "down", "right" })[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and mapName == "0250" then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
				print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
				flush_pad()
				lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
				stuckSince = 0
			end
			if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
				plan = replan(tx, ty)
				if plan == nil then
					print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty))
					flush_pad()
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			end
			local dir = nil
			if plan and #plan > 0 then
				while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
					table.remove(plan, 1)
				end
				local nxt = plan[1]
				if nxt then
					local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
					if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
					elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
					elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
					elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
				end
			end
			if dir == nil and ty <= NORTH_ROW then
				-- at the goal row: push the bounds edge for 084E
				dir = "up"
				edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
				if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
					print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, tx, ty, edgeHold))
					flush_pad()
				end
				if edgeHold > 7200 then
					-- this column does not fire the edge: mark and replan
					blocked[markKey(tx, ty - 1)] = frames
					plan = nil
					edgeHold = 0
				end
			end
			if dir then
				p = { [dir] = 1 }
				if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
					if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
					if frames - stuckSince > STUCK and edgeHold == 0 then
						local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
						local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
						print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
							frames, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
						flush_pad()
						blocked[markKey(bx, by)] = frames
						plan = nil
						stuckSince = 0
					end
				end
			end
		end
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and mapName == "024E" then
		-- camp: the edge-event chain runs itself; keep A taps going
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif frames % CAMP_IDLE_A == 0 then
			p = { a = 1 }
			print(string.format("CAMP-A frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		if frames % 2400 == 0 then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("CAMP-HB frame=%d leader=(%d,%d) busy=%s battle=%s",
				frames, lx, ly, tostring(busy), tostring(battle)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and mapName == "004B" then
		-- Loane: capture, no walking
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- Loane captures: settle 1500 frames, then OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/shot,
	-- then the bank dump is already covered by the GEO hook
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X MAP=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), mapName or "?", lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d map=%s px=%d py=%d tile=(%d,%d) busy=%s battle=%s D2E3=%02X",
			frames, mapName or "?", px, py, tx, ty, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), cfg))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if campAt ~= nil and frames - campAt > CAMP_WAIT then
		print("CAMP-TIMEOUT")
		stop = true
	end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d map=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, mapName or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK3-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/walk4loane.lua`:

```lua
-- walk4loane.lua - walk round 4: GENERIC planner-driven walk of the
-- camp-journey chain. Round 3 (walk3loane.lua) reached the 0x250 north
-- edge, fired the edge event 084E, arrived at camp 0x24E (31,21) and
-- stopped: the chain then mapJumps to road map 0x253 (64x128, cfg 02 —
-- the cfg fingerprint COLLIDES with 0x250's; round 3 misidentified it
-- and sat out the camp timeout).
--
-- Round 4 reads the walk model LIVE from WRAM instead of embedding
-- grids, so any chain map works:
--   * attr grid: WRAM $7F:(D0D5>>1), W = D0D1, H = (D0D5>>1)/W;
--     winorigin2.lua proved tile = (px>>3, py>>3) and the grid is the
--     full map, never rewritten after load;
--   * low buffer: WRAM $7F:0000, bit 3 = event point (blocks);
--   * walkable attrs = the move gate's F9:A400 table rows, precomputed
--     for a zone-0 party with all quadrant bits clear (mapfmt
--     AttrWalkable; the 86-entry open set below);
--   * bounds $D2EE/$D2F0 (Y), $D2EF/$D2F1 (X) are TILE margins;
--   * map state = the fingerprint TRIPLE (cfg $D2E3, D0C5, D0D1) —
--     cfg alone collides (02 = 0x250 AND 0x253).
--
-- Goal heuristic per road map: BFS to the nearest walkable tile on the
-- north bound row (y == $D2EE), then hold up to push the edge event
-- (0x250's event fired exactly this way; no event-point tiles exist on
-- these maps). Camp (cfg 0x2E): wait, the chain advances by itself.
-- Loane (cfg 0x13): capture bank $7F + OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot
-- (townsfolk blob pin, docs/sprites.md) and stop.
--
-- Battle policy: SPC BGM watch (song 1 = battle) + A mash every 30
-- frames after 420 battle frames; busy ($76 != 0): A tap every 30.

local END_FRAME = 260000
local PLAN0 = 28900        -- planner start (0x250 arrival clearing)
local STUCK = 1100         -- frames without tile progress before a mark
local MARK_TTL = 5400
local EDGE_GIVEUP = 7200   -- pushing a bound column this long = try another

local OPEN_ATTR = {
	[0x00]=1,[0x01]=1,[0x02]=1,[0x03]=1,[0x04]=1,[0x05]=1,[0x07]=1,
	[0x08]=1,[0x09]=1,[0x0C]=1,[0x20]=1,[0x21]=1,[0x22]=1,[0x23]=1,
	[0x24]=1,[0x25]=1,[0x26]=1,[0x27]=1,[0x29]=1,[0x2A]=1,[0x2B]=1,
	[0x2C]=1,[0x2D]=1,[0x2F]=1,[0x30]=1,[0x34]=1,[0x35]=1,
	[0x40]=1,[0x41]=1,[0x42]=1,[0x43]=1,[0x44]=1,[0x45]=1,[0x46]=1,
	[0x47]=1,[0x48]=1,[0x49]=1,[0x4A]=1,[0x4B]=1,[0x4C]=1,[0x4D]=1,
	[0x4E]=1,[0x4F]=1,[0x52]=1,
	[0x60]=1,[0x61]=1,[0x62]=1,[0x63]=1,[0x64]=1,[0x65]=1,[0x66]=1,
	[0x67]=1,[0x68]=1,[0x69]=1,[0x6A]=1,[0x6B]=1,[0x6C]=1,[0x6D]=1,
	[0x6E]=1,[0x6F]=1,[0x70]=1,[0x71]=1,[0x72]=1,[0x73]=1,[0x74]=1,
	[0x75]=1,[0x76]=1,[0x77]=1,[0x78]=1,[0x79]=1,[0x7A]=1,[0x7B]=1,
	[0x7C]=1,
	[0x80]=1,[0x81]=1,[0x82]=1,[0x83]=1,[0x84]=1,
}

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local fp = nil             -- fingerprint triple string
local plan = nil
local lastTX, lastTY = -1, -1
local stuckSince = 0
local blocked = {}         -- "x,y" -> frame laid
local edgeHold = 0
local loaneAt = nil
local caps = 0
local gwN = 0
local geoAt = nil          -- frame to emit the GEO line + bank dump
local geoFp = nil
local noplanAt = nil
local roadAt = nil         -- frames spent idle on an unresolvable road

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end

local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

print("WALK4-LOANE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- write-watch: the walk buffers $7F:0000-$7F:3FFF (low buffer, attr
-- grids of every load size, footprint buffer head)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < 20000 or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("GW frame=%d off=%04X val=%02X pc=%02X/%04X",
			frames, addr - 0x10000, val or 0, st.k, st.pc))
		gwN = gwN + 1
		if gwN % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end)
	if not ok then print("GWC-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x10000, 0x13FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < MARK_TTL then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
					if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
						local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
						if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				if frames - stuckSince > STUCK and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3)
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/walk5loane.lua`:

```lua
-- walk5loane.lua - walk round 5 = walk4 plus bump-talk: on a blocked
-- direction the walker presses A while holding it (journey NPCs stand
-- on the exit tiles and only move for talk/dialog input), holds the
-- push longer before laying a mark (1100 -> 3600 frames) and keeps
-- marks for 20000 frames (round 4's 5400 expired mid-loop on 0x253's
-- (41,36) pocket and re-entered it). Round-4 state that motivated this:
-- the chain crossed 0x250 (edge event) -> camp 0x24E -> road 0x253 and
-- walked 88 tiles north to rows 37-38, where steps north were refused
-- until a scripted transition (frame 90433) delivered map 0x35
-- (cfg 35/0800/40, bounds X [18,49) Y [4,60)), where the party sits at
-- tile (20,58) with BFS-open-but-refused north steps.
--
-- walk round 4: GENERIC planner-driven walk of the
-- camp-journey chain. Round 3 (walk3loane.lua) reached the 0x250 north
-- edge, fired the edge event 084E, arrived at camp 0x24E (31,21) and
-- stopped: the chain then mapJumps to road map 0x253 (64x128, cfg 02 —
-- the cfg fingerprint COLLIDES with 0x250's; round 3 misidentified it
-- and sat out the camp timeout).
--
-- Round 4 reads the walk model LIVE from WRAM instead of embedding
-- grids, so any chain map works:
--   * attr grid: WRAM $7F:(D0D5>>1), W = D0D1, H = (D0D5>>1)/W;
--     winorigin2.lua proved tile = (px>>3, py>>3) and the grid is the
--     full map, never rewritten after load;
--   * low buffer: WRAM $7F:0000, bit 3 = event point (blocks);
--   * walkable attrs = the move gate's F9:A400 table rows, precomputed
--     for a zone-0 party with all quadrant bits clear (mapfmt
--     AttrWalkable; the 86-entry open set below);
--   * bounds $D2EE/$D2F0 (Y), $D2EF/$D2F1 (X) are TILE margins;
--   * map state = the fingerprint TRIPLE (cfg $D2E3, D0C5, D0D1) —
--     cfg alone collides (02 = 0x250 AND 0x253).
--
-- Goal heuristic per road map: BFS to the nearest walkable tile on the
-- north bound row (y == $D2EE), then hold up to push the edge event
-- (0x250's event fired exactly this way; no event-point tiles exist on
-- these maps). Camp (cfg 0x2E): wait, the chain advances by itself.
-- Loane (cfg 0x13): capture bank $7F + OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot
-- (townsfolk blob pin, docs/sprites.md) and stop.
--
-- Battle policy: SPC BGM watch (song 1 = battle) + A mash every 30
-- frames after 420 battle frames; busy ($76 != 0): A tap every 30.

local END_FRAME = 260000
local PLAN0 = 28900        -- planner start (0x250 arrival clearing)
local STUCK = 3600         -- frames without tile progress before a mark
local MARK_TTL = 20000
local EDGE_GIVEUP = 7200   -- pushing a bound column this long = try another

local OPEN_ATTR = {
	[0x00]=1,[0x01]=1,[0x02]=1,[0x03]=1,[0x04]=1,[0x05]=1,[0x07]=1,
	[0x08]=1,[0x09]=1,[0x0C]=1,[0x20]=1,[0x21]=1,[0x22]=1,[0x23]=1,
	[0x24]=1,[0x25]=1,[0x26]=1,[0x27]=1,[0x29]=1,[0x2A]=1,[0x2B]=1,
	[0x2C]=1,[0x2D]=1,[0x2F]=1,[0x30]=1,[0x34]=1,[0x35]=1,
	[0x40]=1,[0x41]=1,[0x42]=1,[0x43]=1,[0x44]=1,[0x45]=1,[0x46]=1,
	[0x47]=1,[0x48]=1,[0x49]=1,[0x4A]=1,[0x4B]=1,[0x4C]=1,[0x4D]=1,
	[0x4E]=1,[0x4F]=1,[0x52]=1,
	[0x60]=1,[0x61]=1,[0x62]=1,[0x63]=1,[0x64]=1,[0x65]=1,[0x66]=1,
	[0x67]=1,[0x68]=1,[0x69]=1,[0x6A]=1,[0x6B]=1,[0x6C]=1,[0x6D]=1,
	[0x6E]=1,[0x6F]=1,[0x70]=1,[0x71]=1,[0x72]=1,[0x73]=1,[0x74]=1,
	[0x75]=1,[0x76]=1,[0x77]=1,[0x78]=1,[0x79]=1,[0x7A]=1,[0x7B]=1,
	[0x7C]=1,
	[0x80]=1,[0x81]=1,[0x82]=1,[0x83]=1,[0x84]=1,
}

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local fp = nil             -- fingerprint triple string
local plan = nil
local lastTX, lastTY = -1, -1
local stuckSince = 0
local blocked = {}         -- "x,y" -> frame laid
local edgeHold = 0
local loaneAt = nil
local caps = 0
local gwN = 0
local geoAt = nil          -- frame to emit the GEO line + bank dump
local geoFp = nil
local noplanAt = nil
local roadAt = nil         -- frames spent idle on an unresolvable road

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end

local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

print("WALK4-LOANE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- write-watch: the walk buffers $7F:0000-$7F:3FFF (low buffer, attr
-- grids of every load size, footprint buffer head)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < 20000 or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("GW frame=%d off=%04X val=%02X pc=%02X/%04X",
			frames, addr - 0x10000, val or 0, st.k, st.pc))
		gwN = gwN + 1
		if gwN % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end)
	if not ok then print("GWC-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x10000, 0x13FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < MARK_TTL then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
					if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
						local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
						if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk: after the first hold window, burst A presses
				-- while still holding the direction (talk to whatever
				-- blocks the step before marking it)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				if frames - stuckSince > STUCK and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3)
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```

`tools/emulator/walk6loane.lua`:

```lua
-- walk6loane.lua - walk round 6 = walk5 plus permanent stuck marks and
-- exit-tile goals. Round 5 finding: map 0x35 (the post-ambush scene map,
-- fp 35/0800/40, bounds X [18,49) Y [4,60)) refuses the party's north
-- steps into (20,57) permanently while the model calls it open (attr 00);
-- walk4's 5400-frame mark TTL kept expiring, so the planner re-picked the
-- refused shortest path forever and never routed through the neighbours.
-- Round 6 marks never expire, and on known fingerprints the goals come
-- from exportmap's exit tiles (0x35: (22,14) -> 0x0E1, (22,39) -> 0x0DA)
-- instead of the north bound: this map's way out is an exit tile, not an
-- edge event.
--
-- walk round 5 = walk4 plus bump-talk: on a blocked
-- direction the walker presses A while holding it (journey NPCs stand
-- on the exit tiles and only move for talk/dialog input), holds the
-- push longer before laying a mark (1100 -> 3600 frames) and keeps
-- marks for 20000 frames (round 4's 5400 expired mid-loop on 0x253's
-- (41,36) pocket and re-entered it). Round-4 state that motivated this:
-- the chain crossed 0x250 (edge event) -> camp 0x24E -> road 0x253 and
-- walked 88 tiles north to rows 37-38, where steps north were refused
-- until a scripted transition (frame 90433) delivered map 0x35
-- (cfg 35/0800/40, bounds X [18,49) Y [4,60)), where the party sits at
-- tile (20,58) with BFS-open-but-refused north steps.
--
-- walk round 4: GENERIC planner-driven walk of the
-- camp-journey chain. Round 3 (walk3loane.lua) reached the 0x250 north
-- edge, fired the edge event 084E, arrived at camp 0x24E (31,21) and
-- stopped: the chain then mapJumps to road map 0x253 (64x128, cfg 02 —
-- the cfg fingerprint COLLIDES with 0x250's; round 3 misidentified it
-- and sat out the camp timeout).
--
-- Round 4 reads the walk model LIVE from WRAM instead of embedding
-- grids, so any chain map works:
--   * attr grid: WRAM $7F:(D0D5>>1), W = D0D1, H = (D0D5>>1)/W;
--     winorigin2.lua proved tile = (px>>3, py>>3) and the grid is the
--     full map, never rewritten after load;
--   * low buffer: WRAM $7F:0000, bit 3 = event point (blocks);
--   * walkable attrs = the move gate's F9:A400 table rows, precomputed
--     for a zone-0 party with all quadrant bits clear (mapfmt
--     AttrWalkable; the 86-entry open set below);
--   * bounds $D2EE/$D2F0 (Y), $D2EF/$D2F1 (X) are TILE margins;
--   * map state = the fingerprint TRIPLE (cfg $D2E3, D0C5, D0D1) —
--     cfg alone collides (02 = 0x250 AND 0x253).
--
-- Goal heuristic per road map: BFS to the nearest walkable tile on the
-- north bound row (y == $D2EE), then hold up to push the edge event
-- (0x250's event fired exactly this way; no event-point tiles exist on
-- these maps). Camp (cfg 0x2E): wait, the chain advances by itself.
-- Loane (cfg 0x13): capture bank $7F + OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot
-- (townsfolk blob pin, docs/sprites.md) and stop.
--
-- Battle policy: SPC BGM watch (song 1 = battle) + A mash every 30
-- frames after 420 battle frames; busy ($76 != 0): A tap every 30.

local END_FRAME = 320000
-- exportmap exit tiles per fingerprint triple (walk4/5 findings); the
-- generic goal stays the north bound for fingerprints not listed here
local EXIT_GOALS = {
	["35/0800/40"] = { { x = 22, y = 39 }, { x = 22, y = 14 } },
}
local PLAN0 = 28900        -- planner start (0x250 arrival clearing)
local STUCK = 3600         -- frames without tile progress before a mark
local MARK_TTL = 1000000000
local EDGE_GIVEUP = 7200   -- pushing a bound column this long = try another

local OPEN_ATTR = {
	[0x00]=1,[0x01]=1,[0x02]=1,[0x03]=1,[0x04]=1,[0x05]=1,[0x07]=1,
	[0x08]=1,[0x09]=1,[0x0C]=1,[0x20]=1,[0x21]=1,[0x22]=1,[0x23]=1,
	[0x24]=1,[0x25]=1,[0x26]=1,[0x27]=1,[0x29]=1,[0x2A]=1,[0x2B]=1,
	[0x2C]=1,[0x2D]=1,[0x2F]=1,[0x30]=1,[0x34]=1,[0x35]=1,
	[0x40]=1,[0x41]=1,[0x42]=1,[0x43]=1,[0x44]=1,[0x45]=1,[0x46]=1,
	[0x47]=1,[0x48]=1,[0x49]=1,[0x4A]=1,[0x4B]=1,[0x4C]=1,[0x4D]=1,
	[0x4E]=1,[0x4F]=1,[0x52]=1,
	[0x60]=1,[0x61]=1,[0x62]=1,[0x63]=1,[0x64]=1,[0x65]=1,[0x66]=1,
	[0x67]=1,[0x68]=1,[0x69]=1,[0x6A]=1,[0x6B]=1,[0x6C]=1,[0x6D]=1,
	[0x6E]=1,[0x6F]=1,[0x70]=1,[0x71]=1,[0x72]=1,[0x73]=1,[0x74]=1,
	[0x75]=1,[0x76]=1,[0x77]=1,[0x78]=1,[0x79]=1,[0x7A]=1,[0x7B]=1,
	[0x7C]=1,
	[0x80]=1,[0x81]=1,[0x82]=1,[0x83]=1,[0x84]=1,
}

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local fp = nil             -- fingerprint triple string
local plan = nil
local lastTX, lastTY = -1, -1
local stuckSince = 0
local blocked = {}         -- "x,y" -> frame laid
local edgeHold = 0
local loaneAt = nil
local caps = 0
local gwN = 0
local geoAt = nil          -- frame to emit the GEO line + bank dump
local geoFp = nil
local noplanAt = nil
local roadAt = nil         -- frames spent idle on an unresolvable road

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end

local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

print("WALK4-LOANE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- write-watch: the walk buffers $7F:0000-$7F:3FFF (low buffer, attr
-- grids of every load size, footprint buffer head)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < 20000 or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("GW frame=%d off=%04X val=%02X pc=%02X/%04X",
			frames, addr - 0x10000, val or 0, st.k, st.pc))
		gwN = gwN + 1
		if gwN % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end)
	if not ok then print("GWC-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x10000, 0x13FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < MARK_TTL then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest exit-tile goal if this fingerprint has one,
		-- else the nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				local goals = EXIT_GOALS[fp]
				if goals then
					for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, g.x, g.y) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, g.x, g.y)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				else
					for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk: after the first hold window, burst A presses
				-- while still holding the direction (talk to whatever
				-- blocks the step before marking it)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				if frames - stuckSince > STUCK and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3)
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/walk7loane.lua`:

```lua
--   * map state = the fingerprint TRIPLE (cfg $D2E3, D0C5, D0D1) —

-- north bound row (y == $D2EE), then hold up to push the edge event

-- Loane (cfg 0x13): capture bank $7F + OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot
-- (townsfolk blob pin, docs/sprites.md) and stop.

-- Battle policy: SPC BGM watch (song 1 = battle) + A mash every 30
```
