```lua
local END_FRAME = 320000
-- walk4's exact timings on the road maps; generous only on 0x35
local STUCK_ROAD = 1100
local MARK_ROAD = 5400
-- exportmap exit tiles per fingerprint triple (walk4/5 findings); the
-- generic goal stays the north bound for fingerprints not listed here
local EXIT_GOALS = {
	["35/0800/40"] = { { x = 22, y = 39 }, { x = 22, y = 14 } },
}
local PLAN0 = 28900        -- planner start (0x250 arrival clearing)
local STUCK = STUCK_ROAD         -- frames without tile progress before a mark
local MARK_TTL = MARK_ROAD
local EDGE_GIVEUP = 7200   -- pushing a bound column this long = try another

local OPEN_ATTR = {
	[0x00]=1,[0x01]=1,[0x02]=1,[0x03]=1,[0x04]=1,[0x05]=1,[0x07]=1,
	[0x08]=1,[0x09]=1,[0x0C]=1,[0x20]=1,[0x21]=1,[0x22]=1,[0x23]=1,
	[0x24]=1,[0x25]=1,[0x26]=1,[0x27]=1,[0x29]=1,[0x2A]=1,[0x2B]=1,
	[0x2C]=1,[0x2D]=1,[0x2F]=1,[0x30]=1,[0x34]=1,[0x35]=1,
	[0x40]=1,[0x41]=1,[0x42]=1,[0x43]=1,[0x44]=1,[0x45]=1,[0x46]=1,
	[0x47]=1,[0x48]=1,[0x49]=1,[0x4A]=1,[0x4B]=1,[0x4C]=1,[0x4D]=1,
	[0x4E]=1,[0x4F]=1,[0x52]=1,
	[0x60]=1,[0x61]=1,[0x62]=1,[0x63]=1,[0x64]=1,[0x65]=1,[0x66]=1,
	[0x67]=1,[0x68]=1,[0x69]=1,[0x6A]=1,[0x6B]=1,[0x6C]=1,[0x6D]=1,
	[0x6E]=1,[0x6F]=1,[0x70]=1,[0x71]=1,[0x72]=1,[0x73]=1,[0x74]=1,
	[0x75]=1,[0x76]=1,[0x77]=1,[0x78]=1,[0x79]=1,[0x7A]=1,[0x7B]=1,
	[0x7C]=1,
	[0x80]=1,[0x81]=1,[0x82]=1,[0x83]=1,[0x84]=1,
}

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local fp = nil             -- fingerprint triple string
local plan = nil
local lastTX, lastTY = -1, -1
local stuckSince = 0
local blocked = {}         -- "x,y" -> frame laid
local edgeHold = 0
local loaneAt = nil
local caps = 0
local gwN = 0
local geoAt = nil          -- frame to emit the GEO line + bank dump
local geoFp = nil
local noplanAt = nil
local roadAt = nil         -- frames spent idle on an unresolvable road

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end
-- DO NOT define onSceneMap (or any wr() user) above `local wr/wr16`: a
-- helper defined earlier captures the nil GLOBAL and NAV-ERRORs every
-- frame in the inputPolled pcall, which skips emu.setInput every frame -
-- walk7's original run had dead input for all 320k frames this way (the
-- "SRAM continue" it recorded was the unattended boot).
local function onSceneMap() return wr(0xD2E3) == 0x35 end

local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

print("WALK4-LOANE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- write-watch: the walk buffers $7F:0000-$7F:3FFF (low buffer, attr
-- grids of every load size, footprint buffer head)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < 20000 or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("GW frame=%d off=%04X val=%02X pc=%02X/%04X",
			frames, addr - 0x10000, val or 0, st.k, st.pc))
		gwN = gwN + 1
		if gwN % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end)
	if not ok then print("GWC-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x10000, 0x13FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < (onSceneMap() and 1000000000 or MARK_ROAD) then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest exit-tile goal if this fingerprint has one,
		-- else the nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				local goals = EXIT_GOALS[fp]
				if goals then
					for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, g.x, g.y) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, g.x, g.y)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				else
					for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk on 0x35 only (the road maps stay walk4-exact)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if onSceneMap() and waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				local stuckLim = onSceneMap() and 3600 or STUCK_ROAD
				if frames - stuckSince > stuckLim and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3)
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if onSceneMap() and frames % 600 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d",
			frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520),
			wr(0x76), px, py))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/walk8loane.lua`:

```lua
-- walk8loane.lua - walk round 8 = walk7 plus, on the 0x35 scene map:
-- every 600 frames a STATE line ($D51B event id, $D51D frame-record PC,
-- $76, position, bounds) so the reload-loop VM fragment can be named,
-- and an input ladder (A / START / B / down-hold windows) whenever the
-- planner is out of moves, to find what the loop waits for.
-- walk7loane.lua - walk round 7: walk4's exact band behavior (STUCK 1100 /
-- MARK_TTL 5400 on the road maps — that run deterministically reached the
-- 0x253 ambush scene at frame 90433) plus walk5/6's experiments applied
-- ONLY on the post-ambush map 0x35 (bump-talk A bursts, permanent marks,
-- exit-tile goals (22,39) -> 0x0DA / (22,14) -> 0x0E1 from exportmap).
--
-- walk6 = walk5 plus permanent stuck marks and exit-tile goals. Round 5 finding: map 0x35 (the post-ambush scene map,
-- fp 35/0800/40, bounds X [18,49) Y [4,60)) refuses the party's north
-- steps into (20,57) permanently while the model calls it open (attr 00);
-- walk4's 5400-frame mark TTL kept expiring, so the planner re-picked the
-- refused shortest path forever and never routed through the neighbours.
-- Round 6 marks never expire, and on known fingerprints the goals come
-- from exportmap's exit tiles (0x35: (22,14) -> 0x0E1, (22,39) -> 0x0DA)
-- instead of the north bound: this map's way out is an exit tile, not an
-- edge event.
--
-- walk round 5 = walk4 plus bump-talk: on a blocked
-- direction the walker presses A while holding it (journey NPCs stand
-- on the exit tiles and only move for talk/dialog input), holds the
-- push longer before laying a mark (1100 -> 3600 frames) and keeps
-- marks for 20000 frames (round 4's 5400 expired mid-loop on 0x253's
-- (41,36) pocket and re-entered it). Round-4 state that motivated this:
-- the chain crossed 0x250 (edge event) -> camp 0x24E -> road 0x253 and
-- walked 88 tiles north to rows 37-38, where steps north were refused
-- until a scripted transition (frame 90433) delivered map 0x35
-- (cfg 35/0800/40, bounds X [18,49) Y [4,60)), where the party sits at
-- tile (20,58) with BFS-open-but-refused north steps.
--
-- walk round 4: GENERIC planner-driven walk of the
-- camp-journey chain. Round 3 (walk3loane.lua) reached the 0x250 north
-- edge, fired the edge event 084E, arrived at camp 0x24E (31,21) and
-- stopped: the chain then mapJumps to road map 0x253 (64x128, cfg 02 —
-- the cfg fingerprint COLLIDES with 0x250's; round 3 misidentified it
-- and sat out the camp timeout).
--
-- Round 4 reads the walk model LIVE from WRAM instead of embedding
-- grids, so any chain map works:
--   * attr grid: WRAM $7F:(D0D5>>1), W = D0D1, H = (D0D5>>1)/W;
--     winorigin2.lua proved tile = (px>>3, py>>3) and the grid is the
--     full map, never rewritten after load;
--   * low buffer: WRAM $7F:0000, bit 3 = event point (blocks);
--   * walkable attrs = the move gate's F9:A400 table rows, precomputed
--     for a zone-0 party with all quadrant bits clear (mapfmt
--     AttrWalkable; the 86-entry open set below);
--   * bounds $D2EE/$D2F0 (Y), $D2EF/$D2F1 (X) are TILE margins;
--   * map state = the fingerprint TRIPLE (cfg $D2E3, D0C5, D0D1) —
--     cfg alone collides (02 = 0x250 AND 0x253).
--
-- Goal heuristic per road map: BFS to the nearest walkable tile on the
-- north bound row (y == $D2EE), then hold up to push the edge event
-- (0x250's event fired exactly this way; no event-point tiles exist on
-- these maps). Camp (cfg 0x2E): wait, the chain advances by itself.
-- Loane (cfg 0x13): capture bank $7F + OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot
-- (townsfolk blob pin, docs/sprites.md) and stop.
--
-- Battle policy: SPC BGM watch (song 1 = battle) + A mash every 30
-- frames after 420 battle frames; busy ($76 != 0): A tap every 30.

local END_FRAME = 320000
-- walk4's exact timings on the road maps; generous only on 0x35
local STUCK_ROAD = 1100
local MARK_ROAD = 5400
-- exportmap exit tiles per fingerprint triple (walk4/5 findings); the
-- generic goal stays the north bound for fingerprints not listed here
local EXIT_GOALS = {
	["35/0800/40"] = { { x = 22, y = 39 }, { x = 22, y = 14 } },
}
local PLAN0 = 28900        -- planner start (0x250 arrival clearing)
local STUCK = STUCK_ROAD         -- frames without tile progress before a mark
local MARK_TTL = MARK_ROAD
local EDGE_GIVEUP = 7200   -- pushing a bound column this long = try another

local OPEN_ATTR = {
	[0x00]=1,[0x01]=1,[0x02]=1,[0x03]=1,[0x04]=1,[0x05]=1,[0x07]=1,
	[0x08]=1,[0x09]=1,[0x0C]=1,[0x20]=1,[0x21]=1,[0x22]=1,[0x23]=1,
	[0x24]=1,[0x25]=1,[0x26]=1,[0x27]=1,[0x29]=1,[0x2A]=1,[0x2B]=1,
	[0x2C]=1,[0x2D]=1,[0x2F]=1,[0x30]=1,[0x34]=1,[0x35]=1,
	[0x40]=1,[0x41]=1,[0x42]=1,[0x43]=1,[0x44]=1,[0x45]=1,[0x46]=1,
	[0x47]=1,[0x48]=1,[0x49]=1,[0x4A]=1,[0x4B]=1,[0x4C]=1,[0x4D]=1,
	[0x4E]=1,[0x4F]=1,[0x52]=1,
	[0x60]=1,[0x61]=1,[0x62]=1,[0x63]=1,[0x64]=1,[0x65]=1,[0x66]=1,
	[0x67]=1,[0x68]=1,[0x69]=1,[0x6A]=1,[0x6B]=1,[0x6C]=1,[0x6D]=1,
	[0x6E]=1,[0x6F]=1,[0x70]=1,[0x71]=1,[0x72]=1,[0x73]=1,[0x74]=1,
	[0x75]=1,[0x76]=1,[0x77]=1,[0x78]=1,[0x79]=1,[0x7A]=1,[0x7B]=1,
	[0x7C]=1,
	[0x80]=1,[0x81]=1,[0x82]=1,[0x83]=1,[0x84]=1,
}

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil

local fp = nil             -- fingerprint triple string
local plan = nil
local lastTX, lastTY = -1, -1
local stuckSince = 0
local blocked = {}         -- "x,y" -> frame laid
local edgeHold = 0
local loaneAt = nil
local caps = 0
local gwN = 0
local geoAt = nil          -- frame to emit the GEO line + bank dump
local geoFp = nil
local noplanAt = nil
local roadAt = nil         -- frames spent idle on an unresolvable road
local busySince = nil
local lastBusy = false

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function onSceneMap() return wr(0xD2E3) == 0x35 end
local function leader() return wr16(0xD9AA), wr16(0xD9AC) end

local function fingerprint()
	return string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X", wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1))
end

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

print("WALK4-LOANE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- NOTE: no $7F write watch in this round - the GW line volume throttled
-- the emulator to ~25 fps; the streaming question is settled (zero
-- post-load writes, winorigin2) and the settled grids come from the
-- GEO hook's bank dumps below.

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < (onSceneMap() and 1000000000 or MARK_ROAD) then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest exit-tile goal if this fingerprint has one,
		-- else the nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				local goals = EXIT_GOALS[fp]
				if goals then
					for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, g.x, g.y) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, g.x, g.y)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				else
					for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
					-- input ladder on the scene map: A for a while, then
					-- START, then B, then a down hold, cycling per 2400
					if onSceneMap() then
						local ph = math.floor(frames / 2400) % 4
						if ph == 0 then p = { a = 1 }
						elseif ph == 1 and frames % 60 == 0 then p = { start = 1 }
						elseif ph == 2 and frames % 60 == 0 then p = { b = 1 }
						elseif ph == 3 then p = { down = 1 } end
					end
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk on 0x35 only (the road maps stay walk4-exact)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if onSceneMap() and waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				local stuckLim = onSceneMap() and 3600 or STUCK_ROAD
				if frames - stuckSince > stuckLim and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3)
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- busy-stall breaker: when a busy stretch outlives 12000 frames,
	-- cycle START / B / down / A windows (dialog ladders that plain
	-- A taps do not advance)
	local busyNow = busy
	if busyNow and not lastBusy then busySince = frames end
	if not busyNow then busySince = nil end
	lastBusy = busyNow
	if busyNow and busySince ~= nil and frames - busySince > 12000 then
		local ph = math.floor((frames - busySince - 12000) / 1200) % 4
		if ph == 0 and frames % 60 == 0 then p = { start = 1 }
		elseif ph == 1 and frames % 60 == 0 then p = { b = 1 }
		elseif ph == 2 then p = { down = 1 }
		end
	end

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames % 600 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
			frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520),
			wr(0x76), px, py, wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/walk9loane.lua`:

```lua
-- walk9loane.lua - walk round 9 = walk7 with the 0x35 scene map idle:
-- walk4's 0x35 log shows the party stepping north only in the frames
-- right after the ~8300-frame map reloads (164183 after the 162984
-- reload, 179701 after 179602), suggesting a scripted puppet walk that
-- the walker's own up-holds fight. Round 9 sends NO input on
-- 0x35 (busy-A taps only) and keeps the STATE sampler.
-- walk7loane.lua - walk round 7: walk4's exact band behavior (STUCK 1100 /
-- MARK_TTL 5400 on the road maps — that run deterministically reached the
-- 0x253 ambush scene at frame 90433) plus walk5/6's experiments applied
-- ONLY on the post-ambush map 0x35 (bump-talk A bursts, permanent marks,
-- exit-tile goals (22,39) -> 0x0DA / (22,14) -> 0x0E1 from exportmap).
--
-- walk6 = walk5 plus permanent stuck marks and exit-tile goals. Round 5 finding: map 0x35 (the post-ambush scene map,
-- fp 35/0800/40, bounds X [18,49) Y [4,60)) refuses the party's north
-- steps into (20,57) permanently while the model calls it open (attr 00);
-- walk4's 5400-frame mark TTL kept expiring, so the planner re-picked the
-- refused shortest path forever and never routed through the neighbours.
-- Round 6 marks never expire, and on known fingerprints the goals come
-- from exportmap's exit tiles (0x35: (22,14) -> 0x0E1, (22,39) -> 0x0DA)
-- instead of the north bound: this map's way out is an exit tile, not an
-- edge event.
--
-- walk round 5 = walk4 plus bump-talk: on a blocked
-- direction the walker presses A while holding it (journey NPCs stand
-- on the exit tiles and only move for talk/dialog input), holds the
-- push longer before laying a mark (1100 -> 3600 frames) and keeps
-- marks for 20000 frames (round 4's 5400 expired mid-loop on 0x253's
-- (41,36) pocket and re-entered it). Round-4 state that motivated this:
-- the chain crossed 0x250 (edge event) -> camp 0x24E -> road 0x253 and
-- walked 88 tiles north to rows 37-38, where steps north were refused
-- until a scripted transition (frame 90433) delivered map 0x35
-- (cfg 35/0800/40, bounds X [18,49) Y [4,60)), where the party sits at
-- tile (20,58) with BFS-open-but-refused north steps.

-- walk round 4: GENERIC planner-driven walk of the
-- camp-journey chain. Round 3 (walk3loane.lua) reached the 0x250 north
-- edge, fired the edge event 084E, arrived at camp 0x24E (31,21) and
-- stopped: the chain then mapJumps to road map 0x253 (64x128, cfg 02 —
-- the cfg fingerprint COLLIDES with 0x250's; round 3 misidentified it
-- and sat out the camp timeout).
--
-- Round 4 reads the walk model LIVE from WRAM instead of embedding
-- grids, so any chain map works:
--   * attr grid: WRAM $7F:(D0D5>>1), W = D0D1, H = (D0D5>>1)/W;
--     winorigin2.lua proved tile = (px>>3, py>>3) and the grid is the
--     full map, never rewritten after load;
--   * low buffer: WRAM $7F:0000, bit 3 = event point (blocks);
--   * walkable attrs = the move gate's F9:A400 table rows, precomputed
--     for a zone-0 party with all quadrant bits clear (mapfmt
--     AttrWalkable; the 86-entry open set below);
--   * bounds $D2EE/$D2F0 (Y), $D2EF/$D2F1 (X) are TILE margins;
--   * map state = the fingerprint TRIPLE (cfg $D2E3, D0C5, D0D1) —
--     cfg alone collides (02 = 0x250 AND 0x253).
--
-- Goal heuristic per road map: BFS to the nearest walkable tile on the
-- north bound row (y == $D2EE), then hold up to push the edge event
-- (0x250's event fired exactly this way; no event-point tiles exist on
-- these maps). Camp (cfg 0x2E): wait, the chain advances by itself.
-- Loane (cfg 0x13): capture bank $7F + OAM/CGRAM/VRAM/screenshot
-- (townsfolk blob pin, docs/sprites.md) and stop.
--
-- Battle policy: SPC BGM watch (song 1 = battle) + A mash every 30
-- frames after 420 battle frames; busy ($76 != 0): A tap every 30.

local END_FRAME = 320000

local STUCK_ROAD = 1100
local MARK_ROAD = 5400
-- exportmap exit tiles per fingerprint triple (walk4/5 findings); the
-- generic goal stays the north bound for fingerprints not listed here

	["35/0800/40"] = { { x = 22, y = 39 }, { x = 22, y = 14 } },
}

local STUCK = STUCK_ROAD         -- frames without tile progress before a mark
local MARK_TTL = MARK_ROAD
local EDGE_GIVEUP = 7200   -- pushing a bound column this long = try another

	[0x00]=1,[0x01]=1,[0x02]=1,[0x03]=1,[0x04]=1,[0x05]=1,[0x07]=1,
	[0x08]=1,[0x09]=1,[0x0C]=1,[0x20]=1,[0x21]=1,[0x22]=1,[0x23]=1,
	[0x24]=1,[0x25]=1,[0x26]=1,[0x27]=1,[0x29]=1,[0x2A]=1,[0x2B]=1,
	[0x2C]=1,[0x2D]=1,[0x2F]=1,[0x30]=1,[0x34]=1,[0x35]=1,
	[0x40]=1,[0x41]=1,[0x42]=1,[0x43]=1,[0x44]=1,[0x45]=1,[0x46]=1,
	[0x47]=1,[0x48]=1,[0x49]=1,[0x4A]=1,[0x4B]=1,[0x4C]=1,[0x4D]=1,
	[0x4E]=1,[0x4F]=1,[0x52]=1,
	[0x60]=1,[0x61]=1,[0x62]=1,[0x63]=1,[0x64]=1,[0x65]=1,[0x66]=1,
	[0x67]=1,[0x68]=1,[0x69]=1,[0x6A]=1,[0x6B]=1,[0x6C]=1,[0x6D]=1,
	[0x6E]=1,[0x6F]=1,[0x70]=1,[0x71]=1,[0x72]=1,[0x73]=1,[0x74]=1,
	[0x75]=1,[0x76]=1,[0x77]=1,[0x78]=1,[0x79]=1,[0x7A]=1,[0x7B]=1,

	[0x80]=1,[0x81]=1,[0x82]=1,[0x83]=1,[0x84]=1,
}

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump_bytes(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function dump_bank7f(name)
	dump_bytes(name, function(i) return wr(0x10000 + i) end, 0x8000)
end

print("WALK4-LOANE-LOADED")
flush_pad()

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 == 3 then
				print("VICTORY frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- write-watch: the walk buffers $7F:0000-$7F:3FFF (low buffer, attr
-- grids of every load size, footprint buffer head)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < 20000 or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("GW frame=%d off=%04X val=%02X pc=%02X/%04X",
			frames, addr - 0x10000, val or 0, st.k, st.pc))
		gwN = gwN + 1
		if gwN % 1500 == 0 then flush_pad() end
	end)
	if not ok then print("GWC-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x10000, 0x13FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- live walk model
local function grid()
	local w = wr(0xD0D1)
	local base = math.floor(wr16(0xD0D5) / 2)
	return w, math.floor(base / w), base
end

local function tileWalkable(w, base, x, y)
	if x < 0 or y < 0 or x >= w then return false end
	local t = blocked[x .. "," .. y]
	if t ~= nil and frames - t < (onSceneMap() and 1000000000 or MARK_ROAD) then return false end
	local attr = wr(0x10000 + base + y * w + x)
	if OPEN_ATTR[attr] == nil then return false end
	local low = wr(0x10000 + y * w + x)
	if math.floor(low / 8) % 2 == 1 then return false end -- low buffer bit 3
	return true
end

local function bfs(w, base, h, sx, sy, gx, gy)
	local prev = {}
	local seen = {}
	local q = { { sx, sy } }
	seen[sx .. "," .. sy] = true
	while #q > 0 do
		local cur = table.remove(q, 1)
		if cur[1] == gx and cur[2] == gy then
			local path = {}
			local k = gx .. "," .. gy
			while k do
				local pxs, pys = k:match("(-?%d+),(-?%d+)")
				path[#path + 1] = { x = tonumber(pxs), y = tonumber(pys) }
				k = prev[k]
			end
			local rev = {}
			for i = #path, 1, -1 do rev[#rev + 1] = path[i] end
			return rev
		end
		local dirs = { { 1, 0 }, { -1, 0 }, { 0, 1 }, { 0, -1 } }
		for _, d in ipairs(dirs) do
			local nx, ny = cur[1] + d[1], cur[2] + d[2]
			local k = nx .. "," .. ny
			if not seen[k] and ny < h and tileWalkable(w, base, nx, ny) then
				seen[k] = true
				prev[k] = cur[1] .. "," .. cur[2]
				q[#q + 1] = { nx, ny }
			end
		end
	end
	return nil
end

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	local cfg = wr(0xD2E3)
	local cur_fp = fingerprint()

	if cur_fp ~= fp then
		fp = cur_fp
		plan = nil
		edgeHold = 0
		roadAt = nil
		print(string.format("MAPLOAD frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d", frames, cur_fp, leader()))
		flush_pad()
		if cfg == 0x2E then
			print(string.format("CAMP-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		elseif cfg == 0x13 then
			loaneAt = frames
			print(string.format("LOANE-ARRIVED frame=%d leader=(%d,%d)", frames, leader()))
			flush_pad()
		end
		geoAt = frames + 1800
		geoFp = cur_fp
	end
	if geoAt ~= nil and frames >= geoAt then
		geoAt = nil
		if fingerprint() == geoFp then
			local lx, ly = leader()
			print(string.format("GEO frame=%d fp=%s D0C5=%04X D0D1=%02X D0D5=%04X leader=(%d,%d) EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X",
				frames, geoFp, wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr16(0xD0D5), lx, ly,
				wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)))
			dump_bank7f(string.format("b7f_f%d_cfg%02X_%04X_%02X", frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr16(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1)))
			flush_pad()
		end
	end

	local px, py = leader()

	if frames >= PLAN0 and loaneAt == nil and not battle and not busy and cfg ~= 0x2E and not onSceneMap() then
		local w, h, base = grid()
		if w == 0 or w == 0xFF then
			-- no map loaded (title/intro edges): keep the intro presses
			if p == nil then emu.setInput({ start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0) end
			return
		end
		local ee, ef, f0, f1 = wr(0xD2EE), wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1)
		local tx = math.floor(px / 8)
		local ty = math.floor(py / 8)
		if tx < ef then tx = ef end
		if tx >= f1 then tx = f1 - 1 end
		if ty < ee then ty = ee end
		if ty >= f0 then ty = f0 - 1 end

		if tx ~= lastTX or ty ~= lastTY then
			print(string.format("MOVE frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) px=(%d,%d)", frames, tx, ty, px, py))
			flush_pad()
			stuckSince = 0
		end

		-- plan: nearest exit-tile goal if this fingerprint has one,
		-- else the nearest walkable tile on the north bound row
		if plan == nil or #plan == 0 then
			if ty > ee then
				local best = nil
				local goals = EXIT_GOALS[fp]
				if goals then
					for _, g in ipairs(goals) do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, g.x, g.y) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, g.x, g.y)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				else
					for x = ef, f1 - 1 do
						if tileWalkable(w, base, x, ee) then
							local cand = bfs(w, base, h, tx, ty, x, ee)
							if cand and (best == nil or #cand < #best) then best = cand end
						end
					end
				end
				plan = best
				if plan == nil then
					if noplanAt == nil or frames - noplanAt > 2400 then
						noplanAt = frames
						print(string.format("NOPLAN frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) grid=%dx%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, w, h))
						flush_pad()
					end
					roadAt = (roadAt or frames)
				else
					print(string.format("PLAN frame=%d tile=(%d,%d) len=%d goal=(%d,%d)",
						frames, tx, ty, #plan, plan[#plan].x, plan[#plan].y))
					flush_pad()
				end
			else
				plan = {}
			end
		end

		local dir = nil
		if ty <= ee then
			-- at the north bound: push the edge event
			dir = "up"
			edgeHold = edgeHold + 1
			if edgeHold == 1 or edgeHold % 600 == 0 then
				print(string.format("EDGE-HOLD frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) hold=%d", frames, fp, tx, ty, edgeHold))
				flush_pad()
			end
			if edgeHold > EDGE_GIVEUP then
				blocked[tx .. "," .. ty] = frames
				plan = nil
				edgeHold = 0
				print(string.format("EDGE-TRY-NEXT frame=%d column=%d marked", frames, tx))
				flush_pad()
			end
		elseif plan and #plan > 0 then
			while #plan > 0 and plan[1].x == tx and plan[1].y == ty do
				table.remove(plan, 1)
			end
			local nxt = plan[1]
			if nxt then
				local dx, dy = nxt.x - tx, nxt.y - ty
				if dy < 0 then dir = "up"
				elseif dy > 0 then dir = "down"
				elseif dx < 0 then dir = "left"
				elseif dx > 0 then dir = "right" end
			end
		end
		if dir then
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
			if tx == lastTX and ty == lastTY then
				if stuckSince == 0 then stuckSince = frames end
				-- bump-talk on 0x35 only (the road maps stay walk4-exact)
				local waited = frames - stuckSince
				if onSceneMap() and waited > 1100 and waited % 360 < 120 then
					p = { [dir] = 1, a = 1 }
				end
				local stuckLim = onSceneMap() and 3600 or STUCK_ROAD
				if frames - stuckSince > stuckLim and edgeHold == 0 then
					local dmap = { up = { 0, -1 }, down = { 0, 1 }, left = { -1, 0 }, right = { 1, 0 } }
					local bx, by = tx + dmap[dir][1], ty + dmap[dir][2]
					print(string.format("STUCK frame=%d fp=%s tile=(%d,%d) dir=%s -> mark (%d,%d)",
						frames, fp, tx, ty, dir, bx, by))
					flush_pad()
					blocked[bx .. "," .. by] = frames
					plan = nil
					stuckSince = 0
				end
			end
		end
		lastTX, lastTY = tx, ty
	elseif frames >= PLAN0 and (battle or busy) then
		-- battle A-mash and busy A taps run on every map, camp included
		-- (the camp dialogs advanced on them in round 3)
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		end
	end

	-- Loane captures
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps < 3 and frames >= loaneAt + 1500 + caps * 1600 then
		caps = caps + 1
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d cap=%d 76=%02X fp=%s leader=(%d,%d) D0D1=%02X",
			frames, caps, wr(0x76), fp, lx, ly, wr(0xD0D1)))
		dump_bytes("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump_bytes("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump_bytes("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		flush_pad()
	end

	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s caps=%d",
			frames, fp or "?", px, py, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), caps))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if onSceneMap() and frames % 600 == 0 then
		print(string.format("STATE frame=%d D51B=%04X D51D=%02X%02X%02X%02X 76=%02X px=%d py=%d",
			frames, wr16(0xD51B), wr(0xD51D), wr(0xD51E), wr(0xD51F), wr(0xD520),
			wr(0x76), px, py))
		flush_pad()
	end

	local stop = false
	if loaneAt ~= nil and caps >= 3 then stop = true end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then stop = true end
	if stop then
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d fp=%s px=%d py=%d caps=%d", frames, fp or "?", px, py, caps))
		print("WALK4-LOANE-FINISHED")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("NAV-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
		flush_pad()
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/walkfig.lua`:

```lua
-- walkfig5.lua - retry-queue up/left figure capture.
--
-- walkfig4 won its battles (chain_walk.lua's BGM-dispatch detection +
-- A-mash policy) but its fixed-time legs were eaten by the road's random
-- encounters (about one battle per 3500 field frames). This run keeps
-- the battle policy and drives the legs from a retry queue instead:
-- each leg is held 900 frames, followed by a 300-frame standing capture
-- window (3 shots); a battle interrupting a leg puts it back on the
-- queue. The run ends once both facings have a clean window or at
-- LAST_FRAME. Offline, the clean standing shots per facing are picked by
-- map-render alignment (battle shots fail alignment).
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/walkfig5.lua -timeout=1200

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local CUTSCENE_SONG = 41
local VICTORY_SONG = 3

local WALK_FROM = 35000
local LEG_FRAMES = 900
local WIN_FRAMES = 300
local LAST_FRAME = 78000

local queue = { "up", "left", "up", "left", "up", "left", "up", "left" }
local qi = 1
-- phase: "leg" (holding the direction), "win" (standing capture window)
local phase = nil
local phaseStart = 0
local facing = nil
local legDone = {}       -- facing -> completed clean window count
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local lastBattleEnd = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil

local frames = 0
local done = false

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = {
			math.floor(n / 262144) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64,
			n % 64,
		}
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, s)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end

local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
	elseif id ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and id ~= VICTORY_SONG
		and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		battle_start = nil
		lastBattleEnd = frames
		print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
		-- the leg in progress is void; redo it (queue index stays)
		phase = nil
	end
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

print("WALKFIG-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { down = 1 }
				if math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 == 1 then
					p = { right = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local idle = p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and not battle and frames > lastBattleEnd + 300
	if idle and phase == nil and qi <= #queue then
		phase = "leg"
		phaseStart = frames
		facing = queue[qi]
		print(string.format("LEG-START frame=%d facing=%s", frames, facing))
	end
	if idle and phase == "leg" then
		p = { [facing] = 1 }
		if frames - phaseStart >= LEG_FRAMES then
			phase = "win"
			phaseStart = frames
			print(string.format("WIN-START frame=%d facing=%s", frames, facing))
		end
	end
	if p == nil and battle then
		local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
		if bt > 420 and frames % 30 == 0 then
			p = { a = 1 }
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if phase == "win" and frames > lastBattleEnd + 300 and not battle then
		if frames % 100 == 0 then
			print(string.format("STATE frame=%d facing=%s busy=%d battle=%s",
				frames, facing, wr(0x76), tostring(battle)))
			dump("shot", emu.takeScreenshot())
		end
		if frames - phaseStart >= WIN_FRAMES then
			legDone[facing] = (legDone[facing] or 0) + 1
			print(string.format("WIN-DONE frame=%d facing=%s done_up=%d done_left=%d",
				frames, facing, legDone.up or 0, legDone.left or 0))
			qi = qi + 1
			phase = nil
		end
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("WALKFIG-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)

```

`tools/emulator/walknpc.lua`:

```lua
-- walknpc.lua - NPC walk-figure capture on maps 0x249 (village exit) and
-- 0x250 (street). Same verified timeline as walkfig.lua (new-game boot
-- presses, battle-detecting A-mash, retry-queue legs), but screenshots
-- also land during the 20800-34500 down/right crossing: the party walks
-- the full length of map 0x249 and passes the placed NPC (g=99) at
-- (16,63) right before crossing into 0x250, whose ten NPCs (g=76 x5,
-- g=84 x5) sit along the leg route. Standing windows give party-still
-- pairs (the only moving diff is the wandering NPC); crossing shots give
-- the 0x249 NPC via alignment against exports/data/maps/0249/map.png.
--
-- STATE lines carry the map-load fingerprint $D2E3/$D0C5/$D0D1 so shots
-- can be grouped per map load offline (the map-id cell is scratch during
-- walks - ground_shots249.lua).
--
-- Run: tools/emulator/run.sh tools/emulator/walknpc.lua -timeout=1500

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local BATTLE_SONG = 1
local CUTSCENE_SONG = 41
local VICTORY_SONG = 3

local WALK_FROM = 35000
local LEG_FRAMES = 900
local WIN_FRAMES = 300
local LAST_FRAME = 78000

local queue = { "up", "left", "up", "left", "up", "left", "up", "left" }
local qi = 1
-- phase: "cross" (20800-34500 walk program), "leg", "win"
local phase = nil
local phaseStart = 0
local facing = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local lastBattleEnd = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil

local frames = 0
local done = false

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"

	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do

		local c = {
			math.floor(n / 262144) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64,
			n % 64,
		}
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end

	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, s)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end

local function detect_bgm(id)
	if id == nil or id == last_bgm then return end
	last_bgm = id
	print(string.format("BGM frame=%d id=%d", frames, id))
	if id == BATTLE_SONG then
		battle = true
		battle_start = frames
		print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
	elseif id ~= CUTSCENE_SONG and id ~= VICTORY_SONG
		and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
		battle = false
		battle_start = nil
		lastBattleEnd = frames
		print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
		-- the leg in progress is void; redo it (queue index stays)
		phase = nil
	end
end

emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then
		port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 then
			detect_bgm(port1)
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

print("WALKNPC-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
		if busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then
				p = { a = 1 }
			end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { down = 1 }
				if math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 == 1 then
					p = { right = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local idle = p == nil and frames >= WALK_FROM and not battle and frames > lastBattleEnd + 300
	if idle and phase == nil and qi <= #queue then
		phase = "leg"
		phaseStart = frames
		facing = queue[qi]
		print(string.format("LEG-START frame=%d facing=%s", frames, facing))
	end
	if idle and phase == "leg" then
		p = { [facing] = 1 }
		if frames - phaseStart >= LEG_FRAMES then
			phase = "win"
			phaseStart = frames
			print(string.format("WIN-START frame=%d facing=%s", frames, facing))
		end
	end
	if p == nil and battle then
		local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
		if bt > 420 and frames % 30 == 0 then
			p = { a = 1 }
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	-- cross: the down/right walk program, one shot per 100 frames
	if frames >= 20800 and frames < 34500 and not battle then
		if frames % 100 == 0 then
			print(string.format("STATE frame=%d fp=%02X/%02X/%02X busy=%d battle=%s",
				frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr(0x76), tostring(battle)))
			dump("shot", emu.takeScreenshot())
		end
	end
	if phase == "win" and frames > lastBattleEnd + 300 and not battle then
		if frames % 100 == 0 then
			print(string.format("STATE frame=%d fp=%02X/%02X/%02X busy=%d battle=%s",
				frames, wr(0xD2E3), wr(0xD0C5), wr(0xD0D1), wr(0x76), tostring(battle)))
			dump("shot", emu.takeScreenshot())
		end
		if frames - phaseStart >= WIN_FRAMES then
			print(string.format("WIN-DONE frame=%d facing=%s", frames, facing))
			qi = qi + 1
			phase = nil
		end
	end
	if frames >= LAST_FRAME and not done then
		done = true
		print("WALKNPC-DONE")
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

```lua
-- walknpc2.lua - second NPC capture run. Every 100 frames a screenshot
-- plus a STATE line with the party tile position from WRAM B910/B911

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = {
			math.floor(n / 262144) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 4096) % 64,
			math.floor(n / 64) % 64,
			n % 64,
		}
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, s)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end
```

`tools/emulator/watch_probe.lua`:

```lua
-- watch_probe.lua: which emu.addMemoryCallback form fires on WRAM writes to the
-- VM script PC ($78-$7A), plus the S-CPU -> SPC command trace on $2140-$2143.
--
-- Watch forms under test (all attached once, on first $76==1, never detached):
--   W1 write cb, memType=snesWorkRam, addr 0x78-0x7A   (raw WRAM offsets)
--   W2 write cb, memType=snesMemory,  addr 0x7E0078-7A (CPU-form, bank $7E)
--   W3 write cb, memType=snesMemory,  addr 0x0078-7A   (CPU-form, bank $00/direct page)
--   X1 exec  cb, memType=snesMemory,  addr 0xC01B50    (dispatch store, raw read inside)
--   W4 write cb, memType=snesMemory,  addr 0x2140-2143 (S-CPU->SPC command ports)
-- Control: per-frame raw-offset reads of the VM state (the verified read path).
--
-- Input schedule: tools/emulator/trace_events.lua timeline (boot -> new game ->
-- opening cutscene at ~10621).

local frames = 0
local done = false

local presses = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do presses[f] = { start = 1 } end
presses[7000] = { a = 1 }
presses[7800] = { a = 1 }
presses[8600] = { start = 1 }
presses[9000] = { a = 1 }
presses[9800] = { a = 1 }
presses[10600] = { a = 1 }

print("PROBE-LOADED")

local w1 = { 0, 0, 0 }
local w2 = 0
local w3 = 0
local samples = {}
local attached = false

local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc)
end

local function attach()
	if attached then return end
	attached = true
	for i, a in ipairs({ 0x78, 0x79, 0x7A }) do
		emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
			w1[i] = w1[i] + 1
			if #samples < 10 then
				samples[#samples + 1] = string.format("W1HIT frame=%d addr=%02X val=%02X at %s",
					frames, addr, val, pctag())
			end
		end, emu.callbackType.write, a, a, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	end
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
		w2 = w2 + 1
		if w2 <= 5 then
			print(string.format("W2HIT frame=%d addr=%06X val=%02X at %s", frames, addr, val, pctag()))
		end
	end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x7E0078, 0x7E007A, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
		w3 = w3 + 1
		if w3 <= 5 then
			print(string.format("W3HIT frame=%d addr=%06X val=%02X at %s", frames, addr, val, pctag()))
		end
	end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x78, 0x7A, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
		if val ~= 0 or addr ~= 0x2140 then
			local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
			print(string.format("CMD frame=%d port=%04X val=%02X at %02X:%04X A=%04X X=%04X Y=%04X",
				frames, addr, val, st.k, st.pc, st.a, st.x, st.y))
		end
	end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
	print("WATCH-ATTACHED frame=" .. frames)
end

-- X1: exec hook on the dispatch store C0:1B50, raw-offset reads inside.
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	local lo = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local hi = emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	print(string.format("X1 frame=%d D51B=%02X%02X at %02X:%04X", frames, hi, lo, st.k, st.pc))
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC01B50, 0xC01B50, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	emu.setInput(presses[frames] or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

local last_vm = nil
emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local flag = emu.read(0x76, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		if flag == 1 then attach() end
		local pc_lo = emu.read(0x78, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_hi = emu.read(0x79, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local pc_bk = emu.read(0x7A, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_lo = emu.read(0xD51B, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local ev_hi = emu.read(0xD51C, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
		local vm = string.format("%02X %02X%02X%02X %04X", flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo)
		if vm ~= last_vm then
			print(string.format("VM frame=%d 76=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X D51B=%04X",
				frames, flag, pc_bk, pc_hi, pc_lo, ev_hi * 256 + ev_lo))
			last_vm = vm
		end
		for _, s in ipairs(samples) do print(s) end
		samples = {}
		if frames % 1000 == 0 then
			print(string.format("COUNT frame=%d W1=%d,%d,%d W2=%d W3=%d", frames,
				w1[1], w1[2], w1[3], w2, w3))
		end
		if frames >= 10800 and not done then
			done = true
			print(string.format("SUMMARY W1=%d,%d,%d W2=%d W3=%d", w1[1], w1[2], w1[3], w2, w3))
			print("PROBE-DONE frames=" .. frames)
			emu.stop(0)
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("CALLBACK-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/water_sweep.lua`:

```lua
-- water_sweep.lua - sweep the north road (map 0x250) toward its row-1
-- flag-04 water-zone band and the g=84 blob townsfolk, with full captures.
--
-- Facts baked in from this session: direction holds must be ~900 frames to
-- start a walk (pos_hunt3/4: 20/120-frame holds never moved the party);
-- the walk13 program leaves the party standing somewhere on 0x250
-- ($D2E3=02, its object config); $7E:DBA8/DBE8 hold party-member x values
-- (pos_hunt5: -256/+256px on the west/east leg pair). North is the water
-- band (property block 2: flag 04 at (2,1) 239x1), so the up legs should
-- stall at the zone boundary if the zone model holds.
--
-- Program from frame 35200: alternating 900-frame up and left legs with
-- A-while-busy, 30000 frames total. Dumps (OAM+CGRAM+VRAM+WRAM+shot) every
-- 2000 frames; T lines every 100 with the tracked cells.

local ST0_FRAME = 35200
local SWEEP_END = 30000
local TRACK = { 0xDBA8, 0xDBE8, 0xDBF4, 0x0DB68 }

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local done = false

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function dump(name, readfn, count)
	local bytes = {}
	for i = 0, count - 1 do
		bytes[#bytes + 1] = string.char(readfn(i))
	end
	local s = table.concat(bytes)
	print("DUMPBEGIN " .. name)
	for i = 1, #s, 3000 do
		print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(s:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #s))))
	end
	print("DUMPEND " .. name)
end

local function wr(off)
	return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end
local function mapid()
	return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012)
end

print("SWEEP-LOADED")
print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames < ST0_FRAME then
		if p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					local prog = { "down", "right" }
					p = { [prog[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	else
		if p == nil then
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then
					p = { a = 1 }
				end
			else
				local t = frames - ST0_FRAME
				if t % 2000 < 900 then
					p = { up = 1 }
				elseif t % 2000 < 1900 then
					p = { left = 1 }
				end
			end
		end
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	if frames == ST0_FRAME then
		print(string.format("ST0 frame=%d MAP=%04X 76=%02X D2E3=%02X", frames, mapid(), wr(0x76), wr(0xD2E3)))
		print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
	end
	if frames > ST0_FRAME and frames % 100 == 0 and frames <= ST0_FRAME + SWEEP_END then
		local s = {}
		for _, o in ipairs(TRACK) do
			s[#s + 1] = string.format("%04X=%d", o, wr(o) + wr(o + 1) * 256)
		end
		print(string.format("T frame=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X PC=%02X:%02X%02X %s",
			frames, wr(0x76), mapid(), wr(0xD2E3), wr(0x7A), wr(0x79), wr(0x78),
			table.concat(s, " ")))
	end
	if frames > ST0_FRAME and frames % 2000 == 0 and frames <= ST0_FRAME + SWEEP_END then
		print(string.format("CAPSTATE frame=%d 76=%02X MAP=%04X D2E3=%02X", frames, wr(0x76), mapid(), wr(0xD2E3)))
		dump("oam", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesSpriteRam) end, 544)
		dump("cgram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesCgRam) end, 512)
		dump("vram", function(i) return emu.read(i, emu.memType.snesVideoRam) end, 32768)
		dump("wram", function(i) return wr(i) end, 131072)
		local png = emu.takeScreenshot()
		print("DUMPBEGIN shot")
		for i = 1, #png, 3000 do
			print("DUMPDATA " .. b64encode(png:sub(i, math.min(i + 2999, #png))))
		end
		print("DUMPEND shot")
		print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
	end
	if frames >= ST0_FRAME + SWEEP_END and not done then
		done = true
		print("SWEEP-DONE")
		print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096))
		emu.stop(0)
	end
end, emu.eventType.startFrame)
```

`tools/emulator/winorigin.lua`:

```lua
-- winorigin.lua - runtime verification of the walk-window origin cells
-- (docs/map-format.md "The walk grid is a camera window", open item (h)).
--
-- Watches, all with PC:
--   * write-watch on the streaming cells $D2EE-$D2F1 (window bounds in
--     8px cells per S_C0_57FF) and $D2E6/$D2E8/$D2EA/$D2EC (derived by
--     the C0:4F6E stream reader / C0:4FD0 updater: E6=(b2+16)<<3,
--     E8=(b1+17)<<3, EA=(b5-13)<<3 clamp 0x78, EC=b4)
--   * write-watch on the attr grid region $7F:1800-$7F:2FFF (raw WRAM
--     0x11800-0x12FFF) - the streamer's row rewrites while the party
--     walks, the streaming evidence
--   * 60-frame poll: leader px/py ($D9AA/$D9AC), all cells above,
--     D0D1 (stride), D591 (the updater's compare flag), D2E3 (map
--     fingerprint)
--
-- Input policy is byte-identical to pocket_probe2.lua (deterministic):
-- intro presses, down/right blind walk 20800-28900 (lands the party in
-- the 0x250 arrival clearing, py 496), then up/right 600-frame legs
-- (pocket_probe2 walked py 496->304 north into the tree band). Run
-- extends to 42000 so the stuck-at-the-band state also streams into
-- the log.

local LOG_FROM = 20000
local END_FRAME = 42000

local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local last_bgm = nil
local port1 = nil
local battle = false
local battle_start = nil
local lastPoll = nil

local function flush_pad() print("PAD " .. string.rep(".", 4096)) end
local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function leader()
	return wr(0xD9AA) + wr(0xD9AB) * 256, wr(0xD9AC) + wr(0xD9AD) * 256
end

print("WINORIGIN-LOADED")
flush_pad()

-- BGM dispatch watch (battle detection, walk2loane pattern)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	if addr == 0x2141 then port1 = val
	elseif addr == 0x2140 and port1 ~= nil then
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		if st.pc == 0x0A75 and st.k == 0xC6 and val ~= last_bgm then
			last_bgm = port1
			if port1 == 1 then
				battle = true
				battle_start = frames
				print("BATTLE-START frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			elseif port1 ~= 41 and battle and battle_start and frames > battle_start + 600 then
				battle = false
				battle_start = nil
				print("BATTLE-END frame=" .. frames)
				flush_pad()
			end
		end
		port1 = nil
	end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x2140, 0x2143, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- write-watch: the window cells $D2E6-$D2F1 (raw WRAM 0xD2E6-0xD2F1;
-- $7E:0000-$7F:FFFF map to raw 0x0000-0x1FFFF)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < LOG_FROM or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("WCELL frame=%d off=D2%02X val=%02X pc=%02X/%04X px=%d py=%d",
			frames, addr - 0xD200, val or 0, st.k, st.pc, leader()))
		flush_pad()
	end)
	if not ok then print("WCELL-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0xD2E6, 0xD2F1, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

-- write-watch: attr grid region $7F:1800-$7F:2FFF (raw WRAM 0x11800+)
emu.addMemoryCallback(function(addr, val)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		if frames < LOG_FROM or frames > END_FRAME then return end
		local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
		print(string.format("GW frame=%d off=%04X val=%02X pc=%02X/%04X",
			frames, addr - 0x10000, val or 0, st.k, st.pc))
	end)
	if not ok then print("GW-ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.callbackType.write, 0x11800, 0x12FFF, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
	frames = frames + 1
	local p = PRESSES[frames]
	local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
	if frames >= 20800 and frames < 28900 then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			local t = frames - 20800
			if t % 1000 < 900 then
				p = { [({ "down", "right" })[math.floor(t / 1000) % 2 + 1]] = 1 }
			end
		end
	elseif frames >= 28900 and frames < END_FRAME then
		if battle then
			local bt = frames - (battle_start or frames)
			if (battle_start == nil or bt > 420) and frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		elseif busy then
			if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
		else
			local t = frames - 28900
			local dir = ({ "up", "right" })[math.floor(t / 600) % 2 + 1]
			p = { [dir] = 1 }
		end
	end
	-- 60-frame poll of the window state (log on any change of the
	-- watched cells, heartbeat every 1200)
	if frames % 60 == 0 and frames >= LOG_FROM then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		local s = string.format("%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X%02X",
			wr(0xD2E6), wr(0xD2E8), wr(0xD2EA), wr(0xD2EC), wr(0xD2EE),
			wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1), wr(0xD591), wr(0xD0D1),
			wr(0xD2E3))
		if s ~= lastPoll then
			print(string.format("WIN frame=%d E6=%02X E8=%02X EA=%02X EC=%02X EE=%02X EF=%02X F0=%02X F1=%02X D591=%02X D0D1=%02X D2E3=%02X px=%d py=%d",
				frames, wr(0xD2E6), wr(0xD2E8), wr(0xD2EA), wr(0xD2EC), wr(0xD2EE),
				wr(0xD2EF), wr(0xD2F0), wr(0xD2F1), wr(0xD591), wr(0xD0D1),
				wr(0xD2E3), lx, ly))
			flush_pad()
			lastPoll = s
		end
	end
	if frames % 2400 == 0 then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("HB frame=%d px=%d py=%d busy=%s battle=%s D2E3=%02X", frames, lx, ly, tostring(busy), tostring(battle), wr(0xD2E3)))
		flush_pad()
	end
	if frames >= END_FRAME then
		local lx, ly = leader()
		print(string.format("DONE frame=%d px=%d py=%d", frames, lx, ly))
		print("WINORIGIN-DONE")
		flush_pad()
		emu.stop(0)
	end
	emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)
	end)
	if not ok then print("ERR frame=" .. frames .. " " .. tostring(err)) flush_pad() end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)
```
