`tools/emulator/wipe1.lua`:

```lua
-- wipe1.lua - force a real party wipe (defeat) and trace where the
-- engine routes it (docs/battle-defeat.md section 4 UNVERIFIED block).
--
-- FINDING (2026-11-23, logs /tmp/wipe/run1..run5): the wipe settles
-- $50=2 -> exit arm C2:08D7 -> BGM 0x0A (FE:EEFC, SPC $10/$0A) ->
-- defeat window C2:CE54 (text 0x15) -> FE:C38B packs $F4A3=$20 -> the
-- field return C0:C0B5..C108 completes cleanly (no L+R branch,
-- $7EEFFF=0) -> the post-battle event script runs (interpreter
-- C0:1B93, enqueues via C0:1C0B) and dispatches token 0x3B through the
-- C0:3AD6 table to C0:250E = SPC $F0 mute + $4200=0 + JMP $0000: a
-- full soft boot, then title (with a press) or story montage
-- (unattended). Victory control (wipe2.lua): same injection won ->
-- $F4A3=$02, map restored, NO boot - the reset is outcome-specific.
--
-- Flow: journey_teleport.lua's boot+walk verbatim to the settled field
-- (frame 34600, map 0x0249), inject fixed battle 0x0D once via the
-- queue word (docs/mesence-skip-intro.md recipe), then at battle-up+500
-- poke every living ally's battle-record HP word (record +0x14,
-- docs/battle-formulas.md 13.2) to 1 and every living enemy's HP word
-- to 9999 (keep-enemies-alive policy: no victory can fire), then A-mash
-- every 30 frames (tech_damage.lua's battle-drive policy) until lethal
-- enemy actions wipe the party and evaluator C2:9D8A settles $50/$51.
--
-- Watches:
--   write  raw WRAM 0x0950/0x0951 ($50/$51 outcome pair, battle DP
--          $0900), 0xF4A3/0xF4A4 (packed outcome FE:C38B), 0xEFFF
--          (escape grace 67:F630), 0xFFFF ($7E:FFFF handoff),
--          0xD6BB/0xD6BD/0xD6BE (field queue), 0x1C00/0x1C01 (SPC
--          command/track = BGM switch), 0x091B (battle-end flag $1B)
--   exec   C2:08D7 (wipe arm), C2:08AA (special arm), C2:0869 (victory
--          arm) of the C2:0849 jump table, C2:CE54 (defeat window),
--          C1:0296/C1:02F4 (FE screen command 0x0E/0x13 handlers),
--          FE:EEFC (BGM switch call), C0:0000 (reset boot, gated),
--          C0:C0B1-C0:C10A (field return path, gated on the $F4A3
--          write)
--
-- Run: cp -a /tmp/mesence /tmp/wipe-mesence; rm -f
-- /tmp/wipe-mesence/Saves/*.srm (cold boot); then
--   /tmp/wipe-mesence/Mesen -testRunner tools/emulator/wipe1.lua \
--     patches/bokuno_jp.sfc -enableStdout --timeout=900
-- Scratch (log, decoded screenshots): /tmp/wipe/

local BATTLE_ID = 0x0D
local SETTLE_FRAME = 34600
local INJECT_FRAME = 34700
local BATTLE_UP_TIMEOUT = 2600
local END_OBSERVE = 8000        -- frames of field observation after $F4A3
local HARD_STOP = 90000

local WALK = { "down", "right" }
local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local errruns = 0
local armed = false
local injected = false
local inject_frame = nil
local battle_up = nil
local dumped = false
local poked = false
local arm_wipe = nil            -- C2:08D7
local arm_special = nil         -- C2:08AA
local arm_vict = nil            -- C2:0869
local defeat_window = nil       -- C2:CE54
local scr0e = nil               -- C1:0296
local scr13 = nil               -- C1:02F4
local bgm_call = nil            -- FE:EEFC
local reset_boot = nil          -- C0:0000 after f4a3 (the L+R reset path)
local f4a3_seen = nil
local f4a3_val = nil
local return_snap = nil
local scr_at = {}               -- frame -> true, FRMB64 dumps
local scr_logged_size = false
local trace_lines = 0

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local CHARS = {}
for i = 0, 255 do CHARS[i] = string.char(i) end

local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end
local function mapid() return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012) end
local function bit7(v) return math.floor(v / 128) % 2 end
local function bit2(v) return math.floor(v / 4) % 2 end

local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local buf = emu.getScreenBuffer()
		if not scr_logged_size then
			scr_logged_size = true
			local ok2, sz = pcall(emu.getScreenSize)
			if ok2 and type(sz) == "table" then
				for k, v in pairs(sz) do print("SCR " .. tostring(k) .. "=" .. tostring(v)) end
			end
			print("SCRBUFLEN " .. #buf)
		end
		local parts = {}
		for i = 1, #buf do
			local v = buf[i]
			parts[#parts + 1] = CHARS[math.floor(v / 65536) % 256]
			parts[#parts + 1] = CHARS[math.floor(v / 256) % 256]
			parts[#parts + 1] = CHARS[v % 256]
		end
		print("FRMB64 f" .. frames .. " " .. b64encode(table.concat(parts)))
	end)
	if not ok then print("NAV-ERR shot " .. tostring(err)) end
end

-- ---- memory callbacks (write watches, sparse; per-tag caps) ----
local wcounts = {}
local function add_write(addr, tag, cap, gate_arm)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
		if gate_arm and arm_wipe == nil then return end
		wcounts[tag] = (wcounts[tag] or 0) + 1
		if wcounts[tag] > (cap or 400) then return end
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local pc = pctag()
			local extra = ""
			if tag == "F4A3" and battle_up == nil then
				extra = " <- pre-battle (montage), ignored"
				print(string.format("W f%d %s %02X>%02X pc=%s%s", frames, tag, wr(a), val, pc, extra))
				return
			end
			if tag == "F4A3" and val ~= 0 then
				f4a3_seen = frames
				f4a3_val = val
				scr_at[frames + 60] = true
				scr_at[frames + 600] = true
				scr_at[frames + 2400] = true
				scr_at[frames + 6000] = true
				extra = " <- OUTCOME PACKED"
			end
			if tag == "1C01" and val == 0x0A then extra = " <- BGM 0x0A track" end
			print(string.format("W f%d %s %02X>%02X pc=%s%s", frames, tag, wr(a), val, pc, extra))
			trace_lines = trace_lines + 1
		end)
		if not ok then print("NAV-ERR w" .. tag .. " " .. tostring(err)) end
	end, emu.callbackType.write, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

local xcounts = {}
local function add_exec(addr, tag, gated, cap)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		if gated == "f4a3" and (f4a3_seen == nil or battle_up == nil or f4a3_seen < battle_up) then
			return
		end
		if gated == "f4a3" and reset_boot ~= nil and addr == 0xC00000 then return end
		xcounts[tag] = (xcounts[tag] or 0) + 1
		if xcounts[tag] > (cap or 3) then return end
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local pc = pctag()
			if tag == "ARM-WIPE" then arm_wipe = frames; scr_at[frames + 150] = true end
			if tag == "ARM-SPECIAL" then arm_special = frames end
			if tag == "ARM-VICT" then arm_vict = frames end
			if tag == "DEFEAT-WIN" then
				defeat_window = frames
				scr_at[frames + 30] = true
				scr_at[frames + 70] = true
			end
			if tag == "SCR-0E" then scr0e = frames end
			if tag == "SCR-13" then scr13 = frames end
			if tag == "BGM-SW" then bgm_call = frames end
			if tag == "RESET" then
				reset_boot = frames
				local st2 = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
				for k2, v2 in pairs(st2) do
					print("RSTST " .. tostring(k2) .. "=" .. tostring(v2))
				end
				local sbytes = {}
				for i = 1, 24 do
					sbytes[#sbytes + 1] = string.format("%02X",
						emu.read((st2.sp + i) % 0x10000, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
				end
				print("RSTSTACK sp=" .. string.format("%04X", st2.sp) .. " " .. table.concat(sbytes, " "))
			end
			if tag == "ENQUEUE" then
				local st2 = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
				local rlo = emu.read((st2.sp + 1) % 0x10000, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				local rhi = emu.read((st2.sp + 2) % 0x10000, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				print(string.format("ENCALL f%d sp=%04X k=%02X return=%02X:%04X", frames,
					st2.sp, st2.k, st2.k, rlo + rhi * 256))
			end
			print(string.format("X f%d %s pc=%s", frames, tag, pc))
			trace_lines = trace_lines + 1
		end)
		if not ok then print("NAV-ERR x" .. tag .. " " .. tostring(err)) end
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

add_exec(0xC208D7, "ARM-WIPE")

-- the field return path: every instruction C0:C0B1..C0:C109 after the
-- $F4A3 write, with A; one RETURN-SNAP of the handoff cells on entry
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if f4a3_seen == nil or battle_up == nil or f4a3_seen < battle_up then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local pc, st = pctag()
		if return_snap == nil then
			return_snap = frames
			print(string.format(
				"RETURN-SNAP f%d pc=%s A=%04X f4a3=%04X 141A=%02X map=%04X 76=%02X 1B=%02X 5051=%02X%02X " ..
				"q=%02X %02X %02X 1c=%02X %02X efff=%02X 7effff=%02X",
				frames, pc, st.a, wr16(0xF4A3), wr(0x141A), mapid(), wr(0x76), wr(0x091B),
				wr(0x0950), wr(0x0951), wr(0xD6BB), wr(0xD6BD), wr(0xD6BE),
				wr(0x1C00), wr(0x1C01), wr(0xEFFF), wr(0xFFFF)))
		end
		print(string.format("RTN f%d pc=%s A=%04X X=%04X Y=%04X", frames, pc, st.a, st.x, st.y))
		trace_lines = trace_lines + 1
	end)
	if not ok then print("NAV-ERR rtn " .. tostring(err)) end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC0C0B1, 0xC0C10A, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- ---- helpers ----
local function recs_line(tag)
	local allies, enemies, deads = {}, {}, {}
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local base = 0x2280 + 0x80 * i
		allies[#allies + 1] = string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X%02X",
			wr(base), wr16(base + 0x14), wr(base + 5), wr(base + 7))
		deads[#deads + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X", i, wr(base + 7))
	end
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local base = 0x2000 + 0x80 * i
		enemies[#enemies + 1] = string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X",
			wr(base), wr16(base + 0x14), wr(base + 7))
	end
	print(string.format(
		"RECS %s f%d 2D=%02X 23=%02X F000=%02X allies(a/rec0/hp/rec5rec7)=%s enemies=%s deadbits=%s",
		tag, frames, wr(0x092D), wr(0x0923), wr(0xF000),
		table.concat(allies, ","), table.concat(enemies, ","), table.concat(deads, ",")))
end

local function do_poke()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for i = 0, 5 do
			local base = 0x2280 + 0x80 * i
			if bit7(wr(base + 7)) == 0 then
				emu.write(base + 0x14, 0x01, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				emu.write(base + 0x15, 0x00, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				local hp = wr16(base + 0x14)
				print(string.format("POKE ally%d rec0=%02X hp>=%04X verify=%04X", i, wr(base), 1, hp))
				if hp ~= 1 then error("poke verify ally " .. i) end
			else
				print(string.format("POKE ally%d already dead rec7=%02X", i, wr(base + 7)))
			end
		end
		for i = 0, 4 do
			local base = 0x2000 + 0x80 * i
			if bit7(wr(base + 7)) == 0 and wr(base) ~= 0xFF and wr(base) ~= 0 then
				emu.write(base + 0x14, 0x0F, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				emu.write(base + 0x15, 0x27, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				local hp = wr16(base + 0x14)
				print(string.format("POKE enemy%d rec0=%02X hp>=%04X verify=%04X", i, wr(base), 0x270F, hp))
				if hp ~= 0x270F then error("poke verify enemy " .. i) end
			end
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FAIL poke-verify " .. tostring(err))
		emu.stop(-1)
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local BITW = { 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 }
local function state_line()
	local ahp, dead = {}, 0
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local base = 0x2280 + 0x80 * i
		ahp[#ahp + 1] = string.format("%04X", wr16(base + 0x14))
		if bit7(wr(base + 7)) == 1 then dead = dead + BITW[i + 1] end
	end
	print(string.format(
		"STATE f%d 76=%02X map=%04X 1B=%02X 5051=%02X%02X f4a3=%04X 1306=%02X 141A=%02X 27=%02X " ..
		"23=%02X q=%02X %02X %02X 1c=%02X %02X efff=%02X 7effff=%02X trace=%d ahp=%s dead=%02X",
		frames, wr(0x76), mapid(), wr(0x091B), wr(0x0950), wr(0x0951), wr16(0xF4A3),
		wr(0x1306), wr(0x141A), wr(0x0927), wr(0x0923),
		wr(0xD6BB), wr(0xD6BD), wr(0xD6BE), wr(0x1C00), wr(0x1C01), wr(0xEFFF), wr(0xFFFF),
		trace_lines, table.concat(ahp, ","), dead))
end

-- ---- main loop ----
print("WIPE1-LOADED")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]

		if frames < SETTLE_FRAME and p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
			local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end

		if frames == SETTLE_FRAME then
			local m = mapid()
			print(string.format("SETTLE f%d map=%04X 76=%02X d6bb=%02X d6bd=%02X d6be=%02X",
				frames, m, wr(0x76), wr(0xD6BB), wr(0xD6BD), wr(0xD6BE)))
			if m ~= 0x0249 or wr(0x76) ~= 0 or wr(0xD6BD) ~= 0xFF then
				print("FAIL settle map=" .. string.format("%04X", m))
				emu.stop(-1)
				return
			end
			armed = true
		end

		if armed and not injected and frames >= INJECT_FRAME then
			injected = true
			inject_frame = frames
			emu.write(0xD6BD, 0x19, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			emu.write(0xD6BE, BATTLE_ID, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			print(string.format("INJECT f%d battle=%02X map=%04X", frames, BATTLE_ID, mapid()))
		end

		if injected and battle_up == nil then
			if wr(0x1306) == BATTLE_ID and wr(0x141A) == 0x09 then
				battle_up = frames
				print(string.format("BATTLE-UP f%d 1306=%02X 141A=%02X map=%04X",
					frames, wr(0x1306), wr(0x141A), mapid()))
				scr_at[frames + 200] = true
				scr_at[frames + 700] = true
			elseif frames > inject_frame + BATTLE_UP_TIMEOUT then
				print("FAIL battle-up timeout 1306=" .. string.format("%02X", wr(0x1306)))
				emu.stop(-1)
				return
			end
		end

		if battle_up ~= nil and not dumped and frames >= battle_up + 400 then
			dumped = true
			recs_line("PRE-POKE")
		end
		if battle_up ~= nil and not poked and frames >= battle_up + 500 then
			if not do_poke() then return end
			poked = true
			recs_line("POST-POKE")
		end

		-- battle drive: A every 30 frames; paused while the defeat window
		-- renders (CE54 .. +90) so the window shot lands pre-confirm; idle
		-- after the outcome packs (field settles clean for observation)
		local in_battle = f4a3_seen == nil
		local suppress = arm_wipe ~= nil and (defeat_window == nil or frames < defeat_window + 90)
		if poked and in_battle and not suppress and frames % 30 == 0 then
			p = { a = 1 }
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)

		if frames % 100 == 0 then state_line() end

		if scr_at[frames] then scr_at[frames] = nil; shot() end

		local fail = nil
		if poked and f4a3_seen ~= nil and battle_up ~= nil and f4a3_seen >= battle_up
			and frames > f4a3_seen + END_OBSERVE then
			state_line()
			recs_line("FINAL")
			print(string.format(
				"VERDICT f4a3=%04X arm_wipe=%s arm_special=%s arm_vict=%s defeat_window=%s " ..
				"scr0e=%s scr13=%s bgm=%s reset=%s return_snap=%s",
				f4a3_val or 0,
				tostring(arm_wipe), tostring(arm_special), tostring(arm_vict),
				tostring(defeat_window), tostring(scr0e), tostring(scr13),
				tostring(bgm_call), tostring(reset_boot), tostring(return_snap)))
			print("WIPE1-DONE")
			emu.stop(0)
			return
		end
		if frames >= HARD_STOP then fail = "hard stop, no outcome" end
		if errruns > 300 then fail = "errstorm" end
		if fail then
			print("FAIL " .. fail)
			emu.stop(-1)
		end
	end)
	if ok then
		errruns = 0
	else
		errruns = errruns + 1
		print("NAV-ERR main " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```

`tools/emulator/wipe2.lua`:

```lua
-- wipe2.lua - VICTORY CONTROL for the wipe probe (wipe1.lua): same
-- injection and watches, but the poke is inverted - allies to 9999 HP,
-- the enemy to 1 - so the A-mash WINS battle 0x0D. Answers whether the
-- post-battle soft boot (C0:0000, 43 frames after the field return) is
-- wipe-specific or fires for any injected battle outcome.
--
-- Flow: journey_teleport.lua's boot+walk verbatim to the settled field
-- (frame 34600, map 0x0249), inject fixed battle 0x0D once via the
-- queue word (docs/mesence-skip-intro.md recipe), then at battle-up+500
-- poke every living ally's battle-record HP word (record +0x14,
-- docs/battle-formulas.md 13.2) to 1 and every living enemy's HP word
-- to 9999 (keep-enemies-alive policy: no victory can fire), then A-mash
-- every 30 frames (tech_damage.lua's battle-drive policy) until lethal
-- enemy actions wipe the party and evaluator C2:9D8A settles $50/$51.
--
-- Watches:
--   write  raw WRAM 0x0950/0x0951 ($50/$51 outcome pair, battle DP
--          $0900), 0xF4A3/0xF4A4 (packed outcome FE:C38B), 0xEFFF
--          (escape grace 67:F630), 0xFFFF ($7E:FFFF handoff),
--          0xD6BB/0xD6BD/0xD6BE (field queue), 0x1C00/0x1C01 (SPC
--          command/track = BGM switch), 0x091B (battle-end flag $1B)
--   exec   C2:08D7 (wipe arm), C2:08AA (special arm), C2:0869 (victory
--          arm) of the C2:0849 jump table, C2:CE54 (defeat window),
--          C1:0296/C1:02F4 (FE screen command 0x0E/0x13 handlers),
--          FE:EEFC (BGM switch call), C0:0000 (reset boot, gated),
--          C0:C0B1-C0:C10A (field return path, gated on the $F4A3
--          write)
--
-- Run: cp -a /tmp/mesence /tmp/wipe-mesence; rm -f
-- /tmp/wipe-mesence/Saves/*.srm (cold boot); then
--   /tmp/wipe-mesence/Mesen -testRunner tools/emulator/wipe1.lua \
--     patches/bokuno_jp.sfc -enableStdout --timeout=900
-- Scratch (log, decoded screenshots): /tmp/wipe/

local BATTLE_ID = 0x0D
local SETTLE_FRAME = 34600
local INJECT_FRAME = 34700
local BATTLE_UP_TIMEOUT = 2600
local END_OBSERVE = 8000        -- frames of field observation after $F4A3
local HARD_STOP = 90000

local WALK = { "down", "right" }
local PRESSES = {}
for f = 300, 6800, 60 do PRESSES[f] = { start = 1 } end
PRESSES[7000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[7800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[8600] = { start = 1 }
PRESSES[9000] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[9800] = { a = 1 }
PRESSES[10600] = { a = 1 }

local frames = 0
local errruns = 0
local armed = false
local injected = false
local inject_frame = nil
local battle_up = nil
local dumped = false
local poked = false
local arm_wipe = nil            -- C2:08D7
local arm_special = nil         -- C2:08AA
local arm_vict = nil            -- C2:0869
local defeat_window = nil       -- C2:CE54
local scr0e = nil               -- C1:0296
local scr13 = nil               -- C1:02F4
local bgm_call = nil            -- FE:EEFC
local reset_boot = nil          -- C0:0000 after f4a3 (the L+R reset path)
local f4a3_seen = nil
local f4a3_val = nil
local return_snap = nil
local scr_at = {}               -- frame -> true, FRMB64 dumps
local scr_logged_size = false
local trace_lines = 0

local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local CHARS = {}
for i = 0, 255 do CHARS[i] = string.char(i) end

local function wr(off) return emu.read(off, emu.memType.snesWorkRam) end
local function wr16(off) return wr(off) + wr(off + 1) * 256 end
local function pctag()
	local st = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
	return string.format("%02X:%04X", st.k, st.pc), st
end
local function mapid() return wr(0x2011) * 256 + wr(0x2012) end
local function bit7(v) return math.floor(v / 128) % 2 end
local function bit2(v) return math.floor(v / 4) % 2 end

local function b64encode(bytes)
	local out = {}
	for i = 1, #bytes, 3 do
		local n = bytes:byte(i) * 65536 + (bytes:byte(i + 1) or 0) * 256 + (bytes:byte(i + 2) or 0)
		local c = { math.floor(n / 262144) % 64, math.floor(n / 4096) % 64, math.floor(n / 64) % 64, n % 64 }
		out[#out + 1] = alphabet:sub(c[1] + 1, c[1] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[2] + 1, c[2] + 1)
			.. alphabet:sub(c[3] + 1, c[3] + 1) .. alphabet:sub(c[4] + 1, c[4] + 1)
	end
	local rem = #bytes % 3
	if rem == 1 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 2) .. "=="
	elseif rem == 2 then
		out[#out] = out[#out]:sub(1, 3) .. "="
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function shot()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local buf = emu.getScreenBuffer()
		if not scr_logged_size then
			scr_logged_size = true
			local ok2, sz = pcall(emu.getScreenSize)
			if ok2 and type(sz) == "table" then
				for k, v in pairs(sz) do print("SCR " .. tostring(k) .. "=" .. tostring(v)) end
			end
			print("SCRBUFLEN " .. #buf)
		end
		local parts = {}
		for i = 1, #buf do
			local v = buf[i]
			parts[#parts + 1] = CHARS[math.floor(v / 65536) % 256]
			parts[#parts + 1] = CHARS[math.floor(v / 256) % 256]
			parts[#parts + 1] = CHARS[v % 256]
		end
		print("FRMB64 f" .. frames .. " " .. b64encode(table.concat(parts)))
	end)
	if not ok then print("NAV-ERR shot " .. tostring(err)) end
end

-- ---- memory callbacks (write watches, sparse; per-tag caps) ----
local wcounts = {}
local function add_write(addr, tag, cap, gate_arm)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function(a, val)
		if gate_arm and arm_wipe == nil then return end
		wcounts[tag] = (wcounts[tag] or 0) + 1
		if wcounts[tag] > (cap or 400) then return end
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local pc = pctag()
			local extra = ""
			if tag == "F4A3" and battle_up == nil then
				extra = " <- pre-battle (montage), ignored"
				print(string.format("W f%d %s %02X>%02X pc=%s%s", frames, tag, wr(a), val, pc, extra))
				return
			end
			if tag == "F4A3" and val ~= 0 then
				f4a3_seen = frames
				f4a3_val = val
				scr_at[frames + 60] = true
				scr_at[frames + 600] = true
				scr_at[frames + 2400] = true
				scr_at[frames + 6000] = true
				extra = " <- OUTCOME PACKED"
			end
			if tag == "1C01" and val == 0x0A then extra = " <- BGM 0x0A track" end
			print(string.format("W f%d %s %02X>%02X pc=%s%s", frames, tag, wr(a), val, pc, extra))
			trace_lines = trace_lines + 1
		end)
		if not ok then print("NAV-ERR w" .. tag .. " " .. tostring(err)) end
	end, emu.callbackType.write, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
end

add_write(0x0950, "50")
add_write(0x0951, "51")

add_write(0xD014, "D014", 40)

local xcounts = {}
local function add_exec(addr, tag, gated, cap)
	emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
		if gated == "f4a3" and (f4a3_seen == nil or battle_up == nil or f4a3_seen < battle_up) then
			return
		end
		if gated == "f4a3" and reset_boot ~= nil and addr == 0xC00000 then return end
		xcounts[tag] = (xcounts[tag] or 0) + 1
		if xcounts[tag] > (cap or 3) then return end
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			local pc = pctag()
			if tag == "ARM-WIPE" then arm_wipe = frames; scr_at[frames + 150] = true end
			if tag == "ARM-SPECIAL" then arm_special = frames end
			if tag == "ARM-VICT" then arm_vict = frames; scr_at[frames + 150] = true end
			if tag == "DEFEAT-WIN" then
				defeat_window = frames
				scr_at[frames + 30] = true
				scr_at[frames + 70] = true
			end
			if tag == "SCR-0E" then scr0e = frames end
			if tag == "SCR-13" then scr13 = frames end
			if tag == "BGM-SW" then bgm_call = frames end
			if tag == "RESET" then
				reset_boot = frames
				local st2 = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
				for k2, v2 in pairs(st2) do
					print("RSTST " .. tostring(k2) .. "=" .. tostring(v2))
				end
				local sbytes = {}
				for i = 1, 24 do
					sbytes[#sbytes + 1] = string.format("%02X",
						emu.read((st2.sp + i) % 0x10000, emu.memType.snesWorkRam))
				end
				print("RSTSTACK sp=" .. string.format("%04X", st2.sp) .. " " .. table.concat(sbytes, " "))
			end
			if tag == "ENQUEUE" then
				local st2 = emu.getCpuState(emu.cpuType.snes)
				local rlo = emu.read((st2.sp + 1) % 0x10000, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				local rhi = emu.read((st2.sp + 2) % 0x10000, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				print(string.format("ENCALL f%d sp=%04X k=%02X return=%02X:%04X", frames,
					st2.sp, st2.k, st2.k, rlo + rhi * 256))
			end
			print(string.format("X f%d %s pc=%s", frames, tag, pc))
			trace_lines = trace_lines + 1
		end)
		if not ok then print("NAV-ERR x" .. tag .. " " .. tostring(err)) end
	end, emu.callbackType.exec, addr, addr, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)
end

-- the software-reset funnel: C0:FF00 stub (SEI/CLC/TYX/JML $C00000) and

-- the field return path: every instruction C0:C0B1..C0:C109 after the
-- $F4A3 write, with A; one RETURN-SNAP of the handoff cells on entry
emu.addMemoryCallback(function()
	if f4a3_seen == nil or battle_up == nil or f4a3_seen < battle_up then return end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		local pc, st = pctag()
		if return_snap == nil then
			return_snap = frames
			print(string.format(
				"RETURN-SNAP f%d pc=%s A=%04X f4a3=%04X 141A=%02X map=%04X 76=%02X 1B=%02X 5051=%02X%02X " ..
				"q=%02X %02X %02X 1c=%02X %02X efff=%02X 7effff=%02X",
				frames, pc, st.a, wr16(0xF4A3), wr(0x141A), mapid(), wr(0x76), wr(0x091B),
				wr(0x0950), wr(0x0951), wr(0xD6BB), wr(0xD6BD), wr(0xD6BE),
				wr(0x1C00), wr(0x1C01), wr(0xEFFF), wr(0xFFFF)))
		end
		print(string.format("RTN f%d pc=%s A=%04X X=%04X Y=%04X", frames, pc, st.a, st.x, st.y))
		trace_lines = trace_lines + 1
	end)
	if not ok then print("NAV-ERR rtn " .. tostring(err)) end
end, emu.callbackType.exec, 0xC0C0B1, 0xC0C10A, emu.cpuType.snes, emu.memType.snesMemory)

-- ---- helpers ----
local function recs_line(tag)
	local allies, enemies, deads = {}, {}, {}
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local base = 0x2280 + 0x80 * i
		allies[#allies + 1] = string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X%02X",
			wr(base), wr16(base + 0x14), wr(base + 5), wr(base + 7))
		deads[#deads + 1] = string.format("%d:%02X", i, wr(base + 7))
	end
	for i = 0, 4 do
		local base = 0x2000 + 0x80 * i
		enemies[#enemies + 1] = string.format("%02X/%04X/%02X",
			wr(base), wr16(base + 0x14), wr(base + 7))
	end
	print(string.format(
		"RECS %s f%d 2D=%02X 23=%02X F000=%02X allies(a/rec0/hp/rec5rec7)=%s enemies=%s deadbits=%s",
		tag, frames, wr(0x092D), wr(0x0923), wr(0xF000),
		table.concat(allies, ","), table.concat(enemies, ","), table.concat(deads, ",")))
end

local function do_poke()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for i = 0, 5 do
			local base = 0x2280 + 0x80 * i
			if bit7(wr(base + 7)) == 0 then
				emu.write(base + 0x14, 0x0F, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				emu.write(base + 0x15, 0x27, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				local hp = wr16(base + 0x14)
				print(string.format("POKE ally%d rec0=%02X hp>=%04X verify=%04X", i, wr(base), 0x270F, hp))
				if hp ~= 0x270F then error("poke verify ally " .. i) end
			else
				print(string.format("POKE ally%d already dead rec7=%02X", i, wr(base + 7)))
			end
		end
		for i = 0, 4 do
			local base = 0x2000 + 0x80 * i
			if bit7(wr(base + 7)) == 0 and wr(base) ~= 0xFF and wr(base) ~= 0 then
				emu.write(base + 0x14, 0x01, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				emu.write(base + 0x15, 0x00, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
				local hp = wr16(base + 0x14)
				print(string.format("POKE enemy%d rec0=%02X hp>=%04X verify=%04X", i, wr(base), 1, hp))
				if hp ~= 1 then error("poke verify enemy " .. i) end
			end
		end
	end)
	if not ok then
		print("FAIL poke-verify " .. tostring(err))
		emu.stop(-1)
		return false
	end
	return true
end

local BITW = { 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 }
local function state_line()
	local ahp, dead = {}, 0
	for i = 0, 5 do
		local base = 0x2280 + 0x80 * i
		ahp[#ahp + 1] = string.format("%04X", wr16(base + 0x14))
		if bit7(wr(base + 7)) == 1 then dead = dead + BITW[i + 1] end
	end
	print(string.format(
		"STATE f%d 76=%02X map=%04X 1B=%02X 5051=%02X%02X f4a3=%04X 1306=%02X 141A=%02X 27=%02X " ..
		"23=%02X q=%02X %02X %02X 1c=%02X %02X efff=%02X 7effff=%02X trace=%d ahp=%s dead=%02X",
		frames, wr(0x76), mapid(), wr(0x091B), wr(0x0950), wr(0x0951), wr16(0xF4A3),
		wr(0x1306), wr(0x141A), wr(0x0927), wr(0x0923),
		wr(0xD6BB), wr(0xD6BD), wr(0xD6BE), wr(0x1C00), wr(0x1C01), wr(0xEFFF), wr(0xFFFF),
		trace_lines, table.concat(ahp, ","), dead))
end

-- ---- main loop ----
print("WIPE2-LOADED (victory control)")

emu.addEventCallback(function()
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		frames = frames + 1
		local p = PRESSES[frames]

		if frames < SETTLE_FRAME and p == nil and frames >= 20800 and frames < 34000 then
			local busy = wr(0x76) ~= 0
			if busy then
				if frames % 30 == 0 then p = { a = 1 } end
			else
				local t = frames - 20800
				if t % 1000 < 900 then
					p = { [WALK[math.floor(t / 1000) % #WALK + 1]] = 1 }
				end
			end
		end

		if frames == SETTLE_FRAME then
			local m = mapid()
			print(string.format("SETTLE f%d map=%04X 76=%02X d6bb=%02X d6bd=%02X d6be=%02X",
				frames, m, wr(0x76), wr(0xD6BB), wr(0xD6BD), wr(0xD6BE)))
			if m ~= 0x0249 or wr(0x76) ~= 0 or wr(0xD6BD) ~= 0xFF then
				print("FAIL settle map=" .. string.format("%04X", m))
				emu.stop(-1)
				return
			end
			armed = true
		end

		if armed and not injected and frames >= INJECT_FRAME then
			injected = true
			inject_frame = frames
			emu.write(0xD6BD, 0x19, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			emu.write(0xD6BE, BATTLE_ID, emu.memType.snesWorkRam)
			print(string.format("INJECT f%d battle=%02X map=%04X", frames, BATTLE_ID, mapid()))
		end

		if injected and battle_up == nil then
			if wr(0x1306) == BATTLE_ID and wr(0x141A) == 0x09 then
				battle_up = frames
				print(string.format("BATTLE-UP f%d 1306=%02X 141A=%02X map=%04X",
					frames, wr(0x1306), wr(0x141A), mapid()))
				scr_at[frames + 200] = true
				scr_at[frames + 700] = true
			elseif frames > inject_frame + BATTLE_UP_TIMEOUT then
				print("FAIL battle-up timeout 1306=" .. string.format("%02X", wr(0x1306)))
				emu.stop(-1)
				return
			end
		end

		if battle_up ~= nil and not dumped and frames >= battle_up + 400 then
			dumped = true
			recs_line("PRE-POKE")
		end
		if battle_up ~= nil and not poked and frames >= battle_up + 500 then
			if not do_poke() then return end
			poked = true
			recs_line("POST-POKE")
		end

		-- battle drive: A every 30 frames; paused while the defeat window
		-- renders (CE54 .. +90) so the window shot lands pre-confirm; idle
		-- after the outcome packs (field settles clean for observation)
		local in_battle = f4a3_seen == nil
		local suppress = arm_wipe ~= nil and (defeat_window == nil or frames < defeat_window + 90)
		if poked and in_battle and not suppress and frames % 30 == 0 then
			p = { a = 1 }
		end
		emu.setInput(p or { start = 0, a = 0 }, 0, 0)

		if frames % 100 == 0 then state_line() end

		if scr_at[frames] then scr_at[frames] = nil; shot() end

		local fail = nil
		if poked and f4a3_seen ~= nil and battle_up ~= nil and f4a3_seen >= battle_up
			and frames > f4a3_seen + END_OBSERVE then
			state_line()
			recs_line("FINAL")
			print(string.format(
				"VERDICT f4a3=%04X arm_wipe=%s arm_special=%s arm_vict=%s defeat_window=%s " ..
				"scr0e=%s scr13=%s bgm=%s reset=%s return_snap=%s",
				f4a3_val or 0,
				tostring(arm_wipe), tostring(arm_special), tostring(arm_vict),
				tostring(defeat_window), tostring(scr0e), tostring(scr13),
				tostring(bgm_call), tostring(reset_boot), tostring(return_snap)))
			print("WIPE2-DONE")
			emu.stop(0)
			return
		end
		if frames >= HARD_STOP then fail = "hard stop, no outcome" end
		if errruns > 300 then fail = "errstorm" end
		if fail then
			print("FAIL " .. fail)
			emu.stop(-1)
		end
	end)
	if ok then
		errruns = 0
	else
		errruns = errruns + 1
		print("NAV-ERR main " .. tostring(err))
	end
end, emu.eventType.inputPolled)

```
